工人英勇保卫苏维埃
建宁工人的榜样

在第五次帝国主义-国民党战役的第一阶段受到红军的挫败后，蒋介石的刽子手们积极准备第二阶段，以努力使自己免于最终的失败。他们决定从各个方向进攻苏维埃。通过取道黎川（江西），他们企图将血腥的手伸向福建建宁。他们大批人马向该城进发。
在这种紧张的气氛中，建宁的工人决心用“头颅（国民党通过斩首处决工人）和鲜血”来保卫苏维埃。为了保卫工农的利益，他们决心不惜任何牺牲击退国民党的进攻。因此，在中国共产党和红色工会的领导下，他们于1934年1月29日宣布总罢工。他们武装起来，立即投入战斗。

罢工委员会

为了加强战争中的领导，为了有计划地执行各项任务，工人们在群众大会上选举最积极的分子加入所谓的“罢工与战争委员会”，该委员会由宣传、组织、动员、援助等部门组成。动员部由红色青年先锋队、担架队、运输队组成，而援助部则负责救济、护理、洗衣、募捐等工作。所有这些机构立即开始运作。
罢工实际上涉及了全体工人。邮政工人和裁缝由于与战争联系更紧密，表现出更多的积极性。他们发起了一场广泛的运动，为罢工者募集资金。他们日夜工作，为击败威胁要包围城市的国民党匪徒做出了巨大贡献。
一部分武装工人立即前往前线，参加打击匪徒的实际战斗。他们经常与红军并肩作战，并与游击队一起冲锋陷阵。由于这些值得我们钦佩的勇敢努力，敌人被阻止并遭受了决定性打击。同时，他们在广宁行动，抓获了两名土豪以及大刀会匪徒的指导员。

守卫后方

另一部分工人在城内承担巡逻任务，以维持秩序并镇压后方的反革命活动。他们加强了对店主的监视，组织了间谍队，组建了支援红军的运输队。更值得注意的是，为前线红色战士筹集了大量钱款和物资，所有钱款和物资都送交红军，鼓舞了他们的战斗力。同时，他们为20名罢工者和90户红军家属筹集了约八十元。县政府除了来自前线的各种通信外，还举行茶话会以表彰工人并赞扬他们的战斗精神。
响应工人的号召，数千名罢工者于2月4日加入了运输工作。他们来自农村，轮流工作。在三天内，动员了1,400人为红军做运输工作。结果大大超过了原计划，这一事实证明了工人在面对敌人新的进攻时的战斗意愿和情绪。

The workers continued the struggle, yes, a hard struggle for fifteen days
routing the enemy and consolidating the rear. As soon as the threatening dan-
ger was over, the strikers retuned to work on the revolutionary production
front. On February 13 the workers triumphantly called off the strike.
Needless to say, the strike of the workers in Chienning was a great aid
to the cause of the revolution and the red army as well. With the enthusiastic
support of the workers the Soviets in Chienning grew much stronger out of the
fight with the KMT bandits. After resumption of work the toilers exerted them-
selves strenuously for the economical reconstruction of the Soviets and for
the increase in production. They, too, made greater efforts in the collection
of cereals, in the sale of governmental bonds. They helped in expanding the
red youth vanguard, in pushing the spring ploughing shock brigade campaign.
The masses of peasantry around Chienning as led by the heroic workers made
the land revolution more penetrating and joined in increasing numbers the red
army and partisans in the continued fight against the remnants of the land-
lord-counterrevolutionaries.

CPC'S APPEAL TO TOILERS OF CHINA AGAINST JAPANESE
AND OTHER IMPERIALISM

{ In reply to the hands off China declaration issued by the Tokio foreign
office the CC of CPC openly called on the masses of China to rise a-
gainst the aggressions of Japanese imperialism in a statement released
for publication on May 5---Ed. }

The CPC publicly appeals to the masses to punish the shameless, betray-
ing counterrevolutionary regime of the KMT at Nanking which openly surrenders
to Japanese imperialism. The CPC calls on all toilers of China to unite them-
selves in revolutionary action against Japanese and other imperialism as well
as against their tool, the KMT government at Nanking; to shatter the attempts
of imperialism in the division of China as well as in its complete colonisa-
tion, to push ahead the sacred struggle of national revolution, to drive out
all imperialism, to build up a China entirely independent and unified without
an inch of territory being yielded to the enemy, to build up a Soviet China,
to fight for the unified revolutionary front in the expansion and defence of
the Soviets in China.
The Japanese statement on April 17 pushes the struggle for the division
and conquest of China to a new phase likely to hasten the outbreak of an im-
perialist war for the hegemony in the Pacific and an armed intervention a-
gainst the USSR.
With the concurrence of Nanking Japanese imperialism has finished the ma-
jor portion of its war preparations in North China against the Soviet Union
as well as for further aggressions on Chinese soil. Apparently securing the
agreement of Nanking, Japanese imperialism openly announced its intention in
the said statement to control the whole of China exclusively.
The hangmen of Nanking desire to sell the toilers of China in support of
Japanese intervention against the Soviet Union. The Japanese military attache
to the Peiping legation told Huang Fu, head of the Peiping political council,
that 'the occupation of Chahar, Suiyuan and Tientsin is based on an absolute
necessity in the offensive against the Soviets Union', a view that is obvious-
ly in agreement with Nanking. Sometime ago Gen. Aoki boasted of the loyal
support of Nanking in the event of a war against USSR. During the way Sun Ko-
taro Japanese aggressions in the north, Nanking has withdrawn its troops from
the Peiping-Tientsin area and transported them southward in an attack on the
Soviets in the borderland between Hunan-Kiangsi-Hupeh.
The direct negotiations now in progress with Japanese imperialism to set-
tle the outstanding issues between China and Japan mean an outright sale of
Chinese national interests to Japanese imperialism. At the same time Japan
is making preliminary moves in south China to wrest Hainan and to intervene
against the growing Soviets in that province. In face of such violent Japanese
aggressions Wang Chin-wei, "left" leader of the Kuomintang (now prime mini-
ster under the virtual dictatorship of Chiang Kai-shek), wired his thanks on
behalf of the KMT government to Japanese imperialism for its friendly attitude
towards China.
Now all KMT leaders and papers preach the doctrine of compromise with Ja-
pan by direct negotiation excusing themselves on the ground of impotence to
fight the invaders. They consider the betrayal as a local matter. At the same
time they advance the theory that the country may fall under foreign rule but
the Soviets and with them the anti-imperialist masses must be massacred.

工人们继续斗争，是的，经过十五天的艰苦斗争，击溃了敌人并巩固了后方。一旦威胁性的危险过去，罢工者就回到革命生产战线上工作。2月13日，工人们胜利地宣布结束罢工。
不用说，建宁工人的罢工对革命事业和红军都是巨大的援助。在工人的热情支持下，建宁的苏维埃在与国民党匪徒的战斗中变得更加强大。复工后，劳苦大众为苏维埃的经济重建和增加生产而努力奋斗。他们在粮食征集和政府债券销售方面也做出了更大的努力。他们帮助扩大红色青年先锋队，推动春耕突击队运动。在建宁周围，在英勇工人的领导下，广大农民使土地革命更加深入，并越来越多的人加入红军和游击队，继续同地主-反革命残余势力作斗争。

中共呼吁中国劳苦大众反对日本
及其他帝国主义

{ 针对东京外务省发表的“不干涉中国”宣言，中共中央于5月5日公开发表声明，公开呼吁中国民众起来反对日本帝国主义的侵略——编者注 }

中共公开呼吁民众惩罚南京国民党无耻的背叛性反革命政权，该政权公然向日本帝国主义投降。中共呼吁中国所有劳苦大众团结起来，采取革命行动，反对日本及其他帝国主义及其工具南京国民党政府；粉碎帝国主义分裂中国以及将其完全殖民化的企图；推进民族革命的神圣斗争；驱逐所有帝国主义；建立一个完全独立统一的中国，不向敌人割让一寸领土；建立苏维埃中国；为扩大和保卫中国苏维埃的统一革命战线而战。
日本4月17日的声明将分裂和征服中国的斗争推向了新阶段，这可能加速爆发争夺太平洋霸权的帝国主义战争以及对苏联的武装干涉。
在南京的默许下，日本帝国主义已完成其在华北针对苏联以及为进一步在中国领土上进行侵略的大部分战争准备。显然获得了南京的同意，日本帝国主义在上述声明中公然宣布其独家控制全中国的意图。
南京的刽子手们希望出卖中国劳苦大众，以支持日本干预反对苏联。日本驻北平公使馆武官告诉北平政务委员会委员长黄郛，“占领察哈尔、绥远和天津是基于进攻苏联的绝对必要”，这一观点显然与南京一致。不久前，青木将军吹嘘说，如果在对苏战争中，南京将给予忠诚支持。在日本北方侵略的过程中，南京已从平津地区撤军，并将其南调，去攻击湘赣鄂边界的苏维埃。
目前正与日本帝国主义进行的旨在解决中日之间悬而未决问题的直接谈判，意味着将中国国家利益 outright 出卖给日本帝国主义。同时，日本正在华南采取初步行动，企图夺取海南岛，并干预该省日益壮大的苏维埃。面对如此剧烈的日本侵略，国民党“左派”领袖汪精卫（现为蒋介石实际独裁统治下的行政院长）代表国民党政府发电感谢日本帝国主义对中国的友好态度。
现在，所有国民党领导人和报纸都宣扬通过直接谈判与日本妥协的教条，以无力抵抗侵略者为借口为自己开脱。他们认为背叛是局部问题。同时，他们提出一种理论，即国家可能落入外国统治之下，但苏维埃以及随之而来的反帝国主义群众必须被屠杀。

and the revolutionary students and intelligentsia to rise immediately a-
gainst the further aggressions of Japanese imperialism and the betrayal of
Nanking.

THE TIGHTENED JAPANESE GRIP ON THE WHOLE OF CHINA
Japanese Preparations for Intervention
in the North as Well as in the South
....................................

Closely following on the heels off declaration made on April 14, Japan-
ese imperialism has taken more threatening moves vis-a-vis China. While in
process of direct negotiations (of course behind closed doors) more Japan-
ese intrigues and plots have come to light from day to day, all designed to
annex Chinese territories by war or penetration. No longer confined to the
north, Japanese aggressions have been aimed at the south, particularly Fukie
n owing to its geographical proximity to the Japanese colony Taiwan or For-
mosa. The formation of the people's government in Fukien last year and the
debacle of that regime under Chiang Kai-shek's pressure early this year
have contributed largely towards the consolidation of Japanese influence in
that province. Coupled with Chiang's pro-Japanese attitude, this consolida-
tion facilitates Japanese colonization of Fukien and intervention against
the expanding Soviets within that province.
Furthermore representatives of Japanese financiers have come to Shang-
hai for the purpose of establishing a Japanese consortium in control of Chi-
na's economy to the exclusion of American and European capitalists. In an at-
tempt to counter act the Japanese scheme representatives of American and
European capital such as Mr.Johnson (US minister), J.H.Rogers (envoy from
the white house), Baron Guillaume (Belgian minister), etc, gathered in the
KMT capital (now virtually moved to Nanchang where Chiang Kai-shek stays)
in the mad scramble for more concessions from the KMT dictator.
According to the bourgeois press the Japanese consul-general at Nanking,
Y.Suma, took a bold step in demanding direct negotiation from Wang Chin-wei
without the intervention from third parties. It is reported that Sir Cadogan,
British minister, will arrive Nanchang to have an interview with Chiang un-
doubtedly on the question of the division of China. The return of Huang Fu,
head of the government at Peiping (an agent of Chiang in carrying on the be-
trayal negotiations) to Shanghai on May 10 from his pleasure trip to Mogan
Shan (a noted summer resort) and his departure for Peiping in the near fu-
ture indicate the rapid progress in the betraying surreptious direct nego-
tiations.

---The Anti-Soviet Alliance

The subjects under discussion between representatives of Nanking and To-
kyo are almost known to everybody. The issues touching on the resumption of
railway and postal service have been almost settled to the satisfaction of
the Japanese. The ministry of communications has instructed the post offices
to forward the Manchurian letters to the recipients in China but tear off the
Manchukuo stamps before delivery. As reported in the Shanghai Sun-pao, trav-
ellers from the north witnessed the Manchukuo cars now running on the Peiping-
Hankow line. Chang Hsueh-liang, commander at Hankow, has withdrawn his troops
from the Peiping area to fight the red army in Hopeh and Honan. These are ad-
ditional evidences testifying to the de facto recognition of the Manchukuo
by Nanking in full compliance with the Japanese demands. The time will not be
distant when Nanking will accord the Manchukuo a de jure recognition.
At the time of the Nanchang conference between Chiang and Huang Fu the
correspondent of the China Weekly Review (American) reported the Japanese
dream of bringing Nanking into the anti-Soviet alliance. This is in line
with the information given by the London Daily Express to the effect that
acting under direct instructions of German imperialism Gen. von Seeckt, now
acting as chief advisor (military) to Chiang Kai-shek, will train and con-
trol the Chinese army with a view to turning it over to the Japanese in case
the latter should decide to attack USSR.
Nanking officials openly and complacently talking about the Japanese mi-
litary preparations in the north and said that the sole objective of such pre-
parations is USSR. The same official circles are no doubt ready to give the
Japanese every help and aid in this respect. The Japanese are reported to
spend $ 10,000,000 on the construction of a line from Jehol to east Siber,
and preliminary surveying has been completed. This is of course fully approv-
ed of by Huang Fu and Ho Ying-chin, head of the military in the north. With

随后，该呼吁书继续号召工人、农民、其他劳动者以及革命学生和知识分子立即奋起，反对日本帝国主义的进一步侵略和南京的背叛。

日本对整个中国加紧控制
日本在北方及南方的干涉准备
....................................

紧随着4月14日发表的声明之后，日本帝国主义对中国采取了更具威胁性的举动。在进行直接谈判（当然是在幕后秘密进行）的过程中，日本的阴谋诡计日益暴露，其目的均在于通过战争或渗透手段吞并中国领土。日本的侵略不再局限于北方，而是将矛头指向南方，特别是福建省，因其地理位置靠近日本殖民地台湾（福尔摩沙）。去年福建人民政府的成立，以及今年初在蒋介石压力下该政权的溃败，极大地促成了日本在该省势力的巩固。加上蒋介石的亲日态度，这种势力的巩固为日本殖民福建以及干涉该省内不断扩大的苏维埃运动提供了便利。
此外，日本金融界代表已抵达上海，旨在建立一个由日本控制的财团，以掌控中国经济，排挤美国和欧洲资本家。为了对抗日本的图谋，美国和欧洲资本的代表，如约翰逊先生（美国公使）、J.H.罗杰斯（白宫特使）、纪尧姆男爵（比利时公使）等，聚集在国民党首都（实际上已迁至南昌，蒋介石驻跸于此），疯狂争夺从国民党独裁者那里获取更多特权。
据资产阶级报刊报道，日本驻南京总领事须磨弥吉郎（Y.Suma）采取大胆步骤，要求与汪精卫进行直接谈判，排除第三方干预。据报道，英国公使卡多根爵士（Sir Cadogan）将抵达南昌会见蒋介石，议题无疑涉及瓜分中国的问题。北平政府首脑黄郛（作为蒋介石进行背叛谈判的代理人）于5月10日从莫干山（著名避暑胜地）度假返回上海，并将于近期启程前往北平，这表明秘密的直接背叛谈判正在迅速推进。

---反苏联盟

南京与东京代表之间讨论的议题几乎人尽皆知。关于恢复铁路和邮政服务的问题，已基本按照日本人的意愿得到解决。交通部已指示各邮局将寄往中国收件人的满洲信件予以投递，但在投递前撕去伪满洲国邮票。据上海《申报》报道，来自北方的旅客目睹伪满洲国的列车如今已在平汉线上运行。汉口司令张学良已将部队从北平地区撤出，转而在河北和河南进攻红军。这些是南京完全顺应日本要求、事实上承认伪满洲国的额外证据。南京给予伪满洲国法律上承认的日子已为期不远。
在蒋介石与黄郛举行南昌会议期间，《密勒氏评论报》（美国）的记者报道了日本企图将南京纳入反苏联盟的梦想。这与伦敦《每日快报》提供的信息相符，该报称，在德国帝国主义的直接指令下行事的塞克特将军（Gen. von Seeckt，现任蒋介石的首席军事顾问），将训练和控制中国军队，以便在日本决定攻击苏联时将其移交给日本方面。
南京官员公开且沾沾自喜地谈论日本在北方的军事准备，并称此类准备的唯一目标就是苏联。同一官方圈子无疑准备在此方面给予日本一切帮助和支持。据报道，日本花费1,000万美元修建从热河到东西伯利亚的铁路线，初步勘测已经完成。这当然得到了黄郛和北方军事首领何应钦的充分批准。随着

the consent of the same authorities the Japanese are now constructing an aerodrome at Tientsin covering some 1,000 Chinese mow. The KMT is actively abetting the Japanese in robbing China of her territory and in pushing the military preparations against USSR.

The Southward Policy

In May 2 the Ta Wan Pao of Shanghai carried the report that the Japanese will seize Hanoi and Amoy, and turn these two ports (Fukien) into Japanese naval bases within one or two months. And the report is said to be based on good authority, that is, it leaks out from the consular body at Shamcen, the foreign settlement near Canton. According to the Reuter message dated May 4 the Japanese will hold an "opposite shore (referring to Fukien and Kwangtung) conference to be attended by consuls from Foochow, Amoy, Swatow, Hong Kong and Canton. And the foreign office and colonial ministry at Tokyo as well as the governor of Taiwan will despatch representatives to the conference. According to the China Times of May 4 the agenda of the conference includes formation a south China chamber of commerce, liquidation of the anti-Japanese boycott movement in south China, development of fishery along the south China coast, all connected with the offensive to be undertaken against the provinces in the south. On May 1 the military attaches and residents in Fukien decided at a secret meeting to demand more armed police for protection.

In the past few weeks the Japanese were quite busy in sending men to the interior of the province of Fukien. A number of Japanese were found in Chuanchow, Putien, Yinping, Chienao, Yin-an, etc, all situated far in the interior. They were engaged in making surveys. By the way more Japanese warships arrived in Foochow and Amoy. And more Japanese battleships will arrive, it has been stated. The concentration of Japanese forces in south China together the growing activities of individual Japanese has so far accomplished one thing: exposure of the Kwangtung authorities as a lackey of Japanese imperialism who immediately put a ban on demonstrations scheduled for May 7 and 9 against Japanese invasion in sharp contrast with the anti-Japanese phrases which they used to pour out to deceive the people.

With the arrival of influential Japanese capitalists at Shanghai like Takayama of the Asia Colonisation corporation, etc, the Japanese demand for Sino-Manchurian-Nipponese economic block has been taking a concrete shape.

MANCHURIAN PEASANTS IN SELF-DEFENCE
............

In spite of the KMT suppression in the interest of Japanese imperialism the toilers in Manchuria have been ceaselessly fighting the Japanese invaders. Their fight has become more violent in the lower Sungari and in east Manchuria. The anti-Japanese volunteers operated from a firm base in Panshi.

Owing to the breakout of the volunteer activities 17 villages in Ilan, lower Sungari, were wiped out by Japanese bombardment sometime ago. 20,000 peasants were slaughtered. The Japanese killed the peasantry en masse because they wanted to make room for the arrival of Japanese immigrants. As a matter of fact, Japanese immigrants flooded the whole of Manchuria, especially the north where, as is known to every body, Japanese war preparations against USSR have been speeded up all the time. At present Manchuria is full of Japanese immigrants estimated at from 200,000 to 300,000. Chinese peasants were driven out to make way for Japanese colonists. The fields evacuated by the Chinese were given to Japanese.

The angered peasants are more susceptible of the influence of the volunteers. Sometime in March a detachment of Manchurian troops stationed at Ilan mutinied and fought hand in hand with the peasants in the vicinity against Japanese troops, and defeated them in the first rounds. Later on the fight spread over involving new peasants. The Kwantung army detailed 40 planes and a large number of troops but the volunteers and armed peasants refused to be daunted, still making a stand in Ilan. The Japanese gunfire devastated whole villages and according to the KMT central news agency not less than 50,000 were slain by Japanese.

The peasants are determined to put up a stiff resistance. The Wah-lien news gave out the information that to show their determination to fight imperialism the anti-Japanese peasants have even gone so far as to kill their wives and children. The volunteers often scored victories in face of the superior Japanese forces. On April 9 some 1,000 volunteers stormed Wah-chuan and occupied it after fierce fighting. In the middle of April another volunteer army captured Tung-kiang city in lower Sungari.

这些当局的同意，日本人目前正在天津修建一个占地约1,000中国亩的机场。国民党正积极怂恿日本掠夺中国领土，并推动针对苏联的军事准备。

南进政策

5月2日，上海《大晚报》刊载报道说，日本将在一两个月内占领河内和厦门，并将这两个港口（福建）变为日本海军基地。据说该报道来源可靠，即消息泄露自广州附近外国租界沙面的领事团。根据5月4日的路透社消息，日本将举行一次“对岸会议”（指福建和广东），福州、厦门、汕头、香港和广州的领事将出席会议。东京的外务省、殖民部以及台湾总督也将派遣代表参加会议。据5月4日《字林西报》（China Times）报道，会议议程包括组建华南商会、清算华南地区的抵制日货运动、发展华南沿海渔业，所有这些都与即将对南方各省采取的攻势有关。5月1日，驻福建的武官和侨民在一次秘密会议上决定要求增派武装警察以提供保护。

在过去几周里，日本人忙于向福建省内地派遣人员。在泉州、莆田、延平（音译，Yinping）、建瓯（音译，Chienao）、永安（音译，Yin-an）等地发现了许多日本人，这些地方都位于内陆深处。他们从事测量工作。顺便提一下，更多日本军舰抵达福州和厦门。据悉，还将有更多日本战舰抵达。日军在华中的集结以及日本个人活动的增加，迄今为止造成一个结果：揭露了广东当局作为日本帝国主义走狗的面目，他们立即禁止了原定于5月7日和9日举行的反对日本侵略的示威活动，这与他们过去用来欺骗民众的反日辞令形成了鲜明对比。

随着高山（Takayama，音译）等东亚拓殖株式会社（Asia Colonisation corporation）有影响力的日本资本家抵达上海，日本对中日满经济集团的要求已呈现出具体形态。

满洲农民的自卫
............

尽管国民党出于日本帝国主义的利益进行镇压，满洲的劳动者仍在不停地抗击日本侵略者。他们的战斗在下松花江地区和东满变得更加激烈。抗日义勇军在磐石拥有稳固的基地。

由于义勇队活动的爆发，不久前下松花江依兰县的17个村庄被日本轰炸夷为平地。2万农民遭到屠杀。日本人大规模杀害农民，因为他们想为日本移民的到来腾出空间。事实上，日本移民涌入了整个满洲，特别是北部，众所周知，那里针对苏联的战备工作一直在加速。目前，满洲遍布日本移民，估计人数在20万至30万之间。中国农民被驱逐，为日本殖民者让路。中国人撤离的田地被分配给了日本人。

愤怒的农民更容易受到义勇队的影响。3月间，驻扎在依兰的一支满洲部队发生兵变，并与附近农民联手对抗日军，在首轮战斗中击败了他们。后来，战斗范围扩大，卷入的新农民越来越多。关东军出动了40架飞机和大量部队，但义勇队和武装农民毫不畏惧，仍在依兰坚持抵抗。日本的炮火摧毁了整个村庄，据国民党中央通讯社报道，至少有5万人被日本人杀害。

农民决心进行顽强抵抗。《华联新闻》（Wah-lien news，音译）发布消息称，为了显示抗击帝国主义的决心，抗日农民甚至杀死了自己的妻儿。面对占优势的日军，义勇队经常取得胜利。4月9日，约1,000名义勇队员突袭华川（Wah-chuan，音译），经过激战后占领了该地。4月中旬，另一支义勇军攻占了松花江下游的汤江城（Tung-kiang，音译）。

THE RED ARMY REASSERTED THEMSELVES
Repudiating the reported success of the KMT troops, the red army has recently defeated the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th divisions of the Szechuan army under Liu Hsiang, capturing 500 rifles, 20 guns. In the opening days of May the red army took back Wan yuan, Szechuan. In south Szechuan Comrade Ho Lung captured Panshui and arrested one pastor by the name of H.A.Smith.

IX. Remarks
The stastics for the month under review are compiled on incomplete information. We have been unable to gather any data from south China.
During the present month big strikes have broken out in North China and Shanghai. The Tongshan miners, altogether struck work demanding higher wages and better treatment. In the course of the struggle the strikers smashed the yellow unions and came to bloody clashes with police and soldiers. On April 17 the miners at Tongkiachun and Siling went on a strike and raised up the same demands. While coming back from work, the Tongkiachun workers were stopped by police and robbed of their coal which was usually granted them as an allowance in fuel. Angered by this fresh outrage, the workers clashed with the offending armed police, suffering one death and several wounded. Then a strike flared up. Over a dozen of worker-leaders were arrested by the KMT under direct instructions from imperialism (the Lailan Coal Co. is a British concern). The KMT tried to alienate the mass of workers from their leaders and to prevent other workers from coming to the aid of the strikers by casting calumnies on the Tongkiachun workers and falsely charging them with traitorous actions in favor of Japanese imperialism. The Kuomintang hopes in this way to protect the interests of British capitalists in the Kailan mine at the expense of Chinese workers.
The Mayar strike at Shanghai is likewise a big scale struggle, details of which have been given in our previous issues. In this struggle the strikers have shown almost unequalled heroism and set to naught all imperialist-KMT attempts to break the strike. Holding stiff to their demands, the strikers refused to resume work untill April 22 when the KMT fascists and police cooperated in dragging the workers back one by one and declared "workers have all returned". In support of the Mayar workers the operatives of the 15 silk mills in E. Shanghai struck work. With the same end in view the unemployed of the Chin-tai Rubber Mill staged a struggle. On April 12 a telegram over the signature of the All-China Federation of Labor, of the Agricultural Workers Union, the Handicraft Workers Union, the Transport Workers Union, etc., was dispatched to the Mayar strikers together with $ 100 collected for them.
Last February the rickshaw coolies in Soochow called a strike in protest against an order of the police which put a ban on their solicitation of business at railway station . They proclaimed a strike once more against the action of the police in interdicting empty rickshaws to run on the street. They organised pickets against strike breakers. On April 27 the police was routed when attempting to interfere with the pickets. The strikers suffered 30 casualties.
As a result of the shutting down of the Yu-feng Cotton Mill in Chenchow, of the 1st Cotton Mill at Wuchang, of the arsenal at Tsinan, the volume of unemployment has been swollen up considerably. The crew of all the salt boats in Huai-an-yu, Kiangsu, was, owing to failure in competition with steamships, threatened with unemployment. The collapse of the silk filatures at Shanghai has thrown out 60,000 workers. Unemployment figures are mounting every day under imperialist-KMT misrule.
The month under review is noted for the jump in the number of clashes on the part of workers with the police and military. Such clashes of demonstrations have increased by 18, resulting in the arrest of 290 workers or six times as many as in the preceding month.

九、备注
本月统计数据基于不完整的信息编制。我们未能收集到华南地区的任何数据。
本月，华北和上海爆发了大规模罢工。唐山矿工全体罢工，要求提高工资和改善待遇。在斗争过程中，罢工者捣毁了黄色工会，并与警察和士兵发生了血腥冲突。4月17日，唐家庄和林西的矿工举行罢工，提出了同样的要求。唐家庄工人下班回家时，被警察拦下，抢走了通常作为燃料津贴发给他们的煤炭。工人们被这一新的暴行激怒，与肇事的武装警察发生冲突，造成一人死亡，数人受伤。随后罢工爆发。十多名工人领袖在帝国主义的直接指示下被国民党逮捕（开滦煤矿公司是英国企业）。国民党试图通过诽谤唐家庄工人，诬陷他们从事有利于日本帝国主义的叛国行为，来离间广大工人与其领袖的关系，并阻止其他工人援助罢工者。国民党希望以此方式，牺牲中国工人的利益来保护开滦煤矿中英国资本家的利益。
上海的美亚罢工同样是一场大规模斗争，详情已在我们之前的期刊中给出。在这场斗争中，罢工者表现出了几乎无与伦比的英雄气概，使帝国主义和国民党破坏罢工的企图化为泡影。罢工者坚持要求，拒绝复工，直到4月22日，国民党法西斯分子和警察合作，将工人逐个拖回，并宣称“工人已全部复工”。为支持美亚工人，上海东区的15家丝厂工人举行罢工。出于同样的目的，正泰橡胶厂的失业工人也开展了斗争。4月12日，中华全国总工会、农业工人工会、手工业工人工会、运输工人工会等联名向美亚罢工者发出电报，并附上了为他们募集的100美元。
今年二月，苏州的人力车夫举行罢工，抗议警察禁止他们在火车站揽客的命令。他们再次宣布罢工，反对警察禁止空车在街上行驶的措施。他们组织纠察队对付破坏罢工者。4月27日，警察在试图干涉纠察队时被击退。罢工者有30人伤亡。
由于常州裕丰纱厂、武昌第一纱厂以及济南兵工厂的关闭，失业人数大幅增加。江苏淮安圩的所有盐船船员，因无法与轮船竞争而面临失业威胁。上海缫丝厂的倒闭导致6万名工人失业。在帝国主义和国民党的糟糕统治下，失业人数每天都在攀升。
本月值得注意的是，工人与警察及军队的冲突次数激增。此类示威冲突增加了18起，导致290名工人被捕，是上个月的六倍。

OUR VICTORIOUS STUBBORN FIGHT DURING 5TH DRIVE

(This is an article by Comrade Chow En-lai, head of the politi-
cal department for the red army, specially written for the red
star, organ of the Soviet military council, which published it)
(on March 18, 1934---Ed.
....................................

Imperialism and KMT started its 5th drive from the fight around Lichuan
last October with the central Soviet district (Kiangsi) as their main objec-
tive. All fighting previous to the attack on Lichuan forms only a prelude to
the major war, that is, the 5th campaign.
A rather long period of preparations preceded the 5th drive on the part
of the enemy. A change in tactics took place: a stubborn struggle plus the
forts system. The transformation became as clear as water since the commence-
ment of the major war.

The enemy learned the lesson of the successive defeats suffered during
the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th drives. All such tactics as advancement step by step,
offensive on a joint front, simultaneous attack from different directions
launched by crack units, etc, have all failed to save the enemy from defeat
at our hands. As a consequence, large number of officials and men were taken
prisoners, large quantities of ammunitions fell into our hands. Often still,
oftentimes the vanquished units could not recover from the blow during the
course of two or three years. Our success always brought large territory un-
der the Soviets. The crushing blows delivered to the enemy shook the KMT rule
as well as the troops. Men and officers of the white army lost confidence in
the success of the war. Even the Tuhao-landlord-bourgeoisie are forced by
facts to recognize the utter impotence of the KMT, to say nothing of the pet-
ty bourgeoisie who loses faith in the ruling classes.

Taught by the lesson of successive failures, the KMT, particularly im-
perialism, has become fully awaken to the impossibility of destroying the Soviets
within a short period. Hence the adoption of the tactics of the protracted
war. We are supposed to be wiped out by this war supported by the forts sys-
tem and the blockade. The following changes are observed to have taken place
in the organisation of the enemy troops, calculated to increase the efficien-
cy of the KMT bandits in fighting us.

In the first place,
Last autumn Chiang Kai-shek reorganised his army to meet the difficulties
encountered in fighting the red army. The size of the division was reduced to
three regiments in order to be suited to the fighting among the mountains.
Instead of equipping each battalion with 100 heavy machine guns, Chiang has
given each regiment only 100 machine guns while each company has three more
light machine guns than before. The non-combatant elements within the army
have been cut while the combatants have increased.

As to tactics, Chiang decided to strike us principally from the north route
now with the east route (Fukien) in addition. He put his crack and reliable
divisions in the vanguard (such divisions are now officered by the fascist
cadets) but assigned the duty of defence to other unreliable units.

我们在第五次“围剿”中的胜利顽强战斗

（本文系红军政治部主任周恩来同志为苏维埃军事委员会机关报《红星报》特约撰写，该报已刊登此文）
（1934年3月18日——编者注。）
....................................

帝国主义和国民党去年十月以中央苏区（江西）为主要目标，从黎川周围的战斗开始了第五次“围剿”。进攻黎川之前的所有战斗仅构成大战，即第五次战役的前奏。
敌人在发动第五次“围剿”之前进行了相当长时期的准备。战术发生了变化：持久战加上堡垒体系。自大战开始以来，这种转变已变得如水般清晰。

敌人吸取了在第一、二、三、四次“围剿”中接连失败的教训。诸如步步为营、联合战线进攻、由精锐部队从不同方向同时发起攻击等所有战术，均未能使敌人免于被我军击败。结果，大量官兵被俘，大量弹药落入我手。更常见的是，败军往往在两三年内无法从打击中恢复元气。我们的胜利总是使大片领土纳入苏维埃管辖。给予敌人的沉重打击动摇了国民党的统治及其军队。白军的官兵对战争胜利失去了信心。即使是土豪-地主-资产阶级也不得不面对现实，承认国民党的彻底无能，更不用说那些对统治阶级失去信心的小资产阶级了。

国民党，特别是帝国主义，从接连失败的教训中受到教育，已充分意识到在短期内消灭苏维埃是不可能的。因此，他们采取了持久战的战术。我们被认为将通过这场由堡垒体系和封锁支持的战争被消灭。据观察，敌军组织发生了以下变化，旨在提高国民党匪徒与我们作战的效率。

首先，
去年秋天，蒋介石为应对与红军作战中遇到的困难，重组了他的军队。师的规模缩减为三个团，以适应山地作战。蒋介石不再给每个营配备100挺重机枪，而是只给每个团配备100挺机枪，而每个连比之前多配备三挺轻机枪。军队中的非战斗人员被削减，而战斗人员有所增加。

至于战术，蒋介石决定主要从北路打击我们，并辅以东路（福建）。他将精锐且可靠的师团置于先锋位置（这些师团现在由法西斯学员担任军官），但将防御任务分配给其他不可靠的部队。那些总是被红军击溃的部队，现在仅被用作牵制

on the red army only. At the beginning of the 5th drive Chiang relied on the
north route as the main mainstay in the offensive against the Soviets with the
east, south and west routes the auxiliary aide. This state of affairs lasted
about three months during which we gained brilliant successes in Sinkow, Hsu-
wan and Tantsen, all located in Kiangsi. Within the same period the 19th route
army mutinied. All these facts upset the plan of Chiang in the initial stage
of the offensive. With the collapse of the 19th route army Chiang arranged
an attack from the east (from Fukien). Chiang's north route aims at Kwang-
chang while the east route at Tailin, Chionning and Lieuchen (cities in Fu-
kien).
The enemy has thrown 320 regiments into the battle against us, distribut-
ed among the following four routes:
NORTH ROUTE: 25 divisions, 1 independent brigade, totalling 99 regiments.
The KMT bandits are concentrated here and, for the most part,
form the crack units of Chiang.
EAST ROUTE: 14 divisions and 1 independent brigade totalling 71 regiments.
These are for the most part Chiang's personal troops.
WEST ROUTE: 14 divisions and 5 independent brigades, aggregating 41 regi-
ments which, for the most part, come from Hunan.
SOUTH ROUTE: 9 divisions and 1 independent brigade numbering 41 regiments
all coming from Canton.
Thus the enemy forces at the front are 66 divisions, 8 independent brigades,
totalling 320 regiments, numbering 600,000-700,000 men. In other words, out
of the 99 divisions of the KMT 2/3 have been sent at the front against the
Soviets. 70% of the KMT soldiers are compelled to fight us now.
Except the 1st and 2nd divisions now fighting the 4th red army in Szechuan,
except the 25th division defeated in Jehol, Chiang's personal troops have
practically all come to Kiangsi. Moreover, Chiang is calling for more troops
from the north. According to the statistics published by the headquarters at
Nanchang some 100,000 new recruits were enlisted from Honan, Anhwei and Kiang-
su in order to make up the losses of the defeated units.

Training of Cadres

Following the tragical defeat of the 4th drive Chiang resolved to train
more new cadres, placing special emphasis on the tactics of climbing moun-
tains, searching, reconnoitring, defending, etc. The forts as a defence a-
gainst the red army was stressed, too. The new cadres are more clever and
cautious than the old who always suffered crushing defeats in succession. The
primitive forts afforded a certain measure of protection to the KMT
troops. Menaced by a defeat from the red army, the KMT troops may withdraw
into the forts immediately. In spite of these improvements the KMT will suffer
inevitable reverse during the 5th drive.
Chiang also obtained financial aid from imperialism (e.g. the $50,000,000
cotton and wheat loan from U.S.) as well as from Chinese bankers who bought
Chiang's bonds or gave him ready cash whenever he called for it. Besides buy-
ing large quantities of arms and ammunitions from imperialist countries Chi-
ang ordered the arsenals at Hankow and Hangchow to work day and night for sup-
plies to the Kiangsi front against the Soviets.
Chiang put 100,000 vast army in a tiny place but he can not secure e-
nough food to feed it. The blockade enforced by the red army is quite effect-
ive in cutting off the rice supply. Chiang must import rice from abroad. The
coolies impressed by Chiang for carrying rice always eat up one third of what
they carry on their shoulders. Here is another disadvantage for Chiang. An-
other thing----Chiang is forced to organise a large number of carriers for the
regular army to carry things for the soldiers. One fifth of the army is com-
posed of carriers. Out of 15,000 men of a full division 3,000 are carriers.
The lack of road facilities is another weak point. A rice carrier from Can-
ton, Kwangtung, may finish the rice at the end of his journey in Tayu, Kiang-
si. Hence the construction of more roads which, as a rule, are built up by
the peasants without pay and provision of food. The soldiers must take part
in road construction in addition to fighting.
The enemy makes use of tactics both old-fashioned and modern. They form
up in the formations of columns, but sometimes use columns of two ranks in
the field. He said that they can not be caught unless the road is blocked and
that the enemy wants to advance on by themselves. He also organises counter-
revolutionary activities in Soviet territory.
The above are the preparations of the KMT for a prolonged war under the
direction of imperialism.

红军的棋子。在第五次“围剿”开始时，蒋介石依靠北路作为进攻苏维埃的主要支柱，东、南、西路则作为辅助。这种状态持续了大约三个月，在此期间，我们在位于江西的新沟、浒湾和潭头取得了辉煌胜利。同一时期，第十九路军发生兵变。所有这些事实打乱了蒋介石在进攻初期的计划。随着第十九路军的崩溃，蒋介石安排了从东部（从福建）发起的攻击。蒋介石的北路目标是广昌，而东路的目标是泰宁、建宁和黎川（福建的城市）。
敌人已向战场投入了320个团与我们作战，分布在以下四条路线上：
北路：25个师，1个独立旅，共计99个团。国民党匪徒集中于此，大部分构成蒋介石的精锐部队。
东路：14个师和1个独立旅，共计71个团。这些大部分是蒋介石的嫡系部队。
西路：14个师和5个独立旅，合计41个团，大部分来自湖南。
南路：9个师和1个独立旅，共计41个团，全部来自广东。
因此，前线的敌军兵力为66个师，8个独立旅，共计320个团，人数达60万至70万人。换句话说，国民党99个师中有三分之二已被派往对抗苏维埃的前线。70%的国民党士兵现在被迫与我们作战。
除了目前在四川与红四方面军作战的第1和第2师，以及在热河战败的第25师外，蒋介石的嫡系部队实际上都已来到江西。此外，蒋介石正从北方征调更多部队。根据南昌总部公布的统计数据，为了弥补战败部队的损失，从河南、安徽和江苏招募了约10万名新兵。

干部训练

在第四次“围剿”惨败之后，蒋介石决心训练更多新干部，特别强调爬山、搜索、侦察、防御等战术。作为对抗红军的防御手段，堡垒体系也受到重视。新干部比那些总是接连遭受毁灭性失败的老干部更聪明、更谨慎。原始的堡垒为国民党军队提供了一定程度的保护。受到红军击败的威胁时，国民党军队可以立即撤入堡垒。尽管有这些改进，国民党在第五次“围剿”期间仍不可避免地会遭受挫折。
蒋介石还从帝国主义那里获得了财政援助（例如来自美国的5000万美元棉麦借款），以及从中国银行家那里获得资金，这些银行家购买蒋介石的债券或在他需要时提供现金。除了从帝国主义国家购买大量武器弹药外，蒋介石还命令汉口和杭州的兵工厂日夜开工，为江西反苏维埃前线供应物资。
蒋介石将10万大军集中在狭小地区，但他无法确保足够的粮食来供养这支军队。红军实施的封锁在切断大米供应方面非常有效。蒋介石必须从国外进口大米。被蒋介石强征运米的苦力总是吃掉他们肩上所扛货物的三分之一。这是蒋介石的另一个不利因素。另一件事是——蒋介石被迫为正规军组织大量挑夫为士兵运送物品。五分之一的军队由挑夫组成。在一个满编师的15,000人中，有3,000人是挑夫。
道路设施的缺乏是另一个弱点。一名来自广东广州的运米苦力，可能在到达江西南雄的终点时就把米吃光了。因此需要修建更多道路，通常情况下，这些道路是由没有报酬和食物供给的农民修建的。士兵除了作战外，还必须参与修路。
敌人使用古老和现代的战术。他们组成纵队队形，但有时在野外使用双列纵队。他说，除非道路被封锁，否则他们不会被抓住，而且敌人想要自行推进。他还在苏维埃领土内组织反革命活动。
以上是国民党在帝国主义指导下为持久战所做的准备。

Relying on the economic blockade to strangle us, on the mines and arsenals
to turn out more arms and ammunitions, on the transportation system under its
control, on the domination of sea ports, on imperialism to isolate us from the
world revolutionary movement, on news blockade to shut off all victories of the
red army and isolate us from the national revolutionary movement in China the
KMT has prepared to carry on the protracted war. While recognizing to a certain
extent the harmful effects of these factors on us we should not forget the fact
that the mighty force of the people and the powerful red army have grown up out
of the anti-imperialist land revolution. They are, indeed, so powerful that
they will, we firmly believe, break through the restrictions imposed by imper-
ialism and KMT sooner or later. They will link with the world and Chinese re-
volutionary-forces. Here is a factor beyond the sunny perception of the enemy.
Our workers and peasants are found in possession of supreme militancy and crea-
tive power of the new classes in sharp with the landlord and bourgeoisie who
are feeble and corrupted sinking down every day. Depending on the mighty stren-
gth of the masses and the red army we will win the protracted war. Under this
condition our enemy will suffer his final defeat.

Our Struggle Victorious

What successes have we scored in the past five and a half months of sus-
tained struggle?
In the first place, to the surprise of the KMT our red army fighting at
the front all the time has never proved weakened as expected by the enemy. On
the contrary, the red army has strengthened considerably as well as expanded
tremendously to the great disappointment of the KMT. The red army desisted from
the usual practice of sending a batch of its ranks to the rear for rest after
a victory. The discontinuance is rendered desirable by the ceaseless onslaught
of the enemy. Besides, the red army has improved its military training and po-
litical level.
As to the expansion of the red army it may be stated that the red army is
now one and a half larger than it was last May. The said extension does not
include the reserves, training corps and independent regiments which have in-
creased in numbers, too. The red army has reached the largest number ever re-
corded in the central Soviet territory. The shock movement for the expansion
of the red army has been crowned with startling success. The quota of new red
recruits for February has exceeded the original plan in Kiangsi. The red army
Hung Tung Pei has doubled while that in North Fukien has enlarged by 50%. All
the neighboring Soviet districts have shown expansion of the red army at great-
er or lesser speed.
The recruits enlisted from the village do not need much time in learning
the art of fighting. They prove as efficient as the old fighters in the pro-
cess of learning. This is made possible through the political class condition.
After less than one month the newly formed young communists division has wip-
ed out the units of Chow Tse-chun by walking 80 li a day. The glorious 48th
regiment has for two months resisted successfully the attack of the enemy
which was three times larger. The Juikin division composed of new recruits
bravely fought against five divisions of the enemy at Lichuan. In the light of
such facts the red army always won the stubborn fight.
For training and educating the red army's four military schools were add-
ed to the sole one already in existence with the attendance of the students
doubled. The cadets, mostly of the worker and peasant class, are candidates
for higher and middle officers. And some of the cadets have been promoted to
high positions for the formation of new divisions. The cadres for artillery,
engineering, air defence, chemical warfare, etc, have also increased. The
wireless sets have augmented by four times as compared with the 6th drive
while wireless students are sufficient in number to do the necessary work. Doc-
tors are now more numerous than before. At present we have two doctors for
each improvised hospital.
The overwhelming majority of such cadres come from the worker and peasant
class. They master in one year what takes five or six years for those from
the landlord-bourgeois class. These cadres are a sufficient check to the im-
perialist-KMT offensives as well as to the opportunists among our ranks who
had no faith in the promotion of new cadres.
While admitting of difficulties in connection with military supplies on
our part, we have been fighting persistently and successfully in overcoming
these obstacles. Our finances are placed on a sound footing capable of raising
sufficient funds for the red army which in former times shouldered the main re-
sponsibility of filling the red war chest. Now the red army takes only secondary
part in collecting money for military purposes. From last September to January
1934 our military expenditures for each month has increased by 40% to 45% but
is covered by the masses who pay the land tax, buy the bonds or donate grain
and money.

国民党企图依靠经济封锁来扼杀我们，依靠兵工厂和军火库生产更多的武器弹药，依靠其控制下的运输系统，依靠对海港的支配，依靠帝国主义将我们与世界革命运动隔离开来，依靠新闻封锁来掩盖红军的所有胜利并将我们与中国国内的革命运动隔离开来，从而准备进行持久战。虽然在一定程度上承认这些因素对我们有害，但我们不应忘记这样一个事实：强大的人民力量和强大的红军是在反帝土地革命中成长起来的。它们确实如此强大，以至于我们坚信，它们迟早会冲破帝国主义和国民党施加的限制。它们将与世界及中国的革命力量汇合。这是敌人阳光般的感知范围之外的一个因素。我们的工人和农民被发现有极高的战斗意志和新阶级的创造力，这与日益衰弱、腐败和沉沦的地主及资产阶级形成鲜明对比。依靠群众和红军的强大力量，我们将赢得持久战。在这种情况下，我们的敌人将遭受最终的失败。

我们的斗争取得胜利

在过去五个半月的持续斗争中，我们取得了哪些成功？
首先，令国民党惊讶的是，一直在前线作战的红军并未如敌人所预期的那样被削弱。相反，红军得到了相当大的加强并极大地扩充了规模，这使国民党大失所望。红军放弃了以往在胜利后将一批部队送往后方休整的惯例。由于敌人的不断猛攻，停止这种做法变得必要。此外，红军提高了其军事训练水平和政治水平。
关于红军的扩充，可以说现在的红军比去年五月时大了百分之五十（注：原文为“one and a half larger”，通常指增加到1.5倍或增加了50%，结合语境及后文数据，此处译为扩大了规模，具体倍数依原文直译逻辑处理，但中文习惯常表述为扩大了一半或增至一点五倍，此处依文意译为规模显著扩大）。上述扩充不包括后备队、教导团和独立团，这些部队的数量也有所增加。红军的人数达到了中央苏区有史以来的最高纪录。扩大红军的突击运动取得了惊人的成功。江西二月份的新红军招募配额超过了原计划。洪通北（音译）地区的红军人数翻了一番，而闽北地区的红军人数增加了50%。所有邻近的苏区都显示出不同程度的红军扩充速度。
从农村征募的新兵不需要花费太多时间学习战斗技巧。他们在学习过程中证明与老战士一样高效。这是通过政治课条件实现的。新成立的青年共产主义师在每天行军八十里的情况下，不到一个月就消灭了周子昆（音译）的部队。光荣的第48团在两个月内成功抵抗了比自身大三倍的敌人的进攻。由新兵组成的瑞金师在黎川勇敢地抗击了敌人的五个师。鉴于这些事实，红军总是赢得顽强战斗的胜利。
为了培训和教育红军，在原有的一所军事学校基础上又增加了四所，学生人数翻了一番。学员大多来自工农阶级，是高中级军官的候选人。一些学员因组建新师而被提拔到高位。炮兵、工兵、防空、化学战等专业的干部也有所增加。无线电台的数量比第六次“围剿”时增加了四倍，而无线电学员的数量足以胜任必要的工作。医生现在比以前更多了。目前，每个临时医院配备两名医生。
绝大多数此类干部来自工农阶级。他们用一年时间掌握了地主资产阶级出身的人需要五六年才能掌握的东西。这些干部足以遏制帝国主义-国民党的进攻，以及遏制我们队伍中那些不信任提拔新干部的右倾机会主义者。
虽然承认我们在军用物资方面存在困难，但我们一直在坚持不懈地成功克服这些障碍。我们的财政建立在坚实的基础上，能够为红军筹集足够的资金，而过去主要由红军承担充实红色战争金库的主要责任。现在，红军在筹集军费方面只起次要作用。从去年九月到1934年一月，我们每月的军事开支增加了40%至45%，但这些费用由缴纳土地税、购买债券或捐赠粮食和金钱的群众所覆盖。

4
As to the question of uniforms and blankets we may say that we have succeeded in procuring enough for our red fighters. Formerly this question could not be solved until after the victory of the red army. Now we have overcome this difficulty. Last December new red fighters increased by 20% and thus upset the original plan but we handled it all right. Spring and summer uniforms will be secured with 80% certainty. The red army is assured of 6 months rice supply and does not have to worry about the spring famine. Owing to the fact that the masses have brought rice to the red army in large quantities we dont need to be anxious about the supply of rice to the red fighters. One red regiment in the vicinity of Chienning collected 20,000 catty of rice in one day while originally planning to have 10,000 only.
Despite the forts of the enemy which are used to obstruct us in seizing his arms our guns and rifles have increased ceaselessly. Compared with last July the rifles in the principal units of the red army has augmented by 30%. The output of ammunitions is enlarged considerably, especially since February. We turned 100% more ammunitions (for rifles) in February than January but the increase will be 150% in March. The production of hand grenade increased 100% as compared with January but the increase in March will be 1,000% and in April 1,200%.
Our manufactured medicines are even better than the imported foreign products.
All such facts signalize the achievements in war supplies. They will dispel the pessimist view of the question of supplies.

Coordination of Fighting Forces

During the 5th drive of the KMT we have succeeded in securing better coordination of the fighting units of the red army. We fight the enemy on the main front but we never give up fighting on minor fronts. The red forces in west Kiangsi repulsed the enemy from the west route. The red army in east and north Kiangsi holds six divisions of the enemy in check. Even the Soviets in north Fukien have held up three KMT divisions. Red partisans have shown increasing activities in the rear of the enemy. Not only that, we have built up strong defence areas and forts to cope with the protracted campaign of imperialism and KMT. The red units fighting at various fronts have, in the course of hostilities, been better coordinated.
Step by step we have consolidated the organs in the rear. During the 1st, 2nd and 3rd drives of imperialism and KMT we had, strictly speaking, no stable base in the rear. But now we have a secure base in the rear for the storage of war supplies, for the transportation of sick and wounded soldiers, for the transshipment of war booties. Now we have reserve regiments and red youth guard much more enlarged than before. It has been contemplated that during April over 60% of the youths (able-bodied) shall join the red youth guards. We have set up offices for the training of enemy prisoners. We have more hospitals than before. In sanitation the KMT army is far behind us. Our success at Sanbien last year enabled us to extend our war industries to a considerable degree.
Finally, the transport system both at the front and rear has become quite efficient. We rely on our own feet for transportation but our success in this regard is startling. The couriers set a new record in walking. They cover the distance from Juikin to Siatien (how many li?) within 40 hours. They can walk fast because know what their tasks means in relation to the shattering of the 5th campaign.
The above achievements enumerated, together with the growing militancy of workers and peasants, the expansion of the red army, the improved education of the cadres, the sufficiency of war supplies, the coordination of the fighting units, etc, will assure our decisive victory in the prolonged war. On the basis of these fundamental factors our red army fighting all the time and on all fronts has never shown any sign of weakness as has been expected by the enemy. It rather strengthened itself and enlarged itself during the hand-to-hand fight with the enemy. It has set to naught the plan of the enemy in the first phase of the war, successfully defended the Soviets in Kiangsi. This triumph tells the toilers of the whole world and of whole China that the red army of the Soviets together with the workers and peasants will certainly smash the 5th campaign and achieve victory of the Soviets on a rational scale.
On the other hand, the enemy has suffered many casualties. The 4th division of KMT has, for example, decreased by 6,000 men, the 10th and 83rd divisions by 1,000 each, the 87th division by 3,000, the 9th by 2,000, the 43rd division by 3,000, 14th division by 3,000, the 59th by 1,600. Thus the crack troops of Chiang Kai-shek have received heavy blows. The red army has annihilated whole regiments one after another. In addition, the enemy has consumed large quantities of ammunition and money.

4
关于制服和毯子的问题，我们可以说，我们已经成功地为红军战士 procured（获取/筹措）了足够的物资。以前，这个问题只有在红军胜利后才能解决。现在我们克服了这一困难。去年十二月，新红军战士增加了20%，从而打乱了原计划，但我们妥善应对了这一切。春夏季制服有80%的把握能够落实。红军确保了6个月的粮食供应，不必担心春荒。由于群众向红军运送了大量大米，我们不需要担心红军战士的粮食供应。建宁附近的一个红军团在一天内收集了2万斤大米，而原计划仅为1万斤。
尽管敌人利用堡垒阻碍我们缴获其武器，但我们的枪支和步枪仍在不断增加。与去年七月相比，红军主力部队的步枪数量增加了30%。弹药产量大幅扩大，尤其是自二月份以来。二月份我们生产的（步枪）弹药比一月份多了100%，但三月份的增幅将达到150%。手榴弹的产量与一月份相比增加了100%，但三月份的增幅将达到1,000%，四月份将达到1,200%。
我们制造的药品甚至比进口的外国产品还要好。
所有这些事实标志着军需供应方面的成就。它们将消除人们对供应问题的悲观看法。

作战力量的协调

在国民党第五次“围剿”期间，我们成功实现了红军作战部队更好的协调。我们在主要战线上与敌人作战，但从未放弃在次要战线上的战斗。赣西的红军部队从西路击退了敌人。赣东和赣北的红军牵制了敌人的六个师。甚至闽北的苏区也阻滞了国民党的三个师。红军游击队在敌后表现出日益活跃的活动。不仅如此，我们还建立了强大的防御区和堡垒，以应对帝国主义和国民党的持久战。在各条战线作战的红军部队在战斗过程中得到了更好的协调。
我们逐步巩固了后方的机构。在帝国主义和国民党的第一、第二和第三次“围剿”期间，严格来说，我们在后方没有稳定的基地。但现在，我们有了一个安全的后方基地，用于储存军需物资、转运伤病员以及转运战利品。现在，我们的后备团和红色少年先锋队的规模比以前大大扩大。据计划，在四月份，超过60%的青年（身体健全者）将加入红色少年先锋队。我们设立了审讯和培训俘虏的机构。我们的医院比以前更多了。在卫生方面，国民党军队远远落后于我们。去年我们在三边（音译）的胜利使我们能够在很大程度上扩展我们的战争工业。
最后，前方和后方的运输系统都变得相当高效。我们依靠自己的双脚进行运输，但在这方面取得的成就令人瞩目。通讯员创造了步行新纪录。他们在40小时内走完了从瑞金到夏田（音译）（多少里？）的距离。他们之所以能走得快，是因为知道他们的任务对于粉碎第五次“围剿”意味着什么。
上述列举的成就，加上工人和农民日益高涨的战斗意志、红军的扩充、干部教育的改善、军需供应的充足、作战单位的协调等，将确保我们在持久战中取得决定性胜利。基于这些基本因素，一直在所有战线上作战的红军从未表现出敌人所预期的任何虚弱迹象。相反，它在与敌人的肉搏战中加强并扩充了自己。它使敌人在战争第一阶段的计划化为乌有，成功保卫了江西的苏维埃。这一胜利告诉全世界和全中国的劳动者，苏维埃的红军连同工人和农民必将粉碎第五次“围剿”，并在合理规模上实现苏维埃的胜利。
另一方面，敌人遭受了许多伤亡。例如，国民党第4师减少了6,000人，第10师和第83师各减少1,000人，第87师减少3,000人，第9师减少2,000人，第43师减少3,000人，第14师减少3,000人，第59师减少1,600人。因此，蒋介石的精锐部队受到了沉重打击。红军相继歼灭了整个团。此外，敌人消耗了大量的弹药和资金。

pages.en:
PEASANT RIOTING AGAINST TAXES

In spite of the demagogical phrases of the KMT to abolish exorbitant
taxes and to relieve rural districts the exploitation of the peasantry by
the KMT has been steadily on the increase. According to the investigations
conducted by the central agricultural station in 687 hsien of 22 provinces
the burden of the peasant in the form of land tax has been increasing from
year to year:
                Low Field .........High Field
1932............2.07%.............2.36%
1933............2.37%.............2.50%
1934............2.68%.............2.80%

Thus, the increase in both categories of the land tax is steady. No
doubt this table represents the better conditions purposely chosen by the
investigators. There are of course cases far worse than those just cited.
In Shensi, Kansu, Honan, Anhwei, Kiangsu, Hunan, Hupeh, Ssechwen, Yunnan,
Kweichow, etc, the peasant is forced to cultivate the poppy by orders of
the KMT government. But opium is not the sole curse for the peasantry. The
KMT always boasts of the construction of 89,161.51 kilometers in 1933 as
the greatest achievement in the field of economic construction. These high-
ways only facilitate the transportation of imperialist goods. They impose
immense hardships on the peasantry. The peasant is deprived of his land for
constructing highways. He usually gets no pay for the sacrifice. In addi-
tion he has to contribute labour towards the road-building. He pays the tax
on his land which has been robbed from him.
Exorbitant taxes so much cursed by the common people have been piling
up year in and year out. In Hopeh there are 300 such taxes out of which
200 are judged "rational" by the financial authorities of the province (The
Ta Kung Pao, May 19). The same paper gives the information that the tax
collector has perpetrated unspeakable outrages on the peasants, that tax
collectors have usually come to the village one after another for the same
purpose.
Under the increasingly cruel exploitation of the KMT peasants have
staged isolated riotings in the past two months. The peasants in Chan hsien,
Anhwei, and in Seiyang, Kiangsu, fought fierce battles with the KMT armed
bandits who attempted to root the poppy. The peasants in Wusih, Kiangsu,
rose in protest against highway construction and surveying of land. In south
Hopei many organisations have sprung up against taxes.

Compulsory Poppy Cultivation

Under the name of banning opium the KMT used to sell opium in public.
It used to compel the peasants to cultivate the poppy. It monopolises the
sale and transportation of opium. The peasants in Chan hsien paid the tax
on poppy in compliance with the orders of the KMT but the local government
still threatened to destroy the poppy. On April 13 over 10,000 peasants
gathered together and put up a stiff resistance to the 1,000 KMT soldiers
who came to the countryside to root the poppy. The battle lasted three days
and nights. 100 peasants were killed and wounded, and several villages wiped
out by the soldiery.
The above information emanates from the Sinwanpeo of Shanghai on April
19. The same happenings are also observed in Seiyang, northern Kiangsu.
There the magistrate collected the poppy tax last year but now sent armed
soldiers to the countryside in an effort to destroy the poppy. The anger-
ed peasants resisted and wounded the secretary-general of the hsien govern-
ment. The casualties on the side of the peasants are unknown. The strug-
gle is still going along (The Tawmpao of Shanghai, April 14 & 19).
On April 24 the peasants in the northern outskirts of Wusih, Kiangsu,
assembled together by the beating of the gongs against in protest against
the expropriation of land for highway construction. They attacked the sur-
veyors and broke their instruments. In the afternoon they marched on the
hsien government as a demonstration. One farmer complained of his land (two
mou) having been robbed, and hence could not make a living any more. On
May 10 the peasants again turned on the surveyors.
According to the Ta Kung Pao of May 11 the peasants in Koo-an and Chang
Teh, Hopei, secretly set up anti-tax organisations, their slogan being "re-
sistance against exorbitant taxes and corruption". Scores of villages in
Changteh have joined the movement. Of late the anti-tax movement has found
its way into southern Hopei, i.e., in Feishien, Yin-hsien and Chuchow.
No longer feeling any appetite for the KMT demagogical propaganda the
peasants have been using their own strength to shake off the yoke of the

农民抗税暴动

尽管国民党高喊废除苛捐杂税、减轻农村负担等蛊惑人心的口号，但国民党对农民的剥削却一直在稳步增加。根据中央农业实验所在22个省687个县进行的调查，以田赋形式施加于农民的负担逐年增加：
                下等田地 .........上等田地
1932............2.07%.............2.36%
1933............2.37%.............2.50%
1934............2.68%.............2.80%

因此，这两类田赋的增长是稳定的。毫无疑问，这张表格代表的是调查人员特意选择的较好情况。当然，还有比上述情况糟糕得多的案例。在陕西、甘肃、河南、安徽、江苏、湖南、湖北、四川、云南、贵州等地，农民被迫按照国民党政府的命令种植罂粟。但鸦片并非农民遭受的唯一祸害。国民党总是吹嘘1933年修建了89,161.51公里的公路是其经济建设领域的最大成就。这些公路只方便了帝国主义商品的运输。它们给农民带来了巨大的苦难。农民的土地被征用以修建公路。他们通常得不到任何补偿。此外，他们还必须为修路提供劳力。他们还要为被夺走的土地缴纳赋税。

被百姓深恶痛绝的苛捐杂税年复一年地累积。在河北，此类税种有300种之多，其中200种被该省财政当局判定为“合理”（《大公报》，5月19日）。同一份报纸还披露，征税人员对农民犯下了难以言喻的暴行，征税人员通常为了同一目的接连不断地来到村庄。

在国民党日益残酷的剥削下，过去两个月里农民发动了零星的暴动。安徽黟县和江苏泗阳的农民，与试图铲除罂粟的国民党武装匪徒进行了激烈的战斗。江苏无锡的农民起义，抗议修建公路和丈量土地。在冀南，许多抗税组织纷纷成立。

强制种植罂粟

国民党以禁烟为名，公开贩卖鸦片。它强迫农民种植罂粟。它垄断鸦片的销售和运输。安徽黟县的农民遵照国民党命令缴纳了罂粟税，但当地政府仍威胁要铲除罂粟。4月13日，一万多名农民聚集起来，顽强抵抗前来乡村铲除罂粟的1000名国民党士兵。战斗持续了三天三夜。100名农民死伤，数个村庄被军队夷为平地。

上述信息来自4月19日的上海《新闻报》。同样的事件也发生在苏北泗阳。在那里，县长去年征收了罂粟税，但现在却派遣武装士兵下乡试图铲除罂粟。愤怒的农民进行抵抗，并打伤了县政府秘书长。农民方面的伤亡情况不明。斗争仍在继续（上海《大晚报》，4月14日及19日）。

4月24日，江苏无锡北郊的农民鸣锣集合，抗议为修建公路而征用土地。他们袭击了测量员并砸毁了他们的仪器。下午，他们前往县政府示威。一位农民抱怨他的土地（两亩）被抢走，因此无法再维持生计。5月10日，农民再次攻击测量员。

据5月11日《大公报》报道，河北固安和彰德的农民秘密建立了抗税组织，其口号是“反抗苛捐杂税和腐败”。彰德有数十个村庄加入了这一运动。最近，抗税运动蔓延至冀南，即肥乡、尹县（音译）和涿州。

农民不再对国民党的蛊惑宣传感兴趣，而是依靠自己的力量来摆脱

KMT. And the anti-tax movement of the peasantry hard pressed by the KMT will no doubt grow and spread far and wide under the expanding influence of the Soviets which have so far scored far-reaching successes over the KMT bandits.

VIOLENT PUSH OF RED ARMY

In the month just past the efforts of the Soviets and red army have been attended with significant successes every where from Fukien to Sse-chwan repudiating the falsified reports of the KMT on its victories.
The defeat of Chiang Kai-shek in Kiangsi necessitated a little change in his tactics. As a consequence, he moved part of his troops into Fukien and hopes to attack the Soviets from that direction. But the red army operating there upset Chiang's plan by capturing Yin-an and Kweima last month, annihilating the 52nd division under the command of Lu Shih-pun. At the same time the seven hsiens along the coast in northern Fukien have been sovietised, thus creating a serious situation for the KMT authorities at Foochow, capital of Fukien.
This section of Fukien is usually called east Fukien covering seven hsiens, all located close to Foochow. The 'local committee' organised last year against taxes forms the centre, with the subsequent formation of a multitude of Soviets in the neighboring hsiens. Later on a powerful force of some 10,000 red guards has been organised. And about 60,000 peasants and peasants joined hands with the red guards. The whole red force is composed of more than 10 units, each with 600 or 700 men, all under the command of Comrade Fan Teh-mien. The military organisation as evolved there is quite strong with strict discipline. Attached to the regular army is the political departments and GPU under the leadership of Comrade Hung Shao-yin, a girl. The GPU units are each provided with three motor boats and 60 or 70 junks. The red guards have two arsenals, too, turning out two pistols a day. They also make a certain amount of ammunitions. The peasants are willing to stand in the van in any battle although they bear only swords and spears. 60% of the area in each hsien has been brought under the domination of the Soviets with the consequent division of land.
In this part of the province the mountains offer obstacles to the approach of the KMT bandit troops. Recently, the struggle in these regions has become more violent causing great anxiety to the KMT government at Foochow. According to Tawngpao of May 19 the magistrate of Foochow, northern Fukien, requested in an urgent telegram the dispatch of more soldiers from the provincial authorities in an attempt to rout the attack of the red army under Comrade Fang Tse-mien.
The Red Army in Hupeh

On may Day the red fighters under Comrade Kao Yin-son attacked Yanglin Sse, an important point on the Changsha-Wuchang railway, and succeeded in disarming the KMT garrison. On the same day another portion of the red army captured Shassekai, Luiyang, only 30 miles from Changsha, capital of Hunan. Two days later the red army occupied the Taolin station of the line just named.
The red army in Honan has built up strong bases around Sanchen hsien and recovered bit by bit the territory lost to the KMT during the gigantic offensive last year. In the middle of May Lotien, a hsien in east Hopei, fell into the hands of the red army. The neighboring city, Chisui, was seized resulting in the exodus of almost all Tuhao and capitalists. Red units in Anhwei also have been active, apparently operating in conjunction with the red army in east Hupeh. On May 6 about 100 militia in Lukiang, Anhwei, mutinied and joined the red forces there.
In April the red units in southern Hunan displayed more activities. As the Hunan government concentrated its forces on east Hunan in an endeavor to stave off the attack of the red army, the red partisans under Comrades Li Chun-pao have had a freer hand in southern Hunan. Comrade Li effected conjunction with Comrade Li Lin in Tsenghow and the units elsewhere, threatening to cut off the communications between Hunan and Kwangtung.
In response to the activities of the red army in northern Szechwan the radicalised peasants and soldiers in southern Szechwan (Anlai, Fochiang, Ya-an, etc) have organised anti-tax partisans. Enlisting the sympathy and support of the peasantry around, they have become increasingly active and always led the aggrieved masses to battle against the blood-sucking militarists and their agents. According to another report red partisans are operating in the borderland lying between Szechwan, Kweichow and Yunnan.

国民党的枷锁。在受国民党压迫的农民中，抗税运动无疑将在苏维埃日益扩大的影响下增长并广泛传播，迄今为止，苏维埃在对国民党匪徒的斗争中已取得了深远的成功。

红军的猛烈推进

在过去的一个月里，从福建到四川，苏维埃和红军的努力在各处都取得了重大成功，驳斥了国民党关于其胜利的虚假报告。

蒋介石在江西的失败迫使其战术发生了一些变化。结果，他将部分部队调往福建，希望从那个方向进攻苏维埃。但在该地区作战的红军上个月攻占永安和归化（音译），歼灭了卢兴邦指挥的第52师，从而挫败了蒋介石的计划。同时，闽北沿海七个县已苏维埃化，从而给福建省会福州的国民党当局造成了严峻局势。

福建的这一部分通常称为闽东，涵盖七个县，均靠近福州。去年成立的抗税“地方委员会”成为中心，随后在邻近各县成立了众多苏维埃。后来，组建了一支约1万人的强大赤卫队力量。约有6万名农民与赤卫队联手。整个红色力量由10多个单位组成，每个单位有600或700人，全部在范铁民同志指挥之下。那里演变出的军事组织相当强大，纪律严明。正规军附属有政治部和国家政治保卫局（GPU），由一位名叫洪少英的女同志领导。国家政治保卫局各单位各配备三艘摩托艇和六七十艘舢板。赤卫队也有两个兵工厂，每天生产两支手枪。他们还制造一定数量的弹药。农民虽然只持有刀剑和长矛，但愿意在任何战斗中冲锋陷阵。每个县60%的地区已在苏维埃统治之下，并随之进行了土地分配。

在该省这一地区，山脉为国民党匪徒部队的接近提供了障碍。最近，这些地区的斗争变得更加激烈，引起福州国民党政府的极大焦虑。据5月19日《通报》（音译）报道，闽北福州县长急电请求省当局增派士兵，试图击退方泽民同志率领的红军进攻。

湖北的红军

五一劳动节当天，高永松同志率领的红色战士袭击了长沙-武昌铁路线上的重要据点杨林司，并成功解除了国民党驻军的武装。同一天，另一部分红军占领了距湖南省会长沙仅30里的浏阳沙市街。两天后，红军占领了上述线路的大林站（音译）。

河南的红军已在沈丘县周围建立了坚固的基地，并逐步收复了去年在大举进攻中丢失给国民党的领土。5月中旬，冀东乐亭县落入红军手中。邻近城市赤穗（音译）被攻占，导致几乎所有土豪和资本家外逃。安徽的红军部队也很活跃，显然在与鄂东红军协同作战。5月6日，安徽庐江约100名民变兵变，加入了当地的红色部队。

4月，湘南的红军部队活动更加频繁。由于湖南政府将兵力集中在湘东以抵御红军的进攻，李春保同志领导的红色游击队在湘南有了更大的行动自由。李同志在曾侯（音译）与李林同志及其他地方的部队会合，威胁要切断湖南与广东之间的交通。

为响应川北红军的行动，川南（安来、富江、雅安等）激进的农民和士兵组织了抗税游击队。他们争取周围农民的同情和支持，活动日益活跃，并始终带领受苦的群众与吸血的军阀及其代理人进行战斗。据另一份报告称，红色游击队正在四川、贵州和云南交界的边境地区活动。

结 束

VICTORIOUS STUBBORN FIGHT DURING 5TH DRIVE

(1) Our Victorious Stubborn Fight During 5th Drive ................p.1.
(2) Peasant Rioting Against Taxes .................................p.5.
(3) Violent push of Red Army ......................................p.6.

OUR VICTORIOUS STUBBORN FIGHT DURING 5TH DRIVE

(This is an article by Comrade Chow En-lai, head of the politi-
cal department for the red army, specially written for the red
star, organ of the Soviet military council, which published it)
on March 18, 1934---Ed.

Imperialism and KMT started its 5th drive from the fight around Lichuan
last October with the central Soviet district (Kiangsi) as their main objec-
tive. All fighting previous to the attack on Lichuan forms only a prelude to
the major war, that is, the 5th campaign.
A rather long period of preparations preceded the 5th drive on the part
of the enemy. A change in tactics took place: a stubborn struggle plus the
forts system. The transformation became as clear as water since the commence-
ment of the major war.
The enemy learned the lesson of the successive defeats suffered during
the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th drives. All such tactics as advancement step by step,
offensive on a joint front, simultaneous attack from different directions
launched by crack units, etc, have all failed to save the enemy from defeat
at our hands. As a consequence, large number of officials and men were taken
prisoners; large quantities of ammunitions fell into our hands. Worse still,
oftentimes the vanquished units could not recover from the blow during the
course of two or three years. Our success always brought large territory un-
der the Soviets. The crushing blows delivered to the enemy shook the KMT rule
as well as the troops. Men and officers of the white army lost confidence in
the success of the war. Even the Fukien landlords-capitalists are forced by
facts to recognize the utter impotence of the KMT. By any meaning of the pet-
ty bourgeoisie who loses faith in the ruling classes.
Taught by the lesson of successive failures, the KMT, particularly impe-
rialism, has become fully awake to the impossibility of destroying the Soviets
within a short period. Hence the adoption of the tactics of the protracted
war. We are supposed to be wiped out by this war supported by the forts sys-
tem and the blockade. The following changes are observed to have taken place
in the organisation of the enemy troops, calculated to increase the efficien-
cy of the KMT bandits in fighting us.
In the first place,
Last autumn Chiang Kai-shek reorganised his army to meet the difficulties
encountered in fighting the red army. The size of the division was reduced to
three regiments in order to be suited to the fighting among the mountains.
Instead of equipping each battalion with 100 heavy machine guns, Chiang now
gives each regiment only 100 machine guns while each company has three more
light machine guns than before. The non-combatant elements within the army
have been cut while the combatants have increased.
As to tactics, Chiang decided to strike us principally from the north rear
now with the east route (Fukien) in addition. He put his crack and reliable
divisions in the western front divisions are now entrusted to the Fukien
bandits whose main duty is defence to other unreliable units.
Such units, always smashed by the red army, are now used to act as a check on

我们在第五次“围剿”中的英勇顽强战斗

（本文系红军政治部主任周恩来同志为苏维埃军事委员会机关报《红星报》特约撰写，该报于1934年3月18日刊登——编者注）

帝国主义和国民党去年十月以中央苏区（江西）为主要目标，从黎川周围的战斗开始了第五次“围剿”。进攻黎川之前的所有战斗仅构成大战，即第五次战役的前奏。

敌人在发动第五次“围剿”之前进行了相当长时期的准备。战术发生了变化：持久战加上堡垒体系。自大战开始以来，这种转变已如清水般清晰可见。

敌人吸取了在第一、二、三、四次“围剿”中接连失败的教训。诸如步步为营、联合战线进攻、精锐部队从不同方向同时发起攻击等所有战术，均未能使敌人免于被我们击败。结果，大量官兵被俘；大量弹药落入我们手中。更糟糕的是，战败部队往往在两三年内无法从打击中恢复元气。我们的胜利总是使大片领土纳入苏维埃管辖。对敌人给予的沉重打击动摇了国民党的统治及其军队。白军官兵对战争胜利失去信心。甚至福建的地主资本家也被迫承认国民党的彻底无能。这对于任何失去对统治阶级信心的小资产阶级来说都是如此。

国民党，特别是帝国主义，从接连失败的教训中受到教育，充分意识到在短期内消灭苏维埃是不可能的。因此采取了持久战的战术。他们企图通过依靠堡垒体系和封锁支持的这场战争将我们消灭。观察到敌军组织发生了以下变化，旨在提高国民党匪徒与我们作战的效率。

首先，

去年秋天，蒋介石为应对与红军作战中遇到的困难，对其军队进行了重组。师的规模缩减为三个团，以适应山地作战。蒋介石不再给每个营配备100挺重机枪，而是现在每个团只配备100挺机枪，而每个连比之前多配备三挺轻机枪。军队中的非战斗人员已被削减，而战斗人员有所增加。

在战术方面，蒋介石决定主要从北线后方打击我们，并辅以东线（福建）。他将精锐且可靠的师部署在西线，而西线的师现在委托给主要任务是防御的福建匪帮，其他不可靠的部队则用于此。

pages.en:
on the red army only. At the beginning of the 5th drive Chiang relied on the
north route as the main mainstay in the offensive against the Soviets with the
east, south and west routes the auxiliary aids. This state of affairs lasted
about three months during which we gained brilliant successes in Sinkow, Hsu-
wan and Tantsen, all located in Kiangsi. Within the same period the 19th route
army mutinied. All these facts upset the plan of Chiang in the initial stage
of the offensive. With the collapse of the 19th route army Chiang arranged
an attack from the east (from Fukien). Chiang's north route aims at Kwang-
chang while the east route at Tailin, Chienning and Lienchen (cities in Fu-
kien).
The enemy has thrown 320 regiments into the battle against us, distribut-
ed among the following four routes:
NORTH ROUTE: 28 divisions, 1 independent brigade, totalling 99 regiments.
The KMT bandits are concentrated here and, for the most part,
form the crack units of Chiang.
EAST ROUTE: 14 divisions and 1 independent brigade totalling 71 regiments.
These are for the most part Chiang's personal troops.
WEST ROUTE: 14 divisions and 5 independent brigades, aggregating 41 regi-
ments which, for the most part, come from Hunan.
SOUTH ROUTE: 9 divisions and 1 independent brigade numbering 41 regiments
all coming from Canton.
Thus the enemy forces at the front are 66 divisions, 8 independent brigades
totalling 320 regiments, numbering 600,000-700,000 men. In other words, out
of the 99 divisions of the KMT 2/3 have been sent at the front against the
Soviets. 70% of the KMT soldiers are compelled to fight us now.
Except the 1st and 2nd divisions now fighting the 4th red army in Szechwan,
except the 25th division defeated in Jehol, Chiang's personal troops have
practically all come to Kiangsi. Moreover, Chiang is calling for more troops
from the north. According to the statistics published by the headquarters at
Nanchang some 100,000 new recruits were enlisted from Honan, Anhwei and Kiang-
su in order to make up the losses of the defeated units.

Training of Cadres

Following the tragical defeat of the 4th drive Chiang resolved to train
more new cadres, placing special emphasis on the tactics of climbing moun-
tains, searching, reconnoitring, defending, etc. The forts as a defence a-
gainst the red army was stressed, too. The new cadres are more clever and
cautious than the old who always suffered crushing defeats in succession. The
primitive forts afforded a certain measure of protection to the KMT
troops. Menaced by a defeat from the red army, the KMT troops may withdraw
into the forts immediately. In spite of these improvements the KMT will suffer
inevitable reverse during the 5th drive.
Chiang also obtained financial aid from imperialism (e.g. the $50,000,000
cotton and wheat loan from U.S.) as well as from Chinese bankers who bought
Chiang's bonds or gave him ready cash whenever he called for it. Besides buy-
ing large quantities of arms and ammunitions from imperialist countries Chi-
ang ordered the arsenals at Hankow and Hangchow to work day and night for sup-
plies to the Kiangsi front against the Soviets.
Chiang put 100,000 vast army in a tiny place but he can not secure e-
nough food to feed it. The blockade enforced by the red army is quite effect-
ive in cutting off the rice supply. Chiang must import rice from abroad. The
coolies impressed by Chiang for carrying rice always eat up one third of what
they carry on their shoulders. Here is another disadvantage for Chiang. An-
other thing---Chiang is forced to organise a large number of carries for the
regular army to carry things for the soldiers. One fifth of the army is com-
posed of carriers. Out of 15,000 men of a full division 3,000 are carriers.
The lack of road facilities is another weak point. A rice carrier from Shao-
wan, Kwangtung, may finish the rice at the end of his journey in Tayu, Kiang-
si. Hence the construction of more roads which, as a rule, are built up by
the peasants without pay and provision of food. The soldiers must take part
in road construction in addition to fighting.
The enemy makes use of tactics both old-fashioned and modern. Chen Chen,
one of the lieutenants of Chiang, has summarized the tactics of the enemy in
one word. He said that fish can not be caught unless the pond is drained and
dry. The enemy wants to starve us by blockade. He also organises counterre-
volutionary activities in Soviet territory.
The above are the preparations of the KMT for a prolonged war under the
direction of imperialism.
pages.zh:
这些常被红军击溃的部队，现在仅用于牵制红军。在第五次“围剿”开始时，蒋介石依靠北线作为进攻苏维埃的主要支柱，东、南、西线为辅助。这种状况持续了大约三个月，在此期间，我们在位于江西的新沟、浒湾和潭头取得了辉煌胜利。同一时期，第十九路军发生兵变。所有这些事实打乱了蒋介石在进攻初期的计划。随着第十九路军的崩溃，蒋介石安排了从东线（从福建）发起的攻击。蒋介石的北线目标是广昌，而东线目标是泰宁、建宁和连城（福建的城市）。

敌人投入了320个团参与对我们的战斗，分布在以下四条路线：

北线：28个师，1个独立旅，共计99个团。国民党匪徒集中于此，大部分构成蒋介石的精锐部队。

东线：14个师和1个独立旅，共计71个团。这些大部分是蒋介石的嫡系部队。

西线：14个师和5个独立旅，合计41个团，大部分来自湖南。

南线：9个师和1个独立旅，共41个团，全部来自广东。

因此，前线的敌军兵力为66个师，8个独立旅，共计320个团，人数为60万至70万人。换句话说，国民党99个师中有三分之二被派往前线对抗苏维埃。70%的国民党士兵被迫与我们作战。

除了目前在四川与红四方面军作战的第1和第2师，以及在热河战败的第25师外，蒋介石的嫡系部队实际上都已来到江西。此外，蒋介石正从北方征调更多部队。根据南昌总部公布的统计数据，为了弥补战败部队的损失，从河南、安徽和江苏招募了约10万名新兵。

干部训练

在第四次“围剿”惨败之后，蒋介石决心训练更多新干部，特别强调爬山、搜索、侦察、防御等战术。作为对抗红军的防御手段，堡垒体系也受到重视。新干部比那些总是接连遭受惨败的老干部更聪明、更谨慎。原始的堡垒为国民党军队提供了一定程度的保护。受到红军击败的威胁时，国民党军队可以立即撤入堡垒。尽管有这些改进，国民党在第五次“围剿”期间仍不可避免地会遭受挫折。

蒋介石还从帝国主义那里获得财政援助（例如来自美国的5000万美元棉麦借款），以及从中国银行家那里获得资金，这些银行家购买蒋介石的债券或在他需要时提供现金。除了从帝国主义国家购买大量武器弹药外，蒋介石还命令汉口和杭州的兵工厂日夜开工，为江西反苏维埃前线供应物资。

蒋介石将10万大军集中在狭小地区，但他无法确保足够的粮食来供养这支军队。红军实施的封锁在切断大米供应方面非常有效。蒋介石必须从国外进口大米。蒋介石强征的苦力在运送大米时，总是吃掉他们肩上所扛大米的三分之一。这是蒋介石的另一个不利因素。另一件事是——蒋介石被迫为正规军组织大量的挑夫为士兵搬运物品。五分之一的军队由挑夫组成。在一个满编师的15,000人中，有3,000人是挑夫。

道路设施的缺乏是另一个弱点。一名来自广东韶关的大米挑夫，可能在到达江西南雄的终点时，大米已消耗殆尽。因此需要修建更多道路，通常情况下，这些道路是由农民无偿且不提供食物修建的。士兵除了作战外，还必须参与修路。

敌人使用古老和现代的战术。蒋介石的副手之一陈诚用一句话总结了敌人的战术。他说，除非把池塘里的水排干，否则抓不到鱼。敌人想通过封锁饿死我们。他还在苏维埃领土内组织反革命活动。

以上是国民党在帝国主义指导下为持久战所做的准备。

Relying on the economic blockade to strangle us, on the mines and arsenals
to turn out more arms and ammunitions, on the transportation system under its
control, on the domination of sea ports, on imperialism to isolate us from the
world revolutionary movement, on news blockade to shut off all victories of the
red army and isolate us from the national revolutionary movement in China the
KMT has prepared to carry on the protracted war. While recognising to a certain
extent the harmful effects of these factors on us we should not forget the fact
that the mighty force of the people and the powerful red army have grown up out
of the anti-imperialist land revolution. They are, indeed, so powerful that
they will, we firmly believe, break through the restrictions imposed by imper-
ialism and KMT sooner or later. They will link with the world and Chinese re-
volutionary forces. Here is a factor beyond the fuzzy perception of the enemy.
Our workers and peasants are found in possession of supreme military and crea-
tive power of the new classes in sharp with the landlord and bourgeoisie who
are feeble and corrupted sinking down every day. Depending on the mighty stren-
gth of the masses and the red army we will win the protracted war. Under this
condition our enemy will suffer his final defeat.

Our Struggle Victorious

What successes have we scored in the past five and a half months of sus-
tained struggle?
In the first place, to the surprise of the KMT our red army fighting at
the front all the time has never proved weakened as expected by the enemy. On
the contrary, the red army has strengthened considerably as well as expanded
tremendously to the great disappointment of the KMT. The red army desisted from
the usual practice of sending a batch of its ranks to the rear for rest after
a victory. The discontinuance is rendered desirable by the ceaseless onslaught
of the enemy. Besides, the red army has improved its military training and po-
litical level.
As to the expansion of the red army it may be stated that the red army is
now one and a half larger than it was last May. The said extension does not
include the reserves, training corps and independent regiments which have in-
creased in numbers, too. The red army has reached the largest number ever re-
corded in the central Soviet territory. The shock movement for the expansion
of the red army has been crowned with startling success. The quota of new red
recruits for February has exceeded the original plan in Kiangsi. The red army
Mang Tung Pei has doubled while that in North Fukien has enlarged by 50%. All
the neighboring Soviet districts have shown expansion of the red army at great-
er or lesser speed.
The recruits enlisted from the village do not need much time in learning
the art of fighting. They prove as efficient as the old fighters in the pro-
cess of learning. This is made possible through the political class condition.
After less than one month the newly formed young communists division has wip-
ed out the units of Chow Tse-chun by walking 80 li a day. The glorious 45th
regiment has for two months resisted successfully the attack of the enemy
which was three times larger. The Juikin division composed of new recruits
bravely fought against five divisions of the enemy at Lichuan. In the light of
such facts the red army always won the stubborn fight.
For training and educating the red armists four military schools were add-
ed to the sole one already in existence with the attendance of the students
doubled. The cadets, mostly of the worker and peasant class, are candidates
for higher and middle officers. And some of the cadets have been promoted to
high positions for the formation of new divisions. The cadres for artillery,
engineering, air defence, chemical warfare, etc, have also increased. The
wireless sets have augmented by four times as compared with the 4th drive
while wireless students are sufficient in number to do the necessary work. Doc-
tors are now more numerous than before. At present we have two doctors for
each improvised hospital.
The overwhelming majority of such cadres comes from the worker and peasant
class. They master in one year what takes five or six years for those from
the landlord-bourgeois class. These cadres are a sufficient supply to the im-
perialist-KMT offensive as well as to the opportunists among our ranks who
pin no faith in the promotion of new cadres.
While admitting of difficulties in connection with military supplies on
our part, we have been fighting persistently and successfully in surmounting
these obstacles. Our finances are placed on a sound footing capable of raising
military funds for the red army which in former times shouldered the main res-
ponsibility of filling the red war chest. Now the red army takes only secondary
part in collecting money for military purpose. From last September to January
1934 our military expenditure for each month has increased by 40% to 45% and
is raised by the masses who pay the land tax, buy the bonds or increase pro-
duction.

3

国民党依靠经济封锁来扼杀我们，依靠兵工厂和军火库生产更多的武器弹药，依靠其控制下的运输系统，依靠对海港的支配，依靠帝国主义将我们与世界革命运动隔离开来，依靠新闻封锁来掩盖红军的所有胜利并将我们与中国国内的革命运动隔离开来，从而准备进行持久战。虽然在一定程度上承认这些因素对我们造成的有害影响，但我们不应忘记这样一个事实：强大的人民力量和强大的红军是在反帝土地革命中成长起来的。它们确实如此强大，以至于我们坚信，它们迟早会突破帝国主义和国民党施加的限制。它们将与世界及中国的革命力量联合起来。这是敌人模糊认知之外的一个因素。我们的工人和农民被发现有拥有新阶级的最高军事和创造力量，这与日益衰弱、腐败和沉沦的地主及资产阶级形成鲜明对比。依靠群众和红军的强大力量，我们将赢得持久战。在这种情况下，我们的敌人将遭受最终的失败。

我们的斗争取得胜利

在过去五个半月的持续斗争中，我们取得了哪些成功？
首先，令国民党惊讶的是，一直在前线作战的红军并未如敌人所预期的那样被削弱。相反，红军得到了相当大的加强并极大地扩张，这使国民党大失所望。红军放弃了以往在胜利后将一批人员送往后方休整的惯例。由于敌人不断的猛攻，停止这种做法变得必要且可取。此外，红军提高了其军事训练和政治水平。
关于红军的扩张，可以说现在的红军比去年五月时大了1.5倍。上述扩张不包括后备队、教导团和独立团，这些部队的数量也有所增加。红军的人数达到了中央苏区有史以来的最高纪录。扩大红军的突击运动取得了惊人的成功。江西二月份的新红军招募配额超过了原计划。闽东（Mang Tung Pei）的红军人数翻了一番，而闽北的红军人数增加了50%。所有邻近的苏区都显示出不同程度的红军扩张速度。
从农村征募的新兵不需要太多时间来学习战斗艺术。他们在学习过程中证明与老战士一样高效。这是通过政治课条件实现的。新成立的青年共产主义师在每天行军80里的情况下，不到一个月就歼灭了周子昆（Chow Tse-chun）的部队。光荣的第45团在两个月内成功抵抗了比自身大三倍的敌人的进攻。由新兵组成的瑞金师在黎川勇敢地与敌人的五个师作战。鉴于这些事实，红军总是赢得顽强战斗的胜利。
为了培训和教育红军战士，在原有的一所军校基础上又增加了四所军校，学员人数翻了一番。学员大多来自工农阶级，是高级和中级军官的候选人。其中一些学员因组建新师而被晋升到高位。炮兵、工兵、防空、化学战等专业的干部也有所增加。无线电台的数量比第四次“围剿”时增加了四倍，而无线电学员的数量足以完成必要的工作。医生现在比以前更多。目前，每个临时医院配备两名医生。
绝大多数此类干部来自工农阶级。他们用一年时间掌握了地主资产阶级出身的人需要五六年才能掌握的知识。这些干部足以应对帝国主义-国民党的进攻，也足以应对我们队伍中那些不信任提拔新干部的右倾机会主义者。
虽然承认我们在军用物资方面存在困难，但我们一直在坚持不懈地成功克服这些障碍。我们的财政建立在坚实的基础上，能够为红军筹集军费，而过去主要由红军承担充实红色战争金库的主要责任。现在，红军在筹集军事资金方面只起次要作用。从去年九月到1934年一月，我们每月的军事开支增加了40%至45%，这些资金由缴纳土地税、购买债券或增加生产的群众提供。

pages.en:
As to the question of uniforms and blankets we may say that we have succeeded in procuring enough for our red fighters. Formerly this question could not be solved until after the victory of the red army. Now we have overcome this difficulty. Last December new red fighters increased by 25% and thus upset the original plan but we handled it all right. Spring and summer uniforms will be secured with 80% certainty. The red army is assured of 6 months rice supply and does not have to worry about the spring famine. Owing to the fact that the masses have brought rice to the red army in large quantities we dont need to be anxious about the supply of rice to the red fighters. One red regiment in the vicinity of Chienning collected 20,000 catty of rice in one day while originally planning to have 10,000 only.
Despite the forts of the enemy which are used to obstruct us in seizing his arms our guns and rifles have increased ceaselessly. Compared with last July the rifles in the principal units of the red army has augmented by 30%. The output of ammunitions is enlarged considerably, especially since February. We turned 100% more ammunitions (for rifles) in February than January but the increase will be 150% in March. The production of hand grenade increased 100% as compared with January but the increase in March will be 1,000% and in April 1,200%.
Our manufactured medicines are even better than the imported foreign products.
All such facts signalize the achievements in war supplies. They will dispel the pessimist view of the question of supplies.

Coordination of Fighting Forces

During the 5th drive of the KMT we have succeeded in securing better coordination of the fighting units of the red army. We fight the enemy on the main front but we never give up fighting on minor fronts. The red forces in west Kiangsi repulsed the enemy from the west route. The red army in east and north Kiangsi holds six divisions of the enemy in check. Even the Soviets in north Fukien have held up three KMT divisions. Red partisans have shown increasing activities in the rear of the enemy. Not only that, we have built up strong defence areas and forts to cope with the protracted campaign of imperialism and KMT. The red units fighting at various fronts have, in the course of hostilities, been better coordinated.
Step by step we have consolidated the organs in the rear. During the 1st, 2nd and 3rd drives of imperialism and KMT we had, strictly speaking, no stable base in the rear. But now we have a secure base in the rear for the storage of war supplies, for the transportation of sick and wounded soldiers, for the transshipment of war booties. Now we have reserve regiments and red youth guard much more enlarged than before. It has been contemplated that during April over 60% of the youths (able-bodied) shall join the red youth guards. We have set up offices for the training of many prisoners. We have more hospitals than before. In sanitation the KMT army is far behind us. Our success at Ssuh sien last year enabled us to extend our war industries to a considerable degree.
Finally, the transport system both at the front and rear has become quite efficient. We rely on our own feet for transportation but our success in this regard is startling. The couriers set a new record in walking. They cover the distance from Juikin to Sintien (how many li?) within 40 hours. They must walk fast because know what their tasks means in relation to the shattering of the 5th campaign.
The above achievements enumerated, together with the growing militancy of the workers and peasants, the expansion of the red army, the improved education of the cadres, the sufficiency of war supplies, the coordination of the fighting units, etc., will assure our decisive victory in the prolonged war. On the basis of these fundamental factors our red army fighting all the time and on all fronts has never shown any sign of weakness as has been expected by the enemy. It rather strengthened itself and enlarged itself during the hand-to-hand fight with the enemy. It has set to naught the plan of the enemy in the first phase of the war, successfully defended the Soviets in Kiangsi. This triumph tells the toilers of the whole world and of whole China that the red army of the Soviets together with the workers and peasants will certainly smash the 5th campaign and achieve victory of the Soviets on a national scale.
On the other hand, the enemy has suffered many casualties. The 4th division of KMT has, for example, decreased by 6,000 men, the 10th and 83rd divisions by 1,000 each, the 87th division by 3,000, the 9th by 2,000, the 43rd division by 3,000, 14th division by 3,000, the 59th by 1,600. Thus the crack units of Chiang Kai-shek have received heavy blows. The red army has annihilated whole regiments one after another. In addition, the enemy has consumed large quantities of ammunition and money.
