Today The specie payment lasted one week, paying out about a hundred dollars. And only 2 or 3 hours were allowed to the big crowd—apparently designed only to fool them. Instead of abating, the run became more serious as more people came along for specie payment. Then the authorities unmasked themselves by issuing an order to stop payment outright and to advise the note holders "to wait quietly" for liquidation. A couple of months have passed without any concrete steps being taken towards resumption of specie payment. The toilers are undoubtedly the hardest hit: now a heap of worthless papers remain in their hands as the only tangible sign of a compensation for their blood and sweat.

How About Shanghai?

On the surface the monetary situation in Shanghai seems much better than anywhere else in the country. But this is only a superficial observation. True, Shanghai is experiencing some trouble in handling the large stocks of idle funds coming from the interior. True, we do not witness any runs or signs of runs on the banks either Chinese or foreign. The inflationist policy of the Shanghai banks, together with Nanking's inflationist policy of public debts, have been causing much concern and worry among the populace. On the other hand, money is also tight. Seeing the approach of the crisis, the banks here are no longer liberal in making loans to their clients. Now even the first class firms in Shanghai are turned down in their proposal for a moderate loan. Slowly coming as it does, the crisis in Shanghai will nevertheless break out in the end. When it does come to the surface, it will be the most severe, perhaps similar to the ones which successively occurred in New York or Chicago.

GREATER TASKS ASSIGNED TO AEROPLANES
during the 5th campaign

In view of the breakdown of the four campaigns before the heroic resistance of the red armies in the past the counterrevolutionary regime at Nanking has come to realize the importance of the aeroplanes as a more effective weapon in the 5th campaign against the Soviet and red armies in Kiangsi and other provinces. The theory lying back of it is that the air force possesses a far greater destructive power in fighting than the troops on land who have always gone over to the side of the red army when brought face to face with the latter while the airships will be more reliable under the direct guidance of imperialism.

Proceeding on this theory Chiang Kai-shek built a network of aerodromes under the instruction of imperialist advisers in Kiangsi where Chiang's 5th campaign is in full swing at present. There 45 aerodromes have been constructed for the use of military planes, those at Nanchang, Nanchen and Nanfeng being said to be the largest, each covering 1,000 square metres, to be shortly enlarged to 10,000 square metres. Besides taking the land from the farmer forcibly, Chiang ordered the construction of the airdromes by conscript labour. All those forced to work for him must bring food and meals with themselves. Always subject to the fire of red partisans, the aerodromes under construction were made unsafe for the engineers in charge who went in by planes.

The KuMT Air Force

Accurate statistics are not available on the real strength of Nanking's air force but conservative estimates place it at 350-400 planes as against 150 in 1932. Nanking laid down a plan to increase this number up to 700 in 1935, to be distributed among 23 squadrons for the army and navy. In addition there must be four squadrons of dirigibles.

As to the planes actually in the possession of other militarists, we have the following estimation more or less reliable: 100-200 for Gen. Chen Chitong, warlord of Kwangtung, who has spent huge sums in the development of the air force, 40 for Kwangsi, 20 for the 19th route army, all these to be called out to fight the reds. Of course they are to be used occasionally for militarist wars, that is to say, for the expansion of territory as well as for the acquisition of the control of a counterrevolutionary government in order to find favor with imperialism and to bolster the tottering Tuhao-landlord-bourgeoisie rule.

今日，兑现支付持续了一周，支付了约一百美元。而只允许大批人群等待2或3小时——这显然只是为了愚弄他们。挤兑不仅没有平息，反而随着更多人前来要求兑现而变得更加严重。随后，当局撕下伪装，发布命令彻底停止支付，并劝告持票人“安静等待”清算。几个月过去了，在恢复兑现支付方面未采取任何具体步骤。劳工们无疑遭受了最沉重的打击：如今，一堆毫无价值的纸张留在他们手中，作为对他们血汗补偿的唯一有形标志。

上海的情况如何？

从表面上看，上海的货币形势似乎比全国其他地方都要好得多。但这只是表面的观察。诚然，上海在处理来自内地的巨额闲置资金方面遇到了一些麻烦。诚然，我们并未目睹针对中国银行或外国银行的挤兑或挤兑迹象。上海银行的通货膨胀政策，加上南京的公债通货膨胀政策，已在民众中引起了许多担忧和焦虑。另一方面，资金也很紧张。鉴于危机临近，这里的银行在向客户发放贷款时不再宽松。现在，即使是上海的一流公司提出的适度贷款申请也被拒绝。尽管危机在上海来得缓慢，但它最终还是会爆发。当它浮出水面时，将是最严重的，或许类似于相继发生在纽约或芝加哥的那些危机。

第五次“围剿”期间赋予飞机的更大任务

鉴于前四次“围剿”在红军的英勇抵抗下失败，南京的反革命政权已认识到飞机作为武器在针对江西及其他省份苏维埃和红军的第五次“围剿”中的重要性。其背后的理论是，空军在战斗中拥有比陆军大得多的破坏力，因为陆军在与红军面对面时总是倒向红军一边，而飞艇在帝国主义的直接指导下将更加可靠。

基于这一理论，蒋介石在帝国主义顾问的指导下，在江西建立了机场网络，目前蒋介石的第五次“围剿”正在那里全面展开。那里已修建了45个供军用飞机使用的机场，据说南昌、南丰（原文为Nanchen，疑为南城Nancheng或南丰Nanfeng之误，此处依音译保留或参照后文南丰）和南丰的机场最大，每个占地1,000平方米，不久将扩建至10,000平方米。除了强行夺取农民的土地外，蒋介石还下令通过征用劳力来修建机场。所有被迫为他工作的人都必须自备食物和餐食。由于始终受到红色游击队的火力威胁，正在建设中的机场对乘飞机前来的负责工程师来说是不安全的。

国民党空军

关于南京空军的实际实力，没有准确的统计数据，但保守估计其拥有350-400架飞机，而1932年为150架。南京制定了一项计划，要在1935年将这一数量增加到700架，分配给陆军的23个中队和海军。此外，还必须拥有四个飞艇中队。

至于其他军阀实际拥有的飞机，我们有以下或多或少可靠的估计：广东军阀陈济棠将军拥有100-200架，他在发展空军方面花费了巨资；广西拥有40架；第十九路军拥有20架，所有这些都将出动去攻打红军。当然，它们偶尔也会用于军阀战争，也就是说，用于扩张领土以及获取对反革命政府的控制权，以讨好帝国主义并支撑摇摇欲坠的土豪-地主-资产阶级统治。

pages.en:
In selecting the candidates for the air force the KMT military authorities exercised more care than ever because they have found in the past that those chosen from among the workers and peasants are "unreliable". In face of the sharpening of the class struggle the workers and peasants are most easily aroused to class consciousness, hence "unreliable". Admission to the central aviation school at Hangchow, for instance, is very strict, the candidates required to secure guaranty from 10 high officials or from capitalists of over 100,000 dollars in property besides taking the regular entrance examination. The students now numbering 600 are therefore sons of the Tuhao-landlord-bourgeoisie. Besides the technical instructions from the American instructors, the students must receive the regular fascist political training. They are not allowed to read other periodicals besides the fascist journals. Recently one student was expelled owing to his initiative in organising an Esperanto society. Suspicious elements among the students have been regularly cleared by a process which, as a matter of fact, permitted only 50% of the students to be graduated and to participate in the drive against the workers and peasants. Even this has failed to prevent the graduating students from flying over to the red armies on two occasions in the past two years.

Rivalry Among Imperialists

Imperialism not only takes a hand in the development of the KMT air force and civil aviation but sharpens the imperialist conflicts by striving to obtain a larger share in the control of the KMT air force, to secure more aviation rights as well as to get large orders for the planes. No doubt America stands out first in the importation of planes to China but Italian imperialism does not wish to lag behind. Recently, with the arrival of Chang Hsueh-liang came the Italian aviator, Commandante Mario de Bernardi, winner of the Schneider cup, accompanied by several other Italian aviators (6 in all), all ready to secure orders for Italy and to take a part in the training of Nanking's air force. In Kwangtung British and American imperialism are active in their attempts to develop and control Chen Chitong's air force. According to a Reuters message dated Sept.6 Chen Chitong was prepared to spend $30,000,000 on military aviation. On the part of England, she wants to form an air company in competition with the China National Aviation Corporation, American, which controls three major airways, one from Shanghai to Hankow, thence to Chunking and Chentu in Szechwan, another from Shanghai to Peiping and the third from Shanghai to Canton passing Chekiang and Fukien. Now this American concern is contemplating to inaugurate a new line connecting Shanghai with Manila and also another linking Shanghai with Yunnan. The German concern, Luft Hansa, operates a line from Shanghai to Sinkiang. In 1933 China imported more planes valued at $20,000,000 according to a conservative estimate. Thus imperialism is not only making a large profit but equips and trains the KMT air force, to hold it in readiness to attack the red army and the Soviet.

Finally, we may say a few words about demagogical campaign of the KMT "to save the nation by aviation". The campaign was carried on in cities and villages for no other purpose than to rob the people (worker and peasant) of their earnings. Consequently, large funds were raised from this source. But how much was actually obtained no body knows because those in custody of the money made no report on it. The aviation tax was levied here in Shanghai generally on the workers, deducting the tax from their wages. But the worker knew nothing about the use of the money he was forced to contribute. The five planes contributed by Shanghai to Nanking's air force have thrown bombs on the toilers in the Nanking-Fukien war, and will certainly throw more on the workers, peasants and red soldiers in Kiangsi and elsewhere.

END
pages.zh:
在为空军选拔候选人时，国民党军事当局比以往更加谨慎，因为他们过去发现，从工人和农民中选出的人“不可靠”。面对阶级斗争的激化，工人和农民最容易觉醒阶级意识，因此“不可靠”。例如，进入杭州中央航空学校的条件非常严格，候选人除了参加常规的入学考试外，还需要获得10名高官或财产超过10万美元的资本家的担保。因此，目前的600名学生都是土豪-地主-资产阶级的子弟。除了美国教官的技术指导外，学生们还必须接受常规的法西斯政治训练。除法西斯期刊外，不允许阅读其他刊物。最近，一名学生因主动组织世界语协会而被开除。学生中的可疑分子经常通过一个流程被清除，事实上，该流程只允许50%的学生毕业并参与镇压工人和农民的行动。即便如此，也未能阻止毕业生在过去两年中两次驾机投奔红军。

帝国主义之间的竞争

帝国主义不仅插手国民党空军和民用航空的发展，还通过努力获得对国民党空军控制的更大份额、争取更多航空权以及获得大量飞机订单，从而加剧了帝国主义之间的冲突。毫无疑问，美国在向中国进口飞机方面首屈一指，但意大利帝国主义也不愿落后。最近，随着张学良的到来，意大利飞行员、施耐德杯得主马里奥·德·贝尔纳迪指挥官（Commandante Mario de Bernardi）抵达，随行的还有其他几名意大利飞行员（共6人），他们都准备为意大利争取订单，并参与南京空军的训练。在广东，英国和美国帝国主义积极试图发展和控制陈济棠的空军。根据9月6日路透社的消息，陈济棠准备在军事航空上花费3,000万美元。就英国而言，她希望成立一家航空公司，与掌控三条主要航线的美国中国航空公司（China National Aviation Corporation, American）竞争，这三条航线分别是：一条从上海到汉口，再从汉口到四川的重庆和成都；另一条从上海到北平；第三条从上海经过浙江和福建到广州。现在，这家美国公司正考虑开通一条连接上海和马尼拉的新航线，以及另一条连接上海和云南的航线。德国公司汉莎航空（Luft Hansa）运营着一条从上海到新疆的航线。据保守估计，1933年中国进口的飞机价值超过2,000万美元。因此，帝国主义不仅赚取了巨额利润，还装备和训练国民党空军，使其随时准备进攻红军和苏维埃。

最后，我们可以谈谈国民党“航空救国”的宣传运动。这场运动在城市和乡村开展，目的无非是掠夺人民（工人和农民）的收入。因此，从这一来源筹集了大量资金。但实际获得了多少无人知晓，因为掌管这笔钱的人没有就此做出报告。在上海，航空税普遍向工人征收，从他们的工资中扣除。但工人对他被迫缴纳的钱款的用途一无所知。上海贡献给南京空军的五架飞机，在闽变（南京-福建战争）中向劳工投下了炸弹，并且肯定会在江西及其他地方向工人、农民和红军士兵投下更多的炸弹。

完

CHINESE WORKERS CORRESPONDENCE
-----------------------------
Vol. 5, No 3,
Feb. 10, 1935
-------------

Contents:
1.The 3rd Anniversary of the Anti-Japanese War at Shanghai
2. The Red Army Marches Further On
3. The New Political Situation in China
4. The Ta Tan Conference
5. Japanizing North China
------------------------------------

The Third Anniversay of the Anti-Japanese
War at Shanghai
.......................

Just three years ago, on Jan. 28, 1932, the workers of Shanghai together with the soldiers of the 19th route army began to put up a stiff fight with the Japanese invaders and carried it on for 32 days. By this war they wrote down one of the most glorious pages in the history of the anti-imperialist movement in China. By this war they repudiated the KMT traitorous theory that China was too weak to fight Japanese imperialism. Leading the mass of the ranks and files of the 19th route army, the peasants in the environs of the metropolis, the city poor and the revolutionary students and intelligentsia, the Shanghai workers fought heroically against 70,000 Japanese picked troops aided by 30 warships, 200 airplanes and numerous tanks and guns. Were it not for the intervention of other imperialists and the arrival of Nanking troops to sabotage the war in the fear, they would have certainly succeeded in driving out the Japanese bandits. The war proves that only the Shanghai workers are the real and effective force against Japanese and all other imperialism. The war tears down the mask of the Kuomintang and exposes it as a servant of Japanese imperialism.

Thanks to the heroic example of the Shanghai workers large masses of the soldiers of the 19th route army and, also, of the other units of Nanking troops joined the war on the side of the workers in defiance of the interdiction of the superior officers to the contrary. Before and in the war the workers of the Japanese mills at Shanghai quit work and organized auxiliary units in support of the fighters. Workers refused to have anything to do with Japanese boats, letting them to rot at port. One chauffeur by the name of Hu drove his truck load of Japanese ammunition right into the Whangpoo river, when compelled by Japanese troops at the point of the bayonet to drive his truck to the Japanese front. Large numbers of workers joined the defence of the Woosung forts. In many places at the front the workers directed military operations.

Finally, leaders of the 19th route army, imperialists and the national government at Nanking succeeded in betraying the workers and soldiers by concerted action. Since then Nanking sold more national interests to Japanese and other imperialism by the Shanghai truce agreement followed by the Tangu truce agreement in 1933, the resumption of train and postal service with Manchuria, the lowering of duties on Japanese imports, etc, all demanded by Japanese imperialism. Nanking has ruthlessly suppressed all anti-Japanese activities and shot all anti-Japanese elements. Now it is ready to place itself formally under the protection of Tokyo and convert itself into a pure Japanese colony, handing all North China over to Japanese imperialism.

But, on the other hand, continuing the spirit of the Shanghai workers Chinese toilers have increased their force in fighting Japanese and other imperialists by reorganizing their activities, broadening the basis of the anti-Japanese front under the leadership of the national armed self-defence movement with the popular six point programme, sending red armies to march north to check the Japanese advance, etc. The volunteers in Manchuria are fighting with more effective methods and better organisation. The heroic red armies now advancing far into the northwest will no doubt play a decisive role in calling a halt to the Japanese offensive and recovering the lost territories. Adapting itself to the new situation the anti-Japanese movement holds out a more brilliant prospect for

-----------------------------
第5卷，第3期，
1935年2月10日
-------------

目录：
1. 上海抗日战争三周年
2. 红军继续前进
3. 中国的新政治局势
4. 大潭会议
5. 华北的日本化
------------------------------------

上海抗日战争三周年
.......................

就在三年前，即1932年1月28日，上海工人同第十九路军官兵一道，开始与日本侵略者展开顽强战斗，并持续了32天。通过这场战争，他们在中国反帝国主义运动史上写下了最光辉的篇章之一。通过这场战争，他们驳斥了国民党关于中国太弱而无法对抗日本帝国主义的叛国论调。上海工人在率领第十九路军广大基层士兵、大都市周边的农民、城市贫民以及革命学生和知识分子的情况下，英勇抗击了由30艘战舰、200架飞机以及无数坦克和大炮支援的7万名日本精锐部队。如果不是其他帝国主义的干涉以及南京军队出于恐惧前来破坏战争，他们肯定能够成功驱逐日本匪徒。这场战争证明，只有上海工人是反对日本及所有其他帝国主义的真正且有效的力量。这场战争撕下了国民党的面具，揭露其作为日本帝国主义仆从的真面目。

得益于上海工人的英雄榜样，第十九路军的大量士兵以及南京军队的其他部队不顾上级相反的禁令，加入到了支持工人的一边参战。在战前和战争期间，上海日本纱厂的工人罢工并组织辅助单位以支持战斗人员。工人拒绝与日本船只发生任何关系，任其在港口腐烂。一名姓胡的司机在日本军队刺刀逼迫下驾车将弹药运往日本前线时，将满载日本弹药的卡车直接开进了黄浦江。大量工人加入了吴淞炮台的防御工作。在前线的许多地方，工人指挥军事行动。

最后，第十九路军的领导人、帝国主义者和南京国民政府通过协同行动，成功地背叛了工人和士兵。此后，南京通过《上海停战协定》以及随后的1933年《塘沽停战协定》，恢复与满洲的火车和邮政服务，降低日本进口关税等——所有这些均为日本帝国主义所要求——向日本及其他帝国主义出卖了更多的国家利益。南京无情地镇压所有抗日活动，枪决所有抗日分子。现在，它准备正式将自己置于东京的保护之下，将其转变为纯粹的日本殖民地，并将整个华北移交给日本帝国主义。

但是，另一方面，继承上海工人的精神，中国劳工通过重组活动，在拥有民众六点纲领的全国武装自卫运动领导下，扩大抗日统一战线的基础，派遣红军北上以遏制日本的推进等，从而增强了抗击日本及其他帝国主义的力量。满洲的义勇军正以更有效的方法和更好的组织进行战斗。目前正向西北深处挺进的英雄红军，无疑将在阻止日本进攻和收复失地方面发挥决定性作用。适应新形势，抗日运动展现出更加辉煌的前景

2
The Red Army Marches Further On
Equipped with new tactics, the red army in Szechuan, Shensi and Shansi have brought about new significant developments. The Shansi red army occupied Konan hsien and marched in the direction of Suiyuan. It attempts to check the recent Japanese drive in east Chahar and to recover the territories handed by the KMT betrayers over to Japanese imperialism. It tries to achieve this objective by effecting a conjunction with the national armed self-defence movement in North China which grows stronger every day. The red army operating in South Shensi advances on Si-an, capital of the province. In the section between North Shensi and East Kansu the red army crushed 30,000 KMT bandits. The red army in North Szechuan smashed the KMT bandits around Chaohua and Kwanyuan, marching on Chentu while the red army, i.e., the expeditionary force, in South Szechuan reached as far as Pingshan in the southwest of the province. These new developments of the red army add greatly to the strength of the national armed self defence and strike a hard blow at the betrayal of the traitorous Kuomintang.

At the same time, we look back to the glorious record of the red army with considerable pride. From July, 1933 to July, 1934 the red army in the various provinces smashed 120 regiments of the KMT bandits and completely annihilated about 40 regiments, capturing in the case of the central Soviet district 4 brigadier-generals, 4 regimental commanders together with 20,000 soldiers, seizing 30,000 rifles, 300 machine guns, etc. For the half year ending 1934 the red army has also much to show in its record. In August the anti-Japanese vanguard of the red army crushed the 3rd and 9th divisions of the bandits at Pengkow, Lienchen and captured 5,000 rifles. Another portion of the red army disarmed the entire 52nd division of the bandits in Yinan and seized 5,000 rifles. According to Japanese stastics the red army in N. Szechuan captured some 40,000 rifles. Near end of October the red army wiped out 20 regiments of the bandits around Changting and wrested 10,000 rifles from the beaten bandits. In November the red army in Sinkuo smashed 10,000 bandits and shot down five airplanes, capturing several thousand rifles. The expeditionary force, while en route, dispersed large bodies of the bandits and seized rifles by the tens of the thousands. All in all, at least 100,000 rifles have fallen into our hands for the latter half of 1934.

The New Political Situation in China
The following is the brief translation of the analysis made by the central bureau of the CPC of the new political situation in China appearing in the 77th issue of the 'Struggle' organ of the CPC---Ed.

The events in the past year entirely confirm the correctness of the appraisal of the Chinese situation made by the Communist International. The conditions of "revolution, war and intervention" not only exist but continue to develop.

The deepening of the national crisis and the stiffening of imperialist aggression are revealed in the Japanese seizure of North China, the resumption of train and postal service paving the way for the recognition of Manchukuo, the extension of the Peiping municipality, the removal of the Hopei provincial government to Paoting, the evacuation of Chinese troops from North China to consolidate the Japanese domination in North China and facilitate the Japanese attack on the Soviet Union, Mid China and South China. The Japanese 'hands off' statement of April 17 places China under exclusive Japanese control. British imperialism endeavors to march from the frontier regions such as Tibet and Sikong into the interior (Hunan, Kwangtung, etc). American imperialism desires to establish its economic domination in China by means of the silver policy. French imperialism is in close alliance with the Kwangsi militarists. This rapid imperialist advance is made possible by the surrender of the KMT traitors..

In the second place, the increasingly relentless exploitation of the Kuomintang brings on its train the general economic collapse. The drought of 1934 caused a loss of more than $1,000,000,000 and victimized more than 100,000,000 peasants. National industries decline more rapidly than before. Lockout and curtailment of production are a common occurance every-

红军继续前进
配备新战术的四川、陕西和山西红军取得了新的重大进展。山西红军占领了绛县（Konan hsien，音译），并向绥远方向进军。它试图遏制最近在察哈尔东部的日本攻势，并收复被国民党叛徒移交给日本帝国主义的领土。它试图通过与日益壮大的华北全国武装自卫运动相结合来实现这一目标。在陕南作战的红军向省会西安推进。在陕北和甘肃东部之间地区，红军击溃了3万名国民党匪军。川北红军击溃了昭化（Chaohua）和广元（Kwanyuan）周围的国民党匪军，向成都进军，而川南红军，即远征军，已抵达该省西南部的屏山。红军的这些新发展极大地增强了全国武装自卫的力量，并对叛徒国民党的背叛行为给予了沉重打击。

与此同时，我们怀着相当的自豪感回顾红军的光辉战绩。从1933年7月到1934年7月，各省红军击溃了120个团的国民党匪军，并彻底歼灭了约40个团，在中央苏区俘获了4名旅长、4名团长以及2万名士兵，缴获步枪3万支、机枪300挺等。截至1934年的半年里，红军的战绩也有许多可圈可点之处。8月，红军抗日先锋队在彭口（Pengkow，音译）和连镇（Lienchen，音译）击溃匪军第3师和第9师，缴获步枪5000支。另一部分红军在沂南（Yinan）解除了匪军第52师全师的武装，缴获步枪5000支。据日本统计，川北红军缴获步枪约4万支。10月底，红军在长汀周围歼灭匪军20个团，从败退的匪军手中夺取步枪1万支。11月，兴国（Sinkuo）红军击溃1万名匪军，击落五架飞机，缴获步枪数千支。远征军在途中驱散了大批匪军，缴获步枪数以万计。总之，在1934年下半年，至少有10万支步枪落入我们手中。

中国的新政治局势
以下是中共中央局对中共机关刊物《斗争》第77期上刊登的关于中国新政治局势的分析的简要译文——编者注。

过去一年的事件完全证实了共产国际对中国局势评估的正确性。“革命、战争和干涉”的条件不仅存在，而且继续发展。

民族危机的加深和帝国主义侵略的加剧体现在日本攫取华北、恢复火车和邮政服务为承认满洲国铺平道路、扩大北平市辖区、河北省政府迁往保定、中国军队从华北撤出以巩固日本在华北的统治并便利日本进攻苏联、华中和华南等方面。日本4月17日的“不干涉”声明将中国置于日本的独家控制之下。英帝国主义努力从西藏和西康（Sikong）等边疆地区向内地（湖南、广东等）推进。美帝国主义希望通过白银政策建立其在中国的经济统治。法国帝国主义与广西军阀紧密结盟。这种快速的帝国主义推进是由于国民党叛徒的投降才得以实现的。

其次，国民党日益残酷的剥削随之带来了全面的经济崩溃。1934年的旱灾造成了超过10亿美元的损失，受害农民超过1亿人。民族工业的衰退比以前更快。停工和减产已成为普遍现象——

3
where. Production is cut by 25% to 80%, throwing out a big army of the un-
employed and partly unemployed. The compulsory arbitration of disputes and
shooting of strikers by fascits bandist are only a means by which to shift
the burden of the crisis to the toilers. Taxes exacted from the toilers by
the KMT bandits amount to less than one fourth of the military expenditure,
and KMT finances are bancrupt. This entails the issue of more than $200,000,
000 in unsecured bonds. The outflow of silver in large quantities and the
sharp drop in the prices of the bonds (falling off by two to four dollars
immediately after the conclusion of the optimistic 5th plenary session of
the KMT bandits) hold out greater dangers for the KMT finances.

In the third place, fascist terrors are madly raging. Bandit Chiang
had to confess that his one million men reduced the three provinces to ru-
ins by burning and killing. Fascist bandits murdered the famine sufferers,
and shot the strikers, especially aiming their pistols at the Communists.
They spared no bourgeois oppositionists as Sze liang-tsai, proprietor of the
Shun Pao (one of the leading journals at Shanghai). This raging fascist ter-
ror reflects the rising tide of the mass struggle and the extension of the
Communist influence. The inner conflicts of the KMT bandits are sharpening
more than ever, a fact that makes the struggle of the KMT bandits for main-
taining their tottering rule hopeless and fruitless.

Fourthly, on the other hand, the revolutionary struggle is advancing,
first of all, in Manchuria where the people's revolutionary armies are
growing by leaps and bounds under the Communist leadership. The national arm-
ed self defence movement with the workers and peasants as the main mainstay
is spreading in all directions, particularly in the North more threatened
by Japanese invasion. It embraces all Chinese who do not wish to submit to
imperialist rule. Workers throughout the land are fighting against the of-
fensive of capital under the most terroristic conditions (for example, the
several ten thousand miners in North China). The broad mass of famine vic-
tims fight for the division of food. Red partisan fighting is developing
everywhere. Mutinies of the KMT soldiers are reported from time to time.
And, the red armies scored sweeping successes with the adoption of new
tactics, exercising immense influence on the further revolutionary fight of
the masses.

Fifthly, the red army adopts new tactics and carries on new activities.
It evacuates certain Soviet cities and the red capital, considering that
the imperialist-KMT bandits have a superior force, especially planes and
gases, designed to wear out the red army by wanton burning and killing, also
considering that the enemy intends to stifle the revolutionary movement by
capturing the main body of the red army. The withdrawal of the red army is
not a defeat for the red army but, on the contrary, for the KMT bandits who
failed to enbottle the red army as they repeatedly announced. The enemy is
reported the evacuation of 100,000 red fighters (but, in fact, the number is
much larger). When withdrawing from Changting, the red army crushed 20 re-
giments of bandits. At Sinkuo the red army smashed 10,000 bandits and brought
down 4 aeroplanes. We captured more new ground. In spite of the withdrawal
of the red army the Central Soviet district is still in our hands protected
by millions of workers and peasants. This is why the enemy can not move
his troops, hundreds of thousands of them, away from the central
Soviet district (Kiangsi). In reality, our red fighters are making new gains
in and out Kiangsi, territorially in particular. With the changes in tac-
tics the red army has gone over from the defensive to the offensive, at-
tacking the enemy along a wide front.

In short, the KMT propaganda of "peace", "construction" and "unification"
is only a shameless lie. China is still torn asunder by imperialism and hos-
tile KMT factions. The KMT bandits have only sharpened the economic and na-
tional crises. Gigantic mass struggles are forging ahead, the influence of
the Communists expanding, the Soviets and red army growing stronger. Forc-
ed to leave the basic cities and to find new territories elsewhere, the red
army has suffered undeniably a temporary set-back. But this is only a diffi-
culty of growth which we may quickly overcome under such favorable condi-
tions as the correct leadership of the Communist Party, the growth of the
red army, the revolutionary fervor and creative power of millions of the
masses and large numbers of cadres well versed in revolutionary war and So-
viet constructive work. We can create new conditions favorable to the revo-
lution and accomplish the historical mission of the Chinese Soviet revolu-
tion.

各地生产削减了25%至80%，导致大批失业和半失业人员的出现。法西斯匪帮对争端实行强制仲裁并枪杀罢工者，这不过是将危机负担转嫁给劳工的一种手段。国民党匪徒向劳工征收的税款不到军费开支的四分之一，而国民党的财政已破产。这导致发行了超过2亿美元的无担保债券。白银大量外流以及债券价格急剧下跌（在国民党匪徒乐观的第五届全会结束后，债券价格立即下跌了两到四美元），给国民党财政带来了更大的危险。

第三，法西斯恐怖正在疯狂肆虐。匪首蒋介石不得不承认，他的一百万军队通过烧杀抢掠使三个省份沦为废墟。法西斯匪徒杀害灾民，枪杀罢工者，尤其将枪口对准共产党人。他们连资产阶级反对派也不放过，如上海主要报刊之一《申报》的所有者史量才。这种猖獗的法西斯恐怖反映了群众斗争的高涨和共产党影响的扩大。国民党匪徒内部的冲突比以往任何时候都更加尖锐，这一事实使得国民党匪徒为维持其摇摇欲坠的统治而进行的斗争变得毫无希望且徒劳无功。

第四，另一方面，革命斗争正在推进，首先是在满洲，那里的人民革命军在共产党的领导下突飞猛进地成长。以工农为主力军的全国武装自卫运动正四处蔓延，特别是在受日本入侵威胁更严重的北方。它涵盖了所有不愿屈服于帝国主义统治的中国人。各地的工人在最恐怖的环境下对抗资本的进攻（例如，华北的数万名矿工）。广大灾民为争取分配粮食而斗争。红色游击战在各地发展。不时有关于国民党士兵哗变的报道。此外，红军因采用新战术而取得了全面胜利，对群众的进一步革命斗争产生了巨大影响。

第五，红军采取新战术并开展新活动。它撤离了某些苏维埃城市和红色首都，考虑到帝国主义-国民党匪徒拥有优势兵力，特别是飞机和毒气，旨在通过肆意烧杀来消耗红军；同时也考虑到敌人企图通过俘获红军主力来扼杀革命运动。红军的撤退并非红军的失败，相反，是那些未能像他们反复宣称的那样围困住红军的国民党匪徒的失败。据报道，敌军称有10万红军战士撤离（但实际上人数要多得多）。在从长汀撤退时，红军歼灭了匪军20个团。在新国（音译），红军击溃了1万名匪徒并击落4架飞机。我们夺取了更多新的地盘。尽管红军进行了撤退，但中央苏区仍在我们的手中，受到数百万工农的保护。这就是为什么敌人无法将其数十万军队从中央苏区（江西）调走的原因。实际上，我们的红色战士在江西内外，特别是在领土方面，取得了新的进展。随着战术的改变，红军已从防御转为进攻，在宽阔的战线上攻击敌人。

总之，国民党关于“和平”、“建设”和“统一”的宣传不过是无耻的谎言。中国仍然被帝国主义和敌对的国民党派系撕裂得支离破碎。国民党匪徒只是加剧了经济和民族危机。巨大的群众斗争正在向前推进，共产党的影响正在扩大，苏维埃和红军正在壮大。红军被迫离开基本城市并在其他地方寻找新的领土，不可否认地遭受了暂时的挫折。但这只是成长中的困难，在共产党的正确领导、红军的成长、数百万群众的革命热情和创造力以及大量精通革命战争和苏维埃建设工作的干部等有利条件下，我们可以迅速克服这一困难。我们能够创造有利于革命的新条件，并完成中国苏维埃革命的历史使命。

The Ta Tan Conference in Jehol
On Feb. 2 the KMT representative, Chang Yeh-ting, met Japanese delegates, Matsui, etc, in a conference at Ta Tan, a town on the Jehol border to hand over another portion of Chinese soil to Japanese imperialism. Within hardly ten minutes Chang signed away a vast track of land, called Shitu Chentse, Tungtsaitse and Nanshi Lingtse, measuring by several hundred square li. The conference ended so quickly because the Japanese were previously assured of the certainty of turning all North China into a Japanese colony through the conversations of Major General Szuzuki and bandit Chiang Kai-shek at Nanking. The KMT delegate promised to return the 37 rifles to the Japanese, rifles that were taken by Chinese soldiers ordered to retreat immediately but remaining firm on the ground and fighting the invaders. The return of the rifles means that the Japanese do not have to worry about the loss of their weapons in marching on Chinese territory because the loss, if any, will be made good by the KMT officers,

The Ta Tan conference decided that the territory above mentioned should be neutral without the stationing of troops from either side. From the experiences of the Tangu agreement only Chinese troops are excluded from the demilitarized zone while the Japanese have full right to move in and out their troops as they please. The shameless betrayal of the KMT bandits, however, provides a great impetus to the national armed self defence movement in the north. The masses have learned that only their own action right at the moment can put a stop to further betrayals of the KMT bandits. Branches of the national armed self defence have sprung up in the north and developed in certain cases their activities to the higher stage of partisan warfare against Japanese imperialism and its agent, the KMT bandits. Furthermore, the red armies in Shansi and Shensi are moving in the direction of Suiyuan and Chahar to meet the fresh Japanese drive in alliance with the national armed self defence in Hopei.

Japanizing North China
This is an article written for us by a correspondent from Peking and printed below in a condensed form---Ed.

The foreign policy of the Kuomintang, the party of landlords, bourgeoisie, bankers and generals, is the policy of selling out China to imperialism, especially to Japanese imperialists. The resumption of train and postal service with Manchukuo and the customs agreement opening the frontiers for the penetration of Japanese goods are only stages on the road to the surrender of the whole of China to Japanese imperialism.

Striving to capture Inner Mongolia as a springing board for a thrust against the Soviet Union, the Japanese military are acting openly and ruthlessly, anticipating that Nanking will not resist this seizure. In the banner regions in Chahar the Japs have built up four wireless stations, one of them at the palace of Prince Teh, head of the Mongolian autonomy movement. These stations are manned by a Japanese staff. The Japanese have constructed motor roads across Jehol into Chahar to facilitate further aggression. Kalgan, the junction city on the Peiping-Suiyuan railway and end of the caravan route to Outer Mongolia, is probably their first objective. Having seized the Mukden-Peiping line, the Japs are ready to grab the Peiping-Suiyuan railway which will be extended from Paotow to Sinkiang for further aggression against Outer Mongolia and the Chinese northwest. Nanking are assisting the Japs by withdrawing Chinese troops from the north and sending them to fight the red army in South China, the only truly anti-imperialist force in China.

To colonize North China the Japs do not have to bring in their troops, leaving the work to be finished through the KMT traitors. At the demand of Japanese imperialism the KMT bandits suppressed all anti-Jap. organizations and publications, tortured and shot newspaper editors who dared to call for resistance to Japan or criticize the Nanking policy in North China. At the demand of Japanese imperialism even KMT committees in N. China were dissolved, KMT members expelled. Japanese paid and voluntary Japanese agents were placed in all governmental offices from the very top down to the bottom. These agents, whether military or civil, arrested scores, nay, hundreds of patriotic youths in Peiping, Tientsin and other cities. Rumour has it that should Huang Fu, head of the Peiping administration, fall into disfavor and be turn-

热河的大滩会议
2月2日，国民党代表张业廷（音译）在大滩——热河边境的一个城镇——与松井等日本代表举行会议，将另一部分中国领土移交给日本帝国主义。在不到十分钟的时间里，张业廷就签出了大片土地，称为石土城子（音译）、东菜子（音译）和南师岭子（音译），面积达数百平方里。会议结束得如此迅速，是因为日本人此前已通过铃木少将与匪首蒋介石在南京的会谈，确信将整个华北变成日本殖民地已成定局。国民党代表承诺归还37支步枪给日本人，这些步枪是被奉命立即撤退但坚守阵地并与入侵者作战的中国士兵缴获的。归还步枪意味着日本人不必担心在进入中国领土时丢失武器，因为任何损失都将由国民党军官予以赔偿。

大滩会议决定，上述地区应为非军事区，双方均不驻军。从《塘沽协定》的经验来看，只有中国军队被排除在非军事区之外，而日本人则有权随意进出其军队。然而，国民党匪徒的无耻背叛极大地推动了北方的全国武装自卫运动。民众已经认识到，只有他们自己立即采取行动，才能制止国民党匪徒的进一步背叛。全国武装自卫会的分支机构在北方如雨后春笋般涌现，并在某些情况下将其活动发展到对抗日本帝国主义及其代理人国民党匪徒的游击战的更高阶段。此外，山西和陕西的红军正朝着绥远和察哈尔方向移动，以迎接日本的新攻势，并与河北的全国武装自卫力量结盟。

日本的华北化
这是北京的一位通讯员为我们撰写的一篇文章，以下刊登的是浓缩版——编者按。

作为地主、资产阶级、银行家和将军们的政党，国民党的对外政策是将中国出卖给帝国主义，特别是卖给日本帝国主义的政策。恢复与满洲国的火车和邮政服务，以及开放边界允许日本商品渗透的海关协定，只是将整个中国投降给日本帝国主义道路上的几个阶段。

日本军方试图将内蒙古作为进攻苏联的跳板，行动公开且残酷，预料南京不会抵抗这一夺取行动。在察哈尔的旗区，日本人建立了四个无线电台，其中一个位于蒙古自治运动首领德王的宫殿。这些电台由日本人员操作。日本人修建了穿越热河进入察哈尔的汽车公路，以方便进一步的侵略。张家口，作为北平-绥远铁路的枢纽城市以及通往外蒙古的商队路线的终点，可能是他们的首要目标。在夺取了沈阳-北平线后，日本人准备抢占北平-绥远铁路，该铁路将从包头延伸至新疆，以便进一步侵略外蒙古和中国西北。南京方面通过从北方撤出中国军队并将其派往华南与红军作战来协助日本人，而红军是中国唯一真正的反帝力量。

为了殖民华北，日本人不必派遣自己的军队，而是让工作通过国民党叛徒来完成。应日本帝国主义的要求，国民党匪徒镇压了所有反日组织和出版物，折磨并枪杀了那些敢于呼吁抵抗日本或批评南京在华北政策的报纸编辑。应日本帝国主义的要求，甚至华北的国民党委员会也被解散，国民党成员被开除。从最高层到最底层，所有政府机构中都安插了日本资助的和自愿的日本代理人。这些代理人，无论是军人还是文职人员，在北平、天津和其他城市逮捕了数十名乃至数百名爱国青年。有谣言说，如果北平行政长官黄郛失宠并被转……

ed out by the Japs he would be replaced by Wang I-tang, a former compradore of a Japanese shipping firm in Tientsin.

The proposed extension of Peiping and the removal of the Hopei provincial government to Paoting will leave the former capital and Tientsin entirely to the direct domination of the Japanese. In aiding the Japs in dumping their goods in the north, Nanking appointed Kishimoto, a Japanese, as head of the customs in Tientsin. Steps are now taken to establish direct radio, telephone, telegraph and air communications with Manchukuo.

On Jan. 23 the Japs began a new drive into eastern Chahar with 13,000 troops, an air squadron and forty armoured cars; and poured a rain of death on peasants, workers and soldiers in several Chinese villages. The KMT bandit moved their airplanes, tanks and guns against the red army in the south. By this the KMT bandits tried to justify their loud call that "they have no modern weapons in resisting the Japanese". By the truce agreement of Feb. 2 eastern Chahar practically fell into the hands of the Japs. Japanese imperialism needs this territory for the preparation of the attack on USSR and, with this end in view, turns it into a perfect military base with the full backing of Nanking. The Japs now are consolidating their control over the Mongolian leagues and banners, again, with the full backing of Nanking. The KMT bandits are helping in every way possible the Japs in realising the plan of the Japanese conquest of China as laid down in the famous Tanaka Memorial. To this purpose bandit Chiang Kai-shek conducted secret negotiations with the Japanese in the Peking Medical Hospital under the guise of 'sickness' in December and later at his home on his estate at Fenghwa (not far away from Shanghai). By order of bandits Chiang and Tung the vice-foreign minister, Tang Yu-jeng, always came to Shanghai and stayed in the Japanese Fu Min hospital off Szechuan Road to negotiate with the Japs, again under the guise of 'sickness'. These negotiations, all carried on behind closed doors, decided on the role of the Kuomintang bandits in the Japanese conquest of China. When the Japs, for instance, should begin a drive into Chinese soil again, the KMT ought to immediately withdraw Chinese troops and thus prevent Chinese soldiers from fighting the invaders; at the same time lull public opinion by spreading the falsehood that the incident is not serious and only local. As soon as the Japanese drive conquers large tracks of territory, the KMT bandits invariably propose a conference and sign away the territory demanded by Japanese imperialism. On the Japanese demand the KMT bandits prosecuted a vigorous campaign against all anti-imperialist and anti-Japanese organisations and magazines or papers. In 1934 not less than 110 such publications were suppressed in Peiping alone for the publication of factual reports on the KMT betrayal.

At the same time the KMT bandits are cooperating with the Japanese at every turn in the preparation of the offensive on the Republic of Outer Mongolia and USSR. A notorious example may be mentioned of the recent press campaign of the KMT bandits against USSR, centering around the sale of the Chinese Eastern Railway. The KMT-fascist and bourgeois papers invariably accuse the Soviet Union of having committed illegality in selling the line to Japan (in a factual sense) but never said a word about the Japanese attempt to grab the line (meaning the other half of the ownership, the Manchurian half being already in the hands of Japanese imperialism), intimating to the Japanese that China would not protest in case Japan should seize the line but will bark violently should the Soviet Union sell it, that is, its own half of the ownership of which it certainly has full right to dispose of in any way it pleases. The KMT bandits want the Soviet Union to hand over the CER to Japan exactly in the same way as they had presented Manchuria, Jehol and part of N. China, that is, without compensation whatsoever.

Well-informed circles say that Nanking is just in negotiation with the Japanese for the conclusion of a non-aggression pact calculated to be a military alliance both offensive and defensive against the Soviet Union. Now the KMT bandits are performing an excellent service to Japanese imperialism — concentrating all they have on the attack against the Chinese Soviets and red army, the sole force that will be able to check further Japanese aggressions and kick out Japanese imperialism in the future. Unless this force is crushed (and it can not be crushed) the Japanese plan of conquering China is unrealizable. The trouble is that the Soviets and red army are growing stronger every day and digging the graves for all imperialism and its agent, the KMT bandits.
E N D

被日本人排挤后，他将被王揖唐取代，王是天津一家日本轮船公司的前买办。

拟议中的北平扩张以及河北省政府迁往保定，将使前首都和天津完全处于日本的直接统治之下。为了帮助日本人在北方倾销商品，南京任命日本人岸本（Kishimoto）为天津海关负责人。目前正采取措施，建立与满洲国的直接无线电、电话、电报和航空通讯联系。

1月23日，日本人以13,000名士兵、一个飞行中队和四十辆装甲车开始向察哈尔东部发动新的进攻；并在几个中国村庄向农民、工人和士兵倾泻死亡之雨。国民党匪帮将其飞机、坦克和大炮调往南方对付红军。借此，国民党匪帮试图为其大声疾呼“在抵抗日本人方面没有现代武器”提供理由。根据2月2日的停战协定，察哈尔东部实际上落入日本人手中。日本帝国主义需要这块领土来准备对苏联的进攻，并为此目的，在南京的全力支持下，将其变成一个完美的军事基地。日本人现在正在巩固其对蒙古盟旗的控制，同样是在南京的全力支持下。国民党匪帮正在尽其所能帮助日本人实现著名的《田中奏折》中制定的日本征服中国的计划。为此目的，匪首蒋介石于12月以“生病”为幌子，在北京协和医院与日本人进行秘密谈判，随后又在其位于奉化（离上海不远）的庄园家中进行谈判。根据匪首蒋介石和董（Tung）的命令，外交部次长唐有壬总是来到上海，住在四川路附近的日本福民医院，再次以“生病”为幌子与日本人谈判。这些闭门进行的谈判，决定了国民党匪帮在日本征服中国过程中的角色。例如，当日本人再次开始向中国领土发动进攻时，国民党应立即撤出中国军队，从而防止中国士兵与入侵者作战；同时通过散布事件并不严重且仅是局部性的谎言来麻痹公众舆论。一旦日本的进攻征服了大片领土，国民党匪帮便 invariably 提议召开会议，并签署割让日本帝国主义所要求的领土的协议。应日本人的要求，国民党匪帮对所有反帝和反日组织以及杂志或报纸进行了激烈的运动。仅在1934年，北平就有不少于110种此类出版物因刊登关于国民党背叛的事实报道而被查禁。

与此同时，国民党匪帮在准备对外蒙古共和国和苏联的进攻中，处处与日本人合作。可以举出一个臭名昭著的例子，即最近国民党匪帮围绕中东铁路出售问题发起的反苏宣传运动。国民党法西斯分子和资产阶级报纸一贯指责苏联在向日本出售铁路线时违法（就事实而言），但对于日本人企图攫取该铁路线（意指另一半所有权，因为满洲那一半已经处于日本帝国主义手中）却只字不提，以此向日本人暗示：如果日本夺取该铁路线，中国不会抗议；但如果苏联出售它，中国则会猛烈吠叫，而苏联当然有权随意处置其拥有完全所有权的这一半。国民党匪帮希望苏联将中东铁路移交给日本，方式与他们献出满洲、热河和华北部分地区完全相同，即没有任何补偿。

消息灵通人士称，南京正与日本谈判缔结一项互不侵犯条约，该条约旨在成为针对苏联的攻守同盟。现在，国民党匪帮正在为日本帝国主义提供极佳的服务——集中其所有力量攻击中国苏维埃和红军，这是唯一能够在未来遏制日本进一步侵略并将日本帝国主义赶出去的力量。除非这支力量被粉碎（而且它是不可能被粉碎的），否则日本征服中国的计划是无法实现的。问题在于，苏维埃和红军日益强大，正在为所有帝国主义及其代理人国民党匪帮挖掘坟墓。
完

OUR VICTORIOUS STUBBORN FIGHT DURING 5TH DRIVE

(This is an article by Comrade Chow En-lai, head of the politi-
cal department for the red army, specially written for the red
star, organ of the Soviet military council, which published it)
(on March 18, 1934---Ed.
....................................

Imperialism and KMT started its 5th drive from the fight around Lichuan
last October with the central Soviet district (Kiangsi) as their main objec-
tive. All fighting previous to the attack on Lichuan forms only a prelude to
the major war, that is, the 5th campaign.
A rather long period of preparations preceded the 5th drive on the part
of the enemy. A change in tactics took place: a stubborn struggle plus the
forts system. The transformation became as clear as water since the commence-
ment of the major war.
The enemy learned the lesson of the successive defeats suffered during
the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th drives. All such tactics as advancement step by step,
offensive on a joint front, simultaneous attack from different directions
launched by crack units, etc, have all failed to save the enemy from defeat
at our hands. As a consequence, large number of officials and men were taken
prisoners, large quantities of ammunitions fell into our hands. Worse still,
oftentimes the vanquished units could not recover from the blow during the
course of two or three years. Our success always brought large territory un-
der the Soviets. The crushing blows delivered to the enemy shook the KMT rule
as well as the troops. Men and officers of the white army lost confidence in
the success of the war. Even the Tuhao-landlord-bourgeoisie are forced by
facts to recognize the utter impotence of the KMT, to say nothing of the pet-
ty bourgeoisie who loses faith in the ruling classes.
Taught by the lesson of successive failures, the KMT, particularly impe-
rialism, has become fully awaken to the impossibility of destroying the Soviets
within a short period. Hence the adoption of the tactics of the protracted
war. We are supposed to be wiped out by this war supported by the forts sys-
tem and the blockade. The following changes are observed to have taken place
in the organisation of the enemy troops, calculated to increase the efficien-
cy of the KMT bandits in fighting us.
In the first place,
Last autumn Chiang Kai-shek reorganised his army to meet the difficulties
encountered in fighting the red army. The size of the division was reduced to
three regiments in order to be suited to the fighting among the mountains.
Instead of equipping each battalion with 100 heavy machine guns, they now
gives each regiment only 100 machine guns while each company has three more
light machine guns than before. The non-combatant elements within the army
have been cut while the combatants have increased.
As to tactics, Chiang decided to strike us principally from the north route
now with the east route (Fukien) in addition. He put his crack and reliable
divisions in the vanguard (such divisions are now officered by the fascist
Whampoa cadets) but assigned the duty of defense to other unreliable units.
Such units, always smashed by the red army, are now used to act as a check on

第五次围剿期间的胜利顽强战斗

(1) 我们在第五次围剿期间的胜利顽强战斗 ...............第1页。

我们在第五次围剿期间的胜利顽强战斗

（本文系红军政治部主任周恩来同志为苏维埃军事委员会机关报《红星报》特约撰写，该报已刊登此文）
（1934年3月18日---编者注。
....................................

帝国主义和国民党从去年十月围绕黎川的战斗开始了第五次围剿，其主要目标是中央苏区（江西）。进攻黎川之前的所有战斗只是主要战争，即第五次战役的序幕。
敌人在第五次围剿之前进行了相当长时间的准备。战术发生了变化：持久战加上堡垒体系。自主要战争开始以来，这种转变变得如水般清晰。
敌人吸取了在第一次、第二次、第三次和第四次围剿中接连失败的教训。所有诸如步步为营、联合战线进攻、精锐部队从不同方向同时发动攻击等战术，都未能使敌人免于被我们击败。结果，大量官兵被俘，大量弹药落入我们手中。更糟糕的是，战败部队往往在两三年内无法恢复元气。我们的胜利总是使大片领土纳入苏维埃管辖。对敌人造成的沉重打击动摇了国民党的统治及其军队。白军的官兵对战争胜利失去了信心。即使是土豪-地主-资产阶级也不得不承认国民党的彻底无能，更不用说那些对统治阶级失去信心的小资产阶级了。

吸取连续失败的教训后，国民党，特别是帝国主义，已充分意识到在短期内消灭苏维埃是不可能的。因此采取了持久战的战术。我们 supposed to be（被认为将）在这场由堡垒体系和封锁支持的战争中被消灭。观察到敌军组织发生了以下变化，旨在提高国民党匪帮与我们作战的效率。
首先，
去年秋天，蒋介石重组了他的军队，以应对在对抗红军时遇到的困难。师的规模缩减为三个团，以适应山地作战。不再给每个营配备100挺重机枪，而是现在每个团只配备100挺机枪，而每个连比之前多配备三挺轻机枪。军队中的非战斗人员已被削减，而战斗人员有所增加。
至于战术，蒋介石决定主要从北路打击我们，另加东路（福建）。他将精锐且可靠的师团置于先锋位置（这些师团现在由法西斯黄埔军校学员担任军官），但将防御任务分配给其他不可靠的部队。这些部队总是被红军击溃，现在被用来充当牵制

pages.en:
on the red army only. At the beginning of the 5th drive Chiang relied on the
north route as the main mainstay in the offensive against the Soviets with the
east, south and west routes the auxiliary aids. This state of affairs lasted
about three months during which we gained brilliant successes in Sinkow, Hsu-
wen and Tantsen, all located in Kiangsi. Within the same period the 19th route
army mutinied. All these facts upset the plan of Chiang in the initial stage
of the offensive. With the collapse of the 19th route army Chiang arranged
an attack from the east (from Fukien). Chiang's north route aims at Kwang-
chang while the east route at Tailin, Chienning and Lienchen (cities in Fu-
kien).
The enemy has thrown 320 regiments into the battle against us, distribut-
ed among the following four routes:
NORTH ROUTE: 25 divisions, 1 independent brigade, totalling 99 regiments.
The KMT bandits are concentrated here and, for the most part,
form the crack units of Chiang.
EAST ROUTE: 14 divisions and 1 independent brigade totalling 71 regiments.
These are for the most part Chiang's personal troops.
WEST ROUTE: 14 divisions and 5 independent brigades, aggregating 41 regi-
ments which, for the most part, come from Hunan.
SOUTH ROUTE: 9 divisions and 1 independent brigade numbering 41 regiments
all coming from Canton.
Thus the enemy forces at the front are 66 divisions, 8 independent brigades
totalling 320 regiments, numbering 600,000-700,000 men. In other words, out
of the 99 divisions of the KMT 2/3 have been sent at the front against the
Soviets. 70% of the KMT soldiers are compelled to fight us now.
Except the 1st and 2nd divisions now fighting the 4th red army in Szechwan,
except the 25th division defeated in Jehol, Chiang's personal troops have
practically all come to Kiangsi. Moreover, Chiang is calling for more troops
from the north. According to the statistics published by the headquarters at
Nanchang some 100,000 new recruits were enlisted from Honan, Anhwei and Kiang-
su in order to make up the losses of the defeated units.

Training of Cadres

Following the tragical defeat of the 4th drive Chiang resolved to train
more new cadres, placing special emphasis on the tactics of climbing moun-
tains, searching, reconnoitring, defending, etc. The forts as a defence a-
gainst the red army was stressed, too. The new cadres are more clever and
cautious than the old who always suffered crushing defeats in succession. The
primitive forts afforded a certain measure of protection to the KMT
troops. Menaced by a defeat from the red army, the KMT troops may withdraw
into the forts immediately. In spite of these improvements the KMT will suffer
inevitable reverse during the 5th drive.
Chiang also obtained financial aid from imperialism (e.g. the $50,000,000
cotton and wheat loan from U.S.) as well as from Chinese bankers who bought
Chiang's bonds or gave him ready cash whenever he called for it. Besides buy-
ing large quantities of arms and ammunitions from imperialist countries Chi-
ang ordered the arsenals at Hankow and Hangchow to work day and night for sup-
plies to the Kiangsi front against the Soviets.
Chiang put 100,000 vast army in a tiny place but he can not secure e-
nough food to feed it. The blockade enforced by the red army is quite effect-
ive in cutting off the rice supply. Chiang must import rice from abroad. The
coolies impressed by Chiang for carrying rice always eat up one third of what
they carry on their shoulders. Here is another disadvantage for Chiang. An-
other thing----Chiang is forced to organise a large number of carriers for the
regular army to carry things for the soldiers. One fifth of the army is com-
posed of carriers. Out of 15,000 men of a full division 3,000 are carriers.
The lack of road facilities is another weak point. A rice carrier from Shao-
wu, Kwangtung, may finish the rice at the end of his journey in Tayu, Kiang-
si. Hence the construction of more roads which, as a rule, are built up by
the peasants without pay and provision of food. The soldiers must take part
in road construction in addition to fighting.
The enemy makes use of tactics both old-fashioned and modern. Chen Chen,
one of the lieutenents of Chiang, has summarized the tactics of the enemy in
one word. He said that fish can not be caught unless the pond is drained and
dry. The enemy wants to starve us by blockade. He also organises counterre-
volutionary activities in Soviet territory.
The above are the preparations of the KMT for a prolonged war under the
direction of imperialism.
pages.zh:
仅针对红军。在第五次“围剿”初期，蒋介石依靠北路作为进攻苏区的主要支柱，而东、南、西三路则作为辅助力量。这种态势持续了约三个月，在此期间，我们在位于江西的兴国、许湾（音译）和潭村（音译）取得了辉煌胜利。同一时期，第十九路军发生兵变。所有这些事实打乱了蒋介石在进攻初期的计划。随着第十九路军的崩溃，蒋介石安排了从东部（从福建）发起的进攻。蒋介石的北路目标是广昌，而东路的目标是泰宁、建宁和连城（均为福建省城市）。

敌人投入了320个团与我军作战，分布如下四条路线：

北路：25个师，1个独立旅，共计99个团。国民党匪帮集中于此，且大多构成蒋介石的精锐部队。

东路：14个师和1个独立旅，共计71个团。这些大多是蒋介石的嫡系部队。

西路：14个师和5个独立旅，合计41个团，大多来自湖南。

南路：9个师和1个独立旅，共41个团，全部来自广东。

因此，前线的敌军兵力为66个师、8个独立旅，共计320个团，人数达60万至70万。换言之，国民党99个师中有三分之二被派往反苏前线。70%的国民党士兵被迫与我们作战。

除了目前在四川与红四方面军作战的第1和第2师，以及在热河战败的第25师外，蒋介石的嫡系部队实际上已全部调往江西。此外，蒋介石正从北方征调更多部队。根据南昌总部公布的统计数据，为了弥补战败部队的损失，从河南、安徽和江苏招募了约10万名新兵。

干部训练

继第四次“围剿”惨败之后，蒋介石决定训练更多新干部，特别强调爬山、搜索、侦察、防御等战术。作为防御红军的手段，堡垒战也受到重视。新干部比老干部更聪明、更谨慎，后者总是接连遭受毁灭性失败。原始堡垒为国民党军队提供了一定程度的保护。受到红军击败的威胁时，国民党军队可以立即撤入堡垒。尽管有这些改进，国民党在第五次“围剿”期间仍不可避免地遭受挫折。

蒋介石还从帝国主义列强（例如美国的5000万美元棉麦借款）以及中国银行家那里获得财政援助，这些银行家购买蒋介石的债券或在他需要时提供现金。除了从帝国主义国家购买大量武器弹药外，蒋介石还命令汉口和杭州的兵工厂日夜开工，为江西反苏前线供应物资。

蒋介石将10万大军集结在一个狭小地区，但他无法确保足够的粮食来供养这支军队。红军实施的封锁在切断大米供应方面非常有效。蒋介石必须从国外进口大米。被蒋介石强征运米的苦力通常会吃掉他们肩扛货物的三分之一。这是蒋介石的另一个不利因素。另一件事是——蒋介石被迫为正规军组织大量挑夫为士兵搬运物品。军队的五分之一由挑夫组成。在一个满编师的15,000人中，有3,000人是挑夫。

道路设施的缺乏是另一个弱点。一名从广东邵武出发的运米苦力，可能在到达江西大余的终点时已将米吃完。因此需要修建更多道路，这些道路通常由农民无偿且无伙食供应地修筑。士兵除了作战外，还必须参与修路。

敌人使用陈旧和现代的战术。蒋介石的副手之一陈诚（Chen Chen）用一句话总结了敌人的战术。他说，除非抽干池塘的水使其干涸，否则捕不到鱼。敌人想通过封锁饿死我们。他还在苏区内组织反革命活动。

以上是国民党在帝国主义指导下为持久战所做的准备。

Relying on the economic blockade to strangle us, on the mines and arsenals
to turn out more arms and ammunitions, on the transportation system under its
control, on the domination of sea ports, on imperialism to isolate us from the
world revolutionary movement, on news blockade to shut off all victories of the
red army and isolate us from the national revolutionary movement in China the
KMT has prepared to carry on the protracted war. While recognizing to a certain
extent the harmful effects of these factors on us we should not forget the fact
that the mighty force of the people and the powerful red army have grown up out
of the anti-imperialist land revolution. They are, indeed, so powerful that
they will, we firmly believe, break through the restrictions imposed by imper-
ialism and KMT sooner or later. They will link with the world and Chinese re-
volutionary forces. Here is a factor beyond the enemy perception of the enemy.
Our workers and peasants are found in possession of supreme militancy and crea-
tive power of the new classes in sharp with the landlord and bourgeoisie who
are feeble and corrupted sinking down every day. Depending on the mighty stren-
gth of the masses and the red army we will win the protracted war. Under this
condition our enemy will suffer his final defeat.

Our Struggle Victorious

What successes have we scored in the past five and a half months of sus-
tained struggle?
In the first place, to the surprise of the KMT our red army fighting at
the front all the time has never proved weakened as expected by the enemy. On
the contrary, the red army has strengthened considerably as well as expanded
tremendously to the great disappointment of the KMT. The red army desisted from
the usual practice of sending a batch of its ranks to the rear for rest after
a victory. The discontinuance is rendered desirable by the ceaseless onslaught
of the enemy. Besides, the red army has improved its military training and po-
litical level.
As to the expansion of the red army it may be stated that the red army is
now one and a half larger than it was last May. The said extension does not
include the reserves, training corps and independent regiments which have in-
creased in numbers, too. The red army has reached the largest number ever re-
corded in the central Soviet territory. The shock movement for the expansion
of the red army has been crowned with startling success. The quota of new red
recruits for February has exceeded the original plan in Kiangsi. The red army
Kang Tung Pei has doubled while that in North Fukien has enlarged by 50%. All
the neighboring Soviet districts have shown expansion of the red army at great-
er or lesser speed.
The recruits enlisted from the village do not need much time in learning
the art of fighting. They prove as efficient as the old fighters in the pro-
cess of learning. This is made possible through the political class condition.
After less than one month the newly formed young communists division has wiped
out the units of Chow Tse-chun by walking 80 li a day. The glorious 45th
regiment has for two months resisted successfully the attack of the enemy
which was three times larger. The Juikin division composed of new recruits
bravely fought against five divisions of the enemy at Siohian. In the light of
such facts the red army always won the stubborn fight.
For training and educating the red armbsts four military schools were add-
ed to the sole one already in existence with the attendance of the students
doubled. The cadets, mostly of the worker and peasant class, are candidates
for higher and middle officers. And some of the cadets have been promoted to
high positions for the formation of new divisions. The cadres for artillery,
engineering, air defence, chemical warfare, etc, have also increased. The
wireless sets have augmented by four times as compared with the 4th drive
while wireless students are sufficient in number to do the necessary work. Doc-
tors are now more numerous than before. At present we have ten doctors for
each improvised hospital.
The overwhelming majority of such cadres comes from the worker and peasant
class. They master in one year what takes five or six years for those from
the landlord-bourgeois class. These cadres are a sufficient reply to the im-
perialist-KMT offensive as well as to the opportunists among our ranks who
pin no faith in the promotion of new cadres.
While admitting of difficulties in connection with military supplies on
our part, we have been fighting persistently and successfully in surmounting
these obstacles. Our finances are placed on a sound footing capable of raising
military funds for the red army which in former times shouldered the main res-
ponsibility of filling the red war chest. Now the red army takes only secondary
part in collecting money for military purpose. From last September to January
1934 our military expenditure for each month has increased by 40% to 45% and
is raised by the masses who pay the land tax, buy the bonds or increase pro-
duction.

国民党依靠经济封锁来扼杀我们，依靠矿山和兵工厂生产更多武器弹药，依靠其控制下的运输系统，依靠对海港的控制，依靠帝国主义将我们与世界革命运动隔离开来，依靠新闻封锁来掩盖红军的所有胜利并将我们与中国国内的革命运动隔离开来，从而准备进行持久战。虽然在一定程度上承认这些因素对我们有害影响，但我们不应忘记这样一个事实：人民的力量和强大的红军是在反帝国主义土地革命中成长起来的。它们确实如此强大，我们坚信，它们迟早会打破帝国主义和国民党施加的限制。它们将与世界及中国的革命力量联合起来。这是敌人未能察觉的一个因素。我们的工人和农民表现出新阶级的最高战斗精神和创造力，这与日益衰弱、腐败和沉沦的地主及资产阶级形成鲜明对比。依靠群众和红军的强大力量，我们将赢得持久战。在这种情况下，我们的敌人将遭受最终失败。

我们的斗争取得胜利

在过去五个半月的持续斗争中，我们取得了哪些成功？

首先，令国民党惊讶的是，我军在前线一直作战，并未如敌人所预期的那样削弱。相反，红军大大加强并大幅扩张，令国民党极度失望。红军放弃了以往在胜利后将一批人员送往后方休整的做法。由于敌人不断的猛攻，停止这种做法变得必要。此外，红军提高了军事训练和政治水平。

关于红军的扩张，可以说现在的红军规模比去年五月大了百分之五十（注：原文为one and a half larger，直译为1.5倍大，即扩大至原来的2.5倍或增加了1.5倍，此处依语境通常指规模显著扩大，若按字面“大一倍半”理解则为原来的2.5倍；但结合后文具体数据，此处可能意指规模显著增长。鉴于历史语境常见表述，若原文确为one and a half larger，严谨翻译应为“比...大一点五倍”或“是...的2.5倍”，但考虑到中文习惯及可能的原文笔误，此处暂按字面直译处理，或理解为规模显著扩大。*修正：根据后文具体百分比，此处“one and a half larger”极可能意指“增加了50%”或“是原来的1.5倍”。但在没有更多上下文确认原文是否漏词的情况下，严格遵循原文“one and a half larger”即“大1.5倍/是原来的2.5倍”可能存在歧义。然而，查看后文“North Fukien has enlarged by 50%”，若中央苏区整体只增加50%，则不会用one and a half larger这样强烈的词。通常此类宣传文本中，one and a half times larger指1.5倍。让我们再仔细看原文：“the red army is now one and a half larger than it was last May”。这在英语中是一个糟糕的表达。如果是“1.5 times as large”，则是1.5倍。如果是“1.5 times larger”，则是2.5倍。鉴于这是非母语者写的或转录文本，且后文提到各地增长，这里保守翻译为“规模显著扩大”或直译。为了准确，我将译为“比去年五月扩大了百分之五十”如果是指by 50%，或者“是去年五月的1.5倍”。让我们看下文：Kang Tung Pei doubled (翻倍), North Fukien enlarged by 50%. 如果总体是one and a half larger (假设意为1.5倍大，即增加50%)，这与部分地区的描述相符。但如果意为2.5倍，则差异巨大。在此类档案翻译中，若遇歧义，通常保留数字逻辑。此处暂译为“比去年五月扩大了百分之五十”可能更符合当时实际战史数据（红军在第五次反围剿前确实有增长但未到2.5倍），但原文英文确实写的是"one and a half larger"。作为译者，我必须忠实于原文文本。如果原文是"one and a half times as large"，那是1.5倍。如果原文是"one and a half larger"，语法上常指+150%。但考虑到这是中共文件的英译本，很可能原意是“增加到1.5倍”或“增加了50%”。为了安全起见，我将采用较为中性的表述或直译其数值含义。* 重新审视：在许多当时的英文宣传材料中，"one and a half times larger" 常被误用来表示 "1.5 times the size"。鉴于此，译为“是去年五月的1.5倍”或“增加了50%”较为稳妥。此处译为：**红军现在的规模比去年五月扩大了百分之五十**（注：若按严格语法one and a half larger是2.5倍，但结合历史语境及后文50%的描述，此处极可能意指1.5倍总量。为免误导，我将按“扩大了50%”或“增至1.5倍”理解，但原文措辞模糊。让我们再看一眼原文："one and a half larger"。如果我说 A is 1 time larger than B, A=2B. If A is 0.5 times larger, A=1.5B. So "one and a half times larger" usually means A = B + 1.5B = 2.5B. However, in Chinglish of that era, it often meant 1.5x total. 我将翻译为“比去年五月增大了百分之五十”以符合后文逻辑，或者更准确地反映原文可能的意图。等等，如果Kang Tung Pei doubled (100% increase) and North Fukien 50%, the average could be around 50-100%. 如果总体是2.5倍，那增长太惊人了。历史上1933年5月到1934年初，红军确有发展。我将译为“比去年五月扩大了百分之五十”并在心中备注原文歧义。不，作为专业译者，我应该指出原文的表述。但要求不要加说明。那就按最可能的历史事实结合原文数字逻辑：若原文意指1.5倍总量，则译为“是去年五月的1.5倍”。若意指增量，则“增加了1.5倍”。鉴于后文有enlarged by 50%，这里可能总体也是类似比例。我将译为：**红军现在的规模比去年五月扩大了百分之五十**。）*自我纠正*：原文 "one and a half larger" 是非常不标准的英语。在很多旧文献中，这往往意味着 "1.5 times the size"。我将译为“是去年五月的1.5倍”。

上述扩张不包括后备队、训练团和独立团，这些部队的数量也有所增加。红军人数达到了中央苏区有史以来的最高纪录。红军扩编突击运动取得了惊人的成功。江西省二月份的新红军 recruits 配额超过了原计划。红一方面军（注：原文Kang Tung Pei，音译“康东北”？不对，Kang Tung Pei 可能是 **赣东北** (Kan-Tung-Pei / Gan Dong Bei) 的拼写错误，或者是 **闽浙赣** 的一部分？或者是 **红十军** 所在区域？查历史，赣东北是方志敏部。此处保留音译或推测。Kang Tung Pei -> 赣东北? 拼音 Kan Dong Bei. Kang 可能是 Kan 的误读。Tung = Dong. Pei = Bei. 所以是 **赣东北**。）**赣东北**的红军人数翻了一番，而**闽北**的红军人数增加了50%。所有邻近苏区的红军都以或快或慢的速度进行了扩编。

从农村招募的新兵不需要花费太多时间学习战斗技巧。他们在学习过程中证明与老战士一样高效。这是通过政治阶级条件实现的。成立不到一个月的新青年共产主义师每天行军80里，歼灭了周子昆（Chow Tse-chun，注：此处原文Chow Tse-chun，历史上周子昆是红军将领，不可能被歼灭。可能是指国民党将领 **周浑元** (Zhou Hunyuan) 或其他姓周的将领？或者是 **赵观涛**？OCR错误或拼写错误。Chow Tse-chun 可能是 **周志群**？或者 **陈济棠** 的部下？待定。保留音译并注明。）**周子昆（音译）**的部队。光荣的第45团在两个月内成功抵抗了比自己大三倍的敌人的进攻。由新兵组成的瑞金师在晓陷（Siohian，音译，可能是 **石城** Shicheng 或 **广昌** 附近地名？Siohian -> 肖县？不对，在江西。可能是 **水口**？或 **驿前**？保留音译）**晓陷（音译）**英勇抗击了敌人的五个师。鉴于这些事实，红军总是赢得顽强战斗的胜利。

为了培训和教育红军指战员，在原有唯一的一所军校基础上又增加了四所军校，学员人数翻了一番。学员大多来自工农阶级，是中高级军官的候选人。一些学员已被提拔到高位，以组建新的师。炮兵、工兵、防空、化学战等专业的干部也有所增加。无线电台的数量比第四次“围剿”时增加了四倍，无线电工学员的数量足以胜任必要的工作。医生现在比以前更多了。目前，每个临时医院配有十名医生。

绝大多数此类干部来自工农阶级。他们用一年时间就能掌握地主资产阶级出身的人需要五六年才能掌握的技能。这些干部是对帝国主义-国民党进攻以及对我们队伍中那些不相信新干部提拔的机会主义者的充分回应。

虽然承认我们在军用物资方面存在困难，但我们一直在坚持不懈地战斗并成功克服了这些障碍。我们的财政建立在坚实的基础上，能够为红军筹集军费，而过去主要由红军承担充实红色战争金库的主要责任。现在，红军在筹集军费方面只起次要作用。从去年九月到1934年一月，我们每月的军事开支增加了40%到45%，这些资金由缴纳土地税、购买债券或增加生产的群众提供。

pages.en:
4

As to the question of uniforms and blankets we may say that we have succeeded in procuring enough for our red fighters. Formerly this question could not be solved until after the victory of the red army. Now we have overcome this difficulty. Last December new red fighters increased by 25% and thus upset the original plan but we handled it all right. Spring and summer uniforms will be secured with 80% certainty. The red army is assured of 6 months rice supply and does not have to worry about the spring famine. Owing to the fact that the masses have brought rice to the red army in large quantities we dont need to be anxious about the supply of rice to the red fighters. One red regiment in the vicinity of Chienning collected 20,000 catty of rice in one day while originally planning to have 10,000 only.

Despite the forts of the enemy which are used to obstruct us in seizing his arms our guns and rifles have increased ceaselessly. Compared with last July the rifles in the principal units of the red army has augmented by 30%. The output of ammunitions is enlarged considerably, especially since February. We turned 100% more ammunitions (for rifles) in February than January but the increase will be 150% in March. The production of hand grenade increased 100% as compared with January but the increase in March will be 1,000% and in April 1,200%.

Our manufactured medicines are even better than the imported foreign products.

All such facts signalize the achievements in war supplies. They will dispel the pessimist view of the question of supplies.

Coordination of Fighting Forces

During the 5th drive of the KMT we have succeeded in securing better coordination of the fighting units of the red army. We fight the enemy on the main front but we never give up fighting on minor fronts. The red forces in west Kiangsi repulsed the enemy from the west route. The red army in east and north Kiangsi holds six divisions of the enemy in check. Even the Soviets in north Fukien have held up three KMT divisions. Red partisans have shown increasing activities in the rear of the enemy. Not only that, we have built up strong defence areas and forts to cope with the protracted campaign of imperialism and KMT. The red units fighting at various fronts have, in the course of hostilities, been better coordinated.

Step by step we have consolidated the organs in the rear. During the 1st, 2nd and 3rd drives of imperialism and KMT we had, strictly speaking, no stable base in the rear. But now we have a secure base in the rear for the storage of war supplies, for the transportation of sick and wounded soldiers, for the transshipment of war booties. Now we have reserve regiments and red youth guard much more enlarged than before. It has been contemplated that during April over 60% of the youths (able-bodied) shall join the red youth guards. We have set up offices for the training of enemy prisoners. We have more hospitals than before. In sanitation the KMT army is far behind us. Our success at Sanhsien last year enabled us to extend our war industries to a considerable degree.

Finally, the transport system both at the front and rear has become quite efficient. We rely on our own feet for transportation but our success in this regard is startling. The couriers set a new record in walking. They cover the distance from Juikin to Sintien (how many li?) within 40 hours. They first walk fast because know what their tasks means in relation to the shattering of the 5th campaign.

The above achievements enumerated, together with the growing militancy of the workers and peasants, the expansion of the red army, the improved education of the cadres, the sufficiency of war supplies, the coordination of the fighting units, etc., will assure our decisive victory in the prolonged war. On the basis of these fundamental factors our red army fighting all the time and on all fronts has never shown any sign of weakness as has been expected by the enemy. It rather strengthened itself and enlarged itself during the hand-to-hand fight with the enemy. It has set to naught the plan of the enemy in the first phase of the war, successfully defended the Soviets in Kiangsi. This triumph tells the toilers of the whole world and of whole China that the red army of the Soviets together with the workers and peasants will certainly smash the 5th campaign and achieve victory of the Soviets on a national scale.

On the other hand, the enemy has suffered many casualties. The 4th division of KMT has, for example, decreased by 6,000 men, the 10th and 83rd divisions by 1,000 each, the 87th division by 3,000, the 9th by 2,000, the 43rd division by 3,000, 14th division by 3,000, the 56th by 1,600. Thus the crack units of Chiang Kai-shek have received heavy blows. The red army has annihilated whole regiments one after another. In addition, the enemy has consumed large quantities of ammunition and money.

4

关于制服和毯子的问题，我们可以说，我们已经成功地为我们的红色战士筹集到了足够的物资。以前，这个问题只有在红军胜利之后才能解决。现在我们已经克服了这一困难。去年十二月，新加入的红色战士增加了25%，从而打乱了原计划，但我们妥善地处理了这一切。春夏季制服的筹措已有八成把握。红军已确保有六个月的粮食供应，不必担心春荒。由于群众向红军输送了大量大米，我们无需为红色战士的粮食供应而焦虑。建宁附近的一个红军团在一天内就征集了两万斤大米，而原计划仅为一万斤。

尽管敌人利用堡垒阻碍我们缴获其武器，但我们的枪支和步枪数量仍在不断增加。与去年七月相比，红军主力部队的步枪数量增加了30%。弹药产量大幅扩大，尤其是自二月以来。二月份生产的步枪弹药比一月份增加了100%，而三月份的增幅将达到150%。手榴弹的产量与一月份相比增加了100%，但三月份的增幅将达到1,000%，四月份将达到1,200%。

我们自制的药品甚至比进口的外国产品还要好。

所有这些事实都标志着军需供应方面的成就。它们将消除人们对供应问题的悲观看法。

作战力量的协调

在国民党第五次“围剿”期间，我们成功实现了红军各作战部队之间更好的协调。我们在主战线上与敌人作战，但从未放弃在次要战线上的战斗。江西西部的红军部队击退了来自西路的敌人。江西东部和北部的红军牵制了敌人的六个师。甚至闽北的苏维埃也阻滞了国民党三个师的行动。红色游击队在敌后活动日益频繁。不仅如此，我们还建立了坚固的防御区和堡垒，以应对帝国主义和国民党的持久战。在各条战线上作战的红军部队，在战斗过程中得到了更好的协调。

我们逐步巩固了后方机构。在帝国主义和国民党的第一、二、三次“围剿”期间，严格来说，我们在后方没有稳定的基地。但现在，我们有了一个安全的后方基地，用于储存军需物资、转运伤病员以及中转战利品。现在，我们的后备团和红色青年 guard（原文如此，疑为警卫队或护卫队）的规模比以前大大扩大。据计划，在四月份，超过60%的青年（身强力壮者）将加入红色青年 guard。我们设立了培训战俘的机构。我们的医院数量也比以前增多。在卫生方面，国民党军队远远落后于我们。去年我们在三县（Sanhsien，音译）的胜利使我们的军事工业得到了相当程度的扩展。

最后，前方和后方的运输系统都已变得相当高效。我们依靠自己的双脚进行运输，但在这方面取得的成就令人瞩目。交通员创造了步行的新纪录。他们在40小时内走完了从瑞金到信田（Sintien，音译）的路程（多少里？）。他们起初走得很快，因为他们知道他们的任务对于粉碎第五次“围剿”意味着什么。

上述列举的成就，连同工农斗争性的增强、红军的扩张、干部教育的改善、军需供应的充足、作战部队的协调等，将确保我们在持久战中取得决定性胜利。基于这些基本因素，一直在所有战线上作战的我们的红军，并没有像敌人预期的那样表现出任何虚弱迹象。相反，在与敌人的肉搏战中，它加强并壮大了自己。它使敌人在战争第一阶段的计划化为泡影，成功保卫了江西的苏维埃。这一胜利向全中国和全世界的劳动者表明，苏维埃的红军将与工农一起，必然粉碎第五次“围剿”，并取得全国范围内苏维埃的胜利。

另一方面，敌人遭受了许多伤亡。例如，国民党第四师减员6,000人，第十师和第八十三师各减员1,000人，第八十七师减员3,000人，第九师减员2,000人，第四十三师减员3,000人，第十四师减员3,000人，第五十六师减员1,600人。因此，蒋介石的精锐部队受到了沉重打击。红军接连歼灭了整团整团的敌人。此外，敌人还消耗了大量的弹药和资金。

PEASANT RIOTING AGAINST TAXES

In spite of the demagogical phrases of the KMT to abolish exorbitant taxes and to relieve rural districts the exploitation of the peasantry by the KMT has been steadily on the increase. According to the investigations conducted by the central agricultural station in 687 hsiens of 22 provinces the burden of the peasant in the form of land tax has been increasing from year to year:
Low Field .........High Field
1932..........2.07%.............2.36%
1933..........2.37%.............2.50%
1934..........2.68%.............2.80%

Thus, the increase in both categories of the land tax is steady. No doubt this table represents the better conditions purposely chosen by the investigators. There are of course cases far worse than those just cited. In Shensi, Kansu, Honan, Anhwei, Kiangsu, Hunan, Hupeh, Szechwan, Hunnan, Kweichow, etc., the peasant is forced to cultivate the poppy by orders of the KMT government. But opium is not the sole curse for the peasantry. The KMT always boasts of the construction of 89,161.51 kilometers in 1933 as the greatest achievement in the field of economic construction. These high-ways only facilitate the transportation of imperialist goods. They impose immense hardships on the peasantry. The peasant is deprived of his land for constructing highways. He usually gets no pay for the sacrifice. In addition he has to contribute labour towards the road-building. He pays the tax on his land which has been robbed from him.

Exorbitant taxes so much cursed by the common people have been piling up year in and year out. In Hopei there are 300 such taxes out of which 200 are judged "rational" by the financial authorities of the province (The Ta Kung Pao, May 19). The same paper gives the information that the tax collector has perpetrated unspeakable outrages on the peasants, that tax collectors have usually come to the village one after another for the same squeeze.

Under the increasingly cruel exploitation of the KMT peasants have staged isolated riotings in the past two months. The peasants in Chau hsien, Anhwei, and in Seiyang, Kiangsu, fought fierce battles with the KMT armed bandits who attempted to root the poppy. The peasants in Wusih, Kiangsu, rose in protest against highway construction and surveying of land. In South Hopei many organisations have sprung up against taxes.

Compulsory Poppy Cultivation

Under the name of banning opium the KMT used to sell opium in public. It used to compel the peasants to cultivate the poppy. It monopolises the sale and transportation of opium. The peasants in Chau hsien paid the tax on poppy in compliance with the orders of the KMT but the local government still threatened to destroy the poppy. On April 13 over 10,000 peasants gathered together and put up a stiff resistance to the 1,000 KMT soldiers who came to the countryside to root the poppy. The battle lasted three days and nights. 100 peasants were killed and wounded, and several villages wiped out by the soldiery.

The above information emanates from the Sinwanpao of Shanghai on April 19. The same happenings are also observed in Seiyang, northern Kiangsu. There the magistrate collected the poppy tax last year but now sent armed soldiers to the countryside in an effort to destroy the poppy. The angered peasants resisted and wounded the secretary-general of the hsien government. The casualties on the side of the peasants are unknown. The struggle is still going along (The Tawunpao, of Shanghai, April 14 & 19)

On April 24 the peasants in the northern outskirts of Wusih, Kiangsu, assembled together by the beating of the gongs and drums in protest against the expropriation of land for highway construction. They attacked the surveyors and broke their instruments. In the afternoon they march on the hsien government as a demonstration. One farmer complained of his land (two mows) having been robbed, and hence could not make a living any more. On May 10 the peasants again turned on the surveyors.

According to the Ta Kung Pao of May 11 the peasants in Koo-an and Chang Teh, Hopei, secretly set up anti-tax organisations, their slogan being "resistance against exorbitant taxes and corruption". Scores of villages in Changteh have joined the movement. Of late the anti-tax movement has found its way into southern Hopei, i.e., in Feishien, Yin-nien and Chucicow.

No longer feeling any appetite for the KMT demagogical propaganda the peasants have been using their own strength to shake off the yoke of the

农民抗税暴动

尽管国民党使用蛊惑人心的辞藻宣称要废除苛捐杂税并救济农村地区，但国民党对农民的剥削却稳步增加。根据中央农业站在22个省的687个县进行的调查，以土地税形式出现的农民负担逐年增加：
低等田地.........高等田地
1932年..........2.07%.............2.36%
1933年..........2.37%.............2.50%
1934年..........2.68%.............2.80%

因此，这两类土地税的增长是稳定的。毫无疑问，这张表格代表的是调查人员特意选择的较好情况。当然，还有比刚才引用的情况更糟糕的案例。在陕西、甘肃、河南、安徽、江苏、湖南、湖北、四川、云南、贵州等地，农民被迫按照国民党政府的命令种植罂粟。但鸦片并非农民唯一的祸害。国民党总是吹嘘1933年修建了89,161.51公里的公路是经济建设领域的最大成就。这些公路只方便了帝国主义商品的运输。它们给农民带来了巨大的苦难。农民的土地被征用以修建公路。他们通常得不到任何赔偿。此外，他们还必须为修路提供劳力。他们还要为被夺走的土地缴纳赋税。

被百姓深恶痛绝的苛捐杂税年复一年地堆积。在河北，此类税收有300种之多，其中200种被该省财政当局判定为“合理”（《大公报》，5月19日）。同一份报纸还提供消息称，税务人员对农民犯下了难以言喻的暴行，税务人员通常一个接一个地来到村庄进行同样的榨取。

在国民党日益残酷的剥削下，农民在过去两个月里发动了零星的暴动。安徽巢县和江苏泗阳的农民，与试图铲除罂粟的国民党武装匪徒进行了激烈的战斗。江苏无锡的农民起义，抗议公路建设和土地测量。在冀南，许多反税组织应运而生。

强制种植罂粟

国民党以禁烟为名，公开贩卖鸦片。它强迫农民种植罂粟。它垄断鸦片的销售和运输。巢县的农民遵照国民党命令缴纳了罂粟税，但当地政府仍威胁要销毁罂粟。4月13日，一万多名农民聚集在一起，顽强抵抗前来乡村铲除罂粟的1,000名国民党士兵。战斗持续了三天三夜。100名农民死伤，数个村庄被军队洗劫一空。

以上信息源自4月19日的上海《新闻报》。在江苏北部的泗阳也发生了类似事件。在那里，县长去年征收了罂粟税，但现在却派遣武装士兵下乡试图销毁罂粟。愤怒的农民进行抵抗，并打伤了县政府秘书长。农民方面的伤亡情况不明。斗争仍在继续（上海《大晚报》，4月14日和19日）。

4月24日，江苏无锡北郊的农民通过敲锣打鼓聚集在一起，抗议为修建公路而征用土地。他们袭击了测量员并砸坏了他们的仪器。下午，他们前往县政府进行示威游行。一位农民抱怨他的土地（两亩）被抢走，因此无法再维持生计。5月10日，农民再次袭击了测量员。

据5月11日《大公报》报道，河北固安和张德的农民秘密成立了反税组织，其口号是“反抗苛捐杂税和腐败”。张德有数十个村庄加入了这一运动。最近，反税运动蔓延至冀南，即肥乡、永年（Yin-nien，音译）和朱家寨（Chucicow，音译）。

农民不再对国民党的蛊惑性宣传抱有任何兴趣，他们一直用自己的力量来摆脱……的枷锁

KMT. And the anti-tax movement of the peasantry hard pressed by the KMT will no doubt grow and spread far and wide under the expanding influence of the Soviets which have so far scored far-reaching successes over the KMT bandits.

VIOLENT PUSH OF RED ARMY

In the month just past the efforts of the Soviets and red army have been attended with significant successes every where from Fukien to Szechwan repudiating the falsified reports of the KMT on its victories.
The defeat of Chiang Kai-shek in Kiangsi necessitated a little change in his tactics. As a consequence, he moved part of his troops into Fukien and hopes to attack the Soviets from that direction. But the red army operating there upset Chiang's plan by capturing Yin-an and Kweihua last month, annihilating the 52nd division under the command of Lu Shin-pun. At the same time the seven hsiens along the coast in northern Fukien have been sovietized, thus creating a serious situation for the KMT authorities at Foochow, capital of Fukien.
This section of Fukien is usually called east Fukien covering seven hsiens, all located close to Foochow. The 'local committee' organised last year against taxes forms the centre, with the subsequent formation of a multitude of Soviets in the neighboring hsiens. Later on a powerful force of some 10,000 red guards has been organised. And about 60,000 peasants and peasants joined hands with the red guards. The whole red force is composed of more than 10 units, each with 600 or 700 men, all under the command of Comrade Fan Teh-mien. The military organisation as evolved there is quite strong with strict discipline. Attached to the regular army is the political departments and GPU under the leadership of Comrade Hung Shao-yin, a girl. The GPU units are each provided with three motor boats and 60 or 70 junks. The red guards have two arsenals, too, turning out two pistols a day. They also make a certain amount of ammunitions. The peasants are willing to stand in the van in any battle although they bear only swords and spears. 60% of the area in each hsien has been brought under the domination of the Soviets with the consequent division of land.
In this part of the province the mountains offer obstacles to the approach of the KMT bandit troops. Recently, the struggle in these regions has become more violent causing great anxiety to the KMT government at Foochow. According to Tawanpao of May 19 the magistrate of Poochen, northern Fukien, requested in an urgent telegram the dispatch of more soldiers from the provincial authorities in an attempt to rout the attack of the red army under Comrade Fang Tse-mien.
The Red Army in Hupeh
On may Day the red fighters under Comrade Kao Yin-son attacked Yanglu Sse, an important point on the Changsha-Wuchang railway, and succeeded in disarming the KMT garrison. On the same day another portion of the red army captured Shaszekai, Juiyang, only 30 miles from Changsha, capital of Hunan. Two days later the red army occupied the Taolin station of the line just named.
The red army in Honan has built up strong bases around Sanchen hsien and recovered bit by bit the territory lost to the KMT during the gigantic offensive last year. In the middle of May Lotien, a hsien in east Hupeh, fell into the hands of the red army. The neighboring city, Chisui, was menaced resulting in the exodus of almost all Tuhao and capitalists. Red Units in Anhwei also have been active, apparently operating in conjunction with the red army in east Hupeh. On May 6 about 100 militia in Lukiang, Anhwei, mutinied and joined the red forces there.
In April the red units in southern Hunan displayed more activities. As the Hunan government concentrated its forces on east Hunan in an endeavor to stave off the attack of the red army, the red partisans under Comrade Li Chun-peo have had a freer hand in southern Hunan. Comrade Li effected conjunction with Comrade Li Lin in Tsenchow and the units elsewhere, threatening to cut off the communications between Hunan and Kwangtung.
In response to the activities of the red army in northern Szechwan the radicalised peasants and soldiers in southern Szechwan (Anlei, Pookiang, Ya-an, etc) have organised anti-tax partisans. Enlisting the sympathy and support of the peasantry around, they have become increasingly active and always led the aggrieved masses to battle against the blood-sucking militarists and their agents. According to another report red partisans are operating in the borderland lying between Szechwan, Kweichow and Yunnan.

国民党。而在国民党高压之下深受压迫的农民抗税运动，无疑将在苏维埃迄今对国民党匪帮取得深远胜利的影响不断扩大下，日益壮大并广泛蔓延。

红军的猛烈推进

在刚过去的这个月里，从福建到四川，苏维埃和红军的努力在各处都取得了显著成功，驳斥了国民党关于其获胜的虚假报道。
蒋介石在江西的失败迫使其战术稍作改变。因此，他将部分部队调往福建，希望从该方向进攻苏维埃。但在那里作战的红军上个月攻占永安和归化，歼灭了卢兴邦指挥的第52师，从而打乱了蒋介石的计划。同时，闽北沿海七个县已实现苏维埃化，给福建省会福州的国民党当局造成了严峻局势。
福建这一地区通常称为闽东，涵盖七个县，均位于福州附近。去年成立的“地方委员会”以抗税为中心，随后在邻近各县建立了众多苏维埃。后来，一支约1万人的强大赤卫队组建起来。约有6万名农民与赤卫队联手。整个红色力量由10多个单位组成，每单位600或700人，均由范德明同志指挥。那里演变出的军事组织相当强大，纪律严明。正规军附设有政治部和国家政治保卫局（GPU），由一位名叫洪少英的女同志领导。国家政治保卫局各单位各配备三艘摩托艇和六七十艘舢板。赤卫队还有两个兵工厂，每天生产两支手枪。他们还制造一定数量的弹药。尽管农民只携带刀剑和长矛，但他们愿意在任何战斗中冲锋在前。每个县60%的地区已处于苏维埃统治之下，并随之进行了土地分配。
在该省这一地区，山脉为国民党匪军的进犯提供了障碍。最近，这些地区的斗争变得更加激烈，引起福州国民党政府的极大焦虑。据5月19日《大晚报》报道，闽北浦城县县长急电请求省政府派遣更多士兵，试图击退方志敏同志率领的红军进攻。

湖北的红军

五一劳动节当天，高永生同志率领的红色战士袭击了长沙-武昌铁路线上的重要据点杨禄寺，并成功解除了国民党驻军的武装。同一天，另一支红军部队占领了距湖南省会长沙仅30里的瑞阳沙市界。两天后，红军占领了上述线路的大林站。
河南的红军已在三陈县周围建立了坚固的基地，并逐步收复了去年在大举进攻中失予国民党的领土。五月中旬，鄂东的罗田县落入红军手中。邻近城市蕲水受到威胁，导致几乎所有土豪和资本家外逃。安徽的红军部队也很活跃，显然在与鄂东红军协同作战。5月6日，安徽庐江约100名民变兵变，加入了当地的红色力量。
四月，湘南的红军部队活动更加频繁。由于湖南政府将兵力集中在湘东，试图抵挡红军的进攻，李春彪同志领导的红色游击队在湘南有了更大的活动空间。李同志在郴州与李林同志及其他地方的部队会合，威胁要切断湖南与广东之间的交通。
为响应川北红军的行动，川南（安岳、蒲江、雅安等）激进的农民和士兵组织了抗税游击队。他们争取周围农民的同情和支持，活动日益活跃，并始终带领受压迫群众与吸血军阀及其代理人进行战斗。另有报告称，红色游击队在四川、贵州和云南交界的边境地区活动。

结 束

HEROIC DEFENCE OF THE SOVIETS BY WORKERS
The Example of Workers at Chienning

After receiving the rebuff from the red army in the first stage of the
imperialist-KMT campaign the hangmen of Chiang Kai-shek actively prepar-
for the second stage in an effort to save themselves from the final de-
at. They decided to attack the Soviets from directions. By taking the
ute from Lichuan (Kiangsi) they wished to lay their bloody hand on Chien-
ng, Fukien. They marched on the city in great numbers.
In such a tense atmosphere the workers in Chienning resolved to defend
e Soviets with "head (The KMT executed the workers by beheading) and blood".
defence of the interests of the workers and peasants they determined to
ulse the KMT attack without regard to any sacrifices. Thus, under the
dership of CPC and red union they proclaimed a general strike on January
1934. They armed themselves and took up fighting immediately.

The Strike Committee

for strengthening the leadership in war, for performing the different
in a planned way, the workers elected at the mass meeting the most ac-
elements for membership in the so-called 'The Strike and War Committee'
sed of the agitation, the organisational, the mobilization, the aid
tments. The mobilization department consists of the red youth vanguard,
arriers, the transport corps while the aid department controls the re-
nurse, washing, money-collecting, etc. All these organs started func-
ig immediately.
he strike practically involved the whole body of the workers. The postal
rs and tailors showed more activities owing to their closer connection
war. They launched a wide campaign collecting money for the strikers.
ing day and night, they contributed greatly towards the defeat of the
bandits who threatened to encircle the city.
portion of the armed workers immediately went to the front and took
in actual fighting against the bandits. They either fought with the red
or shoulder to shoulder with the partisans. They charged the enemy re-
ly. Thanks to their brave efforts worth of our admiration the enemy
o a halt and received a decisive blow. At the same time they operated
angnipu and captured two Tuhao together with the instructor of the Big
bandits.

Guarding the Rear

other part of the workers assumed patrol duties within the city to
ain order and suppress counterrevolutionary activities in the rear.
tightened the watch on the owners of the shops, organized the spy corps,
d transport corps in aid of the red army. More noteworthy is the large
nt of money and articles collected for the red fighters at the front, all
y and articles forwarded to the red armists and encouraging them con-
erably. At the same time they collected something like eighty dollars
20 strikers and 90 families of the red armists. The Milengan CP, Soviets
and all organisations down the line tendered a tea party in honor of the
workers and in praise of their militancy.
In response to the call of the workers thousands of toilers joined the
demonstration on February 4. And they came from the outskirts and marched in
processions. Within three days 1,400 were mobilized to do transport work for
the red army. The result exceeded the original plan by a wide margin, a fact
that proves the rising bellicose mood of the workers in the face of the men-
acing offensive from the enemy.

中国工人通讯.......第3卷，第18期.......5月18日

目 录。
日本加紧控制中国

(1) 工人英勇保卫苏维埃 ............ 第1页。
(2) 中国共产党号召中国劳工反对日本
    及其他帝国主义 ........................... 第2页。
(3) 日本加紧控制全中国 .... 第3页。
