4
从北面的绥远到南面的汕头和广州，都受到了危机的不利影响。尽管上海积累了大量的白银储备，但也面临着货币危机，这充分反映在目前资金市场的紧缩上。上海的所有银行都拒绝向商号提供信贷，包括大型商号（例如，商务印书馆有限公司需要80万美元现金却无法获得，等等）。可靠的预测表明，当新年到来时，近3000家大小商店将无法重新开门营业。因此，上海的局势也很糟糕。

危机的原因

与其他国家一样，中国的危机是在局部范围内发展的，其打击对象是当地的商业中心，帝国主义的货物通过这些中心进入内地，本国的农产品则运往大型港口（如上海），进而输往国外。位于这些中心的本土银行通常为进出口商品的支付提供资金。它们还发行在当地流通的钞票。但它们的准备金通常严重不足。当大量现金像往常一样流向大港口以支付贸易逆差时，本土银行不仅面临金库空虚，而且无法获得足够的信贷来度过难关。
中国农民为市场生产的方式实际上与其他国家的农民相同。他用自己的产品交换来自外部的产品，主要是帝国主义商品。这一过程在1932年受到极大阻碍，对他不利，1933年更是如此。其根本原因是，西贡的大米、澳大利亚、加拿大和美国的小麦等外国商品涌入国内，将本国产品挤出市场；而由于世界危机以及外国政府提高关税，丝绸、茶叶、鸡蛋、皮革等本国产品在国外找不到市场。对中国农村不利的贸易逆差如此沉重，以至于当地商业中心的本土银行不得不支付大量现金，导致自家金库所剩无几。不用说，这些本土银行充当了农村与帝国主义商人之间交换货物的支付代理机构。如上所述的事实，是目前席卷全国的货币危机的根本原因。
第二个原因在于，国民党政府的各派系为了从国外购买武器弹药，比以往更加严厉地榨取民众。为此，他们需要现金或外国银行的钞票，拒绝接受本土银行或商号发行的纸币作为税款。在我们之前的刊物中，我们多次提到，自国民党掌权以来，江苏省的土地税增加了400%。这种过高的税收吞没了农民的所有收入。随着土地税的增加，国民党在去年12月提高了其他捐税，如火柴税、烟草税、盐税等。国民党军阀和政治家征收这些增加的税款，并将所得款项运往条约口岸（之所以称为条约口岸，是因为通过条约向外国贸易开放），用于购买弹药（用于对红军和苏维埃的战争，或军阀战争）、奢侈品，或用于外国租界内的土地投机，从而导致农村或附近城镇出现严重的资金短缺。广东省的税务局对本土银行钞票持否定态度，拒绝接受其缴纳税款。他们更喜欢香港银行发行的钞票。这一事实给已经在加速发展的货币危机火上浇油。
另一件事——海外华侨大额汇款的停止也在加剧危机方面发挥了重要作用（在汕头、广州、福建）。过去依靠这一来源作为现金储备，商号和银行总是能够在很大程度上缓解困难，但现在他们再也做不到了。在1931年之前的几年里，海外华侨的汇款平均每年达到3亿或4亿美元。
当然，反复发生的军阀战争构成了另一个因素

pages.en:
5
in bringing about the crisis. The civil war in Sinkiang caused the standstill in business in Suiyuan (and the monetary crisis). The independence of Fukien brought on its heels a run on the banks in Canton and threatened Wuhu with a crisis owing to the stoppage of importation of rice from this city.
The Leading Cities Hit
In the present article we mentioned but a few of the cities hard hit by the crisis. These cities are Swatow, Hsuchow, Kaifeng, etc.
Swatow is the most important port on the south China coast, probably second only to Canton, provincial capital of Kwangtung. Beginning in 1932, the crisis there broke out in 1933 with considerable violence. Before June, 1933, over 1,000 shops closed down in Swatow and the neighboring cities and towns. And a few of the leading banks and commercial houses met with the fate. To grapple with the crisis, the native banks and shops issued the Pei-go-piao (a sort of inconvertible paper) as a medium of payment. The situation worsened considerably since June. Without any prospect of redemption, the Pei-go-piao gradually depreciated and thus lost its effect of alleviation. In September the biggest native bank in port, the Chen-ta-yuan Chuan-trun, collapsed and rocked the credit system to its very foundation. Then the Kwangtung Provincial Bank came on the scene, allegedly to provide relief to the monetary situation. It circulated more than one million notes but exported $500,000 cash out of the city. By this very act it rather aggravated the situation instead of improving it as had been anticipated. Following the outbreak of the Fukien rebellion in November 19 native banks together with a number of first rate commercial houses went into liquidation.
According to a correspondence published by the Shun Pao of Shanghai, dated Dec. 20, the chamber of commerce at Swatow petitioned the Pacific Fleet Commander to force the acceptability of the discredited Pei-go-piao by military orders, and to restrict the withdrawal of deposits, an action that is highly problematical in its attempt to relieve the crisis. The large circulation of the notes issued by the provincial bank of Kwangtung but not backed up by corresponding reserve caused skepticism among the populace. The revolt in Fukien served as an occasion for this skepticism to manifest itself in a run on the provincial bank. In Canton the public has little confidence in the notes of the provincial bank of Kwangtung and has been forced to accept them at the point of the bayonet. As soon as the news of the Fukien revolt came to Canton, the people rushed for the bank and pressed for cash payment. The authorities got around the difficulty by another forcible means: borrowing one month's house rent from the populace (this borrowing amounted, in fact, to additional taxation because it will not be paid back).
Turning to North China, we have the same dismal picture. On Oct. 12 the Hsin-chang native bank at Kaifeng crumbled and spread the panic to Chenchow, Tsinan and other cities. The bank was supposed to be sound in view of its long history, and the collapse came as a surprise. Influenced by the failure of the banks, the Chuen-twuns in Chenchow and Tsinan suspended business for the time being. Had not the government and the bankers of Shanghai came to the rescue, the crisis would have become more disastrous.
In almost the same period we find another serious outburst of a monetary crisis in Hsuchow, Kiangsu, where seven notes-issue houses closed down on Oct. 7, 1933. The note-issue houses referred to put cut in circulation notes of various denominations worth 2,100,000,000 cash or 502,500 dollars, if converted at the present rate of exchange. Even down to the present, they are still unable to resume specie payment. The peasants and petty merchants, being the bulk of the note holders, lost heavy consequently, involved in the crisis, more than ten small shops shut up as a matter of course.
Tragedial incidents occurred later on. The chamber of commerce and the authorities at Hsuchow cooperated in establishing a joint office to cash the notes outstanding, and limited specie payment to one dollar for each note holder. On the proclaimed date of specie payment the office was thick with poor people from the country-side. Beaten and flogged by police and military who guarded the office, the poor country people waited patiently but received nothing after a whole day's waiting. Some of them tried to rush to the office but were badly beaten by the police and military. Not a few were fatally injured, mostly women and old men.
pages.zh:
5
在促成危机方面。新疆的内战导致绥远商业停滞（以及货币危机）。福建的独立随即引发了广州的银行挤兑，并因该城市大米进口中断而使芜湖面临危机威胁。

受打击的主要城市

在本文中，我们仅提及了少数几个受危机严重打击的城市。这些城市包括汕头、徐州、开封等。

汕头是中国南海岸最重要的港口，其地位可能仅次于广东省会广州。那里的危机始于1932年，并于1933年猛烈爆发。在1933年6月之前，汕头及周边城镇有超过1,000家商店倒闭。一些主要钱庄和商号也遭遇了同样的命运。为了应对危机，当地钱庄和商店发行了“北戈票”（一种不可兑换的纸币）作为支付媒介。自6月以来，局势显著恶化。由于没有任何兑付前景，“北戈票”逐渐贬值，从而失去了缓解危机的作用。9月，港口最大的钱庄“陈达源川传”（音译）倒闭，动摇了信用体系的根基。随后，广东省银行介入，据称旨在缓解货币局势。该行流通了超过一百万元的钞票，但却从该市运出了50万美元现金。这一举动非但没有如预期那样改善局势，反而加剧了困境。继11月19日福建事变爆发后，19家本地钱庄连同多家一流商号进入清算程序。

根据上海《申报》12月20日刊登的一封信件，汕头商会 petitioned（请愿）太平洋舰队司令，要求通过军事命令强制人们接受信誉扫地的“北戈票”，并限制提取存款，这一试图缓解危机的行动极具争议性。广东省银行发行的钞票大量流通，却缺乏相应的准备金支持，这在民众中引起了怀疑。福建的叛乱成为这种怀疑情绪爆发并引发对该省银行挤兑的契机。在广州，公众对广东省银行的钞票缺乏信心，一直被迫在刺刀威胁下接受它们。一旦福建叛乱的消息传到广州，人们便涌向银行，要求兑现现金。当局通过另一种强制手段克服了这一困难：向民众借用一个月的房租（这种借款实际上相当于额外征税，因为不会归还）。

转向华北，我们看到了同样凄惨的景象。10月12日，开封的“新昌”钱庄崩溃，并将恐慌蔓延至陈州、济南和其他城市。鉴于其悠久的历史，该银行本被认为稳健，其倒闭令人意外。受银行倒闭的影响，陈州和济南的“川传”（音译，指钱庄或银号）暂时停业。若非政府和上海银行家前来救援，危机将更加灾难性。

几乎在同一时期，我们在江苏徐州发现了另一次严重的货币危机爆发，1933年10月7日，七家发钞机构关闭。上述发钞机构流通的各种面额钞票总值为21亿文铜钱，若按当前汇率折算，合502,500美元。直到目前，它们仍无法恢复硬币兑付。农民和小商贩是持票人的主体，因此遭受了惨重损失，卷入危机之中，十余家小商店随之理所当然地关闭。

随后发生了悲剧性事件。徐州商会与当局合作设立了一个联合办事处，用于兑现未付钞票，并将每位持票人的硬币支付限额定为一元。在宣布的硬币兑付日，办事处挤满了来自乡村的穷人。这些贫穷的乡下人耐心等待，却被守卫办事处的警察和军人殴打鞭笞，整整等待一天后一无所获。其中一些人试图冲向办事处，但遭到警察和军人的毒打。不少人受重伤，大多是妇女和老人。

pages.en:
6
The specie payment lasted one week, paying out about a hundred dollars. And only 2 or 3 hours were allowed to the big crowd—apparently designed only to fool ... Instead of abating, the run became more serious as more people came along for specie payment. Then the authorities unmasked themselves by issuing an order to stop payment outright and to advise the note holders "to wait quietly" for liquidation. A couple of months have passed without any concrete steps being taken towards resumption of specie payment. The toilers are undoubtedly the hardest hit: now a heap of worthless papers remain in their hands as the only tangible sign of a compensation for their blood and sweat.

How About Shanghai?

On the surface the monetary situation in Shanghai seems much better than anywhere else in the country. But this is only a superficial observation. True, Shanghai is experiencing some trouble in handling the large stocks of idle funds coming from the interior. True, we do not witness any runs or signs of runs on the banks either Chinese or foreign. The inflationist policy of the Shanghai banks, together with Nanking's inflationist policy of public debts, have been causing much concern and worry among the populace. On the other hand, money is also tight. Seeing the approach of the crisis, the banks here are no longer liberal in making loans to their clients. Now even the first class firms in Shanghai are turned down in their proposal for a moderate loan. Slowly coming as it is, the crisis in Shanghai will nevertheless break out in the end. When it does come to the surface, it will be the most severe, perhaps similar to the ones which successively occurred in New York or Chicago.

CHIANG'S PLAN DESIGNED TO AERODROMES
during the 5th campaign

In view of the breakdown of the four campaigns before the heroic resistance of the red armies in the past the counter-revolutionary clique at Nanking has come to realize the importance of the aeroplanes as a more effective weapon in the 5th campaign against the Soviet and red armies in Kiangsi and other provinces. The theory lying back of it is that air war possesses a far greater destructive power in fighting than the troops on land who have always gone over to the side of the red army when brought face to face with the latter while the airships will be more reliable under the direct guidance of imperialism.

Proceeding on this theory Chiang Kai-shek built a network of aerodromes under the instruction of imperialist advisers in Kiangsi where Chiang's 5th campaign is in full swing at present. There 45 aerodromes have been constructed for the use of military planes, those at Nanchang, Nanchen and Nanfeng being said to be the largest, each covering 1,000 square metres, to be shortly enlarged to 10,000 square metres. Besides taking the land from the farmer forcibly, Chiang ordered the construction of the airdromes by conscript labour. All those forced to work for him must bring food and meals with themselves. Always subject to the fire of red partisans, the aerodromes under construction were made unsafe for the engineers in charge who went in by planes.

The KuT Air Force

Accurate statistics are not available on the real strength of Nanking's air force but conservative estimates place it at 350-400 planes as against 150 in 1932. Nanking laid down a plan to increase this number up to 700 in 1935, to be distributed among 23 squadrons for the army and navy. In addition there must be four squadrons of dirigibles.

As to the planes actually in the possession of other militarists, we have the following estimation more or less reliable: 100-200 for Gen. Chen Chitong, warlord of Kwangtung, who has spent huge sums on the development of the air force, 40 for Kwangsi, 20 for the 19th route army, all these to be called out to fight the reds. Of course they are to be used occasionally for militarist wars, that is to say, for the expansion of territory as well as for the acquisition of the control of a counterrevolutionary government in order to find favor with imperialism and to bolster the tottering Puhao-landlord-bourgeoisie rule.
pages.zh:
6
硬币兑付持续了一周，支出了约一百美元。而庞大的人群只被允许办理2或3个小时——这显然只是为了愚弄……挤兑并未平息，反而随着更多人前来要求硬币兑付而变得更加严重。随后，当局露出了真面目，发布命令彻底停止支付，并建议持票人“安静等待”清算。几个月过去了，在恢复硬币兑付方面没有采取任何具体步骤。劳动者无疑受到最沉重的打击：现在，他们手中只剩下一堆毫无价值的纸张，作为对其血汗补偿的唯一有形标志。

上海的情况如何？

表面上看，上海的货币状况似乎比全国其他地方都要好。但这只是表面的观察。诚然，上海在处理来自内地的巨额闲置资金方面遇到了一些麻烦。诚然，我们并未目睹针对中国银行或外国银行的挤兑或挤兑迹象。上海银行的通货膨胀政策，加上南京的公债通货膨胀政策，一直在民众中引起诸多关注和担忧。另一方面，资金也很紧张。鉴于危机临近，这里的银行在向客户发放贷款时不再宽松。现在，即使是上海的一流公司提出的适度贷款申请也被拒绝。尽管危机来得缓慢，但它最终还是会爆发。当它浮出水面时，将是最严重的，或许类似于纽约或芝加哥相继发生的那些危机。

蒋介石在第五次围剿期间设计的机场计划

鉴于前四次围剿在红军的英勇抵抗下失败，南京的反革命集团已经认识到飞机作为武器在针对江西及其他省份苏维埃和红军的第五次围剿中的重要性。其背后的理论是，空战在战斗中拥有比地面部队大得多的破坏力，而地面部队在与红军面对面时总是倒向红军一边，而在帝国主义的直接指导下，飞艇（此处原文为airships，结合语境应指飞机或航空器）将更加可靠。

基于这一理论，蒋介石在帝国主义顾问的指导下，在江西建立了机场网络，目前他的第五次围剿正在那里全面展开。那里已修建了45个供军用飞机使用的机场，据说南昌、南城（Nanchen，音译，可能指南城或南丰附近的地点）和南丰的机场最大，每个占地1,000平方米，不久将扩建至10,000平方米。除了强行夺取农民的土地外，蒋介石还下令通过征用劳工来建造机场。所有被迫为他工作的人都必须自备食物和餐食。在建的机场始终受到红色游击队的火力威胁，使得负责工程的工程师们乘坐飞机进入时处于不安全境地。

国民党空军

关于南京空军的实际实力，没有准确的统计数据，但保守估计其拥有350-400架飞机，而1932年为150架。南京制定了一项计划，要在1935年将这一数量增加到700架，分配给陆军和海军的23个中队。此外，还必须有四个飞艇中队。

至于其他军阀实际拥有的飞机，我们有以下或多或少可靠的估计：广东军阀陈济棠将军拥有100-200架，他在发展空军方面花费了巨资；广西拥有40架；第十九路军拥有20架，所有这些都将调集起来对抗红军。当然，它们偶尔也会用于军阀战争，也就是说，用于扩张领土以及获取对反革命政府的控制权，以取悦帝国主义并支撑摇摇欲坠的浦豪（Puhao，音译，可能指买办或特定阶层）-地主-资产阶级统治。

pages.en:
In selecting the candidates for the air force the KMT military authorities exercised more care than ever because they have found in the past that those chosen from among the workers and peasants are "unreliable". In face of the sharpening of the class struggle the workers and peasants are most easily aroused to class consciousness, hence "unreliable". Admission to the central aviation school at Hangchow, for instance, is very strict, the candidates required to secure guaranty from 10 high officials or from capitalists of over 100,000 dollars in property besides taking the regular entrance examination. The students now numbering 600 are therefore sons of the Tuhao-landlord-bourgeoisie. Besides the technical instructions from the American instructors, the students must receive the regular fascist political training. They are not allowed to read other periodicals besides the fascist journals. Recently one student was expelled owing to his initiative in organising an Esperanto society. Suspicious elements among the students have been regularly cleared by a process which, as a matter of fact, permitted only 50% of the students to be graduated and to participate in the drive against the workers and peasants. Even this has failed to prevent the graduating students from flying over to the red armies on two occasions in the past two years.

Rivalry among Imperialists

Imperialism not only takes a hand in the development of the KMT air force and civil aviation but sharpens the imperialist conflicts by striving to obtain a larger share in the control of the KMT air force, to secure more aviation rights as well as to get large orders for the planes. No doubt America stands out first in the importation of planes to China but Italian imperialism does not wish to lag behind. Recently, with the arrival of Chang Hsueh-liang came the Italian aviator, Commandante Mario de Banardi, winner of the Schneider cup, accompanied by several other Italian aviators (6 in all), all ready to secure orders for Italy and to take a part in the training of Nanking's air force. In Kwangtung British and American imperialism are active in their attempts to develop and control Chen Chitong's air force. According to a Reuters message dated Sept.6 Chen Chitong was prepared to spend $30,000,000 on military aviation. On the part of England, she wants to form an air company in competition with the China National Aviation Corporation, American, which controls three major airways, one from Shanghai to Hankow, thence to Chunking and Chengtu in Szechwan, another from Shanghai to Peiping and the third from Shanghai to Canton passing Chekiang and Fukien. Now this American concern is contemplating to inaugurate a new line connecting Shanghai with Manila and also another linking Shanghai with Yunnan. The German concern, Luft Hansa, operates a line from Shanghai to Sinkiang. In 1933 China imported more planes valued at $20,000,000 according to a conservative estimate. Thus imperialism is not only making a large profit but equips and trains the KMT air force, to hold it in readiness to attack the red army and the Soviet.

Finally, we may say a few words about demagogical campaign of the KMT "to save the nation by aviation". The campaign was carried on in cities and villages for no other purpose than to rob the people (worker and peasant) of their earnings. Consequently, large funds were raised from this source. But how much was actually obtained no body knows because those in custody of the money made no report on it. The aviation tax was levied here in Shanghai generally on the workers, deducting the tax from their wages. But the worker knew nothing about the use of the money he was forced to contribute. The five planes contributed by Shanghai to Nanking's air force have thrown bombs on the toilers in the Nanking-Fukien war, and will certainly throw more on the workers, peasants and red soldiers in Kiangsi and elsewhere.

END
pages.zh:
国民党军事当局在选拔空军候选人时，比以往任何时候都更加谨慎，因为他们过去发现，从工人和农民中挑选出来的人“不可靠”。面对阶级斗争的尖锐化，工人和农民最容易觉醒阶级意识，因此被视为“不可靠”。例如，进入杭州中央航空学校的条件非常严格，考生除了参加正常的入学考试外，还必须获得10名高官或拥有超过10万美元财产的资本家的担保。因此，目前600名学生都是土豪-地主-资产阶级的子弟。除了美国教官的技术指导外，学生们还必须接受常规的法西斯政治训练。除法西斯刊物外，他们不允许阅读其他期刊。最近，一名学生因主动组织世界语协会而被开除。学生中的可疑分子经常通过一种程序被清除，事实上，该程序只允许50%的学生毕业并参与对工人和农民的围剿。即便如此，在过去两年中，仍发生过两次毕业生驾机投奔红军的事件。

帝国主义列强之间的竞争

帝国主义不仅插手国民党空军和民用航空的发展，还通过争取在控制国民党空军方面获得更大份额、获取更多航空权以及获得大量飞机订单，从而加剧了帝国主义之间的矛盾。毫无疑问，美国在向中国进口飞机方面首屈一指，但意大利帝国主义也不甘落后。最近，随着张学良的到来，意大利飞行员、施耐德杯得主马里奥·德·巴纳尔迪指挥官（Commandante Mario de Banardi）也抵达中国，随行的还有其他几名意大利飞行员（共6人），他们都准备为意大利争取订单，并参与南京空军的训练。在广东，英美帝国主义正积极试图发展和控制陈济棠的空军。据路透社9月6日消息，陈济棠准备花费3,000万美元用于军事航空。英国方面希望成立一家航空公司，与掌控三条主要航线的美国中国航空公司（China National Aviation Corporation）竞争，这三条航线分别是：一条从上海到汉口，再通往四川的重庆和成都；另一条从上海到北平；第三条从上海经浙江和福建到广州。现在，这家美国公司正考虑开通一条连接上海与马尼拉的新航线，以及另一条连接上海与云南的航线。德国汉莎航空公司（Luft Hansa）运营着一条从上海到新疆的航线。据保守估计，1933年中国进口的飞机价值超过2,000万美元。因此，帝国主义不仅赚取了巨额利润，还为国民党空军提供装备和训练，使其随时准备进攻红军和苏维埃。

最后，我们可以谈谈国民党“航空救国”的宣传运动。这场运动在城乡开展，其目的无非是掠夺人民（工人和农民）的血汗钱。因此，从这一来源筹集了大量资金。但实际筹得多少无人知晓，因为掌管这笔钱的人并未公布账目。在上海，航空税通常向工人征收，直接从他们的工资中扣除。但工人对他们被迫缴纳的钱款的用途一无所知。上海献给南京空军的五架飞机，在闽变期间向劳动者投下了炸弹，将来肯定还会在江西及其他地方向工人、农民和红军士兵投下更多炸弹。

完

Chinese Officers Correspondence
Vol. 4, No 39
Oct. 18, 1934

North China In Greater Danger !

1. Growth of Partisans in North Shensi................................p. 1
2. Struggle of North China Worker in New Phase....................p. 2
3. The Acute Silver Crisis....................................................p. 3
4. Fascist Bandits Under Their Own Men..............................p. 4
5. British Manchuko in Szechuan..........................................p. 5
6. North China Facing Greater Danger..................................p. 6

Growth of Partisans in North Shensi

The Kuomintang bandit generalissimo, Chiang Kai-shek, departed for Si-an, capital of Shensi province, by air on the double tenth (birthday of the Republic of China) immediately following the convocation of the military conference at Suchang, principally for the purpose of taking steps to check the growing activities of the red partisans in N. Shensi as well as of the red army in the Szechuan-Shensi section. The ruling classes in Shensi have become exceedingly uneasy over the activities of the red partisans and red army in that part of China. It is particularly so with the red army in North Szechuan which, as repeatedly reported before, scored sweeping successes over the Kuomintang bandits.

At the same time the Peiping and Tientsin press gave considerable prominence to the report that the landlords-bourgeoisie along the eastern border of the province was driven out by the red partisans in September. These partisans, it is said, were likely to march in a southern direction.

The Hotbed in Shensi

Conditions in North Shensi are very favorable to the growth of the soviets and red army. There the Kuomintang exploitation is indescribly severe. As a result the mass struggle has developed to a higher stage. Taxes are not only heavy but numerous. Every mow for the cultivation of opium is taxed at 40 or 50 dollars. If the poppy is not cultivated, the land 'left fallow' is fined at 10.00 $ mow. The regular land tax is unusually heavy, amounting to 6 or 7 a mow. Each lamp for mere lighting purpose has to pay a tax of 10¢. The cleaning campaigns of the Tuhao have always burnt down the houses of the peasants and butchered the rural population by the hundred, driving out the starving peasants, etc.

Urban conditions are equally bad. Trade is stagnant. Industry comes to a standstill. Workers are thrown out on the street. Petty merchants are crushed by heavy taxation. Soldiers are not paid for several months.

Thus mass struggles have developed from one part of the province to another. Several strikes took place in the Yuling arsenal. And the strikers clashed with the troops attempting to curb them. In Chinchian 500 peasants, fully armed, fought against the hated tax. The peasants in Minno attacked the Hsien government. One machine gun company under Kao Hsuanchen mutinied. Numerous spontaneous struggles took place in the villages for the seizure of the arms from the Tuhao and Kuomintang. As a consequence of the mass struggles being highly developed the Kuomintang and Tuhao could not dare to return to their homes in the countryside in a good many of the hsiens. Yes, mass struggles have been developing rapidly and widely over the vast area in North Shensi.

The Agrarian Revolution in N. Shensi

The development of the land revolution in North Shensi combined with the victory of the red armies along the Shensi-Kansu and Shensi-Szechuan frontiers has absorbed large numbers of the toilers (workers and peasants) into the ranks of the red army which, consequently, is swollen up considerably. Beginning from the second half of 1932 four partisan detachments have sprung up in the northeast of the province under the leadership of the Communist
pages.zh:
中国军官通讯
第4卷，第39期
1934年10月18日

华北面临更大危险！

1. 陕北游击队的发展................................p. 1
2. 华北工人斗争的新阶段....................p. 2
3. 严重的白银危机....................................................p. 3
4. 法西斯匪徒杀害自己人..............................p. 4
5. 四川的英属满洲国..........................................p. 5
6. 华北面临更大危险..................................p. 6

陕北游击队的发展

国民党匪总司令蒋介石在许昌召开军事会议后，于双十节（中华民国国庆日）乘飞机前往陕西省省会西安，主要目的是采取措施遏制陕北红色游击队以及川陕边界红军日益活跃的活动。陕西的统治阶级对该地区红色游击队和红军的活动感到极度不安。尤其是川北的红军，如前多次报道，他们对国民党匪徒取得了全面胜利。

与此同时，平津报刊大幅报道了该省东部边界的地主资产阶级在9月份被红色游击队驱逐的消息。据说，这些游击队可能会向南进军。

陕西的温床

陕北的条件非常有利于苏维埃和红军的发展。在那里，国民党的剥削严重得无法形容。结果，群众斗争发展到了更高的阶段。税收不仅沉重，而且名目繁多。每种植一亩鸦片需纳税40或50美元。如果不种植罂粟，‘休耕’的土地每亩罚款10.00美元。常规土地税异常沉重，每亩高达6或7美元。每盏仅用于照明的灯需缴纳10美分的税。土豪的清乡运动总是烧毁农民的房屋，屠杀数百名农村居民，驱赶饥饿的农民等。

城市状况同样糟糕。贸易停滞。工业停顿。工人被抛上街头。小商贩被沉重的税收压垮。士兵数月未发军饷。

因此，群众斗争已从该省的一个地区发展到另一个地区。榆林兵工厂发生了几次罢工。罢工者与试图镇压他们的部队发生冲突。在晋县，500名全副武装的农民反抗令人憎恨的税收。民诺的农民袭击了县政府。高树勋麾下的一连机枪手发动兵变。在农村发生了许多自发的斗争，以夺取土豪和国民党的武器。由于群众斗争的高度发展，在许多县，国民党和土豪不敢返回他们在乡村的家。是的，群众斗争正在陕北广大地区迅速而广泛地发展。

陕北的土地革命

陕北土地革命的发展，结合红军在陕甘和陕川边界的胜利，已将大量劳动者（工人和农民）吸收到红军队伍中，从而使红军规模大大膨胀。从1932年下半年开始，在共产党的领导下，该省东北部出现了四支游击队

pages.en:
2
Party of China, operating in Fu-shi, Anting, Yench'an, Chinchm, Suiteh, and three other hsiens. These detachments are composed of revolutionary peasants and soldiers with a few rifles at the start. Now they each have from 40-70 rifles, assisting in the division of rice, resistance to tax, the attack on the t'uhao, officials and local militia. Several hundred such cases have happened in the past with the aid of the red partisans. And, more important still, the hard pressed peasants have always appealed to the partisans for help in their struggle against the oppressors.

Form One Division

The North Shensi partisans have under the most difficult conditions beaten off the attacks of the enemy, although outnumbered by several hundred to one. They have succeeded in establishing a stable base and marched to and fro in more than 100 villages with full liberty except for the fourth district under the fourth partisan detachment. They have organised 39 red guard corps and 185 poor peasant unions. Only a few scores of the red partisans tired one full brigade stationed at Kaoshanchen with the collaboration of the mass of the peasantry.

In the previous month a conference took place, attended by delegates of the partisan corps; and, to coordinate their activities, decided to set up a joint commanding headquarters. The conference also took another decision to extend the partisans so as to combine them into a full division. The recent upsurge of the partisan movement bears witness to the success of the decision referred to.

The Struggle of N. China Workers in A New Phase

With the outbreak of the strike of the miners who form the bulk of the proletariat in North China a new phase has set in in the militant strike movement of the N. China workers. In spite of brutal oppression the workers marched forward in a fearless spirit and won considerable success in a good many of the cases. In Hopei alone sharp struggles developed to an amazing extent from January to April, 1934.

Industrial Conditions

A couple of words are needed here to throw a little light on the status of industries in North China. Mines and textiles as the principal industries of North China have been the fertile ground for the development of the workers' struggle in the period under review.

Firstly, the miners figured largely in the strike movement. Several major mines including the Kailan were beset by eight grand strikes involving 110,370 workers. Out of this number six strikes were crowned with success. The railway workers on the Peiping-Suiyuan, Peiping-Hankow, Peiping-Mukden lines struck work 13 times involving 70,000 men. And they scored victory for nine strikes. The longshoremen in Tientsin went on strike four times and came out triumphant on two of the four strikes. Four strikes occurred among the workers employed by the telephone, tramway and lighting companies with the participation of 2,300 men. The cement workers at Tongshan numbering 8,000 walked out four times. There is yet a great number of minor struggles fought out in a desultory manner.

In the second place, the textile workers were no less militant than the miners in the fight against the offensive of capital despite the fact that they were constantly subjected to the attacks of the employer. Nevertheless they plunged into the struggle without hesitation. In the period under review 33,000 operatives took part in the 15 strikes involving a number of cotton mills. The match industry, another important enterprise in North China, experienced seven strikes with the participation of 48,000 workers. Walkout also happened in the flour mills, paper factories, etc, totaling 11 strikes and 45,000 strikers.

Apparently, the mine strikes involved more men than the textile walk-outs. 76.95% is the percentage of men involved in the mine strikes while in the textile strikes the proportion is reduced to 33.05%.

Form of Struggle

组建一个师

陕北游击队在极其困难的条件下击退了敌人的进攻，尽管敌我力量悬殊达数百比一。他们成功建立了稳固的根据地，并在100多个村庄中自由往来，除了第四游击支队所在的第四区外。他们组织了39个赤卫队和185个贫农团。仅凭几十名红色游击队员，在广大农民群众的协作下，就牵制了驻扎在高山镇（音译）的一个整编旅。

上个月召开了一次会议，各游击支队代表出席；为了协调行动，会议决定成立联合指挥部。会议还作出另一项决定，扩充游击队，将其整编为一个完整的师。近期游击运动的高涨证明了上述决定的成功。

华北工人斗争进入新阶段

随着构成华北无产阶级主体的矿工罢工的爆发，华北工人的战斗性罢工运动进入了新阶段。尽管遭受残酷镇压，工人们以无畏的精神前进，在许多案件中取得了相当大的成功。仅在河北，从1934年1月至4月，激烈的斗争发展到了惊人的程度。

工业状况

在此需要略作说明，以揭示华北工业的状况。矿业和纺织业作为华北的主要工业，在审查期间成为工人斗争发展的肥沃土壤。

首先，矿工在罢工运动中占很大比重。包括开滦在内的几个大矿山遭遇了八次大规模罢工，涉及110,370名工人。其中六次罢工取得了成功。平绥、平汉、平沈铁路线的铁路工人罢工13次，涉及7万人。其中九次罢工取得胜利。天津码头工人罢工四次，其中两次取得胜利。电话、电车和照明公司的工人发生了四次罢工，有2,300人参加。唐山的水泥工人共8,000人，罢工四次。还有许多零星进行的小规模斗争。

其次，纺织工人在对抗资本进攻的战斗中，其战斗性不亚于矿工，尽管他们不断遭受雇主的攻击。尽管如此，他们毫不犹豫地投入斗争。在审查期间，33,000名工人参加了涉及多家棉纺厂的15次罢工。火柴业是华北的另一重要企业，经历了七次罢工，有48,000名工人参加。面粉厂、造纸厂等也发生了罢工，共计11次，罢工人数达45,000人。

显然，矿业罢工涉及的人数多于纺织业罢工。矿业罢工涉及人数的比例为76.95%，而纺织业罢工的比例降至33.05%。

The struggle of the Chinese workers took on sharper forms such as strikes and bloody clash, overshadowing petition and bargaining. All in all, 159,150 workers took direct action 57 times in the four months covered, while only 17 petitions occurred with the participation of only 26,039 workers. In most cases direct action led to victory while bargaining and petition were for the most part fruitless. Victory is not only possible but probable in view of the present conditions when the masses are militant and somewhat experienced in the art of the struggle.

Compared with the six months from July to December, 1933, the struggles of the North China workers are five times as many during the four months surveyed (1934). And the clashes with police and military increased in the same proportions.

The Acute Silver Crisis

In face of the silver price soaring up in London and New York the Chinese landlord-bourgeoisie has to fight a crisis single-handed. At first the betraying government at Nanking took no action whatever in regard to the increasing exportation of silver from the country. Kung Hsiang-hsi, minister of finance, has repeatedly assured his imperialist friends that the government would not raise the tax on silver export, much less to institute an embargo on it. But the new peaks in the silver price abroad caused a heavy drain on silver stocks, especially from July to the time (that is, Oct. 15) when Nanking raised the tax on silver exportation as a preliminary step, it is predicted, to a possible silver embargo.

From January to Oct. 15 over $200,000,000 in silver has been exported while silver stocks stored in foreign and Chinese banks at Shanghai amount to some $500,000,000, a sum that will flee the country in five months at the record rate of July or October which is $100,000,000 a month. What a menace to the Shanghai compradore bourgeoisie and the landlord-bourgeois government at Nanking which relies on that huge sum of silver to carry on gradual inflation by the issuance of governmental bonds and paper money! Nanking is in sore need of ready cash to finance the campaign against the Soviet Government in Kiangsi.

Effects of Rise in Silver

Apart from calling forth large exportation of silver from the country the rise in silver price may produce fatal effects on Nanking. 52% of Nanking's revenue accrues from customs duties usually paid in gold units which as a result of the rise in silver has declined considerably in recent months. This is the primary motive behind the appeal of Nanking to Washington for aid regarding the rise in silver. But the White House either in its answer to the Chinese appeal or in interviews to pressmen is entirely elusive on the subject. Secretary of the Treasury, Morgenthau, is reported to have expressed the opinion that the U.S. Government will not deviate from the silver policy already decided on.

From the standpoint of national economy (entirely ignored by Nanking) of course there are many ill-effects resulting from the rise in silver. The higher price of silver, that is, the higher buying power of the silver dollar, will help imperialism in the extension of its market in China (imperialist dumping). And the result will be collapse of Chinese industries under the fierce onslaught of imperialist commodities, thereby throwing out the workers by the thousand.

On the other hand, many branches of exporting industries in China will suffer even to a greater degree, notably the silk filatures. A rise in silver amounts to raising the price for the exported silk and narrowing its market abroad. During the course of the world crisis China silk has already gone down, and its plunge into the abyss will be accelerated by the rise in silver. Here the large number of workers already laid off will be swollen up by more unemployed thrown out of the filatures.

Nanking's imposition of higher taxes on silver exportation is tantamount to going off the silver standard, thereby hastening the process of inflation already under way. Unrestricted inflation will bring more hunger and cold to the toiling population. 中国工人的斗争采取了更激烈的形式，如罢工和流血冲突，使请愿和谈判相形见绌。总之，在涵盖的四个月内，159,150名工人进行了57次直接行动，而仅发生17次请愿，参与工人仅26,039名。在大多数情况下，直接行动导致了胜利，而谈判和请愿大多徒劳无功。鉴于目前群众具有战斗性且在斗争艺术方面有一定经验，胜利不仅是可能的，而且是很有可能的。

与1933年7月至12月的六个月相比，在所调查的四个月（1934年）中，华北工人的斗争次数增加了五倍。与警察和军队的冲突也以同样的比例增加。

严重的白银危机

面对伦敦和纽约白银价格的飙升，中国地主资产阶级不得不独自应对危机。起初，南京的背叛政府对该国白银出口的增加未采取任何行动。财政部长孔祥熙反复向其帝国主义朋友保证，政府不会提高白银出口税，更不会实施禁令。但国外白银价格的新高点导致白银储备大量流失，特别是从7月到南京提高白银出口税之时（即10月15日），据预测，这是迈向可能实施白银禁令的初步步骤。

从1月到10月15日，超过2亿美元的白银被出口，而储存在上海外国银行和中国银行的白银储备约为5亿美元，按照7月或10月每月1亿美元的历史最高速率，这笔款项将在五个月内流出该国。这对依赖巨额白银通过发行政府债券和纸币来维持渐进式通货膨胀的上海买办资产阶级和南京地主资产阶级政府构成了多大的威胁！南京急需现金来资助对江西苏维埃政府的战役。

白银上涨的影响

除了引发大量白银出口外，白银价格上涨还可能对南京产生致命影响。南京52%的收入来自通常以金单位支付的海关关税，由于白银上涨，近几个月来该收入大幅下降。这是南京就白银上涨问题向华盛顿求助背后的主要动机。但白宫在回复中国求助或接受记者采访时，对此问题完全避而不谈。据报道，财政部长摩根索表示，美国政府不会偏离已确定的白银政策。

从国民经济的角度来看（南京完全忽视了这一点），白银上涨当然会产生许多不良影响。白银价格较高，即银元购买力较高，将有助于帝国主义扩大其在中国的市场（帝国主义倾销）。结果将是中国工业在帝国主义商品的猛烈冲击下崩溃，从而导致成千上万的工人失业。

另一方面，中国的许多出口行业部门将遭受甚至更严重的打击，特别是缫丝厂。白银上涨相当于提高出口丝绸的价格，并缩小其海外市场。在世界危机过程中，中国丝绸价格已经下跌，白银上涨将加速其陷入深渊。在此情况下，已经被解雇的大量工人队伍中将增加更多被缫丝厂解雇的失业者。

南京对白银出口征收更高税款等同于放弃银本位，从而加速已经在进行的通货膨胀进程。无限制的通货膨胀将给劳动人民带来更多的饥饿和寒冷。鉴于其传统的sur-（原文不清），南京能否成功遏制白银出口是很值得怀疑的。

Nanking will not dare to offend Japanese imperialism at the moment when all Chinese troops are ordered to evacuate North China on Japanese demand in order to make way for the smooth working of the puppet machine at Peiping with Huang Fu at the head (see below).

Fascist Bandits Murder Their Own Men

The bandit general, Chiang Kai-shek, organised the blue shirts as an aid to his betrayal of the country. But following the June 30th murder in Germany Chiang Kai-shek massacred his own lieutenants in practically the same manner. Likewise all news regarding the murder was suppressed. In the same way the murdered were charged with corruption. The murder or massacre as they call it was taken as a sign of disintegration of the fascist camp. The Japanese bi-monthly, "Shanghai", gave an account of the murder on October 1 with the materials supplied by another Japanese journal published at Hankow. The story is incomplete but amazing.

M. Fascist Blue Shirts

The blue shirts as organised by dictator Chiang Kai-shek are a secret organization enjoined to give every help him in the betrayal of national interests, to put down the anti-Japanese movement, to crush the communists as leader of the anti-imperialist movement by all possible and conceivable terrorist methods. Last year they shot Yang Chuan, a man reputed to have strong anti-Japanese and imperialist tendencies. In North China they assassinated Pei Yu-yuan, editor of the Gen Pao, a fellow that fought in his editorials against Chiang Kai-shek and Japanese imperialism. Last June they arrested Yu Chi-chuan and 19 others, all leaders of the national armed self defence. At the front in Kiangsi the fascist bandits organised machine gun corps to compel white soldiers to fight the red army although those soldiers refused to fire on the red army and wanted to join them in a common fight against Japanese imperialism.

As it is, the organisation of the fascist bandits is a conglomeration of traitors ranging from the old Anfu clique to the Shanghai compradore. All these traitors, whether old or new, have rich experiences in the art of betrayal. The notorious Huang Fu, head of the Peiping Political Council, is also a higher up in the council of the fascist bandits. Three fractions among the fascist bandits always fight against one another: 1) the Whampoa military cadets representing the Tuhao class, 2) the C.C. fraction representing the compradore class, 3) long discredited politicians, members of the old Anfu and Tsenghsueh cliques. The inner struggle in the fascist camp is still going on in spite of the murder of July by which Chiang Kai-shek desired to unify the various factions of the fascist bandits.

Cause of the Murder

As revealed by the Japanese journal the cause of the murder is in our opinion rather trifling. Corruption and graft is the only charge brought against the murdered, Chi Pei-gen and others. According to the Japanese story Chi squeezed a big amount of money out of $20,000,000 entrusted him to buy airplanes from Germany and America by buying second hand machines. Chi was the head of the aviation bureau under Chiang, most trusted by the bandit general. Informed of the squeeze, Chiang had Chi murdered in cold blood without trial or hearing. Following Chi's murder Teng en-yi was dismissed from leadership in the Kiangsi cultural association and Ho Tsun-han et als placed under arrest. All these fascist bandits are the right hand men of Chiang.

The murder of Chi proves conclusively that the fascist bandits as an organisation are experiencing disintegration and disruption along the same lines as the German fascist bandits. In China the national armed self defence coupled with the march of the red army northward in an expedition to fight Japanese imperialism has driven a wide wedge among the fascist bandits, especially in the lower ranks who are said to refuse to carry out the instructions issued by Chiang Kai-shek for the betrayal of the country. Likewise soldiers of the Kuomintang army refused to obey the fascist commanders and deserted to the side of the red army to fight Japan. The fascists are breaking down amid the clamour of the whole country for a war of Japan.

在上海向美国报界发表的意见无疑批评了南京的行动，其原因在于许多日本银行正从事对伦敦的出口业务以牟取利润。此刻，所有中国军队均奉日本之命撤离华北，以便为以黄郛为首的北平傀儡机器的顺利运作让路（见下文），南京不敢得罪日本帝国主义。

法西斯匪徒杀害自己人

匪首蒋介石组织蓝衣社，作为其背叛国家的辅助工具。但在德国6月30日谋杀案之后，蒋介石以几乎相同的方式屠杀了自己的亲信部属。同样，有关该谋杀案的所有消息均被封锁。死者也被指控犯有贪污罪。这次谋杀，或如他们所称的大屠杀，被视为法西斯阵营瓦解的迹象。日本双月刊《上海》（Shanghai）于10月1日刊登了关于此次谋杀的报道，材料由另一份在日本汉口出版的期刊提供。故事虽不完整，但令人震惊。

M. 法西斯蓝衣社

独裁者蒋介石组织的蓝衣社是一个秘密组织，受命在出卖国家利益方面给予他一切帮助，镇压抗日运动，并通过一切可能和可想到的恐怖手段，镇压作为反帝国主义运动领导者的共产党人。去年，他们枪杀了杨铨，此人据称具有强烈的反日和反帝国主义倾向。在华北，他们暗杀了《申报》编辑裴毓元，此人在其社论中反对蒋介石和日本帝国主义。去年六月，他们逮捕了俞济川等19人，这些人均为全国武装自卫会的领导人。在江西前线，法西斯匪徒组织机枪队，强迫白军士兵与红军作战，尽管这些士兵拒绝向红军开火，并希望加入红军，共同抗击日本帝国主义。

事实上，法西斯匪徒的组织是一群叛徒的杂烩，从旧的安福系到上海买办，无所不包。所有这些叛徒，无论新旧，在背叛艺术方面都有着丰富的经验。臭名昭著的北平政务委员会委员长黄郛，也是法西斯匪徒委员会中的高层人物。法西斯匪徒内部有三个派系始终相互争斗：1) 代表土豪阶级的黄埔军校生；2) 代表买办阶级的CC系；3) 早已声名狼藉的政客，即旧安福系和政学系成员。尽管蒋介石希望通过七月的谋杀来统一法西斯匪徒的各派系，但法西斯阵营内部的斗争仍在继续。

谋杀的原因

据日本期刊披露，我们认为谋杀的原因相当琐碎。腐败和贪污是对死者季培根等人提出的唯一指控。根据日本方面的说法，季培根受托从德国和美国购买飞机，款项达2,000万美元，他却通过购买二手飞机从中榨取了大量资金。季培根是蒋介石下属航空署的署长，深受这位匪首的信任。得知贪污情况后，蒋介石未经审判或听证，便冷血地杀害了季培根。继季培根被杀后，滕毅被撤销江西省文化协会的领导职务，何尊汉等人被捕。所有这些法西斯匪徒都是蒋介石的得力助手。

季培根之死确凿地证明，法西斯匪徒作为一个组织，正经历着与德国法西斯匪徒同样的瓦解和分裂过程。在中国，全国武装自卫运动加上红军北上抗日远征军的进军，在法西斯匪徒中间楔入了一个巨大的楔子，特别是在下级官兵中，据说他们拒绝执行蒋介石出卖国家的指令。同样，国民党军队的士兵也拒绝服从法西斯指挥官的命令，投奔红军一方去抗击日本。在全国要求对日作战的呼声高涨中，法西斯分子正在崩溃。

5.
The British Manchukuo in Szechuan

With full support from Japanese imperialism in anticipation of the revival of the Anglo-Japanese alliance British imperialism is making feverish preparations for the British Manchukuo in Szechuan. Here the KMT militarist Liu Hsiang, warlord of Szechuan, takes the place of Henry Pu Yi, head of the Japanese puppet in Manchuria, leaving the Nanking KMT in the same role that it has played in relation to Manchukuo. The KMT is very pleased in agreeing to the British plan, provided enough help financial and military comes from London in order to crush the Szechuan Soviets which are now intrenched in a territory of more than 10 Hsien.

Briefly stated, the British plan of colonizing Szechuan consists of first of all in establishing its economic domination in that Chinese province through the formation of a powerful corporation on the lines of the East India Company which, it shall be recalled, played the decisive role in converting India into a British colony. That corporation has already come into existence under the label of the Lienyi Finance Corporation, Ltd. (See below)

$50,000,000 Loan

In this connection we shall call to mind that during the Fukien coup d'etat last year Nanking and England made a secret agreement giving British imperialism the right to construct a railway from Burma to Szechuan by way of Yunnan. Recently, Liu Hsiang secured a secret loan of $50,000,000 from London offering the mines in Szechuan as a security. The British grip over Szechuan is getting tighter.

The secret loan was first exposed by the Szechuan students at London. According to the news paper story the Manager of the Chishinchen Bank, a certain Yang Tsan-shan, went to London sometime in June accompanied by his son, and made a contract with the British concern named Teh-san & Co. for the development of industries and mines in Szechuan. The terms of the contract provide the formation of the Lienyi Finance Corporation Limited under Anglo-Chinese joint ownership. British money may be loaned to any enterprise or mine through the Corporation. That is to say, the said corporation is an agency by which British imperialism may exercise control over Szechuan economically and politically.

The 50 million loan directly connected with the contract above-referred to has been placed at the disposal of Liu Hsiang for the campaign against the Red Army in Szechuan and a portion of the loan, as the China Weekly Review tells us, already spent on the purchase of ammunitions to the same end. The Szechuan residents at Shanghai vigorously protested against the loan and compelled Yang Tsan-san to say on Oct 12 that the contract has been cancelled. The fascists also raised the cry of protest of course not against the loan but against Liu Hsiang considered as an enemy of Nanking.

Hand of French Imperialism

French imperialism is also active in Szechuan, apparently in a race with England for the upper hand in that province. The Sin Wen Pao on Aug. 5 said that Liu Hsiang signed a contract with the Industrial Mission of Paris for the construction of a railway from Chunking to Chentu which shall be financed with instalment payments of $3,000,000 per annum from France and brought to completion within three years.

On Aug. 8 the Ta Kung Pao confirmed the same news, saying that the contract aggregating 38 articles was duly signed with the French Industrial Mission, providing for a loan of $300,000,000 at most from France as well as the appointment of one French Chief engineer and French accountant.

One More British Victory

British imperialism smiles again at its fresh success in the Kwangtung section. It has long been cherishing the idea of facilitating its aggression from Hongkong to Hankow by way of the Canton-Hankow Railway. 5.
英国在四川的“满洲国”

在英国帝国主义期待英日同盟复兴并得到日本帝国主义全力支持的情况下，英国帝国主义正狂热地为在四川建立“英国的满洲国”做准备。在此，四川军阀、国民党军事将领刘湘取代了日本在满洲的傀儡头目溥仪的位置，而南京国民党则扮演着其在对待满洲国问题上的同样角色。只要伦敦提供足够的财政和军事援助以剿灭目前盘踞在十余县领土上的四川苏维埃，国民党非常乐意同意英国的计划。

简而言之，英国殖民四川的计划首先是通过组建一个类似东印度公司的强大公司，在该省建立经济统治。众所周知，东印度公司在将印度变为英国殖民地的过程中发挥了决定性作用。该公司已经以“联益财务有限公司”（Lienyi Finance Corporation, Ltd.）的名义成立。（见下文）

5,000万美元贷款

对此，我们要提醒的是，在去年福建事变期间，南京与英国达成了一项秘密协议，赋予英国帝国主义经由云南修建从缅甸到四川的铁路的权利。最近，刘湘从伦敦获得了一笔5,000万美元的秘密贷款，并以四川的矿山作为担保。英国对四川的控制正日益收紧。

这笔秘密贷款首先由在伦敦的四川学生揭露。据新闻报道，赤新辰银行经理杨赞山（音译）与其子于六月某时前往伦敦，并与一家名为德三公司（Teh-san & Co.，音译）的英国企业签订合同，开发四川的工业和矿业。合同条款规定成立中英合资的“联益财务有限公司”。英国资金可通过该公司贷给任何企业或矿山。也就是说，该公司是英国帝国主义在经济和政治上控制四川的代理机构。

与上述合同直接相关的5,000万贷款已交由刘湘支配，用于在四川围剿红军的战役，据《密勒氏评论报》（China Weekly Review）报道，部分贷款已用于为此目的购买弹药。在上海的四川居民强烈抗议这笔贷款，迫使杨赞山于10月12日表示合同已取消。法西斯分子当然也发出了抗议的呼声，但这并非针对贷款本身，而是针对被视为南京敌人的刘湘。

法国帝国主义的插手

法国帝国主义在四川也很活跃，显然在与英国争夺在该省的优势地位。8月5日的《新闻报》（Sin Wen Pao）称，刘湘与巴黎工业团签订了修建从重庆到成都的铁路的合同，该铁路将由法国每年分期付款300万美元资助，并在三年内完工。

8月8日，《大公报》证实了这一消息，称已与法国工业团正式签署了共计38条的合同，规定由法国提供最多3亿美元的贷款，并任命一名法国总工程师和一名法国会计师。

英国的又一次胜利

英国帝国主义再次因其在广东地区的新成功而微笑。它长期以来一直怀有这样的想法，即通过粤汉铁路便利其从香港到汉口的侵略。为此，它于1932年1月通过一笔245万英镑的贷款为该线路未完工部分提供资金，最近又敦促连接

pages.en:
6.
up of the Kowloon line to the Canton-Hankow Railway.
On July 1st Chinese and British delegates met at Hongkong ostensibly for the revision of the Kowloon line agreements for a redistribution of profit, not to touch the subject of linking up. But this subject was, in reality, discussed behind the scene. After summarizing the views of various commercial interests, the Canton Chamber of Commerce listed seven points against the linking up. It stated that the linking up would bring Canton under the economic domination of Hongkong, pave the way for more serious imperialist attack on Canton industry and lay off several ten thousand stevedores (The Bank of China Monthly, Aug 1934).
The new agreement on the through traffic over the Kowloon and Canton-Hankow lines was published on September 24th. Not content with this success British imperialism is envisaging a branch line of the Canton-Hankow railway from Sansui, Kiangtung to Kohsien, Kwangsi, for the concession of which the betraying Kwangtung government is said to receive ten million dollars. (The Sin Wen Pao, Aug. 15)

Szechuan Red Army Marches Towards Chunking and Yenshieh
The Kuomintang press is shamelessly propagating that the 5th offensive directed by bandit Chiang Kai-shek has been successful throughout the whole front. The most recent news from the battlefields, however, reveals that what the bandit press has published are entirely groundless lies. Our invincible Szechuan red army, after smashing the whole line of bandit Liu Hsiang, are now marching in the direction towards Chunking and Yenshieh. With the uneasiness of the two cities intensively growing, the exchange rate between Szechuan and Shanghai suddenly leaped up to the point of 1,500 as against the usual rate of 1,200. Even the imperialist news agencies are no longer in a position to conceal the real state of affairs. The following is a free translation of a report made known by the Japanese Rengo of the 18th inst:
"Men from Chunking a few days ago made the following report of the development of Szechuan red army: Co-ordinating their activities, the red army under the command of Hsu Hsien-chien in North Szechuan and that operating in Szechuan-Kweichow borderland (The two red armies under the command of Comrades Ho Lung and Hsiao Ko) suddenly acted on the offensive and smashed the columns of Liu Hsiang with which Chunking threatened. His soldiers on the front are so vacillating that mere news of approach of the red army will make them to take flight for life. The local tou-hao are appealing to the Nanking government for urgent remedies...."
Another reliable report says that the anti-Japanese vanguards of the red army under command of Comrade Lo Pin-hui has during the past week captured Chinen, Tunki and Huichow in Anhui and put the best troops of Tang Chun to flight who dared to hinder their advance.

North China More Dangerous.
The military conference led by bandit Chiang Kai-shek at Hankow solved two problems: The further attack upon the Szechuan red army and the establishment of the North China puppet regime. Chiang has sought to despatch Hsu Hsueh Chuen's troops from Hupeh to Szechuan. Besides he is contemplating mobilization of his own forces in Shensi, the 1st and 3rd divisions, and that of Yang Yu Chen, warlord of Shansi, to attack the Szechuan red army from the north. For the last mentioned plan he is now making a personal visit to Si-an to negotiate with Yang.
Withdrawal of troops from North is prerequisite for bandit Chiang's surrender of North China to Japanese imperialism. Hence, his order of despatch of nine divisions from the north, two from each of Hopeh, Shansi and Shangtung and three of Han Fu Ling's troops, who are all on their southward way now. The remaining troops in that area, it is learned, will still follow the course so as to reinforce the anti-reds campaign and to prepare war with Canton. From Oct. 10, Canton no longer permits Lufosia Line to land its planes at Canton deeming it necessary as a measure to prevent sudden attack of Canton by Chiang's air force. Intra-conflicts in the bandit KMT camps are still tense!
With despatch of KMT troops, N-China garrison posts are opened to the advance of Japanese and Manchukuo troops. The situation intensifies the mission of Huang Fu as traitor in managing the puppet regime in N-China, under the joint direction of Nanking and Tokio. Reliable report says that Japanese and Manchukuo troops are preparing to assume garrison post in Hopeh. Soon we shall see N-China in the hands of Japan! However, the nationwide masses are now focusing their weapons towards the traitors. Their bullets will soon shoot their way through the traitor's chests to fight away Japanese imperialism.
T H E E N D
pages.zh:
6.
九龙线至粤汉铁路的接轨。
7月1日，中英代表在香港会晤，表面上是为了修订九龙线协议以重新分配利润，而不触及接轨问题。但这一议题实际上在幕后进行了讨论。广东商会在总结各商业利益集团的观点后，列出了反对接轨的七点理由。它指出，接轨将使广州处于香港的经济支配之下，为帝国主义更严重地攻击广州工业铺平道路，并导致数万名码头工人失业（《中国银行月刊》，1934年8月）。
关于九龙线与粤汉线直通运输的新协议于9月24日公布。英国帝国主义并不满足于这一成功，正筹划修建一条从广东三水到广西梧州的粤汉铁路支线，据说背叛的广东政府为此收取了一千万美元的特许权费。（《新闻报》，8月15日）

四川红军向重庆和恩施进发
国民党报纸无耻地宣传由匪首蒋介石指挥的第五次“围剿”在整个战线上取得了成功。然而，来自战场的最新消息显示，匪帮报纸发布的完全是毫无根据的谎言。我们无敌的四川红军在粉碎了匪军刘湘的整条防线后，正向重庆和恩施方向进军。随着这两座城市的紧张局势日益加剧，四川与上海之间的汇率突然从通常的1,200飙升至1,500。即使是帝国主义通讯社也无法再掩盖事态的真实情况。以下是本月18日日本联合通讯社报道的自由译文：
“几天前，来自重庆的人士就四川红军的发展情况作了如下报告：在协调行动下，由徐向前指挥的川北红军和在川黔边境地区作战的红军（由贺龙和萧克同志指挥的两支红军）突然发起进攻，粉碎了威胁重庆的刘湘部队。其前线士兵如此动摇，以至于仅仅是红军逼近的消息就会使他们逃命。当地土豪正呼吁南京政府采取紧急措施……”
另一份可靠报告称，由罗炳辉同志指挥的红军抗日先锋队在上周攻占了安徽的旌德、屯溪和徽州，并击溃了敢于阻碍其前进的唐生智的精锐部队。

华北局势更加危险。
由匪首蒋介石在汉口主持的军事会议解决了两个问题：进一步进攻四川红军以及建立华北傀儡政权。蒋试图将徐学谦（音译）的部队从湖北调往四川。此外，他正考虑动员其在陕西的第1师和第3师，以及山西军阀阎锡山的部队，从北面进攻四川红军。为了实施后一计划，他目前正亲自前往西安与阎进行谈判。
从华北撤军是匪首蒋介石将华北出卖给日本帝国主义的先决条件。因此，他下令从北方抽调九个师，其中河北、山西和山东各两个师，以及韩复榘的三个师，这些部队目前都在向南行进。据悉，该地区的剩余部队仍将遵循这一方针，以加强“反共”战役并为与广东的战争做准备。自10月10日起，广东不再允许鲁夫西亚航空公司（Lufosia Line，原文不清，或指某特定航线/公司）的飞机在广州降落，认为这是防止蒋介石空军突然袭击广州的必要措施。国民党匪帮阵营内部的冲突依然紧张！
随着国民党军队的调动，华北驻防地向日军和伪满洲国军队的推进敞开。这种情况加剧了黄郛作为叛徒在南京和东京的共同指导下管理华北傀儡政权的使命。可靠消息称，日军和伪满洲国军队正准备接管河北的驻防地。不久我们将看到华北落入日本手中！然而，全国民众现在正将武器对准叛徒。他们的子弹很快就会射穿叛徒的胸膛，以驱逐日本帝国主义。
完 结

Vol. 4, No. 45,
Nov. 28, 1934

Contents:
1) Success of Manchurian Red Partisans
2) Bandit Chiang's Betrayal Through His Own Mouth
3) Red Army Took Yinchow
4) Skirmish Between Kwangsi and Chiang
5) N. China Puppet To Be Inaugurated Within A Month
6) $170,000,000 For Anti-red War In Szechuan
7) Red Soldiers Buried Alive
8) Taxes Still Higher
9) Opium Forced on China By KMT Bandits

Successes of Manchurian Red Partisans

During the course of last August the red partisans in eastern Kirin won many minor but significant successes in the fight for the liberation of Manchuria from the Japanese yoke. They captured Chuyiton, a strategic point not yet conquered by volunteers, there they confiscated the property of a pro-Japanese store and made new uniforms out of it for the red fighters. A portion of the red partisans broke into the 5th district of Linhsien and disarmed the police, taking out the clothes and beddings and giving them over to the masses. At a grand meeting the masses unanimously passed the resolution to join the anti-Japanese war as a body and to form anti-Japanese associations and self-defence guards. Gathering some 2,000 men, the partisans marched in the direction of Linchsien.

Surrounding the city, the red partisans sang the revolutionary song and found a welcoming echo among the troops besieged. Consequently, the troops showed no signs to resist. At the same time the peasants in the neighborhood comforted the red partisans with nice meals. In face of the enemy planes circling over the city the red partisans retreated safely to the nearby regions and sovietized them thoroughly.

Besieged at Sanpenkow, the red partisans made a heroic stand while the wavering leaders in other volunteer units took to flight. They stood like a rock facing 180 cannon shots from the enemy. Enemy officers perished under the bayonet of the red partisans by the scores. With the arrival of reinforcements the red partisans broke through though with some difficulty.

Wherever the red partisans arrived, the masses treated them with meals, washed clothes for them, carried messages for them, moved wounded soldiers to safety places, doing spying work, all this out of their own initiative. They call the partisans their own detachments. Armed peasants stood guard for the partisans voluntarily. Peasant women mended clothes and made shoes for the red fighters. 100 peasants, men and women, escorted the red partisans two li in the latter's return from the North Road to the south.

The masses followed the red partisans dozens of li, insisting on joining them. "Join the red partisans", cried they in one voice, "war on the Japs is the most glorious for us all". Many brave peasants joined with spears and Chinese-styled cannon, saying that only the red partisans really fight for the liberation of Manchuria and have the certainty to drive out the Japanese robbers.

Bandit Chiang's Betrayal Confessed

Surrender of the bandit KMT to Japanese imperialism is again confirmed by bandit Chiang himself in an interview granted to the correspondent of the Japanese Asahi Shimbun on Nov. 27 at Nanking. First of all bandit Chiang assured the Japanese correspondent that he will not attempt to recover the lost territories from the Japs even the latter should be involved in the world war of 1935-36. But he made it clear that a portion

*修正思考*：规则要求能确定的用通行中文，不确定保留原文加括号。1934年11月左右红军在安徽活动，攻占过太湖、宿松等地。Yinchow可能是Yixian（黟县）的误拼，或者是Yingshan（英山）。但既然不能脑补，我将译为“红军占领Yinchow（音译）”。
*再次检查*：有些资料将“Yinchow”对应“殷墟”或“银川”，但这不符合语境。在1930年代电报或英文报道中，有时拼写极不规范。鉴于规则4，我将在译文中保留“Yinchow（音译）”以确保准确，或者如果这是一个明显的OCR错误指向某个已知地点，我会标注。但在目录中，最好保持原样加注。

4) 桂系与蒋介石之间的冲突
5) 华北傀儡政权将在一个月内成立

9) 国民党匪帮强迫中国吸食鸦片

满洲红色游击队的胜利

在去年8月期间，吉林东部的红色游击队在为从日本枷锁下解放满洲的斗争中，取得了许多虽小但意义重大的胜利。他们攻占了义勇军尚未征服的战略要地朱家屯（Chuyiton，音译），在那里没收了一家亲日商店的财产，并用其为红色战士制作了新制服。一部分红色游击队突入林县（Linhsien，音译）第五区，解除了警察的武装，拿出衣物和被褥分发给群众。在一次盛大集会上，群众一致通过决议，集体参加抗日战争，组建抗日协会和自卫队。游击队集结了约2,000人，向林县（Linchsien，音译）方向进发。

红色游击队包围城市时高唱革命歌曲，在被围部队中引起了欢迎的回响。因此，这些部队没有表现出抵抗的迹象。同时，附近的农民用美餐慰劳红色游击队。面对在城市上空盘旋的敌机，红色游击队安全撤退到邻近地区，并彻底实施了苏维埃化。

在三盆沟（Sanpenkow，音译）被围困时，红色游击队进行了英勇的坚守，而其他义勇军部队中动摇的领导层则纷纷逃跑。他们像岩石一样面对敌人的180炮击。数十名敌军军官死于红色游击队的刺刀之下。随着援军的到来，红色游击队虽经历了一些困难，但仍成功突围。

无论红色游击队到达哪里，群众都主动为他们提供饭菜、洗衣服、传递消息、将伤员转移到安全地方、从事侦察工作。他们称游击队为自己的队伍。武装农民自愿为游击队站岗。农妇为红色战士缝补衣服和制作鞋子。100名男女农民护送红色游击队走了两里路，陪同他们从北路返回南方。

群众跟随红色游击队走了数十里，坚持要加入他们。“加入红色游击队，”他们齐声喊道，“对我们所有人来说，对日作战是最光荣的。”许多勇敢的农民带着长矛和中式火炮加入了队伍，他们说只有红色游击队才是真正为解放满洲而战，并有把握赶走日本强盗。

匪首蒋介石亲口承认的背叛

国民党匪帮向日本帝国主义投降的行为，再次由匪首蒋介石本人在11月27日于南京接受日本《朝日新闻》记者采访时得到证实。首先，匪首蒋介石向日本记者保证，即使日本卷入1935-36年的世界大战，他也不会试图从日本人手中收复失地。但他明确指出，一部分

of the Chinese people is strongly anti-Japanese-minded, probably referring
to the growing national self-defence (armed) movement, the fight of the
people's revolutionary army in Manchuria, the march of the anti-Japanese
vanguard of the red army to the north, etc. By the phrase of "Sino-Japanese
relations on the basis of faith" bandit Chiang gave the hint that he will
carry out all the secret terms imposed by Japanese imperialism but faith-
fully accepted by him in the conversations behind curtains (e. g. the for-
mation of the North China puppet, etc). Denying all the rumours to the con-
trary bandit Chiang stated bluntly that he and his party will never depart
from the Pan-Asiatism of Sun Yat-sen, thus implicitly assuring that he
will do all within his power to clear the way for handing China over to Ja-
panese imperialism. Questioned about his attitude towards the question of
frontier provinces bandit Chiang is content with the rule of Chinese ter-
ritory by Chinese, thus justifying Henry Pu Yi's puppet rule in Manchuria
and Huang Fu's puppet rule in N. China. From these assurances it is beyond
all doubt that bandit Chiang is the most obedient servant of Japanese im-
perialism.

Red Army Took Yinchow.

Our heroic red army has broken down the encircling campaign of the
Kwangsi, Kwangtung and Nanking bandits in Kiangsi and Hunan. It captured
Yinmin, Ningyuan and Toahsien where it killed 6,000 bandits under Chow Fen
yuan, taking 4,000 prisoners and 10,000 rifles altogether. One enemy plan
was shot down during the engagement. On Nov. 26 the red army occupied Yin-
chow on the Hunan-Kwangsi border, killing 2,000 bandits under Li Cha),
seizing 5,000 rifles, clearing all the remnant bandits around the city.
In west Hunan the red army under Hsiao Keh and Ho Lung advanced on Chilli
from Tayung, now threatening to capture Changteh, the one leading city in
west Hunan (about 300 li from Changsha, capital of Hunan).

Skirmish Between Kwangsi and Chiang

That the war between Kwangsi and Chiang has already begun is now con-
firmed by a wire from our own correspondent at the front. On Nov. 25 two
regiments of Chiang's bandits attempted to cross the Hwang Shan River at
4 P.M. in order to force their way into Kwangsi but were discovered and
fired on by the Kwangsi bandits with the sinking of 10 boats laden with ban-
dits and the drowning of 200 men. Three regiments from Chiang's side imme-
diately came to the scene but did nothing owing to the fall of night.

The impending war between Kwangsi and Chiang is kept as a secret for
fear lest it should be taken advantage of by the red army for the expan-
sion of the revolutionary war. The wire from our own correspondent clari-
fies all the doubts about it. The skirmish will surely develop into a ma-
jor war with 200,000 men on the side of Chiang and 40,000 men on the side
of Kwangsi. Bandit Chiang has sent 30 planes (just imported) to the war
zone in the attack on Kwangsi. On Nov. 27 Chiang's circular telegram ap-
pealing for unification and peace is regarded as a mere declaration of war
on the southwest in the traditional Chinese manner. Kwangtung and Kwangsi
bandit troops have effected conjunction and, it appears, endeavored to pre-
sent a united front against Chiang, burying their old differences for the
moment at least.

The N. China Puppet Ready in a Month

Vis-a-vis bandit Chiang Kai-shek Japanese imperialism has displayed
considerable indignation through its mouthpiece in China. In regard to the
formation of the N. China puppet pledged by Nanking the Kiangnan press,
Japanese, charged Nov. 26 bandit Chiang Kai-shek with procrastination, ac-
cusing Chiang of having turned down the proposal of Huang Fu (head of the
Peiping political council) and Yang Yintai (confidential secretary to
Chiang) for the immediate formation of the N. China puppet on the lines
suggested by the Japanese. Originally, Japan wants the puppet formed a-
head of the opening of the London naval talks but a series of objective
difficulties prevented Chiang from carrying out his promise on schedule
time
pages.zh:
2
中国人民具有强烈的反日情绪，这可能指的是日益高涨的民族自卫（武装）运动、人民革命军在满洲的战斗、红军抗日先锋队的北上等。匪酋蒋介石以“基于信义的日中关系”这一措辞暗示，他将执行日本帝国主义强加的所有秘密条款，这些条款是他在幕后谈判中忠实接受的（例如建立华北傀儡政权等）。在否认所有相反谣言时，匪酋蒋介石直截了当地表示，他和他的政党绝不会背离孙中山的泛亚主义，从而隐晦地保证他将竭尽全力为将中国移交给日本帝国主义扫清道路。当被问及他对边疆省份问题的态度时，匪酋蒋介石满足于由中国统治中国领土，从而为溥仪在满洲的傀儡统治以及黄郛在华北的傀儡统治提供了正当性理由。从这些保证来看，毫无疑问，匪酋蒋介石是日本帝国主义最顺从的仆从。

红军攻占永州。

我们英勇的红军打破了广西、广东和南京匪帮在江西和湖南的围剿战役。红军占领了宁远、道县等地，击毙周浑元部匪徒6,000人，共俘虏4,000人，缴获步枪10,000支。战斗中击落敌机一架。11月26日，红军占领湘桂边境的永州，击毙李觉（音译）部匪徒2,000人，缴获步枪5,000支，肃清了城周围的所有残匪。在湘西，萧克和贺龙率领的红军从大庸向澧州进军，目前威胁要攻占常德，这是湘西的首府城市（距湖南省会长沙约300里）。

桂系与蒋介石之间的冲突

本报前线记者发来的电报证实，桂系与蒋介石之间的战争已经开始。11月25日下午4时，蒋介石的两团匪徒试图渡过黄沙河，强行进入广西，但被桂系匪徒发现并开火射击，导致装载匪徒的10艘船只沉没，200人溺亡。蒋方的三个团随即赶到现场，但因夜幕降临而未采取行动。

桂系与蒋介石之间迫在眉睫的战争一直被保密，唯恐被红军利用来扩大革命战争。本报前线记者的电报澄清了对此的所有疑虑。这场小规模冲突必将发展成一场大规模战争，蒋介石一方投入20万人，桂系一方投入4万人。匪酋蒋介石已向战区派遣30架（刚进口的）飞机攻击桂系。11月27日，蒋介石发出的呼吁统一与和平的通电，被视为以中国传统方式向西南宣战的声明。广东和广西的匪军已实现联合，看来正努力建立反对蒋介石的统一战线，至少暂时搁置了旧有的分歧。

华北傀儡政权一月内准备就绪

面对匪酋蒋介石，日本帝国主义通过其在华喉舌表现出相当大的愤慨。关于南京承诺建立的华北傀儡政权，《江南日报》（音译）于11月26日指责匪酋蒋介石拖延，指控蒋介石拒绝了北平政务委员会委员长黄郛和蒋介石亲信秘书杨永泰（音译）提出的按照日本建议立即组建华北傀儡政权的提议。起初，日本希望在日本参加伦敦海军会议之前组建该傀儡政权，但一系列客观困难阻碍了蒋介石按时履行其承诺。

pages.en:
3
Indignant and impatient, Japanese imperialism threatens to take direct action. Two important conferences have been held, one in Peiping and the other in Shanghai, attended by Japanese military attachees and delegates of the Japanese Kwantung army, the vanguard in the invasion of China. Japan presented an ultimatum to bandit Chiang, ordering him to complete the puppet before the end of the present month, otherwise Japanese armies will force the formation of the puppet by a quasi-war, appointing Huang Fu as the head of the autonomous regime comprising Hopei, Chahar, Suiyuan, Shansi and Shantung, with Yen Hsi-shan as his assistant. To avoid international complications the autonomous regime will recognize suzerainty of Nanking but nothing else.

The Japanese ultimatum was delivered to Chiang through the Japanese consul-general at Nanking, Mr. Sugie, it is reliably learned. Panic-stricken, bandit Chiang in conference with his treacherous colleagues has decided on (1) request for one more month to complete the puppet, (2) despatch of 400 more fascist bandits to the north for murdering all the Japanese elements in the factories, mines, barracks and schools who have delayed the formation of the puppet, (3) seeking understanding with the foreign legations at Peiping over the puppet, giving the explanation that the puppet, a product of Chinese sovereignty, will prove far from endangering the interests of foreign powers, etc. But, under the conditions of the growing national armed self-defence movement and the increasing resistance of the KMT soldiers in N. China the outlook of the puppet seems still dark in spite of the optimism of bandit Chiang who again promised to complete the puppet in a month.

$170,000,000 FOR ANTI-RED WAR IN SZECHUAN

From October, 1933, to August, 1934 (only 10 months) the Szechuan bandit leaders, Liu Hsiang, Teng Hsih-hou, Tien Sung-yiao, etc; have exacted from the peasants more than $170,000,000 to finance the war on the Soviets in that province. The money was exacted from every conceivable source, taxes, levies and contributions (forced loans). Numerous additional burdens were imposed on the peasantry under the name of anti-red war. Even anti-red lottery was issued in every hsien (anti-red opium tax, etc.). Now bandit Liu Hsiang came to Nanking and seeks to issue $70,000,000 bonds to carry on the entire drive but bandit Chiang wants to take his territory yielding some $17,000,000 a month and refuses to answer his request for the moment, considering the war under way with Kwangsi. Bandit Liu is practically imprisoned at Nanking by Chiang at present. Now four divisions of bandit Chiang are moving towards Szechuan to take Liu's territory.

Frightened by this move, the other bandit leaders are considering the formation of a joint front against the enemy attack. Sir Cadogan, the British minister to China, is hurrying back from a tour of Kwangtung and Kwangsi to attend the scheduled conference with those bandit leaders. He will see to it that British domination in that province be insured and strengthened, at the same time giving help to the bandits (which is badly needed). Therefore another bandit war among the opposing fractions looms large in Szechuan.

Red Soldiers Buried Alive Again

The KMT brutality and atrocities increases as its rule is drifting more towards the collapse. On Nov. 24 the Japanese news agency, the Dempo Shinbun, despatched a letter from Hankow stating that bandit Shankwan Yin-hsiang (divisional commander) has buried wounded red soldiers together with the dead ones after an engagement with the red army. The Japanese agency is forced to characterize it as sheer atrocity.

In fact, the KMT bandits, either civil or military, have left behind a rather long history of beastial brutalities in regard to the revolutionaries. As far back as 1931 the bandit central KMT buried alive 27 left-wing writers including Li Wei-sen, Hu Yepin, etc. In 1932 the KMT bandits again perpetrated atrocities in late June, the 1st of the Hunan-Hubei Soviets evacuated by the red army in face of overwhelming superior enemy force. Housed in a brick building were 3,000 sick and wounded, most of them convalescent. Instead of showing a little mercy to them as they should under such circumstances, the KMT soldiers burned the building, leaving tears down the face of the white soldiers who stood by as spectators.
pages.zh:
3
日本帝国主义感到愤怒和不耐烦，威胁要采取直接行动。已举行两次重要会议，一次在北平，另一次在上海，与会者包括日本武官和日本关东军（侵华先锋）的代表。日本向匪酋蒋介石发出最后通牒，命令他在本月底前完成傀儡政权的组建，否则日军将通过准战争手段强制组建傀儡政权，任命黄郛为涵盖河北、察哈尔、绥远、山西和山东的自治政权首领，阎锡山为其副手。为避免国际纠纷，该自治政权将承认南京的宗主权，但不承认其他任何权力。

据可靠消息，日本最后通牒是通过日本驻南京总领事须江先生（音译）递交给蒋介石的。惊慌失措的匪酋蒋介石与其奸诈同僚开会后决定：(1) 请求再宽限一个月以完成傀儡政权的组建；(2) 增派400名法西斯匪徒北上，刺杀工厂、矿山、兵营和学校中那些拖延傀儡政权组建的日本相关人员；(3) 就傀儡政权问题寻求北平外国公使团的理解，解释说该傀儡政权是中国主权的产物，绝不会危及列强的利益等。但是，在全国武装自卫运动日益高涨和国民党士兵在华北抵抗日益增强的情况下，尽管匪酋蒋介石再次承诺在一个月内完成傀儡政权的组建并持乐观态度，傀儡政权的前景似乎依然黯淡。

一亿七千万美元用于四川的反共战争

从1933年10月到1934年8月（仅10个月），四川匪首刘湘、邓锡侯、田颂尧等人从农民身上榨取了超过1.7亿美元，以资助在该省对苏维埃的战争。这笔钱是从各种可能的来源榨取的，包括税收、摊派和捐款（强迫贷款）。以反共战争的名义，农民背负了无数额外的负担。甚至每个县都发行了反共彩票（反共鸦片税等）。现在匪首刘湘来到南京，试图发行7,000万美元债券以继续进行全面围剿，但鉴于正在进行的对桂系战争，匪酋蒋介石想要接管刘湘每月收益约1,700万美元的地盘，并暂时拒绝了他的请求。目前，刘湘实际上被蒋介石软禁在南京。现在，蒋介石的四个师正向四川移动，以夺取刘湘的地盘。

受此举惊吓，其他匪首正在考虑组成联合阵线以抵御敌人的进攻。英国驻华公使贾德干爵士（Sir Cadogan）正匆匆结束对广东和广西的巡视返回，以参加与这些匪首的预定会议。他将确保并加强英国在该省的统治地位，同时向急需援助的匪徒提供帮助。因此，四川各对立派系之间的另一场匪帮大战已迫在眉睫。

红军战士再次被活埋

随着国民党统治日益走向崩溃，其暴行和残忍行为也在增加。11月24日，日本新闻机构《电报新闻》（Dempo Shinbun）从汉口发出一封信件，称匪首商震（音译，原文Shankwan Yin-hsiang，疑为商震或类似人名之误，此处依音译保留或根据语境推测，但按规则不确定保留原文加注，然Shankwan极似Shang Zhen商震之误拼，Yin-hsiang可能是字或名混淆，鉴于历史背景商震确有其人且任师长/军长级，但此处严格遵循规则：不确定保留原文并加括号注明「(音译)」，故译为：匪首商万银祥（音译））在与红军交战后，将受伤的红军战士与死者一起活埋。这家日本机构不得不将其定性为纯粹的暴行。

事实上，无论是文职还是军事人员，国民党匪徒在对待革命者方面留下了相当长的兽性暴行历史。早在1931年，国民党中央匪帮就活埋了包括李伟森、胡也频等在内的27位左翼作家。1932年6月下旬，国民党匪徒再次制造暴行，当时红一方面军在面临压倒性优势敌军的形势下撤出了湘鄂苏区。一栋砖房里收容了3,000名病员和伤员，其中大多数是康复期病人。国民党士兵在这种情况下本应稍示怜悯，但他们却放火烧毁了这栋建筑，令在一旁围观的白军士兵泪流满面。

pages.en:
4.
ONEROUS TAXES OF NANKING EVER ON THE INCREASE

The National Finance Conference of Nanking held last May made it its central resolution the liquidation of onerous taxes, and the Nanking regime itself even proclaimed a decree to the effect that abolition of all onerous taxes be started as from July 1 and completed by the end of this year. The CWC in its previous issues has pointed out that these only constitute maneuvers of the KMT by means of which to deceive the peasants and to alleviate their furious anti-taxation struggle. Indeed, as its own press propagated, the KMT did take some measures to wipe out certain taxes that occupy only an insignificant position in its revenues. But more "rationalized" new forms of tax that here and there appeared far surpass the number of those abolished. That the new increase is on the average heavier than those taxes disappeared can be measured by the more frequent occurrence of anti-tax struggle throughout the country.

In our last issue there is an article dealing in the increase of the consolidated tax, stamp tax, tariffs imposed by the KMT. Now we shall proceed to see how similar things have been performed by the various provincial authorities.

The world must have known that this year catastrophes had done tremendous and universal harm to the agricultural crops in China. Nevertheless, in many a place land tax and rentals are collected at usual rates while in other places they are even collected at increased rates. In places where "relief measures" are reportedly enforced what is then the actual situation? For illustration let us pick up Wushih district in Kiangsu. The provincial government provides for a 20 percent reduction of land tax for this year. But as pointed out by the Wushih Magistrate in his petition to the upper authorities, (Sin Wen Poa, Nov. 15) in his district "there are 148,160 Mow of farming land that were completely ruined". It can be easily seen what does the 80 percent land tax mean to the peasants adhering to these farms after one year labour spent in vain and the money invested entirely lost!

In Shantung land tax is raised this year by 20 cents each Mow, effective in three years, to be appropriated as "Dike Construction Expenditure" which will aggregate over two million dollars! (Ta Kung Poa, Nov. 11)

Other important revenues are all marked with big increase. Since the new high rates coming in force in the winter of 1933-34 in the first six months of this year, the total increase of revenues from consolidated taxes of rolled tobacco, match and cement is $13,560,997 compared with the same period of 1933. More blood and sweat from the toiling masses! With the increase of the Tobacco and Wine Licence Tax rate enforced opposition is voiced here and there (Sin Wen Poa, Oct. 19) The Wusin outcries stroke on Oct. 17, as a protest against the increase of new Butchery Tax. Changshu butcheries resorted to petition against the same on Oct. 24 (Sin Wen Poa, Oct. 24) All these constitute vivid evidence of how the KMT is striving at increasing tax impositions.

The situation is the worst particularly in those provinces where "banditry suppression" is directed. The economic blockade in the form of state monopoly of trade is well utilized by the KMT to make the most efficient exploitation of the masses in the neighbouring zones of the Soviet districts. The imperialist paper North China Daily News reported on Nov. 17 "The procedure is so troublesome that most people prefer to pass the night without oil or else burn a pine knot in lieu of kerosene".

The Sin Wen Poa on Oct. 27 reported that among the various taxes now in force in the Chao-Mei district of Kwangtung there are such as "Hall Tax", "Theatre Tax" "Amusement Tax" "Water Closet Tax" "Charcoal Tax", "Marriage Tax", "Opium Tax" "Opium Tax" "Grain Transit Tax" "Living Stock Tax", etc.

500 DIED AS DRUG VICTIMS (by Japanese)

Of late Japanese imperialism is particularly leading in smuggling this drug into this country. A sensational report by the police of Tangshan in the "demilitarized zone" revealed that this year alone 500 died as victims of opium in that small town. According to the Nov. 11, 1934, No. of Ta Kung Poa, far back in 1915 the total amount of morphine shipped to China already reached the height of 18 tons. Since the Mukden occupation there has been influx of all sort of prepared drugs into Manchuria and North China. According to Mr. Allen's work (Yih Shih Poa June 9) 99 percent of the Japanese along the Chiao-chow-Tsinan Railway are engaged in opium traffic. Now according to its Opium Act "Manchukuo" has a farming area of 685,000 Mow for poppy plantation. The KMT follows suit seeing that opium trade is profitable. The total monthly trade of government opium sales in Shansi amounts to $11,250,000 (Yih Shih Poa June 9) Nanking's opium monopoly along the Yangtse is also in progress. The Aviation Bureau Head of Hunan, Huang Fei, even made use of military planes for big scale opium traffic which is another new record of imperialist-KMT in its history of poisoning China.
THE END.
pages.zh:
4.
南京苛捐杂税有增无减

去年五月召开的南京全国财政会议，将废除苛捐杂税作为其中心决议，南京政权甚至颁布法令，宣称自7月1日起开始废除所有苛捐杂税，并于今年年底完成。《中国论坛》（CWC）在往期文章中曾指出，这些不过是国民党欺骗农民、缓和其激烈的抗税斗争的手段。诚如其自家报刊所宣传的那样，国民党确实采取了一些措施，废除了在其财政收入中仅占微不足道地位的某些税种。但是，这里那里出现的更为“合理化”的新税种，其数量远远超过被废除的税种。新增加的税负平均而言比那些已消失的税种更重，这一点可以从全国各地抗税斗争的频繁发生中得到衡量。

在上一期中，有一篇文章讨论了国民党增加的统税、印花税和关税。现在我们将看看各省当局是如何如法炮制的。

世人皆知，今年灾害对中国农作物造成了巨大且普遍的损害。尽管如此，在许多地方，田赋和租金仍按常规税率征收，而在其他地方，甚至以更高的税率征收。在据称实施“救济措施”的地方，实际情况又是如何呢？兹以江苏无锡县为例。省政府规定今年田赋减免百分之二十。但正如无锡县长在向上级呈文中所指出的那样（《新闻报》，11月15日），该县“有148,160亩农田完全毁坏”。不难看出，对于坚守这些土地的农民来说，在一年的劳作付诸东流、投入的资金全部损失之后，缴纳这百分之八十的田赋意味着什么！

在山东，今年每亩田赋增加二角，分三年生效，指定用于“堤工经费”，总额将超过二百万元！（《大公报》，11月11日）

其他重要收入也都大幅激增。自1933-34年冬季新的高税率生效以来，今年上半年卷烟、火柴和水泥的统税收入总额与1933年同期相比增加了13,560,997美元。劳动群众更多的血汗！随着烟酒牌照税率的提高，各地反对之声此起彼伏（《新闻报》，10月19日）。吴兴于10月17日举行罢工，抗议新增屠宰税。常熟屠户于10月24日上书请愿，反对同一税项（《新闻报》，10月24日）。所有这些构成了国民党竭力增加税收负担的生动的证据。

在那些进行“剿匪”的省份，情况尤为糟糕。国民党充分利用以国家贸易垄断形式出现的经济封锁，对苏区邻近地区的民众进行最有效的剥削。帝国主义报纸《字林西报》于11月17日报道：“手续如此繁琐，以至于大多数人宁愿整夜不用油灯，或者燃烧松明代替煤油。”

《新闻报》10月27日报道，在广东潮梅地区现行的各种税捐中，有“厅税”、“戏院税”、“娱乐税”、“马桶税”、“炭税”、“结婚税”、“鸦片税”、“鸦片税”、“粮食通过税”、“牲畜税”等。

500人死于毒品受害（日本人所致）

近来，日本帝国主义在向中国走私这种毒品方面特别活跃。“非军事区”唐山警方的惊人报告揭示，仅今年一年，在这个小镇就有500人死于鸦片受害。根据1934年11月11日的《大公报》，早在1915年，运往中国的吗啡总量已达18吨之高。自沈阳沦陷以来，各种成品毒品涌入满洲和华北。根据艾伦先生（Mr. Allen）的作品（《益世报》，6月9日），胶济铁路沿线99%的日本人从事鸦片交易。现在，根据“满洲国”的《鸦片法》，其罂粟种植面积达685,000亩。国民党见鸦片贸易有利可图，也起而效尤。山西省政府每月鸦片销售总额达11,250,000美元（《益世报》，6月9日）。南京在长江沿线的鸦片专卖也在进行中。湖南航空局局长黄飞甚至利用军用飞机进行大规模鸦片走私，这又是帝国主义与国民党在毒害中国历史上的新纪录。
完。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. REGISTRY.
D 1701/6
Station:
Date: January 14, 1935.
Subject "Chinese Workers' Correspondence" contained in letters
obtained from the Chinese Post Office.
Made by and Forwarded by D. I. Ross

I forward herewith two typewritten copies of the
"Chinese Workers' Correspondence," in English, which were
contained in letters obtained by the undersigned from the
Chinese Post Office on January 14, 1935. The letters, which
were posted locally and addressed to persons in London and

SWEEPING SUCCESS OF RED ARMY IN FUKIEN

According to the press advices published by foreign papers at Shanghai
the red army has won an overwhelming victory over the Kuomintang bandits
in Fukien, occupying Shanghang, Tienchen, Pingyang, Changping in south
Fukien, Solisien, Juchi, Lingson, Tatien in central Fukien, Tingping and Ku-
tien in north Fukien. Thus the red army took some ten hsiens, crushing the
enemy as it advanced. Then reaching the environs of Shuikow, a strategic
point on the Min River 40 miles from Foochow (capital of Fukien province),
500 garrison came out to meet the advancing red army with open hands, giv-
ing it a warm reception. Then they joined the ranks of the red army uncon-
ditionally.

Messages from the same source placed the booty of the red army at more
than 10,000 rifles in a single engagement, 21 military trucks and an un-
counted large quantity of ammunitions. The Kuomintang bandit army is en-
tirely demoralized before the onslaught of the victorious red army. As a
result, the KMT eastern front (meaning Fukien) collapsed to the consterna-
tion of the imperialists who, as reported in our last issue, hurried war-
ships to Foochow menaced by the approaching red army.

The debacle of the KMT in Fukien serves as fresh impetus to more capi-
tulation of Nanking to Japanese imperialism. The KMT bandit chief, Chiang
Kai-shek, now hastily calls a conference attended by Wang Chin-wei (a left-
ist of the Kuomintang), prime minister; Huang Fu, chief of the Peiping po-
litical council; and a number of other high personages of the Kuomintang
who are well versed in the art of handing over China to Japanese imperial-
ism. In quarters close to Nanking officialdom it is said that the confer-
ence scheduled at Kuling (a summer resort for imperialists and representa-
tives of the Chinese Tuhaos and bourgeoisie) will decide to earmark more
Chinese territory and economic rights to Japanese imperialism.

The country as a whole is unusually indignant over further betrayal of
the Kuomintang and rallies to the call of the national council of the Chi-
nese people in a war against Japan. All traitors of the Chinese nation from
Chiang Kai-shek downward have but a short life to live if the armed self
defence movement forges ahead at the present speed.

红军在福建的全面胜利

根据上海外文报纸发布的新闻消息，红军在福建击败了国民党匪军，取得了压倒性胜利，占领了福建南部的上杭、汀辰（音译）、平阳、长平（音译），福建中部的索利森（音译）、巨池（音译）、灵松（音译）、大田，以及福建北部的汀平和古田。因此，红军攻克了约十个县，并在推进过程中击溃敌军。随后，红军抵达距福州（福建省会）40英里的闽江战略要地水口附近，500名驻军出来张开双臂迎接进军的红军，给予热烈欢迎。随后他们无条件加入了红军队伍。

来自同一来源的消息称，红军在一次战斗中缴获的战利品包括超过10,000支步枪、21辆军用卡车以及数量不详的大量弹药。国民党匪军在胜利红军的攻势下士气完全崩溃。结果，国民党东线（指福建）崩溃，令帝国主义者惊恐万分，正如我们上一期报道的那样，他们急忙派遣军舰前往受到逼近红军威胁的福州。

国民党在福建的溃败进一步促使南京向日本帝国主义投降。国民党匪首蒋介石现在匆忙召开了一次会议，出席者包括总理汪精卫（国民党左派）、北平政务委员会委员长黄郛，以及其他多位精通将中国出卖给日本帝国主义艺术的国民党高层人物。在南京官场内部人士中流传，计划在牯岭（帝国主义者和中国土豪及资产阶级代表的避暑胜地）召开的会议将决定划出更多中国领土和经济权益给日本帝国主义。

全国上下对国民党的进一步背叛感到异常愤怒，并响应中国人民全国委员会号召，投入抗日战争。如果武装自卫运动以目前的速度前进，从蒋介石以下的所有中华民族叛徒都时日无多了。
