3.
赤卫队的职责

赤卫队的任务包括：(1) 作为搬运工进行短途运输，(2) 夜间巡逻，询问所有过往行人的姓名、地址、目的地、旅行目的等，拒绝回答不满意者通行；如果是来自其他村庄的旅客，必须出示通行证，(3) 白天巡逻，这项任务由赤卫队、青年先锋队和童子军轮流执行，以确保没有一名国民党间谍能潜入苏区。关于检查通行证有一个有趣的故事。有一次，中央苏维埃政府最受欢迎的主席罗泽东（音译）同志在从瑞金前往新洛（音译）的途中，因未能出示所需的通行证而被值班警卫拒绝通行。

我们的下一篇文章试图回答许多有趣的问题，例如为什么群众聚集在苏维埃周围，为什么群众乐于大量加入红军，当大多数身体健全的男性加入红军或外出经商时，生产如何能持续不间断地进行。

朝鲜人与台湾人支持红军抗日先锋

以下是苏维埃中国的朝鲜人和台湾人代表发表的宣言，支持苏维埃中国政府派遣北上抗击日本强盗的红军先锋部队。——编者按

致苏维埃中国和国民党中国的人民！

卖国的蒋介石集团不满足于已经出卖了半个中国，又采取进一步步骤将整个国家交给日本帝国主义。每个中国人都面临死亡。就在此刻，苏维埃政府宣布派遣红军远征军抗击日本强盗。截至目前，红军抗日先锋已越过闽福田-车良（音译）边界，迅速前进。阻止蒋介石集团作为帝国主义清道夫的进一步投降和背叛。只有红军才能抗击日本强盗。只有苏维埃和红军才能领导全国的武装力量粉碎日本。

没有国家（我们自己的国家），我们被日本帝国主义抢走最后一分钱。可以说，我们无家可归。在中国，我们尝尽了法西斯恐怖的所有苦头。最后，我们不得不前往苏区。在苏维埃下，我们享有与中国所有劳动者一样的权利和自由。我们坚信，苏维埃和红军能够粉碎日本及所有其他帝国主义者，我们最希望的是，帮助我们朝鲜人和台湾人粉碎日本帝国主义。

如果你不想成为日本帝国主义的奴隶，你应该立即团结起来，进行神圣的民族革命战争反对日本帝国主义，更大规模地开展抗日反蒋游击战，没收日本货物，为满洲义勇军和抗日红军筹集资金和其他物资。你应该加入红军，为收复失地而战；为中国的独立和解放而战。

白军士兵们！把枪口对准叛徒，与红军并肩作战，反对日本帝国主义。要求被派往北方去拯救你们的父母。数十万红军在等待你们，四亿同胞期待你们现在起义。我们向你们保证，我们将以在朝鲜和台湾的武装起义来响应你们神圣的抗日战争。

（签名）
查川（音译）代表台湾
毕塞蒂（音译）代表朝鲜

1934年，
红色中华通讯社。

The Debacle of All KMT Bandit Forces in Szechuan
............................

According to the latest advices from Chunking and Hankow all the
KMT bandit forces in Szechuan have broken down before the fierce on-
slaught of the red army. The 1st and 2nd routes beat a hasty retreat
in fear of being flanked up by the red army. The 3rd and 4th routes
suffered a crushing blow, and, worse still, the soldiers mutinied and
joined the red army. Japanese messages state that they were smashed to
pieces. Liu Hsiang's front at Kailiang broke down although in this sec-
tor no less than 100,000 men were concentrated by Liu in an effort to
make the last stand.

All territory east of the Kaling river has been captured by the
red army. The vanguards of the red army have taken Yinshan and San'ei
Kow, marching towards Chunking, the stronghold of Liu Hsiang. Fleeing
soldiers came flocking to Wanshien (a treaty port on the Yangtse River),
throwing the city into considerable confusion.

In view of the seriousness of the situation Liu Hsiang hastily left
the Kailing front and, without stop-over at Chunking, went directly to
Chentu, capital of Szechuan province, allegedly to summon a military
conference there. Chunking was panic-stricken. On the 25th the Germans
(of the German consulate at Chunking) departed for Hankow and took re-
fuge there, accompanied by a stream of refugees down the river.

The red army is making an attempt to join up with its comrades to
the south of the Yangtse river, namely, the red army under Comrade Ho
Lun. Owing to the arrival of red units from Kiangsi by way of Hunan and
Kweichow, the red army under Comrade Ho has increased its strength con-
siderably.

The brilliant campaigns of the red army in Fukien, Kiangsi, Hunan,
Kweichow and Szechuan scared all factions of the Kuomintang bandits,
leading to the despatch of S.O.S. from the bandit generalissimo, Chiang
Kai-shek, to his lieutenants and the possible formation of an allied
force of Kwangtung, Kwangsi, Kweichow, Yunnan and Szechuan against the
red army.

Relying on the support of the toiling masses and the correctness of
its tactics, the red army is quite sure of achieving more
victories, possibly much greater than the ones already won. Before fly-
ing at the throat of Japanese imperialism in North China, the red army
must, at all costs, clear the KMT bandits who want to start trouble in
its rear, while fighting the Japanese robbers at the front. But the red
army will march rapidly towards the North despite the KMT obstacles,
realizing that the people of the whole country expect the red fighters
to drive out Japanese robbers as quickly as possible.

The Anti-Japanese Vanguard of Red Army Advanced Far Into
Chekiang
............................

Since the general mobilization of the Soviet Government on August 1
the national revolutionary war has assumed gigantic proportions and pro-
vided further stimulus to the Manchurian volunteers who launch more at-
tacks on Japanese bandits. While fighting its way to the North, the anti-
Japanese vanguard of the red army has won many significant victories
with the generous aid from the masses. The red army once more proves that
it is the only real force capable of fighting the Japanese bandits, that it
is the only anti-Japanese force enjoying the full confidence of the peo-
ple.

Red Army INC Chekiang

As reported in our columns before, the red army, now called the van-
guard in a northern expedition against Japan, has passed beyond Foo-
chow, liberating several Haiens in east Fukien from the misrule of the

四川所有国民党匪军的溃败
............................

据重庆和汉口的最新消息，四川所有的国民党匪军已在红军的猛烈进攻下崩溃。第一路和第二路因害怕被红军包抄而仓皇撤退。第三路和第四路遭受重创，更糟糕的是，士兵发生兵变并加入了红军。日本方面的消息称，他们已被打得粉碎。刘湘在开梁前线的防线虽然在该地区集中了不下10万人以作最后抵抗，但也已崩溃。

嘉陵江以东的所有领土已被红军占领。红军先头部队已占领银山和三汇口（San'ei Kow，音译），正向刘湘的大本营重庆进发。逃兵蜂拥至万县（长江上的通商口岸），使该城陷入相当大的混乱。

鉴于局势严重，刘湘匆忙离开开梁前线，未在重庆停留，直接前往四川省会成都，据称是为了在那里召开军事会议。重庆陷入恐慌。25日，德国人（重庆德国领事馆人员）沿河而下，在一群难民的伴随下前往汉口避难。

红军正试图与长江以南的同志，即贺龙同志率领的红军会合。由于红军部队经湖南和贵州从江西抵达，贺龙同志麾下的红军实力大增。

红军在福建、江西、湖南、贵州和四川的光辉战役吓坏了国民党匪帮的各派系，导致匪首蒋介石向其部下发出了求救信号，并可能组建由广东、广西、贵州、云南和四川组成的联军以对抗红军。

依靠劳苦大众的支持和战术的正确性，红军完全有信心取得更多的胜利，其规模可能远超已取得的胜利。在向华北的日本帝国主义扼喉之前，红军必须不惜一切代价清除那些想在后方制造麻烦的国民党匪徒，同时在前方抗击日本强盗。尽管面临国民党的阻碍，红军意识到全国人民期望红色战士尽快驱逐日本强盗，因此将迅速向北进军。

红军抗日先锋挺进浙江腹地
............................

自苏维埃政府于8月1日总动员以来，民族革命战争规模巨大，并进一步刺激了东北义勇军对日本匪徒发动更多攻击。在向北方进军的过程中，红军抗日先锋在群众的慷慨援助下赢得了许多重大胜利。红军再次证明，它是唯一能够抗击日本匪徒的真正力量，是唯一享有人民充分信任的抗日力量。

红军进入浙江

正如本报此前报道，这支现在被称为北上抗日先锋队的红军已越过福州，从国民党暴政下解放了闽东的几个县，建立了苏维埃政权，号召群众起来反对日本帝国主义。8月26日，先锋队占领了浙南的庆元，12天后攻克了35英里外的龙泉，经由玉山和江山，先锋队到达了位于浙江中部的遂安。

5
Kuomintang, setting up the Soviets, calling on the masses to rise against
Japanese imperialism. On Aug. 26 the vanguard occupied Chinyuan in south
Chekiang, and 12 days later captured Lunchuan thirty-five miles away,
taking the route through Yushan and Kiangshan the vanguard reached as far
as Sui-an situated in the centre of Chekiang.

Under the protection of the masses the red army has moved not only
swiftly but in a mysterious manner. It frequently makes its appearance
in the rear of the KMT bandits, surprising them with an assault. It has
won many victories in this way. On Aug. 26 it disarmed two battalions of
the Chekiang troops under Yu Chi-sei at Chin-yuan, defeating one KMT regi-
ment at Chukow Aug. 30, capturing 200 rifles. On Aug. 31 it smashed anoth-
er regiment, capturing 500 rifles, killing two captains. It cut off the
communications of the Hangchow-Kiangshan Railway between Chichow and
Kiangshan.

South Chekiang has been thrown into considerable commotion. The Tuhao
around Chichow, withdrawing their confidence in the strength of the KMT
bandits, have fled to Shanghai in increasing numbers, thus placing themselves
under the protection of imperialism. Re-enforcements have been sent from
Anhei over thousands of miles to Chekiang.

The red army in the Kiangsi-Anhwei frontier also moved in a northern
direction to fight the Japanese. At the end of last month it captured
Chinen, routing the 55th division of the KMT bandits under Liu Iao-en.
In this sector the red army opened a new Soviet territory of 300 li by
length and 50 li by width, almost four times as large as the original
one.

Airplanes Burnt Up

The decisive war will, however, be fought in Kiangsi. Here is concen-
trated the forces of the enemy reported to be above 400,000 men. Yet over
the KMT bandits the red army has won several major battles along this
front. On Aug. 5 the red army repulsed the attack of 5 divisions of the
bandits with the aid of guns and planes, killing 2,000 bandits. A week
later the enemy attacked again, leaving 600 killed on the battleground.
50 fascist officers charged but all perished under the ruthless fire of
the red army. At about the same time another division of the bandits was
smashed at Junlang, Kiangsi.

On Sept. 3 a bandit airplane was brought down in Ta Fu Tow, Nan-
Hsien; and four days later another bandit machine shot down at Jialing.
Of greater significance is the burning of 50 planes at Nanchang. In bourge-
ois circles the cause of the fire is said to be unknown but news has leak-
ed out to the effect that the white soldiers in response to the call of
the anti-Japanese vanguard of the red army burnt the machines as a pro-
test against the KMT attack on Soviet China, against the KMT surrender.
At the same time two plane workshops were burnt to the ground with the
same motives back of it. A couple weeks ago the ammunition depot at Nan-
king was partially destroyed by fire certainly for the same reasons.
Thus the white soldiers are also digging graves for the Kuomintang.

Red Army In Kweichow

The activities of the red army in Kweichow have also been crowned with
success as elsewhere. The red army under Comrade Ho Lun entered Kweichow
and occupied Yuan-ling, setting up the Soviet government there. Up to
the end of last month seven hsiens fell into their hands of the red army.
One battalion of the second division of the Kweichow army under the com-
mand of Hsia Wei-chun mutinied and joined hands with the red army, need-
less to mention the support of the wide mass of people long downtrodden
under the foot of Kweichow militarists.

The red army under Comrade Hsiao Keh reached Liping in south Kwei-
chow in an attempt, it seems, to effect conjunction with the red army
under Comrade Ho Lun. While en route towards Kweichow, it smashed two
two divisions of the Hunan bandits under Ho Chien, capturing some ten
hsiens in south Hunan. It also marched into Kwangsi, inflicting heavy
losses on the bandits under Pai Tsun-shi. As a consequence, the partisan
warfare in these regions has developed on a grand scale. Thus, a mighty
force has risen in the Southwest of China to strengthen the anti-imper-
ialist revolutionary war.
E N D

5
在群众的掩护下，红军不仅行动迅速，而且行踪神秘。它经常出现在国民党匪军的后方，出其不意地发起袭击。通过这种方式，它赢得了许多胜利。8月26日，它在庆元解除了俞济时麾下两个浙江营的武装，8月30日在诸暨击败了一个国民党团，缴获步枪200支。8月31日，它又击溃了一个团，缴获步枪500支，击毙两名连长。它切断了衢州和江山之间的杭江铁路交通。

浙南陷入相当大的骚动。衢州周围的土豪劣绅因对国民党匪军实力失去信心，纷纷逃往上海，从而将自己置于帝国主义的保护之下。增援部队已从安徽千里迢迢调往浙江。

赣皖边界的红军也向北移动以抗击日本。上月末，它攻占了赤金（Chinen，音译），击溃了国民党匪军廖恩（Liu Iao-en，音译）指挥的第55师。在该地区，红军开辟了一个长300里、宽50里的新苏区，面积几乎是原来的四倍。

飞机被焚毁

然而，决定性的战争将在江西进行。这里集中了敌方兵力，据报道超过40万人。然而，红军在这一战线上多次战胜国民党匪军。8月5日，红军在火炮和飞机的援助下击退了匪军5个师的进攻，击毙匪军2000人。一周后，敌人再次进攻，在战场上留下600具尸体。50名法西斯军官冲锋，但全部在红军的无情火力下丧生。大约在同一时间，另一股匪军在江西军浪（Junlang，音译）被击溃。

9月3日，一架匪机在南县大福头（Ta Fu Tow, Nan-Hsien，音译）被击落；四天后，另一架匪机在嘉陵（Jialing，音译）被击落。更具意义的是南昌50架飞机被焚毁的事件。在资产阶级圈子里，火灾原因据称不明，但有消息泄露称，白军士兵响应红军抗日先锋队的号召，焚烧飞机以抗议国民党对苏维埃中国的进攻及国民党的投降行为。同时，两个飞机修理厂也被烧毁，动机相同。几周前，南京的弹药库部分被火灾摧毁，肯定也是出于同样的原因。因此，白军士兵也在为国民党挖掘坟墓。

红军在贵州

红军在贵州的活动也像在其他地方一样取得了成功。贺龙同志率领的红军进入贵州并占领了沅陵（Yuan-ling，注：此处原文为Yuan-ling，通常指湖南沅陵，但上下文为贵州，可能指贵州某地或原文有误，依原文音译或保留），并在那里建立了苏维埃政府。截至上月末，红军已攻占七个县。贵州军队第二师夏维春（Hsia Wei-chun，音译）指挥的一个营发生兵变，与红军联手，更不用说长期受贵州军阀践踏的广大民众的支持了。

萧克（Hsiao Keh，音译）同志率领的红军到达贵州南部的黎平，似乎试图与贺龙同志率领的红军会合。在前往贵州的途中，它击溃了何键（Ho Chien，音译）麾下的两个湖南匪军师，在湖南南部攻占了约十个县。它还进军广西，给白崇禧（Pai Tsun-shi，音译）麾下的匪军造成重大损失。因此，这些地区的游击战已大规模发展。这样，中国西南部崛起了一支强大的力量，加强了反帝革命战争。
完

Reconstruction of the Soviets
A Thesis Passed by
The Second Soviet Congress
............................

After hearing the report made by Comrade Ma Iang-ping, the congress wishes to go on record that considerable progress has been achieved in the organisation and work of the Soviets since the 1st congress, that considerably more militant workers and peasants have been drawn into the work of the Soviets, that tremendous achievement has been recorded in the work of arming the workers and peasants, that the work of the basic Soviets such as the town and village Soviets has been more penetrating,. Furthermore in the course of the land inspection campaign many new cadres have come out to the surface and been promoted to leadership in the Soviets while the electorate has shown more interest in the Soviet elections as evidenced by the fact that on the average from 75% to 95% of the legal electors went to the polls. In many of the Soviets the struggle against bureaucracy has been begun, attended by appreciable betterment in the methods of the work of the Soviets. These facts enable the workers and peasants to recognize more clearly the Soviets as their own government, and also make it possible for the Soviet government to mobilize the broadest masses for the front against imperialism and Kuomintang.

On the debit side of the Soviets there have been noticed a number of defects, notably the uneven character of the progress recorded in the work of the various Soviets. In a series of the village Soviets located in Kiangsi, Fukien and Kiangsi-Hunan the work of the Soviets has made the greatest strides while the village Soviets in other isolated districts lag far behind. In the second place, the masses have taken a part in the work of the Soviets only in an insufficient degree, especially women who still hold aloof for the most part. Thirdly, the masses have recalled the delegates only in rare instances. The system of the union Soviets has not been built up on a sound basis. Likewise the division of functions has not been well defined and individual responsibility not yet fully enforced. Bureaucracy in one form or another still remains in the Soviets, preventing a full understanding of the conditions prevailing among the lower strata of the masses. The ideological struggle, already begun in the Soviets, has not been carried on with sufficient energy. Revolutionary leadership in the Soviets is still inadequate. The congress recommends to overcome these shortcomings by a resolute struggle and to make big strides thereafter.

Central Task of the Soviets

To solve its central task of leading and organizing the revolution at the present moment (yes at the most urgent moment) the Soviets must immediately take the following steps:

苏维埃的重建
由
第二次苏维埃代表大会通过的决议
............................

在听取了马良平同志所作的报告后，大会希望记录在案：自第一次代表大会以来，苏维埃的组织和工作取得了相当大的进展；更多具有战斗精神的工人和农民被吸收到苏维埃工作中来；在武装工人和农民方面取得了巨大成就；乡镇苏维埃等基层苏维埃的工作更加深入。此外，在土地检查运动中，许多新干部脱颖而出并被提拔到苏维埃的领导岗位，而选民对苏维埃选举表现出更大的兴趣，这从合法选民中平均有75%至95%参加投票的事实中得到证明。在许多苏维埃中，反对官僚主义的斗争已经开始，苏维埃的工作方法有了明显的改善。这些事实使工人和农民更清楚地认识到苏维埃是他们自己的政府，也使苏维埃政府能够动员最广大的群众投身于反对帝国主义和国民党的前线。

就苏维埃的不足之处而言，人们注意到一些缺陷，特别是各苏维埃工作进展的不平衡性。在位于江西、福建和湘赣地区的一系列村苏维埃中，苏维埃的工作取得了最大的进步，而其他孤立地区的村苏维埃则远远落后。其次，群众参与苏维埃工作的程度仍然不足，尤其是妇女，她们在大多数情况下仍持疏远态度。第三，群众仅在极少数情况下召回代表。联合苏维埃的制度尚未建立在坚实的基础上。同样，职能划分也不明确，个人责任尚未完全落实。各种形式的官僚主义在苏维埃中依然存在，阻碍了对下层群众普遍状况的充分了解。苏维埃中已经开始的思想斗争，开展得不够有力。苏维埃中的革命领导力量仍然不足。大会建议通过坚决的斗争来克服这些缺点，并在此后取得重大进展。

苏维埃的中心任务

为了完成当前（是的，在最紧迫的时刻）领导和组织革命的中心任务，苏维埃必须立即采取以下步骤：
1) 加强中央苏维埃政府的组织和工作。第一次代表大会后中央苏维埃政府的成立，是革命发展的一个重要促进因素。苏维埃必须在实践中... [文本 obscured] ...广大工人和农民群众。有必要建立... [文本 obscured] ...革命的至高领导者... [文本 obscured] ...中央... [文本 obscured] ...委员会与... [文本 obscured] ...各部等之间的职能划分。各种... [文本 obscured] ...和农民，中央政府必须与下级苏维埃保持密切联系，

Hsien Soviets. During the course of war the provincial Soviets shall get fully
acquainted with the practical work of the hsien Soviets, particularly with

weaker districts and to effect conjunction with the Soviets in Honan-Hupeh-An-

'living' directives to the provincial Soviets and examine their work like-
wise.
3) To strengthen the work of the rural and urban Soviets as a means to
increase the strength of the Soviet power in mobilization. Rural and urban
Soviets are basic in the sense that they convey the laws, ordinances and de-
crees of the centre to the broad masses with full power to mobilize the masses
for enforcement. Rural and urban Soviets must draw in the greatest number
possible of militant workers and peasants. The congress recommends formation
of stable relationships between delegates to rural and urban Soviets and
their constituents on the basis of geographical proximity of the two. To aid
rural and urban Soviets the delegates in each unit must have a chief with
full power to call meetings, each delegate hold responsible for the work in
his unit. In accordance with actual needs and local conditions there must be
established various commissions both provisional and permanent under rural
and urban Soviets, with the participation of delegates and wide masses. Rural
and urban Soviets must draw into the work of the Soviets broad masses of work-
ers and peasants who are not segregated from production, especially non-en-
tollers.

The Revolutionary Committee

4) Formation of the revolutionary committees. In certain Soviet or non-
Soviet districts there must be set up revolutionary committees to arm work-
ers and peasants, to develop partisan warfare, to popularize the laws and
ordinances of the Soviets, to organize poor peasant groups, to carry out land
revolution, to confiscate property of the landlord and counterrevolutionary
elements as a means to reduce the material basis of the counterrevolutionar-
ies, to fight against all actions contrary to the laws and policy of the
Soviets, etc. Revolutionary committees in new Soviet districts must draw in
the workers and peasants in a great hurry, helping in the consolidation and
extension of the Soviets.
5) Extension of democracy. In the last two years democracy under the So-
viets has progressed far but not far enough. With this end in view the Soviets
must mobilize more electors for elections, get their opinions on the work of
the Soviets, give masses the possibility to recall any inefficient delegates
at any time, afford the greatest possible facilities to the masses for the
practice of democracy such as meeting place, printing press, etc., lead the
masses in the extension of liberties for speech, assembly, publication, etc,
of will acquainted with the opinions of the masses, draw into the work of
the Soviets militant elements not divorced from production. Make local So-
viets a school for the wide masses. Here is the widest democracy for the
citizens but the counterrevolutionary activities of the bourgeois-landlord
and kulaks shall be ruthlessly put down. The punishment of activities in vio-
lation of the Soviet laws and policy must be explained to the masses in great
detail and obtain the support of the masses. Because the power of the Soviets
to punish rests on the support of the masses. Local and central Soviets
shall strictly enforce the law that has abolished corporal punishment.

Against Bureaucracy

6) Under the whole system of the Soviets a sharp struggle shall be brought
into play against bureaucracy which, ignoring the actual conditions of the
masses, does not take the trouble of solving difficulties for the masses nor
utilizes the masses for the work of the Soviets but relies on empty talks
and sheets, sometimes resorting to compulsion. The congress demands to drive
all bureaucratic and undesirable elements out of the Soviets with the
utmost decisiveness and strong measures.
7) Close relationship with all mass organizations, especially the trade
unions and poor peasant unions. Through the trade unions the Soviets must
draw into their work tens of thousands and a large number of new worker-
peasant masses. They must also through the mass organizations, especially
through the trade unions and poor peasant unions, draw into the work of the

pioneer organizations. The Soviets must establish close contact with the

作为中央与县苏维埃之间纽带的省苏维埃的职责。在战争期间，省苏维埃应充分了解县苏维埃的实际工作，特别是在战争动员的程度方面。省苏维埃应确保各县充分执行上级苏维埃的法令和条例。大会建议巩固薄弱地区的苏维埃，并实现与河南-湖北-安徽、湖南-江西和四川地区苏维埃的联合。中央政府必须定期向省苏维埃发布“活的”指示，并同样审查其工作。

3) 加强城乡苏维埃的工作，以此作为增强苏维埃政权动员力量的手段。城乡苏维埃是基础，因为它们有权将中心的法律、条例和法令传达给广大群众，并动员群众予以执行。城乡苏维埃必须尽可能吸收最多的战斗性工人和农民。大会建议在城乡苏维埃代表与其选民之间，基于地理上的邻近性建立稳定的关系。为了协助城乡苏维埃，每个单位的代表必须有一位拥有召集会议全权的主管，每位代表对其单位的工作负责。根据实际需求和当地情况，必须在城乡苏维埃之下，在代表和广大群众的参与下，设立各种临时和常设委员会。城乡苏维埃必须将不脱离生产的广大工农群众，特别是非党人士，吸收到苏维埃的工作中来。

革命委员会

4) 组建革命委员会。在某些苏维埃或非苏维埃地区，必须设立革命委员会，以武装工农，开展游击战，宣传苏维埃的法律和条例，组织贫农团，实行土地革命，没收地主和反革命分子的财产，以此削弱反革命的物质基础，打击一切违反苏维埃法律和政策的行为等。新苏维埃地区的革命委员会必须紧急吸收工农，帮助巩固和扩大苏维埃。

5) 扩展民主。在过去两年中，苏维埃下的民主取得了长足进步，但还不够。为此，苏维埃必须动员更多选民参加选举，征求他们对苏维埃工作的意见，赋予群众随时罢免任何不称职代表的权利，为群众实践民主提供尽可能多的便利，如会议场所、印刷厂等，领导群众扩展言论、集会、出版等自由，熟悉群众的意见，将不脱离生产的战斗分子吸收到苏维埃工作中来。使地方苏维埃成为广大群众的学校。这里是对公民最广泛的民主，但资产阶级-地主和富农的反革命活动应被无情镇压。必须向群众详细解释对违反苏维埃法律和政策的活动的惩罚，并获得群众的支持。因为苏维埃的惩罚权力依赖于群众的支持。地方和中央苏维埃应严格执行废除体罚的法律。

反对官僚主义

6) 在整个苏维埃体系下，应展开一场反对官僚主义的尖锐斗争，这种官僚主义无视群众的实际情况，不费力为群众解决困难，也不利用群众进行苏维埃工作，而是依赖空谈和文书，有时诉诸强制手段。大会要求以最坚决的态度和强有力的措施，将所有官僚主义和不受欢迎分子驱逐出苏维埃。

200,000 CHINESE TOILERS MOBILIZED BY JAPAN
Against the Soviet Union and China
....................

In the four months past Japanese imperialism has enlisted some 200,000
Chinese workers in Hopei, Honan, Shantung, etc, and sent them to Manchuria
by boats from Tientsin or Tsingtao via Dairen. The toilers so enlisted are
invariably ruined peasants finding no work under the Kuomintang regime.
They can not resist the inducements of Japanese agents, knowing nothing of
the nature of the work to be performed by them. A large fraction of the
toilers recruited went to Jehol and other points in Inner Mongolia.

Defence Works Built

These poor peasants were sent all over to Manchuria under Japanese escort,
engaged in the construction of defence works against the Soviet Union. They
worked and still work on a network of military roads, highways, aerodromes,
etc. Over 20,000 workers, for example, are busy with the construction of a
mighty airdrome at Pei An Tson to the north of Buhai hsien, Holungkiang,
to be used by Japanese troops in an offensive war on the USSR. Other work-
ers are put on jobs in the iron and steel works, in the arsenals, etc.
Those working in Jehol along similar lines are forced by the bayonets of
Japanese soldiers to build up highways, motor roads or airdromes for further
Japanese aggressions in north China. Some of the workers made an attempt at
escape as soon as becoming conscious of the sinister motive of Japanese a-
gents but were shot down together with those who are suspicious.
Japanese agents allured Chinese peasants with enticing promises such as
one dollar per day for each worker when enlistment started. The ruined pea-
sants made a rush for Japanese enlistment offices. But it is too late for
them to repent when transported to Manchuria like cattle. Under the Japan-
ese bayonet they work day and night, faring much worse than the negroes
who work on American plantations. They receive no wages, even not enough
food for meals. A multitude of the workers no longer able to bear the hard-
ships made good their escape back to China, telling revolting stories. The
following is a story from the mouth of a Chinese worker just back from Man-
churia:

Harrowing Experiences

"I went out to Manchuria along with over 10,000 in all. Under the auspic-
es of the Peiping Ta Chang Company (foreign firm) I was sent to Gupeikow,
bordering on the Great Wall, thence to Chen Teh, capital of Jehol, well
treated all the way in my journey, receiving several dimes a day in addi-
tion to free meals. But beyond the Great Wall the conditions changed entire-
ly. Our batch was the last including some 530 in our numbers. Good treatment
was gone. Then ugly-looking Japanese troopers came to meet us and brought
us along in utter disregard of our wishes.
"Just at that time wages failed to come. Worse still, we were given only
some thin diluted gruel for the whole day. We are youths in the prime of
life. With only one small meal a day, we are almost starved to death. Herded
in a concentration camp; we had neither food to eat nor the freedom to move
about, confined in such a plight for more than twenty days. Then suddenly
appeared the Japanese troops in one morning, dividing us into two detach-
ments, one composed of youths and the other of old people. The youths were
impressed into the marionette Manchurian army and sent to places only God knows.

"The old folks were escorted to eastern Chahar for the repair of highways
washed out by floods. From morning to night we worked like slaves without
being permitted to utter a single syllable of complaint. Besides hunger and
starvation we had to fear the whips of Japanese soldiers who beat us as if
making a fun".

The Chinese press is full of reports telling stories of Chinese workers
in Manchuria being killed by the Japanese for no other reason than the fact
that the workers demanded payment of their wages. In Mukden, capital of
the puppet state, the Japs organized a labour union with branches distributed
all over Manchuria to make enquiries into Chinese workers. It did the same
succeeded in recruiting 25,000 workers as navvies for highway work. Aside
from collecting fees from the workers, it got a 5% source of profits from
the Japanese officials (all union officials are Japanese), the union did no-
thing but prevent the workers from striking, that is, to crush any attempt on the
part of the workers to ask for payment of wages. In a word, Any worker who
dares to raise his voice is arrested under communist charges, and
sentenced to death or life imprisonment.
This is exactly a chapter from the China Times of Shanghai.

3
日本动员二十万中国劳工
针对苏联与中国
....................

在过去四个月中，日本帝国主义在河北、河南、山东等地征募了约二十万名中国工人，并通过天津或青岛经大连用船将他们送往满洲。这些被征募的劳工 invariably 是在国民党统治下找不到工作的破产农民。他们无法抗拒日本代理人的诱惑，对自己将要从事的工作性质一无所知。 recruited 的劳工中有很大一部分去了热河及内蒙古其他地区。

修筑防御工事

这些贫苦农民在日本人的押送下被派往满洲各地，从事针对苏联的防御工事建设。他们在军事道路网、公路、机场等工程中劳作，且至今仍在劳作。例如，有两万多名工人正忙于在黑龙江省布海县以北的北安镇（Pei An Tson）修建一座大型机场，供日军在对苏进攻战中使用。其他工人则被安排在钢铁厂、兵工厂等处工作。那些在热河从事类似工作的工人，在日本士兵的刺刀逼迫下，为日本进一步侵略华北而修建公路、汽车道或机场。一些工人在意识到日本代理人的险恶用心后试图逃跑，但随即与那些被怀疑的人一起遭到枪杀。
日本代理人在开始征募时，以诸如每人每天一美元等诱人的承诺来引诱中国农民。破产农民蜂拥至日本的征募办事处。但当他们像牲畜一样被运往满洲时，后悔已为时晚矣。在日本人的刺刀下，他们日夜劳作，境遇比在美国种植园工作的黑人还要糟糕得多。他们领不到工资，甚至得不到足够的果腹之粮。众多不堪忍受苦难的工人成功逃回中国，讲述了令人愤慨的经历。以下是一位刚从满洲回来的中国工人的口述：

悲惨经历

“我与其他总共一万多人一起前往满洲。在北平大昌公司（外资企业）的安排下，我被送到长城边界的古北口，随后前往热河省会承德，一路上待遇尚可，除免费供餐外，每天还能得到几角钱。但出了长城，情况就完全变了。我们这一批是最后一批，人数约为530人。优待不复存在。接着，面目可憎的日本兵来迎接我们，完全不顾我们的意愿，强行将我们带走。
“就在那时，工资停发了。更糟的是，我们整天只能喝到一些稀薄的粥。我们正值壮年。每天只有一顿少量的饭食，我们几乎饿死。被圈禁在集中营里；我们既无食物可吃，也无行动自由，在这种困境中被关押了二十多天。然后，某天早晨日本军队突然出现，将我们分为两队，一队由年轻人组成，另一队由老年人组成。年轻人被强征入伪满洲国军队，送往天知道的地方。

“老年人被押送至察哈尔东部，去修复被洪水冲毁的公路。我们从早到晚像奴隶一样干活，不被允许发出一句抱怨之声。除了饥饿和 starvation，我们还要害怕日本士兵的鞭打，他们打我们就像取乐一样。”

中国报纸上充斥着关于在满洲的中国工人仅因要求支付工资就被日本人杀害的报道。在伪都沈阳，日本人组织了一个工会，其分支机构遍布满洲，以调查中国工人。该工会成功招募了两万五千名工人作为修筑公路的壮工。除了向工人收取费用外，它还从日本官员那里获得5%的利润来源（所有工会官员均为日本人），该工会除了阻止工人罢工外无所作为，也就是说，镇压工人要求支付工资的任何企图。总之，任何敢于发声的工人都会以共产主义罪名被捕，并被判处死刑或无期徒刑。
这正是上海《字林西报》（China Times）中的一章内容。

pages.en:
CONSULTATION OF DE FACTO RECOGNITION TO MANCHUKUO
As Demanded by Japanese Imperialism
....................................

July 1, 1934, marked a decisive step in the consummation of the de facto
recognition of the Manchurian puppet state by Nanking precisely in accordance
with the wishes of Japanese imperialism. Not content with this move of surrender
a large number of the KMT politicians in the north demand to recognize Manchu-
kuo de jure. The consummation of the de facto recognition finds expression in
the resumption of rail service between Mukden and Peiping on July 1. In the
morning trains in both Peiping and Mukden departed for the opposite direction,
placing China (the motherland) and Manchuria on the same equal footing as two
independent states with normal intercourse.
In connection with the de facto recognition Nanking has made another two
manoeuvres of equal significance, i. e., the formation of customs branches
along the great wall accepting it impliedly as the legitimate boundary line
between Manchuria and China Proper, and the lifting up of the postal ban on
mails to or from Manchuria. Taken together the three facts accomplished in the
space of several weeks have entirely disclosed Nanking's determination to a-
bandon Manchuria and to fortify Japan's position in China.

Resumption of Railway Service

The ban on mails from and to Manchuria came to an end months ago when let-
ters addressed to Peiping, Manchukuo, or Peiping, Jehol province, reached Nanking
from Manchuria and came to the hands of the addressee through Chinese postmen.
At the same time the Nanking ministry of communications legalized the irregu-
larities by issuing directives to the effect that all mails from Manchuria
must be delivered to the recipients, tearing, however, off the Manchurian
stamps before delivery.
Then came the establishment of customs branches along the great wall on
July 20. Some 20 branch offices of the Chinese customs began to function on
that very date. Only a few Chinese papers dared to publish the news in their
columns. Now the Nanking ministry of finance only recognized the act as a fait
accompli without adding the usual phrase that 'it has nothing to do with the
de facto recognition of Manchukuo'. Nanking accomplished the act in a hurried
manner due to the high pressure of Japanese imperialism who organised the dis-
appearance of Kuramoto, vice consul of the Japanese consulate at Nanking, and
wanted to use it as an excuse for seizing the KMT capital.
As expected by the Japanese and promised by Nanking, the resumption of train
service between Peiping and Mukden became a reality on July 1. The train from
Peiping started out on schedule time on the morning of the day but met with an
accident involving the death of four passengers and the wounding of dozens at
a point not far from Tientsin. All of a sudden an explosion of bombs took place
in the wagon of the 3rd class, the bombs supposed well laid in the baggage of
a passenger and exploded by rocking in hot weather. No doubt the bomb came from
a man dissatisfied with the KMT regime of ceaseless surrender to Japanese impe-
rialism. The Japs seized the explosion as a pretext for more Japanese soldiers
to be put on the train while Yin Tung, head of the Peiping-Mukden line, a pro-
Japanese traitor (who earned millions in pro-Japanese negotiations), tendered
resignation as an apology to his Japanese masters.

Japanese Guards on Train

Each train from Peiping is accompanied by 9 Japanese gendarmerie and 7 Chi-
nese soldiers, thus implying that the Japs have a right to control Chinese train
even on Chinese territory directly under the jurisdiction of Nanking, not to
mention Manchuria which is still Chinese but abandoned definitely by the KMT.
But Chinese soldiers on the train can not go to Manchuria but must get down
at Shanhaikwan (border line) and take another train back to Peiping. Thus the
Great Wall is again recognised as the boundary line between China and the Ja-
panese puppet.
On July 1 Japanese officials and civilians in Manchuria and Japan celebrat-
ed the occasion, congratulating Nanking on its manifestation of willingness to
submit to Japanese imperialism, but the KMT, on the other hand, remained si-
lent on the Japanese praise, accepting the Japanese proclamation of protec-
torate entirely and without reservation. Nanking's spokesmen have so far re-
frained from repeating the usual official statement that 'it has nothing to
do with the de facto recognition of Manchukuo'. The KMT fascist papers and
journals have all signified their favour of the resumption of train service
by claiming that it is simply to aid our brothers in Manchuria. Why not rescue
our suffering brothers there by sending an expeditionary force beyond the Great
Wall and oust the brutal Japs?
 keen observers are inclined to the view that de jure recognition of Manchu-
kuo by the KMT is not far ahead in the light of recent events.
pages.zh:
应日本帝国主义要求
就事实上承认满洲国进行磋商
....................................

1934年7月1日，标志着南京政府完全按照日本帝国主义的愿望，迈出了事实上承认满洲傀儡政权的关键一步。北方的许多国民党政客不满足于这种投降举动，要求在法律上承认满洲国。事实上承认的完成体现在7月1日恢复沈阳与北平之间的铁路服务。当天上午，北平和沈阳的列车分别向对方方向发车，使中国（祖国）和满洲作为两个拥有正常交往的独立国家处于同等地位。
在与事实上承认相关的问题上，南京政府还采取了另外两项具有同等意义的策略，即：在长城沿线设立海关分卡，默示接受其为满洲与中国本部之间的合法边界线；以及解除对往来满洲邮件的邮政禁令。综合来看，这几周内完成的这三件事，彻底暴露了南京政府放弃满洲并巩固日本在华地位的决心。

恢复铁路服务

对往来满洲邮件的禁令在数月前就已结束，当时寄往北平、满洲国，或北平、热河省的信件从满洲抵达南京，并通过中国邮政人员送达收件人手中。与此同时，南京交通部通过发布指令使这些违规行为合法化，规定所有来自满洲的邮件必须送达收件人，但在投递前需撕掉满洲邮票。
随后，7月20日在长城沿线设立了海关分卡。约20个中国海关分支机构于当日开始运作。只有少数中国报纸敢在其版面上刊登此消息。现在，南京财政部仅将此行为视为既成事实，而未加上通常的“这与事实上承认满洲国无关”的措辞。南京仓促完成此举，是由于日本帝国主义的高压所致，后者制造了日本驻南京领事馆副领事仓本（Kuramoto）失踪事件，并想以此作为占领国民党首都的借口。
正如日本所预期和南京所承诺的那样，北平与沈阳之间的列车服务于7月1日成为现实。当天上午，从北平开出的列车按时刻表出发，但在距天津不远的一处发生了一起事故，导致四名乘客死亡，数十人受伤。突然，三等车厢内发生炸弹爆炸，据信炸弹被妥善安置在某位乘客的行李中，因炎热天气下的颠簸而爆炸。毫无疑问，炸弹来自一名对国民党政府不断向日本帝国主义投降感到不满的人士。日本人利用这次爆炸作为借口，在列车上增派更多日本士兵，而亲日汉奸、北宁铁路局局长殷同（Yin Tung）（他在亲日谈判中赚取了数百万）则向其日本主子辞职以示歉意。

列车上的日本警卫

每列从北平开出的列车均配有9名日本宪兵和7名中国士兵，这意味着日本人有权控制中国领土上直接受南京管辖的中国列车，更不用说虽仍属中国但已被国民党明确放弃的满洲。但是，列车上的中国士兵不能进入满洲，必须在山海关（边界线）下车，换乘另一列火车返回北平。因此，长城再次被承认为中国与日本傀儡政权之间的边界线。
7月1日，满洲和日本的日本官员及平民庆祝了这一场合，祝贺南京表现出愿意屈从于日本帝国主义，而另一方面，国民党对日本的赞扬保持沉默，完全且毫无保留地接受了日本关于保护国的宣言。迄今为止，南京发言人避免重复通常的官方声明，即“这与事实上承认满洲国无关”。国民党的法西斯报刊均表示支持恢复列车服务，声称这仅仅是为了援助我们在满洲的兄弟。既然如此，为何不派遣远征军越过长城，驱逐残暴的日本人，以拯救那里受苦的兄弟呢？
敏锐的观察者倾向于认为，鉴于最近的事态发展，国民党在法律上承认满洲国之日已为期不远。

CHINESE VOLUNTEERS CORRESPONDENCE........Vol.4, No 26...........July 12, 1932.

CONTENTS
........
RESCUE REVOLUTIONARY LEADERS

1) The Volunteers in Kirin Scored Two More Victories...................p.
2) Economic Reconstruction of the Soviets............................p.
3) Nanking Pleased Japan by Another Surrender........................p.
4) Rescue Revolutionary Leaders From Nanking Hangman.................p.

VOLUNTEERS IN KIRIN SCORED TWO MORE VICTORIES
One Mutiny Among Manchurian Troops
.... .... .... ...... .... ....

Following their previous successes, the volunteers in Manchuria have recently occupied two more important cities in Kirin: Hsulan which is only 50 miles from the capital of Kirin and Lung Chin Town, also known under the name of Lutaogu, which serves as a distributive centre in the area of Gurn Tao. In the latter district was located the Chinese customs house before the occupation of Manchuria by the Japanese.

The Volunteer Attack

According to information emanating from Japanese sources the volunteers on June 22 attacked Lutaogu in the morning and, after severe fighting with the Japanese, took the whole city in the afternoon. Only 600 volunteers took part in the offensive. They still keep the city. By its message of June 29 the Japanese Dantung news agency informed us that about 1,000 volunteers besieged the town of Leotsegu Kaitao on June 26 and attacked the troops and police by a surprise, disarming the police entirely. After two days of fighting they succeeded in capturing the town.
Hsulan was taken two weeks earlier. According to the United Press, A-norlean, several hundred volunteers launched an attack on the hsien last Friday and defeated the garrison, setting free all the prisoners held in the jails.
Serious fighting took place in other areas of Manchuria. On June 27 the Simvenpao of Shanghai gave out the following news: The Kirin volunteers numbering some 6,000 besieged Ping Hsien, administering a vital blow to the Japanese garrison, followed on June 23 by another attack of the volunteers who descended on Tung Kiang Hsien. Ping Hsien lies to the north of Hsulan and on the southeast of Harbin while Tung Kiang is situated at the confluence of the Sungari and Holwkiang, quite near the Soviet frontier. By skillful tactics the heroic volunteers operated successfully in regions heavily guarded by the Japanese and their puppet. This fact alone shatters the theory of the KMT bandits that China is too impotent to fight against Japanese imperialism.

Mutiny of Manchurian Cavalry

The high pressure of Japanese officials among the Manchurian troops helps the latter considerably in coming to their national consciousness. The Manchurian soldiers have been subjected to unbearable maltreatment. Now they face the danger of being dissolved, to be replaced by elements who are considered by the Japs as more reliable. The revolutionary flames kindled by the volunteers have been instrumental in the widespread mutinies among the Manchurian army.
On June 21 300 cavalry stationed in Halenyu (a pass along the Great Wall) revolted against the oppression of Japanese officials and fled to the Eastern Liaohuloum. They put up a stiff resistance to the pursuing units.
A week earlier another mutiny was reported from Harbin through the Reuters agency. A section of the Manchurian troops stationed at Laoershan-chun on the eastern line of the Chinese Eastern Railway recently revolted, stated Reuters. Then a battle was fought between the mutineers and those troops who remained loyal, during which both sides registered several losses. Seven of the mutineers succeeded in escaping to the hills, fully armed and equipped.
These events, taken together, are a strong denial of the Japanese boast that the volunteers have been all liquidated.

吉林志愿军再获两胜
满洲军队中的一次兵变
.... .... .... ...... .... ....

继此前的胜利之后，满洲的志愿军最近又占领了吉林的两个重要城市：距吉林省会仅50英里的舒兰 (Hsulan)，以及又称鹿道沟 (Lutaogu) 的龙津镇 (Lung Chin Town)，后者是珲陶 (Gurn Tao) 地区的分销中心。在日本占领满洲之前，中国海关就设在该地区。

志愿军的进攻

根据来自日本方面的消息，志愿军于6月22日上午袭击了鹿道沟 (Lutaogu)，在与日军激战后，于下午攻占了全城。只有600名志愿军参加了这次进攻。他们仍然控制着该城。日本丹东通讯社在6月29日的电讯中通知我们，约1,000名志愿军于6月26日包围了老柞树开道? (Leotsegu Kaitao) 镇，并出其不意地袭击了部队和警察，完全解除了警察的武装。经过两天的战斗，他们成功攻占了该镇。
舒兰 (Hsulan) 是在两周前被攻占的。据合众社 (United Press) 报道，安诺林? (A-norlean)，数百名志愿军于上周五对该县发动攻击，击败了守备部队，释放了监狱中关押的所有囚犯。
满洲其他地区也发生了激烈战斗。6月27日，上海的《新闻报》 (Simvenpao) 发布了以下消息：约6,000名吉林志愿军包围了平县 (Ping Hsien)，给日本守备部队以沉重打击，随后志愿军于6月23日再次发动攻击，进军东江县 (Tung Kiang Hsien)。平县位于舒兰以北、哈尔滨东南，而东江位于松花江与霍尔瓦基江? (Holwkiang) 汇合处，靠近苏联边境。英勇的志愿军凭借巧妙的战术，在日军及其傀儡重兵把守的地区成功作战。仅这一事实就粉碎了国民党匪徒所谓中国无力对抗日本帝国主义的理论。

满洲骑兵兵变

日本官员对满洲军队施加的高压，极大地促使后者民族意识的觉醒。满洲士兵遭受了难以忍受的虐待。现在他们面临被解散的危险，取而代之的是被日本人认为更可靠的分子。志愿军点燃的革命火焰在满洲军队中引发了广泛的兵变。
6月21日，驻守在哈伦峪 (Halenyu，长城沿线的一个关口) 的300名骑兵反抗日本官员的压迫，逃往辽东? (Eastern Liaohuloum)。他们对追击部队进行了顽强抵抗。
一周前，路透社报道了哈尔滨发生的另一起兵变。路透社称，驻扎在中东铁路东线老二山屯? (Laoershan-chun) 的一部分满洲军队最近发动兵变。随后，兵变部队与保持忠诚的部队之间爆发了战斗，双方均有一定伤亡。7名兵变者全副武装成功逃入山区。
这些事件综合起来，有力地驳斥了日本人所吹嘘的志愿军已被全部肃清的说法。

ECONOMIC CONSTRUCTION OF THE SOVIETS
A Decision Adopted by the
Second Soviet Congress
.............

In areas controlled by imperialism and KMT bandits are prevalent decay
in the realm of national economy and ruin, unemployment, starvation for mil-
lions of the toiling masses whereas under the Soviets economic improvement
stands out distinctly with the attending amelioration in the lot of the
workers and peasants, especially during the course of last year, thanks to
the execution by the central government of the economic policy decided on
by the first Soviet congress in spite of the ruthless attack and economic
blockade of imperialism and KMT bandits.

Increase in Production

Production has increased considerably as a result of the ploughing cam-
paigns launched by the Soviets to rouse the toiling masses to greater en-
thusiasm for labour. Hence production of rice in Kiangsi has augmented 15%,
that in Fukien-Choking-Kiangsi by 20% or more, as compared with the year
before. The increase in cereal production is even greater. Fallow land has
decreased in acreage on a grand scale. More than 200,000 mows of swampy land
was reclaimed last year. Revival has been observed in such industries as i-
ron, clothes, line, paper, coal, tungsten, salt, oil, drugs, etc.
The cooperative movement embodying productive, consumptive, credit, pro-
vision cooperatives resulted in the enlistment of over 500,000 members. In
certain districts 50% of the population has joined the cooperatives. Examples
are not lacking which show the enrollment of whole villages. These gigantic
mass organisations maintain close relationships with the foreign trade bu-
reau, food office and governmental shops of the Soviets, and have received
considerable aid from the Soviets regarding finances and personnel. Need-
less to say, the cooperatives are all centralised in some sort of higher or-
ganisations.
The food office and trade bureau have registered great achievements in
stabilizing prices and storage of rice. The cooperatives contributed greatly
towards the supplies to the red army as well as towards the amelioration in
the life of the toilers in the village. With the inauguration of the depart-
ment of national economy, the economic reconstruction of the Soviets has
been carried on in a planned way, that is, on the principle of planned econ-
omy.
These achievements in the field of economics prove conclusively that
the Soviets can build up a new economic order on the ruins of the old as well
as lead and organise the economic life of the masses.

Recommendations of Congress

1) Further increase in production. The Soviets must undertake this task
in connection with agriculture by launching more ploughing campaigns, by
practically solving the difficulties of the peasants such as the lack of
drawing oxen, seeds, fertilizers, irrigation, labour and capital. The Soviets
must encourage the peasants to form mutual aid cooperatives, e.g., labour
mutual aid, drawing oxen, fertilisers, etc., set up experimental stations,
open pasturage grounds, educating the peasantry in the scientific knowledge
of how to fight the harmful insects, floods and drought, etc. Indispensa-
ble crops as cotton, shall be planted in Soviet territory, forestry pro-
tected by planning.
2) Small production by handicraft shall be encouraged, particularly of
those articles which are of vital importance to the war, exportation, and
consumption of the masses. The Soviets must help in the formation of pro-
duction cooperatives composed of unemployed, independent workers, handi-
craftsmen, peasants, absorbing maximum amount of capital as much as pos-
sible in this enterprise. Enterprises confiscated by the Soviets may be
given over to them for operation either by sale or by contract. Under cer-
tain conditions the Soviets may operate state enterprises as, for instance,
mines, salt, paper, etc, but must refrain from attempting at monopoly
of production at the present moment. At present our central task con-
sists in aiding the development of production cooperatives both with
money and men as well as strengthening our leadership over them.

Labour Enthusiasm

Among the workers and peasants labour enthusiasm shall be raised still
higher as a preliminary step towards further increase in production. With
this end in view there shall be developed as widely as possible the shock

苏维埃的经济建设
第二次苏维埃代表大会通过的一项决议
.............

在帝国主义和国民党匪徒控制的地区，国民经济领域普遍存在衰败和破坏，数百万劳动群众面临失业和饥饿；而在苏维埃地区，经济改善显著，工农生活状况随之好转。特别是在去年，尽管遭受帝国主义和国民党匪徒的残酷攻击和经济封锁，但由于中央政府执行了第一次苏维埃代表大会决定的经济政策，取得了上述成就。

生产增加

由于苏维埃发起耕种运动以激发广大劳动群众更高的劳动热情，生产大幅增加。因此，与上一年相比，江西的大米产量增加了15%，福建-浙江-江西地区增加了20%或更多。粮食产量的增长甚至更大。荒地面积大幅减少。去年开垦了超过20万亩沼泽地。铁、服装、亚麻、纸、煤、钨、盐、油、药品等工业已出现复兴。
包含生产、消费、信贷和供应合作社在内的合作化运动，吸收了超过50万名成员。在某些地区，50%的人口加入了合作社。整村加入的例子并不少见。这些庞大的群众组织与苏维埃的对外贸易局、粮食局和政府商店保持密切联系，并在财政和人员方面得到了苏维埃的大量援助。毫无疑问，所有合作社都集中在某种更高级别的组织中。
粮食局和贸易局在稳定物价和大米储备方面取得了巨大成就。合作社对红军的供应以及改善乡村劳动者的生活做出了巨大贡献。随着国民经济部的成立，苏维埃的经济重建已按计划进行，即遵循计划经济的原则。
经济领域的这些成就确凿地证明，苏维埃不仅能在旧秩序的废墟上建立新的经济秩序，而且能领导和组织群众的经济生活。

大会建议

1) 进一步增加生产。苏维埃必须结合农业承担这项任务，发起更多的耕种运动，切实解决农民缺乏耕牛、种子、肥料、灌溉、劳动力和资本等困难。苏维埃必须鼓励农民组建互助合作社，例如劳动互助、耕牛、肥料等，设立实验站，开辟牧场，教育农民掌握防治害虫、洪水和干旱等的科学知识。棉花等必要作物应在苏维埃领土上种植，林业应通过规划加以保护。
2) 应鼓励手工业的小规模生产，特别是那些对战争、出口和群众消费至关重要的物品。苏维埃必须帮助由失业者、独立工人、手工业者和农民组成的生产合作社的形成，在此企业中尽可能吸收最大量的资本。苏维埃没收的企业可以通过出售或承包的方式交给他们经营。在某些条件下，苏维埃可以经营国有企业，例如矿山、盐、纸等，但目前必须避免试图垄断生产。目前我们的中心任务是在资金和人力上援助生产合作社的发展，并加强我们对它们的领导。

劳动热情

作为进一步增加生产的初步步骤，应在工人和农民中进一步提高劳动热情。为此，应尽可能广泛地开展生产突击队和竞赛。鼓励农民并增加

shall be rewarded. So too with the productive corps and individual workers,
all heroes on the labour front, who shall play a such greater role in agri-
cultural and industrial production. Productivity of labour in private enter-
prises may be increased provided the workers consent to it for the ameliora-
tion of their own life. This shall be done under supervision of the Soviets
and trade unions. The communist attitude to labour shall be made clear, first of all, in
state enterprises, at the same time educating the workers in the elementary
truth that workers who render services to the Soviets are, in reality, work-
ing for their own final emancipation and the victory of socialism. Labour
discipline observed in the Soviet enterprises should serve as an example for
proletarian discipline. All inventions likely to raise productivity shall re-
ceive high reward from the Soviets. The training of skilled labour is of spe-
cial importance to increase in production.

Development of Trade

Inter-provincial trade, that is, trade with non-Soviet districts, shall
be developed at all costs to meet the revolutionary needs and to facilitate
improvement in the life of the toiling masses. In spite of the economic block-
ade of the enemy the major products of the Soviet districts as, e.g., tungsten
paper, timber, rice, etc., shall be exported in exchange for salt and cloth
in great demand within the Soviet borders. Leadership over the trade organs
shall be strengthened. The Soviets proclaim freedom of trade in opposition
to trade monopoly which is in force at present. Soviet trade organs ought
to draw in private capital as much as possible. The Soviets have the customs
as an effective weapon for the regulation of trade with non-Soviet territory.
The Soviets must devote considerable attention to the balance of trade be-
tween the Soviet and non-Soviet districts.
5) In the development of Soviet trade the consumption cooperatives have
a special role to play. It is the intermediary through which the toiling mass-
es can buy articles at reduce prices but sell their own products at higher
prices. The flow of goods either to or from the peasants is accelerated by
the consumption cooperatives. Through the cooperatives the Soviets can main-
tain wide control (direct) with the broad masses in the economic field, and
thus mobilize them around itself. Aside from centralising the consumption co-
operatives in a hierarchy from the centre down to the halons, the Soviets
should help them both with money and men. The cooperatives shall draw in e-
very one of the toilers and improve its work as well. Model cooperatives
should be set up. The workers and peasants must be given to understand that
the cooperative is an effective weapon in the struggle against the monopoly
and speculation of the wicked merchants and kulaks, also a weapon for the a-
melioration of their own lot.

The Food Problem

6) The solution of the food problem is the fighting task in the economic
reconstruction of the Soviets at the present moment. The food office has done
something in the distribution of food and in the stabilisation of the price
of food but but it has never solved the problem as a whole. Acute food short-
age which threatened us last spring and fall is still a menace at present.
Under the central government a food commissariat shall be erected in charge
of exportation and distribution of food together with stabilisation of the
price, insuring above all adequate supply to the red army, the Soviets and
the masses. The new commissariat must proceed with the investigation of food,
its storage and transportation, etc. But food monopoly is inadvisable at
present. The solution of the food problem depends on the organisation of
food cooperatives by the masses, cooperatives that shall form the basis of
the food commissariat. The commissariat must most energetically develop the
food cooperatives composed of and supported by the masses.
7) The lack of capital is one of the staggering difficulties confronting
the present economic development of the Soviets. The Soviets have used pri-
vate capital and investments from the masses but only to an insufficient de-
gree. The state bank has little to show besides issuing coins, administering
funds for the state treasury, receiving deposits, etc. All these weaknesses
in connection with the state bank must be overcome in order to make possible
greater accumulation of Soviet capital.

The Issue of Paper Money

8) The Soviets must be very careful in the issue of paper money. Depre-
ciation in value is inevitable when there is an excess of paper over the de-
mand of the market. Then follows the rise in prices and aggravation of the
lot of the toilers likely to jeopardise the alliance between the workers and
peasants. Under the conditions of a continuous revolutionary war the Soviets
are compelled at times to cover the deficit by issuing more paper but the

3
应给予奖励。生产队和个别工人也是如此，所有劳动战线上的英雄都将在农业和工业生产中发挥更大的作用。如果工人为了改善自己的生活而同意，私营企业中的劳动生产率可以提高。这应在苏维埃和工会的监督下进行。首先应在国有企业中明确共产主义的劳动态度，同时教育工人一个基本真理：为苏维埃服务的工人，实际上是在为他们自己的最终解放和社会主义的胜利而工作。苏维埃企业中遵守的劳动纪律应成为无产阶级纪律的榜样。所有可能提高生产率的发明都将得到苏维埃的重奖。熟练劳动力的培训对增加生产特别重要。

贸易发展

省际贸易，即与非苏维埃地区的贸易，应不惜一切代价发展，以满足革命需要并促进劳动群众生活的改善。尽管敌人实行经济封锁，苏维埃地区的主要产品，如钨、纸、木材、大米等，应出口以换取苏维埃境内急需的盐和布匹。应加强对贸易机构的领导。苏维埃宣布贸易自由，反对目前实行的贸易垄断。苏维埃贸易机构应尽可能吸引私人资本。苏维埃拥有海关这一有效武器来调节与非苏维埃领土的贸易。苏维埃必须高度重视苏维埃地区与非苏维埃地区之间的贸易平衡。
5) 在苏维埃贸易的发展中，消费合作社发挥着特殊作用。它是劳动群众以较低价格购买商品并以较高价格出售自己产品的中介。消费合作社加速了流向农民或从农民流出的商品流通。通过合作社，苏维埃可以在经济领域与广大群众保持广泛的（直接）控制，从而将他们动员到自己周围。除了将消费合作社从中央到区（halons）集中为一个层级体系外，苏维埃还应在资金和人力上帮助他们。合作社应吸收每一位劳动者，并改进其工作。应建立模范合作社。必须让工人和农民明白，合作社是对抗奸商和富农垄断及投机的有效武器，也是改善他们自身处境的工具。

粮食问题

6) 解决粮食问题是当前苏维埃经济建设中的战斗任务。粮食局在粮食分配和稳定粮价方面做了一些工作，但从未整体解决这一问题。去年春秋两季威胁我们的严重粮食短缺目前仍是一个威胁。应在中央政府下设立粮食人民委员部，负责粮食的出口和分配以及稳定物价，首要保证红军、苏维埃和群众的充足供应。新成立的委员部必须进行粮食调查、储存和运输等工作。但目前不宜实行粮食垄断。解决粮食问题取决于群众组织粮食合作社，这些合作社将构成粮食人民委员部的基础。委员部必须最积极地发展由群众组成并得到群众支持的粮食合作社。
7) 资本缺乏是苏维埃当前经济发展面临的惊人困难之一。苏维埃利用了私人资本和群众的投资，但程度不足。国家银行除了发行硬币、管理国库基金、接收存款等外，鲜有建树。必须克服与国家银行有关的所有这些弱点，以使苏维埃资本的更大积累成为可能。

纸币发行问题

8) 苏维埃在发行纸币时必须非常谨慎。当纸币发行量超过市场需求时，贬值是不可避免的。随后便是物价上涨和劳动者处境的恶化，这可能危及工农联盟。在持续革命战争的条件下，苏维埃有时被迫通过发行更多纸币来弥补赤字，但

4
Soviet government should resort to another method more fitful, placing the
burden of the revolutionary war on the exploiting classes, increasing taxa-
tion during the upward movement of Soviet economy. The absorption of cash
through the development of the trade with the non-Soviet districts and limi-
tation on the exportation of silver are necessary for expanding the power of
the market to absorb paper and upholding the credit of paper. The movement
in support of paper may produce a certain effect in bolstering up the credit
of paper. The congress appeals to the Hunan-Jiangxi-Kiangsi Soviets for taking
steps towards redemption of the paper issued without any restriction. Our
comrades in that district shall understand that only the branch of the state
bank has the right to issue paper.

Counterrevolutionary Sabotage

Simultaneous with its military attack and economic blockade imperialism
and KMT bandits will surely use remnant landlords, merchants and capitalists
to start trouble in the rear of the Soviets as, e.g., lockout, closings,
sabotage, etc, to wreck the economy of the Soviets, to injure the credit of
Soviet paper, to throw confusion into currency. The Soviets must determinedly
fight against the counterrevolutionary activities of the capitalists, land-
lords and merchants by meting out punishments from fines, hard labour, im-
prisonment, confiscation to capital death sentence. At the same time the
Soviets, always alert to the highest degree, should severely punish the theft,
sabotage, corruption of the counterrevolutionaries who conceal themselves
in the Soviet government. Control of production by the worker must be im-
mediately begun in private enterprises with a view to averting the counter-
revolutionary activities of the capitalists. But as to those capitalists
and merchants who observe the law, the Soviets must protect their life and
property including their business, and guarantee liberty to them. The So-
viets give good treatment to the landlord-bourgeois technicians and intellec-
tuals who honestly work for the Soviets and masses in the economic organs
and consumers cooperatives.

More Effective Leadership

10) The congress insists that to accomplish the tasks enumerated above
for the economic development of the Soviets the presidium of the next exe-
cutive committee and the people's council shall increase their energy in the
direction of the national economy, finance and food commissariats and the
state bank, coordinating the activities of these organs in their relation
to each other. The fight against "left" phrases in economic reconstruction
and bureaucratic leadership is an important premise for a new turn in the
work of these organs. A large number of new cadres must be trained for econ-
omic reconstruction to fill these economic organs. The leading role of the
proletariat in economic reconstruction must be specially strengthened, draw-
ing a large number of toiling women to take up the work on the economic
front during this period of revolutionary war. In the present phase of the
Chinese revolution socialist construction can not be undertaken but the cen-
tre of gravity in all our work should be to create presumptions and favor-
able conditions for the transformation to socialism.
11) In the opinion of the congress the many difficulties confronting us
may be overcome only by winning a thorough victory of the revolutionary war
over the enemy with the capture of leading cities, the enlargement and con-
solidation of Soviet territory. Only until then can the economic reconstruc-
tion of the Soviets proceed more favourably.
This economic reconstruction is not for the development of capitalism
as is supposed in certain quarters but for the triumph of socialism. For
this reason, our economic reconstruction at the present juncture can not be
separated from the revolutionary war but must be subordinated to the needs
of the revolutionary war. And the solution of many of the difficulties is
sought in the success of the revolutionary war.
The congress firmly believes that the path of the economic reconstruc-
tion under the Soviets shall be identical with that of the socialist con-
struction of the Soviet Union, the sole path that ensures a sharp upgrade
movement of Chinese national economy as well as final emancipation of Chi-
nese toilers throughout the whole land.

苏维埃政府应采取另一种更为适宜的方法，将革命战争的负担加诸剥削阶级身上，并在苏维埃经济向上发展时期增加税收。通过发展与非苏维埃地区的贸易来吸收现金，并限制白银出口，这对于扩大市场吸收纸币的能力以及维持纸币信用是必要的。支持纸币的运动可能会在 bolstering（支撑）纸币信用方面产生一定效果。大会呼吁湘赣苏区采取措施，赎回无限制发行的纸币。该地区的同志们应当明白，只有国家银行的分行才拥有发行纸币的权利。

反革命破坏活动

帝国主义和国民党匪帮在进行军事攻击和经济封锁的同时，必然会利用残余的地主、商人和资本家在苏维埃后方制造事端，例如停工、关闭工厂、破坏活动等，以破坏苏维埃经济，损害苏维埃纸币的信用，扰乱货币体系。苏维埃必须坚决打击资本家、地主和商人的反革命活动，处以从罚款、苦役、监禁、没收财产到死刑等惩罚。同时，苏维埃应保持高度警惕，严厉惩处隐藏在苏维埃政府内部的反革命分子的盗窃、破坏和腐败行为。必须在私营企业中立即实行工人对生产的监督，以防范资本家的反革命活动。但对于那些守法的资本家和商人，苏维埃必须保护他们的生命和财产，包括其商业活动，并保障他们的自由。苏维埃给予那些在经济机构和消费合作社中诚实地为苏维埃和群众工作的地主资产阶级技术人员和知识分子以优待。

更有效的领导

10) 大会坚持认为，为了完成上述苏维埃经济发展的任务，下一届执行委员会主席团和人民委员会应加强对国民经济、财政、粮食人民委员部以及国家银行的工作力度，协调这些机构之间的相互活动。反对经济建设中的“左”倾空谈和官僚主义领导，是这些机构工作出现新转折的重要前提。必须培养大量新干部从事经济建设，以充实这些经济机构。必须特别加强无产阶级在经济建设中的领导作用，在革命战争期间吸引大量劳动妇女投身经济战线的工作。在中国革命的当前阶段，尚不能进行社会主义建设，但我们所有工作的重心应当是为向社会主义过渡创造前提和有利条件。
11) 大会认为，只有通过革命战争彻底战胜敌人，夺取主要城市，扩大和巩固苏维埃领土，才能克服我们面临的许多困难。只有到那时，苏维埃的经济建设才能更顺利地进行。
这种经济建设并非如某些方面所设想的那样是为了发展资本主义，而是为了社会主义的胜利。因此，我们当前的经济建设不能与革命战争分离，而必须服从于革命战争的需要。许多困难的解决有待于革命战争的胜利。
大会坚信，苏维埃下的经济建设道路应与苏联的社会主义建设道路一致，这是确保中国国民经济急剧上升以及全中国劳动人民最终解放的唯一道路。

SUBSTANTIAL CUT IN THE CUSTOMS TARIFF
ANOTHER CAPITULATION TO JAPAN
............................

As effective from July 2, 1934, Nanking's new tariff was promulgated by the national government. What is now in the revised tariff is the substantial cut, all round, in the duties on the importation of imperialist wares such as cotton goods, cotton yarn, sea products, sugar, paper, rayon, coal, etc., almost all of Japanese origin. This is another surrender of the KMT bandits to Japanese imperialism which has demanded the lowering of duties along with the resumption of through rail traffic and postal service, the re-adjustment of loans to Japan, etc.

The original KMT has promised national recovery time and again, and made considerable noise regarding such preparations in that direction. But, in fact, it has done all it can to strangle the Chinese nation under the direction of imperialism, especially in the past few months when its work of stranglement was accelerated under the whip of imperialism. It has fully prepared for handing over China to imperialism in exchange for the protection expected of imperialism on an increasing scale. This protection is more valuable in view of the fact that the landlord-bourgeois rule in China totters more than ever owing to the deepening of the national crisis and the advance of the revolution.

In the several weeks past the KMT bandits complied with the few demands that Japanese imperialism has pressed, namely, resumption of train and postal service, establishment of customs branches along the Great Wall. Then immediately follows the reduction of duties on Japanese goods. As reliably reported, the (1,000,000,000 loan to Japan, mostly unfunded, is about to be readjusted on a new basis of amortization. Hence the sharp rise in the price of the bonds last week (Adjustment of the loan will bring money to Nanking from Tokyo).

These undeniable facts signify only one thing: greater determination of the KMT bandits to sell the country at cheap prices plus the deepening of the national crisis confronting the Chinese people. At this juncture the movement for armed self-defence on the part of the masses has become more urgent than ever.

All-round Cut on Japanese Wares

The dumping of Japanese goods in China which has played so much havoc with national products is shielded and facilitated by the so-called reciprocal treaty of 1930 concluded between Nanking and Tokyo. It has counteracted much to the detriment of the boycott movement launched by the Chinese masses. The new tariff cuts the duty on cotton goods by 10% to 50% (a great benefit to Japanese and British imperialism), that on sea products by 15% to 26% (as against the 100% before), that on paper by 30%, that on rayon, sugar, coal, etc., by a certain percentage.

On the other hand, the duty on raw cotton needed by Chinese cotton mills is raised by 47%, that on machinery imported for Chinese industries (yet no substitutes in China) by 33%. On this point Nanking has embarrassed itself by contradictory explanations. Its spokesman put forward the theory that the lowering of duties on necessities will benefit the consumers while the duties on luxuries must be bolstered up. But why cut the duty on shark's fin, usually considered as a kind of expensive sea food? The KMT traitor better keep his mouth shut.

The new tariff strikes a hard blow at the cotton mill in China which is regarded as the greatest national industry in the whole land. But the KMT traitor belittles it saying that the higher duty on cotton goods can do little in checking the dumping of foreign goods because foreigners have a treaty right to set up and enlarge mills in China. Here the KMT has intimated that it will uphold the unequal treaties imposed by imperialism at the point of the sword, and give imperialism more benefit supplementary to the unequal treaties. The immediate effect of the lowered tariff is well indicated in the closing last week of the Shenxin cotton mills at Shanghai (employing over 30,000 workers) shortly after the promulgation of the tariff. The mills, nine in all, are in the hands of a receiver representing the bankers, creditors. The silk industry already ruined will never be able to raise its head any more in face of the competition of rayon. (The Shanghai News, July 5).

In one word, the increase and decrease in the duties constitute a decisive step towards the much advertised military and economic alliance between China, Manchukuo and Japan under Japanese hegemony. By this and other actions Nanking has willingly accepted the guardianship of Japanese imperialism proclaimed by the Tokyo foreign office on April 17. It is also flirting with U.S. and British imperialism for the same purpose: aid and assist-

大幅削减海关关税
对日本的又一次屈服
............................

自1934年7月2日起生效的新关税由国民政府颁布。修订后的关税实质上是全面大幅降低了棉织品、棉纱、海产品、糖、纸张、人造丝、煤炭等帝国主义商品——几乎全部原产于日本——的进口税。这是国民党匪帮对日本帝国主义的又一次投降，日本帝国主义曾要求降低关税，并以此作为恢复直通铁路交通和邮政服务、重新调整对日贷款等的条件。

国民党原本一再承诺民族复兴，并为此类准备大造声势。但事实上，它在帝国主义的指使下竭尽所能扼杀中华民族，特别是在过去几个月里，其在帝国主义的鞭笞下加速了这种扼杀工作。它已做好充分准备，将中国移交给帝国主义，以换取日益扩大的帝国主义保护。鉴于中国的民族危机加深和革命前进，地主资产阶级的统治比以往任何时候都更加摇摇欲坠，这种保护显得更有价值。

在过去几周里，国民党匪帮顺从了日本帝国主义施加的几项要求，即恢复火车和邮政服务，在长城沿线设立海关分支。紧接着就是降低日货关税。据可靠消息报道，（10亿日元贷款，大部分无基金担保，正打算在新的摊销基础上重新调整。因此上周债券价格急剧上涨（贷款调整将为南京带来来自东京的资金）。

这些不可否认的事实只意味着一件事：国民党匪帮廉价卖国的决心更大，加上中国人民面临的民族危机加深。在此关头，群众的武装自卫运动变得比以往任何时候都更加紧迫。

全面削减日货关税

日本商品在中国的倾销严重破坏了国货，而南京与东京之间签订的所谓1930年互惠条约对此起到了庇护和便利作用。这在很大程度上抵消了中国民众发起的抵制运动的效果。新关税将棉织品的关税降低了10%至50%（这对日本和英国帝国主义大有裨益），海产品的关税降低了15%至26%（此前为100%），纸张关税降低了30%，人造丝、糖、煤炭等的关税也降低了一定百分比。

另一方面，中国棉纺厂所需的原棉关税提高了47%，为中国工业进口（且中国尚无替代品）的机械关税提高了33%。在此问题上，南京自相矛盾的解释使其陷入尴尬境地。其发言人提出一种理论，称降低必需品关税将使消费者受益，而必须提高奢侈品关税。但为什么要降低通常被视为昂贵海鲜的鱼翅的关税呢？国民党卖国贼最好闭嘴。

新关税对中国棉纺业造成了沉重打击，棉纺业被视为全国最大的民族工业。但国民党卖国贼却轻描淡写地说，提高棉织品关税在阻止外国商品倾销方面作用甚微，因为外国人拥有在中国开设和扩大工厂的条约权利。在此，国民党暗示它将维护帝国主义强加的不平等条约，并在不平等条约之外给予帝国主义更多利益。降低关税的直接影响在上海申新棉纺厂（雇佣超过3万名工人）在关税颁布后不久于上周倒闭一事中得到了充分体现。这九家工厂目前由代表银行家和债权人的接管人管理。面对人造丝的竞争，已经破产的丝绸业将再也无法翻身。（《上海新闻》，7月5日）。

总之，关税的增减构成了迈向日本霸权下中国、满洲国和日本之间大肆宣传的军事和经济联盟的决定性一步。通过这一举动及其他行动，南京 willingly（自愿地）接受了东京外务省于4月17日宣布的日本帝国主义的监护权。它也在与美国和英国帝国主义眉来眼去，出于同样的目的：援助和协助——

pages.en:
6
tance from imperialist countries to bolster up the shakun rule of Chinese land-lord-bourgeoisie.

Protests From All Sides

National bourgeoisie has shown a violent opposition to the new tariff under which Japanese goods flood Chinese market. The Chinese cotton mills association angrily accused Nanking of having struck the industry with a most hard-er blow. The Shanghai chamber of commerce which represents the comprador class has also filed a protest against the new tariff saying, "How can a coun-try go along when submitting to foreign dictation at every turn", thus charg-ing Nanking with wrecking Chinese enterprises. Even the leading newspaper in Shanghai, Yu Chochin, can not refrain from saying "With the imposition of duties on Japanese goods Chinese enterprises are surely to be put out of busi-ness" (The Shen Pao, July 5). But Nanking has firmly resolved to carry out the new surrender in spite of protests.

Compradors have to protest, partly because the new capitulation is too plain and too disgraceful, partly because under the guise of protecting their own note profit out of the sale of Japanese goods. Past experience of the anti-Japanese boycott movement tell us that the shops which refuse to sell Japanese goods posted on their doors have usually done a lucrative business in selling Ja-panese wares. Besides, compradors, not loyal to one but many imperialists, may remain silent on the cut in duties on Japanese goods but must take a hos-tile attitude so far as the increase in duties on machinery and raw cotton affects American and British interests. Here in the matter of tariff is re-flected the growing conflict among imperialists.

On the other hand, the leading papers of Shanghai, though commenting e-ditorially on the new tariff, have raised a serious protest save for the fas-cist Chen Pao which, however, advises Chinese enterprises to overhaul their own conditions thoroughly, implicitly coming to the conclusion that they had better accept the new tariff as it affords them an opportunity for thorough-going reorganization. Thus, the new surrender of Nanking has, on the whole, secured the support of all counterrevolutionary factions. No wonder that Chiang Kai-shek is working feverishly for pacification by betrayal.

RESCUE REVOLUTIONARY LEADERS FROM KMT HANGMEN!
Scores Arrested at Shanghai

According to information given out by bourgeois papers at Shanghai scores of revolutionary leaders were recently arrested by the police of the Shanghai international settlement and French concession, including two members of the CC of CPC. The arrested were handed over to Chinese police for torture and execution in direct violation of the rendition agreement concluded between China and imperialist powers. Of course imperialism hates the revolutionaries just the same as the KMT bandits and might have executed them on the spot were it not for the fact that imperialism has traditionally carried out exe-cutions through Chinese authorities on Chinese territory outside of the settle-ment and concessions.

These leaders of China's liberation movement are all trusted by Chinese masses, waging an uncompromising struggle against imperialism and KMT. For the moment, their work will be taken up by others with a strong likelihood to push the revolutionary movement on a much wider front. Their arrest has caused violent indignation among the workers at Shanghai and called forth a broad mass movement for their rescue.

The imperialist-KMT-fascist terror is raging on an increasing scale but only in territories strongly guarded. The initial success of the Chinese So-viets in repulsing the 5th campaign of imperialism and KMT is a severe contribu-tion to the making of the fascist terrors. In face of the successes the KMT has lost its head. It therefore spread the terror with redoubled energy. At the present the mass struggle against the white terror is of greater importance than any time in the past. We appeal to international proleta-riat for aid in our struggle in this respect.

E B D

6
来自帝国主义国家的援助，以支撑中国地主资产阶级摇摇欲坠的统治。

各方抗议

民族资产阶级对新关税表现出强烈的反对，在该关税下，日本商品涌入中国市场。中国棉纺业公会愤怒地指责南京方面给了该行业最沉重的一击。代表买办阶级的上海总商会也提交了对新关税的抗议书，称“一个国家若处处屈从于外国指令，如何能维持下去”，从而指责南京方面破坏中国企业。甚至上海的主要报纸《字林西报》（Yu Chochin）也不禁表示：“随着对日本商品征收关税，中国企业势必倒闭”（《申报》，7月5日）。但尽管有这些抗议，南京方面仍坚决执行新的投降政策。

买办们不得不提出抗议，部分原因是因为这种新的屈辱性妥协太过明显且太丢脸，部分原因是因为他们借保护自身之名，实则从销售日本商品中牟取暴利。过去抵制日货运动的经验告诉我们，那些在门上张贴拒绝出售日货告示的商店，通常在私下销售日货方面获利丰厚。此外，买办并不效忠于某一个而是多个帝国主义国家，他们可能对降低日本商品关税保持沉默，但当提高机器和原棉关税影响到英美利益时，他们必须采取敌对态度。在此关税问题上，反映了帝国主义之间日益增长的冲突。

另一方面，上海的主要报纸虽然就新关税发表社论评论，但除了法西斯报纸《晨报》（Chen Pao）外，都提出了严肃的抗议。然而，《晨报》建议中国企业彻底整顿自身状况，隐含地得出结论认为，既然新关税为他们提供了彻底重组的机会，他们最好接受它。因此，南京方面的新投降总体上获得了所有反革命派别的支持。难怪蒋介石正疯狂地致力于通过背叛来实现“绥靖”。

从国民党刽子手手中营救革命领袖！
上海数十人被捕

根据上海资产阶级报纸发布的消息，最近，上海公共租界和法租界的警察逮捕了数十名革命领袖，其中包括两名中共中央委员。被捕者被移交给中国警察进行拷打和处决，这直接违反了中国与帝国主义列强之间达成的引渡协议。当然，帝国主义像国民党匪徒一样憎恨革命者，如果不是因为帝国主义传统上通过中国当局在租界和租借地以外的中国领土上执行处决，他们可能当场就将其处决了。

这些中国解放运动的领袖深受中国民众信任，正在进行反对帝国主义和国民党的毫不妥协的斗争。目前，他们的工作将由其他人接手，很有可能将革命运动推向更广阔的局面。他们的逮捕在上海工人中引起了强烈的愤慨，并引发了广泛的群众运动以营救他们。

帝国主义-国民党-法西斯恐怖主义正在日益加剧，但仅限于防守严密的地区。中国苏维埃在击退帝国主义和国民党第五次“围剿”中的初步成功，是对制造法西斯恐怖活动的严重打击。面对这些成功，国民党失去了理智。因此，它以加倍的精力散布恐怖。目前，反对白色恐怖的群众斗争比以往任何时候都更为重要。我们呼吁国际无产阶级在这一方面的斗争中给予援助。

E B D

SWEEPING SUCCESS OF RED ARMY IN FUKIEN

According to the press advices published by foreign papers at Shanghai
the red army has won an overwhelming victory over the Kuomintang bandits
in Fukien, occupying Shanghang, Tienchen, Pingyang, Changping in south
Fukien, Sahsien, Suchi, Ningon, Tatien in central Fukien, Yingping and Ku-
tien in north Fukien. Thus the red army took some ten hsiens, crushing the
enemy as it advanced. When reaching the environs of Shuikou, a strategic
point on the Min River 40 miles from Foochow (capital of Fukien province),
500 garrison came out to meet the advancing red army with open hands, giv-
ing it a warm reception. Then they joined the ranks of the red army uncon-
ditionally.

Messages from the same source placed the booty of the red army at more
than 10,000 rifles in a single engagement, 21 military trucks and an un-
counted large quantity of ammunitions. The Kuomintang bandit army is en-
tirely demoralized before the onslaught of the victorious red army. As a
result, the KT eastern front (meaning Fukien) collapsed to the consterna-
tion of the imperialists who, as reported in our last issue, hurried war-
ships to Foochow menaced by the approaching red army.

The debacle of the KT in Fukien serves as fresh impetus to more capi-
tulation of Nanking to Japanese imperialism. The KT bandit chief, Chiang
Kai-shek, now hastily calls a conference attended by Wang Chin-wei (a left-
ist of the Kuomintang), prime minister; Huang Fu, chief of the Peiping po-
litical council; and a number of other high personages of the Kuomintang
who are well versed in the art of handing over China to Japanese imperial-
ism. In quarters close to Nanking officialdom it is said that the confer-
ence scheduled at Kuling (a summer resort for imperialists and representa-
tives of the Chinese Tuhaos and bourgeoisie) will decide to earmark more
Chinese territory and economic rights to Japanese imperialism.

The country as a whole is naturally indignant over further betrayal of
the Kuomintang and rallies to the call of the national council of the Chi-
nese people in a war against Japan. All traitors of the Chinese nation like
Chiang Kai-shek doom themselves but a short life to live if the armed self
defence movement forges ahead at the present speed.

红军在福建的巨大胜利

根据上海外文报纸刊登的新闻报道，红军在福建击败了国民党匪军，取得了压倒性胜利，占领了闽南的上杭、田陈（音译）、平阳、长平（音译），闽中的沙县、苏溪（音译）、宁洋（音译）、大田，以及闽北的延平和古田。因此，红军攻克了约十个县，并在进军过程中粉碎了敌人。当到达距离福州（福建省会）40英里的闽江战略要点水口附近时，500名守军张开双臂出来迎接进军的红军，给予热烈欢迎。随后他们无条件加入了红军队伍。

来自同一来源的消息称，红军在一次战斗中缴获的战利品包括超过10,000支步枪、21辆军用卡车以及数量巨大的弹药。在胜利红军的攻势面前，国民党匪军士气完全崩溃。结果，国民党东线（即福建）崩溃，令帝国主义者惊恐万分，正如我们在上一期中报道的那样，他们急忙派遣军舰前往受到逼近红军威胁的福州。

国民党在福建的溃败进一步推动了南京向日本帝国主义投降。国民党匪首蒋介石现在匆忙召开了一次会议，出席者包括总理汪精卫（国民党左派）、北平政务委员会主席黄郛，以及其他许多精通将中国出卖给日本帝国主义艺术的国民党高层人物。在南京官场内部人士中流传的说法是，计划在牯岭（帝国主义者和中国土豪及资产阶级的避暑胜地）举行的会议将决定划出更多的中国领土和经济权益给日本帝国主义。

全国上下自然对国民党的进一步背叛感到愤怒，并响应中国人民全国委员会号召，投入抗日战争。如果武装自卫运动以目前的速度推进，像蒋介石这样的中华民族叛徒注定寿命不长。

Chinese toilers both in Kuomintang China and Soviet China observed
August 1 this year around a slogan that has stupendous significance for
China as well as for the whole world. This year Chinese toilers inaugu-
rated an unprecedented liberation movement on August 1, a movement that
is designed evidently to repulse further attacks from imperialism, es-
pecially from Japanese imperialism.

On August 1 nearly all the foreign papers at Shanghai published the
basic programme of the Chinese people in a war against Japan with brief
explanations and editorial notes. The day has become the signal of the
declaration of war on Japanese imperialism by the Chinese people who,
led by the toilers, will push it vigorously until Japanese imperialism is
driven out and Chinese territory recovered.(See below).

Reliable information emanating from the usual source states that on
August 1 Soviet China carried out a general mobilization for a positive
war against Japanese imperialism, believing that such a step is indispen-
sable in fighting for real peace in the Far East, against an imperialist
war over the Pacific, for the defence of the Chinese nation against ad-
vancing Japanese imperialism. Monster demonstrations of such a nature
accordingly took place in Soviet China with the participation of mil-
lions of Chinese toilers whose interest has been jeopardized by uninter-
rupted aggressions of Japanese imperialism and threatened by the coming
imperialist war. Thus in observance of the day Soviet China embarked on
a noble undertaking that will finally liberate China from the fetters of
imperialism and KMT.

In this connection, of added significance is the victory of the red
army just mentioned. Thanks to the heroism of the red fighters Soviet
China witnessed on August 1 the collapse of Chiang Kai-shek's eastern
front defended by no less than 200,000 troops of Chiang's crack units.
At the same time the north, west and south fronts of the KMT bandits in
the encircling campaign are shaking before the charges of the red army.
The red army has accomplished more than half of its task in breaking the
5th drive of imperialism and KMT up to the present time. Consequently,
August 1, 1934, is worth more to Chinese toilers and Chinese Soviets than
any similar date in the past.

In KMT China toilers observed the day in a different manner but with
no less enthusiasm. Here in Shanghai demonstrations took place in the in-
dustrial centres in east and west Shanghai. Handbills and revolutionary
literature were distributed freely among the working masses. Speeches
were delivered by worker-leaders at mass meetings against the oppression
and exploitation of imperialism and KMT which was increased as the econo-
mic crisis in China deepened, against the KMT surrender and betrayal, etc.
Workers succeeded in forming groups of several hundred each for meetings
and demonstrations.

In the crowded streets of Shanghai anti-war literature was freely dis-
tributed and freely accepted by the masses in spite of the police cor-
dons of KMT-imperialism. Following the day with greater interest this
year no doubt due to the approach of the threatened imperialist war the
masses at Shanghai lined the thoroughfares, waiting to take a glance at
the anti-war demonstration. Some people loitered hours in places where
the demonstration was supposed to take place. They eagerly grabbed at the
literature offered them. Police officers failed to clear the street of
the loiters. And many regretted to come late, too late to meet the anti-
war parade.

THE ARMED SELF DEFENCE MOVEMENT GROWS RAPIDLY
...............................

In our last number we have printed the basic program of the Chinese
people in a war against Japan together with the news relating thereto.
As time goes on, the movement rapidly gains ground among the Chinese mas-
ses who hate the KMT betrayal more than ever. The movement is of course
is yet in its infancy but it has possibilities beyond the imagination
of the oppressors and reactionaries.

今年，国民党统治区和苏维埃中国的中国劳苦大众围绕着一个对中国乃至全世界都具有巨大意义的口号庆祝了八月一日。今年，中国劳苦大众在八月一日发起了一场前所未有的解放运动，这场运动显然旨在击退帝国主义的进一步进攻，特别是日本帝国主义的进攻。

8月1日，上海几乎所有的外文报纸都刊登了中国人民抗日的基本纲领，并附有简要说明和社论注释。这一天已成为中国人民向日本帝国主义宣战的信号，在劳动者的领导下，中国人民将 vigorously 推进这一行动，直到将日本帝国主义驱逐出境并收复中国领土。（见下文）。

来自通常可靠来源的消息指出，8月1日，苏维埃中国进行了全面动员，以对日本帝国主义发动积极战争，认为这一步骤对于争取远东的真正和平、反对太平洋上的帝国主义战争、保卫中华民族免受 advancing 的日本帝国主义侵害是必不可少的。因此，苏维埃中国举行了此类性质的盛大示威，数百万中国劳苦大众参与其中，他们的利益因日本帝国主义的不间断侵略而受到损害，并受到即将到来的帝国主义战争的威胁。因此，为了纪念这一天，苏维埃中国开始了一项崇高的事业，最终将使中国从帝国主义和国民党的枷锁中解放出来。

与此相关，前述红军的胜利具有额外的意义。得益于红色战士的英勇，苏维埃中国在8月1日见证了蒋介石东线的崩溃，该防线由不少于20万人的蒋介石精锐部队防守。与此同时，国民党匪军在“围剿”中的北、西、南战线在红军的冲锋面前动摇。截至目前，红军已完成打破帝国主义和国民党第五次“围剿”任务的一半以上。因此，1934年8月1日对中国劳苦大众和中国苏维埃来说，比过去任何类似的日子都更有价值。

在国民党统治区，劳苦大众以不同的方式但同样热情地纪念这一天。在上海，示威活动发生在上海东部和西部的工业中心。传单和革命文献在工人群众中自由分发。工人在群众集会上由工人领袖发表演讲，反对随着中国经济危机加深而加剧的帝国主义和国民党的压迫与剥削，反对国民党的投降和背叛等。工人们成功组建了数百人一组的小队，用于集会和示威。

在上海拥挤的街道上，尽管有国民党-帝国主义的警察封锁线，反战文献仍被自由分发并被群众自由接受。今年，由于受到威胁的帝国主义战争临近，人们无疑以更浓厚的兴趣关注这一天，上海的群众挤满街道，等待瞥一眼反战示威。一些人在预计举行示威的地方徘徊数小时。他们急切地抓取提供给他们的文献。警察未能清除街道上的滞留者。许多人遗憾来得太晚，没能赶上反战游行。

武装自卫运动迅速增长
...............................

在我们上一期中，我们刊登了中国人民抗日的基本纲领以及相关新闻。随着时间的推移，这场运动在痛恨国民党背叛甚于以往的中国群众中迅速获得支持。当然，这场运动仍处于萌芽阶段，但它拥有压迫者和反动派无法想象的可能性。

3
the only means 'to save the nation' (read: to save themselves). As the movement makes considerable headway, the K T chiefs are panic-stricken, including Chiang Kai-shek and Wang Chin-wei who are holding a conference at Ku-lin; to sell more of China to Japan in order to check the growth of the movement. But Chinese toilers as the backbone of the movement will see to it that the K T chiefs who have signed away Chinese territory one piece after another be barred from further betrayal of a similar nature. The armed self defence movement can play a big role in this direction.

The First Block:

There is definite evidence that the Kuomintang has undertaken to block the armed self defence movement of the people at the very beginning. It shall be recalled that on August 1 the Chinese press at Shanghai published no news whatsoever concerning the movement, much less to print the basic programme of the Chinese people in a war against Japan which embodies six fundamental points. Nor was published the statement of the preparatory committee of the national council of the Chinese armed self defence, a statement that gives the reasons why a war of the Chinese people against Japan is possible, shattering the illusions of those who have placed faith in international treaties and imperialist powers for the defence of China.

Undoubtedly, some of the Chinese papers as the China Times is in the direct pay of Chiang Kai-shek while others such as the Shun Pao are owned by compradors, lackeys of imperialism. They will under no circumstances give any space to news that condemns the capitulation of Nanking. But there are papers that try to maintain a nationalist attitude but keep silent on the movement due to the rigid censorship of the Kuomintang. At the very outset the Kuomintang, we are informed from authoritative sources, decided to nip the movement in its bud by placing a ban on it, depriving the people of the opportunity to know anything about it. The Kuomintang called out the entire detective force to hunt for those behind the movement. The first martyrs as far as we know are comrades Yu Chi-chun, etc, the sole charge brought against them being their association with the armed self defence movement. The Kuomintang has issued orders to the papers forbidding to publish any news regarding the movement. The dirty KT has blackmailed those patriots and revolutionaries that stand behind the programme of the Chinese people in a war against Japan.

Here, more palpably than ever has the KT come out in the open to defend the interests of Japanese imperialism. It has led the fascists, compradors, landlords, capitalists (even including the national bourgeoisie) in a ruthless war on the people who dare to speak or act against Japan in defiance of the KT's interdiction. Decapitation as meted out by Chiang Kai-shek to those who still talk about resistance to Japan is more rigidly enforced as the movement for armed self defence progresses rapidly.

In Defiance of the KT

Despite the persecution of the Kuomintang in the interest of Japanese imperialism Chinese masses can no longer be cowed and intimidated by words or deeds of the treacherous Kuomintang. Standing in the van of the movement are Chinese workers, peasants, city-poor and advanced intellectuals who push the movement ahead with vigor. Chinese patriots rally around the new movement in increasing numbers. Now under the banner of the armed self defence thousands have added their signatures in additional to the original 3,000 promoters including Madame Sun Yat-sen (Soong Chin-lin), Madame Liao Chun-kai, General Li Tu, etc. Dozens of anti-Japanese associations have sprung into existence in defiance of the KT suppression, nay, have done valuable work for the expansion of the movement.

On 6 ins. General Li Tu gave a reception to pressmen of foreign papers outlining the policy of the Chinese people in a war against Japan, explaining the motives of the war, clarifying the practical measures adopted to that end, answering the questions put to him, etc. All papers of foreign ownership at Shanghai published the interview of Gen. Li in some detail but not the Chinese press which again remained silent due to the tightening hand of the KT censor. Gen. Li's explanation made a very good impression on those present although it was later found that some of his points were purposely distorted by certain reporters in the defence of imperialism. Of course imperialist-owned papers can hardly remain neutral in such a matter as China's armed self defence, but fully utilizing the opportunity,

3
唯一的“救国”手段（即：拯救他们自己）。随着运动取得相当大的进展，国民党头目们惊慌失措，包括正在古林（Ku-lin，音译）举行会议的蒋介石和汪精卫；他们为了遏制运动的增长，不惜将更多的中国利益出卖给日本。但是，作为运动中坚力量的中国劳苦大众将确保那些已一片片割让中国领土的国民党头目无法再进行类似的背叛。武装自卫运动在这方面可以发挥巨大作用。

第一街区：

有确凿证据表明，国民党从一开始就着手阻挠人民的武装自卫运动。回想起来，8月1日，上海中文报刊没有刊登任何关于该运动的新闻，更不用说刊登中国人民对日作战的基本纲领，该纲领包含六个基本要点。全国武装自卫委员会筹备处的声明也未予发表，该声明阐述了中国人民对日战争之所以可能的原因，打破了那些寄希望于国际条约和帝国主义列强来保卫中国的人的幻想。

毫无疑问，像《中国时报》（China Times）这样的一些中文报纸直接受雇于蒋介石，而另一些如《申报》则由买办——帝国主义的走狗——所有。它们绝不会为谴责南京投降的新闻提供任何版面。但也有一些报纸试图保持民族主义态度，但由于国民党的严厉审查，对该运动保持沉默。据权威消息来源告知，国民党在最初就决定通过禁止该运动将其扼杀在萌芽状态，剥夺人民了解该运动的任何机会。国民党出动全部侦探力量搜捕运动背后的支持者。据我们所知，首批烈士是俞启纯（Yu Chi-chun，音译）等同志，对他们的唯一指控是与武装自卫运动有关联。国民党已向各报馆发布命令，禁止刊登任何关于该运动的新闻。肮脏的国民党勒索那些支持中国人民对日作战纲领的爱国者和革命者。

在此，国民党比以往任何时候都更公开地站出来维护日本帝国主义的利益。它带领法西斯分子、买办、地主、资本家（甚至包括民族资产阶级）对那些敢于违抗国民党禁令、发表反日言论或采取反日行动的人民发动了残酷的战争。随着武装自卫运动的迅速发展，蒋介石对仍谈论抗日者实施的斩首处决执行得更为严酷。

违抗国民党

尽管国民党为了日本帝国主义的利益进行迫害，但中国民众再也不能被卖国贼国民党的言行所吓倒和恐吓。站在运动前列的是中国工人、农民、城市贫民和进步知识分子，他们有力地推动着运动向前发展。越来越多的中国爱国者聚集在新运动的周围。现在，在武装自卫的旗帜下，除了原有的3000名发起人（包括孙逸仙夫人[宋庆龄]、廖仲恺夫人、李杜将军等）之外，又有成千上万的人签名加入。数十个抗日协会不顾国民党的镇压应运而生，不，它们还为运动的扩展做了有价值的工作。

本月6日，李杜将军接见了外文报纸记者，概述了中国人民对日作战的政策，解释了战争的动机，阐明了为此采取的实际措施，并回答了向他提出的问题等。上海所有外资拥有的报纸都详细刊登了李将军的访谈，但中文报纸再次保持沉默，这是由于国民党审查机构收紧了控制。李将军的解释给在场者留下了很好的印象，尽管后来发现，他的某些观点被某些记者故意歪曲，以维护帝国主义。当然，帝国主义拥有的报纸在中国武装自卫这样的问题上很难保持中立，但它们充分利用了这一机会，
