Gen. Li (commander of a section of the Chinese forces against Japan in
Manchuria, 1931-1933) went far enough in emphasizing that the Chinese
people have resolved to fly at the throat of Japanese imperialism at all
costs and got ready to plunge into the war of their own initiative and
with their own resources without fear of the modern weapons of Japan
and the treacherous acts of her agents in China, referring to Chiang Kai-
shek, Wang Chin-wei and the whole bunch of the Kuomintang.

Six Points Reiterated

While the new movement is spreading in all directions in the whole
country, reaching even the farthest corners of China, despite the sabo-
tage of the Kuomintang, it may be of interest to reiterate the famous
six points as embodied in the programme, all agreed to by the leaders
as well as the ranks and files of the movement. The following is the six
points in a nutshell.

(1) Mobilization of all the forces on land and sea and in air in a
war against Japanese imperialism, estimated at a strength of about 3,000,
000 men and officers, (2) mobilization of the whole body of people, or-
ganization of various volunteer armies, (3) arming the people with weapons
from all sources, (4) financing the war by confiscating all Japanese
owned enterprises in China amounting to $2,000,000,000 at the present
rate of exchange, confiscating the property of all traitors, earmarking
the national revenue for the war, collecting a progressive tax, solicit-
ing money from within as well as without the country, from foreign sym-
pathizers, too, (5) formation of a national council for armed self de-
fence as the supreme organ directing all activities connected with the
war on Japan, consisting of delegates chosen by workers, peasants, sol-
diers, merchants, students, etc, (6) alliance with the enemies of Japan-
ese imperialism.

Following the promulgation of the programme just cited a declaration
over the signature of the preparatory committee of the national council
for armed self defence was issued calling on the nation to arise at once
for the defence of the country which is precisely on the point of break-
down in the face of imperialist aggressions with the aid of the Kuomintang.
Instead of defending the country as supposed to do, the KMT has given e-
very facility to Japan in her further attacks on China and, for this rea-
son, incurred the high displeasure of the people. Now the angered people
take the lead in the movement for armed self defence of their own accord.

WORKERS LIFE IN SOVIET CHINA
............

Workers in Soviet China are leading a life never dreamt of in other
parts of the country thanks to the protection of the Soviet government
set up by the workers themselves. With the rigid enforcement of labour
law by the Soviet government considerable betterment in the lot of the
working masses has become a reality. The eight hour law, the social insu-
rance, the increase in pay (e.g., rise from $2.00 to $20.00 a month in
Tingchow, Fukien), the collective bargaining, etc, are all conducive to
the amelioration. In every case the Soviet government and trade unions
come to the aid of the workers in a counter-attack against the offensive
of capital such as wage-cut, ill-treatment, etc. Woman-worker is placed
on an absolutely equal footing with men. Her life has likewise improved.
During my visit to the central printing office a woman worker was observ-
ed in the act of feeding her one year old baby with milk, such feeding re-
peated several times a day, all with pay. Young workers have also obtain-
ed better conditions of work, e.g., six hour-day, etc.

The Question of Unemployment

Unemployment which has positively refused to move downward either in
Soviet China or in the advanced capitalist countries is no longer a serious
question to be dealt with. The development of production in Soviet China
at an accelerated pace helps greatly and speedily in solving the problem
of unemployment. Only a small fraction of the working population finds no
regular jobs as a result of the migration of workers from the countryside
to the town. Peasants, women and men, rush for the city while urban enter-
prises have failed to absorb them all owing to the slow tempo of develop-
ment (hindered by the KMT's 5th campaign). The government gives them relief.

李将军（1931-1933年中国东北抗日部队某部指挥官）极力强调，中国人民决心不惜一切代价掐住日本帝国主义的喉咙，并准备依靠自己的主动性和资源投入战争，不惧怕日本的现代武器及其在华代理人——指蒋介石、汪精卫及整个国民党团伙——的背叛行为。

重申六点

尽管遭到国民党的破坏，新运动仍在整个国家四面八方蔓延，甚至到达中国最偏远的角落，此时重述纲领中著名的六点或许令人感兴趣，这六点得到了运动领导层以及普通成员的一致同意。以下是这六点的概要。

(1) 动员所有陆、海、空力量参加对日帝国主义战争，估计兵力约为3,000,000人；(2) 动员全体人民，组织各种志愿军；(3) 用各种来源的武器武装人民；(4) 通过没收在华所有日资企业（按当前汇率计算达20亿美元）、没收所有汉奸财产、指定国家财政收入用于战争、征收累进税、向国内外（包括外国同情者）募捐来为战争融资；(5) 成立全国武装自卫委员会，作为指导所有对日战争相关活动的最高机构，由工人、农民、士兵、商人、学生等选出的代表组成；(6) 与日本帝国主义的敌人结盟。

在上述纲领颁布后，全国武装自卫委员会筹备处签署了一份宣言，呼吁全国人民立即奋起保卫国家，因为国家在帝国主义的侵略和国民党的协助下正面临崩溃的边缘。国民党非但没有履行其应有的保国职责，反而为日本进一步攻击中国提供了一切便利，因此招致了人民的极大不满。现在，愤怒的人民自发地带头开展武装自卫运动。

苏维埃中国的工人生活
............

由于工人自己建立的苏维埃政府的保护，苏维埃中国的工人过着该国其他地区做梦也想不到的生活。随着苏维埃政府严格执行劳动法，广大劳动群众的境遇得到了切实改善。八小时工作制、社会保险、工资增加（例如，福建汀州从每月2.00美元涨至20.00美元）、集体谈判等，都有助于这种改善。在每一种情况下，苏维埃政府和工会都在反击资本的进攻（如削减工资、虐待等）时援助工人。女工被置于与男子完全平等的地位。她的生活也同样得到了改善。在我访问中央印刷厂期间，观察到一名女工正在给其一岁的婴儿喂奶，这种喂奶每天重复数次，且照常支付工资。青年工人也获得了更好的工作条件，例如六小时工作日等。

失业问题

无论是在苏维埃中国还是在先进的资本主义国家，失业率都坚决拒绝下降，但这不再是一个需要处理的严重问题。苏维埃中国生产的加速发展极大地并迅速地帮助解决了失业问题。只有极少部分的劳动人口因工人从农村迁移到城镇而找不到固定工作。男女农民涌向城市，而由于发展缓慢（受到国民党第五次围剿的阻碍），城市企业未能全部吸收他们。政府向他们提供救济。

Owing to the fact that the workers themselves run the government, the wage earners in Soviet China are placed in a privileged position, enjoying such privileges as freedom of strike against capital with the protection of the Soviet government, etc. The workers organised their own unions with a large membership. Workers employed in the state enterprises have almost joined the unions in a body as in the state printing office. In every factory there are workers' clubs, Leninist rooms, ball fields, wall papers, illustrated papers, etc. Workers may, of course, hold meetings from time to time, aided sometimes by the government who has in the past given rooms for meetings. Needless to say, full freedom of speech is enjoyed by the workers.

A Contrast to KMT China

The workers under the Soviets provide a sharp contrast with those in the KMT-controlled China so far as their life is concerned. In white China the workers lead a life of dogs, always placed on the starvation line.

The workers in Soviet China are distinguished in another respect: the development of creative power. They have shown marvellous initiative and creative power. They support the Soviet government with the greatest possible proletarian vigor and energy. Their cadres have filled the leading positions in the government and army. The All China Federation of Labour has, for example, mobilized a host of cadres for the expansion of the red army.

The wonderful creative power of the workers under the Soviets is shown by the following examples. The workers in the arsenals can turn out new weapons just as good as those made by machine--rifles, guns, mines, etc, which are all of good quality. The printing workers not only attend to duties assigned to them but at the same time make good ink for printing. This ink proves just as good as the imported from imperialist countries. Printing by hand in Soviet China proves an entire success in comparison with machine work. Paper making has shown great strides. In connection with mimeograph many new inventions have come to the foreground such as the manufacture of double paper in place of the stencil paper, of a new type of carbon paper, etc.

Even the most backward peasant and peasant women who come from the village may master the technique in the mills and factories in a short space of time. Besides, the workers take a great pleasure in the work laid before them. They have all shown an eagerness for work, desiring to accomplish the work ahead of schedule time. For instance, the workers finished the construction of the building for the II Soviet congress far ahead of time. All workers in the state enterprises want to work extra hours in addition to the regular hours (The state arsenal, mint, printing office, etc).

Bond Subscription

In connection with the bonds issued by the Soviet government for economic reconstruction the workers have displayed an enthusiasm almost unequalled. They bought the bonds in a rush, realising that the bonds will contribute largely towards the betterment in their own lot besides as a result of economic reconstruction, realising, too, that the bonds bought will provide enough money for the shattering of the 5th campaign of imperialism and Kuomintang. Undoubtedly, the latter consideration afforded a greater stimulus to the rush of the workers for taking up the bonds, as the 5th drive threatens to wipe out all the benefits conquered by them in the course of revolution.

As to the struggles of the workers going on in KMT China the toiling masses under the Soviets have done their best in helping their brothers oppressed by KMT and imperialism. They deserve special merit in assisting the extension of the red army.

It goes without saying that the workers in Soviet China have displayed and still display the greatest positive militancy in the work for the Soviets as well as for themselves. The fact that they lead and operate the Soviets is in itself a mighty factor in placing the worker on a higher level both as to ability to work and enthusiasm to work. Both the Soviets and unions, it may be said with reason, are a better type of schools for the workers in a political as well as in a technical sense. By going through these schools the workers can score success in the political and technical

由于工人自己管理政府，苏维埃中国的工薪阶层处于特权地位，享有在苏维埃政府保护下对资本进行罢工自由等特权。工人们组织了自己的工会，会员人数众多。在国家企业受雇的工人几乎全体加入了工会，如在国家印刷厂即是如此。每个工厂都有工人俱乐部、列宁室、球场、墙报、画报等。工人们当然可以不时举行会议，有时得到政府的协助，政府过去曾提供会议室。不用说，工人们享有充分的言论自由。

与国民党统治下的中国形成对比

就生活而言，苏维埃政权下的工人与国民党控制下的中国工人形成了鲜明对比。在“白色中国”，工人们过着牛马不如的生活，始终处于饥饿线上。

苏维埃中国的工人在另一个方面也很突出：创造力的发展。他们表现出了非凡的主动性和创造力。他们以最大的无产阶级活力和精力支持苏维埃政府。他们的干部占据了政府和军队的领导职位。例如，中华全国总工会动员了大量干部以扩充红军。

苏维埃政权下工人惊人的创造力体现在以下例子中。兵工厂的工人能够制造出与机器制造的一样好的新武器——步枪、枪支、地雷等，且质量优良。印刷工人不仅履行分配给他们的职责，同时还制造优质的印刷油墨。这种油墨被证明与从帝国主义国家进口的油墨一样好。与机器作业相比，苏维埃中国的手工印刷取得了完全的成功。造纸业也取得了巨大进步。在与油印相关的领域，许多新发明脱颖而出，例如制造双层纸以代替蜡纸，以及新型复写纸等。

即使是来自农村的最落后的农民和农妇，也能在短时间内掌握磨坊和工厂的技术。此外，工人们从摆在面前的工作中获得极大的乐趣。他们都表现出对工作的渴望，希望提前完成工作。例如，工人们远远提前完成了第二次苏维埃代表大会会场建筑的建设。所有国有企业（如国家兵工厂、造币厂、印刷厂等）的工人都希望在正常工作时间之外加班。

债券认购

关于苏维埃政府为经济重建而发行的债券，工人们表现出了几乎无与伦比的热情。他们争相购买债券，认识到这些债券除了有助于经济重建外，还将大大改善他们自身的境遇；同时也认识到，购买债券将为粉碎帝国主义和国民党的第五次“围剿”提供足够的资金。毫无疑问，后一种考虑更加刺激了工人们抢购债券的热情，因为第五次“围剿”威胁要抹杀他们在革命过程中赢得的所有成果。

至于国民党统治下中国正在进行的工人斗争，苏维埃政权下的劳苦大众已竭尽全力帮助被国民党和帝国主义压迫的兄弟阶级。他们在协助扩大红军方面功绩卓著。

不用说，苏维埃中国的工人已经并继续在为苏维埃以及为他们自己的工作中表现出最大的积极战斗性。他们领导和管理苏维埃这一事实本身，就是一个强大的因素，使工人在工作能力和工作热情方面都提升到更高的水平。可以说，无论是从政治意义上还是技术意义上讲，苏维埃和工会都是更好的工人学校。通过在这些学校中学习，工人们可以在政治和技术

fields.

COMMERCE AND FINANCE IN SOVIET CHINA
....................

Having given an account of the development in production in Soviet China in our previous numbers, now we come to commerce and finance under the Soviets. The Soviets have, it shall be recalled, proclaimed freedom of trade within its borders but this very proclamation implies a certain measure of reorientation on the part of the Soviet government on lines designed to strengthen the position of the government vis-a-vis private traders, especially the profiteers.

Trade More Under Control

In the present situation the government takes a hand in the development of trade with the outside world. With this end in view the government has established the foreign trade bureau helping by all means the merchants engaged in trade with Non-Soviet regions. Blows are thus directed against the economic embargo of the enemy. It accounts for the conclusion of an agreement with the defunct people's government in Fukien respecting trade which was considered one of the main points in the anti-Japanese and anti-Chiang Kai-shek concordat.

Foreign trade, if well developed along lines decided on by the government, may certainly have obviated the difficulties standing in the way of the people's livelihood. At the same time the government has defined the freedom of trade by clear-cut legislation with a view to further expansion of commerce. But restrictions are imposed on the manipulation and exploitation of the unscrupulous merchants and kulaks.

Under such conditions commerce in general has been on the upgrade movement, even on a higher level than the pre-revolutionary period, to the surprise of the outside world. This statement applies to the countryside as well as to the town except where the enemy's blockade is operating with some effect.

Financial Conditions

Turning to finance and currency, the same upgrade movement is observed. The state bank of the central government has opened branches in provincial capitals and cities (Juilin) with a strong likelihood to establish more in future. Thus, an imposing system of state banks is already in existence.

The notes issued by the central bank have a high prestige among the masses and are generally accepted in regions under the Soviet jurisdiction. These notes are well covered by cash reserves turned out by the state mint. Now two silver coins are in circulation: the dollar piece and 20¢ pieces. Recently, in response to actual needs a new copper coin worth 5¢ has appeared on the market,

Of late the central bank began to receive deposits from the masses no matter how small they are.

Return of Bonds

As reported before, the bonds of the Soviet government were over-subscribed by the masses out of the desire to aid the government in carrying on economic reconstruction as well as breaking the 5th drive of the enemy. The bonds, as is known to every one, are secured on nothing other than the credit of the government which is exceedingly good among the masses, unlike the bonds of the Kuomintang which can not be sold unless secured on reliable revenue.

Later on several hundred thousand dollars in bonds were, however, returned to the government out of a desire to support it with something more substantial. Of their own accord the masses initiated a campaign for the return of the bonds to help the government tide over temporary financial difficulties. As far as my personal knowledge goes, a multitude of workers and red soldiers handed back the bonds bought before. One soldier of the 5th corps who had served in the white army and bought the bonds with his small savings of some thirty dollars returned the bonds to the
pages.zh:
6
领域取得成功。

苏维埃中国的商业与金融
....................

在前几期中，我们已经叙述了苏维埃中国生产发展的情况，现在我们来谈谈苏维埃政权下的商业与金融。应当回顾的是，苏维埃在其境内宣布了贸易自由，但这一宣言本身就意味着苏维埃政府在旨在加强政府相对于私人商人（尤其是投机商）地位的方针上进行了某种程度的调整。

贸易受到更多控制

在目前的情况下，政府插手对外贸易的发展。为此目的，政府设立了对外贸易局，千方百计帮助从事与非苏维埃地区贸易的商人。从而打击敌人的经济封锁。这也解释了为何与福建已灭亡的人民政府达成贸易协定，该协定被视为反蒋抗日协定的主要要点之一。

如果按照政府决定的方针良好发展，对外贸易肯定可以避免阻碍人民生计的困难。同时，政府通过明确的立法界定了贸易自由，以进一步扩展商业。但是，对无良商人和富农的操纵和剥削施加了限制。

在这种情况下，整体商业一直处于上升趋势，甚至达到了革命前时期的更高水平，令外界感到惊讶。这一说法适用于农村和城市，除非敌人的封锁在某些地方产生了一定效果。

金融状况

转向金融和货币方面，也观察到了同样的上升趋势。中央政府国家银行已在省会和城市（瑞金）开设分行，未来很有可能开设更多分行。因此，一个庞大的国家银行体系已经存在。

中央银行发行的钞票在群众中享有很高威望，并在苏维埃管辖地区普遍被接受。这些钞票有由国家造币厂生产的现金储备作为充分担保。目前流通两种银币：一元币和二十分币。最近，出于实际需要，一种价值五分的新型铜币出现在市场上。

近来，中央银行开始接受群众的存款，无论金额多么微小。

退还债券

如前所述，出于帮助政府进行经济重建以及打破敌人第五次“围剿”的愿望，群众超额认购了苏维埃政府的债券。众所周知，这些债券除了依靠政府的信用外没有任何担保，而政府在群众中的信用极好，这与国民党的债券不同，后者若无可靠税收作为担保便无法出售。

然而，后来有数十万美元的债券被退还给政府，这是出于用更实质性的东西支持政府的愿望。群众自发发起了一场退还债券的运动，以帮助政府渡过暂时的财政困难。据我个人所知，许多工人和红军战士退回了以前购买的债券。第五军团的一名士兵，曾在白军服役，用他大约三十美元的小额积蓄购买了债券，他面带微笑地将债券退还给了

pages.en:
7
state only with a smile on his face. Likewise a postman who made some sav-
ings through long years in the post service also returned the bonds with-
out a murmur. Such examples are found among a vast multitude of men, wo-
men and youths who offer everything including their life for the defence
of the Soviets.

Taxation on a New Principle

The principle of taxation under the Soviets is based on greater exac-
tions from the exploiting classes. Taking the principle as a basis, the
Soviet policy of taxation aims at the enforcement of a progressive tax
which weighs heavier on the exploiters. In another respect the tax sche-
dule was revised to meet the demand for more revenue. Increase in the ex-
portation of commodities from the Soviet regions and absorption of cash from
this source have also entered into the consideration of the government in
revising the new tax schedules.

At the same time the government keeps an eye on the activities of the
counterrevolutionaries engaged in the sabotage of Soviet currency and fi-
nance. In fact, it punishes such activities severely as soon as discover-
ed. Waste, extravagance and corruption are things strictly watched by the
government. A ruthless struggle has been waged against waste and corrup-
tion, and an economy campaign in governmental expense launched. Besides,
a strict auditing system has been instituted, checking all governmental ex-
penses with the budget at hand. All these factors have played their part in
the 'sanisierung' of Soviet finances.

Of course commerce and finance, like all other branches of national
economy, are matters falling within the jurisdiction of the department of
national economy newly set up under the people's council. The department
makes a study of the problems connected therewith and elaborates the plans
for development.

Soviet Communications

Communications under the Soviets have improved considerably with far
more efficiency than the KMT system which is caught in corruption and in-
efficiency. In spite of the lack of planes, locomotives and steamboats the
Soviet rail system has fair progress, linking the central districts with o-
ther regions lying far away, regions that have been cut off by the KMT ban-
dit troops. In certain localities rail traffic has been restored with the
KMT controlled districts. Express delivery is promptly effected within a
short space of time.

Wireless communications, though still confined to military use, have
made long strides. The telephone service covers a wide area. Long distance
telephone is also in operation. The construction of highways connecting
the urban and rural districts, building up wide roads (motor roads) on
narrow paths, is another achievement of the Soviets in the field of commu-
nications. Hundreds of unknown miles of motor roads have been complet-
ed under the Soviet building programme. Yet more and far more are to be
built up under the direction of the commissariat of internal affairs.

By the way it shall be mentioned that the Soviets have devoted con-
siderable attention to sanitation and hospitals. Many modern hospitals have
sprung up at the Red capital, Juikin, for civilians and wounded soldiers.

Were it not for the enemy's economic blockade, economic improvement in
Soviet China would have been far greater and more amazing. But the present
status of economic development under the direction of the Soviets shows con-
clusively that the Soviets have so far demonstrated its ability to build
up an entirely new economy on the ruins of the old demolished by the revo-
lutionary forces of the Soviets.

7
国家。同样，一名通过多年邮政服务积攒了一些储蓄的邮递员也毫无怨言地退回了债券。在无数男女青年中都可以找到这样的例子，他们为保卫苏维埃奉献了一切，包括生命。

基于新原则的税收

苏维埃政权下的税收原则是基于对剥削阶级征收更多的税款。以此原则为基础，苏维埃的税收政策旨在实行累进税制，使剥削者承担更重的税负。另一方面，修订了税目表以满足增加收入的需求。苏维埃地区商品出口的增加以及由此来源吸收现金，也是政府修订新税目表时的考虑因素。

同时，政府密切关注从事破坏苏维埃货币和金融的反革命分子的活动。事实上，一旦发现此类活动，即予以严厉惩罚。浪费、奢侈和腐败是政府严格监控的事项。政府开展了反对浪费和腐败的无情斗争，并发起了政府开支节约运动。此外，还建立了严格的审计制度，根据现有预算核查所有政府开支。所有这些因素都在苏维埃财政的“净化”（sanisierung）中发挥了作用。

当然，商业和金融像国民经济的其他部门一样，属于人民委员会下设的新成立的国民经济部的管辖范围。该部研究与这些问题相关的问题，并制定发展计划。

苏维埃的交通通讯

苏维埃政权下的交通通讯有了显著改善，效率远高于陷入腐败和低效的国民党系统。尽管缺乏飞机、火车头和轮船，苏维埃铁路系统仍取得了不错的进展，将中心区与其他遥远地区连接起来，而这些地区此前已被国民党匪军切断。在某些地方，与国民党控制区的铁路交通已恢复。快递服务能在短时间内迅速完成。

无线通信虽然仍限于军事用途，但已取得长足进步。电话服务覆盖范围广。长途电话也已开通。连接城乡地区的公路建设，即在狭窄小径上修建宽阔道路（汽车路），是苏维埃在交通通讯领域的另一项成就。在苏维埃建设计划下，数百英里未知的汽车路已完工。然而，在内务人民委员部的指导下，还将修建更多且更长的道路。

顺便提一下，苏维埃非常重视卫生和医院建设。在红色首都瑞金，为平民和受伤士兵兴建了许多现代化医院。

如果不是因为敌人的经济封锁，苏维埃中国的经济改善将会更大、更令人惊叹。但是，目前在苏维埃指导下的经济发展状况 conclusively 表明，苏维埃迄今为止已证明其有能力在旧经济被苏维埃革命力量摧毁的废墟上建立全新的经济。

结 束

SWEEPING SUCCESS OF RED ARMY IN FUKIEN

According to the press advices published by foreign papers at Shanghai the red army has won an overwhelming victory over the Kuomintang bandits in Fukien, occupying Shanghang, Lienchen, Tingyang, Changping in south Fukien, Sahsien, Juchi, Yinron, Tatien in central Fukien, Tingping and Kutien in north Fukien. Thus the red army took some ten hsiens, crushing the enemy as it advanced. When reaching the environs of Shuikou, a strategic point on the Min River 40 miles from Foochow (capital of Fukien province), 500 garrison came out to meet the advancing red army with open hands, giving it a warm reception. Then they joined the ranks of the red army unconditionally.

Messages from the same source placed the booty of the red army at more than 10,000 rifles in a single engagement, 21 military trucks and an uncounted large quantity of ammunitions. The Kuomintang bandit army is entirely demoralized before the onslaught of the victorious red army. As a result, the KMT eastern front (meaning Fukien) collapsed to the consternation of the imperialists who, as reported in our last issue, hurried warships to Foochow menaced by the approaching red army.

The debacle of the KMT in Fukien serves a fresh impetus to more capitulation of Nanking to Japanese imperialism. The KMT bandit chief, Chiang Kai-shek, now hastily calls a conference attended by Wang Chin-wei (a leftist of the Kuomintang), prime minister; Huang Fu, chief of the Peiping political council; and a number of other high personages of the Kuomintang who are well versed in the art of handing over China to Japanese imperialism. In quarters close to Nanking officialdom it is said that the conference scheduled at Kuling (a summer resort for imperialists and representatives of the Chinese finance and bourgeoisie) will decide to cede more Chinese territory and concede rights to Japanese imperialism.

The country as a whole is especially indignant over further betrayal of the Kuomintang and rallies to the call of the national council of the Chinese people in a war against Japan. All traitors of the Chinese nation from Chiang Kai-shek down must have but a short life to live if the armed self defence movement forces ahead at the present speed.

红军在福建的巨大胜利

根据上海外文报纸发布的新闻消息，红军在福建击败了国民党匪帮，取得了压倒性胜利，占领了闽南的上杭、连城、汀阳、长平，闽中的沙县、尤溪、永荣、大田，以及闽北的延平和古田。因此，红军攻克了约十个县，并在进军过程中粉碎了敌人。当抵达距福州（福建省会）40英里的战略要地水口附近时，500名驻军敞开双手出来迎接进军的红军，给予热烈欢迎。随后他们无条件加入了红军队伍。

来自同一来源的消息称，红军在一次战斗中缴获的战利品包括超过10,000支步枪、21辆军用卡车以及数量巨大的弹药。国民党匪军在胜利红军的攻势面前士气完全瓦解。结果，国民党东线（指福建）崩溃，令帝国主义者惊惶失措，正如我们在上一期中报道的那样，他们急忙将军舰派往受到逼近红军威胁的福州。

国民党在福建的溃败进一步推动了南京向日本帝国主义投降。国民党匪首蒋介石现在匆忙召开了一次会议，出席者包括总理汪精卫（国民党左派）、北平政务委员会委员长黄郛，以及其他多位精通将中国出卖给日本帝国主义艺术的国民党高层人物。据接近南京官场的人士称，计划在牯岭（帝国主义者和中国金融界及资产阶级代表的避暑胜地）召开的会议将决定向日本帝国主义割让更多中国领土并出让权利。

全国上下对国民党的进一步背叛行为尤其愤慨，并响应中国人民全国委员会号召，投入抗日战争。如果武装自卫运动以目前的速度推进，从蒋介石以下的所有中华民族叛徒的日子都将屈指可数。

Chinese toilers both in Kuomintang China and Soviet China observed
August 1 this year around a slogan that has stupendous significance for
China as well as for the whole world. This year Chinese toilers inaugu-
rated an unprecedented liberation movement on August 1, a movement that
is designed evidently to repulse further attacks from imperialism, es-
pecially from Japanese imperialism.

On August 1 nearly all the foreign papers at Shanghai published the
basic programme of the Chinese people in a war against Japan with brief
explanations and editorial notes. The day has become the signal of the
declaration of war on Japanese imperialism by the Chinese people who,
led by the toilers, will push it vigorously until Japanese imperialism is
driven out and Chinese territory recovered.(See below).

Reliable information emanating from the usual source states that on
August 1 Soviet China carried out a general mobilization for a positive
war against Japanese imperialism, believing that such a step is indispen-
sable in fighting for real peace in the Far East, against an imperialist
war over the Pacific, for the defence of the Chinese nation against ad-
vancing Japanese imperialism. Monster demonstrations of such a nature
accordingly took place in Soviet China with the participation of mil-
lions of Chinese toilers whose interest has been jeopardized by uninter-
rupted aggressions of Japanese imperialism and threatened by the coming
imperialist war. Thus in observance of the day Soviet China embarked on
a noble undertaking that will finally liberate China from the fetters of
imperialism and KMT.

In this connection, of added significance is the victory of the red
army just mentioned. Thanks to the heroism of the red fighters Soviet
China witnessed on August 1 the collapse of Chiang Kai-shek's eastern
front defended by no less than 200,000 troops of Chiang's crack units.
At the same time the north, west and south fronts of the KMT bandits in
the encircling campaign are shaking before the charges of the red army.
The red army has accomplished more than half of its task in breaking the
5th drive of imperialism and KMT up to the present time. Consequently,
August 1, 1934, is worth more to Chinese toilers and Chinese Soviets than
any similar date in the past.

In KMT China toilers observed the day in a different manner but with
no less enthusiasm. Here in Shanghai demonstrations took place in the in-
dustrial centres in east and west Shanghai. Handbills and revolutionary
literature were distributed freely among the working masses. Speeches
were delivered by worker-leaders at mass meetings against the oppression
and exploitation of imperialism and KMT which was increased as the econo-
mic crisis in China deepened, against the KMT surrender and betrayal, etc.
Workers succeeded in forming groups of several hundred each for meetings
and demonstrations.

In the crowded streets of Shanghai anti-war literature was freely dis-
tributed and freely accepted by the masses in spite of the police cor-
dons of KMT-imperialism. Following the day with greater interest this
year no doubt due to the approach of the threatened imperialist war the
masses at Shanghai lined the thoroughfares, waiting to take a glance at
the anti-war demonstration. Some people loitered hours in places where
the demonstration was supposed to take place. They eagerly grabbed at the
literature offered them. Police officers failed to clear the street of
the loiters. And many regretted to come late, too late to meet the anti-
war parade.

THE ARMED SELF DEFENCE MOVEMENT GROWS RAPIDLY
............................

In our last number we have printed the basic program of the Chinese
people in a war against Japan together with the news relating thereto.
As time goes on, the movement rapidly gains ground among the Chinese mass-
es who hate the KMT's betrayal more than ever. The movement is of course
is yet in its infancy but it has potentialities beyond the imagination
of the defeatists and traitors who prefer unconditional capitulation as

无论是国民党统治下的中国还是苏维埃中国的劳工，今年8月1日都围绕着一个对中国乃至全世界具有巨大意义的口号进行了纪念。今年，中国劳工于8月1日发起了一场前所未有的解放运动，这场运动显然旨在击退帝国主义的进一步进攻，特别是日本帝国主义的进攻。

8月1日，上海几乎所有的外文报纸都刊登了中国人民对日作战的基本纲领，并附有简要说明和社论注释。这一天已成为中国人民向日本帝国主义宣战的信号，在劳工的领导下，中国人民将 vigorously 推进这一战争，直到将日本帝国主义驱逐出境并收复中国领土。（见下文）。

来自惯常渠道的可靠消息指出，8月1日，苏维埃中国为对日本帝国主义进行积极战争实施了总动员，认为此举对于争取远东的真正和平、反对跨越太平洋的帝国主义战争、以及保卫中华民族免受 advancing 的日本帝国主义侵害是不可或缺的。因此，苏维埃中国举行了此类性质的盛大示威，数百万中国劳工参与其中，他们的利益因日本帝国主义不间断的侵略而受到损害，并受到即将到来的帝国主义战争的威胁。因此，为纪念这一天，苏维埃中国投身于一项崇高的事业，最终将使中国从帝国主义和国民党的枷锁中解放出来。

与此相关，前述红军的胜利具有额外的重大意义。得益于红色战士的英勇，苏维埃中国在8月1日见证了蒋介石东线的崩溃，该防线由不少于20万人的蒋介石精锐部队防守。与此同时，国民党匪徒在围剿战役中的北、西、南各战线在红军的冲锋下摇摇欲坠。截至目前，红军在打破帝国主义和国民党的第五次“围剿”中已完成过半任务。因此，1934年8月1日对中国劳工和中国苏维埃而言，比过去任何类似的日子都更有价值。

在国民党统治下的中国，劳工以不同的方式纪念这一天，但热情丝毫未减。在上海，示威活动发生在上海东部和西部的工业中心。传单和革命文献在工人群众中自由分发。工运领袖在群众集会上发表演讲，反对随着中国经济危机加深而加剧的帝国主义和国民党的压迫与剥削，反对国民党的投降与背叛等。工人们成功组建了数百人一组的小队，用于集会和示威。

尽管有国民党-帝国主义的警察封锁线，反战文献仍在上海拥挤的街道上自由分发，并被民众自由接受。今年，无疑由于迫在眉睫的帝国主义战争威胁，民众对这一天的关注度更高，上海民众聚集在主要街道两旁，等待瞥一眼反战示威。一些人在预计举行示威的地方徘徊数小时。他们急切地抓取递给他们的文献。警察未能清除街道上的闲散人员。许多人遗憾来得太晚，没能赶上反战游行。

武装自卫运动迅速发展
............................

在我们上一期中，我们刊登了中国人民对日作战的基本纲领以及相关消息。随着时间的推移，这场运动在痛恨国民党背叛甚于以往的中国民众中迅速获得支持。当然，这场运动仍处于萌芽阶段，但它所具有的潜力超出了那些偏好无条件投降作为

the only means 'to save the nation' (read: to save themselves). As the movement makes considerable headway, the K T chiefs are panic-strucken, including Chiang Kai-shek and Tang Chin-wei who are holding a conference at Kuling to sell more of China to Japan in order to check the growth of the movement. But Chinese toilers as the backbone of the movement will see to it that the K T chiefs who have signed away Chinese territory one piece after another be barred from further betrayal of a similar nature. The armed self defence movement can play a big role in this direction.

The First Block

There is definite evidence that the Kuomintang has undertaken to block the armed self defence movement of the people at the very beginning. It shall be recalled that on August 1 the Chinese press at Shanghai published no news whatsoever concerning the movement, much less to print the basic programme of the Chinese people in a war against Japan which embodies six fundamental points. Nor was published the statement of the preparatory committee of the national council of the Chinese armed self defence, a statement that gives the reasons why a war of the Chinese people against Japan is possible, shattering the illusions of those who have pinned faith in international treaties and imperialist powers for the defence of China.

Undoubtedly, some of the Chinese papers as the China Times is in the direct pay of Chiang Kai-shek while others such as the Shun Pao are owned by compradors, lackeys of imperialism. They will under no circumstances give any space to news that condemns the capitulation of Nanking. But there are papers that try to maintain a nationalist attitude but keep silent on the movement due to the rigid censorship of the Kuomintang. At the very outset the Kuomintang, we are informed from authoritative sources, decided to nip the movement in its bud by placing a bar on it, depriving the people of the opportunity to know anything about it. The Kuomintang called out the entire detective force to hunt for those behind the movement. The first martyrs as far as we know are comrades Yu Chi-chun, etc, the sole charge brought against them being their association with the armed self defence movement. The Kuomintang has issued orders to the papers forbidding to publish any news regarding the movement. The dirty KT has blackmailed those patriots and revolutionaries that stand behind the programme of the Chinese people in a war against Japan.

Here, more palpably than ever has the KT come out in the open to defend the interests of Japanese imperialism. It has led the fascists, compradors, landlords, capitalists (even including the national bourgeoisie) in a ruthless war on the people who dare to speak or act against Japan in defiance of the KT's interdiction. Decapitation as meted out by Chiang Kai-shek to those who still talk about resistance to Japan is more rigidly enforced as the movement for armed self defence progresses rapidly.

In Defiance of the KT

Despite the persecution of the Kuomintang in the interest of Japanese imperialism Chinese masses can no longer be cowed and intimidated by words or deeds of the treacherous Kuomintang. Standing in the van of the movement are Chinese workers, peasants, city-poor and advanced intellectuals who push the movement ahead with vigor. Chinese patriots rally around the new movement in increasing numbers. Now under the banner of the armed self defence thousands have added their signatures in additional to the original 3,000 promoters including Madam Sun Yat-sen (Soong Chin-lin), Madam Liao Chun-kai, General Li Tu, etc. Dozens of anti-Japanese associations have sprung into existence in defiance of the KT suppression, nay, have done valuable work for the expansion of the movement.

On 6 ins. General Li Tu gave a reception to pressmen of foreign papers outlining the policy of the Chinese people in a war against Japan, explaining the motives of the war, clarifying the practical measures adopted to that end, answering the questions put to him, etc. All papers of foreign ownership at Shanghai published the interview of Gen. Li in some detail but not the Chinese press which again remained silent due to the tightening hand of the KT censors. Gen. Li's explanation made a very good impression on those present although it was later found that some of his points were purposely distorted by certain reporters in the defence of imperialism. Of course imperialist-minded persons can hardly remain neutral in such a matter as China's armed self defence. But fully utilizing the opportunity
pages.zh:
3
唯一“救国”手段（即：自救）的失败主义者和叛徒的想象。随着运动取得相当大的进展，国民党头目们惊慌失措，包括正在庐山开会以便向中国出卖更多利益给日本以遏制运动增长的蒋介石和唐钦韦（音译）。但是，作为运动中坚力量的中国劳工将确保那些已逐一签署割让中国领土的国民党头目无法再进行类似的背叛。武装自卫运动在这方面可以发挥重要作用。

第一道封锁

有确凿证据表明，国民党从一开始就着手封锁人民的武装自卫运动。值得回顾的是，8月1日，上海中文报纸没有刊登任何关于该运动的新闻，更不用说刊登体现六个基本要点的中国人民对日作战基本纲领了。全国武装自卫委员会筹备委员会的声明也未获刊登，该声明阐述了中国人民对日战争之所以可能的原因，打破了那些迷信国际条约和帝国主义列强能保卫中国的人的幻想。

毫无疑问，像《时报》（China Times）这样的一些中文报纸直接受雇于蒋介石，而另一些如《申报》（Shun Pao）则由买办——帝国主义的走狗——拥有。它们绝不会提供任何版面来谴责南京的投降。但也有一些报纸试图保持民族主义立场，但由于国民党的严格审查，对该运动保持沉默。据权威消息来源告知，国民党在一开始就决定通过禁止该运动将其扼杀在萌芽状态，剥夺人民了解该运动的任何机会。国民党出动全部侦探力量搜捕运动背后的人员。据我们所知，首批烈士是余启俊（音译）同志等人，对他们的唯一指控是与武装自卫运动有关联。国民党已向各报馆发布命令，禁止刊登任何关于该运动的新闻。肮脏的国民党勒索那些支持中国人民对日作战纲领的爱国者和革命者。

在此，国民党比以往任何时候都更公开地站出来维护日本帝国主义的利益。它带领法西斯分子、买办、地主、资本家（甚至包括民族资产阶级）对敢于违抗国民党禁令发表反日言论或采取反日行动的人民发动无情战争。随着武装自卫运动的迅速发展，蒋介石对那些仍谈论抗日者实施的斩首刑罚执行得更为严厉。

无视国民党

尽管国民党为了日本帝国主义的利益进行迫害，但中国民众再也不能被奸诈国民党的言行所吓倒和恐吓。站在运动前列的是中国工人、农民、城市贫民和进步知识分子，他们有力地推动运动向前发展。越来越多的中国爱国者聚集在新运动周围。现在，在武装自卫的旗帜下，除了原有的3000名发起人（包括孙逸仙夫人[宋庆龄]、廖仲恺夫人、李杜将军等）外，又有成千上万的人签名加入。数十个抗日协会无视国民党的镇压应运而生，不，它们还为运动的扩展做了有价值的工作。

本月6日，李杜将军接见了外文报纸记者，概述了中国人民对日作战的政策，解释了战争动机，阐明了为此采取的实际措施，回答了向他提出的问题等。上海所有外资拥有的报纸都详细刊登了李将军的访谈，但中文报纸再次保持沉默，这是由于国民党审查官收紧了控制。李将军的解释给在场者留下了很好的印象，尽管后来发现，出于维护帝国主义的目的，某些记者故意歪曲了他的部分观点。当然，具有帝国主义思想的人在中国武装自卫这样的问题上很难保持中立。但充分利用这一机会

Gen. Li (commander of a section of the Chinese forces against Japan in
Manchuria, 1931-1933) went far enough in emphasizing that the Chinese
people have resolved to fly at the throat of Japanese imperialism at all
costs and got ready to plunge into the war of their own initiative and
with their own resources without fear of the modern weapons of Japan
and the treacherous acts of her agents in China, referring to Chiang Kai-
shek, Tang Chin-wei and the whole bunch of the Kuomintang.

Six Points Reiterated

While the new movement is spreading in all directions in the whole
country, reaching even the farthest corners of China, despite the sabo-
tage of the Kuomintang, it may be of interest to reiterate the famous
six points as embodied in the programme, all agreed to by the leaders
as well as the ranks and files of the movement. The following is the six
points in a nutshell:

(1) Mobilization of all the forces on land and sea and in air in a
war against Japanese imperialism, estimated at a strength of about 3,000,
000 men and officers, (2) mobilization of the whole body of people, or-
ganization of various volunteer armies, (3) arming the people with weapons
from all sources, (4) financing the war by confiscating all Japanese
owned enterprises in China amounting to $2,000,000,000 at the present
rate of exchange, confiscating the property of all traitors, earmarking
the national revenue for the war, collecting a progressive tax, solicit-
ing money from within as well as without the country, from foreign sym-
pathizers, too, (5) formation of a national council for armed self de-
fence as the supreme organ directing all activities connected with the
war on Japan, consisting of delegates chosen by workers, peasants, sol-
diers, merchants, students, etc, (6) alliance with the enemies of Japan-
ese imperialism.

Following the promulgation of the programme just cited a declaration
over the signature of the preparatory committee of the national council
for armed self defence was issued calling on the nation to arise at once
for the defence of the country which is precisely on the point of break-
down in the face of imperialist aggressions with the aid of the Kuomintang.
Instead of defending the country as supposed to do, the KMT has given e-
very facility to Japan in her further attacks on China and, for this rea-
son, incurred the high displeasure of the people. Now the angered people
take the lead in the movement for armed self defence of their own accord.

WORKERS LIFE IN SOVIET CHINA
............

Workers in Soviet China are leading a life never dreamt of in other
parts of the country thanks to the protection of the Soviet government
set up by the workers themselves. With the rigid enforcement of labour
law by the Soviet government considerable betterment in the lot of the
working masses has become a reality. The eight hour law, the social insu-
rance, the increase in pay (e.g., rise from $2.00 to $20.00 a month in
Tingchow, Fukien), the collective bargaining, etc, are all conducive to
the amelioration. In every case the Soviet government and trade unions
come to the aid of the workers in a counter-attack against the offensive
of capital such as wage-cut, ill-treatment, etc. Woman-worker is placed
on an absolutely equal footing with men. Her life has likewise improved.
During my visit to the central printing office a woman worker was observ-
ed in the act of feeding her one year old baby with milk, such feeding re-
peated several times a day, all with pay. Young workers have also obtain-
ed better conditions of work, e.g., six hour-day, etc.

The Question of Unemployment

Unemployment which has positively refused to move downward either in
Soviet China or in the advanced capitalist countries is no longer a serious
question to be dealt with. The development of production in Soviet China
at an accelerated pace helps greatly and speedily in solving the problem
of unemployment. Only a small fraction of the working population finds no
regular jobs as a result of the migration of workers from the countryside
to the towns. Besides, when the city while urban enter-
prises have absorbed a large number of workers, the government gives them relief.

李将军（1931-1933年间在中国东北抗击日军的某部中国军队指挥官）极力强调，中国人民已决心不惜一切代价扼住日本帝国主义的咽喉，并准备依靠自身力量主动投入战争，无所畏惧于日本的现代化武器及其在华代理人的背叛行径，此处所指代理人即蒋介石、唐钦伟（音译）以及整个国民党团伙。

重申六点纲领

尽管遭到国民党的破坏，新运动仍在全国各地蔓延，甚至波及中国最偏远的角落。在此之际，重申该运动领袖及基层成员一致同意的著名六点纲领，或许颇有意思。这六点概要如下：

(1) 动员所有陆海空力量进行反对日本帝国主义的战争，估计兵力约为300万人；(2) 动员全体民众，组织各类志愿军；(3) 利用各种来源的武器装备民众；(4) 通过没收在华所有日资企业（按当前汇率计算约合20亿美元）、没收所有汉奸财产、划拨国家财政收入用于战争、征收累进税、向国内外（包括外国同情者）募捐等方式筹措战费；(5) 成立全国武装自卫委员会，作为指导对日作战相关一切活动的最高机构，其代表由工人、农民、士兵、商人、学生等选举产生；(6) 与日本帝国主义的敌人结盟。

在上述纲领颁布后，以全国武装自卫委员会筹备委员会名义签署发表了一份宣言，呼吁全国人民立即奋起保卫国家，因为国家在帝国主义侵略及国民党协助下面临崩溃边缘。国民党本应保卫国家，却为日本进一步攻击中国提供了一切便利，因此招致民众的强烈不满。如今，愤怒的人民自发地带头开展武装自卫运动。

苏维埃中国的工人生活
............

得益于工人自己建立的苏维埃政府的保护，苏维埃中国的工人过着该国其他地区难以想象的生活。随着苏维埃政府严格执行劳动法，广大劳动群众的境遇得到了切实改善。八小时工作制、社会保险、工资增加（例如福建汀州从每月2.00美元涨至20.00美元）、集体谈判等，均有助于改善状况。在每一次反击资本进攻（如削减工资、虐待等）的行动中，苏维埃政府和工会都给予工人援助。女工享有与男子完全平等的地位，她们的生活同样得到了改善。在我参观中央印刷厂期间，观察到一名女工正在给其一岁的婴儿喂奶，这种哺乳每天进行数次，且期间照付工资。青年工人的工作条件也得到了改善，例如实行六小时工作制等。

失业问题

无论是在苏维埃中国还是在先进的资本主义国家，失业率都坚决拒绝下降，但这已不再是一个需要处理的严重问题。苏维埃中国生产的加速发展极大地并迅速地帮助解决了失业问题。只有极少部分的劳动人口因从农村迁移到城镇而找不到固定工作。此外，当城市及城市企业吸收了大量工人时，政府会向他们提供救济。

pages.en:
Owing to the fact that the workers themselves run the government, the
wage earners in Soviet China are placed in a privileged position, enjoy-
ing such privileges as freedom of strike against capital with the protec-
tion of the Soviet government, etc. The workers organised their own unions
with a large membership. Workers employed in the state enterprises have
almost joined the unions in a body as in the state printing office. In e-
very factory there are workers' clubs, Leninist rooms, ball fields, wall
papers, illustrated papers, etc. Workers may, of course, hold meetings from
time to time, aided sometimes by the government who has in the past giv-
en rooms for meetings. Needless to say, full freedom of speech is enjoy-
ed by the workers.

A Contrast to KMT China

The workers under the Soviets provide a sharp contrast with those in
the KMT-controlled China so far as their life is concerned. In white Chi-
na the workers lead a life of dogs, always placed on the starvation line.

The workers in Soviet China are distinguished in another respect: the
development of creative power. They have shown marvellous initiative and
creative power. They support the Soviet government with the greatest pos-
sible proletarian vigor and energy. Their cadres have filled the leading
positions in the government and army. The All China Federation of Labour
has, for example, mobilized a host of cadres for the expansion of the red
army.

The wonderful creative power of the workers under the Soviets is shown
by the following examples. The workers in the arsenals can turn out new
weapons just as good as those made by machine---rifles, guns, mines, etc,
which are all of good quality. The printing workers not only attend to du-
ties assigned to them but at the same time make good ink for printing. This
ink proves just as good as that imported from imperialist countries. Print-
ing by hand in Soviet China proves an entire success in comparison with
machine work. Paper making has shown great strides. In connection with mi-
meograph many new inventions have come to the foreground such as the manu-
facture of double paper in place of the stencil paper, of a new type of
carbon paper, etc.

Even the most backward peasant and peasant women who come from the
village may master the technique in the mills and factories in a short
space of time. Besides, the workers take a great pleasure in the work laid
before them. They have all shown an eagerness for work, desiring to accom-
plish the work ahead of schedule time. For instance, the workers finished
the construction of the building for the II Soviet congress far ahead of
time. All workers in the state enterprises want to work extra hours in
addition to the regular hours (The state arsenal, mint, printing office,
etc).

Bond Subscription

In connection with the bonds issued by the Soviet government for eco-
nomic reconstruction the workers have displayed an enthusiasm almost un-
equalled. They bought the bonds in a rush, realising that the bonds will
contribute largely towards the betterment in their own lot as a re-
sult of economic reconstruction, realising, too, that the bonds bought
will provide enough money for the shattering of the 5th campaign of impe-
rialism and Kuomintang. Undoubtedly, the latter consideration afforded a
greater stimulus to the rush of the workers for taking up the bonds, as
the 5th drive threatens to wipe out all the benefits conquered by them
in the course of revolution.

As to the struggles of the workers going on in KMT China the toiling
masses under the Soviets have done their best in helping their brothers
oppressed by KMT and imperialism. They deserve special merit in assisting
the extension of the red army.

It goes without saying that the workers in Soviet China have displayed
and still display the greatest possible militancy in the work for the So-
viets as well as for themselves. The fact that they lead and operate the
Soviets is in itself a mighty factor in placing the worker on a higher le-
vel both as to ability to work and willingness to work. Both the Soviets
and unions, it may be said with reason, are a better type of schools for the
workers in a broad sense as well as in a technical sense by giving them
what is usually the monopoly of the ruling classes in the political and tech-

由于政府由工人自己管理，苏维埃中国的工薪阶层处于特权地位，享有诸如在苏维埃政府保护下自由罢工反对资本等特权。工人们组织了拥有大量会员的工会。在国家企业工作的工人几乎全体加入了工会，如在国家印刷厂的情况一样。每个工厂都有工人俱乐部、列宁室、球场、墙报、画报等。工人当然可以不时举行会议，有时由政府协助，政府过去曾提供会议室。毫无疑问，工人享有充分的言论自由。

与国民党统治下的中国形成对比

就生活而言，苏维埃政权下的工人与国民党控制下的中国工人形成了鲜明对比。在“白色中国”，工人们过着狗一样的生活，始终处于饥饿线上。

苏维埃中国的工人在另一个方面也很突出：创造力的发展。他们表现出了非凡的主动性和创造力。他们以最大的无产阶级活力和精力支持苏维埃政府。他们的干部占据了政府和军队的领导职位。例如，中华全国总工会已动员大批干部以扩充红军。

以下事例展示了苏维埃政权下工人奇妙的创造力。兵工厂的工人能够制造出与机器制造的一样好的新武器——步枪、枪支、地雷等，且质量优良。印刷工人不仅履行分配给他们的职责，同时还制作优质的印刷油墨。这种油墨被证明与从帝国主义国家进口的油墨一样好。与机器作业相比，苏维埃中国的手工印刷取得了完全的成功。造纸业也取得了巨大进步。在与油印相关的领域，许多新发明脱颖而出，例如制造双层纸以替代蜡纸、新型复写纸等。

即使是最落后的来自乡村的农民和农妇，也能在短时间内掌握磨坊和工厂的技术。此外，工人们从摆在面前的工作中获得极大乐趣。他们都表现出对工作的渴望，希望提前完成工作。例如，工人们远早于预定时间完成了第二次苏维埃代表大会大楼的建设。所有国家企业（如国家兵工厂、造币厂、印刷厂等）的工人都希望在正常工作时间之外加班。

债券认购

在认购苏维埃政府为经济重建而发行的债券方面，工人们表现出了几乎无与伦比的热情。他们争相购买债券，认识到这些债券将因经济重建而大大改善他们自身的境遇，同时也认识到购买债券将为粉碎帝国主义和国民党的第五次“围剿”提供足够的资金。毫无疑问，后一种考虑更加刺激了工人抢购债券的热情，因为第五次“围剿”威胁要抹杀他们在革命过程中赢得的所有利益。

至于国民党统治下中国正在进行的工人斗争，苏维埃政权下的劳苦大众已竭尽全力帮助受国民党和帝国主义压迫的兄弟阶级。他们在协助扩充红军方面功绩卓著。

不用说，苏维埃中国的工人在为苏维埃以及为自己工作的过程中，已经并继续表现出尽可能高的战斗性。他们领导和管理苏维埃这一事实本身，就是一个强大的因素，使工人在工作能力和工作意愿方面都提升到更高水平。可以说，无论是从广义还是技术意义上讲，苏维埃和工会都是更好的工人学校，因为它们给予了工人通常在政治和技术上为统治阶级所垄断的东西

6
fields.

COMMERCE AND FINANCE IN SOVIET CHINA
....................

Having given an account of the development in production in Soviet China in our previous numbers, now we come to commerce and finance under the Soviets. The Soviets have, it shall be recalled, proclaimed freedom of trade within its borders but this very proclamation implies a certain measure of reorientation on the part of the Soviet government on lines designed to strengthen the position of the Government vis-a-vis private traders, especially the profiteers.

Trade More Under Control

In the present situation the government takes a hand in the development of trade with the outside world. With this end in view the government has established the foreign trade bureau helping by all means the merchants engaged in trade with Non-Soviet regions. Blows are thus directed against the economic embargo of the enemy. It accounts for the conclusion of an agreement with the defunct people's government in Fukien respecting trade which was considered one of the main points in the anti-Japanese and anti-Chiang Kai-shek concordat.

Foreign trade, if well developed along lines decided on by the government, may certainly have obviated the difficulties standing in the way of the people's livelihood. At the same time the government has defined the freedom of trade by clear-cut legislation with a view to further expansion of commerce. But restrictions are imposed on the manipulation and exploitation of the unscrupulous merchants and kulaks.

Under such conditions commerce in general has been on the upgrade movement, even on a higher level than the pre-revolutionary period, to the surprise of the outside world. This statement applies to the countryside as well as to the town except where the enemy's blockade is operating with some effect.

Financial Conditions

Turning to finance and currency, the same upgrade movement is observed. The state bank of the central government has opened branches in provincial capitals and cities (Fukien) with a strong likelihood to establish more in future. Thus, an imposing system of state banks is already in existence.

The notes issued by the central bank have a high prestige among the masses and are generally accepted in regions under the Soviet jurisdiction. These notes are well covered by cash reserves turned out by the state mint. Now two silver coins are in circulation: the dollar piece and 20¢ pieces. Recently, in response to actual needs a new copper coin worth 5¢ has appeared on the market.

Of late the central bank began to receive deposits from the masses no matter how small they are.

Return of Bonds

As reported before, the bonds of the Soviet government were over-subscribed by the masses out of the desire to aid the government in carrying on economic reconstruction as well as breaking the 5th drive of the enemy. The bonds, as is known to every one, are secured on nothing other than the credit of the government which is exceedingly good among the masses, unlike the bonds of the Kuomintang which can not be sold unless secured on reliable revenue.

Later on several hundred thousand dollars in bonds were, however, returned to the government out of a desire to support it with something more substantial. Of their own accord the masses initiated a campaign for the return of the bonds to help the government tide over temporary financial difficulties. As far as my personal knowledge goes, a multitude of workers and red soldiers handed back the bonds bought before. One soldier of the 5th corps who had served in the white army and bought the bonds with his grand savings of some thirty dollars returned the bonds to the
pages.zh:
6
领域。

苏维埃中国的商业与金融
....................

在前几期中，我们已叙述了苏维埃中国生产方面的发展，现在我们来谈谈苏维埃政权下的商业与金融。须回顾的是，苏维埃已宣布在其境内实行贸易自由，但这一宣言本身就意味着苏维埃政府在政策上进行了某种程度的调整，旨在加强政府相对于私人商贩、尤其是投机商人的地位。

贸易受到更多管控

在当前形势下，政府介入对外贸易的发展。为此目的，政府设立了对外贸易局，竭尽全力帮助从事与非苏维埃地区贸易的商人。此举旨在打击敌人的经济封锁。这也解释了为何与已不复存在的福建人民政府达成贸易协定，该协定被视为反蒋抗日协定的主要要点之一。

如果按照政府决定的路线良好发展，对外贸易无疑可以消除阻碍人民生计的困难。同时，政府通过明确的立法界定了贸易自由，以进一步促进商业扩张。但对无良商人和富农的操纵与剥削行为施加了限制。

在此条件下，整体商业呈现上升趋势，甚至达到了革命前时期以上的水平，令外界感到惊讶。这一说法适用于农村和城镇，除非在敌人封锁产生一定效果的地方。

金融状况

转向金融与货币领域，同样观察到上升趋势。中央政府国家银行已在各省省会和城市（福建）开设分行，且未来极有可能增设更多分行。因此，一个庞大的国家银行体系已经存在。

中央银行发行的钞票在群众中享有崇高威望，并在苏维埃管辖区域内被普遍接受。这些钞票有由国家造币厂生产的现金储备作为充分担保。目前流通两种银币：一元币和二十分币。最近，出于实际需要，一种价值五分的新型铜币出现在市场上。

近来，中央银行开始接受群众存款，无论金额多么微小。

债券退还

如前所述，出于希望协助政府进行经济建设以及打破敌人第五次“围剿”的愿望，群众超额认购了苏维埃政府债券。众所周知，这些债券仅以政府信用为担保，而政府在群众中的信用极佳，这与国民党债券不同，后者若无可靠税收作保便无法出售。

然而，后来有数十万美元的债券被退还给政府，这是出于希望以更实质性的方式支持政府的愿望。群众自发发起了一场退还债券的运动，以帮助政府渡过暂时的财政困难。就我个人所知，众多工人和红军战士交回了此前购买的债券。第五军团的一名士兵，曾在白军服役，用其积攒的约三十美元购买了债券，他面带微笑地将债券退还给

pages.en:
7
state only with a smile on his face. Likewise a postman who made some sav-
ings through long years in the post service also returned the bonds with-
out a murmur. Such examples are found among a vast multitude of men, wo-
men and youths who offer everything including their life for the defence
of the Soviets.
Taxation on a New Principle
The principle of taxation under the Soviets is based on greater exac-
tions from the exploiting classes. Taking the principle as a basis, the
Soviet policy of taxation aims at the enforcement of a progressive tax
which weighs heavier on the exploiters. In another respect the tax sche-
dule was revised to meet the demand for more revenue. Increase in the ex-
portation of commodities from the Soviet regions and absorption of cash from
this source have also entered into the consideration of the government in
revising the new tax schedules.

At the same time the government keeps an eye on the activities of the
counterrevolutionaries engaged in the sabotage of Soviet currency and fi-
nance. In fact, it punishes such activities severely as soon as discover-
ed. Waste, extravagance and corruption are things strictly watched by the
government. A ruthless struggle has been waged against waste and corrup-
tion, and an economy campaign in governmental expense launched. Besides,
a strict auditing system has been instituted, checking all governmental ex-
penses with the budget at hand. All these factors have played their part in
the 'sanisierung' of Soviet finances.

Of course commerce and finance, like all other branches of national
economy, are matters falling within the jurisdiction of the department of
national economy newly set up under the people's council. The department
makes a study of the problems connected therewith and elaborates the plans
for development.
Soviet Communications
Communications under the Soviets have improved considerably with far
more efficiency than the KMT system which is caught in corruption and in-
efficiency. In spite of the lack of planes, locomotives and steamboats the
Soviet mail system has fair progress, linking the central districts with o-
ther regions lying far away, regions that have been cut off by the KMT ban-
dit troops. In certain localities mail traffic has been restored with the
KMT controlled districts. Express delivery is promptly effected within a
short space of time.

Wireless communications, though still confined to military use, have
made long strides. The telephone service covers a wide area. Long distance
telephone is also in operation. The construction of highways connecting
the urban and rural districts, building up wide roads (motor roads) on
narrow paths, is another achievement of the Soviets in the field of commu-
nications. Hundreds of motor roads miles of motor roads have been complet-
ed under the Soviet building programme. Yet more and far more are to be
built up under the direction of the commissariat of internal affairs.

By the way it shall be mentioned that the Soviets have devoted con-
siderable attention to sanitation and hospitals. Many modern hospitals have
sprung up at the Red capital, Juikin, for civilians and wounded soldiers.

Were it not for the enemy's economic blockade, economic improvement in
Soviet China would have been far greater and more amazing. But the present
status of economic development under the direction of the Soviets shows con-
clusively that the Soviets have so far demonstrated its ability to build
up an entirely new economy on the ruins of the old demolished by the revo-
lutionary forces of the Soviets.

国家。同样，一名在邮政服务多年并有所积蓄的邮递员也毫无怨言地退回了债券。在无数男女青年中都能找到这样的例子，他们为保卫苏维埃奉献一切，包括生命。

基于新原则的税收

苏维埃的税收原则基于对剥削阶级征收更重的税赋。以此原则为基础，苏维埃的税收政策旨在实施累进税制，使剥削者承担更重的税负。另一方面，修订税则以满足增加收入的需求。苏维埃地区商品出口的增加以及由此来源吸收现金，也是政府在修订新税则时考虑的因素。

同时，政府密切关注从事破坏苏维埃货币和金融活动的反革命分子。事实上，此类活动一经发现即受严惩。浪费、奢侈和腐败受到政府的严格监控。政府开展了反对浪费和腐败的无情斗争，并发起了节约政府开支的运动。此外，建立了严格的审计制度，根据现有预算核查所有政府开支。所有这些因素都在苏维埃财政的“整顿”（sanisierung）中发挥了作用。

当然，商业和金融同国民经济的其他部门一样，属于人民委员会下新设的国民经济部的管辖范围。该部研究与这些问题相关的事项，并制定发展计划。

苏维埃的交通通讯

苏维埃下的交通通讯有了显著改善，效率远高于陷入腐败和低效的国民党系统。尽管缺乏飞机、火车头和轮船，苏维埃邮政系统仍取得了良好进展，将中心区与遥远的其他地区连接起来，而这些地区此前已被国民党匪军切断。在某些地方，与国民党控制区的邮件往来已恢复。快递服务在短时间内迅速完成。

无线通信虽仍限于军事用途，但已取得长足进步。电话服务覆盖广泛区域。长途电话也已开通。连接城乡地区的公路建设，即在狭窄小径上修建宽阔道路（机动车道），是苏维埃在交通领域的另一项成就。在苏维埃建设计划下，数百英里长的机动车道已完工。在内务人民委员部的指导下，还将修建更多道路。

顺便提一下，苏维埃对卫生和医院给予了相当多的关注。在红色首都瑞金，为平民和伤兵建立了许多现代化医院。

若不是敌人的经济封锁，苏维埃中国的经济改善本会更大、更令人惊叹。但目前在苏维埃指导下的经济发展状况确凿地表明，苏维埃迄今已证明其有能力在旧经济被苏维埃革命力量摧毁的废墟上建立起全新的经济。

SWEEPING SUCCESS OF RED ARMY IN FUKIEN

According to the press advices published by foreign papers at Shanghai
the red army has won an overwhelming victory over the Kuomintang bandits
in Fukien, occupying Shanghang, Lienchen, Ningyang, Changping in south
Fukien, Sahsien, Juchi, Ningon, Tatien in central Fukien, Yingping and Ku-
tien in north Fukien. Thus the red army took some ten hsiens, crushing the
enemy as it advanced. When reaching the environs of Shuikow, a strategic
point on the Min River 40 miles from Foochow (capital of Fukien province),
500 garrison came out to meet the advancing red army with open hands, giv-
ing it a warm reception. Then they joined the ranks of the red army uncon-
ditionally.

Messages from the same source placed the booty of the red army at more
than 10,000 rifles in a single engagement, 21 military trucks and an un-
counted large quantity of ammunitions. The Kuomintang bandit army is en-
tirely demoralized before the onslaught of the victorious red army. As a
result, the 19th eastern front (meaning Fukien) collapsed to the consterna-
tion of the imperialists who, as reported in our last issue, hurried war-
ships to Foochow menaced by the approaching red army.

The debacle of the KMT in Fukien serves fresh impetus to more capi-
tulation of Nanking to Japanese imperialism. The KMT bandit chief, Chiang
Kai-shek, now hastily calls a conference attended by Wang Chin-wei (a left-
ist of the Kuomintang), prime minister; Huang Fu, chief of the Peiping po-
litical council; and a number of other high personages of the Kuomintang
who are well versed in the art of handing over China to Japanese imperial-
ism. In quarters close to Nanking officialdom it is said that the confer-
ence scheduled at Kuling (a summer resort for imperialists and representa-
tives of the Chinese Tycoons and bourgeoisie) will decide to cede more
Chinese territory and economic rights to Japanese imperialism.

The country as a whole is generally indignant over further betrayal of
the Kuomintang and rallies to the call of the national council of the Chi-
nese people in a war against Japan. All traditions of the Chinese nation
Chiang Kai-shek does not have but a short life to live if the armed self
defence movement forges ahead at the present speed.

根据上海外文报纸发布的新闻消息，红军在福建击败了国民党匪军，取得了压倒性胜利，占领了闽南的上杭、连城、宁洋、长平，闽中的沙县、尤溪、宁冈、大田，以及闽北的延平和古田。因此，红军攻克了约十个县，并在进军过程中击溃敌军。当抵达距离福州（福建省会）40英里的闽江战略要地水口附近时，500名守军出来张开双臂迎接进军的红军，给予热烈欢迎。随后他们无条件加入了红军队伍。

来自同一来源的消息称，红军在一次战斗中缴获的战利品包括超过10,000支步枪、21辆军用卡车以及数量巨大的弹药。在胜利红军的猛攻面前，国民党匪军士气完全崩溃。结果，第十九路军东线（指福建）崩溃，令帝国主义者惊恐万分，正如我们在上一期中报道的那样，他们急忙派遣军舰前往受到逼近红军威胁的福州。

国民党在福建的溃败进一步推动了南京向日本帝国主义投降。国民党匪首蒋介石现在匆忙召开了一次会议，出席者包括总理汪精卫（国民党左派）、北平政务委员会委员长黄郛，以及其他许多精通将中国出卖给日本帝国主义艺术的国民党高层人物。在南京官场内部人士中流传的说法是，计划在牯岭（帝国主义者和中国大亨及资产阶级代表的避暑胜地）召开的会议将决定向日本帝国主义割让更多中国领土和经济权利。

全国上下对国民党的进一步背叛普遍感到愤怒，并响应中国人民抗日国会的号召，投入对日战争。如果武装自卫运动以目前的速度推进，没有中华民族任何传统的蒋介石将命不久矣。

Chinese toilers both in Kuomintang China and Soviet China observed
August 1 this year around a slogan that has stupendous significance for
China as well as for the whole world. This year Chinese toilers inaugu-
rated an unprecedented liberation movement on August 1, a movement that
is designed evidently to repulse further attacks from imperialism, es-
pecially from Japanese imperialism.

On August 1 nearly all the foreign papers at Shanghai published the
basic programme of the Chinese people in a war against Japan with brief
explanations and editorial notes. The day has become the signal of the
declaration of war on Japanese imperialism by the Chinese people who,
led by the toilers, will push it vigorously until Japanese imperialism is
driven out and Chinese territory recovered.(See below).

Reliable information emanating from the usual source states that on
August 1 Soviet China carried out a general mobilization for a positive
war against Japanese imperialism, believing that such a step is indispen-
sable in fighting for real peace in the Far East, against an imperialist
war over the Pacific, for the defence of the Chinese nation against ad-
vancing Japanese imperialism. Monster demonstrations of such a nature
accordingly took place in Soviet China with the participation of mil-
lions of Chinese toilers whose interest has been jeopardized by uninter-
rupted aggressions of Japanese imperialism and threatened by the coming
imperialist war. Thus in observance of the day Soviet China embarked on
a noble undertaking that will finally liberate China from the fetters of
imperialism and KMT.

In this connection, of added significance is the victory of the red
army just mentioned. Thanks to the heroism of the red fighters Soviet
China witnessed on August 1 the collapse of Chiang Kai-shek's eastern
front defended by no less than 200,000 troops of Chiang's crack units.
At the same time the north, west and south fronts of the KMT bandits in
the encircling campaign are shaking before the charges of the red army.
The red army has accomplished more than half of its task in breaking the
5th drive of imperialism and KMT up to the present time. Consequently,
August 1, 1934, is worth more to Chinese toilers and Chinese Soviets than
any similar date in the past.

In KMT China toilers observed the day in a different manner but with
no less enthusiasm. Here in Shanghai demonstrations took place in the in-
dustrial centres in east and west Shanghai. Handbills and revolutionary
literature were distributed freely among the working masses. Speeches
were delivered by worker-leaders at mass meetings against the oppression
and exploitation of imperialism and KMT which was increased as the econo-
mic crisis in China deepened, against the KMT surrender and betrayal, etc.
Workers succeeded in forming groups of several hundred each for meetings
and demonstrations.

In the crowded streets of Shanghai anti-war literature was freely dis-
tributed and freely accepted by the masses in spite of the police cor-
dons of KMT-imperialism. Following the day with greater interest this
year no doubt due to the approach of the threatened imperialist war the
masses at Shanghai lined the thoroughfares, waiting to take a glance at
the anti-war demonstration. Some people loitered hours in places where
the demonstration was supposed to take place. They eagerly grabbed at the
literature offered them. Police officers failed to clear the street of
the loiters. And many regretted to come late, too late to meet the anti-
war parade.

...............................

people in a war against Japan together with the news relating thereto.
As time goes on, the movement rapidly gains ground among the Chinese mass-
es who hate the KMT betrayal more than ever. The movement is of course
of far reaching significance beyond the imagination
of the imperialists and their agents. The armed self-defence agitation is

今年8月1日，无论是在国民党统治区还是苏维埃中国，中国劳苦大众都围绕着一个对中国乃至全世界都具有巨大意义的口号进行了纪念。今年，中国劳苦大众在8月1日发起了一场前所未有的解放运动，这场运动显然旨在抵御帝国主义的进一步进攻，特别是日本帝国主义的进攻。

8月1日，上海几乎所有的外文报纸都刊登了中国人民对日作战的基本纲领，并附有简要说明和社论注释。这一天已成为中国人民向日本帝国主义宣战的信号，在劳苦大众的领导下，中国人民将 vigorously 推进这一行动，直到将日本帝国主义驱逐出境并收复中国领土。（见下文）。

来自通常渠道的可靠消息指出，8月1日，苏维埃中国进行了全面动员，准备对日本帝国主义进行积极战争，认为这一步骤对于争取远东的真正和平、反对太平洋上的帝国主义战争、保卫中华民族免受 advancing 的日本帝国主义侵害是必不可少的。因此，苏维埃中国举行了此类性质的盛大示威，数百万中国劳苦大众参与其中，他们的利益因日本帝国主义的不间断侵略而受到损害，并受到即将到来的帝国主义战争的威胁。因此，为了纪念这一天，苏维埃中国开始了一项崇高的事业，这将最终使中国从帝国主义和国民党的枷锁中解放出来。

与此相关，前述红军的胜利具有额外的重大意义。得益于红色战士的英勇，苏维埃中国在8月1日见证了蒋介石东线的崩溃，该防线由不少于20万人的蒋介石精锐部队防守。与此同时，国民党匪军在围剿战役中的北、西、南战线在红军的冲锋下动摇。截至目前，红军已完成打破帝国主义和国民党第五次“围剿”任务的一半以上。因此，1934年8月1日对中国劳苦大众和中国苏维埃来说，比过去任何类似的日子都更有价值。

在国民党统治区，劳苦大众以不同的方式纪念这一天，但热情丝毫不减。在上海，示威活动发生在上海东部和西部的工业中心。传单和革命文献在工人群众中自由分发。工人领袖在群众集会上发表演讲，反对随着中国经济危机加深而加剧的帝国主义和国民党的压迫与剥削，反对国民党的投降与背叛等。工人们成功组建了数百人一组的小队，用于集会和示威。

在上海拥挤的街道上，尽管有国民党-帝国主义的警察封锁线，反战文献仍被自由分发，并被群众自由接受。毫无疑问，由于受到威胁的帝国主义战争日益临近，今年人们对这一天的兴趣更加浓厚，上海群众聚集在街道两旁，等待瞥一眼反战示威。一些人在预计举行示威的地方徘徊数小时。他们急切地抓取提供给他们的文献。警察未能清除街道上的滞留者。许多人遗憾来得太晚，没能赶上反战游行。

武装自卫运动迅速发展
...............................

the only means 'to save the nation' (read: to save themselves). As the movement makes considerable headway, the K T chiefs are panic-stricken, including Chiang Kai-shek and Wang Chin-wei who are holding a conference at Ku-lin; to sell more of China to Japan in order to check the growth of the movement. But Chinese toilers as the backbone of the movement will see to it that the K T chiefs who have signed away Chinese territory one piece after another be barred from further betrayal of a similar nature. The armed self defence movement can play a big role in this direction.

The First Block

There is definite evidence that the Kuomintang has undertaken to block the armed self defence movement of the people at the very beginning. It shall be recalled that on August 1 the Chinese press at Shanghai published no news whatsoever concerning the movement, much less to print the basic programme of the Chinese people in a war against Japan which embodies six fundamental points. Nor was published the statement of the preparatory committee of the national council of the Chinese armed self defence, a statement that gives the reasons why a war of the Chinese people against Japan is possible, shattering the illusions of those who have pinned faith in international treaties and imperialist powers for the defence of China.

Undoubtedly, some of the Chinese papers as the China Times is in the direct pay of Chiang Kai-shek while others such as the Shun Pao are owned by compradors, lackeys of imperialism. They will under no circumstances give any space to news that condemns the capitulation of Nanking. But there are papers that try to maintain a nationalist attitude but keep silent on the movement due to the rigid censorship of the Kuomintang. At the very outset the Kuomintang, we are informed from authoritative sources, decided to nip the movement in its bud by placing a ban on it, depriving the people of the opportunity to know anything about it. The Kuomintang called out the entire detective force to hunt for those behind the movement. The first martyrs as far as we know are comrades Yu Chi-chun, etc, the sole charge brought against them being their association with the armed self defence movement. The Kuomintang has issued orders to the papers forbidding to publish any news regarding the movement. The dirty K T has blackmailed those patriots and revolutionaries that stand behind the programme of the Chinese people in a war against Japan.

Here, more palpably than ever has the K T come out in the open to defend the interests of Japanese imperialism. It has led the fascists, compradors, landlords, capitalists (even including the national bourgeoisie) in a ruthless war on the people who dare to speak or act against Japan in defiance of the K T's interdiction. Decapitation as meted out by Chiang Kai-shek to those who still talk about resistance to Japan is more rigidly enforced as the movement for armed self defence progresses rapidly.

In Defiance of the K T

Despite the persecution of the Kuomintang in the interest of Japanese Imperialism Chinese masses can no longer be cowed and intimidated by words or deeds of the treacherous Kuomintang. Standing in the van of the movement are Chinese workers, peasants, city-poor and advanced intellectuals who push the movement ahead with vigor. Chinese patriots rally around the new movement in increasing numbers. Now under the banner of the armed self defence thousands have added their signatures in additional to the original 3,000 promoters including Madame Sun Yat-sen (Soong Ching-lin), Madam Liao Chun-kai, General Li Tu, etc. Dozens of anti-Japanese associations have sprung into existence in defiance of the K T suppression, nay, have done valuable work for the expansion of the movement.

On 6 ins. General Li Tu gave a reception to presses of foreign papers outlining the policy of the Chinese people in a war against Japan, explaining the motives of the war, elucidating the practical measures adopted to that end, answering the questions put to him, etc. All papers of foreign ownership at Shanghai published the interview of Gen. Li in some detail but not the Chinese press which were compelled silence due to the tightening hand of the K T censor. Gen. Li's explanation made a very good impression on those present although it was later found that some of his points were purposely distorted by certain reporters in the defense of imperialism. Of course imperialist-minded persons can hardly remain neutral in such a matter as China's armed self defence. But fully realizing the opportunity,

唯一的“救国”手段（即：拯救他们自己）。随着运动取得相当大的进展，国民党头目们惊慌失措，包括正在牯岭开会的蒋介石和汪精卫；他们为了遏制运动的发展，不惜将更多的中国利益出卖给日本。但是，作为运动中坚力量的中国劳苦大众将确保那些已一片片割让中国领土的国民党头目无法再进行类似的背叛。武装自卫运动在这方面可以发挥巨大作用。

第一道封锁线

有确凿证据表明，国民党从一开始就着手阻挠人民的武装自卫运动。回想一下，8月1日，上海中文报刊没有刊登任何关于该运动的新闻，更不用说刊登中国人民对日作战基本纲领中体现的六项基本要点了。全国武装自卫委员会筹备处的声明也未予发表，该声明阐述了中国人民对日战争之所以可能的原因，打破了那些迷信依靠国际条约和帝国主义列强来保卫中国的人的幻想。

毫无疑问，像《时报》这样的一些中文报纸直接受雇于蒋介石，而另一些如《申报》则由买办——帝国主义的走狗——所有。它们绝不会提供任何版面来刊登谴责南京投降主义的新闻。但也有一些报纸试图保持民族主义立场，但由于国民党的严厉审查，对该运动保持沉默。据权威消息来源告知，国民党在最初就决定通过禁止该运动将其扼杀在萌芽状态，剥夺人民了解该运动的任何机会。国民党调动了全部侦探力量来搜捕运动背后的人员。据我们所知，首批烈士是俞启纯同志等人，对他们的唯一指控就是与武装自卫运动有关联。国民党已向各报馆发布命令，禁止刊登任何关于该运动的新闻。肮脏的国民党勒索那些支持中国人民对日作战纲领的爱国者和革命者。

在此，国民党比以往任何时候都更加赤裸裸地站出来维护日本帝国主义的利益。它带领法西斯分子、买办、地主、资本家（甚至包括民族资产阶级）对那些敢于无视国民党禁令、发表反日言论或采取反日行动的人民发动残酷的战争。随着武装自卫运动的迅速发展，蒋介石对那些仍谈论抗日者实施的斩首刑罚执行得更为严酷。

无视国民党

尽管国民党为了日本帝国主义的利益进行迫害，但中国民众已不再被卖国贼国民党的言行所吓倒和恐吓。站在运动前列的是中国工人、农民、城市贫民和进步知识分子，他们有力地推动着运动向前发展。越来越多的中国爱国者聚集在新运动的周围。现在，在武装自卫的旗帜下，除了原有的3,000名发起人（包括孙逸仙夫人[宋庆龄]、廖仲恺夫人、李杜将军等）之外，又有成千上万的人签名加入。数十个抗日协会无视国民党的镇压应运而生，不，它们为运动的扩展做了有价值的工作。

本月6日，李杜将军举行外国报社记者招待会，概述中国人民对日作战的政策，解释战争动机，阐明为此采取的实际措施，并回答提出的问题等。上海所有外文报纸都详细刊登了李将军的访谈，但中文报纸因国民党审查机构的收紧而被迫保持沉默。李将军的解释给在场者留下了很好的印象，尽管后来发现，某些记者出于维护帝国主义的目的，故意歪曲了他的部分观点。当然，具有帝国主义思想的人在中国武装自卫这样的问题上很难保持中立。但充分意识到这一机会，

Gen. Li (commander of a section of the Chinese forces against Japan in
Manchuria, 1931-1933) went far enough in emphasizing that the Chinese
people have resolved to fly at the throat of Japanese imperialism at all
costs and got ready to plunge into the war of their own initiative and
with their own resources without fear of the modern weapons of Japan
and the treacherous acts of her agents in China, referring to Chiang Kai-
shek, Wang Chin-wei and the whole bunch of the Kuomintang.

Six Points Reiterated

While the new movement is spreading in all directions in the whole
country, reaching even the farthest corners of China, despite the sabo-
tage of the Kuomintang, it may be of interest to reiterate the famous
six points as embodied in the programme, all agreed to by the leaders
as well as the ranks and files of the movement. The following is the six
points in a nutshell:

(1) Mobilization of all the forces on land and sea and in air in a
war against Japanese imperialism, estimated at a strength of about 3,000,
000 men and officers, (2) mobilization of the whole body of people, or-
ganization of various volunteer armies, (3) arming the people with weapons
from all sources, (4) financing the war by confiscating all Japanese
owned enterprises in China amounting to $2,000,000,000 at the present
rate of exchange, confiscating the property of all traitors, earmarking
the national revenue for the war, collecting a progressive tax, solicit-
ing money from within as well as without the country, from foreign sym-
pathizers, too, (5) formation of a national council for armed self de-
fence as the supreme organ directing all activities connected with the
war on Japan, consisting of delegates chosen by workers, peasants, sol-
diers, merchants, students, etc, (6) alliance with the enemies of Japan-
ese imperialism.

Following the promulgation of the programme just cited a declaration
over the signature of the preparatory committee of the national council
for armed self defence was issued calling on the nation to arise at once
for the defence of the country which is precisely on the point of break-
down in the face of imperialist aggressions with the aid of the Kuomintang.
Instead of defending the country as supposed to do, the KMT has given e-
very facility to Japan in her further attacks on China and, for this rea-
son, incurred the high displeasure of the people. Now the angered people
take the lead in the movement for armed self defence of their own accord.

WORKERS LIFE IN SOVIET CHINA
...........

Workers in Soviet China are leading a life never dreamt of in other
parts of the country thanks to the protection of the Soviet government
set up by the workers themselves. With the rigid enforcement of labour
law by the Soviet government considerable betterment in the lot of the
working masses has become a reality. The eight hour law, the social insu-
rance, the increase in pay (e.g., rise from $2.00 to $20.00 a month in
Tingchow, Fukien), the collective bargaining, etc, are all conducive to
the amelioration. In every case the Soviet government and trade unions
come to the aid of the workers in a counter-attack against the offensive
of capital such as wage-cut, ill-treatment, etc. Woman-worker is placed
on an absolutely equal footing with men. Her life has likewise improved.
During my visit to the central printing office a woman worker was observ-
ed in the act of feeding her one year old baby with milk, such feeding re-
peated several times a day, all with pay. Young workers have also obtain-
ed better conditions of work, e.g., six hour-day, etc.

The Question of Unemployment

Unemployment which has positively refused to move downward either in
Soviet China or in the advanced capitalist countries is no longer a serious
question to be dealt with. The development of production in Soviet China
at an accelerated pace helps greatly and speedily in solving the problem
of unemployment. Only a small fraction of the working population finds no
regular jobs as a result of the migration of workers from the countryside
to the towns. Peasants, women and men, rush for the city while many enter-
prises have failed to absorb them all owing to the slow tempo of develop-
ment (hindered by the KMT's 5th campaign). The government gives them relief.

李将军（1931-1933年中国东北抗日部队某部指挥官）极力强调，中国人民已决心不惜一切代价掐住日本帝国主义的喉咙，并准备依靠自己的主动性和资源投入战争，不惧怕日本的现代武器及其在华代理人——指蒋介石、汪精卫及整个国民党团伙——的背叛行径。

重申六点

尽管遭到国民党的破坏，新运动仍在全国各地蔓延，甚至到达中国的偏远角落，此时重申纲领中著名的六点或许令人感兴趣，这六点得到了运动领导层以及普通成员的一致同意。以下是这六点的概要：

(1) 动员所有陆海空力量参加对日帝国主义战争，估计兵力约为3,000,000人；(2) 动员全体民众，组织各种志愿军；(3) 用各种来源的武器武装人民；(4) 通过没收在华所有日资企业（按当前汇率计算达2,000,000,000美元）、没收所有汉奸财产、划拨国家财政收入用于战争、征收累进税、向国内外（包括外国同情者）募捐来为战争融资；(5) 成立全国武装自卫委员会，作为指导所有对日战争相关活动的最高机构，由工人、农民、士兵、商人、学生等选出的代表组成；(6) 与日本帝国主义的敌人结盟。

在颁布上述纲领之后，全国武装自卫委员会筹备处签署了一份宣言，呼吁全国人民立即起来保卫国家，因为国家在帝国主义的侵略和国民党的协助下正面临崩溃的边缘。国民党非但没有履行其应有的保国职责，反而为日本进一步攻击中国提供了一切便利，因此招致了人民的极大不满。现在，愤怒的人民自发地带头开展武装自卫运动。

苏维埃中国的工人生活
...........

由于受到工人自己建立的苏维埃政府的保护，苏维埃中国的工人过着该国其他地区做梦也想不到的生活。随着苏维埃政府严格执行劳动法，广大劳动群众境遇的显著改善已成为现实。八小时工作制、社会保险、工资增加（例如，福建汀州从每月2.00美元涨至20.00美元）、集体谈判等，都有助于这种改善。在每一种情况下，苏维埃政府和工会都在反击资本的进攻（如减薪、虐待等）时援助工人。女工被置于与男子完全平等的地位。她们的生活也同样得到了改善。在我访问中央印刷厂期间，观察到一名女工正在给其一岁的婴儿喂奶，这种喂奶每天重复数次，且照付工资。青年工人也获得了更好的工作条件，例如六小时工作日等。

失业问题

无论是在苏维埃中国还是在先进的资本主义国家，失业率都坚决拒绝下降，但这已不再是一个需要处理的严重问题。苏维埃中国生产的加速发展极大地并迅速地帮助解决了失业问题。只有极少部分的劳动人口因工人从农村迁移到城镇而找不到固定工作。男女农民涌向城市，而许多企业由于发展缓慢（受国民党第五次围剿阻碍）未能全部吸收他们。政府向他们提供救济。

5

Owing to the fact that the workers themselves run the government, the wage earners in Soviet China are placed in a privileged position, enjoying such privileges as freedom of strike against capital with the protection of the Soviet government, etc. The workers organised their own unions with a large membership. Workers employed in the state enterprises have almost joined the unions in a body as in the state printing office. In every factory there are workers' clubs, Leninist rooms, ball fields, wall papers, illustrated papers, etc. Workers may, of course, hold meetings from time to time, aided sometimes by the government who has in the past given rooms for meetings. Needless to say, full freedom of speech is enjoyed by the workers.

A Contrast to K T China

The workers under the Soviets provide a sharp contrast with those in the K.T-controlled China so far as their life is concerned. In white China the workers lead a life of dogs, always placed on the starvation line.

The workers in Soviet China are distinguished in another respect: the development of creative power. They have shown marvellous initiative and creative power. They support the Soviet government with the greatest possible proletarian vigor and energy. Their cadres have filled the leading positions in the government and army. The All China Federation of Labour has, for example, mobilized a host of cadres for the expansion of the red army.

The wonderful creative power of the workers under the Soviets is shown by the following examples. The workers in the arsenals can turn out new weapons just as good as those made by machine--rifles, guns, mines, etc, which are all of good quality. The printing workers not only attend to duties assigned to them but at the same time make good ink for printing. This ink proves just as good as that imported from imperialist countries. Printing by hand in Soviet China proves an entire success in comparison with machine work. Paper making has shown great strides. In connection with mimeograph many new inventions have come to the foreground such as the manufacture of Loubian paper in place of the stencil paper, of a new type of carbon paper, etc.

Even the most backward peasant and peasant women who come from the village may master the technique in the mills and factories in a short space of time. Besides, the workers take a great pleasure in the work laid before them. They have all shown an eagerness for work, desiring to accomplish the work ahead of schedule time. For instance, the workers finished the construction of the building for the II Soviet congress far ahead of time. All workers in the state enterprises want to work extra hours in addition to the regular hours (The state arsenal, mint, printing office, etc).

Bond Subscription

In connection with the bonds issued by the Soviet government for economic reconstruction the workers have displayed an enthusiasm almost unequalled. They bought the bonds in a rush, realising that the bonds will contribute largely towards the betterment in their own lot as a result of economic reconstruction, realising, too, that the bonds bought will provide enough money for the shattering of the 5th campaign of imperialism and Kuomintang. Undoubtedly, the latter consideration afforded a greater stimulus to the rush of the workers for taking up the bonds, as the 5th drive threatens to wipe out all the benefits conquered by them in the course of revolution.

As to the struggles of the workers going on in K.T China the toiling masses under the Soviets have done their best in helping their brothers oppressed by K T and imperialism. They deserve special merit in assisting the extension of the red army.

It goes without saying that the workers in Soviet China have displayed and still display the greatest possible militancy in the work for the Soviets as well as for themselves. The fact that they lead and operate the Soviets is in itself a mighty factor in placing the worker on a higher level both as to ability to work and enthusiasm to work. Both the Soviets and unions, it may be said with reason, are a better type of schools for the workers in a political as well as in a technical sense. By going through these schools the workers can acquire experience in the political and technical

由于工人自己管理政府，苏维埃中国的工资收入者处于特权地位，享有在苏维埃政府保护下自由罢工反对资本家等特权。工人们组织了拥有大量会员的工会。在国家企业工作的工人几乎全体加入了工会，如在国家印刷厂即是如此。每个工厂都有工人俱乐部、列宁室、球场、墙报、画报等。工人们当然可以不时举行会议，有时还得到政府的协助，政府过去曾提供会议室。不用说，工人们享有充分的言论自由。

与国民党统治下的中国形成对比

就生活而言，苏维埃政权下的工人与国民党（K.T.）控制下的中国工人形成了鲜明的对比。在“白色中国”，工人们过着牛马不如的生活，始终处于饥饿线上。

苏维埃中国的工人在另一个方面也很突出：创造力的发展。他们表现出了非凡的主动性和创造力。他们以最大的无产阶级活力和精力支持苏维埃政府。他们的干部占据了政府和军队的领导职位。例如，中华全国总工会动员了大量干部以扩充红军。

苏维埃政权下工人的惊人创造力体现在以下例子中。兵工厂的工人能够制造出与机器制造的一样好的新武器——步枪、枪支、地雷等，且质量优良。印刷工人不仅履行分配给他们的职责，同时还制造优质的印刷油墨。这种油墨被证明与从帝国主义国家进口的油墨一样好。与机器作业相比，苏维埃中国的手工印刷取得了完全的成功。造纸业也取得了巨大进步。在与油印相关的领域，许多新发明脱颖而出，例如制造罗边纸（Loubian paper）以代替蜡纸，以及新型复写纸等。

即使是来自农村的最落后的农民和农妇，也能在短时间内掌握磨坊和工厂的技术。此外，工人们对他们所从事的工作感到极大的乐趣。他们都表现出对工作的渴望，希望提前完成工作。例如，工人们远远提前完成了第二次苏维埃代表大会会场的建设。所有国有企业（如国家兵工厂、造币厂、印刷厂等）的工人都希望在正常工作时间之外加班。

债券认购

关于苏维埃政府为经济重建而发行的债券，工人们表现出了几乎无与伦比的热情。他们争先恐后地购买债券，认识到这些债券将有助于通过经济重建改善他们自身的境遇，同时也认识到购买债券将为粉碎帝国主义和国民党的第五次“围剿”提供足够的资金。毫无疑问，后一种考虑更加刺激了工人们抢购债券的热情，因为第五次“围剿”威胁要抹杀他们在革命过程中赢得的所有利益。

至于在国民党（K.T.）统治下的中国正在进行的工人斗争，苏维埃政权下的劳苦大众已竭尽全力帮助受国民党和帝国主义压迫的兄弟。他们在协助扩大红军方面功绩卓著。

不用说，苏维埃中国的工人在为苏维埃政权以及为他们自己的工作当中，已经并继续表现出尽可能高的战斗性。他们领导和管理苏维埃政权这一事实本身，就是一个强大的因素，使工人在工作能力和工作热情方面都提升到更高的水平。可以说，无论是从政治意义上还是技术意义上讲，苏维埃政权和工会都是更好的工人学校。通过这些学校，工人们可以获得政治和技术方面的经验
