The success of the Soviet power provides the basic presumption for con-
ade reconstruction.
KT's Fabrications
JT and all other counterrevolutionary fractions have spread the damned
lie that the Soviets and communists are an agency for destruction, knowing
nothing about construction. In support of their slander they point to the
killing, burning and pillaging in the Soviet districts which were actually
done by the KT bandits but laid at the door of the Soviets. But, in fact,
the Soviets can tear down just as well as build up. It is the KT bandits
that have build nothing on the ruins of the old order. They can never do so
in the future insofar as they remain in power.
On the other hand, a fallacious sentiment also prevails along a certain
section of the Soviet partisans: construction is impossible in face of the
present civil war nor is it the central task in this phase of the revolu-
tion. This is of course a harmful, opportunist, ideological conception.
Soviet economic reconstruction will undoubtedly meet with difficulties
during the process of civil war. Coupled with war is the fact that the So-
viets are far away from the leading industrial and commercial centres. But
the Soviets will overcome these difficulties during the process of develop-
ment. The repulse of the enemy's offensive, the improvement in the lot of
workers and peasants, the breaking through of the KT's economic blockade
demand greater progress in the economic reconstruction of the Soviets.
The following is a resume of the achievements registered in Soviet eco-
nomic reconstruction:
Land Inspection
The land inspection aims at distributing the benefits of the land revo-
lution among poor and middle peasants as well as among farm hands, and is
now crowned with considerable success. It resulted in the ousting of many
exploiters and retrocession of their land. The land so recovered was dis-
tributed among the poor peasants.
Many errors were committed in connection with land inspection. Conscious
of these errors, the Soviets took prompt action in clarifying the situation.
It gave to the peasants the assurance that they may keep the land already
secured without being in the least disturbed by land inspection.
Next is the raise in production. The Soviets mobilized broad masses for
this task and secured brilliant successes in this field. Generally speaking,
all production of agricultural commodities has been raised from 200% to 250%.
Spring ploughing for the current year was started somewhat ahead. The govern-
ment and cooperatives gave aid to the peasants who had neither live stock nor
seeds. Efforts were continued in reclamation work. Agricultural education
was widely disseminated.
The greatest effort was made in facilitating the marketing of agricultural
produce with the development of trade both within and without the Soviet
territory. Agricultural produce is exported in exchange for the commodities
in great need in the Soviet districts so as to make it possible for the mass-
es to ameliorate their lot. With the aid from the masses, the crops of the
families of the red armists yield much more than was supposed. All KT ex-
ploitation and usury have been abolished. This fact with the rise in pro-
duction resulted in the greater income for the peasantry. Now the peasant
can eat more and better food.
Industrial Production
Under the Soviets private investment for industrial development is encou-
raged under conditions laid down in various laws. At the same time aid is
given to handicrafts industry, workshops and household industry. Productive
cooperatives are also organised. State enterprises, especially immediately
connected with war, are forging ahead at full speed. Arsenals, repair shops,
mint, printing office, uniform factory, weaving mills, postal and telegraph
(wireless) administration, etc., are all state enterprises, employing several
hundred to several thousand workers (like the tungsten industry). It has
been contemplated to establish a big cloth-weaving mill with a capital of
100,000.
All industries in the Soviet territory are, on the whole, recovering
from the blows delivered by the KT bandits who came to the village, killing,
burning and looting at random, playing the greatest havoc with local economy.
They are recuperating at faster or slower rate under Soviet direction. Yet
recovery is realised under most difficult conditions.
E N D
pages.zh:
5
尽管进展缓慢，但胜利在望。
苏维埃政权的成功为经济重建提供了基本前提。
国民党的捏造

国民党及其他所有反革命派别散布恶毒谎言，称苏维埃和共产党是破坏机构，不懂建设。为了支持他们的诽谤，他们指出苏维埃地区的杀戮、焚烧和掠夺，而这些实际上是由国民党匪徒所为，却嫁祸于苏维埃。但事实上，苏维埃既能破坏也能建设。真正在旧秩序的废墟上一无所建的是国民党匪徒。只要他们掌权，将来也永远做不到这一点。

另一方面，在部分苏维埃支持者中也流行一种错误的观点：面对当前的内战，建设是不可能的，也不是这一革命阶段的中心任务。这当然是一种有害的、机会主义的思想观念。

苏维埃的经济重建在内战过程中无疑会遇到困难。加之苏维埃远离主要的工商业中心。但苏维埃将在发展过程中克服这些困难。击退敌人的进攻、改善工农生活状况、突破国民党的经济封锁，都要求苏维埃在经济重建方面取得更大进展。

以下是苏维埃经济重建所取得成就的概要：

土地检查

土地检查旨在将土地革命的利益分配给贫农、中农以及雇农，目前已取得相当成功。它导致许多剥削者被驱逐，其土地被收回。收回的土地分配给了贫农。

在土地检查过程中犯了许多错误。意识到这些错误后，苏维埃迅速采取行动澄清局势。它向农民保证，他们可以保留已经获得的土地，丝毫不会受到土地检查的干扰。

其次是提高产量。苏维埃动员广大群众投入这项任务，并在这一领域取得了辉煌的成功。总的来说，所有农产品的产量提高了200%至250%。今年的春耕提前开始。政府和合作社向既无牲畜又无种子的农民提供援助。开荒工作继续进行。农业教育得到广泛传播。

最大的努力在于促进农产品的销售，发展苏维埃境内外的贸易。出口农产品以交换苏维埃地区急需的商品，从而使民众能够改善生活状况。在群众的帮助下，红军家属的庄稼收成远超预期。所有国民党的剥削和高利贷都被废除。这一事实加上产量的提高，使得农民收入增加。现在农民可以吃得更饱、更好。

工业生产

在苏维埃领导下，鼓励私人投资工业发展，条件是符合各项法律的规定。同时，对手工业、作坊和家庭工业给予援助。生产合作社也已组织起来。国有企业，特别是与战争直接相关的企业，正全速前进。兵工厂、修理厂、造币厂、印刷厂、制服厂、织布厂、邮政和电报（无线）管理局等均为国有企业，雇佣数百至数千名工人（如钨矿业）。已计划建立一家资本为10万元的大型织布厂。

总体而言，苏维埃领土上的所有工业正从国民党匪徒造成的打击中恢复过来，这些匪徒来到村庄，随意杀人、放火和抢劫，对当地经济造成了最大破坏。它们在苏维埃的指导下以或快或慢的速度恢复元气。然而，这种恢复是在极其困难的条件下实现的。
结 束

pages.en:
Gentlemen,

Enclosed you will find a piece of news that repudiates the Japanese theory that the whole of China is on very friendly terms with Tokyo. No, the people of China can not be friendly to a power that has grabbed Chinese territory in direct contravention of international treaties, much less to Japan who is planning to annex the whole of China. The Kuomintang government may bow to the wishes of Japanese imperialism for reasons well known but not the people who condemn the capitulation.

At present the people of China have, more than ever, awaken to the necessity of resisting the Japanese advance just at a moment when the anti-Japanese sentiment seems to have died down. But the anti-Japanese sentiment is still seething under the surface. Nanking has apparently failed in its repression of the anti-Japanese movement because right in Shanghai more than two thousand people have, after thorough discussion, signed THE PROGRAMME OF THE CHINESE PEOPLE IN A WAR AGAINST JAPAN which you will find herewith. There also was inaugurated the national council of armed self-defence to carry out the programme. And the council has issued a declaration to the Chinese public, appealing for their aid.

This declaration which may be taken as a declaration of war on Japan represents the genuine wishes of the Chinese people who must rely on themselves to repulse the brute attacks of Japanese imperialism and to recover the lost territory from the robbers. Our foreign friends may laugh at such a move on the part of a people who, suffering a defeat without a war, have strong enemies to face both at home and abroad. But we fight with a force entirely invincible (the people all armed). It is the defeatists that prefer defeat without a war.

2,000 individuals here in Shanghai, including men and women in every walk of life (from Sun Yat-sen, Gen. Li Tu, down to labourers in the factory or coolies on the street) have taken the lead in the war movement against Japanese imperialism. They firmly believe that war is the only way to save China from further attacks of the Japanese hordes. We will remain friendly to those powers who take a friendly attitude towards us in the movement.

Convinced that our attitude may be misconstrued or distorted unless wide publicity is given to the programme and declaration enclosed, we must ask for aid from our foreign friends or sympathizers. You are kindly requested to give a little space to the materials we mail you.

Yours Truly,

China News Agency

August 1, 1934.
pages.zh:
先生们：

随函附上一则新闻，驳斥了日本关于全中国与东京关系非常友好的理论。不，中国人民不可能对一个公然违反国际条约攫取中国领土的强国表示友好，更不用说对计划吞并整个中国的日本了。国民党政府可能出于众所周知的原因屈从于日本帝国主义的愿望，但谴责投降行为的人民不会这样做。

目前，中国人民比以往任何时候都更清醒地认识到抵抗日本推进的必要性，而这正是在反日情绪似乎已经平息的时刻。但反日情绪仍在表面下涌动。南京显然未能镇压住反日运动，因为就在上海，两千多人在经过充分讨论后，签署了《中国人民对日作战纲领》，该纲领随函附上。此外，还成立了全国武装自卫委员会以执行该纲领。该委员会已向中国公众发表宣言，呼吁他们提供援助。

这份宣言可视为对日本的宣战书，代表了中国人民的真实愿望，他们必须依靠自己的力量来击退日本帝国主义的野蛮攻击，并从强盗手中收复失地。我们的外国朋友可能会嘲笑一个尚未开战就已遭受失败、国内外强敌环伺的民族所采取的此类举动。但我们以一支完全不可战胜的力量（全民武装）进行战斗。是不战而败的失败主义者更喜欢不战而败。

上海的2,000名个人，包括各行各业的男女（从孙中山、李杜将军，到工厂工人或街头苦力），已在反对日本帝国主义的战争运动中率先行动。他们坚信，战争是将中国从日本匪帮进一步攻击中拯救出来的唯一途径。我们将对那些在运动中对我们采取友好态度的国家保持友好。

深信除非对所附纲领和宣言进行广泛宣传，否则我们的态度可能会被误解或歪曲，因此我们必须请求外国朋友或同情者提供援助。恳请贵方为我们邮寄的材料提供一点版面。

此致

中国新闻社

1934年8月1日

pages.en:
The following is the draft of an important document entitled "THE
BASIC PROGRAMME OF THE CHINESE PEOPLE IN A WAR AGAINST JAPAN" under-
signed by some 3,000 Chinese (men and women that are found almost in
every walk of life in China) including Sung Ching-ling (Madam Sun Yat-
sen), Gen. Li Tu (commander of a section of Chinese forces against
Japanese imperialism in Manchuria), Chang Iai-shi (manager of the
Chakiang Industrial Bank at Shanghai), etc, who have figured pro-
minently in shaping and popularizing the programme.

THE BASIC PROGRAM OF THE CHINESE PEOPLE IN A WAR
AGAINST JAPAN

On September 18, 1931, Japanese imperialism took our Manchuria with-
out experiencing much trouble from Marshal Chang Hsuch-liang and Nanking
who embarked on a policy of non-resistance. Japanese imperialism, how-
ever, failed in its efforts to seize Chinese territory at Shanghai (Cha-
pei, Nantao, Woosung, etc) in the grand scale Japanese offensive launched
on January 28, 1932. Japanese planes bombed Chapei but the workers in
Shanghai together with the soldiers of the 19th Route army, city-poor,
coolies, students and all patriotic Chinese were able to stop the Japanese
advance. Shanhaikwan fell into Japanese hands just on the New Year's day,
1933, followed by the Japanese occupation of Jehol in February. In the
following months Japanese imperialism marched into Chahar, trying to lay
its hand on Suiyuan, Inner Mongolia and N. China. Of late it presented an
ultimatum to Nanking demanding the immediate opening of conversations to
accept all conditions that will confirm Japan's hegemony in N. China as
well as in the whole country. The northeastern troops (of Chang Hsueh-
liang) have already been withdrawn from the north in order to make room
for the advent of the Japanese army which is reported to come down as far
as the Yellow River. Tokyo made a public statement placing the whole of
China under its protection.

Obviously, Japanese imperialism not only desires to force with the aid
of troops the realisation of the 21 demands presented on China in 1915 but
actually enforces with blood and iron the famous positive policy of ex-
premier Tanaka towards China, that is, to annex the whole of China and
convert China into a Japanese colony.

For this reason, the people of the entire country, whether they are
Hans (pure Chinese) or Mongols, or Mohammedans or other minorities, have
come to face an extra-ordinary danger, a danger that foreshadows death
ahead. They are liable to be bombarded, shot, beheaded, tortured, raped,
insulted at the hands of the Japanese. They are liable to be left without
or by hunger, poverty and unemployment ahead. They will meet with exactly
the same fate that has befallen the Koreans, Formosans, etc. They will suf-
fer in the same terrible manner as our 40,000,000 brothers and sisters
in Manchuria, Jehol and N. China.

Through their own bitter experiences the people of China have learned
that the Kuomintang and Nanking government can not be depended on to save the
country from the bloody hands of Japanese imperialism; that reliance on A-
merica or the League of Nations for help against Japan proves only a fu-
tile illusion. So far America and the League of Nations have shown no-
thing concrete in the fight against Japan. Even supposed friends and the
League of Nations are necessary in one way or another against Japan. It will
bring no relief to the Chinese people unless they themselves take up arms
to drive out the Japanese invaders from their soil. The present moment
is critical. The goal of the Chinese people is clear: to drive out
Japanese imperialism with all means at their disposal. That is to say, we must
recognize that the Chinese people must fight for their own liberation. This
is recognized by the majority of the Chinese people at the
present moment. Yet, it is also recognized that such a war is the war of the
righteousness and progress.
pages.zh:
以下是一份重要文件的草案，题为《中国人民对日作战基本纲领》，由约3,000名中国人（男女皆有，涵盖中国社会各界）签署，其中包括宋庆龄（孙中山夫人）、李杜将军（在满洲抗击日本帝国主义的中国部队某部指挥官）、张义澍（上海浙江兴业银行经理）等，他们在制定和推广该纲领方面发挥了突出作用。

中国人民对日作战基本纲领

1931年9月18日，日本帝国主义占领了我们的满洲，而张学良将军和南京政府采取了不抵抗政策，未遇太大阻力。然而，日本帝国主义在1932年1月28日发动的大规模进攻中，企图夺取上海领土（闸北、南市、吴淞等地）的努力失败了。日本飞机轰炸了闸北，但上海的工人连同第十九路军士兵、城市贫民、苦力、学生以及所有爱国中国人，成功阻止了日军的推进。1933年元旦，山海关落入日军之手，随后日本于二月占领了热河。在接下来的几个月里，日本帝国主义进军察哈尔，试图染指绥远、内蒙古和华北。最近，它向南京发出最后通牒，要求立即开启谈判，接受所有确认日本在华北乃至全国霸权的条件。据报道，为了给即将南下的日军让路，（张学良的）东北军已从北方撤出，日军据报将推进至黄河一线。东京发表公开声明，将整个中国置于其保护之下。

显然，日本帝国主义不仅希望借助武力迫使实现1915年向中国提出的“二十一条”，而且实际上正在以铁血手段执行前首相田中对华著名的积极政策，即吞并整个中国，将中国变为日本的殖民地。

因此，全国人民，无论是汉族（纯种中国人）、蒙古族、回族还是其他少数民族，都面临着一种非凡的危险，一种预示着死亡临近的危险。他们可能遭到日本人的轰炸、枪击、斩首、酷刑、强奸和侮辱。他们可能面临无家可归、饥饿、贫困和失业的前景。他们将遭遇与朝鲜人、台湾人等完全相同的命运。他们将遭受与我们在满洲、热河和华北的四千万兄弟姐妹同样可怕的苦难。

通过自身的痛苦经历，中国人民已经认识到，国民党和南京政府不能指望从日本帝国主义的血腥手中拯救国家；依靠美国或国际联盟的帮助来对抗日本，证明只是一种徒劳的幻想。迄今为止，美国和国际联盟在对抗日本的斗争中没有任何具体表现。即使是对付日本所必需的朋友和国际联盟，也以这样或那样的方式显得必要。除非中国人民自己拿起武器，将日本侵略者赶出国土，否则不会带来任何解脱。此刻至关重要。中国人民的目标很明确：利用一切可用手段驱逐日本帝国主义。也就是说，我们必须认识到，中国人民必须为自己的解放而战。这一点目前已被大多数中国人民所认识。同时，人们也认识到，这样一场战争是正义和进步的战争。

pages.en:
2
tics, war for the independence and territorial integrity of China, war for
the salvation of 400,000,000, in short, a holy war saving 1/4 of the popula-
tion of the world from the fate of 'slaves without a country'.

But owing to the fact that such a holy national war lacks a concrete
programme in common, our action in fighting Japanese imperialism has been
sporadic and ineffective. Here we may take a little illustration by citing
the examples of anti-Japanese volunteers, anti-Japanese salvation army and
the anti-Japanese partisans in Manchuria and Jehol who have heroically
fought the Japanese robbers. Likewise our brothers and sisters have waged
many praiseworthy struggles against Japanese imperialism: such as workers'
strikes, students' strikes, demonstrations and boycott. But up to the pre-
sent we have been unable to hold at bay the Japanese advance on us, to say
nothing of the recovery of the lost provinces. Thus we make a few sugges-
tions deemed absolutely necessary for the progress of action of the Chinese
people in a war against Japan.

1) Mobilization of all land, naval and air forces in a war against Ja-
pan. The standing army of China is the largest in the whole world. Apart
from police and militia the regulars amount to 3,000,000 men and officers
in times of peace. The air force, though weak, eats up a large portion of
the contributions of the people. Especially in the few years past appropria-
tions for the navy and air force have been on the increase. The people who
contribute towards the support of the army surely have the right to demand
the dispatch of all land, naval and air forces to the front in a war against
Japan, to demand discontinuance of the internecine war at once. But, as is
known to everybody, the troops alone will not be able to prove commensurate
to the task. Hence:

2) Mobilisation of the whole body of people. At the very outset volun-
tary enlistment is preferable but later on conscription must be adopted,
drawing millions of people into a series of volunteer armies (e.g., workers
volunteer army, peasant volunteer army, student, merchant, doctor, journa-
list, teacher volunteer armies, etc). These volunteers must be sent to the
front immediately in fighting the Japanese. Besides, there must be organised
supply, transport, nursing, sabotage, propaganda corps, drawing in wide masses
of people.

3) Arming the whole body of people. With this end in view, the NT govern-
ment must be demanded to turn over all weapons from machine guns to native
styled swords in the arsenals or depots to anti-Japanese volunteers for train-
ing as well as fighting purposes. The people must take out these weapons
in case the authorities refuse to surrender them. Of course arms and ammuni-
tions may be imported from abroad, if need be.

4) Financing the war against Japan. The question of finance must be in-
vestigated along the following lines:
First and foremost, confiscate all Japanese enterprises in China (Banks,
factories, railways, steam boats, mines and wares of Japanese origin) which
amount to $2,000,000,000 Chinese currency at the present rate of exchange.
Stop payment on Japanese loans (a big sum, too). Confiscate the property of
all traitors. Use all revenue for financing the war. Collect a progressive
tax on property. Collect money from Chinese both within and without the coun-
try, also from foreign sympathizers.
These measures, if enforced, will produce enough revenue for financing
the war, at least in the first stage. Other measures may be devised later on
to yield more revenue.

5) The national council of the Chinese people for armed self-defence e-
lected by the delegates of workers, peasants, soldiers, students, merchants.
This council is the supreme organ directing all activities connected with
the national war against Japan. Membership of the council should be deter-
mined by public bodies (anti-Japanese organizations, trade unions, etc.)
at a mass meeting or a congress. Provincial councils are elected in the
same way. Local councils are respectively chosen by mass meetings of factories,
villages, mines, students, etc.
The national council has full power to carry out all measures connected with
the movement for armed self-defence.
pages.zh:
2
是一场为了中国独立和领土完整的战争，是一场拯救四亿人的战争，简而言之，是一场神圣的战争，将世界四分之一的人口从“亡国奴”的命运中拯救出来。

但是，由于这样一场神圣的民族战争缺乏一个共同的具体纲领，我们抗击日本帝国主义的行动一直是零星且无效的。在此，我们可以举一些例子稍作说明，如抗日义勇军、抗日救国军以及在满洲和热河英勇抗击日本强盗的抗日游击队。同样，我们的兄弟姐妹也进行了许多值得赞扬的反对日本帝国主义的斗争：如工人罢工、学生罢课、示威和抵制日货。但到目前为止，我们未能阻挡日军对我们的推进，更不用说收复失地了。因此，我们提出几点建议，认为对于中国人民对日作战行动的推进绝对必要。

1) 动员所有陆、海、空军力量投入对日作战。中国的常备军是世界上规模最大的。除警察和民团外，和平时期的正规军官兵人数达300万。空军虽然薄弱，却消耗了民众捐税的大部分。特别是在过去几年中，海军和空军的拨款一直在增加。出资供养军队的人民当然有权要求在对日战争中将所有陆、海、空军派往前线，要求立即停止内战。但是，众所周知，仅靠军队不足以胜任此任务。因此：

2) 动员全体人民。起初志愿入伍较为可取，但后来必须实行征兵制，将数百万人纳入一系列志愿军队伍（例如，工人志愿军、农民志愿军、学生、商人、医生、记者、教师志愿军等）。这些志愿者必须立即被派往前线抗击日军。此外，还必须组织供应、运输、护理、破坏、宣传等队伍，吸纳广大民众参与。

3) 武装全体人民。为此，必须要求南京政府将兵工厂或仓库中从机枪到中式大刀的所有武器移交给抗日志愿者，用于训练和作战。如果当局拒绝交出武器，人民必须自行取出这些武器。当然，如有需要，也可以从国外进口武器弹药。

4) 筹措对日作战经费。财政问题必须按以下思路进行调查：
首先，没收所有在华日本企业（银行、工厂、铁路、轮船、矿山及日货），按当前汇率计算，价值达20亿中国货币元。停止支付日本贷款（也是一笔巨款）。没收所有汉奸的财产。将所有收入用于战争经费。征收累进财产税。向国内外中国人以及外国同情者募集资金。
如果实施这些措施，至少在第一阶段将产生足够的战争经费。以后可以 devise 其他措施以获取更多收入。

5) 由工人、农民、士兵、学生、商人代表选举产生的中国人民武装自卫会全国委员会。该委员会是指导所有与对日民族战争相关活动的最高机构。委员会成员应由公共团体（抗日组织、工会等）在群众大会或代表大会上确定。省级委员会以同样方式选举产生。地方委员会分别由工厂、村庄、矿山、学生等的群众会议选出。
全国委员会拥有执行与武装自卫运动相关的所有措施的充分权力。

pages.en:
6) Alliance with all enemies of Japanese imperialism. In this regard
we must first of all ally ourselves th with the Korians, Formosans, Mongo-
lians, natives of the islands under Japanese mandate and All other nation-
alities oppressed by Japanese imperialism, in the same way we must join
hands with the revolutionary workers, peasant, soldiers and intellectuals
who carry on heroic struggle against the Mikado and Japanese imperialism,
to the end that we may crush our common enemy by concerted action.
At the same time we proclaim to the whole world that we regard as the
friends of the Chinese nation those countries or nations
which maintain a sympathetic attitude, or observe a friendly neutrality, or
even give a helping hand vis-a-vis the anti-Japanese war waged by the Chine-
se people, whereas those nations or countries which assist Japanese imperi-
alism in the fight against China or in imitation of Japanese robbers grab
Chinese territory in a scramble are certainly to be considered as comrades
of Japanese imperialism and as enemies of the Chinese people.

The six points enumerated above are the most fundamental of all, even
though they do not embrace all the prerequisites for the organization of a
people's war against Japan. With the six points put into effect, we are
sure that we can carry on the war.

We appeal to all our brothers, all those who want to lead a human life
but not that of a slave without a country under brute rule, immediately
to discuss this programme in private conversations, at open air meetings
or delegate conference in the factories, mines, railways, steamboats,
schools, villages, shops and offices, barracks, etc; to carry the program
into effect by organising anti-Japanese associations, volunteers and commi-
ttees collecting money for Manchurian volunteers; to take concrete steps
for the popularisation and realisation of this programme on a nation-wide
scale.

We have the unflinching belief that the enforcement of the programme
just enunciated assures us the possibility of staving off further
Japanese attacks and recovering all lost territories in Manchuria, Jehol.
Chahar, etc, but results in the complete wreckage of all Japanese imperia-
list influences in China.

The Holy War of the Chinese People against Japan Forever!

Liberation of Greater China Forever!

The Preparatory Committee of
THE COUNCIL OF THE CHINESE PEOPLE
FOR ARMED SELF-DEFENCE

SPONSORS....................

ADHERENTS.................
pages.zh:
6) 与日本帝国主义的所有敌人结盟。在这方面，我们首先必须与朝鲜人、台湾人、蒙古人、日本委任统治岛屿的原住民以及所有受日本帝国主义压迫的其他民族结盟；同样，我们必须与那些反对天皇和日本帝国主义并进行英勇斗争的革命工人、农民、士兵和知识分子携手合作，以便通过协同行动粉碎我们的共同敌人。
同时，我们向全世界宣告，我们将那些对中国人民进行的对日战争持同情态度、保持友好中立、甚至伸出援手的国家或民族视为中华民族的朋友；而那些在对华战争中协助日本帝国主义，或模仿日本强盗在争夺中攫取中国领土的国家或民族，则肯定被视为日本帝国主义的同伙和中国人民的敌人。

上述六点是最基本的，尽管它们并未涵盖组织人民对日战争的所有先决条件。一旦落实这六点，我们确信我们能够进行这场战争。

我们呼吁所有兄弟，所有那些希望过人的生活而不是在野蛮统治下做亡国奴的人，立即在工厂、矿山、铁路、轮船、学校、村庄、商店和办公室、兵营等地的私人谈话、露天集会或代表会议上讨论这一纲领；通过组织抗日协会、志愿者和为满洲义勇军筹款的委员会来实施该纲领；采取具体步骤，在全国范围内推广和实现这一纲领。

我们坚信，执行刚刚阐述的纲领，使我们有可能阻止日本的进一步攻击，并收复满洲、热河、察哈尔等地的所有失地，并将彻底摧毁日本帝国主义在中国的所有影响。

中国人民对日神圣战争万岁！

大中华解放万岁！

中国人民武装自卫会筹备委员会

发起人....................

拥护者.................

A STATEMENT OF THE WAR AGAINST JAPAN
Made by the Preparatory Commission of
the Armed Self-Defence Committee of
the Chinese People on June 20, 1934

The downright surrender of the Kuomintang to Japanese imperialism which
has gone so far as to recognise Manchukuo by the resumption of railway and
postal service scheduled for July 1, 1934, has called forth a storm of
protests from the masses, followed by the formation of THE ARMED SELF-
DEFENCE COMMITTEE sponsored by the mass of people who do not want to lead
a life of the slave without a country but will do their best to uphold the
independence of China against increasing aggressions of Japanese imperial-
ism in China. Following is a translation of the declaration of the prepara-
tory commission (under the armed self-defence committee of the Chinese
people) made on June 20, 1934——M.

To Brothers & Sisters of the Whole Land
c/o the Chinese Press & Public Bodies.

The Chinese people are experiencing an unprecedented acute crisis. 400,000,
000 compatriots must make a choice of life or death right now!
Brutal Japanese imperialism has occupied Manchuria and North China while
British and French imperialism, casting a covetous eye on our Northwest and
Southeast, have been racing troops to march on our territory. During the nine-
ty years following the Opium War we lost more than 2,000,000 square miles in
territory but the land seized by Japanese imperialism during the past two or
three years is twice as large. Now one fifth of Chinese territory has definitely
gone while one sixth of the Chinese population is downtrodden under the feet
of Japanese and other imperialists.

The Manchurian-Mongolian Empire

Having obtained recognition from the Tangu agreement, the puppet Manchu-
kuo which was launched into life by Japanese bayonets has gone a step further
by assuming the title of the Manchurian-Mongolian Empire. Now it is loudly
clamouring for "the recovery of lost territory", meaning thereby to march into
the territory lying inside of the Great Wall. With feverish military prepara-
tions going on, it embarks on an adventure to "swallow" the whole of China and
to hand over our 400,000,000 compatriots to Japanese imperialism for perpetual
enslavement.
No longer contented with the notorious demands, 21 in number (presented to
China in 1915——Ed.), Japanese imperialism has openly, with the full consent of
Chinese traitors through a series of conversations, proclaimed to the world that
China is a protectorate of Japan. With this end in view, Japanese imperialism has
been and is making large scale military preparations for north and south China,
and more important still, sent Akira Ariyoshi, Japanese minister to China, back
to Nanking in order to open Sino-Japanese negotiations under some 200 conditions
entrusted to Ariyoshi. These negotiations, when attended with success, will mean
a death knell for China.
Brothers! Before the Chinese people are laid two diametrically opposite roads:
either the road to final imperialist dismemberment and international control, be-
coming thereby chained to imperialism as slaves; or the road to the overthrow of im-
perialism and the achievement of China's independence and liberation. At this criti-
cal juncture our compatriots must rise and wage a life and death struggle against
our brothers in Manchuria who are now living like cattle under Mikado rule.
Behold! there is not the slightest protection for the lives and property of mil-
lions of Chinese residing in Manchuria. All the basic industries and enter-
prises have been confiscated. Chinese peasants have been robbed of their fertile
land by the so-called armed immigrants from Japan. Only recently have Japanese
bandits of Ilan and six other hsien and drowned 17 villages in blood. Genocidal law
has been resorted to for the construction of highways, railways and aerodromes. Any-
one who dares to voice a protest is surely beaten or summarily executed. The
introduction of conscription and the organisation of local militia will turn our

中国人民武装自卫委员会筹备委员会
于一九三四年六月二十日发表的
对日作战宣言

国民党向日本帝国主义彻底投降，甚至通过定于1934年7月1日恢复铁路和邮政服务来承认伪满洲国，此举引发了民众的抗议风暴，随后由不愿过亡国奴生活、决心尽力维护中国独立以对抗日本帝国主义在华日益加剧的侵略的广大群众赞助，成立了武装自卫委员会。以下是中国人民武装自卫委员会筹备委员会于1934年6月20日发表的宣言译文——M.

致全国同胞
转交中国新闻界及公共团体。

中国人民正经历着前所未有的严重危机。四亿同胞此刻必须做出生死抉择！
残暴的日本帝国主义已占领满洲和华北，而英法帝国主义则觊觎我国西北和东南，正调兵遣将进犯我国领土。鸦片战争后的九十年间，我们丧失了两百多万平方英里的领土，但过去两三年间被日本帝国主义攫取的土地面积是其两倍。如今，中国五分之一的领土已确切丧失，六分之一的人口在日本及其他帝国主义的铁蹄下受尽蹂躏。

满蒙帝国

凭借《塘沽协定》获得的承认，由日本刺刀扶植起来的傀儡政权伪满洲国更进一步，自称为“满蒙帝国”。现在它高声叫嚣“收复失地”，意即进军长城以内的领土。随着疯狂的军事准备正在进行，它着手进行“吞并”整个中国的冒险，并将我们四亿同胞交给日本帝国主义永久奴役。
日本帝国主义不再满足于臭名昭著的“二十一条”要求（1915年向中国提出——编者注），而是通过一系列会谈，在中国叛徒的完全同意下，向世界公然宣称中国是日本的保护国。为此目的，日本帝国主义一直并在继续为华北和华南进行大规模军事准备，更重要的是，派遣日本驻华公使有吉明（Akira Ariyoshi）返回南京，以便在有吉明受托的大约200项条件基础上开启中日谈判。这些谈判若成功，将意味着中国的丧钟敲响。
兄弟们！摆在中国人民面前的是两条截然相反的道路：要么走向最终被帝国主义肢解和国际共管，从而像奴隶一样被锁在帝国主义身上；要么走向推翻帝国主义，实现中国的独立和解放。在这危急关头，我们的同胞必须奋起，与那些在天皇统治下如牲畜般生活的满洲兄弟并肩，进行生死斗争。
看吧！居住在满洲的数百万中国人的生命财产毫无保障可言。所有基础工业和企业均被没收。中国农民的肥沃土地被所谓的日本武装移民掠夺。就在最近，依兰等六个县的日本匪徒血洗了17个村庄。在修建公路、铁路和机场时，采取了种族灭绝式的法律。任何敢于表示抗议的人必定遭到殴打或就地处决。实行征兵制和组织地方民团，将使我们在

fellow nationals in Manchuria simply into cannon-fodder for Japanese imperialism
and the puppet state, or force them to carry on an internecine war among ourselves.
Considerable commotion has been caused by impressment of coolies and requisition
of carts, wagons, provision and forage. And the crushing burden of taxation
and unlimited usury have brought unspeakable misery on the mass of people.

Japanese brutalities

There has been launched the most brutal campaign against the anti-Japanese
volunteers, whole villages bombarded, the masses murdered in cold blood or buried
alive. Sometime in May Japanese troops descended on Panshih and attacked the
volunteers there, setting fire to scores of villages, killing the refugees by the
thousand. When taken prisoner, officers and men of the anti-Japanese volunteers
were bayonetted throughout the whole body, torn to pieces by bombs purposely
laid in the trousers of the captives, or eaten up by the dogs, or stoned to
death, etc.
Arms in possession of the people have been seized, more than 5,100,000 rifles
confiscated in Laoning, Kirin and Heilungkiang. Now five provinces in east Man-
churia have been ordered to surrender some 100,000 rifles. Oppositionists have been
threatened with death. Even kitchen knives are limited in number. Several house-
holds can have only one knife in common. Japanese imperialism and its puppet
carry on exploitation of the people by disarming them totally.
The Pao-kia (headmen in the village, usually of the Tuhao class---Ed.) sys-
tem has been put into wide practice throughout Manchuria. Census is taken from
time to time in accordance with the notorious 'ten household mutual guaranty'
regulations. Any able-bodied Chinese found missing in a certain household will
be taken as having joined the volunteers, his families arrested and punished,
his house burned down. The order-preserving committee, the village-purifying
committee, the regulations governing village-purification, stringent martial
law, the house-to-house search, etc., have created a reign of terror among the
populace and attempted to force the people to meek submission.
Under Japanese and Manchukuo rule advanced ideas have been outlawed and the
study of modern science forbidden. The curricula are limited to such rotten
stuff as respect for the king and restoration of monarch. The study of the Ja-
panese language has been made compulsory and the school boy required to recite
names of the Japanese Mikados. Needless to say, such slave education is calcu-
lated to make submissive slaves out of the people in Manchuria.
Brothers and sisters! Millions of our fellow men in Manchuria are leading
an intolerable life under oppression, exploitation, massacre, enslavement, rape
and humiliation, just like man without a country.
The most criminal Japanese imperialism is now endeavoring to use the same
cruel methods to North China and even to the whole of China.

Laying Hands on China Proper

With troops stationed in the twenty haiens situated within the demilitariz-
ed zone, the police and administrative power has practically fallen into the
hands of the Japanese. Publishing houses in these haiens are required to give
a guaranty pledging to refrain from anti-Japanese propaganda and from anti-
Manchukuo agitation. They will be sealed if they violate this rule. Pedestrains
are searched everywhere by Japanese patrols. Manoeuvres of Japanese troops and
planes have struck a terror into the hearts of the populace. Japanese spies
have penetrated far into Chahar, Suiyuan, Shansi, Shantung, etc., without meet-
ing the slightest difficulty just like a man entering a deserted house. A big
airdrome has been built in Tientsin for the Japs, covering some 4,000 mou of
land. North China has apparently become a second Manchukuo.
After receiving a satisfactory answer to the questions of through rail com-
munication and postal service between China and Manchuria, Japanese imperialism
regards the recognition of Manchukuo as settled. Thus encouraged, it is getting
ready to swallow the whole of China. To make good the hands off declaration
made on April 17, the Japanese minister Ariyoshi has returned to China, bring-
ing with him a plan to get hold of the whole land under the camouflage of ne-
gotiations.
As a result of the suppression of the anti-Japanese boycott movement Japanese
wares are flooding our market, driving out the so-called national goods, not
only in north China but in the Yangtse Valley as well. Meanwhile the Japanese
offensive on the financial front is also threatening. Japanese financiers have
come to China on an important mission to adjust the outstanding debts,
including the notorious Nishihara loans. The 'experts' shore' conference in Taiwan (Formosa)
pages.zh:
2
满洲的同胞仅仅成为日本帝国主义和傀儡政权的炮灰，或迫使我们进行内战。
强征苦力和征用车辆、马车、粮食及草料引起了相当大的骚动。沉重的赋税负担和无限制的高利贷给广大民众带来了难以言喻的苦难。

日本的暴行

针对抗日义勇军发动了最残酷的战役，整个村庄遭到轰炸，群众被冷血屠杀或活埋。五月某时，日军突袭磐石，袭击那里的义勇军，烧毁数十个村庄，杀害数千名难民。抗日义勇军的官兵一旦被俘，便全身被刺刀捅穿，被故意塞入俘虏裤中的炸弹炸得粉碎，或被狗吃掉，或被石头砸死，等等。
民众持有的武器被收缴，在辽宁、吉林和黑龙江没收了超过5,100,000支步枪。现在，东满五省已被命令上缴约10万支步枪。反对者受到死亡威胁。甚至菜刀的数量也受到限制。几户人家只能共用一把刀。日本帝国主义及其傀儡通过彻底解除民众武装来剥削人民。
保甲制度（村中头目，通常属于土豪阶层——编者注）已在满洲广泛推行。根据臭名昭著的“十户连保”规定，不时进行人口普查。若某户中发现任何适龄男子失踪，即被视为加入义勇军，其家属将被逮捕和惩罚，房屋将被烧毁。治安维持会、清乡委员会、清乡条例、严厉的戒严令、挨户搜查等，在民众中制造了恐怖统治，并试图迫使人民顺从屈服。
在日本和伪满洲国的统治下，先进思想被定为非法，现代科学研究被禁止。课程仅限于尊王复古之类的腐朽内容。学习日语成为必修课，要求学生背诵日本天皇的名字。不用说，这种奴化教育旨在将满洲人民变成顺从的奴隶。
兄弟姐妹们！我们在满洲的数百万同胞在压迫、剥削、屠杀、奴役、强奸和侮辱下过着无法忍受的生活，就像没有国家的人一样。
罪恶深重的日本帝国主义正企图将同样的残酷手段用于华北，甚至全中国。

染指中国内地

由于在非军事区内的二十个县驻扎了军队，警察和行政权力实际上已落入日本人手中。这些县的出版机构被要求提供保证，承诺不进行反日宣传和反伪满洲国煽动。违反此规则者将被查封。行人到处受到日本巡逻队的搜查。日军和飞机的演习使民众心中充满恐惧。日本间谍已深入察哈尔、绥远、山西、山东等地，未遇丝毫阻碍，如同进入无人居住的房屋。天津为日本人建造了一个大型机场，占地约4000亩。华北显然已成为第二个伪满洲国。
在对中国与满洲之间直通铁路和邮政服务的问题得到满意答复后，日本帝国主义认为承认伪满洲国一事已定。受此鼓舞，它正准备吞并整个中国。为了落实4月17日发表的“放手”声明，日本公使有吉明已返回中国，带来了一项以谈判为伪装来控制整个国土的计划。
由于镇压抗日抵制运动，日本商品泛滥于我国市场，不仅在华北，在长江流域也排挤了所谓的国货。同时，日本在金融战线上的攻势也构成威胁。日本金融家带着调整包括臭名昭著的西原借款在内的未偿债务的重要使命来到中国。台湾（福尔摩沙）的“专家”会议

The Japanese demand for Amoy and Shantuo has been presented. Feverish preparations are being made to take Fukien and Kwangtung. The Japanese plot to threat south China by sending aeroplanes to fly over Kwangsi and Hunan has been laid bare, more than ever. The recent disappearance of the Japanese vice consul at Nanking, Kuramoto, is but another Japanese attempt to pick up a pretext for a major offensive. All these point to the Japanese ambition to annex the whole of China.

Make a Decision Just Now

Fellow compatriots! Japanese imperialism is directing its gun at the people of the whole country. The danger of collapse and partition is looming right before our eyes. Now time is up for us to ask ourselves whether we are willing or unwilling to be slaves without a country. If we are unwilling, then we must give up all illusions of relying on the government and fight the Japs with our own strength and resources in order to work out our own salvation. Just at present moment the Chinese people have no other alternative but to fight. War on Japan requires removal of all obstacles standing in the way.

The first and foremost is the non-resistance policy which accelerates the Japanese aggressions and brings about the national crisis confronting China. Marshall Chang Hsueh-liang, who is responsible for the defence of the country with several hundreds of thousands of troops under his command ran for life as soon as he heard of the Mukden coup, retreating for the moment into Chinchow, then to Peiping inside the Great Wall, finally taking a trip to Italy as a traveller. In face of more violent Japanese aggressions in North China our Marshall transferred all his troops from the north to the south immediately upon his return from abroad, definitely abandoning Manchuria and North China to the enemy. Gen. Tang Yu-ling yielded the strategical points in Jehol to the advancing Japs within barely a week, thus beating the world record in speed for the loss of territory. Yes, more guilty than Tang Yu-ling is another general who is slaughtering Chinese toilers on a mass scale in a big campaign without, however, firing one shot at Japanese imperialism, although he has some 1,000,000 men under his command. For this reason, a war on Japan requires abandonment of non-resistance.

The second obstacle is confidence placed in the league of nations, approaching the imperialist powers with the request of upholding justice. Since the Manchurian incident all faithful lackeys of imperialism have stuck to the view that the dispute shall be settled in accordance with the covenants of the league of nations and the nine power treaty. But, in fact, the league of nations and the imperialist powers have never adopted measures really directed against Japanese imperialism. The much advertised Lytton report merely mentions the impossibility of making any change in the status quo of Manchuria, supporting the Japanese seizure but suggesting international control over Manchuria. Recently, the league of nations virtually gave de facto recognition to Manchukuo by subscribing to the arrangements of postal communication with the puppet but, at the same time, regarding it as only 'technical'. The British march on Pan-hung and south Sinkiang, the British invasion of Tibet and Sikong, the French seizure of the Coral Islands and south Yunnan, the exchange of notes between Japan and America, all such facts are a clear proof of imperialist attempt at the partition of China. Reliance on the league of nations or any imperialist power for aid is tantamount to 'taking the enemy for father'. For this reason, a war on Japan must needs part company with all illusions on imperialism for possible help.

The Pro-Japanese Traitors

In the third place, the pro-Japanese policy of the betrayers is another impediment. These betrayers insist on surrender to Japanese imperialism in the shortest time possible, then all is well. In their view the Wan-pao-shan incident (forerunner of the Mukden coup——Ed.) might have been averted were it not for the premature death of Yuan Shi-kai (president of China 1911-15——Ed.) which prevented the 21 demands from being realised much earlier; the 21 demands should have been recognised right on the day of the Mukden coup; Manchukuo should have been recognised long since in order to forestall the present national crisis. Finally, the betrayers advocate submission to Japan as its protectorate, accepting all the 200 demands presented by Japan.

Thus, the fault lies with Japanese imperialism but with the Chinese people who should have capitulated much earlier. Here is the summary view of the traitors. A war on Japan requires denunciation of this most disgraceful policy of the pro-Japanese traitors, who sabotaged the war on Japan before.

Finally comes the theory of 'salvation by reconstruction', a theory that the recovery of a defunct China provided we proceed fairly good reconstruction, the fall of a country mattering little. But what is to be
pages.zh:
3
日本已提出对厦门和汕头（Shantuo）的要求。正紧锣密鼓地准备夺取福建和广东。日本企图派遣飞机飞越广西和湖南以威胁华南的阴谋，比以往任何时候都更加暴露无遗。最近日本驻南京副领事仓本（Kuramoto，音译）的失踪，不过是日本人为发动大规模进攻寻找借口的又一次尝试。所有这些都指向日本吞并整个中国的野心。

现在就做出决定

同胞们！日本帝国主义正将枪口对准全国人民。崩溃和被瓜分的危险就在我们眼前。现在是时候问问自己，我们是否愿意成为亡国奴了。如果我们不愿意，那么我们必须放弃依赖政府的一切幻想，依靠我们自己的力量和资源与日本人作战，以求得自救。目前，中国人民别无选择，只有战斗。对日作战需要清除一切阻碍。

首当其冲的是不抵抗政策，它加速了日本的侵略，并导致了中国面临的民族危机。负责国防、麾下拥有数十万大军的张学良将军，一听到沈阳事变的消息便逃命，先退至锦州，随后退至关内的北平，最后以旅行者身份前往意大利。面对华北更激烈的日本侵略，我们的这位将军从国外回来后，立即将其部队从北方调往南方，明确地将满洲和华北拱手让给敌人。汤玉麟将军在不到一周的时间内就将热河的战略要地让给了进逼的日军，从而创下了丧失领土速度的世界纪录。是的，比汤玉麟罪责更重的是另一位将军，他指挥着约100万大军，却未向日本帝国主义开过一枪，反而在一场大规模战役中屠杀中国劳工。因此，对日作战必须放弃不抵抗政策。

第二个障碍是寄希望于国际联盟，乞求帝国主义列强主持公道。自满洲事变以来，帝国主义的忠实仆从们一直坚持认为，争端应根据国际联盟盟约和九国公约来解决。但事实上，国际联盟和帝国主义列强从未采取真正针对日本帝国主义的措施。大肆宣传的李顿调查报告仅提及改变满洲现状的不可能性，支持日本的占领，但建议对满洲实行国际管制。最近，国际联盟通过与伪满政权签订邮政通信安排，实际上给予了对满洲国的既成事实承认，尽管同时称这仅是“技术性”的。英国进军潘洪（Pan-hung，音译）和南疆，英国入侵西藏和西康（Sikong，音译），法国夺取珊瑚群岛和滇南，以及日美之间的换文，所有这些事实都清楚地证明了帝国主义企图瓜分中国。依赖国际联盟或任何帝国主义强国提供援助，无异于“认贼作父”。因此，对日作战必须与对帝国主义可能提供援助的一切幻想决裂。

亲日汉奸

第三，卖国贼的亲日政策是另一个障碍。这些卖国贼坚持认为，应尽快向日本帝国主义投降，这样万事大吉。在他们看来，如果不是袁世凯（1911-1915年任中国总统——编者注）过早去世，致使“二十一条”未能更早实现，万宝山事件（沈阳事变的前奏——编者注）本可以避免；在沈阳事变当天就应承认“二十一条”；早就应承认满洲国，以防止目前的民族危机。最后，卖国贼主张作为日本的保护国向其屈服，接受日本提出的全部200项要求。

因此，过错不在于日本帝国主义，而在于本应更早投降的中国人民。这就是卖国贼的总体观点。对日作战需要谴责这些亲日卖国贼的最可耻政策，他们此前破坏了对日战争。

最后是“建设救国”论，这种理论认为，只要我们进行相当好的建设，即使国家灭亡也无妨，中国仍可复兴。但是，要

pages.en:
4
constructed? How to carry on the reconstruction work? In spite of the claims
for reconstruction national industries have shown a greater slump, and a gen-
eral rural collapse is already in sight. Every year the excess of imports over
exports amounts to some $800,000,000. Out of the total budget only less than
had been applied to reconstructive enterprises. At present reconstruction is
restricted to non-productive military roads, motor roads and small sized rail-
ways but one third of our railways has been lost with Manchuria. We can not pre-
serve existing industries, much less talk about future reconstruction. So long
as imperialist forces exist to partition and wreck China, our recovery is ab-
solutely impossible. So long as the campaign of Chinese feudal elements and mi-
litarists continues against the masses, reconstruction can not be started. This
is a simple truth known to every body. Thus, the talk of reconstruction instead
of resistance to Japan is but a camouflage for surrender to Japanese imperial-
ism. We must expose this talk of reconstruction as a smoke screen for betrayal
if we decide on a war against Japanese imperialism.
Finally, we must expose the defeatist agitation of the traitors who have
advanced the theory that China is too impotent to resist Japan. As to man-power
China has 400,000,000 nearly six times as much as Japan. As to the fighting
force China has far more troops than Japan, nay, more than any other country in
the world. Added to this is the simple truth, confirmed time and again by his-
tory, that the outcome of a holy national revolutionary war does not depend on
military technique alone.
In the struggle for independence the thirteen original states in North A-
merica beat England with an army that was ill-equipped. Right after the October
Revolution the Soviet Union beat off the armed intervention of 14 states with
modern military equipment and technique. British imperialism trembled before
the Canton-Hong-Kong strike of 1925 which reduced the British colony to a 'dead'
port. 1927 witnessed the retrocession of the British concessions in Hankow and
Kiukiang under the overwhelming pressure of the masses who enthusiastically sup-
ported the northern expeditionary forces along the Yangtse river. In 1932 the
masses of Shanghai and the poor-equipped 19th route army administered deadly
blows to the crack land, naval and air forces of Japan, and made it impossible for
them to occupy Chinese territory at Shanghai. The fighting along the passes of
the Great Wall dealt crushing blows to Japanese and Manchurian troops. The vo-
lunteers in Manchuria and Jehol fought stubbornly and successfully against the
series of 'punitive expeditions' launched by Japanese imperialism. Women with
babies in their arms also took an active part in fighting against the Japs and
puppets, Japanese and Manchurian troops, being thus made weary, met with re-
verses (yes, serious reverses). The Japs have recently abandoned their attempt
at confiscating the arms of the people as a result of the heroic resistance of
the volunteers in Liao and other six hsiens. Are these not living realities?
They prove beyond doubt that if we can mobilise the masses to join and continue
the holy anti-Japanese national revolutionary war we are 100% sure to beat back
Japanese imperialism. We must fight against defeatism in a war on Japan.
Of course victory can not be secured by taking a chance, the more so when
have to fight so formidable an enemy as Japanese imperialism. In order to win
the war we must, above all, pin our faith in victory. This is insufficient. And
we must have a united front, more concrete methods of action and a more clear-
cut programme. In the past there were advocates of resistance to Japan, and many
anti-Japanese battles were actually fought. Yet, none the less, we have to make
more efforts to regain our lost territory and drive the Japanese invaders out
of China. Among the many causes lying back of it one stands out prominent which
is the lack of an integral plan and a common programme of action, each inclining
to fight single-handed.

The New Programme

Considering this as a weakness, we have discussed the matter thoroughly with
a legion of fellow patriots and drawn up the 'basic programme of the Chinese
people in a war against Japan' which has been widely popularised and brought up
for thorough discussion with those who endorse it. The programme received support
in wide circles in barely a month's time. That it was signed by thousands
of people at Shanghai clearly shows that it is the only way to national salva-
tion. We deem it necessary to proclaim this programme to our brothers of the
entire country.
We appeal to all our brothers, patriots as well as those who do not wish to
be slaves without a country to support this anti-Japanese war programme, to
form the anti-Japanese united front and to wage the holy national revolutionary
war for China's independence, liberation and territorial integrity.
All officers and men in land, naval and air forces: Every military is duty
bound to defend the country with arms. Now you got to serve the country and
fight the enemy when China is overrun by Japanese invaders. The defence of Shang-
hai, the fighting along the Great Wall and the series of mutinies in Manchurian

建设什么？如何开展建设工作？尽管声称要进行建设，但民族工业显示出更大的衰退，普遍的农村崩溃已近在眼前。每年进口超过出口的差额高达约8亿美元。在总预算中，用于建设企业的资金不到一小部分。目前，建设仅限于非生产性的军用公路、汽车道和小型铁路，但随着满洲的丧失，我国三分之一的铁路已经丢失。我们无法保留现有的工业，更谈不上未来的重建。只要存在瓜分和破坏中国的帝国主义势力，我们的复兴就绝对不可能。只要中国封建势力和军阀继续对民众进行镇压，重建就无法开始。这是一个人人皆知的简单真理。因此，空谈建设而不抵抗日本，不过是对向日本帝国主义投降的伪装。如果我们决定对日本帝国主义作战，就必须揭露这种作为背叛烟幕的建设论调。
最后，我们必须揭露卖国贼的失败主义煽动，他们提出了中国太弱小无法抵抗日本的理论。就人力而言，中国拥有4亿人口，几乎是日本的六倍。就战斗力而言，中国的军队远多于日本，甚至多于世界上任何其他国家。此外，还有一个被历史反复证实的简单真理：神圣的民族革命战争的结局并不仅仅取决于军事技术。
在争取独立的斗争中，北美最初的十三个州凭借装备简陋的军队击败了英国。十月革命后，苏联击退了14个国家凭借现代军事装备和技术进行的武装干涉。1925年的省港大罢工使英国殖民地变成一个“死”港，令英国帝国主义为之颤抖。1927年，在热情支持沿长江北伐军的民众的巨大压力下，见证了汉口和九江英租界的收回。1932年，上海民众和装备简陋的第十九路军对日本的精锐陆海空军给予了致命打击，使其无法在上海占领中国领土。长城各关口的战斗给日军和伪满军队以沉重打击。满洲和热河的义勇军顽强而成功地对抗了日本帝国主义发动的一系列“讨伐行动”。怀抱婴儿的妇女也积极参与抗击日军和伪军，使日军和伪满军队疲惫不堪，遭受挫折（是的，严重的挫折）。由于辽东及其他六县义勇军的英勇抵抗，日本人最近放弃了没收民间武器的企图。这些难道不是活生生的现实吗？它们毫无疑问地证明，如果我们能动员民众加入并持续进行神圣的反日民族革命战争，我们就百分之百能够击退日本帝国主义。在对日战争中，我们必须反对失败主义。
当然，胜利不能靠碰运气获得，尤其是当我们要对抗日本帝国主义如此强大的敌人时。为了赢得战争，我们首先必须坚信胜利。但这还不够。我们必须有一个统一战线，更具体的行动方法和更清晰的纲领。过去曾有主张抗日的人，也确实进行了许多抗日战斗。然而，尽管如此，我们仍需付出更多努力来收复失地并将日本侵略者赶出中国。在众多原因中，有一个尤为突出，那就是缺乏整体计划和共同的行动纲领，各方倾向于各自为战。

新纲领

鉴于这是一个弱点，我们与众多爱国同胞进行了充分讨论，制定了“中国人民对日作战基本纲领”，该纲领已广泛传播，并与支持者进行了彻底讨论。该纲领在短短一个月内就获得了广泛阶层的支持。在上海有数千人签署，这清楚地表明它是民族救亡的唯一途径。我们认为有必要向全国同胞宣布这一纲领。
我们呼吁所有同胞，无论是爱国者还是那些不愿成为亡国奴的人，支持这一抗日战争纲领，组成抗日统一战线，为中国的独立、解放和领土完整而进行神圣的民族革命战争。
陆海空军全体官兵：每个军人都有义务用武器保卫国家。现在，当中国被日本侵略者蹂躏时，你们必须为国效力，抗击敌人。上海保卫战、长城沿线的战斗以及满洲发生的一系列兵变

army have set glorious examples of the patriotism of the military. We hope that
you, the military in our country, hold high the banner of the anti-Japanese
war and follow the example of our martyrs to fight for the glory of the exis-
tence of the Chinese nation. We appeal to you to stop at once the internecine
civil war and to go with the entire land, naval and air forces to North China
and Manchuria to fight shoulder to shoulder with the tough volunteers and lo-
cal populace against Japanese imperialism and its puppet, to recover our lost
territory by ousting the Japs and Manchurian lackeys and to rescue millions of
our brothers from acute misery.

Turning to Patriots

Patriots of the whole country! The war against Japan requires mobilization
of the whole body of people in addition to existing troops. The old adage that
"Every body is responsible for the rise or fall of a nation" still holds good.
Japanese bandit robbers direct their guns point-blankly against each of us. The down-
fall or survival of China entirely depends on whether we, the whole body of ci-
tizens, perform our duty in defending the country by a general mobilization
for the war against Japanese imperialism.
We appeal to every honest citizen and all patriots to rise and 'wash', this
national disgrace. Give money or provision if one can, give rifles or service
if one can, each contributing as much as he can, all for the holy war against
Japan! The whole body of people, regardless of sex and age, should not watch
merely with folded hands and hold aloof. War organisations shall be formed,
composed of various categories of people. To this end the following corps shall
be called into existence: reconnoitring, transport, communications, comfort,
nurse, funds-collecting, agitation, anti-Japanese boycott, severing relations,
disturbing the enemy, wrecking the enemy's military works, arresting the ene-
my's spies, fighting the Japs everywhere. The volunteer units as organised by
the workers, peasants, students, merchants, etc, are a necessity for the war
against Japan by mobilization of the entire people. They must march to the
front immediately. The anti-Japanese bloody battles of the Manchurian volun-
teers during the past two or three years have considerably raised the ability
of self-defence of our people and displayed encouraging spirit in protection of
the country, examples that ought to be followed by us in furthering our holy
cause of the anti-Japanese war.
Brothers and sisters! As the war on Japan requires the arming of the en-
tire people, we must demand from the government all the weapons stored in ar-
senals and magazines, or bought from abroad to fight the Japs. On refusal we
must take the weapons by ourselves. The arms turned out by the Hukden arsenal
of Chang Hsuch-liang and the great number of his aeroplanes bought with the
blood and sweat of the people, instead of being used to arm the masses, were
handed over to Japan for the massacre of our brothers in Manchuria. Our mili-
tary expenditure has been growing from day to day. The host of planes bought
with our contributions under the plea of 'salvation by aviation' have, up to
the present, all been held back from the war against Japan. What a painful ex-
perience! We must arm ourselves with all sorts of weapons whether stored in
military depots or owned by individuals in resisting the Japs. Thus, we can
have sufficient arms in waging the war against Japan.

The War Expenses

In our programme we have suggested adoption of many measures to finance
the anti-Japanese war. First of all is the confiscation of all Japanese enter-
prises in China, a measure that is perfectly just when recalling that Japan
has confiscated our property, seized our revenue and postal funds in Manchuria.
This method is being consistently applied by the Manchurian volunteers. On A-
pril 13 the volunteers in Helungkiang took some $200,000 from the Chingan
branch of the Manchukuo central bank by breaking the vaults, and used it as the
funds for fighting the Japs. Undoubtedly this is the most effective method.
Next is the suspension of payment on Japanese loans, both principal and inter-
est, which will make a huge sum available. Asked to be re-adjusted by the Japs,
our old debts to Japan are placed not less than $1,000,000,000. Why we should
pay this loan instead of using it to finance the anti-Japanese war can not be
comprehended except for the reason that we want to help the enemy. Besides, we
must confiscate the property of the traitors and collect money both at home and
abroad, among the overseas Chinese as well as foreign sympathizers. Lastly, we
introduce the progressive tax. Here are, in sum, the methods applicable for
raising money to finance the war against Japan.
Brothers and sisters! The war on Japan needs a broad united front not only
with all nationalities within the borders of China but with the oppressed na-
tionalities of Japanese imperialism as the Koreans, the Formosans, and those
in the mandated islands of the South Seas, also with the workers, peasants and
intellectuals of Japan itself who are revolutionising, in a strong and wide unit-
pages.zh:
军队树立了军人爱国主义的光辉榜样。我们希望我国军方高举抗日战旗，效法烈士，为中华民族的生存荣耀而战。我们呼吁你们立即停止自相残杀的内战，率领全部陆海空军开赴华北和满洲，与顽强的义勇军及当地民众并肩作战，对抗日本帝国主义及其傀儡，通过驱逐日寇和满洲走狗来收复失地，并将数百万同胞从深重的苦难中解救出来。

致爱国者

全国爱国者们！对日战争除了依靠现有部队外，还需要动员全体人民。“天下兴亡，匹夫有责”的古训依然适用。日本强盗的枪口直逼我们每一个人。中国的存亡完全取决于我们全体公民是否履行保卫国家的职责，进行反对日本帝国主义的全面战争动员。
我们呼吁每一位正直的公民和所有爱国者奋起“洗刷”这一国耻。有钱出钱，有粮出粮，有枪出枪，有力出力，各尽所能，一切为了神圣的抗日之战！全体人民，不分男女老幼，不应袖手旁观、置身事外。应组建由各类人员构成的战时组织。为此，应成立以下队伍：侦察、运输、通讯、慰劳、护理、募捐、宣传、抵制日货、断绝关系、扰乱敌人、破坏敌军工事、逮捕敌方间谍、处处打击日寇。由工人、农民、学生、商人等组织的志愿队是实行全民动员抗日的必要力量。他们必须立即开赴前线。过去两三年间，满洲义勇军的抗日血战极大地提高了我国人民的自卫能力，展现了保家卫国的鼓舞人心的精神，这些榜样应当被我们在推进神圣的抗日事业中所效仿。
兄弟姐妹们！由于对日战争需要武装全体人民，我们必须要求政府将储存在兵工厂和仓库中的所有武器，或从国外购买的武器，用于抗击日寇。如果遭到拒绝，我们必须自行夺取武器。张学良的汉阳兵工厂（注：原文为Hukden，疑指奉天/沈阳兵工厂，此处依音译或当时语境处理，但Hukden非标准拼写，结合上下文指张学良部）生产的武器以及他用人民血汗购买的大量飞机，没有被用来武装群众，反而交给了日本，用于屠杀我们在满洲的同胞。我们的军费开支与日俱增。以“航空救国”为名、用我们的捐款购买的大批飞机，迄今为止都被扣留，未用于抗日。这是多么痛苦的经历！在抵抗日寇时，无论是储存在军用仓库还是个人拥有的各种武器，我们都必须武装自己。这样，我们在进行抗日战争时才能拥有充足的武器。

战争经费

在我们的纲领中，我们建议采取多种措施来筹措抗日战费。首先是没收日本在华的所有企业，鉴于日本在满洲没收我们的财产、攫取我们的税收和邮政资金，这一措施是完全正义的。满洲义勇军一直在持续采用这种方法。4月13日，黑龙江的义勇军通过炸开金库，从伪满洲中央银行兴安分行取走了约20万美元，并将其用作抗日经费。毫无疑问，这是最有效的方法。其次是停止支付日本贷款的本息，这将腾出巨额资金。应日本方面要求重新调整，我们欠日本的旧债不少于10亿美元。除了我们要帮助敌人的原因外，无法理解为什么我们要偿还这笔贷款，而不是将其用于资助抗日战争。此外，我们必须没收汉奸的财产，并在国内外、包括在海外华侨和外国同情者中募集资金。最后，我们实行累进税制。综上所述，这些是筹措抗日战费的适用方法。
兄弟姐妹们！对日战争不仅需要与中国境内的所有民族建立广泛的统一战线，还需要与被日本帝国主义压迫的民族，如朝鲜人、台湾人以及南洋委任统治岛屿上的居民，以及日本本国正在革命的工人、农民和知识分子，建立一个强大而广泛的统

6
ed front against the common enemy, namely, Japanese imperialism. In Manchuria
Chinese and Korean masses are fighting shoulder to shoulder with each other
in a common struggle against Japanese imperialism and Manchukuo. At the same
time, the heroic struggles of the revolutionary workers and peasants in Japan
found their way into the Japanese army and called forth demonstra-
tions among the ranks and files against the invasion of China. Hence the con-
clusion that alliance with the enemy of Japanese imperialism is possible and
logical. The Far Eastern Anti-war Conference held last year in Shanghai bears
witness to the fact that the struggle of national liberation in China may en-
list the sympathy and aid of the anti-imperialist fighters in other countries
of the world, far from being placed in isolation. We must enlarge the anti-Ja-
panese front by establishing a close contact with all anti-Japanese elements.

The United Leadership

Finally, in the war against Japan we must set up a common leading organ in
contrast with the lack of common organisation and concerted action in the an-
ti-Japanese movement in the past, a state of things that ought to be put an end
to. We suggest the creation of an Armed Self-defence Committee of the Chinese
People to be chosen by workers, peasants, merchants, students and soldiers
as the central leading organ of the campaign against the Japs, entrusted with
the power to decide on all questions connected with the anti-Japanese campaign
as well as to exercise control over all anti-Japanese matters. All must take
a part in the committee if they do not want to be slaves without a country, if
they are ready to fight the Japs, if they endorse the anti-Japanese program
just outlined. We call on all patriots to form committees of this nature in
factories, villages, schools, shops, etc, in response to our programme, to dis-
cuss and adopt plans and measures for the war on Japan.
We suggest that on the coming September 18 (date of the Mukden coup) we
shall commemorate the day by holding a national congress as the supreme organ
of the national armed self-defence committee.
Dear brothers and sisters! We firmly believe that we can fight Japan with
the adoption of the above mentioned measures. This war is a holy one, a war
for advancement and justice. Dear brothers and sisters! Wake up and unite!
Arm yourselves under the banner of national self-defence! Fight for the inde-
pendence, liberation and territorial integrity of China!

1) DOWN WITH JAPANESE IMPERIALISM!
2) LONG LIVE THE NATIONAL REVOLUTIONARY WAR!
3) LIBERATION OF THE CHINESE PEOPLE FOREVER!

Signed by
THE ARMED SELF DEFENCE COMMITTEE OF THE CHINESE PEOPLE
The Preparatory Commission.

一战线，共同对抗共同的敌人，即日本帝国主义。在满洲，中国和朝鲜民众在反对日本帝国主义和伪满洲国的共同斗争中并肩作战。同时，日本革命工人和农民的英勇斗争渗透到了日本军队中，引发了基层士兵反对入侵中国的示威活动。因此得出结论，与日本帝国主义的敌人结盟是可能且符合逻辑的。去年在上海举行的远东反战大会证明，中国的民族解放斗争绝非孤立无援，而是可以赢得世界其他各国反帝战士的同情和援助。我们必须通过与所有抗日分子建立密切联系来扩大抗日阵线。

统一领导

最后，在抗日战争中，我们必须建立一个共同的领导机构，以改变过去抗日运动中缺乏共同组织和协调行动的局面，这种状况必须终结。我们建议成立一个由工人、农民、商人、学生和士兵选出的“中国人民武装自卫委员会”，作为抗日运动的中央领导机构，赋予其决定与抗日运动有关的所有问题以及管控所有抗日事务的权力。如果不想成为亡国奴，如果准备抗击日寇，如果赞同上述刚 outlined 的抗日纲领，所有人都应参与该委员会。我们呼吁所有爱国者在工厂、村庄、学校、商店等地响应我们的纲领，成立此类委员会，讨论并通过对日作战的计划和措施。
我们建议在即将到来的9月18日（沈阳事变纪念日），通过举行全国代表大会来纪念这一天，该大会将作为全国武装自卫委员会的最高机构。
亲爱的兄弟姐妹们！我们坚信，通过采取上述措施，我们能够战胜日本。这是一场神圣的战争，一场追求进步和正义的战争。亲爱的兄弟姐妹们！觉醒并团结起来！在民族自卫的旗帜下武装自己！为中国的独立、解放和领土完整而战！

1) 打倒日本帝国主义！
2) 民族革命战争万岁！
3) 中国人民解放万岁！

签署人
中国人民武装自卫委员会
筹备委员会。

RESCUE OUR REVOLUTIONARY LEADERS
1) Rescue Revolutionary Leaders in Distress....................p. 1

RESCUE REVOLUTIONARY LEADERS IN DISTRESS

As reported previously in our columns, a score of revolutionary lead-
ers headed by Hu Chi-chun, Lin Tse-lin, Lin Yeh-yin, etc, were arrested
by imperialist-T agents in the international settlement on June 26.
While in the imperialist prison, they bluntly refused to expose any of our
revolutionary secrets in spite of the most cruel torture at the hands of
imperialist police. On the contrary, they denounced imperialism as a curse
to the Chinese people and the Kuomintang as a traitor in the face of the
police of the international settlement. They fired a strong fusillade at
the liars of the revolutionary betrayers.

Yes, they behaved just like a genuine revolutionary leader who de-
liberately sacrificed his own life for the defence of the revolution. They
behaved before the torturers of imperialism and KMT just as heroically and
unflinchingly as the red fighters who are refused to yield an inch of So-
viet territory to the enemy (class) in the present 5th campaign now in full
swing. Precisely due to this fact imperialism handed over them to Nanking
for further torture and execution in the last resort.

These revolutionary leaders who are either heading the anti-Japanese
anti-imperialist movement or serving functionaries in trade unions have
played a decisive part in the struggle movement of the masses against im-
perialism and KMT. A few of their number have just sponsored the national
armed self defence movement now expanding in all directions. With the con-
fidence and support won from the masses during the struggles, they have
been able to push the Chinese revolution still further.

SHANGHAI WORKERS ARISE

Apparently, the arrest of the revolutionary leaders by imperialism and
Kuomintang has aroused the extreme ire of the toiling masses here in
Shanghai as well as in the whole country. Workers and other toilers accord-
ingly gathered together and resolved to secure release of the leaders ar-
rested by the following means:

1. Immediately choose delegates and send them on a trip to Nanking to
comfort the leaders now KMT jail and try to secure their release.
Collect money for relief purpose.

2. Launch a campaign for signatures for a protest with Nanking.

3. Call mass meetings, wire the revolutionary masses in China and the
world for immediate concerted action for the rescue of our lead-
ers.

4. Hold demonstrations and parades, besiege the government for the re-
lease of the leaders arrested and all other revolutionary leaders.

5. Expand the national armed self defence movement as a token to con-
tinue the work of the leaders taken in custody.

营救身处逆境的革命领袖

正如本刊此前报道，6月26日，以胡志明（Hu Chi-chun，音译）、林泽林（Lin Tse-lin，音译）、林叶英（Lin Yeh-yin，音译）等为首的一大批革命领袖在公共租界被帝国主义特务逮捕。在帝国主义的监狱中，尽管遭受帝国主义警察最残酷的酷刑，他们坚决拒绝泄露任何革命机密。相反，他们在公共租界警察面前谴责帝国主义是中国人民的祸害，国民党是叛徒。他们对革命叛徒的谎言发起了猛烈的抨击。

是的，他们的表现正如真正的革命领袖那样，为了保卫革命而故意牺牲自己的生命。在帝国主义和国民党的施刑者面前，他们的表现同样英勇无畏，就像在当前全面展开的第五次围剿中，拒绝向敌人（阶级）让出一寸苏维埃领土的红色战士一样。正是由于这一事实，帝国主义最终将他们移交给南京，以便进一步施以酷刑并处决。

这些革命领袖要么领导着反日反帝运动，要么在工会中担任职员，他们在群众反对帝国主义和国民党的斗争运动中发挥了决定性作用。他们中的几个人刚刚发起了目前正在各地扩展的全国武装自卫运动。凭借在斗争中赢得的群众信任和支持，他们得以推动中国革命进一步向前发展。

上海工人起义

显然，帝国主义和国民党逮捕革命领袖的行为激起了上海乃至全国劳动群众的极大愤怒。工人和其他劳动者因此聚集在一起，决心通过以下手段确保被捕领袖获释：

1. 立即选举代表，派往南京慰问目前关押在国民党监狱中的领袖，并试图争取释放他们。为救济目的募集资金。

2. 发起向南京抗议的签名运动。

3. 召开群众大会，致电中国和世界的革命群众，要求立即采取协调行动，营救我们的领袖。

4. 举行示威游行，包围政府，要求释放被捕领袖及其他所有革命领袖。

5. 扩大全国武装自卫运动，以此作为继续开展被拘捕领袖工作的象征。

The work of relieving the leaders should be closely related to the struggle against the intensified oppression and exploitation of capital, the struggle of the peasants for relief to flood and drought sufferers, the struggle of the K T soldiers against ill-treatment, squeeze of their pay and against the attack on red army.

AN APPEAL TO CHINESE WORKERS AND PEASANTS
....................

To workers, peasants, soldiers and other toilers of China!

Chinese workers as a great support to Soviet China have stood unservingly in the front of the betrayal of the Kuomintang which wants to hand over China to imperialism as a colony. The K T has thrown all in the 5th campaign against Soviet China, suppressed the anti-imperialist-K T movement to the best of its ability, killed the vanguard of the workers and peasants, all this for one thing: attempt to maintain the decaying rule of the Kuomintang.

But, on the other hand, far from being scared, workers and peasants in China are moving still farther in the forefront against imperialism and K T, rising up from factories in defiance of the bandit leader Chiang Kai-shek's interdiction to the contrary notwithstanding, promoting the armed self defence movement at a time when Japanese imperialists are much in North China with the aid of the K T. The armed self defence movement is progressing rapidly, a fact that inspires the K T to mobilize all its police force, detectives and revolutionary traitors to arrest our revolutionary leaders with a view to stripping the masses of the strong leadership.

All workers, peasants and soldiers! On June 26 our revolutionary leaders such as Chi-chun, Lin Tse-in, etc, at the head fell into the hands of the K T fascist hangmen. Tortured in the most brutal way, their life is in an extremely critical condition!

Record of Leaders

Our leaders have waged an uncompromising struggle against imperialism and the betrayal of the Kuomintang. During 1925-27 they led millions of Chinese workers and peasants in a fight against imperialism and remnant feudalism, and for the liberation of the Chinese nation. To check the Japanese offensive against Shanghai in 1932 they marched ahead in face of Japanese fusillade. They stood in the van of the national revolutionary war against Japan along the Great Wall.

Of late they initiated the armed self defence movement, calling on the masses to rise immediately in armed self defence and to fight for the thorough emancipation of the Chinese nation. Their positive activities in this regard incurred the hatred of the K T fascists who want to remove our leaders right away lest their deal of betrayal as agreed to by secret negotiations might be greatly hampered.

Our Appeal

All toilers! Just at a moment where the Kuomintang is selling the whole country as slaves to imperialism we can not suffer our leaders to be tortured or shot openly or secretly. We must do everything in our power to get back our leaders. We and China need them most just at the present juncture. File the most serious protests with the K T. Demand the immediate release of our leaders in the K T's hell. Inaugurate committees for the rescue of Comrades Yu Chi-chun, etc, and against imperialism and Japan. Send delegates to Nanking to see our leaders. Stage demonstrations as a protest against the K T's murder.

At the same time, expand the armed self defence movement as directed by our leaders. Stage strikes in the factories and schools against the K T surrender and fascist white terror as a reply to the K T suppression of the anti-imperialist movement.

THE ANTI-IMPERIALIST & FASCIST COMMITTEE IN THE FAR EAST
July 15, 1934

告中国工农书
....................

致中国的工人、农民、士兵及其他劳苦大众！

中国工人作为苏维埃中国的强大后盾，始终站在反对国民党背叛的最前列，国民党企图将中国作为殖民地移交给帝国主义。国民党将其全部力量投入第五次“围剿”苏维埃中国的战役中，竭尽全力镇压反帝及反国民党运动，杀害工农先锋，所有这一切只为一个目的：试图维持国民党日益腐朽的统治。

但是，另一方面，中国的工人和农民非但没有被吓倒，反而更加坚定地站在反对帝国主义和国民党的最前列，不顾匪首蒋介石的禁令，从工厂中奋起反抗，在日本帝国主义在国民党协助下大举进犯华北之际，推动武装自卫运动。武装自卫运动进展迅速，这一事实促使国民党动员其全部警力、侦探及革命叛徒，逮捕我们的革命领袖，旨在剥夺群众强有力的领导。

全体工人、农民和士兵们！6月26日，我们的革命领袖如季纯（Chi-chun）、林泽英（Lin Tse-in）等为首的一批人落入国民党法西斯刽子手手中。他们遭受最残酷的酷刑，生命垂危！

领袖事迹

我们的领袖曾对帝国主义和国民党的背叛进行毫不妥协的斗争。在1925-27年间，他们领导数百万中国工人和农民开展反对帝国主义和封建残余、争取中华民族解放的斗争。为遏制1932年日本对上海的进攻，他们在日本的枪林弹雨面前勇往直前。他们站在长城沿线抗日民族革命战争的最前列。

最近，他们发起武装自卫运动，号召群众立即起来进行武装自卫，为中华民族的彻底解放而战。他们在此方面的积极活动招致了国民党法西斯的仇恨，后者急于除掉我们的领袖，以免其通过秘密谈判达成的背叛交易受到严重阻碍。

我们的呼吁

全体劳苦大众！就在国民党将整个国家作为奴隶出卖给帝国主义的时刻，我们不能坐视我们的领袖遭受公开或秘密的酷刑或枪决。我们必须尽一切努力营救我们的领袖。在这个关键时刻，我们和中国最需要他们。向国民党提出最严重的抗议。要求立即释放关押在国民党地狱中的我们的领袖。成立营救余季纯（Yu Chi-chun）等同志委员会，并开展反对帝国主义和日本的活动。派遣代表前往南京探望我们的领袖。举行示威游行，抗议国民党的谋杀行径。

同时，按照我们领袖的指示，扩大武装自卫运动。在工厂和学校举行罢工，反对国民党的投降和法西斯白色恐怖，以此回应国民党对反帝运动的镇压。

远东反帝反法西斯委员会
1934年7月15日

WIDESPREAD RICE RIOTINGS IN CHINA
... ... ... ....

With disasters inseparable from the rule of imperialism and KMT, toil-
ers of China have learned many a terrible lessons through their own bitter
experience. The widespread drought catastrophe in this summer is no doubt
bitterest in the past decade or so. Crops of the peasants are either dried
or washed away in the vast paddy fields amounting to several ten millions
mows. Millions of peasants are facing acute starvation. Right in the pro-
cess of the drought rice riotings took place extensively in the KMT con-
trolled provinces. The peasants, particularly those near the Soviet border,
have held the KMT responsible for the drought and other disasters connect-
ed therewith. Under conditions of flagrant misrule of the KMT floods and
drought are certainly traceable to the devastations and neglect of the rul-
ing classes.

Immense Damage Occasioned

As investigated by the Nanking relief committee, the present disaster
has wrought havoc in the following provinces: 30 Hsiens in Kiangsu hit by
drought, 40 Hsiens in Chekiang hit by drought, 50 Hsiens in Anhwei hit by
drought and insects, 30 Hsiens in Kiangsi hit by drought and floods, 30
Hsiens in Hupeh hit by floods, 30 Hsiens in Honan by floods and drought,
10 Hsiens in Hopei by floods and drought, 30 Hsiens in Shansi by flood and
drought, 40 Hsiens in Kansu by drought, 40 Hsiens in Szechow by flood and
drought, 10 Hsiens in Suiyuan. Taking all together, 11 provinces are struck
by floods and drought, totalling 400 Hsiens. Besides, there are extensive
disasters in Fukien, Kwangsi and Yunnan but reports are not available
in this connection. In Hunan 40 or 50 hsiens are reported hit by the dis-
aster.△

The present catastrophe is the severest of all in recent years, beating
the stupendous floods of 1931 in the extent of the areas affected. The
director commissioner of reconstruction has given out the definite informa-
tion that all crops south of the Yangtze river are hopeless except for the
small grain of 10%. The damage amounts to $130,000,000. The catastrophe is
very still in Chekiang according to a message of the KMT central news a-
gency dated July 12 from Hangchow, capital of Chekiang province. There the
loss is estimated at $2,000,000,000 at the rate of 10 for each mow. So
the loss must be immense, not to speak of the damages in other provinces.

The Gloomiest Picture

In the concluding days of July showers did come in certain localities
but brought no relief to the drought stricken peasants as the long expect-
ed rainfall was not sufficient in quantity. A correspondent of the Shen Pao
wrote from Hangchow: "The peasants are starving. They have nothing
left in their households. The well-to-do eat only two meals in grain a day.
The poorer families feed the children with peas---that is all." (July 27).

According to another story equally pathetic published by the Sin Wen Pao
on August 4, the starving peasants in Hai-yuan, Chekiang, braving the
scorching sun, rushed to the hsien government for aid, creating a grave si-
tuation.

Rice Rioting Widespread

The tax collected by the KMT on the importation of foreign rice (im-
post 40% ad valorem) has been instrumental in bringing about a little rise
in the price of rice for the first half of the current year. The drought
sent the price still higher up until at the present moment rice is double
price as much as last Fall.

The soaring price of rice is an immediate cause in rice rioting in
the whole land, especially in Chekiang where the desperate pea-
sants no longer submit to starvation. There more than ten rice risings
took place for the last two weeks. The peasants are reputed to be peace-
ful and non-violent. But hunger tells, then this time to practise the pro-
verb: If there is a will there is a way.

Seizure of rice took place at the town of Sha-si on the Shanghai-Hang-
chow railway on July 24 and 25. The town is said to be a centre of the rice
market in Chekiang. Several thousand famine stricken people marched on
the town, with old women leading the way. They took rice from three shops
and ten ships without meeting much resistance. Closely following on the
heels of Sha-si 2,000 peasants seized rice in Wong-tien-tsen not far away
pages.zh:
中国各地爆发大规模米骚动
... ... ... ....

伴随着与帝国主义和国民党统治密不可分的灾难，中国劳苦大众通过自身痛苦的经历吸取了许多惨痛的教训。今年夏季 widespread 的旱灾无疑是过去十多年来最严重的。数千万亩广阔稻田中的农作物要么干枯，要么被冲毁。数百万农民面临严重的饥荒。正是在旱灾过程中，国民党控制的各省广泛发生了米骚动。农民，特别是靠近苏区边界的农民，将旱灾及其他相关灾害归咎于国民党。在国民党公然乱政的情况下，水旱灾害无疑可追溯至统治阶级的破坏和忽视。

造成巨大损失

据南京赈灾委员会调查，目前的灾害在以下各省造成了严重破坏：江苏30县受旱，浙江40县受旱，安徽50县受旱及虫灾，江西30县受旱及水灾，湖北30县受水灾，河南30县受水旱灾害，河北10县受水旱灾害，山西30县受水旱灾害，甘肃40县受旱，四川40县受水旱灾害，绥远10县。总计共有11个省遭受水旱灾害，涉及400个县。此外，福建、广西和云南也有大面积灾害，但暂无相关报告。据报道，湖南有40或50个县受灾。△

目前的灾难是近年来最严重的一次，受影响地区范围超过了1931年的特大洪水。建设委员会主任委员发布确切消息指出，除10%的小宗谷物外，长江以南的所有农作物均无收成希望。损失金额达1.3亿美元。据国民党中央社7月12日从浙江省会杭州发出的消息，浙江灾情依然严峻。那里每亩损失估计为10元，总额达20亿元。因此损失必然巨大，更不用说其他省份的损失了。

最黯淡的景象

7月下旬，某些地区确实下了阵雨，但由于期盼已久的降雨量不足，并未缓解受旱农民的困境。《申报》一名记者从杭州写道：“农民正在挨饿。家中已无存粮。富户每天仅吃两顿粮食。贫苦家庭用豌豆喂养孩子——仅此而已。”（7月27日）。

据8月4日《新闻报》刊登的另一则同样悲惨的报道，浙江海盐的饥饿农民冒着烈日涌向县政府求救，造成了严峻局势。

米骚动广泛发生

国民党对进口洋米征收的关税（从价税40%）导致今年上半年米价略有上涨。旱灾使米价进一步飙升，直至目前米价已是去年秋季的两倍。

米价飞涨是全国范围内发生米骚动的直接原因，特别是在浙江，绝望的农民不再忍受饥饿。在过去两周里，那里发生了十多次抢米事件。农民素以和平、非暴力著称。但当饥饿难耐时，他们便践行这句谚语：有志者事竟成。

7月24日和25日，沪杭铁路上的沙市镇发生了抢米事件。据说该镇是浙江的米市中心。数千名灾民涌入该镇，由老妇人带头。他们从未遇到太大阻力，便从三家商店和十艘船上抢走了大米。紧随沙市之后，2000名农民在不远处的王店镇（Wong-tien-tsen，音译）抢米

pages.en:
from the-si. The peasants took away some 600 piculs of rice and cereals.
But six peasants were taken into custody. In the hsiens around Nanling, like
Hsingpu and Shin-tan, the struggle for the division of rice is almost a dai-
ly occurrence;

The KMT to Blame

Realising that the KMT is in a sense organiser of famine, the peasants
have staged anti-KMT demonstrations one after another. The peasants in Chi-
nkiang, capital of Kiangsu province, have, for example, burnt the survey-
instruments and placed the surveyors under arrest, on the simple ground
that the KMT, instead of devoting any attention to the menace of drought,
is bent on the increase in land taxes by surveying. (The China Times, July
10).

The peasants in Kiangsan, Chekiang, are more militant. In geographical
proximity to the Soviets in Kiangsi they are undoubtedly influenced by the
latter in the struggle against the Kuomintang. They, on the one hand, com-
plain of the inaction of the Kuomintang in regard to the relief of the
fright disaster, and, on the other, of the expropriation of land lying on
the Hangchow-Kiangsan highway. Their land is taken without compensation.
Worse still, they have to pay a tax on the land already taken. In the third
place, the peasants also hate the raise in the salt tax as a result of the
economic embargo.

The peasants listed these charges against the Kuomintang. Failing to re-
ceive any answer the angered peasants rushed to the Hsien Kuomintang and
beat the reactionaries the majority of whom had fled before the ad-
vent of the rioters. One KMT functionary by the name of Chou Tsai was un-
fortunate enough to be left behind, forming the target of the peasants. The
fellow was dragged away and bound to a telegraph pole with his coats strip-
ped off under the burning sun. He tasted the scorching sun for three full
hours before giving way. The incident happened on July 18.

The day following, several hundred peasants converged on the hsien from
different directions, bearing batons in their arms or shouldering primitive
styled rifles, rushing to the Hsien Kuomintang in a stampede. They broke
the windows, tore off the papers, wrecked the furniture, etc. (The China
Times, August 3).

The bourgeois paper Shenpao, has recently drawn a cartoon showing
KMT leaders chatting about famine relief in a villa at a summer resort but
ignoring the famine sufferers below. The peasants, however, know much more
clear than the cartoon can display. They know that salvation lies in their
own hands. Hence rice rioting. The peasants are taking the direct route to
Soviet revolution.

RED ARMY MARCHES ON FOOCHOW

The red army under Comrade Lo Ping-hui, numbering 5,000 strong, advanc-
ed down on Paisha 12 miles from Foochow, capital of Fukien province. The
advance of the red army caused a great panic in Foochow although the red
fighters may not head for that city. No doubt the red army held a great pa-
rade in observance of the anti-war day because they took the city before
August 1. According to press advices the red army deserted the city only on
Aug. 5. Another report has it that the red army may enter Foochow if it
wants to owing to the handful of KMT soldiers at Foochow, who are not mat-
ches of the red fighters. Imperialist warships are hurrying to Foochow from
various anchorages, to help the KMT in defending the city.

The red army operating in Hupeh also scored a big success over the KMT
bandits in east Hupeh end of August. It disarmed one regiment (3,000 men)
of the KMT bandits in east Hupeh in addition to the large quantities of am-
munitions seized. It put one whole division of Chang Hsueh-liang on flight

Red partisans were in the latter part of August very active in the vi-
cinity of Shinyang, an important center on the Peiping-Hankow railway (in
Honan). Their activities reached as far as The Cock Mountain (a famous sum-
mer resort for rich class Chinese and foreigners). Shinyang seems to lie
in a state of siege owing to the increasing activities of red partisans. At
the same time the red army under Comrade Ho Lung occupied several hsiens in

来自西寺（音译）。农民拿走了大约600担大米和谷物。
但有六名农民被拘留。在南陵附近的县，如兴浦（音译）和新坦（音译），争夺分米的斗争几乎每天都在发生；

应受谴责的是国民党

意识到国民党在某种意义上是饥荒的组织者，农民们接连举行反国民党示威。例如，江苏省会镇江的农民烧毁了测量仪器，并将测量员逮捕，理由很简单：国民党不关注干旱的威胁，却一心通过土地测量来增加土地税。（《字林西报》，7月10日）。

浙江江山（音译）的农民更具战斗性。由于在地理上邻近江西的苏维埃地区，他们在反对国民党的斗争中无疑受到了后者的影响。他们一方面抱怨国民党在救济水灾方面无所作为，另一方面抱怨没收位于杭州-江山公路沿线的土地。他们的土地被无偿征用。更糟糕的是，他们还必须为已被征用的土地缴纳税款。第三，农民也憎恨因经济封锁导致的盐税上涨。

农民列出了这些对国民党的指控。由于没有得到任何答复，愤怒的农民冲向县国民党部，殴打反动派，其中大多数人在暴动者到来之前已经逃之夭夭。一名名叫周载（音译）的国民党官员不幸被留下，成为农民的目标。这家伙被拖走，剥去外衣，绑在电线杆上，在烈日下暴晒。他在酷热的太阳下煎熬了整整三个小时才昏死过去。此事发生在7月18日。

次日，数百名农民从不同方向汇聚到县城，手持棍棒或肩扛老式步枪，蜂拥冲向县国民党部。他们打破窗户，撕毁文件，砸坏家具等。（《字林西报》，8月3日）。

资产阶级报纸《申报》最近刊登了一幅漫画，显示国民党领导人在避暑胜地的别墅里闲聊救灾事宜，却无视下方的灾民。然而，农民们比漫画所展示的清楚得多。他们知道救赎掌握在自己手中。因此发生了米骚动。农民们正走上苏维埃革命的直接道路。

红军向福州进军

罗炳辉同志率领的五千名红军，向距离福建省会福州12英里的白沙进发。红军的进军在福州引起了极大的恐慌，尽管红色战士可能并不以该城市为目标。毫无疑问，红军为了纪念反战日举行了一次盛大的阅兵式，因为他们在8月1日之前占领了该城。据媒体报道，红军直到8月5日才撤离该城。另有报告称，如果红军愿意，他们可以进入福州，因为福州的国民党士兵寥寥无几，无法与红色战士匹敌。帝国主义军舰正从各个锚地匆忙赶往福州，以帮助国民党保卫城市。

在湖北作战的红军也在8月底于鄂东取得了针对国民党匪军的重大胜利。除了缴获大量弹药外，它还解除了鄂东一个团（3000人）的国民党匪军的武装。它使张学良的一个整师溃逃

8月下旬，红色游击队在平汉铁路（位于河南）上的重要中心信阳附近非常活跃。他们的活动范围远至鸡公山（中国富裕阶层和外国人著名的避暑胜地）。由于红色游击队活动的增加，信阳似乎处于被围困状态。与此同时，贺龙同志率领的红军占领了几个县，

Minor successes of the red army and partisans are also reported from other localities such as Tunning (Fulien), Tsai-poo (B. Fulien), etc.

ARMED SELF DEFENCE IN FULL SWING
...... .... ......

As matters now stand, the armed self defence has as powerful a backing among the masses as can never be imagined. The program embodying the famous six points in a war against Japanese imperialism is quite popular in the whole country as the K T censorship can never bar oral propaganda among the toiling masses. For the sake of news and curiosity foreign papers are willing to pay for the full draft at rather a high rate. Nearly all the foreign papers (except only a few) have published the programme in the form of outline. The Japanese press at Shanghai gave considerable prominence to the programme. It exploits the program as another sign of the approach of an anti-Chiang Kai-shek storm but forgets the fact that the programme itself explicitly aims at delivering a blow at Japanese imperialism.

Certain imperialist papers such as the North China Daily News (British) sneers at the programme and asks how leading personages in China (Madame Sun Yat-sen, Madame Liao Chun-kai, etc, can back such a naive programme. "The naivety of trying to finance a war", says the paper in an editorial of August 5, "against a thoroughly prepared power like Japan by confiscating Japanese property in China is too obvious to need emphasis. Any attempt to do such a thing would play straight into the hands of the 'enemy'". In short this statement the British paper is anxious over a similar fate of its own. Confiscation of imperialist property hovers over the British journal like a bugbear whether it concerns Japan or other imperialism. Chinese patriots and revolutionaries are in full support of the programme, not only regarding this point but vis-a-vis all others, for the simple reason that all the measures as contained in the programme are entirely practical and suited to the needs of the holy war.

Popular Support

All Chinese, dissatisfied with the K T's surrender to Japanese imperialism, have immediately come to the support of the programme as outlined in our special number. Workers have shown a high pitch of enthusiasm in the rally. Let first take the example of the seamen on the British oil boat.

That boat employs some 70 seamen of Chinese nationality who are indignant over the exaction of bribery by the foremen. Unless bribery to the foremen is demanded, workers will be dismissed just on that ground. The seamen are all for the formation of a committee against the foremen without exception. Just at this point all workers are in a highly bellicose mood, discussing concrete measures at mass meetings.

There appears a fellow bringing with him the 'programme of the Chinese people in a war against Japan'. After the completion of the report by that fellow all present at the meeting rallied to the programme. 12 signed while others who could not write stamped their fingers on the papers as a testimonial of approval. They asked for more copies of the program and pledged to distribute them among the ports called on. They also committed themselves to the promise that attempts would be made to get the signature of the whole body of seamen on the same boat. Finally, an anti-imperialist committee was formed with a chairman at the head.

Another British Oil Boat

In regard to the support given to the programme the same enthusiasm was observed in another British oil boat. Here the workers hated the foreman because they were compelled to pay a tribute to him in the form of money collected on winnings in gambling. The workers were compelled to gamble simply to yield additional receipts to the foreman.

The disgruntled workers first called a meeting to discuss the program. One worker said, "The K T does this simply to invite more outrages from Japan". Foreign employees of the boat encouraged our workers saying that safety can be found if you take up the cudgel. They saw no reason

其他地区也报道了红军和游击队的小规模胜利，如屯宁（福建）、寨埔（北福建）等。

武装自卫运动全面展开
...... .... ......

就目前的局势而言，武装自卫运动在群众中拥有的强大支持是难以想象的。体现抗日帝国主义著名六点的纲领在全国范围内颇受欢迎，因为国民党的审查制度永远无法阻止在劳苦大众中的口头宣传。出于新闻价值和好奇心，外国报纸愿意以相当高的价格购买全文草稿。几乎所有的外国报纸（除少数几家外）都以大纲的形式发表了该纲领。上海的日本报纸对该纲领给予了显著的关注。它利用该纲领作为反蒋介石风暴即将到来的另一个迹象，但忘记了该纲领本身明确旨在打击日本帝国主义这一事实。

某些帝国主义报纸，如英国的《字林西报》，对该纲领冷嘲热讽，并质问中国的知名人士（孙逸仙夫人、廖仲恺夫人等）怎能支持如此幼稚的纲领。“试图通过没收在华日本财产来资助一场对抗像日本这样准备充分的强权的战争，其幼稚性显而易见，无需强调。”该报在8月5日的社论中说，“任何此类尝试都将直接落入‘敌人’的圈套”。简而言之，这家英国报纸急于担心自身遭遇类似的命运。没收帝国主义财产就像梦魇一样笼罩着这家英国期刊，无论涉及日本还是其他帝国主义。中国爱国者和革命者完全支持该纲领，不仅在这一点上，而且在所有其他方面，原因很简单，纲领中包含的所有措施都完全切实可行，符合神圣战争的需要。

民众支持

所有对国民党向日本帝国主义投降不满的中国人，立即支持了我们特刊中概述的纲领。工人们在集会上表现出高度的热情。让我们先以英国油轮上的海员为例。

那艘船雇佣了大约70名中国籍海员，他们对工头的勒索贿赂感到愤怒。除非向工头行贿，否则工人就会以此为由被解雇。海员们无一例外地全都赞成成立一个反对工头的委员会。就在这一点上，所有工人都处于高度好战的情绪中，在群众大会上讨论具体措施。

这时出现一个人，带来了“中国人民对日作战纲领”。在那个人做完报告后，出席会议的所有人都拥护该纲领。12人签了名，而其他不会写字的人则在文件上按上手印以示批准。他们要求更多的纲领副本，并承诺在所停靠的港口分发。他们还承诺将设法获得同船上全体海员的签名。最后，成立了一个反帝国主义委员会，并选出了一名主席。

另一艘英国油轮

在对纲领的支持方面，另一艘英国油轮上也观察到了同样的热情。这里的工人憎恨工头，因为他们被迫以赌博赢钱收集的形式向工头进贡。工人们被迫赌博，仅仅是为了给工头提供额外的收入。

不满的工人们首先召开会议讨论该纲领。一名工人说：“国民党这样做只是为了招致日本更多的暴行。”船上的外籍雇员鼓励我们的工人，说如果拿起棍棒就能找到安全。他们看不出
