ask for "hand back" of the Mongolia Republic, which is entirely
independent by itself. Again, the Sinkiang incident is utilized
by KMT to attack U.S.S.R., taking the emancipation struggle of
the Mohamedans as incited by Soviet Russia and ignoring their
own misrule, the real role played by the British and Japanese
Imperialism and the oppression of the Mohamedans by the White
Russians. The toiling masses of China heartily support the
struggle of Sinkiang oppressed people against KMT and imper-
ialists, recognize their right of self-determination and their
right to be independent from China, if they want. Commercially,
KMT limits the Soviet trade in China on the pretext of dumping-
prevention, while at the same time full effort is laid to sup-
press the boycott against the Japanese Imperialism, and grant-
ing generously the real dumping action by the Imperialists.
Lastly, taking advantage of the serious situation created by
the destruction and seizure of C.E.R. by the Japanese imperial-
ist, KMT make special attack against U.S.S.R.

In order to uphold its subservience policy towards the im-
perialists, in order to be consistent to its policy of selling
out of the national interests, KMT has mobilized all its shame-
less apparatus, especially the Ministry for of Foreign affair—
the expert broker for selling out of China, the KMT-Tangpis and
the KMT reactionary papers to start a shower of anti-Soviet ar-
bitrary propaganda regarding the C.E.R. problem.

What's really about the C.E.R. case? It is a well known
fact that the C.E.R. was primarily solely belonged to U.S.S.R.,
and the Chinese participation in its administration was only
granted me to the fact that the railway is crossing the Chin-
ese territory. Since the Japanese occupation of Manchuria, for
eighteen months Nanking did not assume its part in the admini-
stration any more, and not even tried to, nothing has been at-
tempted to restore its responsibility over the railway. And it
seems that now the Japanese plot to seize the line is only too
welcome by Nanking, the running dog of Imperialists. It has
been well known fact that Japan has practically reduced most
of the railway useless by reckless ruin, which met not a word
of protest from Nanking. And now when the Japanese imperialist
and their puppets have arranged every step to seize the line,
when U.S.S.R. is said to be ready to consider the selling out
of the railway for good, that Nanking begins to move, begins
to yell protests. Apparently such actions could only serve to
help the Japanese ambition.

The "reason" KMT and all reactionaries uphold to op-
pose the Soviet proposal of selling out of C.E.R. was that So-
viet Russia was not authorized to do it; she has no right to do
it, so they declare; and that by so doing, U.S.S.R. would violate
pages.zh:
要求“归还”完全独立的蒙古共和国是合理的。再者，国民党利用新疆事件攻击苏联，将穆斯林的解放斗争说成是由苏俄煽动的，却无视其自身的暴政、英日帝国主义所扮演的真实角色以及白俄对穆斯林的压迫。中国劳苦大众衷心支持新疆受压迫人民反对国民党及帝国主义的斗争，承认他们的自决权，以及如果他们愿意，脱离中国独立的权利。在商业上，国民党以防倾销为借口限制苏联在华贸易，同时却全力压制抵制日本帝国主义的运动，并慷慨地允许帝国主义者进行真正的倾销行动。最后，国民党利用日本帝国主义破坏和夺取中东铁路所造成的严峻局势，专门攻击苏联。

为了维持其对帝国主义的屈从政策，为了贯彻其出卖民族利益的政策，国民党动员了其所有无耻的机构，特别是外交部——出卖中国的专家掮客、国民党党棍以及国民党反动报纸，就中东铁路问题发起了一阵反苏的任意宣传攻势。

中东铁路事件的真相究竟是什么？众所周知，中东铁路最初完全属于苏联，中国参与管理仅仅是因为该铁路穿越中国领土。自日本占领满洲以来的十八个月里，南京政府不再承担其管理职责，甚至未曾尝试，也未做任何努力来恢复其对铁路的责任。现在看来，日本企图夺取该线路的计划正合南京这个帝国主义走狗的心意。众所周知，日本通过肆意破坏，实际上使大部分铁路瘫痪，而南京未发一言表示抗议。如今，当日本帝国主义者及其傀儡已安排好每一步以夺取该线路，当据说苏联准备考虑永久出售该铁路时，南京才开始行动，开始大声抗议。显然，这种行为只能助长日本的野心。

国民党和所有反动派反对苏联出售中东铁路提议的“理由”是，苏俄无权这样做；他们宣称她没有权利这样做；并且声称，这样做的话，苏联将违反

the Sino-Russia and the Fengtien-Russia settlements. But the fact
is too clear that C.E.R. was built with the money of the toiling
masses of the Russian people, and in all the settlements and agree-
ments, provisions have been made to allow the purchase of the line
by the Chinese Government. But Nanking, not only failing to realise
this agreement, but since 1929, has completely given the railway
up with all Manchuria to the Japanese puppets—"Manchukuo". KMT
not only gives up cooperation with U.S.S.R. over the administra-
tion and the protection of the railway, but also, when U.S.S.R.
proposes to sell the same, attempts to raise protests and wishes
to present C.E.R., first as Manchuria and the rest of China, uncon-
ditionally to the imperialists and their agents.

KMT and all reactionaries attempt to utilize the C.E.R. inci-
dent for another break of the Sino-Soviet relations. This again
proves that KMT not only is not intending to establish good rela-
tions with U.S.S.R. but is also looking for every chance to des-
troy the brotherly federation between the toiling masses of the
two nations. On the otherhand, they consider all imperialist na-
tions as their "friends", maintain at their best a friendly rela-
tion with the Japanese Robbers, and obey them.

KMT and all reactionaries shamelessly blame U.S.S.R. as "ben-
ding over the force of Japanese Imperialism", but actually who
is really "bending over"? U.S.S.R. is the only state that is
struggling constantly against the "imperialist forces" and expo-
sing their conspiracies. Over the C.E.R. problem U.S.S.R. is con-
stantly upholding their own interest, unlike Nanking, which not
only give up their own territory and rights to Japan and her pu-
ppets, but also act to help the imperialist to seize C.E.R..

KMT and all reactionaries shamelessly charge U.S.S.R. with
the violation of her policy of "assisting the weak nations,"
charge her as "Red Imperialism", as "betrayer to Revolution", but
actually U.S.S.R. is the only state assisting weak nations and
secure the independence and territorial integrity of China. U.S.
S.R. is the first state to give up all her rights, privileges,
unequal treaties and sphere of influence in China. It was just in
the agreements which KMT utilize now to build their protests that
U.S.S.R. declared all these hearty concessions. U.S.S.R. is the
only state supporting materially and spiritually the Chinese Re-
volution, declaring on the day of Japanese occupation of Manchu-
ria that she standing on the side of Chinese people, she would
not recognize any result of armed aggression. While KMT, not only
evades from its duty of resisting the Japanese, but also suppress
all anti-imp. anti-Japanese movement, attacking with full vigor
the only anti-imp. force of China—Chinese Red Armies and Soviet
Districts, and even attempting to ask U.S.S.R. to "order the stop of
Chinese Soviet movement". These all prove that KMT is a loyal dog
pages.zh:
3
中俄协定与奉俄协定。但事实再清楚不过，中东铁路是用俄罗斯劳动人民的血汗钱建成的，而且在所有协定和协议中，都规定了允许中国政府购买该铁路的条款。然而南京方面不仅未能履行这一协定，反而自1929年以来，将整个满洲连同铁路完全拱手让给了日本傀儡——“满洲国”。国民党不仅放弃了与苏联在铁路管理和保护方面的合作，而且当苏联提议出售该铁路时，竟试图提出抗议，并妄图将中东铁路，首先是将满洲乃至全中国，无条件地献给帝国主义者及其代理人。

国民党及一切反动派企图利用中东铁路事件再次破坏中苏关系。这再次证明，国民党不仅无意与苏联建立良好关系，反而寻找一切机会破坏两国劳动人民之间的兄弟般联盟。另一方面，他们视所有帝国主义国家为“朋友”，极力维持与日本强盗的友好关系，并对他们唯命是从。

国民党及一切反动派无耻地指责苏联“屈从于日本帝国主义的力量”，但实际上究竟是谁在真正“屈从”？苏联是唯一一个不断与“帝国主义势力”作斗争并揭露其阴谋的国家。在中东铁路问题上，苏联始终维护自身利益，不像南京方面，不仅向日本及其傀儡放弃了自己的领土和权利，还采取行动帮助帝国主义夺取中东铁路。

国民党及一切反动派无耻地指责苏联违反了其“援助弱小民族”的政策，指责其为“红色帝国主义”，是“革命的背叛者”，但实际上苏联是唯一援助弱小民族并保障中国独立和领土完整的国家。苏联是第一个放弃其在中国的所有权利、特权、不平等条约和势力范围的国家。正是在国民党如今用来构建其抗议依据的那些协定中，苏联宣布了这些真诚的让步。苏联是唯一在物质和精神上支持中国革命的国家，在日本占领满洲之日即声明站在中国人民一边，不承认任何武装侵略的结果。而国民党不仅逃避抗日的责任，还镇压一切反帝、反日运动，全力攻击中国唯一的反帝力量——中国红军和苏区，甚至企图要求苏联“命令停止中国苏维埃运动”。这一切都证明，国民党是忠诚的走狗

pages.en:
of imperialists, a scavenger for the imperialism, an active participant of the anti-Soviet conspiracy and the enemy of Chinese people.
KMT and all reactionaries view the peace-policy of U.S.S.R. as "subserviance" and "weakness", attempting to pull U.S.S.R. into the whirl pool of the imperialist troubles, enabling the imperialists to find "pretexts" for armed intervention of U.S.S.R. But U.S.S.R. upholds her peace policy in "not taking an inch of other's territory but not letting an inch of her territory taken by others," in maintaining peace among nations and for the peace as a whole. This peace policy has rendered direct hindrance and obstacle to the imperialist aggression and oppression of weak nations. Only those i.p. running dogs, shameless KMT that would view such peaceful policy as being "subserviance" or "weakness", only the enemies of U.S.S.R. attempt to induce her to get rid of such peace policy.
KMT and all reactionaries shamelessly charge U.S.S.R. with the recognition of Manchukuo, which they say lends difficulty to the League's non-recognition and hinders the recovery of territory by China. In fact, U.S.S.R. has never done so, only the Imperialist League recognizes in its report the existing condition of Manchuria, recognizes the robbery Japan carried out in Manchuria, and only the mean KMT government accepts the League's Report, relies upon the League and recognizes Manchukuo silently. Not only so, KMT is now preparing a second Manchukuo in North China and Inner Mongolia, to serve the imperialists a base for armed intervention of U.S.S.R.
KMT and all reactionaries shamelessly attempt to carry out anti-Soviet challenges by mocking themselves as the friend of U.S.S.R. They estimate for U.S.S.R. that the soil of C.E.R. won't stop Japanese aggression; that Japan will continue to attack Vladivostok and Sachalin Prov. But the Imp-KMT never understand that U.S.S.R. under the proletariat dictatorship, with its socialistic victory and the support of the world proletariat, is sufficiently strong to secure their socialistic victory and all the rights of U.S.S.R.—at the same time, the rights of the world revolution. Shameless KMT has not only sold out Manchuria and North China, given up all rights of the Chinese Nation, but also disguised itself under the mask of "sympathy" and attempt to drag U.S.S.R. into the biggest conspiracy of Imp-KMT.
All these anti-Soviet conspiracies carried out by KMT and all reactionaries over the C.E.R. problem. KMT, by taking this offensive against U.S.S.R., not only satisfies the need of their own master—the imperialists, but also attempts to distract the anti-Imp sentiment of the furious masses so that they may be taught to oppose the only revolutionary federation of Chi-

帝国主义的走狗，帝国主义的清道夫，反苏阴谋的积极参与者，以及中国人民的敌人。
国民党及一切反动派将苏联的和平政策视为“顺从”和“软弱”，企图将苏联卷入帝国主义纠纷的漩涡，使帝国主义者能够找到武装干涉苏联的“借口”。但苏联坚持其和平政策，即“不取他人一寸土地，也不让他人取走自己一寸土地”，以维护各国间的和平及整体和平。这一和平政策直接阻碍和妨碍了帝国主义对弱小民族的侵略和压迫。只有那些帝国主义的走狗、无耻的国民党才会将这种和平政策视为“顺从”或“软弱”，只有苏联的敌人才企图诱使其放弃这种和平政策。
国民党及一切反动派无耻地指责苏联承认满洲国，称此举给国联的不承认政策带来困难，并阻碍中国收复领土。事实上，苏联从未这样做过，只有帝国主义控制的国联在其报告中承认了满洲的现状，承认了日本在满洲进行的抢劫行径，也只有卑鄙的国民党政府接受国联的报告，依赖国联，并默许承认满洲国。不仅如此，国民党现在正准备在华北和内蒙古制造第二个满洲国，为帝国主义者武装干涉苏联提供基地。
国民党及一切反动派无耻地企图通过自诩为苏联的朋友来进行反苏挑衅。他们替苏联盘算，认为中东铁路的土地无法阻止日本的侵略；日本将继续进攻符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）和萨哈林省。但帝国主义-国民党永远不理解，在无产阶级专政下，凭借社会主义的胜利和世界无产阶级的支持，苏联足够强大以保卫其社会主义胜利和苏联的所有权利——同时也是世界革命的权利。无耻的国民党不仅出卖了满洲和华北，放弃了中华民族的所有权利，还伪装在“同情”的面具下，企图将苏联拖入帝国主义-国民党最大的阴谋之中。
国民党及一切反动派就中东铁路问题实施了所有这些反苏阴谋。国民党通过对苏联采取这种攻势，不仅满足了其主子——帝国主义者的需求，还企图转移愤怒群众的反帝情绪，以便让他们被教导去反对中

CIVIL RIGHTS GROUP PROTESTS NAZI "TERROR"
—Delegation Pays Call On Shanghai German Consul;
Brutalities Reviewed—
—Persecution Of Jews Is Denounced In Missive—
A delegation of the China League for Civil Rights, Headed
by Mrs. Sun Yat-sen, Dr. Tsai Yuan-pei, and including Lu Sin, Chi-
na's foremost writer, Mr. Yang Chien of the Academia Sinica, Dr.
Lin Yu-tang, writer and critic, Mr. Harold Isaacs, editor of the
China Forum, and several others visited the Shanghai German con-
sulate-general yesterday to protest against the "terror" institu-
ted in Germany by Adolf Hitler and his fascist party.
The delegation was received by Herr. Behrend, the acting con-
sul-general. He received the delegation's written protest and
promised to send it on to the German minister in Peiping. The
written protest was supplemented orally and with clippings from
the German, American and Shanghai press relating to the "many acts

支持中国革命工人和农民、红军和苏维埃政权。只有苏维埃和红军才能根除帝国主义的枷锁，并对日宣战。只有苏维埃中国才能为中国的独立和领土完整而战，为中国劳动大众的解放而战！
反对国民党的“反共运动”！争取苏维埃中国的胜利！

The League's statement of protest was as follows:
"The China League for Civil Rights, which fights against the
terror in China, for the civil and human rights of the Chinese
people, and which allies itself with progressive forces throughout
the world, feels compelled to enter an energetic protest against
the brutal terror and reaction prevailing in Germany at the pre-
sent time.
"We learn from the most varied and reliable sources, represen-
ting all shades of political opinion, that since the Fascist re-
gime was established in Germany, 30,000 to 40,000 workers and thou-
sands of working class leaders and intellectuals have been arrest-
ed. Prisoners are beaten up and tortured in jails, in the barracks
of the Nazi Storm Troops and in the concentration camps. In the
hospitals there are thousands of people with broken limbs, whose
condition bear witness to the barbarism now prevailing in Germany.
Hundreds have been killed and their corpses often thrown in rivers
lakes or forests. Others are shot and news is given out that they
were shot while trying to escape. Or they committed suicide in
their homes or in prison. Needless to say, all these cases are no-
thing but cold-blooded murder.
"The organizations of the working class have been suppressed,
their printing plants, property and funds confiscated or stolen
by Fascists. The rights of the working class in Germany, gained in
decades of struggle, are torn to shreds. There is no freedom of
the press, of speech, of assembly, no right of organization, no
right to any activity of the masses to better their conditions.
"All progressive intellectual and cultural life in Germany is
blocked. The greatest scientists, like Dr. Albert Einstein, Magnus
Hirschfeld, and thousands of others, are persecuted and driven in-
to exile. Famous writers like Ludwig Renn have been reported kill-
ed. Others, Like Leon Feuchtwanger, and the Nobel Prize winner
Thomas Mann, have been forced to leave the country and their posi-
tions in Germany taken by mediocrities. The fate of thousands of
others, proletarian and progressive writers, is even worse.
"Great artists like Max Liebermann and Kaethe Kollwitz, and
great composers or directors like Bruno Walther, are deprived of
any opportunity to work, are molested and their works smashed and
burned. Libraries are deprived of rich collections of literature &
thousands of books burned in the streets.
"The press exists under the iron rule of the Fascists, the en-
tire working class press, and even such liberal intellectual or-
gans as the Weltbuehne and others of an even milder nature, have
been suppressed and their editors imprisoned. Foreign news dispat-
ches are rigidly censored before they are permitted to enter the
country. Another sign of moral and cultural retrogression in the

同盟的抗议声明如下：
“中国民权保障同盟致力于对抗中国的恐怖统治，争取中国人民的公民权利和人权，并与全世界的进步力量结盟，现感到有必要对目前德国盛行的残酷恐怖和反动势力提出强烈抗议。
“我们从代表各种政治观点的最多样且可靠的来源获悉，自法西斯政权在德国建立以来，已有3万至4万名工人以及数千名工人阶级领袖和知识分子被捕。囚犯在监狱、纳粹冲锋队营房和集中营中遭受殴打和酷刑。医院里有成千上万肢体断裂的人，他们的状况证明了目前德国盛行的野蛮行径。数百人被杀害，尸体常被抛入河流、湖泊或森林。其他人则被枪杀，并发布消息称他们是在试图逃跑时被击毙的。或者声称他们在家里或监狱中自杀。不用说，所有这些案件无非是冷血的谋杀。
“工人阶级的组织遭到镇压，其印刷厂、财产和资金被法西斯分子没收或窃取。德国工人阶级经过数十年斗争赢得的权利被撕得粉碎。没有新闻自由、言论自由、集会自由，没有组织权，也没有群众改善自身条件的任何活动权利。
“德国所有进步的知识分子和文化生活均受阻。最伟大的科学家，如阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦博士、马格努斯·赫希菲尔德以及成千上万的其他人，受到迫害并被流亡。据报道，像路德维希·雷恩这样的著名作家已被杀害。其他人，如莱昂·福伊希特万格和诺贝尔奖得主托马斯·曼，被迫离开该国，他们在德国的职位被庸才取代。成千上万其他无产阶级和进步作家的命运甚至更糟。
“像马克斯·利伯曼和凯绥·珂勒惠支这样的伟大艺术家，以及像布鲁诺·瓦尔特这样的伟大作曲家或指挥家，被剥夺了任何工作的机会，受到骚扰，他们的作品被砸毁和焚烧。图书馆失去了丰富的文学收藏，成千上万的书籍在街头被烧毁。
“新闻界存在于法西斯的铁腕统治之下，整个工人阶级报刊，甚至是像《世界舞台》这样温和性质的自由主义知识分子刊物，都遭到镇压，其编辑被监禁。外国新闻电讯在获准进入该国之前受到严格审查。这是道德和文化倒退的另一个迹象，

Middle Ages and the darkest days of Czarist Russia, is the persecu-
tion of the Jews and the anti-Semitic pogroms, systematically
organized and encouraged by the German Government and the Fasc-

"The latest acts of vandalism in burning the books of progres-
sive, proletarian and Jewish writers are acts such as have oc-
curred only during the darkest days of ignorance and barbarism in
human history. Such was the fate of great scientists and thinkers
in the distant past when they paid for their advanced thinking by
being burnt at the stake. These facts, with many others of a simi-
lar nature have been reported in responsible papers in Europe and
America. Even such conservative organs as the New York Times have
published such reports daily. In its March 15, 20 & 21 issues, the
Times further reported the following facts:
"Reports of the torturing of Communists, Socialists, Radical &
Jewish deputies, newspapermen, lawyers and writers are daily publi-
shed in the newspapers of Vienna. Of common occurrence are such
instances as that of Deputy Sollmann who was beaten unconscious,
his ribs fractured, then he was repeatedly revived by burning the
soles of his feet with a torch, only to lose consciousness again.
"Dr.Ossietsky, editor of the Weltbuehne, had his teeth knock-
ed out by a revolver butt; the novelist Heinz Pohl was made to eat
his own manuscript. The eyes of other prisoners are gouged out,
their hair torn out, hands burned, heads and bones broken...mutil-
ated bodies are found in fields and forests...in the Nazi barracks
men are confronted with levelled revolvers and compelled under
threats of death to flog each other until they lose consciousness.
Among the victims are fathers and sons...it is not unusual to find
almost any morning in the woodlands surrounding Berlin the bodies
of men killed by bullets or beatings; three such discoveries were
made last week in a single morning. The police report them as 'un-
identified suicides!' Berlin proletarian homes have been raided &
their occupants mistreated....'
"Lion Feuchtwanger, the great writer, writing in a special ar-
ticle in the New York Times on March 21, reports 'despairing stor-
ies of women whose husbands and sons have been dragged from bed
and inhumanly beaten, and about whom nothing more has been heard
or seen...day after day bodies are discovered mutilated beyond
identification....'
"The Volksrecht of Switzerland reports among numberless other
facts: 'There are bourgeois newspapers in Germany which report
that corpses of men with gouged out eyes and teeth knocked out
have been dragged from the Land-wehr Canal in Berlin.'
"In the name of the human, social and cultural advancement of
mankind, and in an effort to help preserve the social and cultural
achievements of men and movements, the China League for Civil
Rights protests in the most energetic manner against these facts,
reports of which are duplicated in all the press of Europe and
America. We protest against this fearful terror against the German
working class and progressive thinkers, a terror which is crip-
pling the social, intellectual and cultural life of Germany."

May 14, 1933

“最近焚烧进步作家、无产阶级作家和犹太作家书籍的破坏行为，是人类历史上无知和野蛮最黑暗的日子里才发生过的行径。在遥远的过去，伟大的科学家和思想家就曾遭遇这样的命运，他们因先进的思想而被处以火刑。这些事实以及许多其他类似性质的事实，已在欧美负责任的报纸上报道。甚至像《纽约时报》这样保守的媒体也每天刊登此类报道。在3月15日、20日和21日的版面上，《时报》进一步报道了以下事实：
“维也纳的报纸每天都刊登关于共产党人、社会党人、激进派和犹太裔议员、新闻记者、律师和作家遭受酷刑的报道。常见的案例如索尔曼（Sollmann）议员，他被殴打至昏迷，肋骨断裂，随后敌人用火炬灼烧他的脚底使其反复苏醒，接着又再次失去知觉。
“《世界舞台》（Weltbuehne）编辑奥西茨基（Ossietsky）博士的牙齿被枪托打掉；小说家海因茨·波尔（Heinz Pohl）被迫吞食自己的手稿。其他囚犯的眼睛被挖出，头发被拔掉，双手被烧伤，头部和骨头被打碎……残缺不全的尸体在田野和森林中被发现……在纳粹兵营里，人们面对平举的左轮手枪，在死亡威胁下被迫互相鞭打直至昏迷。受害者中包括父子……几乎每天早晨在柏林周围的林地中发现被枪杀或殴打死去的男子尸体已不足为奇；上周仅在一个早晨就发现了三具这样的尸体。警方将其报告为‘身份不明的自杀者！’柏林的无产阶级住宅遭到突袭，居住者受到虐待……”
“伟大作家莱昂·福伊希特万格（Lion Feuchtwanger）在3月21日《纽约时报》的一篇特约文章中报道了‘令人绝望的故事：妇女的丈夫和儿子被从床上拖走并遭受非人道的殴打，此后便杳无音信……日复一日，人们发现被残害得无法辨认的尸体……’”
“瑞士《人民权利报》（Volksrecht）在众多其他事实中报道：‘德国有资产阶级报纸报道，眼睛被挖出、牙齿被打掉的男子尸体从柏林的兰德韦尔运河（Land-wehr Canal）中被拖出。’”
“为了人类的社会和文化进步，并努力帮助保护人类及其运动的社会和文化成就，中国民权保障同盟以最有力的方式抗议这些事实，其报道在欧美所有报刊上屡见不鲜。我们抗议这种针对德国工人阶级和进步思想家的可怕恐怖，这种恐怖正在摧残德国的社会、智力和文化生活。”

1933年5月14日

RED ARMY MARCHES ON CHUNKING
Causing Another Consternation
Among KMT Circles
..............

According to the Pa Sheng Pao of June 6 the victorious red army under Comrade Lo Lung advanced into Szechuan last month and took Chin-an, An-hsien and Wuchuan, all hsieens located between Szechuan and Kweichow. But later on it turned back to the south of Szechuan, marching on Chi-kiang, Tzeliu, while in Kweichow, it completely annihilated the brigade under Gen. Ho Hsiung-wu. Now the red army advanced as far as Anchow only 30 li from Chunking, ready to swoop down on Chunking, an important trading center on the upper reach of the Yangtze River. It thus struck a terror deep into the hearts of the KMT bandits.

The Shenpao of Shanghai carried the report on June 16 that the red army on the northern bank of the river, namely, the 4th red army, contemplated a possible attack on Hankow and Wei chow from its base in the north.

Reds In Anhwei

The red army in eastern Kiangsi together with red partisans brought about many new developments in the military field. They launched new offensives on some of the leading cities either within or outside Kiangsi. The Chinese press states that the red partisans approached Haw-yang only 30 li from Anking, the capital of Anhwei. Haw-yang, as described by the paper, is the gate of Anking and its seizure by the red army constitutes a great menace to the safety of Anking. No wonder that the populace around Anking was in consternation. Owing to the same threat the Peasant Bank at Anking was forced to a severe run.

According to another source of information the red army turned back and entered Lu-an, putting the armed volunteers of the landlords to pieces. It killed the head of the volunteers and captured 7 rifles. Another report has it that three detachments of the local militia have mutinied, fleeing in the direction of Lu-an, probably to join the red partisans there. The red partisans in the county of Anhwei were considerably swollen up by more peasants from Hopei Shantung in the neighborhood. They wandered about in a wide zone.

Red Partisans More Active in Fukien

Lungyen circles reported that the rebels in northern Fukien joined the red partisans who are operating in that area against the KMT troops.

红军进军重庆
在国民党圈子中引起另一阵恐慌
..............

据6月6日《巴声报》报道，罗隆同志率领的胜利红军上月进入四川，攻占了位于四川和贵州之间的綦江、安县和武川等县。但随后它折返川南，向綦江、自流井进军，同时在贵州彻底歼灭了何雄武将军指挥的旅。现在红军推进至距重庆仅30里的安州，准备猛扑长江上游的重要贸易中心重庆。这使国民党匪徒内心深处感到恐惧。

上海《申报》于6月16日报道称，位于江北的红军，即红四方面军，正考虑从其北方基地对汉口和魏州发动可能的攻击。

安徽的红军

赣东红军连同红色游击队在军事领域带来了许多新的发展。他们对江西省内外的某些主要城市发起了新的攻势。中国报刊称，红色游击队逼近华阳，该地距安徽省会安庆仅30里。据该报描述，华阳是安庆的门户，其被红军占领对安庆的安全构成巨大威胁。难怪安庆周围民众陷入恐慌。由于同样的威胁，安庆的农民银行遭遇了严重的挤兑。

据另一消息来源称，红军折返并进入六安，将地主的武装志愿队打得粉碎。它杀死了志愿队头目并缴获7支步枪。另有报告称，当地民团的三个分队发生哗变，向六安方向逃窜，可能是去加入那里的红色游击队。安徽各县的红色游击队因附近来自河北、山东的更多农民加入而大幅扩充。他们在广阔区域内活动。

福建红色游击队更加活跃

龙岩方面报道，闽北的反叛者加入了在该地区活动并对抗国民党军队的红色游击队。

On June 16 the Mengkow correspondent of the Sinwanpao reported the increasing activities of the peasant partisans along the coast in comparison with the previous month. This is the case particularly in Futing and Suling near the Chekiang border. The KMT bandit army is inadequate in dealing with the riotings of the peasants. The KMT bandits contemplate calling more re-enforcements from Chekiang.

SUFFERINGS OF THE PEASANTRY IN NORTH
MANCHURIA

The peasants in north Manchuria always heard of rumours of a possible war of Japanese imperialism against the Soviet Union. They also heard of the possible conversion of Pei-an-tsen into a new capital. The truth, however, is that Japanese imperialism built up forts and aerodromes in Pei-an-tsen, intending to use it as a military base in the war against the Soviet Union. Pei-an-tsen is linked with Harbin and other centres by a network of railways traversed mostly by trains at night.

The districts in north Manchuria are full of Japanese troops in quest for soldiers and foods from the peasantry. The peasants are required to build up the works against the Soviet Union. A week ago no carts dared to enter the city of Sulma in fear of being commandeered by Japanese troops. In Chintsen Japanese troops took away nearly all the horses used by the peasants to till the ground. The hard pressed peasantry complained of the frequent requisitions of food and horses with a bitterness that is well-nigh unequalled any whereelse.

Continuing, the wrong peasants have more to complain of: The village with 50 households must contribute a wagon together with a good many recruits for the Japanese controlled army. In this respect the poorer peasants bear the brunt of the Japanese attack. Whenever and wherever the Japanese troops make a stop, they must pick up a quarrel and kill some one.

The approach to Japanese defence works is positively prohibited. Any one that comes nearer to it by mistake will be killed right way. Half a month ago six peasants came to blows in Eulen and met with death in the riverside at the hands of the Japanese soldiers. The workers engaged in the construction of the Hailun-Kesan line always received floggings from the Japanese on flimsy grounds. They must salute the Japanese whenever meeting them by accident on the way. They must call the Japanese by "Greater Japanese". In the countryside the populace must put up flags with the sun in the centre (Japanese national flag) to welcome the few Japanese who come by accident.

The Attack on USSR

Before launching the offensive on the Soviet Union Japanese imperialism is actively engaged in the work of a thorough housecleaning in the rear. The unreliable police forces in Hailun and other hsien have been disarmed and dissolved. Inquiries are conducted in the village and rifles of the peasants confiscated. The constabulary stationed in the forests is placed under strict surveillance, accompanied by the enforcement of the joint guaranty system according to which a man is jointly responsible for the acts of his fellow soldiers. Many mutinies took place before the contemplated dissolution. One week ago a full regiment of cavalry stationed at Jailun revolted and fled, followed by the mutiny of 600 constabulary at Chintsen who engaged the Japs in three battles, killing and wounding quite a number of Japanese garrison troops. Desertion has become a daily occurrence.

A couple of weeks ago the workers of the Hailun-Kehsan line (numbering about 80 in all) surprised the Japanese troops and seized two machine guns from them. Then they made an escape. The red spears and the peasant societies which went into action in the villages have made themselves felt to strike. The anti-Japanese movement in north Manchuria is making a wide penetration into the countryside (among the peasantry).

End of Translation

6月16日，《新闻报》孟家沟通讯员报道，与上月相比，沿海地区农民游击队的活动日益增加。特别是在靠近浙江边界的福鼎和绥宁一带更是如此。国民党匪军不足以应对农民的暴动。国民党匪徒正考虑从浙江调用更多增援部队。

北满农民的苦难

北满的农民总是听到关于日本帝国主义可能对苏联发动战争的谣言。他们还听到可能将北安镇改为新首都的消息。然而，事实是日本帝国主义在北安镇修建了堡垒和机场，打算将其作为对苏战争中的军事基地。北安镇通过铁路网与哈尔滨和其他中心相连，夜间大多有火车通行。

北满各地区遍布日军，他们向农民征募士兵和粮食。农民被要求修建针对苏联的工事。一周前，因害怕被日军征用，没有马车敢进入舒兰城。在锦县，日军拿走了农民用于耕地的几乎所有马匹。备受压迫的农民抱怨频繁征用粮食和马匹，其痛苦程度几乎无处可比。

此外，受害农民还有更多苦衷：拥有50户家庭的村庄必须提供一辆马车以及大量新兵供日本控制的军队使用。在这方面，贫农承受了日本攻击的主要压力。无论何时何地，只要日军停留，他们就必须挑起争端并杀害某人。

严禁接近日本防御工事。任何因误入而靠近的人将立即被杀。半个月前，六名农民在额伦发生冲突，并在河边死于日本士兵之手。从事海伦-克山线建设的工人总是因微不足道的理由受到日本人的鞭打。他们在路上偶然遇到日本人时必须敬礼。他们必须称呼日本人为“大日本人”。在乡村，民众必须悬挂中心有太阳图案的旗帜（日本国旗），以欢迎偶尔路过的少数日本人。

对苏联的攻击

在对苏联发动进攻之前，日本帝国主义正积极从事后方的彻底清洗工作。海伦及其他县不可靠的警察部队已被解除武装并解散。在村庄中进行调查，没收农民的步枪。驻扎在森林中的宪兵受到严密监视，并实施连保制度，根据该制度，一人需对其同伴的行为承担连带责任。在预想的解散之前发生了多次哗变。一周前，驻扎在贾伦的一个完整骑兵团起义并逃跑，随后锦县的600名宪兵哗变，与日本人进行了三次战斗，杀伤了不少日本驻军士兵。开小差已成为日常现象。

几周前，海伦-克山线的工人（总共约80人）突袭了日军，并从他们手中缴获了两挺机枪。随后他们逃脱。在农村行动的红灯照和农民协会已开始发挥打击作用。北满的反日运动正在广大农村（农民中）广泛渗透。

译文结束

The Chintse is perhaps only a variant of the medieval manor implanted in Manchuria. The landlord builds up a monster house on it, covering in some cases nearly one third of the whole estate, surrounded by a wall behind which are stored guns and other weapons. The inhabitants in the Chintse are for the most part tenant peasants and farm hands.

The failure of crops in 1932 worked a great hardship on the whole body of peasantry in the spring of 1933. This particularly the case with the tenants and poorer peasants who made a living on grass and the bean cake (the worst kind of nourishment). Yes, there may be cereals on the market but the poor peasants can not come at it without money. Worse still, the landlord refuses to sell it even if money is offered in exchange. Hence the origination of a cereal committee which was empowered to compel the landlord to put his cereal on sale. But starvation was widespread. Lots of people died of starvation. Whole families in Kueichow swallowed poison than no longer bearing the pangs of hunger.

The Tenant System in Vogue

In north Manchuria two different systems prevail regarding the land rent. The tenant may hand over 60% of his crops to the landowner as rent, seeds to be supplied by the latter. But he has to bear all the other expenses incurred in the cultivation. This arrangement is widely in use. Under another system the tenant is required to pay a lump sum of 8.5 piculs (of the crops) whether the year is good or bad, the landowner simply collecting the rent without supplying anything to the peasant. The landlord of course prefers the latter arrangement.

Agricultural labourers in north Manchuria are found in great numbers. As a rule, a landlord has from 20 to 40 farm hands. The tenant may hire from 5 to 10. The initial employs 4-10. A Chintse with 40 or 50 households usually has 200-300 farm hands. These workers are hired on one year contract with the employer or just work for one season only. Each household hires seven or eight boys to take care of the livestock.

The farm hands work more than 12 hours a day. They go to work at day break and come back home after sunset. They eat the meal at noon on the field. During the harvest time in winter they have to get up early and take to the field work long before dawn. Every day only 10 or 15 minutes are allowed them for a rest. The one year contract worker begins his employment in the second moon (Chinese calendar) and ends it some time in the 10th moon without holidays whatsoever during the long interval.

The Farm Hands

The wage of the farm hands is determined by bargaining before the conclusion of the contract. It ranges from 30 to 40 dollars a year. Besides board and lodging, the seasonal workers are paid 50-80 cents a day. Owing to the depreciation of money the real wages of the farm hands have fallen to about half per cent. Formerly, one could buy an ox with a year's wage, now it cannot buy only half so much. When the spring farm work is begun, the rent is due. During the interval the workers get no cash whatever. They are always in demand for cash. The sick workers are not cared for by the employer. The death of workers, even in large numbers, is not a matter of concern for the employers.

Of course the workers get free meals from the employers. They usually have three meals a day. Breakfast is only gruel. At noon they eat corn flour cakes and salted vegetables. For supper they have the same kind of food. Only three times throughout the year, namely, on the 5th of the 5th moon and the 15th of the 8th moon, are they treated with pork and white noodles. In the spring of 1933 the famine set in as a sequel to the crop failure the previous year.

Adopted by the Second Soviet Congress

“庄子”（Chintse）或许只是植入满洲的中世纪庄园的一种变体。地主在其中建造一座庞大的宅邸，在某些情况下，其占地面积几乎达到整个庄园的三分之一，四周筑有围墙，墙内储存着枪支和其他武器。庄子内的居民大多是佃农和雇农。

1932年的农作物歉收给1933年春季的全体农民带来了巨大的苦难。对于那些靠草料和豆饼（最劣质的营养品）维持生计的佃农和贫农来说，情况尤其如此。是的，市场上可能有谷物，但贫农没有钱就买不到。更糟糕的是，即使有人出钱购买，地主也拒绝出售。因此，成立了一个谷物委员会，被授权强迫地主将其谷物投放市场出售。然而，饥荒依然广泛蔓延。许多人死于饥饿。贵州的许多家庭因无法忍受饥饿的痛苦而服毒自尽。

流行的佃农制度

在满洲北部，关于地租有两种不同的制度盛行。佃户可能将其收成的60%作为地租交给地主，种子由后者提供。但他必须承担耕作过程中产生的所有其他费用。这种安排被广泛使用。在另一种制度下，无论年成好坏，佃户都被要求支付8.5石（作物）的一次性总额，地主只是收取租金，不向农民提供任何物资。地主当然更喜欢后一种安排。

满洲北部的农业劳工数量众多。通常，一个地主拥有20到40名雇农。佃户可能雇佣5到10名。初者（此处原文指代不明，可能指小地主或富农）雇佣4-10名。一个拥有40或50户人家的庄子通常有200-300名雇农。这些工人要么与雇主签订为期一年的合同，要么只工作一个季节。每户人家雇佣七八个男孩来照料牲畜。

雇农每天工作超过12小时。他们破晓时分去上班，日落后才回家。中午他们在田里吃饭。在冬季收获期间，他们必须早起，在黎明前很久就下田劳作。每天只允许他们休息10或15分钟。签订一年合同的工人从二月（农历）开始受雇，到十月的某个时候结束，在这漫长的间隔期间没有任何假期。

雇农

雇农的工资是在签订合同前通过讨价还价确定的。年薪在30到40美元之间。除了食宿外，季节性工人每天支付50-80美分。由于货币贬值，雇农的实际工资已降至约一半。以前，一年的工资可以买一头牛，现在连半头都买不到了。当春季农活开始时，地租到期。在此期间，工人们得不到任何现金。他们总是急需现金。生病的工人得不到雇主的照顾。工人的死亡，即使是大量死亡，也不是雇主关心的问题。

当然，工人可以从雇主那里获得免费膳食。他们通常一天吃三顿饭。早餐只有稀粥。中午他们吃玉米面饼和咸菜。晚餐也是同样的食物。一年中只有三次，即五月初五和八月十五，他们会受到猪肉和白面条的款待。1933年春，继前一年农作物歉收之后，饥荒爆发。

possible only after the replacement of the KMT rule with the Soviet pow-
er in China. Only then can the constitution of the Soviet Republic of
China be perfected. The congress calls on the masses of the whole country
to fight for the realization of these tasks under the leadership of the
provisional central government of the Soviet Republic of China.

Victory of Soviet Revolution

1) The basic task of the Soviet republic is to consolidate the demo-
cratic dictatorship of the workers and peasants on a stable Soviet terri-
tory and to fight for the success of the Soviet revolution throughout the
land. The objective of this dictatorship is to clear the remnant of
feudalism in its entirety, to drive out the imperialist influence in
China, to unify China, to limit the capitalist development in a proper
way, to proceed with the economic construction of the Soviets, to raise
the solidarity and consciousness of the proletariat, to mobilize broad
masses around it, to consolidate the alliance with the middle peasants
so as to lead to the dictatorship of the proletariat.

2) As set up by the Soviet government of China, the state under the
democratic dictatorship of the workers and peasants belongs to the work-
ers, peasants, red armists and all other toilers. Under the Soviets all
workers, peasants, red armists and toilers have a right to vote for dele-
gates in control of the government except for militarists, politicians,
landlords, tuhao, kulaks, priests and monks, and all other exploiters
together with counterrevolutionaries who of course have no right to vote.

3) The national Soviet congress is the supreme political organ in
the Soviet republic of China. During the recess of the congress the pro-
visional central executive committee of the Soviets shall have final au-
thority in all matters. Under the executive committee there shall be a
people's council to handle every day business, issue orders and promul-
gate decisions.

4) All workers, peasants, red armists and other toilers together with
their families shall be equal before the laws of the Soviets and be the
citizens of the Soviet republic of China regardless of sex, race (Hans,
Mongols, Mohammedans, Tibetans, aborigins, Formosans, Koreans and Ar-
menites residing in China) and religion. To draw more workers, peasants,
etc, into the control of their own government all citizens of the Soviets
at the age of 16 and upwards as provided in the laws governing elections
shall have the right to vote and be elected delegates to Soviet congress-
es with a view to discussing and deciding on matters both national and
local.
As to the election of delegates, the factories of the industrial
centers and the districts inhabited by handicraft workers, peasants and
poor shall serve as constituencies. The delegates so chosen shall take
part in the work of the Soviets and its commissions at a definite date.
They shall make periodical reports to the constituencies. The electorate
can recall any delegate and choose a new one at any time it sees fit. So-
viet China gives proportionately greater number of delegates to the pro-
letariat in order to enable the latter to lead the peasantry and other
toilers to socialism.

5) The Soviet power of China shall have as its main objective a tho-
rough betterment of the lot of the working class and enact the labour
law with the eight hour, minimum wages, social insurance, unemployment
relief, workers' control of production as the outstanding features.

6) With the thorough extermination of feudal exploitation and amelio-
ration of the lot of the peasantry in view the Soviet power of China has
proclaimed a land law aiming at confiscation of the land of all landlords
and its distribution to landless, poor peasants and middle peasants,
looking forward to the ultimate nationalization of land.

7) The Soviet power of China aims for the defence of the interests of
workers and peasants, the restriction of capitalist development, and for
the eventual transition to socialism.

只有在中国以苏维埃政权取代国民党统治后才可能完成的任务。只有这样，中华苏维埃共和国的宪法才能完善。大会号召全国民众在中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府的领导下，为实现这些任务而奋斗。

苏维埃革命的胜利

1) 苏维埃共和国的基本任务是在稳定的苏维埃领土上巩固工农民主专政，并为苏维埃革命在全国范围内的成功而奋斗。这一专政的目标是彻底清除封建残余，驱逐帝国主义在中国的影响，统一中国，适当限制资本主义发展，进行苏维埃经济建设，提高无产阶级的团结和觉悟，动员广大民众围绕在其周围，巩固与中农的联盟，从而走向无产阶级专政。

2) 正如中国苏维埃政府所确立的那样，在工农民主专政下的国家属于工人、农民、红军战士和所有其他劳动者。在苏维埃制度下，所有工人、农民、红军战士和劳动者都有权选举代表来控制政府，但军阀、政客、地主、土豪、富农、僧侣以及所有其他剥削者和反革命分子当然没有选举权。

3) 全国苏维埃代表大会是中华苏维埃共和国的最高权力机关。在大会休会期间，苏维埃临时中央执行委员会对所有事项拥有最终决定权。在执行委员会之下设人民委员会，处理日常事务，发布命令和颁布决定。

4) 所有工人、农民、红军战士和其他劳动者及其家属，不论性别、种族（汉族、蒙古族、穆斯林、藏族、土著、台湾人、朝鲜族和居住在中国的亚美尼亚人）和宗教如何，在苏维埃法律面前一律平等，均为中华苏维埃共和国公民。为了吸引更多的工人、农民等参与管理自己的政府，根据选举法规定，所有16岁及以上的苏维埃公民均享有选举权和被选举为苏维埃代表大会代表的权利，以讨论和决定国家和地方事务。
关于代表的选举，工业中心的工厂以及手工业工人、农民和穷人居住的区作为选区。这样选出的代表将在指定日期参加苏维埃及其委员会的工作。他们应定期向选区报告。选民可以随时撤换任何代表并选出新代表。苏维埃中国给予无产阶级比例更高的代表名额，以便使后者能够领导农民和其他劳动者走向社会主义。

5) 中国苏维埃政权的主要目标是彻底改善工人阶级的状况，并颁布劳动法，其主要特点包括八小时工作制、最低工资、社会保险、失业救济和工人监督生产。

6) 鉴于彻底消灭封建剥削和改善农民状况的目标，中国苏维埃政权颁布了土地法，旨在没收所有地主的土地，并将其分配给无地、贫农和中农，以期最终实现土地国有化。

7) 中国苏维埃政权旨在保护工农利益，限制资本主义发展，并最终过渡到社会主义。

8) To emancipate China from the imperialist shackles completely, the
Soviets of China declare the full freedom and independence of China, repu-
diating all political and economic rights enjoyed by imperialism in China,
repudiating all unequal treaties concluded by counterrevolutionary regimes

9) To insure the success of the Soviet revolution on a national scale
and to support the theory that participation in the revolutionary war is the
responsibility of the toilers, the Soviet power of China promulgates the
draft law for the time being designed to substitute compulsory for voluntary
enlistment. But the right to bear arms shall be conceded only to the toil-
ers. Under the Soviets all counterrevolutionaries and exploiters shall be dis-
armed.

10) Aiming at the insurance of the liberty of the workers and peasants
to speak, assemble, publish, etc, the Soviets oppose bourgeois democracy
but favour the workers' and peasants' democracy, smashing all the political
and economic power of the bourgeoisie and landlord, breaking all the fetters
of the landlord-bourgeoisie that throttle the liberty of the toilers. The
Soviets shall provide material foundation for the liberty of the toilers by
giving them printing machines, meeting place, etc. At the same time all
counterrevolutionaries under the Soviets shall have no liberty whatsoever
in carrying on agitation and activities.

11) The Soviets recognise the liberty of marriage and take all the ne-
cessary measures for the protection of women as an essential step forward
to the thorough emancipation of the feminine sex, thus enabling women to
be free from the shackles of the home and to take an active part in social,
economic, political, cultural life.

13) Assuring full liberty of conscience to the toilers, the Soviets
strictly enforces the principle of the separation of the state from the
church, give no grants or subvention whatsoever to religious denominations.
All citizens of the Soviets have the liberty to oppose religion. Imperial-
ist missionaries may exist under Soviet rule provided they obey the Soviet
law.

14) The Soviets give full national liberty to all minority nationali-
ties within the borders of China, conceding them the right to secede
from China and form independent states. The Mongols, Koreans, Tibetans,
and all the aboriginals resident in China have a full right to join or leave
the Soviet federation of China, or to set up their own autonomous districts.
The Soviets at present set itself the task of helping these nationalities
in shaking off the yoke of imperialism, warlords and militarists, princes, lamas
and chieftains and securing a free Soviet power. The Soviets will at pre-
sent develop the culture among these nationalities.

15) The Soviets give asylum to revolutionary fighters of Chinese or
foreign nationality who are persecuted by counterrevolutionary regimes,
and aid and lead them in the revival of new struggles until the success
of the revolution.

16) The Soviets accord full political rights to foreigners engaged in
labour on Soviet territory---rights that are enjoyed by Soviet citizens.

17) The Soviets of China proclaim to the proletariat and oppressed na-
tions of the whole world that it regards the Soviet Union as a strong ally
which has been and is fighting at the same revolutionary front under the
directing of the Comintern.

RAPID EXTENSION OF THE RED ARMY
Decided on by the Second Soviet Congress

8) 为了将中国从帝国主义的枷锁中完全解放出来，中国苏维埃宣布中国的完全自由和独立，废除帝国主义在中国享有的一切政治和经济权利，废除反革命政权与帝国主义签订的一切不平等条约，废除反革命政权所欠的一切外债。在苏维埃领土内，绝对禁止帝国主义陆海空军进入，收回外国租界，将帝国主义的银行、海关、铁路、矿山、工厂及所有其他企业收归国有。但外国承租人在遵守苏维埃法律的前提下可被接纳。

9) 为了确保苏维埃革命在全国范围内的成功，并支持参加革命战争是劳动者的责任这一理论，中国苏维埃政权暂时颁布草案，以义务兵役制取代志愿兵役制。但携带武器的权利仅授予劳动者。在苏维埃制度下，所有反革命分子和剥削者将被解除武装。

10) 为了确保工人和农民言论、集会、出版等的自由，苏维埃反对资产阶级民主，但赞成工农民主，粉碎资产阶级和地主的所有政治和经济权力，打破地主-资产阶级扼杀劳动者自由的所有枷锁。苏维埃将通过提供印刷机、会议场所等为劳动者的自由提供物质基础。同时，在苏维埃制度下，所有反革命分子在进行煽动和活动方面没有任何自由。

11) 苏维埃承认婚姻自由，并采取一切必要措施保护妇女，作为彻底解放女性的关键一步，从而使妇女摆脱家庭的束缚，积极参与社会、经济、政治和文化生活。

13) 苏维埃保证劳动者拥有充分的信仰自由，严格执行政教分离原则，不给予任何宗教团体拨款或补贴。所有苏维埃公民都有反对宗教的自由。帝国主义传教士在遵守苏维埃法律的前提下，可以在苏维埃统治下存在。

14) 苏维埃给予中国境内所有少数民族充分的民族自由，承认他们脱离中国并建立独立国家的权利。蒙古族、朝鲜族、藏族以及所有居住在中国的土著居民拥有加入或退出中国苏维埃联邦，或建立自己自治区的充分权利。苏维埃目前将自己任务定为帮助这些民族摆脱帝国主义、军阀、军事首领、王公、喇嘛和酋长的枷锁，并确保自由的苏维埃政权。苏维埃目前将在这些民族中发展文化。

15) 苏维埃为受到反革命政权迫害的中国或外籍革命战士提供庇护，并援助和领导他们复兴新的斗争，直到革命成功。

16) 苏维埃赋予在苏维埃领土上从事劳动的外国人充分的政治权利——即苏维埃公民所享有的权利。

17) 中国苏维埃向全世界无产阶级和被压迫民族宣告，它视苏联为强大的盟友，后者一直在共产国际的指导下，在同一革命战线上战斗。

The Soviet Congress goes on record that as revealed in the report of Comrade Chu Teh the central government and military council have carried out the decisions of the first congress. The congress further goes on record that the red army has achieved overwhelming victories in smashing the four campaigns of imperialism-KMT and in repulsing the fifth one, thus opening a bright perspective of capturing one or more provinces in the initial stage of the Soviet revolution.

During ceaseless fighting with the KMT bandits the red army has steeled itself and enlarged itself, drawing hundreds of thousands of workers and peasants into its ranks, accompanied by the elevation in political consciousness and technique. It has proved the genuine armed force of the masses capable of fighting imperialism-KMT, fighting Japanese imperialism, fighting the landlord-bourgeoisie. It has proved a vital force fighting for the emancipation of the workers and peasants to the last. Under conditions of a life-and-death struggle with imperialism and KMT just at the present moment the greatest efforts shall be made to expand the red army to 1,000,000 within the shortest time possible.

Measures for Strengthening Red Army

First of all, organize and draw in wide masses of the toilers both within and without the Soviet districts. Organize new divisions and corps by turning to advantage the wealth of past experiences. Strengthen the recruiting offices attached to the Soviets, and clear the vacillating elements. Enlist only workers and toilers. Bar the landlord and kulaks. Strengthen the reserve of the red army, that is, the youth vanguards and red guards. Raise the political education among these units. Make preparations for a transition from the voluntary to the compulsory enlistment.

For purposes of consolidation, purge the red army of alien elements, strengthen the leadership of the workers in the red army. Strengthen the leadership of the party in the whole army. Make the red fighters conscious of fighting for the Soviets. Take concrete steps for a closer contact of the army with the masses. Raise the conscious discipline in the red army. Relaxation of discipline as well as excessive punishment (above that fixed by order) shall not be permitted. Mobilize more communists and YC for the army in order to strengthen the political machine and party organizations within the red army.

At the same time military technique must be improved in conjunction with the elevation of political consciousness and heroism among the red combatants. In modern warfare victory can not be secured without a full acquaintance with military science. Much must be learned from the experience of the Soviet Union in the protracted civil war.

A new turn shall be effected in the method of partisan warfare as well as in the composition of the partisans with special emphasis on political education. Partisans shall not act contrary to the policy of the Soviets and the party nor break away from the masses. Place the activities of the partisans on the basis of the development of the mass struggle and land revolution. Turn guerilla warfare into a new weapon in the hands of the revolution.

Ample Provision to Red Army

Ample provision shall be made for the material needs of the red army. In this connection the increase in the production of rice and storage of rice are of vital importance. In the carrying of foreign trade articles needed by the red army shall be secured at all costs. Road construction comes next and plays a great role in the improvement of transport. Bureaucracy and corruption in this regard shall be fought against at all cost.

Every Soviet apparatus and mass organization are duty bound to aid the red combatants in their unflinching bellicose mood against imperialism-KMT. The campaign-to-do-work for the families of the red fighters shall be continued with redoubled energy. The Soviets and mass organization shall carry on this campaign of their own volition. A ruthless struggle shall be waged against those who sabotage the orders of the Soviets in this respect. Masses of the workers and peasants shall be drawn in to participate in the campaign.

To shatter the encircling movement of the enemy the revolutionary military council shall increase its leadership of the red armies, map out plans for operations, consolidate the red armies under a unified command, fight according to the orders of the Centre.

The red army is the most advanced guard in the Chinese revolution, the most effective weapon of the Soviets. It calls upon the broad masses to join the red army and to fight for the victory of the Soviet revolution.

苏维埃代表大会记录在案，正如朱德同志的报告所揭示，中央政府和军事委员会已执行第一次代表大会的决议。大会进一步记录在案，红军在粉碎帝国主义-国民党四次“围剿”并击退第五次“围剿”中取得了压倒性胜利，从而为苏维埃革命初期夺取一个或数个省份开辟了光明前景。

在与国民党匪帮的不断战斗中，红军得到了锤炼和壮大，将数十万工人和农民吸收到其队伍中，同时提高了政治觉悟和技术水平。它证明了自己是能够对抗帝国主义-国民党、对抗日本帝国主义、对抗地主资产阶级的真正的群众武装力量。它证明了一支为工农解放战斗到底的重要力量。在当前与帝国主义和国民党进行生死斗争的条件下，应尽最大努力在最短时间内将红军扩充至100万人。

加强红军的措施

首先，组织并吸引苏区内外的广大劳动群众。利用过去的丰富经验，组建新的师和军。加强附属于苏维埃的征兵机构，清除动摇分子。只招募工人和劳动者。禁止地主和富农加入。加强红军的后备力量，即少年先锋队和赤卫队。提高这些单位的政治教育水平。为从志愿兵役制向义务兵役制过渡做好准备。

为了巩固部队，清洗红军中的异己分子，加强工人在红军中的领导地位。加强党对整个军队的领导。使红色战士意识到他们是为苏维埃而战。采取具体措施加强军队与群众的密切联系。提高红军的自觉纪律。不允许纪律松弛以及过度惩罚（超过命令规定的惩罚）。动员更多的共产党员和青年团团员加入军队，以加强红军内部的政治机关和党组织。

同时，必须结合提高红色战斗员的政治觉悟和英雄主义精神来改进军事技术。在现代战争中，如果不充分掌握军事科学，就无法确保胜利。必须从苏联长期内战的经验中学习很多东西。

游击战的作战方式以及游击队的组成应当发生新的转变，特别强调政治教育。游击队的行动不得违背苏维埃和党的政策，也不得脱离群众。将游击队的活动建立在群众斗争和土地革命发展的基础上。将游击战变成革命手中的一种新武器。

红军的充足供给

应充分满足红军的物质需求。在这方面，增加大米生产和储备大米至关重要。在进行对外贸易时，必须不惜一切代价确保红军所需的物资。道路建设紧随其后，在改善运输方面发挥着巨大作用。必须不惜一切代价打击这方面的官僚主义和腐败现象。

每一个苏维埃机构和群众组织都有责任援助红色战斗员，保持他们对抗帝国主义-国民党的坚定战斗意志。应以加倍的努力继续开展为红色战士家属代耕代作的运动。苏维埃和群众组织应自愿开展这一运动。应对那些破坏苏维埃在此方面命令的人进行无情的斗争。应吸引广大工农群众参与这一运动。

为了粉碎敌人的包围运动，革命军事委员会应加强对红军的领导，制定作战计划，在统一指挥下巩固红军，按照中央的命令进行战斗。

红军是中国革命中最先进的先锋队，是苏维埃最有效的武器。它号召广大群众加入红军，为苏维埃革命的胜利而战。

SALT RIOTINGS IN SHANTUNG CHEKIANG & KIANGSU
against Increase in Salt Taxation
............................

The 24% increase in gabelle by Nanking towards the end of last year has brought in its train serious reactions among the mass of the poorer people. In the past month five riotings, for example, have taken place for the seizure of salt in the provinces along the coast. On May 20 and 21 several thousand peasantry including women and children fought desperately battle with the police in an attempt to seize the salt stored in the governmental warehouse, resulting in 5 casualties. The cause of the rioting as given by the Simwenpao is the much tax collected on salt. The ruined peasants can not buy salt at high prices boosted up by heavy taxation. Hence the attempted seizure.

Closely following it is another rioting in Yisicn, Shantung, staged by armed people on June 7 at night, to surprise the salt police while several hundred others boldly took salt out of the governmental warehouse. Large quantities of salt are reported to have been taken out. Several days reports came from the same province stating that the people in Weihaiwei (formerly a British concession), no longer able to bear the exorbitant salt tax, gathered some 5,000 individuals and seized 80,000 piculs of salt from the government warehouse.

In this respect Chekiang and Kiangsu, two 'prosperous' provinces near Nanking, have much to show. According to a message of the NT central news agency dated June 20 about 100 piculs of salt were grabbed by the masses from the governmental warehouse in Huang Tsechi, Puking, Chekiang. And the rioters broke into the warehouse and smashed it to pieces. 400 households in Changchow, Jiangsu, stormed the salt police in a hard fight. (The Simwenpao, June 16,

Gabelle Too High

As everybody knows, salt is a necessity for the masses. It ought to be cheap. But, on the contrary, the NT has raised it from year to year. The revenue from gabelle is the second largest item in the public receipts of Nanking. Of the total revenue only next to customs duties, the major part of which has been offered as securities for foreign loans.

The sale of salt under the NT is still monopolized by influential merchants who say that it was under the Peking regime. Backed by the government, these merchants have the right as well as the power to sell salt at an arbitrary price far from the folks who manufacture it. The high price of salt is a combination of high gabelle and intensified exploitation of the merchants. The gabelle is so high that it amounts to 40 times as much as the productive cost, not to count the squeezes of the merchants and officials.

Since 1927 the gabelle has increased eight times with a tendency to further increase under the NT regime. After 1931 the last increase took place in April this year when the sales monopoly was granted to a new company.

山东、浙江和江苏的盐民骚乱
反对增加盐税
............................

南京政府在去年年底将盐税提高24%，这在广大贫苦民众中引起了严重的反响。在过去的一个月里，例如，沿海各省发生了五次抢夺食盐的骚乱。5月20日和21日，包括妇女和儿童在内的数千名农民与警察进行了殊死搏斗，试图夺取储存在政府仓库中的食盐，造成5人伤亡。《新闻报》称，骚乱的原因是盐税过重。破产的农民无法购买因重税而价格高涨的食盐。因此试图抢夺。

紧接着的是6月7日晚在山东沂县（音译）发生的另一起骚乱，由武装人员发起，突袭盐警，同时另有数百人大胆地从政府仓库中取出食盐。据报道，大量食盐被取出。几天后，来自该省的消息称，威海卫（前英国租界）的居民再也无法忍受高昂的盐税，聚集了约5000人，从政府仓库中抢走了8万担食盐。

在这方面，靠近南京的两个“繁荣”省份浙江和江苏也有很多事例。据南京中央通讯社6月20日消息，浙江浦江黄宅（音译）的群众从政府仓库中抢走了约100担食盐。暴徒闯入仓库并将其砸得粉碎。江苏常州的400户人家在一场激战中袭击了盐警。（《新闻报》，6月16日，

盐税过高

众所周知，盐是大众的必需品。它应该便宜。但相反，南京政府逐年提高盐价。盐税收入是南京公共收入的第二大项目。在总收入中，仅次于关税，而关税的大部分已被作为外债的担保。

在南京政府统治下，食盐销售仍然由有影响力的商人垄断，他们说这是在北京政府时期形成的。在这些商人的背后有政府支持，他们拥有以任意价格出售食盐的权利和权力，这与生产食盐的民众相去甚远。盐价高企是高盐税和商人加剧剥削相结合的结果。盐税如此之高，以至于相当于生产成本的40倍，这还不算商人和官员的盘剥。

自1927年以来，盐税已增加了八次，并且在南京政府统治下有进一步增加的趋势。1931年以后，最后一次增加发生在今年四月，当时销售垄断权授予了一家新公司。

fit. High prices make salt virtually a luxury to the masses, especially the
toilers who, hit by economic depression and rural bankruptcy, are deprived the

price of salt compels the people to employ substitutes such as carbonate of
soda (The Eastern Miscellany, June 1, 1934, p.12).
Deprived the power to buy salt, the peasants are also forbidden to use salt
water coming from the sea in Kiangsu. Here is an interesting item from the
columns of the Sinwanpao of June 13: "The people in Chihang and Haining (Kiang-
su) who have been suffering from an acute shortage in salt in connection with
the cheap rice and high price of salt are interdicted by the police from
the attending arrest of dozens of them for the simple reason that they
took a little salt water from a river swollen up by the tide of the sea. The
police served the warning that the taking of such salt water will be punished
in the same sense as smuggling. But a militant mass struggle overcame the warn-
ing of the police and restored the liberty to take salt water to the people.
These cold facts prove the impossibility of abolishing the so-called exor-
bitant taxes under the KMT regime which actually raises the tax under the very
slogan of doing away with it. The masses must get ready to pay higher taxes
when told by the KMT to abolish the nefarious tax.

STUDENTS VIOLENTLY AGAINST JOINT EXAMS
In Taiyuan, Shensi.
....................

The promotion of the joint examination system as a means to restrict the
liberty of thought among the students has been laid down by the KMT fascists
in their policy of fascistizing education throughout the country but met with a
strong rebuff from students of the whole country, followed by strikes of the
students.
Some time in May the students of all the private middle schools at Nanking
went on a joint strike against the joint examination to be held. On June 18,
several thousand students of 17 middle schools demonstrated before the office
of the educational commissioner at Taiyuan and clashed with the police and mili-
tary, resulting in the killing and wounding of some. The city gates were all
closed for a whole day. Troubles are still brewing in spite of the ban on the
publication of such news by the press as well as transmission of such news by
telegraph and mail.
On the morning of 18 the students of the middle schools went in groups be-
fore the Yamen of the educational commissioner and staged a demonstration ri-
there, distributing CP handbills. They organized pickets against the interven-
tion of the police and military. Several students came to a clash with the police
with batons and flax ropes as weapons. As a result many were wounded. One cap-
tain of the bodyguards was injured in the mouth with his tooth cut off by a
stone. A soldier was struck in the eye with one eyeball smashed by stone.
More than ten students were injured by bayonets or stones while others down-
trodden.
To stop the march of the students, the police and military in fear of trou-
bles immediately shut the gates of the walled city, thus interrupting the
traffic between the inside and outside of the wall for 24 hours. Passengers
coming from the railway stations were compelled to take a round-about way in
order to gain admission to the city.
But the students made a hole through the city wall with axes, etc. They
were unable to win admission in face of the strong resistance of the police and
military.
As a result 36 students were arrested including four girls. The students
held a mass meeting to discuss how to deal with the situation, how to fight
against the police and military, how to aid the arrested students. The stu-
dents' committee blocked the move of the students by posting guards at the
entrance of each middle school. The struggle is still going on.

负责保税仓库的人员几乎无一例外地采取将盐与沙土混合的做法，以获取更高的利润。高昂的价格使盐对大众而言实际上成为一种奢侈品，尤其是那些遭受经济萧条和农村破产打击的劳工阶层，他们已无力购买盐及其他生活必需品。6月18日，报刊刊登了一封来自山西北部的信件，称“近期，民众因缺乏购买力而宁愿不吃盐”。类似的信息也来自北平社会调查局，该局指出，在河北（两个富庶省份）的黎县和定县，高昂的盐价迫使民众使用苏打粉等替代品（《东方杂志》，1934年6月1日，第12页）。

农民不仅无力购买盐，在江苏也被禁止使用海水。以下是6月13日《新闻报》栏目中一则有趣的消息：“浙江（原文为江苏，疑误）之乍浦和海宁民众，因米贱盐贵而遭受严重的盐荒之苦，却遭警方禁止取用海水，数十人因此被捕，原因仅仅是他们从受海潮上涨影响的河流中取了一点咸水。警方警告称，汲取此类咸水将以走私论处。但一场激烈的群众斗争克服了警方的警告，恢复了民众汲取咸水的自由。这些冷酷的事实证明，在国民党政权下，所谓废除苛捐杂税是不可能的，该政权实际上是在废除苛捐杂税的口号下增加税收。当国民党告知民众要废除恶税时，民众必须准备好支付更高的税款。”

学生激烈反对联合考试
在陕西太原。
....................

国民党法西斯分子在其全国教育法西斯化的政策中，规定推行联合考试制度以限制学生的思想自由，但这遭到了全国学生的强烈抵制，并引发了学生罢工。

5月间，南京所有私立中学的学生举行联合罢工，反对即将举行的联合考试。6月18日，太原17所中学的数千名学生在教育厅署前示威，并与军警发生冲突，导致一些人伤亡。城门整整关闭了一天。尽管新闻界被禁止发布此类消息，电报和邮件传输也受到封锁，但动荡仍在酝酿之中。

18日上午，中学生成群结队前往教育厅署衙门，并在那里举行示威，分发中共传单。他们组织纠察队以阻止军警的干预。几名学生手持棍棒和麻绳作为武器与警察发生冲突。结果多人受伤。一名卫队长嘴部受伤，牙齿被石头打掉。一名士兵眼部被击中，眼球被石头砸碎。十多名学生被刺刀或石头击伤，其他人则遭到践踏。

为了阻止学生游行，军警因害怕出事立即关闭了城墙城门，从而切断了城内外的交通达24小时。从火车站来的乘客被迫绕道才能进入城内。

但是学生们用斧头等工具在城墙上凿开了一个洞。面对军警的强力抵抗，他们未能成功进入。

结果包括四名女生在内的36名学生被捕。学生们举行集会，讨论如何应对局势、如何对抗军警以及如何援助被捕学生。学生委员会在各中学入口处布置岗哨，以阻止学生的行动。斗争仍在继续。

学生反对国民党法西斯分子的罢工
进入新阶段

On June 13 the Struggle (organ of CC of CPC) wrote a timely editorial on
the activities of the KMT fascists both old and new under the title of "The
13th Plenum of CI and the Chinese Revolution" mainly devoted to an enunciation
of the chief theses of the CI in their relation to the development of the
Chinese revolution. Of special importance to us is that part of the editorial,
which exposes the real role, just at the present moment, of the KMT fascists
in the partition of China by imperialism, a role that is now camouflaged under
various forms, particularly the new life movement set afoot some two months
ago under the aegis of Chiang Kai-shek, the notorious hangman of the Chinese
people.—Ed.

"The various fractions of the KMT government, whether with their seat at
Nanking or Canton or Peiping, are practically fascistized as a result of their
efforts in this direction. They may have a debate on how to fascistize such as
the difference between Chiang Kai-shek who insists on unity for construction
and Wang Chin-wei who advocates unity through construction. They may fight for
spells as a reflection of the growing conflicts among their imperialist mas-
ters (conflicts between Chiang, Wang, Chen Hsin-hu, Chen Chi-tang, Hu Hanmin,
etc). ... The attempt to find a middle ground between fascistization and revolu-
tion has failed as in the case of the people's government in Fukien. This ac-
celerates the process of two extremes: the rampancy of fascists and the rap-
id growth of the revolution.
"Not content with its existence as a small secret organisation, Chinese
fascism attempts to form an open party and to thwart the revolutionary move-
ment by bribery, kidnapping and assassination. With this end in view the fol-
lowing steps are being taken: fascistization of the army in the drive against
the Soviets, ban on the talks about resistance to Japan, 'bandit-suppression'
and cultural control in Shanghai factories and schools, the burning and sup-
pression of revolutionary and liberal books, the attack on film companies and
book stores, the appearance of many periodicals of a modern fascists na-
ture with the advocacy of San-minism to be replaced by fascism, the demand
for the restoration of Tsun-li (head of the party) headed by Chiang Kai-shek,
finally the new life movement, all designed to form an open party and to es-
tablish an open dictatorship. Other militarists are following the example of
Chiang Kai-shek. So with the politicians. Far from an indication of the
strength of the landlord-bourgeoisie, this is positively a weakness in the
landlord-bourgeois machine."
.... .... ....

"KMT fascists are characterised by the following:
1) The KMT fascists are the most reactionary fraction of the Chinese land-
lord-bourgeoisie who endeavor to rescue the rule of imperialism-IJ from the
existing revolutionary crisis with the most terroristic and cruel methods un-
der the protection of imperialism. They grow in the very bosom of the KMT and
aim at the complete fascistization of the KMT, thereby hoping to proclaim a
full-fledged fascist dictatorship over the whole country.
2) The KMT fascists are the most treacherous and disgraceful in direct
contrast with the chauvinist-fascists in Europe. Under 'nationalism' they
revive the antiquated slave morality and turn out slaves (out of Chinese)
for imperialism, thus paving the way for the imperialist division of China.
"The hangman Chiang Kai-shek shouted loudly at Nanchang: Death to those
who still talk about resistance to Japan. The fascist papers and statements
declare publicly that the loss of Manchuria and Jehol to Japanese imperialism
matters little provided the communists can be exterminated. In their view
the imperialist division of China does no harm to the landlord-bourgeoisie,
only the workers and peasants alone being hurt."

The New Life Movement

"To help imperialism in its attack on China the KMT fascists have recent-
ly thrown considerably more into the campaign against the Soviets and redoub-
led their energy in the extension of slave education incarnated in the new
life movement.
"Among the five basic rules of the new life movement not a single pa-
triotic slogan is found such as 'resistance to foreign powers' lately pro-
claimed by Chinese statists (nationalists). Apart from loyalty to the mili-
tary leader meaning Chiang Kai-shek, the KMT fascists put forward an-
other slogan: National recovery.
"In a speech at Nanchang on Feb. 19, Chiang Kai-shek clearly defined 'na-
tional recovery' in the following terms. At the very outset he said:
... the motion with the co-existence of ... was one of hindrances ... the removal of this ... is out of the question. ..."

6月13日，《斗争》（中共中央机关报）发表了一篇及时的文章，题为《共产国际第十三次全会与中国革命》，主要阐述共产国际关于中国革命发展的主要论点。对我们来说特别重要的是社论中揭露国民党法西斯分子在当前帝国主义瓜分中国中所扮演的真实角色的部分，这一角色目前以各种形式伪装起来，特别是两个月前在中国人民著名的刽子手蒋介石庇护下发起的“新生活运动”。——编者按。

“国民党政府各派系，无论其总部设在南京、广州还是北平，实际上都已法西斯化，这是他们朝此方向努力的结果。他们可能会就如何实行法西斯化进行辩论，例如坚持‘建设统一’的蒋介石与主张‘统一建设’的汪精卫之间的分歧。他们可能会间歇性地争斗，这反映了其帝国主义主子之间日益加剧的冲突（蒋、汪、陈信虎(音译)、陈济棠、胡汉民等人之间的冲突）。……试图在法西斯化和革命之间寻找中间道路的尝试已经失败，福建人民政府的情况便是如此。这加速了两个极端的发展过程：法西斯主义的猖獗和革命的迅速增长。

“中国法西斯主义不满足于作为一个小型秘密组织存在，而是试图组建一个公开政党，并通过贿赂、绑架和暗杀来阻碍革命运动。为此，正在采取以下步骤：在反苏维埃运动中将军队法西斯化，禁止谈论抗日，在上海工厂和学校进行‘剿匪’和文化控制，焚烧和查禁革命及自由主义书籍，攻击电影公司和书店，出现许多具有现代法西斯性质的期刊，主张以法西斯主义取代三民主义，要求恢复由蒋介石领导的党统，最后是新生活运动，所有这些都旨在组建一个公开政党并建立公开独裁统治。其他军阀也在效仿蒋介石。政客们也是如此。这绝非表明地主资产阶级的力量，而恰恰是地主资产阶级机器的虚弱表现。”
.... .... ....

“国民党法西斯分子的特征如下：
1) 国民党法西斯分子是中国地主资产阶级中最反动的派系，他们企图在帝国主义的庇护下，用最恐怖和残酷的手段，将帝国主义统治从现有的革命危机中拯救出来。他们在国民党内滋生，旨在将国民党完全法西斯化，从而希望在全国范围内宣布实行全面的法西斯独裁统治。
2) 与欧洲的沙文主义法西斯分子形成直接对比，国民党法西斯分子是最背信弃义和最可耻的。他们在‘民族主义’的名义下复兴古老的奴隶道德，并将中国人变成帝国主义的奴隶，从而为帝国主义瓜分中国铺平道路。
“刽子手蒋介石在南昌大声叫嚣：处死那些仍谈论抗日的人。法西斯报纸和声明公开宣称，只要能消灭共产党，将满洲和热河丧失给日本帝国主义无关紧要。在他们看来，帝国主义瓜分中国对地主资产阶级无害，只有工人和农民才会受到伤害。”

新生活运动

“为了帮助帝国主义进攻中国，国民党法西斯分子最近大幅加强了对苏维埃的运动，并加倍努力推广体现为新生活运动的奴隶教育。

“在新生活运动的五项基本规则中，找不到像中国国家主义者（民族主义者）最近提出的‘抵抗列强’这样的爱国口号。除了效忠军事领袖（即蒋介石）外，国民党法西斯分子还提出了另一个口号：民族复兴。

“在2月19日南昌的一次演讲中，蒋介石清楚地定义了‘民族复兴’，其措辞如下。一开始他说：
... 伴随...共存的运动是障碍之一 ... 消除这一... 是不可能的。 ..."

vengor of imperialism has set himself the task of clearing the communists for
imperialists. Herein lies the decisive significance of the 5th campaign of
Chiang Kai-shek.
"National recovery must rely on Li (manners) and Tsoi (shame) for its real-
lisation", says Chiang, who wishes to conceal his betrayal of national inter-
ests with these solemn words. Although Chiang is disqualified to speak on this
subject, yet under the cloak of Li and Tsoi he may, he hopes, succeed in divert-
ing the masses from the revolutionary path by preaching the old fashioned mo-
rality. According to the fascists papers the life movement is a portion of the
program of national recovery, and old morality the soul of the new life move-
ment.
"Chiang wants to educate the masses in the spirit of old morality through
the police and school. Old morality and batons of the police are precisely
the weapons needed by imperialism to attack China.
Thus it is clear that the new activities of the KMT fascists have but one
purpose: preparing more ground for the imperialist division of China. The fas-
cists can not and dare not indulge in such demagogical propaganda as 'against
Versailles' advanced by Hitler or 'restoration of the old glorious Roman Em-
pire' preached by Mussolini. National phrases on their lips are mere evidences
of their betrayal.
Clamour for War
"Chinese fascists are clamouring for a world war, an imperialist world
war, in response to their brothers in Europe who agitate and organize that
war. They are thirsty for an imperialist war on the Soviet Union and Chinese
revolution. Proletarians of the whole world are fighting against the world
war primarily aimed at the Soviet Union and Chinese revolution but Chinese
fascists employ their whole propaganda machine in agitation for a second world
war, disseminating illusions among the masses and diverting them from the an-
tiimperialist struggle. Chinese fascists are preparing China as the battle-
field and the Chinese people as the cannon fodder for imperialism.
4) As said before, Chinese fascists dare not indulge freely in national
phrases nor dare they employ such words as 'revolution' and 'socialism' to
cover their role as lackey to capitalism. They merely declare in favour and
support of the old regime. The fascist papers openly preach that "We must re-
frain from any action inimical to the public peace and order and grow in
strength under conditions of maintenance of the status quo in China".
This does not mean in the least that Chinese fascists have no national
and social phrases whatsoever. They are actively agitating for 'technical co-
operation with the league of nations', 'opening the northwest', 'controlled
and planned economy', 'collaboration between labour and capital', 'making the
greatest efforts to push construction', etc, all for the maintenance of the
rule of imperialism-landlord-bourgeoisie, for the more severe exploitation of
the Chinese toilers, for leading the Chinese masses to the road of hunger, fa-
mine, death and colonial slavery.
5) For the above reasons Chinese fascists are more afraid of ... than their brothers in Europe. Their ideological poverty makes them fear ... for any mass movement. They dare not play with fire within a revolutionary
environment. Chinese fascists depend on troops, police, militia, ... revolutionary renegades and the upper stratum of intellectuals in contact
with their European brothers who appeal to the ruined peasants, handicraftsmen,
employees, officials and the declassed elements in big cities with an inclination
to break into the working class.
"European fascists have a mass armed organisation which is lacking in the
Chinese fascist camp. The fascist blue shirts under Chiang Kai-shek are a se-
cret body resting on blind discipline and the mutual watch of its members.
Chinese fascists mobilise the entire police force and detectives on every me-
morial day to prevent any demonstration while European fascists permit and or-
ganise certain anti-foreign demonstrations.
"This does not mean that Chinese fascists make no appeal to the masses.
They are just buying the labour contractors and backward workers, appealing
to the kulaks in the village, organising the new life movement in support of
the old regime (regime ancient), a movement that aims at making docile slaves
out of the Chinese people for imperialism.
"Such are the characteristics of Chinese fascism with the bitterest feelings
against the Chinese revolution, the Chinese Soviets and the USSR. Chinese fas-
cism is the most faithful servant of imperialism.
"All counterrevolutionary groups in China, from social democrats, the right
wing, to Trotskyists, have openly joined hands with the fascists, especially
after the collapse of the people's government in Fukien.
"We are pretty sure that with the participation of millions of militant
workers the revolutionary movement in China is able to smash the fascist
dictatorship in the end."

帝国主义的复仇者已给自己定下了为帝国主义清除共产党的任务。蒋介石的第五次“围剿”的决定性意义即在于此。
“国家复兴必须依靠‘礼’和‘耻’来实现”，蒋介石说道，他企图用这些庄严的词句来掩盖其出卖民族利益的行为。虽然蒋介石没有资格谈论这个话题，但他希望披着“礼”和“耻”的外衣，通过宣扬旧道德，成功地将群众从革命道路上引开。据法西斯报纸称，新生活运动是国家复兴计划的一部分，而旧道德则是新生活运动的灵魂。
“蒋介石想通过警察和学校以旧道德的精神教育群众。旧道德和警察的警棍正是帝国主义攻击中国所需要的武器。
因此，国民党法西斯分子的新活动显然只有一个目的：为帝国主义瓜分中国准备更多的场地。法西斯分子不能也不敢像希特勒那样 indulge in（沉溺于）‘反对凡尔赛条约’之类的煽动性宣传，或像墨索里尼那样鼓吹‘恢复古罗马帝国的光荣’。他们口头的民族主义辞藻仅仅是其背叛行为的证据。
叫嚣战争
“中国法西斯分子正在叫嚣世界大战，一场帝国主义的世界大战，以响应他们在欧洲那些煽动和组织这场战争的兄弟。他们渴望发动一场针对苏联和中国革命的帝国主义战争。全世界无产者正在 primarily（主要）反对旨在针对苏联和中国革命的世界大战，但中国法西斯分子却动用其全部宣传机器鼓动第二次世界大战，在群众中散布幻想，使他们偏离反帝斗争。中国法西斯分子正将中国准备为战场，将中国人民准备为帝国主义的炮灰。
4) 如前所述，中国法西斯分子不敢随意使用民族主义辞藻，也不敢使用‘革命’和‘社会主义’等词汇来掩盖其作为资本主义走狗的角色。他们 merely（仅仅）声明拥护和支持旧政权。法西斯报纸公开宣扬：“我们必须避免任何有害于公共和平与秩序的行动，并在维持中国现状的条件下壮大力量。”
这绝不意味着中国法西斯分子没有任何民族和社会方面的辞藻。他们积极鼓吹‘与国际联盟进行技术合作’、‘开发西北’、‘受控和计划经济’、‘劳资合作’、‘竭尽全力推进建设’等，所有这些都是为了维持帝国主义-地主-资产阶级的统治，为了更严厉地剥削中国劳工，为了将中国群众引向饥饿、饥荒、死亡和殖民奴役的道路。
5) 出于上述原因，中国法西斯分子比他们在欧洲的兄弟更害怕……他们的思想贫乏使他们害怕……任何群众运动。他们不敢在革命环境中玩火。中国法西斯分子依赖军队、警察、民团、……革命叛徒以及与其欧洲兄弟有联系的知识分子上层，后者向破产的农民、手工业者、雇员、官员以及大城市中倾向于混入工人阶级的堕落分子发出呼吁。
“欧洲法西斯分子拥有中国法西斯阵营所缺乏的群众武装组织。蒋介石旗下的法西斯蓝衣社是一个依靠盲目纪律和成员间相互监视的秘密团体。中国法西斯分子在每个纪念日动员全部警察力量和侦探以防止任何示威活动，而欧洲法西斯分子则允许并组织某些反外示威。
“这并不意味着中国法西斯分子不向群众发出呼吁。他们只是在收买包工头和落后工人，向村里的富农发出呼吁，组织新生活运动以支持旧政权（古代政权），该运动旨在使中国人民成为帝国主义驯服的奴隶。
“这就是中国法西斯主义的特征，它对中国革命、中国苏维埃和苏联怀有最强烈的仇恨。中国法西斯主义是帝国主义最忠实的仆从。
“中国所有的反革命集团，从社会民主党人、右翼到托洛茨基主义者，都已公开与法西斯分子联手，特别是在福建人民政府垮台之后。
“我们确信，随着数百万战斗工人的参与，中国的革命运动最终能够粉碎法西斯独裁统治。”

pages.en:
5
ANOTHER VICTORY OF THE RED ARMY
On May 29 a portion of the red army annihilated one full brigade of the
80th division of the KMT bandits in the eastern part of Shhsien, Fukien, cap-
turing 800 rifles, 20 machine guns, 30 piculs of bullets for the cannon, 100,
000 rounds of ammunition.

A MILITARIST WAR LOOMING AGAIN

Beginning a week ago, the Canton 'National Defence' Conference has just
come to a conclusion, declaring that all KMT leaders present at the meeting
agreed on the need for greater efforts being made in the joint campaign a-
gainst the Soviets in Kiangsi, for closer cooperation between Canton and Nan-
king in the military field vis-a-vis the communists. The KMT leaders of the
southwest pledged themselves to make more strenuous exertions in the march on
Soviet territory.

Militarists at the Conference

Under the guise of national defence militarists gathered at Canton from
Shanghai as well as from the south. Gen. Chiang Pei-shen, personal delegate
of Chiang Kai-shek, first went to Canton, telling Gen. Chen Chitong (warlord
of Kwangtung) to speed up his drive on the communists in Kiangsi as well as
to aid Nanking in the work of unification. The latter phrase may mean dif-
ferent things to the different militarists. In the case of Chen Chitong uni-
fication signifies handing over Kwangtung to Chiang Kai-shek which he and his
master, British imperialism, are quite unwilling to do. To Hu Han-min, the
master politician now living in retirement in Hong Kong, Chiang's unifica-
tion means cutting off his relations with Canton (his financial reservoir)
as well as supporting Nanking in its present surrender to Japanese imperial-
ism to which he is opposed for the simple reason that he wants to keep the
anti-Japanese slogan as a weapon to win popular sympathy and postpone the ca-
pitulation until his rise to power at Nanking. Viewed from the angle of the
Kwangsi militarists, Chiang's unification is a great threat to them and their
master, French imperialism, which has just succeeded in laying a firmer hand
on the warlords of Kwangsi (adjacent to French Indo-China).
Whatever the implications of unification, the KMT militarists concerned
must take up the matter and talk it over among themselves behind closed
doors, especially at the moment when the red army has scored initial success
in repulsing the KMT 5th campaign.
Besides Chiang Pei-shen and Gen. Sheh Yno, both representatives of Chiang
Kai-shek, the Canton conference is attended by Ho Chien, dictator of Hunan;
Pei Tsung-hsi, dictator of Kwangsi; Chen Chitong, dictator of Kwangtung; Gen.
Li Chi-shen, aide to Pei, and a number of ranking military officers. Politic-
ians are excluded on the ground that the conference concerns national defence
and communist-suppression alone. Practically all the military dictators of
the southern provinces have honored the conference with their presence, a
fact that has caused special anxiety among the public. The Japanese owned
paper, Kiang Hwa Chen Pao, has followed the immediate proceedings of the con-
ference with special interest and considered the conference as an anti-Chiang
Kai-shek gathering.

Decisions of the Conference

According to the interviews granted to the press by the militarists the
conference reached the decision to finish the campaign against the Soviets
at an earlier date by closer cooperation between Nanking and Canton. As to
national defence the conference departed from the original objective and an-
nounced that measures for national defence shall be indefinitely postponed
in order to avoid misunderstandings with Japan. The treacherous character
of the KMT militarists is thus entirely laid bare. KMT militarists, politi-
cians and fascists are all the same in one respect: capitulation to impe-
rialism.
The concentration, at present, of the major part of the KMT bandit forc-
es against the Soviets does not, however, exclude the possibility of another
imperialist war (a war among the militarists) in the near future. The ex-
pansion of Chiang's influence at the expense of other militarists and the
concentration of forces in practically tantamount to the widening of the Jap-
anese sphere of influence in China. It can not go on without arousing the jeal-
ousy of American and British imperialism who have vital interests...

红军的又一胜利
5月29日，红军一部在福建邵武东部歼灭了国民党匪帮第80师的一个整旅，缴获步枪800支、机枪20挺、炮弹30担、子弹10万发。

军阀战争再次逼近

一周前开始的广州“国防”会议刚刚结束，宣布出席会议的所有国民党领导人均同意需要更加努力地在江西联合“剿共”，并在军事领域加强广州与南京在对抗共产党方面的合作。西南地区的国民党领导人承诺在向苏区进军中做出更 strenuous（艰苦/大力）的努力。

会议上的军阀们

打着国防的幌子，军阀们从上海以及南方聚集到广州。蒋介石的个人代表蒋伯森（Chiang Pei-shen，音译）将军首先前往广州，告诉陈济棠将军（广东军阀）加快对江西共产党的进攻，并协助南京进行统一工作。后一种说法对不同军阀而言可能有不同含义。对陈济棠来说，统一意味着将广东交给蒋介石，这是他和他的主子英国帝国主义极不愿意做的。对现在隐居香港的政治大师胡汉民来说，蒋介石的统一意味着切断他与广州（他的财政储备库）的关系，并支持南京目前向日本帝国主义的投降，他反对这一点仅仅是因为他想保留抗日口号作为赢得民众同情的武器，并将投降推迟到他掌权南京之时。从广西军阀的角度来看，蒋介石的统一对他们和他们的主子法国帝国主义构成了巨大威胁，后者刚刚成功地更牢固地控制了广西军阀（毗邻法属印度支那）。
无论统一的含义如何，相关的国民党军阀必须在幕后处理此事并相互商讨，尤其是在红军在击退国民党第五次“围剿”中取得初步成功的时刻。
除了蒋介石的代表蒋伯森和薛岳（Sheh Yno，音译）将军外，出席广州会议的还有湖南统治者何键、广西统治者白崇禧（Pei Tsung-hsi，音译）、广东统治者陈济棠、白的助手李济深将军以及多名高级军官。政客们被排除在外，理由是会议仅涉及国防和镇压共产党。南方各省的几乎所有军事独裁者都出席了会议，这一事实引起了公众的特别焦虑。日本人拥有的报纸《江华晨报》（Kiang Hwa Chen Pao，音译）特别关注会议的即时进程，并将此次会议视为反蒋介石的集会。

会议决议

根据军阀们接受媒体采访的说法，会议决定通过南京和广州的更紧密合作，早日结束对苏维埃的战役。至于国防，会议偏离了最初的目标，宣布为避免与日本产生误解，国防措施将无限期推迟。国民党军阀的背叛性质 thus（因此）完全暴露无遗。国民党军阀、政客和法西斯分子在一个方面是一样的：向帝国主义投降。
目前，国民党匪帮主力集中在对付苏维埃，但这并不排除近期发生另一场帝国主义战争（军阀之间的战争）的可能性。蒋介石以牺牲其他军阀为代价扩大其影响力，以及兵力的集中，实际上等同于日本在华势力范围的扩大。这不可避免地会引起拥有重大利益的美国和英国帝国主义的嫉妒……

RESCUE REVOLUTIONARY LEADERS

1) The Volunteers in Kirin Scored Two More Victories...................p. 1
2) Economic Reconstruction of the Soviets............................p. 2
3) Nanking Pleased Japan by Another Surrender........................p. 4

VOLUNTEERS IN KIRIN SCORED TWO MORE VICTORIES
One Mutiny Among Manchurian Troops
...... .... .... ...... .... ....

Following their previous successes, the volunteers in Manchuria have recently occupied two more important cities in Kirin: Hsulan which is only 50 miles from the capital of Kirin and Lung Chin Tsen, also known under the name of Lutaogu, which serves as a distributive centre in the area of Funn Tao. In the latter district was located the Chinese customs house before the occupation of Manchuria by the Japanese.

The Volunteer Attack

According to information emanating from Japanese sources the volunteers on June 22 attacked Lutaogu in the morning and, after severe fighting with the Japanese, took the whole city in the afternoon. Only 600 volunteers took part in the offensive. They still keep the city. By its message of June 29 the Japanese Dontung news agency informed that about 1,000 volunteers besieged the town of Lotaogu Chisuo on June 26 and attacked the troops and police by a surprise, disarming the police entirely. After two days of fighting they succeeded in capturing the town.
Hsulan was taken two weeks earlier. According to the United Press, American, several hundred volunteers launched an attack on the hsien last Friday and defeated the garrison, setting free all the prisoners held in the jails.
Serious fighting took place in other areas of Manchuria. On June 27 the Shunpao of Shanghai gave out the following news: The Kirin volunteers numbering some 6,000 besieged Ping Hsien, administering a vital blow to the Japanese garrison, followed on June 27 by another attack of the volunteers who descended on Tung Chiang Hsien. Ping Hsien lies to the north of Hsulan and on the southeast of Harbin while Tung Chiang is situated at the confluence of the Sungari and Volunkiang, quite near the Soviet frontier. By skillful tactics the heroic volunteers operated successfully in regions heavily guarded by the Japanese and their puppet. This fact alone shatters the theory of the KMT bandits that China is too impotent to fight against Japanese imperialism.

Mutiny of Manchurian Soldiers

The high pressure of Japanese officials among the Manchurian troops helps the latter considerably in coming to their national consciousness. The Manchurian soldiers have been adjusted to un... But they face the danger of being dissolved, to be replaced by those who are considered by the Japs as more reliable. The mutinies instigated by the volunteers have been instrumental in the disintegration among the Manchurian army.
On June 21 800 cavalry stationed in Halangyu (a pass situated in the west) revolted against the oppression of Japanese officials in the eastern Manchukuo. They put up a stiff resistance to the Japanese.

吉林义勇军再获两胜
满洲军队发生一次兵变
…… .... .... ...... .... ....

继此前取得的胜利之后，满洲的义勇军最近又占领了吉林的两个重要城市：舒兰，距吉林省会仅50英里；以及龙镇（又称鹿道沟），它是抚松地区的一个分销中心。在日本占领满洲之前，中国海关就设在该地区。

义勇军的进攻

根据来自日本方面的消息，义勇军于6月22日上午袭击了鹿道沟，在与日军经过激烈战斗后，于下午攻占了全城。参加此次进攻的义勇军仅有600人。他们目前仍控制着该城。日本东通社在6月29日的电讯中称，约1,000名义勇军于6月26日包围了鹿道沟支所，出其不意地袭击了驻军和警察，完全解除了警察的武装。经过两天的战斗，他们成功攻占了该镇。
舒兰是在两周前被攻占的。据美国合众社报道，数百名义勇军于上周五对该县发动攻击，击败了守备部队，释放了监狱中关押的所有囚犯。
满洲其他地区也发生了激烈的战斗。6月27日，上海《申报》发布了如下消息：约6,000名吉林义勇军包围了宾县，给日本守备队以沉重打击，随后义勇军于6月27日又袭击了同江县。宾县位于舒兰以北、哈尔滨东南，而同江位于松花江与乌苏里江汇合处，靠近苏联边境。英勇的义勇军凭借巧妙的战术，在日军及其傀儡重兵把守的地区成功作战。仅这一事实就粉碎了国民党匪徒所谓中国无力对抗日本帝国主义的理论。

满洲士兵的兵变

日本官员在满洲军队中施加的高压，极大地促使后者觉醒民族意识。满洲士兵已被调整以适应未……但他们面临着被解散的危险，并被日本人认为更可靠的人所取代。由义勇军煽动的兵变加速了满洲军队的瓦解。
6月21日，驻扎在哈伦峪（位于西部的一个山口）的800名骑兵，因反抗伪满洲国东部日本官员的压迫而发动起义。他们对日军进行了顽强的抵抗。
