northwest and the Tibetans in the southwest. They lead a nomadic life and have strong religious prejudices. Beyond trading they have no relations with the Chinese and Mohammedans. The census of Kansu shows that 30% of the population is Mohammedans who by virtue of their firm belief in Mohammedanism have formed into a solid bloc. The feudal lords of the Mohammedan race have always squabbled among themselves but this fact does not place the solidarity of the Mohammedans in jeopardy. Quarrels of a racial nature have occurred between the two races resulting from the malicious machinations of the Chinese and Mohammedan Tuhao-landlord-bourgeoisie. By stirring up such quarrels and then turning them to advantage the Chinese and Mohammedan landlord and bourgeoisie have succeeded in capturing political power. In 1928 the Mohammedans revolted against the exploitation of Gen. Feng Yu-shiang, a revolt that was later turned into a racial war in which thousands were killed and between Chinese and Mohammedans. Working behind this terrific racial war involving thousands killed and wounded, leaders of the landlord-bourgeoisie of both races laughed at it and made the greatest political gains. Needless to say, the toilers of both races suffered heavily during this racial massacre engineered and brought about by Chinese and Mohammedan landlord-bourgeois.

Development of Mass Struggle

The Kuomintang government in Kansu squeezed perhaps much harder than elsewhere for the simple reason that the province is poor and impoverished. Nevertheless in 1931 it exacted some 10,478,000 dollars: $4,825,000 on opium culture (the same tax on areas whether cultivated or not), $650,000 on opium business, $1,300,000 on land tax, $1,740,000 special tax, $140,000 on tea, $211,000 stamp tax, $582,000 tax on wine and tobacco, $1,030,000 miscellaneous taxes. In the same year it spent $13,850,000: $9,360,000 military expenditure, $1,440,000 civil administration in the provincial capital, $2,500,000 for local administration, $450,000 education, $150,000 for kuomintang. Taking the population of the province as 5,000,000, each person whether male or female is forced to pay three dollars and 0.3 Chinese bushel of rice in addition. Under the increasing extortion of the Kuomintang and landlord-bourgeoisie in the past two years the masses could no longer live as usual, hence the main cause of the sharpening of the mass struggle. To place a check on this rising struggle the KMT called for the despatch of one full division from Nanking. Commanded by Hu Chung-nan, a reliable general of Chiang Kai-shek and stationed in the south of the province, this division serves as the headquarters of the fascist thugs who aid in the suppression of the mass struggle.

Aside from spasmodic struggles among the workers in the cities, the peasants in the village were forced by the sharpened exploitation of the landlord and the KMT Government to fight for their own existence, particularly in a dozen of hsiens in the south bordering on Shensi in the east and Szechuen in due south where the red armies and Soviets have been operating with a varying measure of success. Occasionally they fought shoulder to shoulder with the red partisans coming from neighbouring regions. There the party, that is, the communist party, can speak with a good deal of authority and confidence. There the Soviet is going to emerge sooner or later. Some of the KMT soldiers joined the revolution, too.

Owing to the penetration of Japanese imperialism from the east and north and British imperialism from the southwest (from Chinhai), the masses in Kansu have become in the past awaken to the danger of the two named imperialist powers. The anti-imperialist movement in the cities has been forging on slowly but steadily. In Lanchow we find anti-imperialist associations under various names, all organised by toilers and advanced intelligentsia. But like elsewhere the anti-imperialist work there must be done in an underground way because of the KMT oppression. Last November three anti-imperialist leaders were rounded up by the military authorities and executed a few days later.

In short, Kansu's swing to revolution is highly significant as it reflects the further penetration of the revolutionary influence in the regions backward. Revolution will find a very fertile soil there under the correct leadership of the communist party.

THE FASCIST CULTURAL POLICY OF THE KUOMINTANG

The increasing fascisation of the Kuomintang in the field of culture entirely falls in line with its set policy of surrender to imperialism. The measures employed in this regard are increasingly violent and barbarous. As previously mentioned in our previous issues, a multitude of writers, artists, professors, students, etc, have fallen victims to the
pages.zh:
5
西北部以及西南部的藏人。他们过着游牧生活，且抱有强烈的宗教偏见。除贸易外，他们与汉人和穆斯林没有任何往来。甘肃的人口普查显示，30%的人口为穆斯林，他们凭借对伊斯兰教的坚定信仰形成了一个坚实的集团。穆斯林种族的封建领主们虽然总是内部争吵，但这一事实并未危及穆斯林的团结。由于汉人和穆斯林土豪—地主—资产阶级的恶意操纵，两个种族之间发生了种族性质的争吵。通过煽动此类争吵并从中渔利，汉人和穆斯林的地主及资产阶级成功攫取了政治权力。1928年，穆斯林反抗冯玉祥将军的剥削，这场起义后来演变成一场种族战争，导致汉人与穆斯林之间数千人丧生。在这场涉及数千死伤的可怕种族战争背后，两个种族的地主—资产阶级领袖对此冷眼旁观，并获得了最大的政治利益。不用说，在这场由汉人和穆斯林地主—资产阶级策划和引发的种族屠杀中，两个种族的劳苦大众遭受了沉重的苦难。

群众斗争的发展

国民党政府在甘肃的盘剥可能比其他地方更为严酷，原因很简单，即该省贫穷困顿。尽管如此，1931年它仍征收了约10,478,000美元：鸦片种植税4,825,000美元（无论是否耕种，区域均征收同等税额），鸦片贸易税650,000美元，土地税1,300,000美元，特别税1,740,000美元，茶税140,000美元，印花税211,000美元，烟酒税582,000美元，杂税1,030,000美元。同年支出为13,850,000美元：军费9,360,000美元，省会民政行政费1,440,000美元，地方行政费2,500,000美元，教育费450,000美元，国民党党务费150,000美元。以全省人口5,000,000计算，无论男女，每人被迫缴纳3美元，此外还需缴纳0.3中国石的大米。在过去两年中，由于国民党和地主—资产阶级的勒索日益加剧，民众已无法照常生活，这就是群众斗争激化的主要原因。为了遏制这一上升的斗争势头，国民党要求从南京派遣一个整编师。该师由蒋介石的亲信将领胡宗南指挥，驻扎在该省南部，作为协助镇压群众斗争的法西斯暴徒的大本营。

除了城市工人中零星的斗争外，农村农民在地主和国民党政府加剧的剥削下，被迫为生存而战，特别是在南部与东面的陕西和正南面的四川接壤的十几个县，红军和苏维埃在那里活动并取得不同程度的成功。他们偶尔还与来自邻近地区的红色游击队员并肩作战。在那里，党，即共产党，说话具有相当大的权威和信心。在那里，苏维埃迟早会出现。一些国民党士兵也加入了革命。

由于日本帝国主义从东部和北部渗透，以及英国帝国主义从西南部（从青海）渗透，甘肃民众在过去已意识到这两个帝国主义列强的危险。城市的反帝运动正在缓慢但稳步地推进。在兰州，我们发现各种名义的反帝协会，均由劳苦大众和进步知识分子组织。但与其他地方一样，由于国民党的压迫，那里的反帝工作必须以地下方式进行。去年十一月，三名反帝领袖被军事当局逮捕，并在几天后被处决。

总之，甘肃转向革命具有高度重要意义，因为它反映了革命影响在落后地区的进一步渗透。在共产党的正确领导下，革命将在哪里找到非常肥沃的土壤。

国民党的法西斯文化政策

国民党在文化领域日益法西斯化，完全符合其向帝国主义投降的既定政策。在此方面采取的措施日益暴力和野蛮。正如我们在前几期中提到的，大批作家、艺术家、教授、学生等沦为受害者，

pages.en:
6
fascist thugs as a result of their refusal to bow before the fascist policy to sell the country.
Led by Chiang Kai-shek, the fascist cultural policy of the KMT has been carried on in the school, press, bookstores, literary circles, drama societies, film companies, etc. The ministry of the interior, the ministry of education, the KMT offices and political departments are all open instruments of the fascist policy while the secret blue shirts society with its ramifications play the leading role. Besides suppressing the revolutionary and liberal elements by brute force, these thugs also published and still publish a chain of periodicals filled the nationalist and chauvinist phrases calculated to anaesthetize the youth.

make Slaves out of Students

To enslave the young students and to check the growth of the revolutionary movement in the school, the fascists adopt the following methods: 1) military training forced on the students who can not but obey; any one seriously objecting to it will be expelled as has been the case with the non-conforming students of the 1st middle school in Changsha who, numbering 68 in all, were in the middle of December ruthlessly thrown on the street by the armed guard of Gen. Ho Chien, chairman of Hunan; the military instructors are for the most part fascists and their agents controlling the fascist cells in the school; 2) restriction of the courses on social studies and literature but extension of those on pure sciences and engineering with a view to making more slaves out of the students deprived of any correct thought on society while the fascist political school at Nanking is making a persistent drive to enrol more students and to give them a thorough fascist education; 3) enforcement of the examination system out of the school designed to make the students entirely absorbed in their studies and convert them into subservient men of letters; 4) fascist domination of the student and teacher associations bent on the elimination of the revolutionary and anti-KMT elements; 5) revolutionary or leftist professors arrested or kidnapped or turned out by the misguided students with the fascist cell playing behind the curtain; 6) students required to read Chinese classics long forgotten and to be injected with feudal moralities, so that they will become willing slaves. As a whole, the students so oppressed and maltreated by the fascists are not only indignant but prepared to put up a stubborn resistance.
At the same time, the fascist thugs also choose the bookstore as a target of their attack. Numerous bookstores have been punished or sealed throughout the country for having sold marxist or radical books. Special stress is laid on the ban of books turned out by Soviet Union or simply dealing with the Soviet Union. According to information from reliable sources the propaganda committee of the central KMT at Nanking is contemplating to place some 6,000 books on the black list. But, on the other hand, Chiang Kai-shek has set aside large sums of money to buy over Chinese papers including the mosquito papers as well as those run by imperialism. These papers, when actually bought over, set themselves the sole task of eulogizing Chiang Kai-shek and prosecuting a vigorous campaign of lies and slander against the personages hostile to Chiang or the revolutionaries or radicals.

Recent Fascist Culture Drive

In view of the rising tide of the revolutionary movement in the field of culture the fascist thugs have recently taken measures both defensive and offensive on the cultural front. On Jan. 22 more than 50 leaders of fascist gang including Chen Quo-fu, Chen Li-fu, Wu Shen-a, etc, openly advertised in the papers for the immediate formation of The China Culture Association. In their letter they denounced both feudal and proletarian culture, and favored the organisation of the so-called San Min Chu I culture front. This is no doubt a maneuvre directed against the growing influence of the revolution in culture. Two days later the said association was formally inaugurated with the attendance of 100 delegates all fascist thugs. In his short address the Chairman, Quo Wei, had this much to say: "As the revolutionary force (the KMT) grows stronger and stronger, the communist propaganda has become more effective and penetrating, the more so in the few years just past.... The association has an important mission in reviving the nationalist culture and repulsing the irrational reactionary culture".
Synchronising with the formation of the China Culture Association is the publication in local papers of manifesto over the signature of an anti-communist league of young men who demanded in strong terms the expulsion of a few dozen radical playwrights from the moving picture companies
pages.zh:
6
因为他们拒绝向出卖国家的法西斯政策低头，从而成为法西斯暴徒的牺牲品。
在蒋介石的领导下，国民党的法西斯文化政策在学校、新闻界、书店、文学界、戏剧社团、电影公司等机构中推行。内政部、教育部、国民党党部和政治部都是实施法西斯政策的公开工具，而拥有分支机构的秘密蓝衣社则发挥主导作用。这些暴徒除了用武力镇压革命和自由派分子外，还出版并仍在出版一系列期刊，充斥着民族主义和沙文主义的辞藻，旨在麻醉青年。

使学生成为奴隶

为了奴役年轻学生并遏制学校中革命运动的增长，法西斯分子采取以下方法：1) 强迫学生接受军事训练，学生不得不服从；任何强烈反对者将被开除，正如长沙第一中学的情况那样，该校68名不守规矩的学生在12月中旬被湖南省主席何键的武装卫队无情地赶上街头；军事教官大多是法西斯分子及其代理人，控制着学校内的法西斯小组；2) 限制社会科学和文学课程，但扩展纯科学和工程课程，旨在使学生在缺乏任何正确社会思想的情况下成为更多的奴隶，而南京的法西斯政治学校则持续努力招收更多学生，并给予他们彻底的法西斯教育；3) 在校外实施考试制度，旨在使学生完全埋头于学业，并将他们转化为顺从的文人；4) 法西斯分子支配学生和教师协会，致力于消除革命和反国民党分子；5) 革命或左派教授被逮捕、绑架，或被受误导的学生赶走，法西斯小组在幕后操纵；6) 要求学生阅读早已被遗忘的中国经典，并向他们灌输封建道德，使他们成为自愿的奴隶。总体而言，受到法西斯分子如此压迫和虐待的学生不仅感到愤怒，而且准备进行顽强的抵抗。
与此同时，法西斯暴徒也将书店作为攻击目标。全国许多书店因出售马克思主义或激进书籍而受到惩罚或被查封。特别强调禁止出版苏联出版的或仅涉及苏联的书籍。据可靠消息来源称，南京国民党中央宣传部正考虑将约6,000本书列入黑名单。但另一方面，蒋介石拨出巨款收买中文报纸，包括小报以及由帝国主义经营的报纸。这些报纸一旦被收买，便将自己唯一的任务定为颂扬蒋介石，并对敌视蒋介石的人、革命者或激进分子大肆进行谎言和诽谤运动。

近期的法西斯文化运动

鉴于文化领域革命运动的高涨，法西斯暴徒最近在文化战线上采取了防御和进攻措施。1月22日，包括陈果夫、陈立夫、吴醒亚等在内的50多名法西斯帮派头目在报纸上公开广告，立即成立“中国文化协会”。在他们的信中，他们谴责封建文化和无产阶级文化，并支持组织所谓的“三民主义”文化阵线。这无疑是一种针对革命在文化中日益增长的影响力的策略。两天后，该协会正式成立，出席的100名代表均为法西斯暴徒。主席郭伟在其简短致辞中表示：“随着革命力量（国民党）越来越强大，共产主义宣传变得更为有效和深入，尤其是在过去几年中……本协会在复兴民族文化和击退非理性的反动文化方面肩负着重要使命。”
与中国文化协会的成立同步，当地报纸刊登了一份署名“青年反共联盟”的宣言，该联盟强烈要求将几十名激进剧作家从电影公司中驱逐出去

of Shanghai:Tien Han, Mou Shen, Sen Fan-shan, Chien Sei-tsen, Sen Shi-lin,
Shu Shen-tse, etc. They further demanded the suppression or change of a
whole lot of films (nearly 20) said to be favorable to the commist cause.
In the name of the league they petitioned and urged the central KMT to
carry out their demands immediately and this as an aid to the KMT forces
at the front in fighting the red armies. Of course this league is but a
camouflage for the bloodthirsty fascists.
On Jan. 9 the fascist thugs took a bold, unprecedented step towards
the fascization of the journals in Shanghai. On that day they invited the
journalists present with sanctions if they fail to purge journalists of the
leading papers to an impressive banquet, and their spokesman, "an Kung-zon
(a leader of the local KMT), openly threatened the journalists present
with sanctions if they fail to purge their publications of revolutionary
news and radical thoughts. In his opinion, any writings advocating the
class struggle must be a taboo. The proprietor of the Shanghai Sun
Pao, Se Liang-tsai, and Wang Pai-chi of the Shanghai Sinwanpao promised
in their speech to help the KMT in this work of purification. Other jour-
nalists followed suit and expressed their opinion almost in the same tone,
Here we find the fascist tendency on the part of the Shanghai compradore-
bourgeoisie in face of the expanding influence of the revolutionary move-
ment. But in spite of the cooperation of the Shanghai journalists with
the fascist thugs the revolutionary trend in culture will go forward as

30,000 KAILAN MINERS WENT ON STRIKE
Demanded to form unions, against contract system,
British consul asked for armed intervention.

30,000 miners employed by the British Kailan Mining administration
struck work on Jan.14 in the afternoon and heroically held on for the
past two weeks. Their demands as reported in the press are: re-instate-
ment of dismissed workers, abolition of the contractor system, raise in
pay, old bonus and above all, organisation of unions. More than 10,000
workers in the Makiagou mine staged a monster demonstration and clashed
with the mining police resulting in 3 casualties. The strikers attempt-
ed to disarm the police. And then followed the proclamation of martial
law. The Kailan administration and the British consul discussed with the
Hopei provincial government concrete means of forcibly breaking the
strike.
Unions forbidden by Tangu Agreement
The Kailan mining administration is the largest of its kind owned by
British capitalists within the Great Wall, controlling five mines situat-
ed in Tongshan, Makiagou, etc, employ-ing over 40,000 workers. The Makia-
gou mine is said to be the biggest with more than 10,000 men. 4/5 of the
workers are controlled by 40-50 contractors, and their wages for the most
part have gone into the pockets of the contractors—so with their wages
on Sundays. The Japanese invasion of N. China last Spring turned the Kai-
lan mining district into a war zone and inflicted the greatest sufferings
on the workers.
The Tangu agreement signed by the KMT on May 30, 1933, as a sign of
capitulation to Japanese imperialism contains a secret clause putting a
ban on union activities. With the dissolution of the unions by the KMT
when mining work was resumed, British capitalists had practically a free
hand in cutting the wages by one third and reducing work to the 5-day-
shifts. They effected mass dismissals, 700 workers being, for instance,
fired in Makiagou alone. The strike burst out immediately after it was
made known that the capitalists decided to withhold payment of the bonus
at the end of the lunar year.
Materialisation of general strike
The strikers at Makiagou demonstrated and came into a clash with the
mining police who fired on the workers. But the latter were also prepared
for this eventuality and put up a fight with the provokating police, re-
sulting in 3 dead and 6 wounded. Then workers of the other mines came to
the rescue by declaring a strike for the same demands. On Jan.26 about
40,000 miners in the four mines proclaimed a general strike, asking for
(1) formation of the unions, (2) abolition of the 5-day system, (3) abo-
lition of the contract system, (4) jobs to the unemployed, (5) restora-
tion of wages on the original level. Among these demands the strikers
pressed most hard for the organisation of the unions. This means that the
strike has become more political in character. The struggle still continues
against the clamour of the Chinese authorities who act as
direct instruments of the British consul.

上海的：田汉、穆申、森范山（音译）、钱世珍（音译）、森士林（音译）、舒申泽（音译）等。他们进一步要求查禁或修改一大批（近20部）据说有利于共产主义事业的电影。他们以该联盟的名义请愿，敦促国民党中央立即执行他们的要求，以此作为对前线与红军作战的国民党军队的援助。当然，这个联盟不过是嗜血法西斯分子的伪装。

1月9日，法西斯暴徒采取了大胆且前所未有的步骤，推动上海报刊的法西斯化。当天，他们设下盛大宴会，邀请记者出席，并威胁若不清除主要报纸中的革命新闻和激进思想记者，将予以制裁；其发言人、“安公尊”（音译，当地国民党领导人）公开威胁在场记者，若不从出版物中清除革命新闻和激进思想，将面临制裁。在他看来，任何倡导阶级斗争的文章都必须是禁忌。《上海太阳报》业主史量才和《上海新晚报》的王柏奇在发言中承诺协助国民党进行这项净化工作。其他记者也纷纷效仿，以几乎相同的语调表达了意见。在此，我们看到了面对革命运动影响扩大，上海买办资产阶级表现出的法西斯倾向。但是，尽管上海记者与法西斯暴徒合作，文化领域的革命趋势仍将照常向前发展。

三万名开滦矿工罢工
要求组建工会，反对包工制，
英国领事请求武装干涉。

受雇于英资开滦矿务局的三万名矿工于1月14日下午罢工，并在过去两周里英勇地坚持了下来。据媒体报道，他们的要求是：复职被解雇的工人，废除包工制，增加工资，发放旧奖金，以及最重要的是，组织工会。马家沟矿的一万多名工人举行了大规模示威，并与矿警发生冲突，造成3人伤亡。罢工者试图解除警察的武装。随后宣布戒严。开滦矿务局和英国领事与河北省政府讨论了强行破坏罢工的具体手段。

《塘沽协定》禁止工会
开滦矿务局是长城以内英资资本家拥有的最大同类企业，控制着位于唐山、马家沟等地的五个矿井，雇佣工人超过4万名。据说马家沟矿是最大的，拥有一万多名工人。五分之四的工人受40至50名包工头控制，他们的大部分工资——包括周日工资——都落入了包工头的口袋。去年春天日本入侵华北，使开滦矿区变成战区，给工人带来了最大的苦难。

国民党于1933年5月30日签署的《塘沽协定》，作为向日本帝国主义投降的标志，包含一项禁止工会活动的秘密条款。随着复工时国民党解散工会，英国资本家在实际上得以随心所欲地将工资削减三分之一，并将工作减少为五天轮班制。他们实施了大规模解雇，例如仅在马家沟就解雇了700名工人。在得知资本家决定扣留农历年底的奖金后，罢工立即爆发。

总罢工的实现
马家沟的罢工者举行示威，并与向其开枪的矿警发生冲突。但后者也对这一可能发生的情况有所准备，并与挑衅的警察进行了搏斗，导致3人死亡，6人受伤。随后，其他矿井的工人通过宣布罢工以支持相同的要求来进行救援。1月26日，四个矿井的约4万名矿工宣布总罢工，要求：(1) 组建工会，(2) 废除五天制，(3) 废除包工制，(4) 为失业者提供工作，(5) 恢复原有工资水平。在这些要求中，罢工者最强烈坚持的是组织工会。这意味着罢工具有了更多的政治性质。斗争仍在继续，对抗着作为中国当局喧嚣声的直接工具的英国领事的叫嚣。

ANOTHER IMPENDING BETRAYAL OF N.CHINA BY KMT
.....................

In the spirit of the Tangu agreement signed last year KMT leaders are just discussing the terms of the betrayal of North China to Japanese imperialism. The chairman of the Peiping political council. Huang Fu (a sales agent for Nanking in negotiations with Japan), has, it is said, clashed with Ho Yin-chin, chairman of the Peiping military council, over the very terms. Huang Fu, attacked by Ho's men, took a trip down to Nanchang on April 3, and will appeal to Gen.Chiang Kai-shek for the adoption of his formulae of selling the country. The press here predicts that unless securing ratification of his formulae from Chiang he will not proceed to Peiping any more--meaning resignation. What terms Ho insists on for the conclusion of the sale is rather a secret. Nanchang Betrayal Conference

Many KMT experts well versed in the art of betrayal of national interests have gathered at Nanchang around Chiang Kai-shek and taken part in the discussion of the betrayal, with special stress on such questions as how to recognize Manchukuo, how to make secure the dominating position of Japanese imperialism in N. China, even in the whole land.

While agreeing with the Japanese plan of effecting through railway and postal service as well as other questions which lead to the de facto recognition by Nanking, the KMT leaders need only discuss the form to be adopted, a form that satisfies the Japanese but reduces the opposition from the masses. Besides, they have to agree to a plan by which the benefits accruing from the big sale shall be equitably distributed among the various fractions of the KMT. According to the opinion of Huang Fu as expressed in his interview given at Hankow, these questions, important as they are, will not bother Nanking very much as they are merely technical points.

The negotiations concerning the through railway and postal service, begun last year between Peiping and the Japanese Kwantung army, came to a sudden halt owing to the growing opposition from the masses, particularly at the moment when the People's government in Fukien proclaimed independence and denounced Chiang's betrayal of N.China (though the Fukien machine was itself a tool of the Japanese). Certainly, the revival of negotiations and the resumption of Manchukuo constitute a very delicate matter in view of the storm of protests from the masses.

国民党再次即将背叛华北
.....................

秉承去年签署的《塘沽协定》的精神，国民党领导人正在讨论将华北出卖给日本帝国主义的条款。据说，北平政务委员会委员长黄郛（南京在对日谈判中的推销员）就具体条款与北平军分会委员长何应钦发生了冲突。遭到何氏部下攻击的黄郛于4月3日南下南昌，将向蒋介石将军上诉，以求采纳其卖国方案。此处媒体预测，除非获得蒋介石对其方案的批准，否则他将不再前往北平——意指辞职。何坚持作为成交条件的条款相当保密。南昌背叛会议

许多精通出卖国家利益艺术的国民党专家聚集在南昌蒋介石周围，参与讨论背叛事宜，特别强调如何承认伪满洲国、如何确保日本帝国主义在华北乃至整个中国的支配地位等问题。

虽然同意日本通过直通铁路和邮政服务以及其他导致南京事实承认的问题的计划，但国民党领导人只需讨论所采用的形式，一种既能满足日本又能减少民众反对的形式。此外，他们还必须同意一项计划， whereby 从大出卖中获得的利益将在国民党各派系之间公平分配。根据黄郛在汉口接受采访时表达的意见，这些问题虽然重要，但不会太困扰南京，因为它们仅仅是技术性问题。

去年北平与日本关东军开始的关于直通铁路和邮政服务的谈判，由于民众日益增长的反对而突然停止，特别是在福建人民政府宣布独立并谴责蒋介石背叛华北的时候（尽管福建政权本身也是日本的工具）。当然，鉴于民众抗议的风暴，重启谈判和恢复与伪满洲国的关系构成非常微妙的事项。

came to Peiping and stayed in the Japanese legation en route to Shansi, Sui-
-yuan, etc. Japanese manoeuvres in the Tientsin area caused a great consterna-
tion to the inhabitants, some of them fleeing. On April 9 the Japanese army
told the magistrates of Tsinhua and Fengyin to reserve housing accomodations
for the incoming Japanese troops. All these signs point to a Japanese of-
fensive any moment in the future. The Shanghai bonds registered a sharp drop.
According to the information given by the North China Daily News on A-
pril 6 all mails coming from Japan are addressed as "Peiping, Manchukuo",
those coming from Changchun as "Peiping, Jehol province", betraying the am-
bition of Japanese imperialism in N. China. All the KMT papers together with
the bourgeois journals are in favor of a quick sale in face of the threaten-
ing situation in North China. Certain European quarters induced Nanking to
sell quickly and will reward it with loans according to the China Weekly,
American, (April 7, p.201). The Weekly concluded that "If America accords
recognition to Manchukuo, then America will have to follow suit".
International Control
No longer satisfied with the implied international control exercised
through the technical cooperation under the auspices of the league of na-
tions, international imperialism is openly advocating a new type of interna-
tional control. Recently, the editor of Le Matin (French) in an interview
at Chunking, Szexhwan, openly declared,
"England sent Cadogan, America Smith and France me to make investiga-
tions in the Yangtse Valley, in the Huangho Valley and Yunnan-Kweichow, Kwang-
tung-Kwangsi, respectively, with a view to instituting international control
over China. I finished my survey in Yunnan, Kwangtung and Kwangsi".(See, the
China Times, April 5).
The French editor bears the name of Paloi(?) and was escorted to Chun-
king with 100 soldiers from the chairman of Kweichow.

JAPAN'S MONOPOLIST ECONOMIC POSITION
in North China
Japanese aggression coupled with the KMT surrender has operated to ruin
the economy in Hopei. As a result of the Tangu agreement North China has sunk
into the position of a Japanese colony. 1/4 of Hopei amounting to 130,000
square li has fallen into Japanese hands. The Japanese got hold of almost all
economic rights, particularly over the mines in Tsinhua, Hsinlung and Mihsic
Mihsien. Now they control the Peiping-Mukden line and compete with the Bri-
tish Kailan mine.
North China Association
The North China Association inaugurated last December forms the organ
for the execution of the plans embodied in the so-called Japanese-Manchu-N.
China block economy. With its quarters at Tokyo, the association serves as
a general staff, its activities in China to be carried on by the Japanese
trade and industry association in north China. Its plan consists of 1) rea-
lisation of Japan's economic domination in N. China, 2) ousting British and
American capital from N. China, 3) bringing about bloc economy between Ja-
pan, Manchuria and North China. The Peiping political council appointed by
Nanking is an effective agency in clearing the ground for further Japanese
aggression.
Imperialism controls 70% of all industrial investments in N.China, with
Japan and England in the dominant position. The British Kailan mine with an
annual production of 4,800,000 tons or 37% of the total output in China vir-
tually dominates the coal business in Hopei Considering that many of the
Chinese enterprises were turned over to foreign capital in one form or an-
other, Chinese capitalists control far less than 30%. The iron mines in Char-
har and north Hopei, mainly situated in the demilitarized zone, have come
to the Japanese as a matter of course. The Japanese are enlarging the light
industries such as cotton mill, etc. Taking all in all, Japanese imperialism
controls over 60% of the key industries in North China.
Japanese Dumping
Since the Tangu agreement Japanese dumping in the market has become very
serious. Japanese capitalists have congratulated themselves on the better
turn in the relations between China and Japan. Taking the year 1933 as a
whole, Japan imported more wares to north China than she exported there-
from.
According to a customs officer Japanese trade has gone back to the ori-
ginal level before the Manchurian incident. Japanese cloth, cotton yarn, su-
gar, sea foods, etc, find a ready market. 60% of the market in North China
pages.zh:
2
抵达北平，在前往山西、绥远等地途中停留于日本公使馆。日军在天津地区的演习引起居民极大恐慌，部分居民逃离。4月9日，日军告知清华（音译）和丰宁（音译）的县长为即将开到的日军预留住房。所有这些迹象都表明日本随时可能发动进攻。上海债券价格急剧下跌。根据《字林西报》4月6日提供的信息，所有来自日本的邮件地址均写为“北平，满洲国”，来自长春的邮件地址写为“北平，热河省”，这暴露了日本帝国主义在华北的野心。面对华北的威胁局势，所有国民党报纸以及资产阶级报刊都主张迅速出卖。据4月7日出版的美国《中国周刊》（第201页）称，某些欧洲势力诱导南京迅速出卖，并将以贷款作为回报。该周刊总结道：“如果美国承认满洲国，那么美国也将不得不效仿。”

国际管制

国际帝国主义不再满足于通过国际联盟主持下的技术合作所实施的隐含的国际管制，而是公开倡导一种新型的国际管制。最近，《晨报》（法文）编辑在四川重庆接受采访时公开宣称：

“英国派遣卡多根（Cadogan），美国派遣史密斯（Smith），法国派遣我，分别前往长江流域、黄河流域以及云贵、两广地区进行调查，旨在对中国实施国际管制。我已完成了在云南、广东和广西的调查。”（见4月5日《中国时报》）。

这位法国编辑名为帕洛瓦（Paloi?）（音译），由贵州省主席派出一百名士兵护送至重庆。

日本在华北的垄断经济地位

日本的侵略加上国民党的投降，已导致河北经济崩溃。由于《塘沽协定》，华北已陷入日本殖民地的地位。河北四分之一的土地，共计13万平方里，已落入日本手中。日本人几乎掌握了所有的经济权利，特别是对清华（音译）、兴隆和密县（音译）矿山的控制权。现在他们控制着北平至沈阳线，并与英国的开滦煤矿竞争。

华北协会

去年十二月成立的华北协会，是执行所谓日满华区块经济计划中体现的各项方案的机构。该协会总部设在东京，充当总参谋部的角色，其在华活动将由日本华北工商业协会执行。其计划包括：1) 实现日本在华北的经济统治；2) 将英美资本逐出华北；3) 建立日本、满洲和华北之间的区块经济。由南京任命的北平政治委员会是为日本进一步侵略扫清障碍的有效机构。

帝国主义控制了华北全部工业投资的70%，其中日本和英国占据主导地位。英国的开滦煤矿年产量为480万吨，占中国总产量的37%，实际上主导了河北的煤炭业务。考虑到许多中国企业以各种形式转交给外国资本，中国资本家控制的份额远低于30%。察哈尔和河北北部的铁矿主要位于非军事区，理所当然地落入了日本人手中。日本人正在扩大棉纺厂等轻工业。总而言之，日本帝国主义控制了华北关键工业的60%以上。

日本倾销

自《塘沽协定》以来，日本在市场上的倾销变得非常严重。日本资本家因中日关系的好转而自我庆贺。就1933年全年而言，日本向华北进口的货物多于从华北出口的货物。

据一位海关官员称，日本贸易已恢复到九一八事变前的原有水平。日本布料、棉纱、糖、海产品等在华北市场畅销。华北市场的60%

3
belongs to the Japanese. In fact, the Japanese share is far more than that.
It runs up as high as 90% so far as cotton clothes, cotton yarn, serge, sea
foods are concerned. There is a curious example---all oranges in Tientsin
almost come from Formosa according to the story of a fruit peddler. The Ja-
panese are greatly aided by the demilitarized zone through which they smug-
gle their goods without paying the duties.
Japanese goods also flooded Mid-China. In a petition to the bandit-sup-
pression headquarters, the Chinese chamber of commerce at Hankow stated that
4/5 of the cotton yarn traded in the exchange every day is Japanese while
Japanese cotton cloth dominates to the extent of over 90% (The Shen Pao,
April 9).

JAPAN'S FEVERISH ANTI-SOVIET WAR PREPARATIONS
In North China
Recently, Chinese bourgeois journals, magazines and military critics have
openly talked about the major objective of Japanese aggressions in North
China. In their opinion, the Japanese must necessarily take Manchuria, Mon-
golia and N. China in order to wage a war on the Soviet Union. On April 3,
the Shanghai Shun Pao said that in active preparations against the Soviet
Union the Japanese have marked Sin-an-lin, Helungkiang and the Great Wall as
the first, second and third defence lines, respectively; that they would not
give the strategical points along the Great Wall back to China. Here the
spokesman of Chinese bourgeoisie implicitly justified Japan's further stay a-
long the Great Wall.
On March 21 another bourgeois paper, the Tientsin Ta-Kung-Pao, said, 'ac-
cording to military critics Japanese activities in Charhar are mainly war pre-
parations against the Soviet Union on the extreme left flank. Japanese stra-
tegy consists in cutting the Siberian railway and blocking the military con-
nections of the Soviet Union. Far from wishing to take Urga, the Japanese are
aiming at Chita and reach there through Eastern Mongolia. Japanese troops have
built wireless stations in Shilingol League as an aid to this strategy.
Japanese advance on Dolonor and Kuyuan is but for defensive purpose'.
Like many others, this military critic never utters a syllable against
the Anti-Soviet war preparations of Japan (Chinese mil. preparations that
enslave the whole chinese nation including the critic himself). These same mi-
litary critics, under instructions from Nanking, signed the surrender (the
Tango agreement) to Japan last year. Now they are willing to turn Chinese
territory over to the Japanese as a military base against the Soviet Union.
In their interviews to pressmen leaders of the Kuomintang have confirmed
the report that Japanese imperialism in North China has been pushing war pre-
parations against the Soviet Union with redoubled energy. In addition, they
talked much in favor of Japan and encouraged Japanese imperialism to attack
the Soviet Union.
To facilitate her military operations against the Soviet Union, West
Charhar and Suiyuan, Japanese imperialism has constructed a network of mo...
roads and aerodromes in East Charhar. It recruited 40,000-50,000 Chinese wor-
kers in the North for the said construction work in the past two months. But
it is said that a fraction of the workers have been compelled to serve in the
Japanese controlled army. In face of growingly indignant protest from the
masses against the recruiting, the Kuomintang Government has promised to take
action and have the recruiting stopped but the promise was purposely made a-
fter the Japanese had succeeded in carrying the workers to destination.
Near end of March the Tass news service reported a Japan's plan of build-
ing up another anti-Soviet puppet under a Turkish prince in Sinkiang.
The prince came to Shanghai under Japanese escort en route to Sinkiang pre-
sumably with the help from the KMT. But the Kuomintang government in Shanghai
while admitting of the presence of the Prince here, nevertheless gave full pro-
tection to him, saying that he was expelled from Tokio and would "submit" to
China.
In short, the Kuomintang is overtly and covertly aiding Japanese im-
perialism in anti-Soviet war preparations in China.

属于日本。事实上，日本的份额远不止于此。就棉布、棉纱、哔叽呢和海产品而言，这一比例高达90%。有一个奇怪的例子——据一位水果小贩说，天津的所有橘子几乎都来自台湾。日本人通过非军事区大大受益，他们借此走私货物而不缴纳关税。

日本商品也淹没了华中地区。汉口中华总商会在向剿匪总部提交的一份请愿书中指出，交易所每天交易的棉纱中有五分之四是日本货，而日本棉布的主导地位超过90%（《申报》，4月9日）。

日本在华北疯狂的反苏战争准备

最近，中国的资产阶级报刊、杂志和军事评论员公开谈论日本在华北侵略的主要目标。在他们看来，日本为了对苏联发动战争，必然要占领满洲、蒙古和华北。4月3日，上海《顺报》（音译）称，在积极准备对苏作战方面，日本已将兴安岭、黑龙江和长城分别标记为第一、第二和第三道防线；他们不会将沿长城的战略要点归还中国。在此，中国资产阶级的代言人隐晦地为日本继续驻留长城沿线辩护。

3月21日，另一份资产阶级报纸《天津大公报》称，“据军事评论员称，日本在察哈尔的活动主要是针对极左翼侧翼的对苏战争准备。日本的战略在于切断西伯利亚铁路并阻断苏联的军事联系。日本人的目标并非攻占乌兰巴托，而是瞄准赤塔，并通过东蒙古到达那里。日军已在锡林郭勒盟建立了无线电台，以辅助这一战略。日军向多伦和沽源的推进仅出于防御目的”。

像许多人一样，这位军事评论员对日本的反苏战争准备（包括评论员本人在内的整个中华民族被奴役的中国军事准备）只字未提。正是这些军事评论员，去年在南京的指示下，签署了对日投降书（《塘沽协定》）。现在，他们愿意将中国领土移交给日本，作为对抗苏联的军事基地。国民党领导人在接受记者采访时证实了有关日本帝国主义在华北加倍努力推进反苏战争准备的报道。此外，他们还大量发表亲日言论，鼓励日本帝国主义进攻苏联。

为了便于其对苏联在西察哈尔和绥远的军事行动，日本帝国主义在东察哈尔修建了一个由汽...车道路和飞机组成的网络。在过去两个月里，它在北方招募了4万至5万名中国工人从事上述建设工作。但据说，部分工人被迫在日本控制的军队中服役。面对民众对招募工作日益愤怒的抗议，国民党政府承诺采取行动并停止招募，但这一承诺是在日本人成功将工人运抵目的地后故意作出的。

3月底，塔斯社新闻报道了日本计划在新疆拥立一位土耳其王子建立另一个反苏傀儡政权的计划。

该王子在日本人的护送下前往新疆，途经上海， presumably（原文不清/推测）得到了国民党的帮助。但是，上海的国民党政府在承认王子在此出现的同时，却给予他全面保护，称他被东京驱逐，并将“归顺”中国。

总之，国民党正在明里暗里协助日本帝国主义在中国进行反苏战争准备。

WORKERS' STRUGGLE IN KUOMINTANG CHINA, March, 1934

In addition to Dr. In Shu: almost all the press of the Chinese
ruling classes have expressed similar remarks in reference to the re-
port. The Shenpao, Oct. 3, had editorial comment, "It is just impossible
for us but to put a big head upon the report's attitude of the
League of Nations on Japan." The Peking Gazette's editorial on Oct.
4 says, "As a whole, it is not satisfactory." The Ta Kung Pao's editorial
particularly noted that although the report admits II and IV of
the report are not in accordance with Sino-Japanese relations before the Mukden
occurrence, it has failed to give a clear decision on the September
18 Event. On the other hand, the Shanghai Chenpao says, "We are most
regretful to see such a report as this one, which is full of the Commission
of Enquiry." It is also mentioned by the South China Morning Post that "unbalanced
facts on Manchuria should be recognized, and the 'report' be taken as
a special auto-determination under international control", is the open ac-
ceptance of a special position, in agreement with what was proposed by
the Soviet on Oct. 2. The Shenpao's editorial on Oct. 5 says, "The
reason why there is such a contradictory point in the report is that
Sir Lytton and company will have the earnest desire for peace (1) They
have to care for one side or the other and to observe the establi-
shed facts on the other." Indeed, if truth be told, the country have
to pay equal thanks to all sides, so as to express the Chinese ruling
classes!

Of course, the Chinese ruling classes, controlling the country-
wide toilers! opposition of the report, are not so foolish as to spare
a little dissatisfaction; they are possibly more "against the report."
Then, comes the role played by them who are not in the report. For
instance, in Kwantung the Shenpao has used such words as "worthless"
and "disappointment" over the Council action. It should be noted
here, their opinions are no way different from those of the rest of
their groups, except they are more direct in expressing over the too-harsh-
ness of the plot in the report for the intervention of co-prosperity in Manchu-
ria and the dismemberment of China.

To make up the shortcomings of the report, which favor of the
ruling classes, the Tientsin, Hsintsin, Po Chi, and others on
Oct. 14: "We suggest to accept with conditions the principles of the
report before the League Assembly;...Under the auspices of the League
of Nations, China is willing to send a plenipotentiary to begin negotia-
tions with the Japanese representative. The topics of the treaty are
based on the principles of the League report, consist of: 1. China on
its initiative establishes an autonomous system for Manchuria; Japan
withdraws its troops and returns back the occupied areas in accordance
with the resolutions of the League. Manchuria be put under garrison
of peace preservation corps; both China and Japan put no troops in
Manchuria, not even the so called railway guards. 2. Both countries
announce mutual reconciliation; promise political means but not mili-
tary means for any future dispute and conclude an economic treaty of
reciprocity and a political agreement of non-aggression. 3. China on
its own initiative advises the Manchukuo to abandon its organization;
summons a representative conference of the various public bodies of
Manchuria to discuss the autonomous system and to find means for better
politics and better livelihood of the people. 4. China on its own ini-

除了殷舒博士外：几乎所有中国统治阶级的报刊都对该报告发表了类似的评论。《申报》10月3日的社论评论道：“对于国联对日本的态度，我们不得不在此报告中大加推崇。”《北平日报》10月4日的社论称：“总体而言，并不令人满意。”《大公报》的社论特别指出，虽然报告承认其第二和第四部分不符合沈阳事变前的中日关系状况，但未能对九一八事变给出明确的裁决。另一方面，《上海晨报》称：“看到这样一份充满调查团色彩的报告，我们深感遗憾。”《南华早报》也提到，“应当承认关于满洲的事实不平衡，并将‘报告’视为在国际控制下的特殊自决”，这是对特殊地位的公开接受，这与苏联10月2日提出的建议一致。《申报》10月5日的社论称：“报告中出现这种矛盾点的原因在于，李顿爵士及其同僚既抱有和平的真诚愿望 (1) 他们不得不照顾一方，又要顾及另一方的既定事实。”的确，如果说实话，国家必须向各方表示同样的感谢，以此表达中国统治阶级的心声！

当然，控制着全国劳工的中国统治阶级，他们对报告的反对，并非愚蠢到只流露少许不满；他们可能更“反对报告”。接着，便出现了那些未在报告中提及的人所扮演的角色。例如，在广东，《申报》使用了“毫无价值”和“失望”等词语来形容理事会的行动。此处应注意，他们的观点与其他群体并无不同，只是他们在表达对报告中旨在干预满洲共荣及肢解中国的阴谋过于严苛时更为直接。

为了弥补这份有利于统治阶级的报告的不足，天津、《新申》、《波吉》等报刊于10月14日提出：“我们建议在国联大会前有条件地接受报告的原则；……在国联的主持下，中国愿意派遣全权代表开始与日本代表进行谈判。条约议题基于国联报告的原则，包括：1. 中国主动在满洲建立自治制度；日本根据国联决议撤军并归还占领区。满洲由治安维持团驻守；中日两国均不在满洲驻军，甚至不包括所谓的铁路护卫队。2. 两国宣布相互和解；承诺通过政治手段而非军事手段解决任何未来争端，并缔结互惠经济条约和不侵略政治协定。3. 中国主动劝告伪满洲国放弃其组织；召集满洲各公共团体代表会议，讨论自治制度，并寻求改善政治和人民生计的方法。4. 中国主动

IX. Remarks

Five mills attached to the Fushing flour mill, the greatest of its kind in China, have closed down throwing out 1,000 workers. In fear of the growing dumping of imperialist flour they can not but shut up. According to the North China Daily News of March 25 the village in Honan has been hit hard by the American wheat and cotton.

The gradual rise in the value of silver strengthens imperialist dumping and constitutes a great menace to Chinese national industries. The crisis in China has become much sharper. Capitalists have been attempting to shift the burden of the crisis on the workers. The Yuyuan cotton mill in Tientsin dismissed 1,500 workers. Owners of the silk mills in Huchow have cut the wages by another 20%. According to the contract of 1929 the umbrella workers are entitled to $40 a month but now receive only $16. The slogans of the workers' struggle during the month under review center around resistance to wage-cut and lock-out.

The wave of struggles on the part of the workers draws in more handicraftsmen, salesmen and employees of small mills. This leads to the increase in the number of the factories affected. For the three months past the workers employed by the silversmiths in Shanghai have been waging a struggle against a 30% cut by the management. From March 1 thirteen workers have been on a hunger strike. And finally, the strikers triumphed. Close on the heels of the silversmith strike followed the struggle of the workers hired by the umbrella workshops. The general strike was directed against wage cut. And the general oil strike in Wusih is also worthy of note.

Not only the quantity but the quality of the struggles show an advance over the previous month. The Kailan strike, the Mayar strike in Shanghai, the silk strike in Huchow, etc, have taken on a more political character. The workers have shown a greater stubbornness and heroism in the fight against the exploitation of capital, oppression of KMT and imperialism, deception of yellow unions. The Mayar workers, united in a solid bloc, repulsed the attacks of French police, besieged the municipality of Great Shanghai, wrested back their leaders arrested. The strike is still in progress, and strikers, mostly women and girls, again besieged the Shanghai Municipal Government in a bolder manner on April 16.

The Kailan strikers smashed the yellow unions, organised themselves in the form of regular troops, arrested the special functionary of Chinese police, drove away leaders of the yellow unions, forced police to release arrested. The strike has not yet ended.

The silk workers in Huchow numbering 4,000 have declared a strike against wage cut by 20%. After the elapse of three months the starving workers resorted to street fighting against soldiers and police. They refused to accept the arbitration of the chamber of commerce. They smashed the insulting paper and the Hsien government. (As to these major strikes, See previous issue).

As shown by the above struggles, the workers highly dissatisfied with the deception of the KMT and yellow unions and more indignant over the oppression of imperialism-KMT have fought for the defence of their own interests. Their heroism and new tactics have set an example to the rest of the workers who quickly follow them.

Finally, we must state that relying principally on bourgeois papers we can get only incomplete data for our monthly report.

九、评论

附属于中国最大的福新面粉厂的五家工厂已经关闭，导致1000名工人失业。由于害怕帝国主义面粉的倾销日益加剧，他们不得不关门。据3月25日的《字林西报》报道，河南的村庄受到美国小麦和棉花的严重打击。

银价的逐渐上涨加强了帝国主义的倾销，并对中国民族工业构成了巨大威胁。中国的危机变得更加尖锐。资本家一直试图将危机的负担转嫁给工人。天津的裕元纱厂解雇了1500名工人。湖州丝厂业主又将工资削减了20%。根据1929年的合同，雨伞工人每月应得40美元，但现在只收到16美元。在本报告所述月份中，工人斗争的口号集中在抵制减薪和闭厂停工上。

工人的斗争浪潮吸引了更多的手工艺人、小工厂的推销员和雇员。这导致受影响的工厂数量增加。在过去三个月里，上海银楼雇佣的工人一直在与管理层削减30%工资的行为作斗争。从3月13日起，十三名工人进行了绝食抗议。最终，罢工者取得了胜利。紧随银楼罢工之后的是雨伞作坊雇佣工人的斗争。总罢工是针对减薪而发起的。无锡的总油业罢工也值得关注。

不仅斗争的数量，而且斗争的质量都显示出比上个月有所进步。开滦罢工、上海的梅亚（Mayar，音译）罢工、湖州的丝绸罢工等，都具有更强烈的政治色彩。工人们在反对资本剥削、国民党压迫和帝国主义压迫以及黄色工会欺骗的斗争中，表现出更大的顽强性和英雄气概。梅亚工人团结成坚固的整体，击退了法国警察的攻击，包围了大上海市政府，夺回了被捕的领导人。罢工仍在进行中，罢工者（大多是妇女和女孩）于4月16日以更大胆的方式再次包围了上海市政府。

开滦罢工者捣毁了黄色工会，以正规军的形式组织起来，逮捕了中国警察的特派员，赶走了黄色工会的领导人，迫使警察释放被捕人员。罢工尚未结束。

湖州4000名丝织工人宣布罢工，反对削减20%的工资。三个月后，饥饿的工人诉诸街头战斗，对抗士兵和警察。他们拒绝接受商会的仲裁。他们捣毁了侮辱性的文件并冲击了县政府。（关于这些主要罢工，见上一期）。

上述斗争表明，工人们高度不满国民党和黄色工会的欺骗，并对帝国主义-国民党的压迫感到更加愤怒，从而为捍卫自身利益而战。他们的英雄气概和新战术为其他迅速效仿的工人树立了榜样。

最后，我们必须指出，主要依靠资产阶级报纸，我们只能获得不完整的月度报告数据。

结 束

ANOTHER IMPENDING BETRAYAL OF N.CHINA BY KMT
.......................

In the spirit of the Tangu agreement signed last year KMT leaders are just discussing the terms of the betrayal of North China to Japanese imperialism. The chairman of the Peiping political council, Huang Fu (a sales agent for Nanking in negotiations with Japan), has, it is said, clashed with Ho Yin-chin, chairman of the Peiping military council, over those very terms. Huang Fu, attacked by Ho's men, took a trip down to Nanchang on April 3, and will appeal to Gen.Chiang Kai-shek for the adoption of his formulae of selling the country. The press here predicts that unless securing ratification of his formulae from Chiang he will not proceed to Peiping any more--meaning resignation. What terms Ho insists on for the conclusion of the sale is rather a secret.
Nanchang Betrayal Conference

Many KMT experts well versed in the art of betrayal of national interests have gathered at Nanchang around Chiang Kai-shek and taken part in the discussion of the betrayal, with special stress on such questions as how to recognize Manchukuo, how to make secure the dominating position of Japanese imperialism in N. China, even in the whole land.

Fully agreeing with the Japanese plan of effecting through railway and postal service as well as other questions which lead to the de facto recognition by Nanking, the KMT leaders now only discuss the form to be adopted, a form that satisfies the Japanese but reduces the opposition from the masses. Besides, they have to agree to a plan by which the benefits accruing from the big sale shall be equitably distributed among the various fractions of the KMT. According to the opinion of Huang Fu as expressed in his interview given at Hankow, these questions, important as they are, will not bother Nanking very much as they are merely technical points.

The negotiations concerning the through railway and postal service, begun last year between Peiping and the Japanese Kwantung army, came to a sudden halt owing to the growing opposition from the masses, particularly at the moment when the People's government in Fukien proclaimed independence and denounced Chiang's betrayal of N.China (though the Fukien machine was itself a tool of the Japanese). Certainly, the revival of the pourparleys and the recognition of Manchukuo constitute a very delicate technical point. In anticipation of the storm of protests from the mass Nanking has to proceed cautiously. The Nanchang conference will discuss the measures to be adopted against the growing anti-Japanese, anti-imperialist, anti-KMT movement led by the communist party of China which will surely receive a fresh impetus from the new sale of KMT.
Japanese Menace in N. China

After a trip to N. China the KMT leaders sounded the warning. China is now in a great danger. Fresh Japanese reinforcements have been pushed to Chahar. The 7th division has moved to Dolonor. Dozens of Japanese spies came to the north, making surveys, inquiring about the property of foreigners, etc. On April 8 more than 100 Japanese retired officials

国民党即将再次出卖华北
.......................

秉承去年签署的《塘沽协定》的精神，国民党领导人正在讨论向日本帝国主义出卖华北的条款。据说，北平政务委员会主席黄郛（南京在对日谈判中的销售代理）就这些条款与北平军事委员会主席何应钦发生了冲突。黄郛遭到何部下的攻击，于4月3日前往南昌，并将向蒋介石将军呼吁采纳其卖国方案。这里的媒体预测，除非获得蒋介石对其方案的批准，否则他将不再返回北平——这意味着辞职。何坚持要求达成出卖交易的具体条款相当保密。
南昌出卖会议

许多精通出卖国家利益艺术的国民党专家聚集在南昌蒋介石周围，参与讨论出卖事宜，特别强调如何承认伪满洲国、如何确保日本帝国主义在华北乃至整个中国的统治地位等问题。

国民党领导人完全同意日本通过铁路和邮政服务等手段实现事实上被南京承认的计划，现在他们只讨论采取何种形式，一种既能满足日本又能减少民众反对的形式。此外，他们还必须同意一项计划，即从这次大出卖中获得的利益将在国民党各派系之间公平分配。根据黄郛在汉口接受采访时表达的意见，这些问题虽然重要，但不会让南京太费心，因为它们仅仅是技术性问题。

去年北平与日本关东军开始的关于直通铁路和邮政服务的谈判，由于民众日益增长的反对而突然停止，特别是在福建人民政府宣布独立并谴责蒋介石出卖华北的时候（尽管福建政权本身也是日本的工具）。当然，重启谈判和承认伪满洲国构成一个非常微妙的技术问题。鉴于预料到民众的抗议风暴，南京必须谨慎行事。南昌会议将讨论针对由中国共产党领导的日益增长的反日、反帝、反国民党运动所采取的措施，国民党的新出卖行为无疑将为该运动注入新的动力。
日本在华北的威胁

国民党领导人在视察华北后发出了警告。中国现在处于巨大的危险之中。新的日本增援部队已被推至察哈尔。第7师团已移至多伦。数十名日本间谍来到北方，进行勘测，调查外国人的财产等。4月8日，100多名日本退休官员

pages.en:
2
came to Peiping and stayed in the Japanese legation en route to Shansi, Sui-
yuan, etc. Japanese manoeuvres in the Tientsin area caused a great consterna-
tion to the inhabitants, some of them fleeing. On April 9 the Japanese army
told the magistrates of Tsinhua and Fengyin to reserve housing accomodations
for the incoming Japanese troops. All these signs point to a Japanese of-
fensive any moment in the future. The Shanghai bonds registered a sharp drop.
According to the information given by the North China Daily News on A-
pril 6 all mails coming from Japan are addressed a-s "Peiping, Manchukuo",
those coming from Changchun as "Peiping, Jehol province", betraying the am-
bition of Japanese imperialism in N. China. All the KMT papers together with
the bourgeois journals ... in favor of a quick sale in face of the threaten-
ing situation in North China. Certain European quarters induced Nanking to
sell quickly and will reward it with loans according to the China Weekly,
American, (April 7, p.207). The Weekly conceded that "If Nanking accords
recognition to Manchukuo, then America will have to follow suit".
International Control
No longer satisfied with the implied international control exercised
through the technical cooperation under the auspices of the league of na-
tions, international imperialism is openly advocating a new type of interna-
tional control. Recently, the editor of Le Matin (French) in an interview
at Chunking, Szexhwan, openly declared,
"England sent Cadogan, America Smith and France me to make investiga-
tions in the Yangtse Valley, in the Huangho Valley and Yunnan-Kweichow, Kwang-
tung-Kwangsi, respectively, with a view to instituting international control
over China. I finished my survey in Yunnan, Kwangtung and Kwangsi". See, the
China Times, April 5).
The French editor bears the name of Polci(?) and was escorted to Chun-
king with 100 soldiers from the chairman of Kweichow.

JAPAN'S MONOPOLIST ECONOMIC POSITION
in North China
Japanese aggression coupled with the KMT surrender has operated to ruin
the economy in Hopei. As a result of the Tangu agreement North China has fallen
into the position of a Japanese colony. 3/4 of Hopei amounting to 130,000
square li has fallen into Japanese hands. The Japanese got hold of almost all
economic rights, particularly over the mines in Tsinhua, Hsinlung and Mihsic
Mihsien. Now they control the Peiping-Mukien line and compete with the Bri-
tish Kailan mine.
North China Association
The North China Association inaugurated last December forms the organ
for the execution of the plans embodied in the so-called Japanese-Manchu-N.
China block economy. With its quarters at Tokyo, the association serves as
a general staff, its activities in China to be carried on by the Japanese
trade and industry association in north China. Its plan consists of 1) rea-
lization of Japan's economic domination in N. China, 2) ousting British and
American capital from N. China, 3) bringing about bloc economy between Ja-
pan, Manchuria and North China. The Peiping political council appointed by
Nanking is an effective agency in clearing the ground for further Japanese
aggression.
Imperialism controls 70% of all industrial investments in N.China, with
Japan and England in the dominant position. The British Kailan mine with an
annual production of 4,800,000 tons or 37% of the total output in China vir-
tually dominates the coal business in Hopei Considering that many of the
Chinese enterprises were turned over to foreign capital in one form or an-
other, Chinese capitalists control far less than 30%. The iron mines in Char-
har and north Hopei, mainly situated in the demilitarised zone, have come
to the Japanese as a matter of course. The Japanese are enlarging the light
industries such as cotton mill, etc. Taking all in all, Japanese imperialism
controls over 60% of the key industries in North China.
Japanese Dumping
Since the Tangu agreement Japanese dumping in the market has become very
serious. Japanese capitalists have congratulated themselves on the better
turn in the relations between China and Japan. Taking the year 1933 as a
whole, Japan imported more wares to north China than she exported there-
from.
According to a customs officer Japanese trade has gone back to the ori-
ginal level before the Manchurian incident. Japanese cloth, cotton yarn, su-
gar, sea foods, etc, find a ready market. 60% of the market in North China
pages.zh:
2
来到北平，住在日本公使馆，途经前往山西、绥远等地。日军在天津地区的演习引起居民极大恐慌，其中一些人逃离。4月9日，日军告诉清华和丰润的地方官为即将到来的日军预留住房。所有这些迹象都指向日本随时可能发动进攻。上海债券价格急剧下跌。
据4月6日《字林西报》提供的信息，所有来自日本的邮件地址均写为“北平，满洲国”，来自长春的邮件写为“北平，热河省”，这暴露了日本帝国主义在华北的野心。面对华北的威胁局势，所有国民党报纸连同资产阶级期刊……都赞成快速出卖。据《密勒氏评论报》（美国，4月7日，第207页）称，某些欧洲方面促使南京快速出卖，并将以贷款作为回报。该评论报承认：“如果南京承认伪满洲国，那么美国也将不得不效仿。”
国际管制
国际帝国主义不再满足于通过在国际联盟主持下的技术合作所行使的隐含国际管制，而是公开倡导一种新型的国际管制。最近，《晨报》（法国）编辑在四川重庆的一次采访中公开宣称：
“英国派遣卡多根，美国派遣史密斯，法国派遣我，分别对长江流域、黄河流域以及云南-贵州、广东-广西进行调查，旨在对中国实行国际管制。我已经完成了在云南、广东和广西的调查”。（见4月5日《时报》）。
这位法国编辑名叫波尔奇（Polci，音译？），由贵州省主席派出的100名士兵护送至重庆。

日本在华北的垄断经济地位
日本的侵略加上国民党的投降，导致河北经济崩溃。作为《塘沽协定》的结果，华北已沦为日本的殖民地。河北四分之三的土地，共计13万平方里，已落入日本手中。日本人几乎掌握了所有的经济权利，特别是对清华、兴隆和密云县矿山的控制权。现在他们控制着北平-穆肯（Mukien，音译）线，并与英国的开滦煤矿竞争。
华北协会
去年十二月成立的华北协会构成了执行所谓日-满-华北集团经济计划的机构。该协会总部设在东京，充当总参谋部，其在华活动由日本华北工商业协会执行。其计划包括：1) 实现日本在华北的经济统治；2) 将英美资本逐出华北；3) 促成日本、满洲和华北之间的集团经济。南京任命的北平政务委员会是为进一步日本侵略扫清道路的有效机构。
帝国主义控制了华北所有工业投资的70%，其中日本和英国占据主导地位。英国开滦煤矿年产量为480万吨，占中国总产量的37%，实际上主导了河北的煤炭业务。考虑到许多中国企业以各种形式移交给了外国资本，中国资本家控制的份额远低于30%。主要位于非军事区的察哈尔和河北北部的铁矿，理所当然地落入了日本人手中。日本人正在扩大棉纺厂等轻工业。总而言之，日本帝国主义控制了华北关键工业的60%以上。
日本倾销
自《塘沽协定》以来，日本在市场上的倾销变得非常严重。日本资本家因中日关系的改善而自我庆贺。纵观1933年全年，日本向华北进口的货物多于从那里出口的货物。
据一位海关官员称，日本贸易已恢复到九一八事变前的原有水平。日本布料、棉纱、糖、海产品等在华北市场畅销。华北市场的60%

pages.en:
3
belongs to the Japanese. In fact, the Japanese share is far more than that.
It runs up as high as 90% so far as cotton clothes, cotton yarn, surge, sea
foods are concerned. There is a curious example---all oranges in Tientsin
almost come from Formosa according to the story of a fruit peddler. The Ja-
panese are greatly aided by the demilitarized zone through which they smug-
gle their goods without paying the duties.
Japanese goods also flooded Mid-China. In a petition to the bandit-sup-
pression headquarters, the Chinese chamber of commerce at Hankow stated that
4/5 of the cotton yarn traded in the exchange every day is Japanese while
Japanese cotton cloth dominates to the extent of over 90% (The Shen Pao,
April 9).

JAPAN'S FEVERISH ANTI-SOVIET WAR PREPARATIONS
In North China

Recently, Chinese bourgeois journals, magazines and military critics have
openly talked about the major objective of Japanese aggressions in North
China. In their opinion, the Japanese must necessarily take Manchuria, Mon-
golia and N. China in order to wage a war on the Soviet Union. On April 8,
the Shanghai Shun Pao said that in active preparations against the Soviet
Union the Japanese have marked Sin-an-li, Helungkiang and the Great Wall as
the first, second and third defence lines, respectively; that they would not
give the strategical points along the Great Wall back to China. Here the
spokesman of Chinese bourgeoisie impliedly justified Japan's further stay a-
long the Great Wall.
On March 21 another bourgeois paper, the Tientsin Ta-Kung-Pao, said, 'ac-
cording to military critics Japanese activities in Chahar are mainly war pre-
parations against the Soviet Union on the extreme left flank. Japanese stra-
tegy consists in cutting the Siberian railway and blocking the military con-
nections of the Soviet Union. Far from wishing to take Urga, the Japanese are
aiming at Chita and reach there through Eastern Mongolia. Japanese troops have
built wireless stations in Shilingol League as an aid to this strategy.
Japanese advance on Dolonor and Kuyuan is but for defensive purpose'.
Like many others, this military critic never utters a syllable against
the Anti-Soviet war preparations of Japan on Chinese soil, preparations that
enslave the whole chinese nation including the critic himself. These same mi-
litary critics, under instructions from Nanking, signed the surrender (the
Tango agreement) to Japan last year. Now they are willing to turn Chinese
territory over to the Japanese as a military base against the Soviet Union.
In their interviews to pressmen leaders of the Kuomintang have confirmed
the report that Japanese imperialism in North China has been pushing war pre-
parations against the Soviet Union with redoubled energy. In addition, they
talked much in favor of Japan and encouraged Japanese imperialism to attack
the Soviet Union.
To facilitate her military operations against the Soviet Union, West
Chahar and Suiyuan, Japanese imperialism has constructed a network of motor
roads and aerodromes in East Chahar. It recruited 40,000-50,000 Chinese wor-
kers in the North for the said construction work in the past two months. But
it is said that a fraction of the workers have been compelled to serve in the
Japanese controlled army. In face of growingly indignant protest from the
masses against the recruiting, the Kuomintang Government has promised to take
action and have the recruiting stopped but the promise was purposely made a-
fter the Japanese had succeeded in carrying the workers to destination.
Near end of March the Tass news service reported a Japan's plan of build-
ing up another anti-Soviet puppet under a Japanese Turkish prince in Sinkiang.
The prince came to Shanghai under Japanese escort en route to Sinkiang pre-
sumably with the help from the KMT. But the Kuomintang government in Shanghai
while admitting of the presence of the Prince here, nevertheless gave full pro-
tection to him, saying that he was expelled from Tokio and would "submit" to
China.
In Short, the Kuomintang is overtly and covertly aiding Japanese im-
perialism in anti-Soviet war preparations in China.

3
属于日本人。事实上，日本人的份额远不止于此。就棉衣、棉纱、哔叽（surge）和海产品而言，这一比例高达 90%。有一个奇怪的例子——据一位水果小贩说，天津的橘子几乎全部来自福尔摩沙（Formosa）。日本人极大地得益于非军事区，他们通过该区域走私货物而无需缴纳关税。

日本商品也淹没了华中地区。汉口中华总商会在向剿匪总部提交的一份请愿书中指出，交易所每日交易的棉纱中有 4/5 是日本货，而日本棉布的市场占有率超过 90%（《申报》，4 月 9 日）。

日本在华北疯狂进行反苏战争准备

最近，中国的资产阶级报刊、杂志和军事评论家公开谈论日本在华北侵略的主要目标。在他们看来，日本为了对苏联发动战争，必然要占领满洲、蒙古和华北。4 月 8 日，上海《顺报》（Shun Pao）称，在日本积极准备对苏作战的过程中，已将辛安里（Sin-an-li，音译）、黑龙江和长城分别标记为第一、第二和第三道防线；他们不会将沿长城的战略要点归还中国。在此，中国资产阶级的代言人暗示性地为日本进一步滞留长城沿线辩护。

3 月 21 日，另一份资产阶级报纸《天津大公报》称，“据军事评论家称，日本在察哈尔的活动主要是针对极左翼侧翼的反苏战争准备。日本的战略在于切断西伯利亚铁路并阻断苏联的军事联系。日本人的目标并非攻占乌兰巴托（Urga），而是旨在夺取赤塔（Chita），并通过外蒙古到达那里。日军已在锡林郭勒盟建立了无线电台，以辅助这一战略。日军向多伦诺尔（Dolonor）和沽源（Kuyuan）的推进仅出于防御目的”。

像许多其他人一样，这位军事评论家对日本在中国领土上进行的反苏战争准备只字未提，而这些准备正奴役着整个中华民族，包括评论家自己。正是这些军事评论家，去年在南京政府的指示下，签署了对日投降书（《塘沽协定》）。现在，他们愿意将中国领土交给日本，作为对抗苏联的军事基地。

国民党领导人在接受记者采访时证实了有关日本帝国主义在华北加倍努力推进反苏战争准备的报道。此外，他们还大量发表亲日言论，鼓励日本帝国主义进攻苏联。

为了便于其对苏联西部察哈尔和绥远的军事行动，日本帝国主义在东部察哈尔修建了一个公路网和机场网。在过去两个月里，它在北方招募了 40,000-50,000 名中国工人从事上述建设工程。但据说，其中一部分工人被迫在日本控制的军队中服役。面对民众因招募问题日益愤怒的抗议，国民党政府承诺采取行动并停止招募，但这一承诺是在日本人成功将工人运抵目的地后故意做出的。

3 月底，塔斯社新闻报道了日本计划在新疆建立一个由日本土耳其王子领导的另一个反苏傀儡政权的计划。该王子在日本人的护送下前往新疆，途经上海， presumably（原文如此，意为“大概”）得到了国民党的帮助。但是，上海的国民党政府在承认该王子在此出现的同时，却给予他全面保护，称他被东京驱逐，并将“归顺”中国。

总之，国民党正在明里暗里协助日本帝国主义在中国进行反苏战争准备。

IX. Remarks
Five mills attached to the Fushing flour mill, the greatest of its kind in China, have closed down throwing out 1,000 workers. In fear of the growing dumping of imperialist flour they can not but shut up. According to the North China Daily News of March 25 the village in Honan has been hit hard by the American wheat and cotton loan.
The gradual rise in the value of silver strengthens imperialist dumping, and constitutes a great menace to Chinese national industries. The crisis in China has become much sharper. Capitalists have been attempting to shift the burden of the crisis on the workers. The Yuyuan cotton mill in Tientsin dismissed 1,500 workers. Owners of the silk mills in Huchow have cut the wages by another 20%. According to the contract of 1929 the umbrella workers are entitled to $40 a month but now receive only $10. The slogans of the workers' struggle during the month under review center around resistance to wage-cut and lock-out.
The wave of struggles on the part of the workers draws in more handi-craftsmen, salesmen and employees of small mills. This leads to the increase in the number of the factories affected. For the three months past the workers employed by the silversmiths in Shanghai have been waging a struggle against a 30% cut by the management. From March 3 thirteen workers have been on a hunger strike. And finally, the strikers triumphed. Close on the heels of the silversmith strike followed the struggle of the workers hired by 53 umbrella workshops. The general strike was directed against wage cut. And the general oil strike in Wusih is also worthy of note.
Not only the quantity but the quality of the struggles show an advance over the previous month. The Kailan strike, the Mayar strike in Shanghai, the silk strike in Huchow, etc, have taken on a more political character. The workers have shown a greater stubbornness and heroism in the fight against the exploitation of capital, oppression of KMT and imperialism, deception of yellow unions. The Mayar workers, united in a solid bloc, repulsed the attacks of French police, besieged the municipality of Great Shanghai, wrested back their leaders arrested. The strike is still in progress, and strikers, mostly women and girls, again besieged the Shanghai Municipal Government in a bolder manner on April 10.
The Kailan strikers smashed the yellow unions, organised themselves in the form of regular troops, arrested the special functionary of Chinese police, drove away leaders of the yellow unions, forced police to release the arrested. The strike has not yet ended.
The silk workers in Huchow numbering 4,000 have declared a strike against wage cut by 20%. After the elapse of three months the starving workers resorted to street fighting against soldiers and police. They refused to accept the arbitration of the chamber of commerce. They smashed the insulting paper and the Hsien government. (As to these major strikes, see our previous issue).
As shown by the above struggles, the workers highly dissatisfied with the deception of the KMT and yellow unions and more indignant over the oppression of imperialism-KMT have fought for the defence of their own interests. Their heroism and new tactics have set an example to the rest of the workers who quickly follow them.
Finally, we must state that relying principally on bourgeois papers we can get only incomplete data for our monthly report.

九. 备注
附属于中国最大的福新面粉厂的五个分厂已经关闭，导致1000名工人失业。由于害怕帝国主义面粉倾销日益加剧，他们不得不关门。据3月25日《字林西报》报道，河南的村庄受到美国小麦和棉花贷款的沉重打击。
银价的逐渐上涨加强了帝国主义的倾销，对中国民族工业构成巨大威胁。中国的危机变得更加尖锐。资本家一直试图将危机的负担转嫁给工人。天津裕元纱厂解雇了1500名工人。湖州丝厂业主又将工资削减了20%。根据1929年的合同，雨伞工人每月应得40元，但现在只拿到10元。本月工人斗争的口号集中在抵制减薪和关厂。
工人的斗争浪潮吸引了更多的手工艺人、小厂的销售员和职员。这导致受影响的工厂数量增加。在过去三个月里，上海银楼雇佣的工人一直在与管理层削减30%工资的行为作斗争。从3月13日起，十三名工人开始绝食抗议。最终，罢工者取得了胜利。紧随银楼罢工之后的是53家雨伞作坊雇佣工人的斗争。这次总罢工是针对减薪的。无锡的总油业罢工也值得关注。
不仅斗争的数量，而且斗争的质量都显示出较上月有所进步。开滦罢工、上海美亚绸厂罢工、湖州丝厂罢工等，都具有更强烈的政治色彩。工人们在反对资本剥削、国民党压迫和帝国主义、以及黄色工会欺骗的斗争中，表现出更大的顽强性和英雄气概。美亚工人团结成坚固的整体，击退了法国警察的攻击，包围了大上海市政府，夺回了被捕的领导人。罢工仍在进行中，罢工者（大多是妇女和女孩）于4月10日以更大胆的方式再次包围上海市政府。
开滦罢工者捣毁了黄色工会，以正规军的形式组织起来，逮捕了中国警察的特派员，赶走了黄色工会的领导人，迫使警察释放被捕者。罢工尚未结束。
湖州的4000名丝织工人宣布罢工，反对减薪20%。三个月后，饥饿的工人诉诸街头战斗，对抗士兵和警察。他们拒绝接受商会的仲裁。他们捣毁了侮辱性的文件以及县政府。（关于这些主要罢工，见我们上一期）。
如上所述，工人们因对国民党和黄色工会的欺骗深感不满，并对帝国主义-国民党的压迫更加愤怒，从而为捍卫自身利益而战。他们的英雄气概和新战术为其他迅速效仿的工人树立了榜样。
最后，我们必须指出，主要依靠资产阶级报纸，我们只能获得不完整的月度报告数据。

结 束

THE NEW OFFENSIVE OF JAPANESE IMPERIALISM IN N. CHINA

(In our previous issue we published an article on the new offensive
of Japanese imperialism in North China together the Kuomintang's deci-
sion to surrender by a new deal with Japan. The decision involves, so
far as we know, the de facto recognition of the Manchukuo as the most
important step in the direction of further capitulation to Japan and
further aid to Japanese war preparations against the Soviet Union. The
new deal is embodied in an agreement between representatives of Nanking
and agents of the Japanese Kwantung army, and may not be made known
for a long time to come. The following is a translation of the decla-
ration made on April 10 by the C.C. of the Communist Party of China,
calling on the masses of China to rise in a protest against the new
betrayal of the Kuomintang---Ed.
....................

To the masses of the whole country,
Since enthronement of its puppet, Henry Pu Yi, the predatory Japanese im-
perialism is openly contemplating further violences and outrages in N. China
with the annexation of the whole country as the main objective.
Japanese imperialism has presented the following demands on its agent in
N.China, Huang Fu, chairman of the Peiping political council: 1) immediate
acceptance of all the conditions relating to Sino-Japanese direct negotiations,
2) complete evacuation of the old Manchurian troops (under Chang Hsueh-liang)
as well as of all other units, to be replaced by Japanese and Manchukuo troops,
3) complete suppression of all anti-Japanese and anti-imperialist bodies, to
be replaced by Japanese and Manchukuo organisations, 4) protection to be giv-
en by the authorities in N. China to Pu Yi when the latter comes within the
Great Wall in a visit to the eastern imperial tombs, 5) demarkation of the ter-
ritory to the north of the Huang Ho as Manchukuo territory, 6) guarantee of
preferential rights to Japanese investments in China as a vital step to Sino-
Japanese economic cooperation. In a word, dissatisfied with the status quo in
N. China, Japanese imperialism demands Hun Pei, even the whole land, to be
placed under its direct control like the present Manchukuo.
With this objective in view Japanese imperialism has been making active
war preparations: further reinforcements to Jehol and E. Chahar, mass
recruitment of Chinese workers, construction of motor roads for war purpose,
incorporation of the bandits (under Japanese instigation the notorious bandit
leader Liu Kueitang has devastated several provinces), despatch of numerous
planes for reconnoitering purposes, increasing activities of the Japanese
spy service (surveying in the provinces lying north of the Huang Ho), construc-
tion of more than 30 wireless stations between Jehol and Mongolia, signs
that point to the new Japanese offensive not only against N. China but against
Sinkiang and the People's Republic in Outer Mongolia in an attempt to march
on the Soviet Union.
Parallel to the Japanese offensive British and French imperialism are
making further attempts to widen their spheres of influences in S. China. En-
gland and Japan are said to revive the old alliance. The Yankee imperialism

中国共产党中央委员会关于

日本帝国主义在华北的新攻势的声明

（在上一期中，我们发表了一篇关于日本帝国主义在华北新攻势的文章，以及国民党通过与日本达成新交易而决定投降的内容。据我们所知，该决定包括事实上承认伪满洲国，这是进一步向日本投降和进一步援助日本针对苏联的战备工作的最重要步骤。这项新交易体现在南京代表与日本关东军代理人之间的一项协议中，可能在很长一段时间内不会公开。以下是中国共产党中央委员会于4月10日发表的宣言译文，号召中国民众起来抗议国民党的新背叛——编者注。
....................

致全国民众，
自从其傀儡溥仪登基以来，掠夺成性的日本帝国主义公然策划在华北进行进一步的暴行和 outrage，其主要目标是吞并整个国家。
日本帝国主义向其华北代理人、北平政务委员会委员长黄郛提出了以下要求：1) 立即接受所有关于中日直接谈判的条件，2) 完全撤出旧东北军（张学良部下）以及所有其他部队，由日本和伪满洲国军队取代，3) 彻底镇压所有反日和反帝国主义团体，由日本和伪满洲国组织取代，4) 当溥仪进入关内谒陵时，华北当局须给予保护，5) 划定黄河以北地区为伪满洲国领土，6) 保证日本在华投资的优先权，作为中日经济合作的重要步骤。总之，日本帝国主义对华北现状不满，要求河北，甚至整个土地，像现在的伪满洲国一样置于其直接控制之下。
为了实现这一目标，日本帝国主义一直在积极进行战争准备：向热河和察哈尔东部增兵，大规模招募中国工人，修建战备公路，收编土匪（在日本唆使下，臭名昭著的匪首刘桂堂蹂躏了数省），派遣大量飞机进行侦察，增加日本间谍活动的频率（在黄河以北各省进行调查），在热河和蒙古之间修建了30多个无线电台，这些迹象表明日本的新攻势不仅针对华北，还针对新疆和外蒙古人民共和国，企图进犯苏联。
与日本攻势并行，英法帝国主义正进一步试图扩大其在华南的势力范围。据说英国和日本正在恢复旧同盟。美帝国主义

wants to convert China into its exclusive colony in its fight for the hegemony over the Pacific. The recent exchange of notes between Japan and U.S. are simply a conspiracy against the Soviet Union. For the partition of and international over China all imperialism, especially German imperialism, is prepared to recognize Manchukuo, and an international consortium is just considering a big loan to Nanking.
The people in N. China as well as in the whole country are facing a life and death battle. The anti-Soviet war is more critical. And the imperialist invasion of China has reached a new stage, that is, the stage of direct division.

KMT's New Sale

In face of this acute crisis the KMT is shamelessly, nay, more shamelessly, conducting the sale negotiations with Huang Fu and Ho Yin-chin figuring most prominently. Nanking sent its vice-minister of foreign affairs, Tang Yu-jin, to Changchun paying Pu Yi a visit. Chiang Kai-shek and his henchmen decided to accept all Japanese demands at the Hanchang conference. Evacuation has been already begun in N. China and many of the northwestern divisions have come down to attack the red army. In turning N. China to Japan, The fascist KMT has resolved to put down all anti-Japanese movements or strikes. Chiang Kai-shek has issued strict orders against all strikes and sabotages. By these acts the KMT has proved the most reliable agent of Japanese imperialism and the most loyal subject of Pu Yi.
To conceal its betrayal the KMT has been carrying on the most shameless demagogical propaganda, saying that we should not worry so much about the danger in N. China, assuring that British imperialism has not yet occupied Panhung and Nanchang in Yunnan (which were seized long time ago). It considers the anti-Japanese and anti-imperialist movements as prejudicial to its policy of "construction" and communist-suppression. It is pushing the campaign against the Soviets without taking any steps to ward off the danger in north China. It is initiating a new life movement to enthrottle and enslave the masses so as to have a freer hand in selling the country. Yet it calls the movement as a national recovery.
The KMT's plea that the country is too weak to resist Japanese aggressions has been clearly contradicted by the victories of the anti-Japanese troops and volunteers in Manchuria, N. China and Shanghai. And the heroic red armies have been able to shatter the imperialist-KMT campaigns in succession. It is the KMT that has cleared the ground for imperialist invasion. China is weak because the KMT wants to bow before imperialism.

Appeal to Workers and Peasants

The imperialist gun is aiming at us, toilers of China. The KMT will not its sale unless we rise against it. Any one who do not want to live like a slave under foreign rule, who do not want to be sold by the KMT, must arm themselves in defence of N. China and the whole country by a revolutionary national struggle; drive out Japanese imperialism and smash its tool---KMT. They must unite against Japanese and other imperialist aggressions in a unified anti-imperialist front without regard to political affiliations, occupations or sex. Our anti-imperialist programme consists of
1) against the KMT surrender, no illusions on the league of nations and America, union of all toilers as the mainstay of the national struggle against imperialism,
2) in favor of a sacred revolutionary national struggle in defence of China's independence and territorial integrity,
3) appeal to the masses to join the war against Japan, aid for the volunteers,
4) seizure of all arms, whether in China or imported, to arm the masses, confiscation of Japanese property and property of the traitors for war expenditure against Japan,
5) keeping away from Japanese and other imperialist influence, also from the influence of the traitors, repudiation of all debts in order to raise funds for the anti-Japanese war,
6) complete severance of diplomatic relations with Japan, mobilization of all land, naval and air forces against Japan, discontinuation of the campaign against the Soviets,
7) against the Tangu agreement and direct negotiations.
Here is our programme for the national struggle which ought to have the support of all toilers as well as those who are really against imperialism. (Here follows the appeal to the masses in North China, to workers and peasants, to revolutionary students and intellectuals, etc.)
