企图在争夺太平洋霸权的斗争中将中国变为其独占的殖民地。近日日本与美国之间的换文，仅仅是一场针对苏联的阴谋。为了瓜分并实行对中国的国际共管，所有帝国主义列强，尤其是德意志帝国主义，都准备承认满洲国，而一个国际财团正在考虑向南京提供一笔巨额贷款。
华北以及全国的民众正面临着一场生死存亡的战斗。反苏战争更为危急。帝国主义对中国的侵略已进入一个新阶段，即直接瓜分的阶段。

国民党的新出卖

面对这一严峻危机，国民党无耻地、甚至更加无耻地进行着出卖谈判，其中黄郛和何应钦最为突出。南京派遣外交部次长唐有壬前往长春拜访溥仪。蒋介石及其亲信在汉口会议上决定接受日本的所有要求。华北的撤离已经开始，许多西北师团已南下进攻红军。为了将华北拱手让给日本，法西斯化的国民党决心镇压一切抗日运动或罢工。蒋介石已发布严厉命令，禁止一切罢工和破坏活动。通过这些行径，国民党证明了自己是日本帝国主义最可靠的代理人，也是溥仪最忠诚的臣民。
为了掩盖其背叛行径，国民党一直在进行最无耻的蛊惑性宣传，声称我们不必过分担忧华北的危险，并保证英国帝国主义尚未占领云南的潘洪（音译）和南昌（这些地方早已被占领）。它认为抗日和反帝运动有害于其“建设”和剿共政策。它在未采取任何措施抵御华北危险的情况下，持续推进反苏运动。它发起新生活运动以扼杀和奴役群众，以便更自由地出卖国家。然而，它却称该运动为民族复兴。
国民党以国家太弱无法抵抗日本侵略为借口的说辞，已被满洲、华北和上海抗日部队及志愿军的胜利所明确驳斥。英勇的红军已能够接连粉碎帝国主义-国民党的围剿。正是国民党为帝国主义侵略扫清了道路。中国之所以软弱，是因为国民党想要向帝国主义屈膝。

告工农书

帝国主义的枪口正对准我们，中国的劳动者们。除非我们起来反抗，否则国民党不会停止其出卖行径。任何不愿在外国统治下像奴隶一样生活、不愿被国民党出卖的人，都必须通过革命性的民族斗争武装起来，保卫华北和全国；驱逐日本帝国主义并粉碎其工具——国民党。他们必须不分政治派别、职业或性别，在统一的反帝战线中团结起来，对抗日本和其他帝国主义的侵略。我们的反帝纲领包括：
1) 反对国民党投降，对国际联盟和美国不抱幻想，团结所有劳动者作为反帝民族斗争的中坚力量，
2) 支持为捍卫中国独立和领土完整而进行的神圣革命民族斗争，
3) 号召群众参加对日战争，援助志愿军，
4) 没收所有武器，无论是国产还是进口的，以武装群众，没收日本财产和汉奸财产作为对日战争经费，
5) 摆脱日本及其他帝国主义的影响，以及汉奸的影响，拒绝偿还所有债务以筹集抗日资金，
6) 与日本完全断绝外交关系，动员所有陆海空军对日作战，停止反苏运动，
7) 反对《塘沽协定》及直接谈判。
这就是我们的民族斗争纲领，它应当得到所有劳动者以及真正反对帝国主义者的支持。（以下是向华北群众、工人和农民、革命学生和知识分子等发出的呼吁。）

pages.en:
LIFE AND STRUGGLE OF THE CHINTSIN MINERS

Located in Hopei, the Chintsin mine is the largest, only next to the Kai-lan mine under British control. It is composed of seven or eight minor mines, employing 16,000 workers. A part of it is situated in the north worked up by the son of a militarist while in the south the enterprise is under Sino-German management. But strictly speaking it is run by the Germans because Chang Hsueh-liang mortgaged it to them for the purchase of aeroplanes.
Over the workers there is a hierarchy of five grades with the foremen in direct control of the workers.
Life of Workers

The miners are divided into two shifts, each working eight hours. The first begins from 6 A.M. while the second from 2 P.M. But the workers as a rule work one or two hours overtime every day.
2/3 of the miners are natives, the remainder coming from the neighboring provinces. Owing to low wages, wage cut, lockout, etc, the workers are always on the starvation line. They eat the worst food and live in caves. When you enter the worker's house, you see but all darkness---dark clothes, dark bedding, dark hearth, dark man, etc. All this is due the dark heart of the capitalist.
The internal workers, about 1,200, directly paid by the management, earn $8 to $20 a month, hence in a better position as compared with the external workers who receive their wages from the contractors varying from 20 to 40 cents a day. They get no pay when they don't work. They work every two or three days. Hence they do not get enough for their own living, much less for their families.
The internal workers, though paid a definite wage each month, are always several months in arrears. Last year their pay was withheld from 5.5 to 2 months Dissatisfied with the back pay, the workers were agitating against it and demanded the pay in full. They went on strike several times but failed owing to the treachery of the yellow unions.
The external workers, not directly connected with the management, suffered more from the contractors as a result of double and triple exploitation. They are subject to the exploitation of the so-called guarantor who, usually a usurer and a landlord, stands as surety for the contractors and takes more than a half from the workers' wages. The guarantor always lends money to the needy workers at the rate of 5 or 10 cents for each dollar a month. Still worse is the noodle loan to the workers who get the noodle from the guarantor at a much higher rate. So long as the worker gets no pay, he must be subject to this usurious loan.
The external workers demand abolition of the contractor system, direct payment from the management, loan in money or noodle without interest, ride on lifts down or up the shafts.
In the south each contractor controls some 160 workers and is, for this reason, called the big contractor. In the north there is no big contractor, each controlling 4 to 100 workers.
Workers Organisations

800 workers in the south are organised in the red unions. In the north mine there are the blue and red organisations (gangster). The strongest are the Tung Hsiang Hui (union of men from the same birth place) from the workers coming from outside. The yellow unions have declined considerably in influence as a result of their betrayals.
Last March 400 workers (internal) demanded pay in full, a demand was supported by the advanced as well as the backward workers. And the workers were firmly resolved to carry out the demands. But the yellow unions tried to stop the outbreak of the struggle by intimidation and deception. At last they took up the leadership of the struggle (which was inevitable) in order to sell it out.
The yellow unions in attempting to sell out the struggle adopted the following methods: buying the traitors and gangsters for keeping a watch on the workers, dismissing the leaders of the working masses, separating the masses from each other, splitting the workers by putting forward slogans favorable for certain workers but disfavorable for certain others. To save its bankruptcy, they even attacked their own leaders. They held back the workers back from the struggle in every way possible. They received $300 from the management as a grant to the yellow unions. The dissatisfaction of the workers over the yellow is increasing every day.
The red unions have made progress among the workers in spite of the deception and persecution of the yellow unions. Their papers and slogans have engaged the growing attention of the working masses.
pages.zh:
井陉矿工的生活与斗争

井陉煤矿位于河北，是仅次于英资控制的开滦煤矿的第二大煤矿。它由七八个小矿组成，雇佣工人16,000名。其北部部分由一位军阀的儿子经营，而南部企业则由中德合办。但严格来说，它是由德国人经营的，因为张学良为了购买飞机将其抵押给了德国人。
在工人之上有一个五级的层级结构，工头直接控制着工人。
工人的生活

矿工分为两班，每班工作八小时。第一班从早上6点开始，第二班从下午2点开始。但工人们通常每天加班一到两个小时。
三分之二的矿工是本地人，其余来自邻近省份。由于工资低、减薪、闭厂等原因，工人们始终处于饥饿线上。他们吃着最糟糕的食物，住在窑洞里。当你走进工人的住所，看到的只有一片黑暗——黑色的衣服、黑色的被褥、黑色的炉灶、黑乎乎的人，等等。这一切都是由于资本家黑心所致。
内部工人约1,200名，由管理处直接支付工资，月薪8至20美元，因此与外部工人相比处境较好，后者的工资由包工头支付，每天 varying from 20 to 40 cents（原文不清/混合，意为20至40美分不等）。他们不干活就没有工资。他们每两三天工作一次。因此，他们的收入连维持自身生活都不够，更不用说养活家人了。
内部工人虽然每月有固定工资，但总是拖欠数月。去年他们的工资被拖欠了5.5到2个月（原文数字表述可能有误，照实译出）。工人们不满于欠薪，对此进行抗议并要求全额支付工资。他们曾数次罢工，但由于黄色工会的背叛而失败。
外部工人不直接与管理处联系，因遭受双重乃至三重剥削，受包工头的压榨更甚。他们受到所谓“保人”的剥削，保人通常是高利贷者和地主，为包工头作保，并从工人工资中拿走一半以上。保人总是以每月每元借款收取5或10美分利息的方式，向急需资金的工人放贷。更糟糕的是向工人提供的“面条贷款”，工人从保人那里以高得多的利率获得面条。只要工人拿不到工资，就必须忍受这种高利贷。
外部工人要求废除包工制，由管理处直接支付工资，提供无息金钱或面条贷款，乘坐升降梯上下井筒。
在南部，每个包工头控制约160名工人，因此被称为大包工头。在北部没有大包工头，每人控制4至100名工人。
工人组织

南部有800名工人组织在红色工会中。在北矿则有蓝色和红色组织（帮会）。势力最强的是同乡会，由外来工人组成。黄色工会因其背叛行为，影响力已大幅衰退。
去年三月，400名内部工人要求全额支付工资，这一要求得到了先进工人和落后工人的支持。工人们坚决要求实现这些诉求。但黄色工会试图通过恐吓和欺骗来阻止斗争的爆发。最后，他们接管了斗争的领导权（这是不可避免的），以便出卖斗争。
黄色工会在试图出卖斗争时采取了以下方法：收买叛徒和流氓监视工人，开除群众运动的领袖，离间群众，通过提出对某些工人有利而对其他工人不利的口号来分裂工人。为了挽救其破产，他们甚至攻击自己的领袖。他们千方百计阻碍工人参与斗争。他们从管理处获得了300美元，作为对黄色工会的资助。工人对黄色工会的不满与日俱增。
尽管受到黄色工会的欺骗和迫害，红色工会在工人中仍取得了进展。他们的报刊和口号引起了广大劳动群众日益增长的关注。

pages.en:
THE MAYAR WORKERS SURROUNDED THE MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT
....................

Imperialism and KMT have been very busy with the arrest of the workers leaders of the Mayar silk mill at Shanghai (See our last issue). Up to last week more than 50 leaders were thrown into prisons. The 4,000 workers, however, persisted in the strike for 6 weeks already. Under the leadership of the CPC they refused to accept all reconciliation and arbitration offered by KMT, contractors, yellow unions, bourgeois journalists, lawyers, etc. They decided to fight to the last for the interests of the workers. Other workers, toilers and students in Shanghai have given aid to them. Workers of 15 silk mills have declared a sympathetic strike, likely to result in a general tie-up for the silk enterprises as a whole. On April 12 the garrison commander of Shanghai, therefore, proclaimed an order strictly forbidding strikes and sabotage. The fascist hangmen busied themselves with the arrest of workers leaders, thus trying to wreck the strike. But the strikers refused to yield.
Besieged the Municipal Gov't

Under the guidance of the strike committee 4,000 workers of the Mayar silk mill called a strike on March 9 against the 20% wage cut. Being mostly women, they nevertheless organized agitation and messenger corps, pickets, etc., fighting for the interests of the working class. Relying on the strength of the masses, they snatched from the hands of the police their leaders and fellow workers serving on the strike committee. They demonstrated against the threat of the capitalists to their delegates. They fought against police men for an hour and suffered 100 casualty.

On April 10, the date set for arbitration in the bureau of social affairs, workers went there in small bands after dinner. They desired to aid their delegates in the arbitration but resolved not to yield on any of their demands. By and by the crowd reached 2,000, and demonstrated. In face of the police and troop charge they refused to retreat. Cold and rain rather encouraged the Workers who would not yield at all. In the evening the crowd was reenforced by workers from other quarters, and received bread from them. Functionaries of the municipal government were shut in.

In spite of drizzling rain and severe cold the workers refused to leave the municipal government and spent the night by standing and waiting. One woman worker fainted and bore a child on the very spot. The day following, 500 soldiers were rushed to the scene. At 10 o'clock they opened fire on the besieging crowd resulting in the killing and wounding of dozens.
Leaders Arrested

To break the strike the KMT started the offensive against the central organisations of the workers and arrested their leaders by the dozens. They dragged the leaders from the workers quarters, charging them with theft and robbery, hoping thus to lessen the indignation of the workers. Up to now over 50 leaders were taken into custody. As firm as ever, the strikers never returned to work as ordered by the KMT.
Aid from Other Workers

Workers in the other 15 mills at Shanghai have suffered wage cut in the current year. They are thus quite sympathetic for the Mayar strikers. They collected money for the Mayar workers. They carried banners in aid of them while besieging the bureau of social affairs. They brought them food and bread. On April 11 the crowd of the Mayar strikers around the Shanghai municipal gov't was dispersed by police and troops but next day 15 silk mills at Shanghai called a sympathy strike just at the moment when the KMT strictly interdicted strikes and sabotage.

The CPC in leading this struggle directed decisive blows against the deception of the yellow unions, against the deception of the liquidationalists who are only opposed to the "irrational wage cut", broke through the severe white terror of the KMT and imperialism. In the light of these facts the workers now perfectly understand that the CPC alone defends the interests of the workers, that only firm solidarity and stiff struggle can win the final victory. More united than ever, they are organising the general strike of the silk mills as a condition for the success of their struggle.

CHINESE ECONOMY IN FIRST QUARTER
1934
....................

Chinese bourgeoisie is at present disappointed, more disappointed than last year, in their new hopes for the better in 1934. With the conclusion of
pages.zh:
美亚工人包围市政府
....................

帝国主义和国民党一直忙于逮捕上海美亚丝厂的工人领袖（见本刊上一期）。截至上周，已有50多名领袖被投入监狱。然而，4000名工人已坚持罢工6周。在中国共产党的领导下，他们拒绝接受国民党、包工头、黄色工会、资产阶级记者、律师等提供的任何调解和仲裁。他们决定为工人的利益战斗到底。上海的其他工人、劳工和学生也给予了他们援助。15家丝厂的工人宣布举行同情罢工，这可能导致整个丝绸行业的全面停工。因此，上海卫戍司令于4月12日发布命令，严厉禁止罢工和破坏活动。法西斯刽子手们忙于逮捕工人领袖，企图以此破坏罢工。但罢工者拒绝屈服。

包围市政府

在罢工委员会的指导下，美亚丝厂4000名工人于3月9日举行罢工，反对削减20%的工资。尽管她们大多是女性，但仍组织了宣传队和通讯队、纠察队等，为工人阶级的利益而斗争。依靠群众的力量，她们从警察手中夺回了被捕的领袖和在罢工委员会服务的工友。她们举行示威，抗议资本家对其代表的威胁。她们与警察搏斗了一小时，伤亡达100人。

4月10日是社会局设定的仲裁日期，工人们饭后分批前往该局。她们希望协助代表进行仲裁，但决心在任何要求上都不让步。人群逐渐增至2000人，并举行了示威。面对警察和军队的冲锋，她们拒绝撤退。寒冷和雨水反而鼓舞了绝不妥协的工人们。傍晚，来自其他地区的工人加入队伍，增强了力量，并给她们送来了面包。市政府官员被关在里面。

尽管细雨绵绵且严寒刺骨，工人们仍拒绝离开市政府，站立守候过夜。一名女工晕倒，并在当场分娩。次日，500名士兵被紧急调往现场。上午10时，他们向包围的人群开火，导致数十人死伤。

领袖被捕

为了破坏罢工，国民党开始对工人中央组织发动进攻，逮捕了数十名领袖。他们将领袖从工人居住区拖走，指控其犯有盗窃和抢劫罪，希望以此减轻工人的愤怒。截至目前，已有50多名领袖被拘留。罢工者依然坚定，未按国民党的命令复工。

其他工人的援助

上海其他15家丝厂的工人在今年也遭受了减薪。因此，他们对美亚罢工者深表同情。他们为美亚工人募集了资金。在包围社会局时，他们举着横幅声援美亚工人。他们给美亚工人送去食物和面包。4月11日，聚集在上海市政府周围的美亚罢工人群被警察和军队驱散，但次日，就在国民党严厉禁止罢工和破坏活动之际，上海15家丝厂举行了同情罢工。

中国共产党在领导这场斗争中，对黄色工会的欺骗、对仅反对“不合理减薪”的取消主义者的欺骗给予了决定性打击，突破了国民党及帝国主义的严重白色恐怖。鉴于这些事实，工人们现在完全明白，只有共产党捍卫工人的利益，只有坚定的团结和顽强的斗争才能赢得最终胜利。他们比以往更加团结，正在组织丝厂总罢工，以此作为斗争成功的条件。

1934年第一季度中国经济
....................

中国资产阶级目前对他们对于1934年情况好转的新希望感到失望，这种失望甚于去年。随着

pages.en:
5
the first quarter, 1934, the crisis has become much sharper. The largest of national industries, namely, the cotton mill, is reported to be on the verge of collapse in its entirety. The flour mills, silk weaving mills and tobacco factories will meet the same fate in the near future. Those which still struggle on will suck the last drop of blood from the worker before falling to pieces.

New Factors in the Crisis

New factors are working for the further deepening of the crisis. They assist imperialist economic aggressions in China. In the first place, the steady rise in the value of silver is a great aid to imperialist dumping in China to the detriment of Chinese national goods. China is a silver country and, for this very reason, closely related to the rise or fall in the price of silver. Owing to the low price of silver before 1932 Chinese industry and trade could maintain themselves in a somewhat stable position because the price level remained rather high. But since the suspension of the gold standard by Japan, England and US (which take up 50% of the total foreign trade of China) Chinese price level steadily declines. The American dollar in January and February has fallen by 20% as compared with last year. This helps imperialist wares in bringing pressure on the Chinese. This depresses Chinese prices. With the aid of the greatly depreciated Yen, of its military machine and the political superiority in China, of its smuggling, of the interdiction of the anti-Japanese boycott movement by the KMT, Japanese imperialism has been able to obtain the upper hand in the Chinese market.

The tax taxation has been on the increase from year to year. Last December the taxes on tobacco, cement, matches, etc, xxx were raised by one third. Beginning from this year, Tientsin collects 6% likin. Anhwei and Hupeh have followed the example of Tientsin. In view of the decrease in taxes as a result of the economic crisis the provincial, hsien and other local governments have ceaselessly increased the rate of taxation.

In the third place, rural economy has gone from bad to worse. The levy of a tax on the importation of foreign rice considered as the necessary step in raising the prices of agricultural produce has been enforced only in provinces under the control of Nanking, and has failed to show the desired effects. The price of flour is still going down. The purchasing power of the peasant is on the decline.

The Cotton Mill

Turning to the actual condition of the sharpening of the crisis, we may take the cotton mill as an example. Chinese textiles divide the market of China with Japanese textiles almost on the 50%-50% basis but in regard to capital and technique the Japanese exceeds the Chinese. According to a statement of the Chinese textile association Japanese capital is mapping out a plan to wipe out the Chinese cotton mill in three years by monopolizing the market in Manchuria and North China as well as elsewhere. The selling price of the Japanese yarn is always lower than the Chinese by more than ten dollars. And this fact causes a further slump in the price of yarn. Here in Shanghai the yarn of 20 counts sells at $176 in January or $28 below the price in the corresponding period last year. Now it declines to $163.70, the lowest level touched since 1911.

The low price of the yarn is, however, accompanied by stagnation, a condition much worse than last year. According to the report of the Chinese Textile association at Hankow the Japanese control 80% of the yarn market and 90% of the cloth market. Oppressed by the Japanese, the cotton mills in Shanghai are not able, it is reported, to pay back $120,000,000 to the banks which have advanced the money as a loan. At a conference on April 13 the cotton mills in Shanghai decided to curtail production beginning from May 1. On account of labour day falling on May 1, the curtailment was postponed to June 1. It shall be remembered that from April 20, 1933, the cotton mills in Shanghai have cut production by 23%. The Shanghai bourgeois press reported the flight of the cotton mill king, Yin Chun-chin, to Hong Kong in order to avoid the pressure of his creditors. The Shanghai banks have been stated ready in assuming the control over the cotton mills owing to the latter's inability to repay loans but as they are not well versed in the cotton mill business they will engage Japanese experts as managers. The day is drawing near when the Chinese textiles will fall into the hands of the Japanese.

Other Industries

Next comes the flour mills which, numbering some 20 throughout the country, have been running in 70% capacity since the beginning of the year. As a result of the importation of American wheat and flour provided in the US cotton and wheat loan, as a result of the monopolisation of the market in Manchuria and North China by the Japanese, Chinese flour has been steadily declining in price. Under such conditions the largest of flour mills in Chi-
pages.zh:
5
1934年第一季度的结束，危机变得更加尖锐。据报道，最大的民族工业即棉纺业正处于全面崩溃的边缘。面粉厂、丝织厂和烟草厂在不久的将来也将面临同样的命运。那些仍在挣扎的企业在彻底垮台之前，将从工人身上榨取最后一滴血。

危机中的新因素

新的因素正在促使危机进一步加深。它们助长了帝国主义对中国的经济侵略。首先，银价的稳步上涨极大地便利了帝国主义在中国倾销商品，从而损害了中国国货。中国是一个用银国家，正因如此，与银价的涨跌密切相关。由于1932年以前银价低廉，中国工商业得以维持相对稳定的地位，因为物价水平保持较高。但是，自从日本、英国和美国（这三个国家占中国对外贸易总额的50%）放弃金本位制以来，中国的物价水平持续下降。今年一月和二月，美元汇率较去年同期下跌了20%。这有助于帝国主义商品向中国施加压力。这压低了中国的物价。借助大幅贬值的日元、其军事机器、在华政治优势、走私活动以及国民党对抵制日货运动的禁令，日本帝国主义已能够在中国市场占据上风。

税收逐年增加。去年十二月，烟草、水泥、火柴等的xxx税提高了三分之一。从今年开始，天津征收6%的厘金。安徽和湖北也效仿天津的做法。鉴于经济危机导致税收减少，省、县及其他地方政府不断提高了税率。

第三，农村经济每况愈下。征收进口洋米税被视为提高农产品价格的必要步骤，但该措施仅在南京控制的省份实施，且未能显示出预期效果。面粉价格仍在下跌。农民的购买力正在下降。

棉纺业

转向危机加剧的实际状况，我们可以以棉纺业为例。中国纺织品与日本纺织品几乎以五五开的比例瓜分中国市场，但在资本和技术方面，日本优于中国。据中国纺织协会声明，日本资本正制定计划，通过垄断满洲、华北及其他地区的市场，在三年内消灭中国棉纺业。日本纱线的售价总是比中国纱线低十元以上。这一事实导致纱价进一步暴跌。在上海，20支纱一月份售价为176美元，比去年同期价格低28美元。现在已跌至163.70美元，这是自1911年以来的最低水平。

然而，纱价低迷伴随着停滞，这种情况比去年更为糟糕。据汉口中国纺织协会的报告，日本控制了80%的纱线市场和90%的布匹市场。据报道，在上海的日本压迫下，棉纺厂无力偿还银行垫付的1.2亿美元贷款。在4月13日的一次会议上，上海棉纺厂决定从5月1日起缩减生产。由于5月1日是劳动节，减产推迟到6月1日。值得注意的是，自1933年4月20日以来，上海棉纺厂已减产23%。上海资产阶级报纸报道，“棉纱大王”殷振钦（Yin Chun-chin，音译）为躲避债权人压力逃往香港。据悉，由于棉纺厂无力偿还贷款，上海银行准备接管棉纺厂，但由于他们不熟悉棉纺业务，将聘请日本专家担任经理。中国纺织业落入日本人手中的日子已近在咫尺。

其他行业

接下来是面粉厂，全国约有20家，自年初以来一直以70%的产能运行。由于美国棉花和小麦贷款项下的美国小麦和面粉进口，以及日本对满洲和华北市场的垄断，中国面粉价格持续下跌。在这种情况下，最大的面粉厂在Chi-

pages.en:
6
na, the Foosin flour mill, was forced to close down. As to the silk business,
the condition is still worse. The rise in silver prevents Chinese silk from
competition with the Japanese in foreign markets, namely, in America and
France. The silk market in foreign countries is, therefore, occupied by the
Japanese. Since the opening of the year all silk filatures except a couple
have shut up, throwing out some 60,000 workers. The silk-weaving business
has likewise sunk steadily. Originally, there were 9,000 looms at Shanghai
but up to April, 1933, the number decreased down to 4,745, then down to
2,500 February, 1934.
Last December the Nanking government increased the tax on tobacco by 1/3
to the great prejudice of Tobacco companies of Chinese nationality. The
new tax is a discrimination against Chinese cigarettes. According to the re-
port of the Chinese tobacco association foreign made cigarettes pay only 7¢,
while the Chinese have to pay 120% or 50% more. Since the imposition of the
new tax foreign cigarettes have cut their prices by 20% and depressed the
Chinese products still further. Chinese tobacco manufacturers have peti-
tioned to the government for a revision of the tax but obtained no answer
from Nanking.
The tax on matches was also raised, thus rendering ineffective the
dumping tax of 1931 against the unfair competition of foreign matches. The
new tax is so high that it virtually takes up 70% of the price of the pro-
duct.
Rural Economy
Agriculture repeatedly hit by the crisis has reduced its productivity
considerably. Take the example of sericulture. According to the Shanghai
Sin-Wen-pao of April 13 2/3 of the peasants have given up silk-worm-breed-
ing in Wusih, centre of sericulture in China. The sheets of silkworm, though
sold at reduced prices, can not find a market. The exportation of tea a-
mounts to 72,623 piculs from January to March or a decrease of 7,796 piculs
as against the corresponding period. Statistics are not available as to the
other agricultural products.
Trade has worsened. Take Foochow as an example. Here trade suffered
more than last year. Owing to deflation of credit over 30 big stores in the
most prosperous street of Foochow have closed down. Other shops are consid-
ering liquidation. In a word, trade conditions have aggravated as compared
with last year.

VOLUNTEERS ACTIVE EVERYWHERE IN MANCHURIA
....................
Since the accession of Henry Pu Yi to the throne under Japanese instiga-
tion the people in Manchuria have shown more resentment, and the volunteers
have become more active everywhere in Manchuria. The bourgeois press here in
Shanghai is full of such news.
In the opening days of March one detachment of the Manchukuo troops sta-
tioned in Sanshin, lower Sungari, has mutinied and killed the Japanese offi-
cer by the name of Yizuka together with many others.
In the morning of March 1 thirty-two soldiers of the machine gun de-
tachment of Manchukuo mutinied, killing the captain, disarming six others
who refused to revolt.
April 7 about 100 volunteers attacked the Anshin railway and fought with
Japanese troops, killing one Japanese, wounding two. On the same day 200
volunteers started offensive against the Japanese troops stationed along the
Anfeng line.
50 volunteers came to the outskirts of Harbin on the night of April 11,
killing one Japanese merchant but swiftly disappeared before the advent of
the Manchukuo troops. Four days later 40 volunteers attacked Chinkung, He-
lungkiang and killed 6 functionaries (Japanese and Manchurian) of the Man-
chukuo central bank who refused to hand over the money demanded by the vo-
lunteers. The volunteers opened the vaults and obtained $226,000 cash for the
financing of the campaign against the Japanese imperialists and Manchukuo
traitors.
Here are but a few of the examples showing the increasing activities of
the volunteers operating in Manchuria. They are fighting for the indepen-
dence of China, for the territorial integrity of China. Some of them are
carrying on the offensive against Japanese imperialism under the revolution-
ary leadership of the CPC (See our previous issues bearing this point).
E N D
pages.zh:
6
那，福新面粉厂被迫关闭。至于丝绸业，情况更为糟糕。银价上涨导致中国丝绸无法在海外市场（即美国和法国）与日本产品竞争。因此，国外丝绸市场被日本占据。自年初以来，除少数几家外，所有缫丝厂均已停业，导致约60,000名工人失业。丝织业同样持续衰退。上海原有织机9,000台，但截至1933年4月，数量降至4,745台，到1934年2月进一步降至2,500台。
去年12月，南京政府将烟草税提高了三分之一，这对华资烟草公司造成了极大损害。新税制是对中国卷烟的歧视。据中国烟草协会报告，外国卷烟仅纳税7美分，而中国卷烟则需缴纳120%或高出50%的税额。自征收新税以来，外国卷烟降价20%，进一步打压了中国产品。中国烟草制造商已向政府请愿要求修订税制，但未得到南京方面的答复。
火柴税也已提高，从而使1931年针对外国火柴不公平竞争的倾销税失效。新税额如此之高，实际上占到了产品价格的70%。
农村经济
农业屡受危机打击，生产力大幅下降。以蚕桑业为例。据4月13日上海《新闻报》报道，作为中国蚕桑业中心的无锡，已有三分之二的农民放弃养蚕。蚕种虽降价出售，却找不到市场。茶叶出口量从一月至三月为72,623担，较同期减少7,796担。其他农产品暂无统计数据。
贸易状况恶化。以福州为例。这里的贸易遭受的损失比去年更严重。由于信用紧缩，福州最繁华街道上的30多家大商店已倒闭。其他店铺也在考虑清算。总之，贸易状况较去年加剧恶化。

满洲各地义勇军活动频繁
....................
自从溥仪在日本唆使下登基以来，满洲民众表现出更多的愤慨，各地的义勇军活动也变得更加活跃。上海的资产阶级报纸充斥着此类新闻。
三月初，驻扎在下松江三姓（Sanshin）的一队伪满军队发生兵变，杀死了名为饭冢（Yizuka）的日本军官及其他多人。
3月1日上午，伪满机枪队的32名士兵发动兵变，击毙队长，并缴了另外六名拒绝参与叛乱者的械。
4月7日，约100名义勇军袭击安沈铁路，与日军交战，击毙一名日本人，击伤两名。同日，200名义勇军开始向驻守在安奉线沿线的日军发起进攻。
4月11日晚，50名义勇军来到哈尔滨郊区，杀死一名日本商人，但在伪满军队到达前迅速消失。四天后，40名义勇军袭击黑龙江金宫（Chinkung），杀死了6名拒绝交出纳款要求的伪满中央银行职员（包括日本人和满洲人）。义勇军打开金库，获取现金226,000元，用于资助反对日本帝国主义和满洲卖国贼的运动。
以上仅是显示在满洲活动的义勇军活动日益增加的几个例子。他们为中国的独立和领土完整而战。其中一些人在中国共产党（CPC）的革命领导下对日本帝国主义进行进攻（参见我们此前关于此点的期刊）。
完

-The Chinese Ruling Classes, Their Lackeys And The Lytton Report.

The report of the Commission of Enquiry of the League of Nations
into the Manchurian Event for which the Chinese ruling classes had ear-
nestly longed, eventually appeared before the public. There are par-
ticularly lays great stress on: the wide-developing of the Communist
led-Soviet movement in China as an actual rival to the Kuomintang rule;
the ever-surging of the anti-imperialist waves of the Chinese toiling
masses; the mighty influence of the Soviet Union to the Chinese Revo-
lution; and the powerful threat of these two to the interests of impe-
rialism.

The report suggests the following as actually possible to settle
the Sino-Japanese conflict: To erect an "advisory committee" in Man-
churia to be organized by international imperialists, but with the Ja-
panese as the backbone; to put down the Manchurian Volunteers; to ac-
tively attack the Soviet Union from Manchuria; to dismember China in
accordance with the late Dr. Sun Yat Sen's plan of "international co-
operation"; to intensify suppression of the nation-wide anti-imperia-
list movement and the Soviet revolutionary movement in China.

To this report what attitude has been shown by the Chinese ruling
class? First of all the Nanking Ministry for Foreign Affairs on Oct.
10 (The Shenpao) declared: "In detailing facts, there is no distinct
mistake in the report.... The suggestions in the last chapter are what
China can not accept." Nevertheless, Wellington Koo, Chinese Minister
at Paris, in an interview with the Geneva pressmen on Oct. 9 expressed
that the Chinese Government was ready to accept the Lytton Report on
the ground that the recognition of the report would lead to the once-
forever and adequate settlement of the Manchurian issue". (London Te-
legram from Geneva, Oct. 9.) On the other hand, according to the
Shunpao, Oct. 20, the Foreign Affairs of the Nanking Central Political
Committee is of the opinion that "the suggestions of the League report
for the solution of the Manchurian Problem can be accepted in princi-
ple."

More noticeable is the statement made public by Dr. Hu Shih, im-
portant and well-known scholar of the ruling classes; according to him,
"The Lytton report stands for the just opinion of the world." In
showing his appreciation of "the just and apprehensive consideration"
made by the League Commission, Hu even thinks that "Their righteous
judgment, their enthusiasm for the world peace and their toilso-
work during the past seven months deserve thanks and reverence from
us." His conclusion is exactly the resonance of that of the League
report: "Facing so big a crisis, China and the whole civilized world
have to live another ten miserable years, if the restraining power of

-中国统治阶级、其走狗与李顿调查报告。

中国统治阶级翘首以盼的国联满洲事变调查委员会报告，终于公之于众。报告特别着重强调以下几点：由共产党领导的苏维埃运动在中国广泛发展，已成为国民党统治的实际对手；中国劳苦大众的反帝浪潮不断高涨；苏联对中国革命的巨大影响；以及这两股力量对帝国主义利益构成的强大威胁。

报告提出以下实际上可能解决中日冲突的方案：在满洲建立一个由国际帝国主义者组织、但以日本人为骨干的“咨询委员会”；镇压满洲义勇军；从满洲积极进攻苏联；按照已故孙中山博士的“国际合作”计划瓜分中国；加紧镇压全国范围内的反帝运动和中国的苏维埃革命运动。

对于这份报告，中国统治阶级持何种态度？首先，南京外交部于10月10日（据《申报》）声明：“在陈述事实方面，报告并无明显错误……但最后一章中的建议是中国无法接受的。”然而，中国驻巴黎公使顾维钧在10月9日接受日内瓦记者采访时则表示，中国政府准备接受李顿调查报告，理由是承认该报告将导致“一劳永逸且充分地解决满洲问题”。（10月9日伦敦电，发自日内瓦。）另一方面，据10月20日《顺报》报道，南京中央政治委员会外交部门认为，“国联报告中关于解决满洲问题的建议在原则上是可以接受的。”

更引人注目的是统治阶级重要知名学者胡适博士公开发表的声明；在他看来，“李顿报告代表了世界的公正舆论。”在表达对国联调查委员会“公正且审慎的考量”的赞赏时，胡适甚至认为，“他们正义的裁决、他们对世界和平的热忱以及过去七个月里的辛勤工作，值得我们感谢和敬仰。”他的结论恰恰与李顿报告的论调产生共鸣：“面对如此巨大的危机，如果缺乏制约力量，中国和整个文明世界将不得不再度过十年悲惨岁月，”

tially announced to the world that Japan will not be bound by any agreement or treaty which is contrary to the principles of international law, on the part of Japan. If this is true, then the whole structure of the League of Nations is at stake."

It is clear that the Chinese nationalists are extremely opposed to the report, as might be expected. In an article in the "People's Tribune", No. 37, Oct. 15, they say: "The report is a betrayal of the Chinese people and a disgrace to the League of Nations. It is a document which will be remembered as one of the most shameful in the history of international diplomacy. The report is a complete failure, and it shows that the League of Nations is unable to maintain peace and justice in the world. The report is a blow to the cause of peace and justice, and it will be remembered as a dark page in the history of the League of Nations."

Some have said that the Chinese nationalists are opposing the report because they are afraid of the consequences. But this is not true. The Chinese nationalists are opposing the report because they believe that it is unjust and unfair to China. They believe that the report is a violation of the principles of international law and justice. They believe that the report is a threat to the sovereignty and independence of China. They believe that the report is a danger to the peace and stability of the world.

The Soviet Union has also criticized the report. In an article in the "Pravda", the official organ of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, it is said: "The report is a reflection of the imperialist policy of the Western powers. It is a attempt to divide China and to weaken the Chinese revolution. The report is a tool of imperialism, and it should be rejected by all progressive forces in the world."

The Chinese Social Democrats have also expressed their views on the report. In an article with the headline of "Critique on the Lytton Report" that appeared on the Oct. 15 issue of "The Society and Education" (organ of the Chinese Social Democrats) one Social Democrat writer says, in a usual way, "The Lytton report is a reflection of three different conflicts of the world, namely, conflicts among the imperialists; conflicts between imperialism and colonial countries; and conflicts between capitalism and socialism in the Soviet Union." Nevertheless, when coming to the conclusion he only says, "In short the important aim of the Lytton report is to attain international administration of Manchuria."

In a separate article headlined "After the proclamation of the Lytton Report,", of the same issue of "The Society and Education", another Social Democrat writer says, "The core of the Lytton report rests on three things: 1. China be content with the nominal sovereignty over Manchuria; Japan gets the real profits; and other powers take the advantage of the situation."

显然，中国国民党人极为反对该报告，这也是意料之中的事。在10月15日出版的《人民论坛》第37期的一篇文章中，他们称：“该报告是对中国人民的背叛，也是国际联盟的耻辱。这是一份将被铭记为国际外交史上最可耻的文件之一的文书。该报告彻底失败，表明国际联盟无力维护世界和平与正义。该报告是对和平与正义事业的打击，将成为国际联盟历史上黑暗的一页而被人们记住。”

有人说，中国国民党人反对该报告是因为他们害怕后果。但这并非事实。中国国民党人反对该报告，是因为他们认为该报告对中国不公正、不公平。他们认为该报告违反了国际法和正义的原则。他们认为该报告威胁到中国的主权和独立。他们认为该报告危及世界的和平与稳定。

苏联也批评了该报告。在苏联共产党官方机关报《真理报》的一篇文章中写道：“该报告反映了西方列强的帝国主义政策。它是企图分裂中国并削弱中国革命的一次尝试。该报告是帝国主义的工具，应被世界所有进步力量所拒绝。”

中国社会民主党人也表达了他们对报告的看法。在10月15日出版的《社会与教育》（中国社会民主党机关报）上，一篇题为《李顿报告书批判》的文章中，一位社会民主党作家以惯常的方式说道：“李顿报告书反映了世界上三种不同的冲突，即：帝国主义者之间的冲突；帝国主义与殖民地国家之间的冲突；以及苏联的资本主义与社会主义之间的冲突。”然而，在得出结论时，他仅表示：“简言之，李顿报告书的重要目的是实现对满洲的国际共管。”

在同一期《社会与教育》的另一篇题为《李顿报告书发表之后》的文章中，另一位社会民主党作家写道：“李顿报告书的核心在于三点：1. 中国满足于对满洲的名义主权；日本获得实际利益；而其他列强则利用局势……”

The chief conflicts no longer appear in the conclusion of either one of the two Social Democrat writers. As the latter writer says in his conclusion, "In short, the Manchurian issue implies a very severe war (war between imperialists--the ed.). During this crisis, how shall we do as the third party as is masters of Manchuria? Shall we repeat what Tan Chee-sun did in the 1914-17 war and just shout in a sitting position? We do not think, that the government rulers as they are interested only in striving for power and money, have ever thought of the danger!"

The whole sermon here of the Social Democrats have entirely covered up the extreme danger of imperialist attacks upon the Soviet Union and the Chinese Revolution. They have only given hint to the KMT Government to promote it to determine either to which of the imperialist powers, Japan or the United States, it will prefer to sell the whole Chinese nation during the coming war.

The shameless acts, as enumerated above, of the Chinese ruling classes together with their lackeys in accepting the League Report, in inducing imperialist partition of China, in suppressing the nation-wide anti-imperialist and Soviet movements and in initiating an attack upon the Soviet Union have vividly revealed before the broad masses. In sharp contrast to these disgraceful manners and wicked intrigues, there are now the heroic Communist Party and the Soviet Government who are leading the determined toiling fighters in their struggles against imperialism, against invasion of the Soviet Union, for the interests of the Chinese nation and for the final victory of the Soviet Revolution in this country. The declarations issued by the Party and the Soviet Government have been published by us in our latest number. Here we do not need to repeat them.

**************************

How Shanghai Workers Reply the Lytton Report.

Concerning the report of the League Commission of Enquiry, the editorial of "the True Words", organ of the Kiangsu C. P. Headquarters, on its Oct 7 issue have plainly pointed out, "The report evidently tells imperialist robbers that the development of the Chinese communist led Red armies and anti-imperialist movement have become so violent that the KMT, despite its willingness to be imperialist running dogs, is already hardly possible to buttress up its collapsing rule. The waves of the Chinese Revolution, assisted by the Soviet Union nearby, are about to sweep away all imperialist influences in China. Hence all imperialists should promptly form a united front to obtain international control of Manchuria and to put down the Soviet Union and the Chinese Revolution so that the imperialist blood-thirsty rule may be continued. In short, the report summons the robbers to quickly attack the Soviet Union and dismember China in alliance."

两位社会民主党作家的结论中均不再显现主要冲突。正如后一位作家在结论中所说：“简言之，满洲问题意味着一场非常严重的战争（即帝国主义者之间的战争——编者注）。在这场危机中，作为满洲主人的我们这第三方该如何行事？我们要重复谭熙春（音译）在1914-17年战争中的做法，只是坐在那里空喊口号吗？我们认为，那些只热衷于争权夺利的政府统治者从未考虑过这种危险！”

社会民主党人的这番长篇大论完全掩盖了帝国主义攻击苏联和中国革命的极端危险。他们只是暗示国民党政府，促使其决定在即将到来的战争中，更愿意将整个中华民族出卖给哪一个帝国主义强国，是日本还是美国。

上述中国统治阶级及其走狗接受国联报告、引诱帝国主义瓜分中国、镇压全国性的反帝和亲苏运动以及发动对苏联进攻的无耻行径，已生动地暴露在广大民众面前。与这些可耻的行径和邪恶的阴谋形成鲜明对比的是，英勇的共产党和苏维埃政府正领导着坚定的劳动战士进行斗争，反对帝国主义，反对入侵苏联，为了中华民族的利益，以及为了苏维埃革命在这个国家的最终胜利。党和苏维埃政府发表的宣言已在我们最新一期刊物上刊登。此处我们无需重复。

**************************

上海工人如何回应李顿报告书。

关于国联调查团的报告，江苏共产党总部机关报《真言》10月7日刊物的社论明确指出：“该报告显然告诉帝国主义强盗，由中国共产党领导的红军发展和反帝运动已变得如此猛烈，以至于国民党尽管愿意充当帝国主义的走狗，也已几乎无法支撑其摇摇欲坠的统治。在中国革命浪潮的推动下，加之 nearby 苏联的协助，即将扫除中国所有的帝国主义影响。因此，所有帝国主义者应迅速组成统一战线，以获得对满洲的国际控制，并镇压苏联和中国革命，从而使帝国主义的嗜血统治得以延续。简言之，该报告号召强盗们迅速结盟攻击苏联并瓜分中国。”

The Provincial Party organ in its editorial on Feb. 13 makes the following appeal to the toilers: : "We should immediately launch struggles against the report. Workers, fight for the maintenance of a general strike against Japanese imperialism; strike against removal of the S'hai Japanese mills and factories to Manchuria; strike against wage-cuts, dismissal, intensification of work, etc. The unemployed and famine sufferers, rise up and confiscate all foreign goods on your own initiative!..."

It is the East S'hai workers who first of all answered the call. A mass meeting of about 1,000 was held at the intersection of Ningpo Road and Thurborn Road at 7 o'clock in the evening of Oct. 10. Boycott squads were organized and it was decided to begin boycott inspection against Japanese goods right after the meeting. All the shops in the vicinity which sold Japanese goods were inspected and closed their doors immediately. Then the boycott inspection movement was strengthened by a demonstration. The procession marched along the road from Ningpo Road to Nanking Road. Along the way slogans such as "Against the Lytton report!", "Down with the K.M.T. which betrays the national interests!", "Against imperialist invasion of the Soviet Union!", "Against partition of China!", "Work or bread for the unemployed!", "Support the Manchurian Volunteers!", "All must join the 4th drive of the R.G.!", etc., were shouted.

At about 3 o'clock in the morning of Oct. 26, a group of the discharged workers of the Sin Ly Cotton Mill Co. distributed leaflets along Burleigh Road and before the gate of the Win Or Cotton Mill. The leaflets called upon the C.P.C. and of the Chinese Soviet Government against the Lytton Report. One was arrested by the imperialist police.

In the anti-Lytton-Report week, the East S'hai Section of the Anti-imperialist League has increased its membership from 700 to more than 2,000. The Association of Boycott of Japanese Goods of the East S'hai employees has increased from 300 members to more than 500. Now ex-workers of the San Yu Cotton Weaving Co., the Anti-Imperialist Association of Shanghai Cotton-mill Workers, Fong Co. workers, workers of the Shun Hsin No. 6 mill, tobacco workers of the British-American Tobacco Co. are planning to organize the East S'hai Federation against Japanese, Against Imperialism and for the Manchurian Volunteers. The East S'hai Anti-imperialist League has named Oct. 30 as the date for a conference of the young workers in the district in order to strengthen the struggle against the League report.

In West S'hai, over thirty workers of the Win Or No. 5 mill have on Oct. 17 formed their preparatory committee for the anti-report struggle before the anniversary of the October Revolution. Over 100 of the bus workers have formed their own club since the beginning of Oct. They have wall paper and have had two special issues on the anti-report struggles. The workers of the Win Yu cotton mill have recently circulated many leaflets and chalked many slogans on the street walls calling the public to fight the Lytton Report and to participate in the boycott movement.

该省党部机关报在2月13日的社论中向劳工发出如下呼吁：“我们应立即发起反对该报告的斗争。工人们，为维持反对日本帝国主义的大罢工而斗争；罢工反对将上海的日本纱厂和工厂迁往满洲；罢工反对减薪、解雇、强化劳动强度等。失业者和灾民们，奋起并主动没收所有洋货！……”

首先是上海东区的工人响应了这一号召。10月10日晚7时，约1000人在宁波路与提篮桥路（Thurborn Road，音译）交叉口举行群众大会。会上组织了抵制纠察队，并决定在会后立即开始对日货进行抵制检查。附近所有出售日货的商店均受到检查并立即关门。随后，通过一次示威游行加强了抵制检查运动。游行队伍沿道路从宁波路行进至南京路。沿途高呼“反对李顿报告！”、“打倒出卖民族利益的国民党！”、“反对帝国主义入侵苏联！”、“反对瓜分中国！”、“给失业者工作或面包！”、“支援满洲义勇军！”、“所有人都必须参加反帝大同盟第四次运动！”等口号。

10月26日凌晨3时许，一群新利棉纺公司（Sin Ly Cotton Mill Co.，音译）的被解雇工人在伯利路（Burleigh Road，音译）及温尔棉纺厂（Win Or Cotton Mill，音译）门前散发传单。传单号召拥护中国共产党及中华苏维埃政府，反对李顿报告。其中一人被帝国主义警察逮捕。

在“反李顿报告周”期间，上海东区反帝同盟的成员从700人增加到2000多人。上海东区职员抵制日货协会的成员从300人增加到500多人。目前，三友实业社（San Yu Cotton Weaving Co.）的前工人、上海纱厂工人反帝协会、丰公司（Fong Co.，音译）工人、顺信六厂（Shun Hsin No. 6 mill，音译）工人、英美烟草公司的烟草工人正计划组织上海东区反日、反帝及支援满洲义勇军联合会。上海东区反帝同盟已指定10月30日为该区青年工人会议日期，以加强反对李顿报告的斗争。

在上海西区，温尔五厂（Win Or No. 5 mill，音译）的三十多名工人于10月17日成立了十月革命周年纪念日前反报告斗争筹备委员会。自10月初以来，一百多名公交车司机组建了自己的俱乐部。他们张贴壁报，并已出版了两期关于反报告斗争的特刊。温裕棉纺厂（Win Yu cotton mill，音译）的工人最近散发了许多传单，并在街道墙壁上书写了许多标语，呼吁公众反对李顿报告并参与抵制运动。

south end of the Animal Park. About 100, part of them being
family members of revolutionary victims, participated in it. They
fastened a red banner on the fence of the Kuo Min Tang on which
is written "Down with the prison and demand the release of all revolu-
tionary fighters"(The demonstration was originally fixed to take place
before the main gate of the Nanking High Court.) From the vicinity
of the Tiger Hill, they marched forward and distributed many
leaflets calling for a revolution of the Red Army against the Nanking
Report. Slogans such as "Release all revolutionary fighters!", "A-
gainst the white terror!", "Fight against Chiang Kai-shek!", "Against
the puppet government", "Consolidate the defense posts for the revolutionary
fighters!", etc., were shouted. The demonstration lasted about one
hour. Half an hour later, the police arrived. A number of bicycl-
ists were arrested. The rest scattered and went back to their respec-
tive places.

****** ******* *****

However, on 10 ex-soldiers of the 19th Route Army to join the
Red Army in Fukien came to Shanghai.

7,000 of the soldiers of the 19th Route Army, in Fukien, re-
fused to fight the Red Army and stood against Chiang Kai-shek. About 3,000 of them
were sent to Shanghai by the Kuomintang. These men,
once the backbone of the Red Army during the First War at
Shanghai, have been much revolutionized. They have become conscious of
the necessity of joining the Red Army. The Kuomintang tried to send them to
Fukien again but they refused to go. Only
2,000 of them were sent to Fukien. Of
these, 1,000 joined the Red Army. The rest are still in
Shanghai waiting to be sent to West China.

They are now in Shanghai, but they want to join the
Red Army. They do not want to go to West China. Yet,
all this is kept secret by the Kuomintang.

They started from Shanghai on Oct. 13. They walked along
the Shanghai-Nanking Railway(It is about 300 li from Shang-
hai to Nanking). Very orderly, the group of revolutionary "soldiers", they arrived at Chinkiang, in the dis-
trict of Soochow, which is a junction of two railways. As there
many of the KMT garrisons and institutions at Soochow,
garrison commanders rushed there and surrounded them. As they were sur-
rounded, they did not know what to do. They were
captured, sent to Shanghai and handed over immediately to the Nanking
Military Authority. The military authority was in great
panic over the revolutionization, and the support for the Red Army of
the soldiers under their control. It is reported, there are still
1,000 ex-soldiers of the 19th Route Army remaining in Shanghai
and they will also be sent to Nanking in the immediate future.

场示威于10月11日中午举行。起点是动物园南端。约100人参加了示威，其中部分是革命受害者的家属。他们在国民党部的围栏上悬挂了一面红旗，上面写着“打倒监狱，要求释放所有革命战士”（示威原定于在南京高等法院正门前举行）。他们从老虎山（Tiger Hill，音译）附近出发前进，并分发了许多呼吁红军革命反对南京报告的传单。高呼“释放所有革命战士！”、“反对白色恐怖！”、“打倒蒋介石！”、“反对傀儡政府！”、“巩固革命战士的防御阵地！”等口号。示威持续了约一小时。半小时后，警察到达。数名骑自行车的人被捕。其余人四散并返回各自住处。

****** ******* *****

然而，10名原十九路军士兵前往上海加入福建的红军。

在福建，十九路军的7000名士兵拒绝与红军作战，并反对蒋介石。其中约3000人被国民党送往上海。这些人曾在第一次上海战争中作为红军的中坚力量，已经深受革命影响。他们意识到加入红军的必要性。国民党试图再次将他们派往福建，但他们拒绝前往。最终只有2000人被派往福建。其中，1000人加入了红军。其余人员仍留在上海，等待被派往华西地区。

他们现在身在上海，但希望加入红军。他们不愿去华西地区。然而，国民党对此严加保密。

他们于10月13日从上海出发。他们沿着沪宁铁路行进（从上海到南京约300里）。这支革命“士兵”队伍秩序井然，抵达了苏州地区的镇江，这是一个两条铁路的交汇点。由于苏州有许多国民党驻军和机构，驻军指挥官 rushed 那里并将他们包围。当被包围时，他们不知所措。他们被俘，被送往上海，并立即移交给南京军事当局。军事当局对其控制下的士兵的革命化及对红军的支持感到极度恐慌。据报道，仍有1000名原十九路军士兵留在上海，他们将在不久的将来也被送往南京。

还有另一组1700名原十九路军

**************************

Agricultural Crisis in China.
Grain good; Market askew;
Peasants embarrassed; Many bankrupt;
Not an uncommon report with Chinese newspapers. For
another rural loan to finance the anti-red campaign.

That the KMT had sent all Dike for to finance its anti-Red cam-
paign, at some instances, to maintain its opium traffic (like that
committed by Ho Chih-chien, Military Chief in Anhui) as the main cause,
which have led to unprecedented floods of country-wide in the last
year, the flood's destruction extends to 13 provinces including the
most important foodstuff producing land such as Kiangsu, Anhui, Hunan,
Anhui, Hupeh, etc. When a few days ago, they sent over 20 million
bank notes to Hankow, Hanyang, locally and soon afterwards broke
bank.

Owing to the favorable international conditions for agriculture, this
year, the autumn rice harvest is exceptionally rich. Consequently, there
has been a sudden drop of prices of foodstuffs to more than 50 per-
cent. It is hardly possible for the average peasant to meet the land
rent, taxes, cost of production, debts, etc. with so cheap foodstuff
in hand. While barns of food merchants and landlords are filled to ca-
pacity with grain awaiting better market, most of the peasants in the
country not more than two months since the harvest time, have already
become foodless.

To understand this "abnormal" situation, one has to know the cha-
racteristics of the Chinese village economy together with the form of
imperialist and the KMT rule over the nation!

Soon after the world crisis stretched into the domain of agri-
culture, imperialists, facilitated by the privileges they have enjoyed
in this country, have made China the dumping market for their surplus
grains. In 1931, foreign wheat imported to China was valued at $87,64
9,301., nearly three hundred times that imported in 1921 or 11,500
times that; in 1911. (The China Bank Monthly, Vol. 5, No. 1.) The im-
ported foreign rice in 1930 amounted to 19,690,000 piculs and was va-
lued at $121,234,193, occupying the third place among the import
trades of China. There was a slight drop of this type in 1931. Of
the present year, the records for the first six months have already
reached the marks of 13,000,000 piculs and $69,000,000 respectively.
Foreign grains are cheap and are free of miscellaneous taxations.
Hence most of the Chinese flour mills use foreign wheat. Even in the
remote rural districts in Shansi, American flour and wheat are no rare
goods. At Wuchin, the greatest rice market in China, Annamite and Bur-
ma rice have dominated almost all the rice mills this year. Under im-
perialist dumping, indeed, there has been little market left for China's
own food products.

**************************

中国的农业危机。
粮食丰收；市场扭曲；
农民困窘；许多人破产；
这在中国报纸上并非罕见的报道。为了另一笔农村贷款来资助反共战役。

国民党派遣所有堤防工程资金用于资助其反共战役，在某些情况下，甚至用于维持其鸦片贸易（如安徽军事首领何志谦（Ho Chih-chien，音译）所为），这是主要原因，导致去年全国范围内发生前所未有的洪水，洪灾波及包括江苏、安徽、湖南、安徽、湖北等最重要粮食产地的13个省份。几天前，他们向汉口、汉阳等地运送了超过2000万纸币，随后不久便发生银行倒闭。

由于有利的国际农业条件，今年秋稻收成格外丰富。因此，食品价格突然下跌超过50%。手持如此廉价食品的普通农民几乎不可能支付地租、税款、生产成本、债务等。虽然粮商和地主的仓库里堆满了等待更好行情的粮食，但该国大多数农民在收获后不到两个月就已经断粮。

要理解这种“异常”状况，必须了解中国乡村经济的特点以及帝国主义和国民党对国家的统治形式！

世界危机蔓延到农业领域后不久，帝国主义列强利用其在中国享有的特权，使中国成为其剩余粮食的倾销市场。1931年，进口到中国的外国小麦价值为87,649,301美元，几乎是1921年进口量的三百倍，或是1911年的11,500倍。（《中国银行月刊》第5卷第1期。）1930年进口的外国大米达到19,690,000担，价值121,234,193美元，占中国进口贸易的第三位。1931年此类进口略有下降。今年前六个月的记录已达到13,000,000担和69,000,000美元。外国粮食价格便宜且免杂税。因此，大多数中国面粉厂使用外国小麦。即使在山西偏远的农村地区，美国面粉和小麦也不是稀有商品。在中国最大的大米市场武进，今年安南米和缅甸米几乎占据了所有米行。在帝国主义的倾销下，中国本土食品确实几乎没有市场可言。

The average rent per mou of land is about 40-50 per cent of the total produce. In some places, it is even higher. In Shantung, for example, the rent is 60-70 per cent. In Honan, it is 50-60 per cent. In Kiangsu, it is 40-50 per cent. In Chekiang, it is 30-40 per cent. In Fukien, it is 30-40 per cent. The highest is in the Hopei district (Anhui) and Shansi (Shensi) where tenants have to offer 70-80 per cent of their total produce to the landlord. So through landlords over one half of the total agricultural products of the nation is turned commodity in the market.

The farming areas of the petty peasants are small. Yet the landlords claim more than one half of their products away. However, the self-sufficient and self-satisfied livelihood of the Chinese rural population has given way to the imperialist commodity economy. Under this situation, the petty and poor peasants, the majority of the Chinese peasantry, are firmly bound by exploitations by commercial capital and usurious loans. The lowest rate of interest is usually 30 percent. In Kansu, 80 percent is not rare. In Shansi, there even exists rate of interest as high as 300 percent. (The China Press, Oct. 1931) In the loan areas of Hopei, in Anhui, sometimes rate of interest is higher than 100 percent. In the petition of the Nanking Ministry of Civil Affairs to the Executive Yuan that appeared on the Nov. 28 issue of the Central Daily News, it is quite common for the peasants to borrow from local merchants and the amount of money they borrow from such sources are both short. The consequence is, of course, the action taken. The food borrowed is repaid in money. The rate of interest is 50 percent. Since grain price is always high in spring and low in autumn, the rate of interest, if expressed in the standard

No matter how low the grain market is, the peasants, though with hungry bellies, are forced to offer their products for prompt sale under various exploitative pressures.

In China, petty peasants form the majority of the rural population. The Yangtze and Si-king Valleys are dominated by tenant peasants. Land rents are usually payable with agricultural products. In the Szechow district, Sianyang, and the Hsinhs district, Shensi, tenants pay their rents in cash in accordance with the market price of the grain they produce. The rent rates vary in various districts. In South Kiangsu and North Chekiang, the rate is 40-50 percent of the total crop. In Fukien and Kwangtung, it is 30-40 percent. The highest is in the Hopei district (Anhui) and Shansi (Shensi) where tenants have to offer 70-80 percent of their total produce to the landlord. So through landlords over one half of the total agricultural products of the nation is turned commodity in the market.

每亩土地的平均租金约为总产量的40-50%。在一些地方甚至更高。例如，在山东，租金为60-70%。在河南，为50-60%。在江苏，为40-50%。在浙江，为30-40%。在福建，为30-40%。最高的是河北地区（安徽）和山西（陕西），佃农必须将总产量的70-80%交给地主。因此，通过地主，全国一半以上的农产品变成了市场上的商品。

小农的耕种面积很小。然而，地主拿走了他们一半以上的产品。但是，中国农村人口自给自足的生活已被帝国主义商品经济所取代。在这种情况下，占中国农民多数的小农和贫农被商业资本和高利贷牢牢束缚。最低利率通常为30%。在甘肃，80%并不罕见。在山西，甚至存在高达300%的利率。（《字林西报》，1931年10月）在河北、安徽的借贷地区，有时利率高于100%。在11月28日《中央日报》刊登的内政部致行政院的请愿书中提到，农民向当地商人借款是很常见的，且从这些来源借到的金额都很短缺。后果自然是采取某种行动。借入的是粮食，偿还的是货币。利率为50%。由于粮价总是春季高、秋季低，如果以标准

无论粮食市场多么低迷，农民尽管饥肠辘辘，在各种剥削压力下仍被迫立即出售其产品。

在中国，小农构成了农村人口的多数。长江和西江流域以佃农为主。地租通常以农产品支付。在四川地区、咸阳和陕西的新县地区，佃农根据其所产粮食的市场价格以现金支付租金。各地的租金率各不相同。在苏南和浙北，比率为总产量的40-50%。在福建和广东，为30-40%。最高的是河北地区（安徽）和山西（陕西），佃农必须将总产量的70-80%交给地主。因此，通过地主，全国一半以上的农产品变成了市场上的商品。

grain rent, is far much higher than 20 percent. Rice was sold $13
per picul in West Chekiang this spring. But now it is sold at little
more than $6 for the same unit. This means in East Chekiang, for eve-
ry picul of rice harvested in the spring a usurious repayment is 2 and
half piculs. Does not this give a rate of interest of 150 percent in
four bi-annually? While one half of the autumn harvest of the pea-
sants goes into the barns of landlords the other half is disposed at
the mercy of the plunder by usurers!

In addition to landlords, commercial capital and usurers, the KMT
is also listed as one of the powerful exploiters of the peasantry.
The editorial of the Ta Kung Pao of Oct. 12 says: "South Shensi has had
five good years yet. Rice is sold at 4 for 100!! ... Why throw aside the
rice prices so low for the peasants all sell their grain at bargain to
get money for the ever pressing tax... On the way to South
Shensi, one can find numerous peasant farmers. In one of the district
there the deserted farms amount to more than 100,000 mou.... It is not
rare to find the grain left in the fields without harvest!" The
Yellow River Valley has more owners' farms than the tenant ones of the
country. Though the landlord exploitation is comparatively less here,
the squeeze by the KMT is so intolerable—not enough to eat if even
if all the crop is sold out—but the peasants can but leave their land
and start their career as famine refugees!

Practically, under the endless squeeze of the KMT, landlords and
usurers, all crops of the peasants are immediately are brought to the
market for sale. The buying power of the peasants is exceedingly
low. There is the demand of bread-like grains. Furthermore, being
hampered by the unlimited taxes, militia and extortions, wide circulation
of home produced foodstuffs is impossible. All these combined accounts
for the incredible fall of price of rice from $15-16 per picul in Septem-
ber to the present rate of $6. The peasants make sales of their pro-
ducts at great losses. In West Chekiang, the loss to the owners' farms
is 70 percent. To the tenant farmers, it will be 80 or 90 percent this
month and next.

Soon as most of the grains are transported into their hands, the
landlords and merchants, began to monopolize the market. For over one
million dollars was flowing from Shanghai to Hankow to absorb the cheap
rice there. On the other hand under the pretext that "cheap grain is
harmful to peasants", the leading financial capitalists in Kiangsu as
represented by Tien, Yu-chien, manager of the Bank of China, Chen
Kuo-fu, chairman of the Wush Chamber of Commerce, Hsu Tsai-hsin,
representative of the Kiangsu Peasants' Bank and many Yen-tse, repre-
sentatives of the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce, have convened, beginning
from Oct. 7, a conference of the Kiangsu landlords at Wush to discuss
how to bring up the rice price. To say it correctly, they are endeavor-
ing now to sell to the toiling masses at higher price the rice they have
plundered from the peasants.

The same problem is also firmly caught by the KMT to intensify its
exploitation and suppression of the masses. A national food conference
was summoned beginning from Oct. 8 at Nanking by the KMT Ministry of
Finance. In the conference, it was proposed by Chen Ko-fu, the
Central Committee man and Minister of Finance, "to obtain credits

地租，远高于百分之二十。今年春季，浙西的米价为每石13元。但现在同样单位的米价仅略高于6元。这意味着在浙东，春季收获的每一石米，高利贷的偿还额是两石半。这难道不是在四个半年期内给出了150%的利率吗？当农民秋季收成的一半进入地主粮仓时，另一半则任由高利贷者掠夺摆布！

除了地主、商业资本和高利贷者之外，国民党也被列为对农民的有力剥削者之一。10月12日的《大公报》社论称：“陕西南部已有五个好年景。米价低至100元买4石！！……为何将米价压得如此之低，以致农民为了应付日益紧迫的税收，不得不廉价抛售粮食……在前往陕南的路上，可以看到无数农民。在该地区的一个县里，荒废的农田超过10万亩……田里有粮食未收割的情况并不罕见！”黄河流域的自耕农多于佃农。虽然这里的地主剥削相对较少，但国民党的压榨如此令人难以忍受——即使卖掉所有作物也不够糊口——农民只能离开土地，开始他们作为饥民的生涯！

实际上，在国民党、地主和高利贷者无休止的压榨下，农民的所有农作物都立即被投入市场出售。农民的购买力极低。对面食类谷物的需求存在。此外，由于受到无限度的税收、民团和勒索的阻碍，本地生产的食品无法广泛流通。所有这些因素共同导致了米价从9月份的每石15-16元惊人地跌至目前的6元。农民亏本出售其产品。在浙西，自耕农的损失为70%。对于佃农来说，本月和下月的损失将达到80%或90%。

一旦大部分粮食运到他们手中，地主和商人便开始垄断市场。超过一百万元的资金从上海流向汉口，以吸纳那里的廉价大米。另一方面，以“低价粮食有害于农民”为借口，江苏的主要金融资本家，如中国银行经理钱永铭（音译）、吴县商会主席陈果夫（音译）、江苏农民银行代表徐载新（音译）以及许多上海商会代表颜子（音译），从10月7日开始在吴县召开江苏地主会议，讨论如何提高米价。说得准确些，他们正努力将以掠夺手段从农民手中得到的大米，以更高的价格卖给劳苦大众。

国民党也紧紧抓住同样的问题，以加强对群众的剥削和镇压。国民党财政部于10月8日在南京召开全国粮食会议。会上，中央委员兼财政部长陈果夫（音译）提议，“从美国获得小麦贷款信贷，

Chinese Soviets and Red armies. In fact, the bond for another wheat
loan from American(450,000 tons of a value of G$1,200,000) was already
signed by Chiang Kai-shih and the Shanghai American Consul-General at
Nanking on Oct. 4. The first shipment as reported by Shunpon, Oct. 5,
will reach China in the coming November.

The further fall in price of grain is in sight. This in turn will
further intensify the sufferings of the peasantry. Imperialists and
the KMT have the common interests to exploit the toiling masses and
to attack the Chinese Soviets and Red armies. The world toilers!
fight against American Wheat Loan! Down with the KMT.! Down with
imperialism!

**************************

Mass Strike of Silk Filature Workers in Wusih.

Under the pretext of business depression the national capitalists
of the silk industry have; in recent years, employed every possible
means to intensify the exploitation of their workers. The highest
wage of silk filature workers in Shanghai has been reduced from 60
cents(Shores) per day to 40 cents, and their daily and monthly bonus
have been cancelled. The silk filature workers in Wusih, center of
silk industry of Kiangsu and one of the big towns on the Shanghai-Nan-
king Railway, have also been victimized by wage cut, bonus cancella-
tion and other means of exploitation. (In silk industry female workers
occupy ninety per cent of the whole working population.)

The attack of the capital resulted the growth of workers' counter
attack. The strike of 9,000 silk filature workers in Shanghai had
just been settled; there followed the outbreak of the mass strike of
20,000 silk filature workers in Wusih on Oct. 8.

At 1 P.M. of Oct. 8, the workers of Chien Sen, Silk Filature be-
gan to leave the factory and declared strike and they were immediately
joined by workers of nine other filatures in the east and north dis-
tricts, at 4 o'clock in the same afternoon. On the following day, 15
filatures in the south district also participated. Those 20,000 strik-
ing workers were joined by more than 2,000 clerks who are employed in
the silk plants.

The cause of the strike is against the violation of the labour-
capital agreement. According to the agreement, the highest daily pay
is 37 cents; there is a bonus of three days' wages for the uninterrupted
service during the month; the working hours are 11 without one
hour off at noon for lunch.

Since the introduction of the standard wage system this spring,
maximum wage one can get falls to 30 cents a day. Moreover, the bonus
is cancelled, the working day is prolonged to 14 hours and the lunch
hour is reduced to thirty minutes.

粮价的进一步下跌指日可待。这将反过来加剧农民的苦难。帝国主义者和国民党在剥削劳苦大众和攻击中国苏维埃及红军方面有着共同的利益。全世界的劳动者们！反对美国小麦贷款！打倒国民党！打倒帝国主义！

**************************

无锡缫丝工人大罢工。

近年来，丝绸业的民族资本家以商业萧条为借口，采取各种可能的手段加强对工人的剥削。上海缫丝工人的最高工资已从每天60角（Shores，原文如此）降至40角，其日和月度奖金已被取消。作为江苏丝绸业中心且位于沪宁铁路沿线大镇之一的无锡缫丝工人，也遭受了减薪、取消奖金及其他剥削手段的侵害。（在丝绸业中，女工占整个劳动人口的百分之九十。）

资本家的进攻导致了工人反击的增长。上海9,000名缫丝工人的罢工刚刚平息；紧接着，10月8日，无锡20,000名缫丝工人的大规模罢工爆发。

10月8日下午1点，乾森（音译）缫丝厂的工人开始离开工厂并宣布罢工，同日下午4点，东部和北部地区的其他九家缫丝厂的工人立即加入。次日，南部地区的15家缫丝厂也参与其中。这20,000名罢工工人得到了受雇于丝绸厂的2,000多名职员的加入。

罢工的原因是违反劳资协议。根据协议，最高日薪为37分；连续服务一个月有三天工资的奖金；工作时间为11小时，中午有一小时午餐休息时间。

自从今年春季引入标准工资制度以来，能获得的最高工资降至每天30分。此外，奖金被取消，工作日延长至14小时，午餐时间缩短至三十分钟。

11.
The demand of the striking women workers in the main is the resto-
ration of the old wage system of the old treatments.

The KMT police immediately sent out armed force to protect the
mills. The Yellow Trade Unionists also called a meeting to discuss how
to bring the workers back to work. Their meeting in the afternoon of
Oct. 9 decided upon: 1. Willing to resume work provided the capitalists
show considerable concession; 2. Send delegates to deliver petition to
the district government; 3. Require the strikers to keep good order.

On Oct. 10, the district government called a meeting of the repre-
sentatives of workers and capitalists. The magistrate proposed that
work be first resumed, then the discussion of the demands. This was re-
fused by the workers' body because they knew that the KMT intent to
break up their struggling front.

Then in the evening of Oct. 10, some of the KMT officials includ-
ing deputies of the Provincial Bureau of Industry and the Provincial
KMT Headquarters arrived at Wushih to mediate the struggle.

The capitalists thought the high officials' presence would hasten
the strike would certainly come to an end. So they fixed Oct. 11 for
the resumption of work. But the majority of the strikers did not do so. Three mills were wrecked by the strik-
ers and all those who were induced to go back to work again walked out.
A proclamation was issued by the KMT officials and the workers were
again called to go back on the 12th. At the same time the capitalists
bowed to the workers and brought out the following conditions for the
resumption of work: 1. Working hours be reduced to 13 or after the 12th;
2. Two days' wages as bonus beginning from September; The highest daily
be at 42 cents.

In the morning of the 12th except those in the south district only
very small portion in the east and north returned to work. The major-
ity still insisted upon complete victory as condition for going back.
Pickets of the workers were all out preparing to fight the Yellow be-
trayers who should induce the strikers to go to the mills. Clashes oc-
curred, four mills in the east and north districts were wrecked. At 9
o'clock the pickets rushed to the west district where they succeeded
in bringing back to the striking front those workers who were induced
back to work. One of the mills by the name of Chin Hso refused their
admission and the mill was besieged by the pickets with all the doors
and window panes smashed. Immediately the KMT police came and state
of emergency was announced. The pickets were dispersed by batons and
all roads to the south district were cut. Hence the pickets could not
enter this district and the 11 mills in it completely resumed work.

More officials were sent by the Kiangsu Provincial Government to
Wushih to settle the strike. Once more the KMT men and unionists deter-
mined to bring about resumption of work first and then to leave the dis-
pute to the arbitration parties on the 15th. The Yellow leaders following
the decision went out to start individual deceitful talks among the wor-
kers. In the morning of the 13th, every mill sounded its whistle but
none of the workers appeared in the mills. The workers on the contrary
went in groups to the south district to try to ask their sisters to re-

11.
罢工女工的主要要求是恢复旧的工资制度和旧待遇。

国民党警察立即派出武装力量保护工厂。黄色工会分子也召开会议，讨论如何让工人复工。他们在10月9日下午的会议决定：1. 如果资本家做出相当让步，愿意复工；2. 派代表向区政府递交请愿书；3. 要求罢工者保持良好秩序。

10月10日，区政府召开了工人和资本家代表的会议。县长提议先复工，再讨论诉求。这被工人团体拒绝，因为他们知道国民党意图破坏他们的斗争阵线。

随后在10月10日晚，包括省建设厅副厅长和省国民党党部代表在内的一些国民党官员抵达无锡调解斗争。

资本家认为高官的到来会加速罢工的结束。因此他们定下10月11日为复工日。但大多数罢工者并未这样做。三家工厂被罢工者捣毁，所有被诱骗回去工作的人再次出走。国民党官员发布公告，再次号召工人在12日回去。同时，资本家向工人低头，提出了以下复工条件：1. 工作时间在12日后减少至13小时；2. 从9月开始发放两天工资的奖金；最高日薪为42分。

12日上午，除了南部地区外，东部和北部只有极少部分人复工。大多数人仍坚持以完全胜利作为回去的条件。工人纠察队全部出动，准备打击那些诱骗罢工者去工厂的黄色叛徒。发生了冲突，东部和北部地区的四家工厂被捣毁。9点钟，纠察队冲向西部地区，成功将被诱骗回去工作的工人带回到罢工阵线。一家名为金浩（音译）的工厂拒绝他们进入，纠察队包围了该厂，砸碎了所有门窗玻璃。国民党警察随即赶到，宣布进入紧急状态。纠察队被警棍驱散，通往南部地区的所有道路被切断。因此纠察队无法进入该地区，其中的11家工厂完全复工。

江苏省政府派遣更多官员前往无锡解决罢工。国民党人员和工会分子再次决定先促成复工，然后将争议留给15日的仲裁方处理。黄色领袖们按照决定出去，在工人中进行个别欺骗性谈话。13日上午，每家工厂都拉响了汽笛，但没有工人出现在工厂里。相反，工人们成群结队地去南部地区，试图请求他们的姐妹回

turn to the striking front. In the way a big clash occurred. The wor-
kers fought with stones and woods etc. She called police, who stop-
ped to enter the south district. The workers who participated in the
fight amounted to three to four thousand. The KMT police were outnum-
bered and they resorted to shooting of rifles. Half an hour passed,
15 workers were injured, six arrested. 2% of the policemen were also
injured. The news about the fight soon reached the ears of the north
district at work. All in a rush they again walked out.

The consolidation of the workers has repeatedly the reactions and
suppressions of the KMT and the capitalists. The local force of the
KMT was overpowered. This necessitates the KMT to dispatch more armed
force to Wushih. In the evening of the 14th, the Jiangsu Provincial
Minister of Industry, the KMT Party Standing members of the Provincial
Headquarters together with the Commissioner of the Provincial Peace Pre-
servation Headquarters came personally to Wushih with one battalion of
armed force, to put down the struggle of the working mass. At the same
time the KMT Gendarmerie also telegraphed the town that "anyone who continues to march on strike be shot immediately".

The KMT high officials and generals ordered the workers to return
to work on block on the 17th; and declared that those who refuse to
accept the order would be dealt with according to law. The arbitra-
tion panel on the 16th then announced the conditions for the resump-
tion of work. The two conditions concerning the working hours and
bonus were the same as promised by the capitalists on the 13th. The
wage is increased to 47 cents a day.

In the morning of the 17th, in the presence of the KMT high offi-
cials and generals, the workers were forced to go back to the mills.

At the point of rifles and pistols, the 20,000 Wushih silk workers
resumed work for the time being. This struggle is a great experience
to them. It is certain, they are now more determined and more strongly
consolidated for the fight to overthrow the Kuomintang regime.

工人的团结多次引起国民党和资本家的反应和镇压。当地国民党力量被压倒。这使得国民党不得不向无锡派遣更多武装力量。14日晚，江苏省建设厅厅长、省党部常务委员以及省保安司令部专员亲自率领一营武装力量来到无锡，镇压劳工大众的斗争。同时，国民党宪兵队也向该镇发电报称，“任何继续罢工游行的人立即枪决”。

国民党高官和将军命令工人在17日集体复工；并声明那些拒绝接受命令的人将依法处置。仲裁小组于16日随后宣布了复工条件。关于工作时间和奖金的两个条件与资本家在13日承诺的相同。工资增加到每天47分。

17日上午，在国民党高官和将军在场的情况下，工人被迫回到工厂。

在步枪和手枪的威胁下，20,000名无锡丝绸工人暂时复工。这场斗争对他们来说是一次伟大的经验。可以肯定的是，他们现在更加坚定，更加紧密地团结起来，为推翻国民党政权而战。

Enraged Peasants Attack Twice The Yangchow Walled City.
"Against increase of land tax!"; "Release the arrested!"
Over 10,000 armed in tools vis-a-vis with the KMT army and police;
the Magistrate's offices smashed; the KMT flag and the late
Dr. Sun Yet-sen's portrait torn; land tax bills and title
deeds burned; seven killed, ten-odd injured.

To fight against the promulgated decision to increase the burden
of land tax and to demand the immediate release of the 50 peasants who
were the prisoners just because they are unable to bear the KMT ex-
ploitation, thousands of the peasants in the District of Yangchow,
north of the Yangtze River in Kiangsu, gathered on Oct. 24, demonstra-
ted in the walled city and smashed the Magistrate's office. 200 were
arrested. The demonstration was renewed on the 26th when over 10,000
peasants made another attempt to invade the walled-city. A clash be-
tween the masses and the KMT force occurred resulting in ten-odd ca-
sualties of the former.

The strong opposition on the part of the peasants has hindered
the practice of the KMT's new land tax regulations in Yangchow. The
ever pressing financial crisis, however, forces the KMT to eventual-
ly put the new regulations into enforcement regardless of the resis-
tance. The 2nd Section of the Yangchow District is the first to suf-
fer. According to the new regulations, a great many of the peasants
in the Section are debtors of the Government. On Oct. 21, fifty of
them were arrested and sent to the District Prison in the walled city
being found unable to clear themselves of the new burden.

The event stirred the local peasants to anger. By request of the
thousands from all directions were gathered and a demonstration was
decided upon to demand the immediate release of the arrested. Early
in the morning of the following day, Oct. 25, while the hearing of the
arrested was taking place in the office of the Magistrate, alarm came
to the effect that thousands of the peasants from all directions were
approaching the walled city. The district police hurriedly closed the
city gates and the merchants, their shops. At about 1 o'clock in the
afternoon, the peasants armed in agricultural tools who besieged the
walls forced their way into the city by means of big woods. The dis-
trict policemen being outnumbered were overpowered and the masses mar-
ched directly to the District Government Building. They successfully
captured back their comrades in custody and, to show their wrath with
the KMT Government, smashed the District Government Hall with the KMT
flag, portrait of the late Dr. Sun Yet-sen torn and countless land-tax
bills and title deeds burned. The residence of the Magistrate was
also destroyed.

愤怒的农民两次攻打扬州城墙。
“反对增加田赋！”；“释放被捕者！”
逾万名手持农具的农民与国民党军队及警察对峙；
县公署被捣毁；国民党旗帜及已故孙逸仙博士遗像被撕毁；田赋单据及地契被焚毁；七人死亡，十余人受伤。

为对抗颁布的增加田赋负担的决定，并要求立即释放那50名仅因无力承受国民党剥削而被捕的农民，江苏长江以北扬州地区的数千名农民于10月24日聚集，在城内举行示威并捣毁了县公署。200人被捕。26日示威再次爆发，当时逾万名农民再次试图攻入城墙围护的城市。群众与国民党部队发生冲突，导致前者十余人伤亡。

农民的强烈反对阻碍了国民党在扬州实施新的田赋条例。然而，日益紧迫的财政危机迫使国民党不顾抵抗，最终强制执行新条例。扬州第二区首当其冲。根据新条例，该区许多农民成为政府的债务人。10月21日，其中五十人因被发现无力摆脱新负担而被捕，并被送往城内的区监狱。

此事激怒了当地农民。应数千人请求，来自各方的农民聚集起来，决定举行示威，要求立即释放被捕者。次日（10月25日）清晨，当被捕者在县公署受审时，传来警报称来自各方的数千名农民正逼近城墙。区警察匆忙关闭城门，商人也关闭了店铺。下午约1时许，手持农具围攻城墙的农民利用大木头强行进城。区警察因寡不敌众而被制服，群众径直冲向区政府大楼。他们成功夺回被拘留的同志，并为表达对国民党政府的愤怒，捣毁了区政府大厅，国民党旗帜和已故孙逸仙博士的遗像被撕毁，无数田赋单据和地契被焚毁。县长的住所也被摧毁。

The Magistrate secretly fled and sent for reinforcement from the Independent Regiment stationed on the outskirts of the city. Led by horsemen, the KMT troops soon formed a cordon around the demonstrators and arrested 200 odd women and 70 odd men.

The news about the mass arrests further roused the peasants all over the district of Yangchow. In the morning of Oct. 23, peasants more than 10,000 in number made a second attack upon the walled city declaring their fight to be again for the release of the arrested. The KMT force in defense of the city was the Independent Regiment whose sentinels in full arms were scattered at all important points on the walls.

The bridges to the city gates were destroyed, and the peasants made their own pontoons. Seeing that the city was in immediate danger of falling, a company commander led his company out of the city and attempted to stop the work of the peasants at the vicinity of bayonets. The latter resisted and a clash occurred. A sergeant was injured and several soldiers were disarmed. During the confusion, the KMT sentinels on the walls fired, killing seven and among three seriously injured and ten-odd slightly injured. Most of the killed were women and youngsters including a girl of 16 years of age who was to marry the next day.

On the same day, in three sections the peasants had also separately smashed the houses of the section headmen. The residence of the chairman of the Yangchow Chamber of Commerce situated in the suburbs was also burned by the peasants.

The intensification of the peasants' struggles frightened the KMT a great deal. A little deception became necessary. In the afternoon of Oct. 23, the Magistrate came personally to the peasants who besieged the city and told them that the government would withdraw the new land-tax regulations and that the arrested would be released. Meanwhile, the local KMT men together with the officers of the so called Peasants Association, organ of landlords, went to the various sections and villages to make deceitful propaganda telling the peasants not to resort to disturbances but to send representatives to see the Magistrate if there is really anything contrary to their interests.

The Provincial Government of Kiangsu was alarmed and two high officials, namely, Han Toh-chin, member of the Provincial Council and the other, Li Min-yung, chief of the Provincial Peace Preservation Corps, were appointed to be investigators of the "trouble". They arrived at Yangchow on the 25th.

25 leaders of the peasants were still kept under custody. The peasants do not believe that any appeal to the KMT will bring them any fruit in return. They continued to make demonstration. On the 24th, on the eastern outskirts there still gathered three thousand peasants. On the 25th, about one thousand peasants from the north and east villages renewed their attack upon the city walls. Machine guns of the KMT force were on the strategic points and sandbag barricade behind the city gates. The whole city was in extreme panic. On the

2.
县长秘密逃跑，并向驻扎在城郊的独立团求援。在骑兵的带领下，国民党部队很快在示威者周围形成包围圈，逮捕了200多名妇女和70多名男子。

大规模逮捕的消息进一步激起了扬州全区农民的愤怒。10月23日上午，一万多名农民第二次攻打城墙围护的城市，宣称他们的战斗再次是为了释放被捕者。防守城市的国民党部队是独立团，其全副武装的哨兵散布在城墙的所有重要据点。

通往城门的桥梁被破坏，农民们自制了浮桥。见城市面临即刻陷落的危险，一名连长率领全连出城，试图在刺刀附近阻止农民的作业。后者进行抵抗，发生了冲突。一名中士受伤，几名士兵被缴械。混乱中，城墙上的国民党哨兵开枪，造成七人死亡，三人重伤，十余人轻伤。死者多为妇女和青少年，其中包括一名定于次日结婚的16岁少女。

同日，在三个区，农民还分别捣毁了区头目的房屋。位于郊区的扬州商会主席的住所也被农民焚毁。

农民斗争的加剧使国民党大为惊恐。一点欺骗手段变得必要。10月23日下午，县长亲自来到围城的农民面前，告诉他们政府将撤回新的田赋条例，并将释放被捕者。与此同时，当地的国民党分子与所谓农民协会（地主阶级的机构）的官员一起，前往各个区和村庄进行欺骗性宣传，告诉农民不要诉诸骚乱，如果确实有违背他们利益的事情，应派代表去见县长。

江苏省政府感到震惊，任命两名高官，即省议会成员韩德勤（Han Toh-chin，音译）和省保安总队队长李民庸（Li Min-yung，音译），作为此次“骚乱”的调查员。他们于25日抵达扬州。

25名农民领袖仍被拘留。农民不相信向国民党上诉会带来任何成果。他们继续举行示威。24日，东郊仍有三千名农民聚集。25日，来自北部和东部村庄的约一千名农民再次攻打城墙。国民党部队的机枪部署在战略要点，城门后方设有沙袋路障。全城陷入极度恐慌。在

pages.en:
3.
With, the peasants burned another two houses of the landlords there, there were mass meetings of thousands of people. The situation became more and more critical. The Central Headquarters, Nanking, the Ministry of War, and the Kiangsu Provincial Government of the KMT all sent out espionage to watch at the movements of the rural people.

Yangchow is located at the point where the Grand Canal joins the Yangtse River. The latter river also connects the city with Nanking, the capital of the Kiangsu Province. Since the civil war, the Kuomintang's exploitation of the Yangchow peasants has been on the increase. The present land-tax is nearly double that in 1926 when the province was still under the rule of Sun Chuan-fang. Besides the provincial and the district land-tax in Yangchow contains 15 sub-taxes including The Party Contribution, The Autonomy Contribution, The Village Contribution, Public Safety Contribution, The High-way Contribution, The Defense Contribution, the Party Affairs Contribution, the Educational Contribution, etc. This year, two other sub-taxes, are added, the Military Grain Contribution and the Food Preservation Contribution, each tax amounts for each Mow. In short, each Mow of the Yangchow fields has to bear a total tax of one dollar Mex. It is about 450/c of the income one mow of land can produce.

Embezzlement marks the land-tax gathering system of the Kuomintang throughout the country. It is particularly corrupt with the Yangchow District Government. The tax-gatherers used not to tear bills to the peasants when their duties are paid. Hence, the revenue book of the Yangchow District Government shows a balance of more than $300,000 due to tax in arrears(!). While the individual officials' purses have swollen, the Kuomintang Government wants the peasants to be responsible to make up the loss. This is the so called new land regulations.

It is an undisputable fact the the Kuomintang Government is now in extreme financial stringency. The Province of Kiangsu is now in debts of more than Mex.$ 20,000,000. The budget of the current fiscal year shows a deficiency of Mex.$6,555,000 which is one third of the total annual expenditures. To buttress its tottering rule and to finance the anti-Red campaigns, one of the measures now pursued by the KMT is to intensify exploitation of the peasantry. Under the brutal predatory Kuomintang, indeed, the living conditions of the Chinese peasant masses are passing from bad to worse.

From struggles against the Kuomintang tax, the Yangchow peasants have proceeded to the direct clash with the Kuomintang Government. Despite all suppressions and the deceptions of landlords and the Kulaks confronting them. The fight is noticeable in that it is organized, systematic and involves thousands of masses scattered all over the Yangchow district.

**************************

Further Development of the Peasant Uprisings in Yangchow.

3.
随着农民在那里又烧毁了两座地主房屋，举行了数千人的群众大会。局势变得越来越危急。南京中央总部、国民党军政部以及江苏省政府都派出间谍监视农村民众的动向。

扬州位于大运河与长江交汇处。后者也将该城市与江苏省会南京连接起来。自内战以来，国民党对扬州农民的剥削日益增加。目前的田赋几乎是1926年的两倍，当时该省仍处于孙传芳统治之下。除了省级和区级田赋外，扬州的田赋还包含15种附加税，包括党捐、自治捐、村捐、公安捐、公路捐、防务捐、党务捐、教育捐等。今年，又增加了两种附加税，即军粮捐和粮食保管捐，每种税额按每亩计算。简而言之，扬州每亩田地需承担总计一元银元的税负。这约占一亩土地产出的45%。

贪污腐败标志着国民党在全国范围内的田赋征收体系。扬州区政府尤其腐败。收税员在农民缴纳税款时通常不撕毁单据。因此，扬州区政府的税收账簿显示有超过30万美元的欠税余额（！）。虽然个别官员的腰包鼓了起来，但国民党政府却要求农民负责弥补这一损失。这就是所谓的新田赋条例。

国民党政府目前处于极度财政紧缩状态，这是一个不争的事实。江苏省现在的债务超过2,000万银元。本财政年度的预算显示赤字为655.5万银元，占年度总支出的三分之一。为了支撑其摇摇欲坠的统治并为反红运动提供资金，国民党目前采取的措施之一是加强对农民的剥削。在国民党残酷的掠夺下，中国广大农民的生活状况确实在每况愈下。

从反对国民党税收的斗争中，扬州农民已发展到与国民党政府直接冲突。尽管面临所有镇压以及地主和富农的欺骗。这场斗争引人注目之处在于它是有组织的、系统性的，并且涉及分散在扬州全区各地的数千名群众。

**************************

扬州农民起义的进一步发展。

5.
locally supported by the Chinese masses. Every person here in the
Soviet district considers it a great honor to be a Red fighter and
has the greatest pleasure whenever he or she has the chance to tender
consolation to the Red troops.

On Oct. 10, on the outskirts of Juichin, the Chinese Red capital,
a huge mass meeting was held at which masses together with 300
representatives from the Communist Party and the Soviet Government
to see the Women's Volunteers and the August First Regiment off for the
front to join the Red Army. The mobilization operations extended
over one Li (about one third of a mile) long. There were among the
programmes, several speeches which the masses enjoyed. The fighters
were very much excited. This is the first time the Shuikou mass-
es gathered to see their new red plants off. During the last month
more than 1,600 have left here for the front, 1,000 strong being ex-
fighters who had already recovered from wounds or sickness and
the rest, as volunteers who volunteered to enlist to fight in the Red
Army. Indeed, in the struggle to smash the Fourth Drive of the ene-
mies, the movement for the expansion of the Red Army, under the sys-
tematic leadership of the Communist Party and the Soviet Government,
has made rapid headway.

Adequate political mobilization on the part of the Party and the
Government, as well as the interests of the masses in the revolutionary
competition among sections and villages, have made the Move-to-Front Week,
Sept. 25-30, of Juichin for the expansion of the Red army a success.
The new red fighters enlisted amount to over 1,600. This number has
surpassed the original plan by 30% and broken the total record of
Summer for July and August. The constituents are: 355 party members;
476 Young Communists; 538 workers, farm hands and coolies; 391 young
men.

Among the 355 Communists and Young Communists, 97% answered
the call of their own initiative. Only 3% were conscript by decisions
of the party and league locals.

"Join the Red Army!" is almost the demand of every inhabitant!
The talking women especially showed great enthusiasm in getting oth-
er inhabitants to be red soldiers. They make shoes and cloth garments
for them and in many cases they accompanied them to the government of-
fices to complete the enlistment procedure. Many of the talking women
shed tears simply because they could not have the chance to fight on
the front as soldiers of the Red Army. Extremely tense air marked the
communication between sections and villages. The erroneous ideas of
coercion and deception have been generally corrected.

During the week, separate social meetings to entertain the family
members of the Red Army were held in the various villages. In order
the work to aid the Red fighters' families is comparatively universal
and definite. Every party member and Young Communist is actually
working Saturdays for the Red fighters' families. These families have
the first privilege to buy their needs on credit at low prices and to
borrow loans at low rate of interest from the co-operatives. In many
places, the masses even first do the farming work for the Red fighters'
families and then their own.
pages.zh:
5.
在当地得到中国民众的支持。苏区这里的每个人都认为成为一名红色战士是莫大的荣誉，每当有机会向红军部队表示慰问时，都感到极大的喜悦。

10月10日，在中国红色首都瑞金郊区，举行了一次盛大的群众大会，广大群众与来自共产党和苏维埃政府的300名代表一起，为女子志愿队和八一团送行，他们即将前往前线加入红军。动员队伍绵延一里（约三分之一英里）长。议程中包括几场深受群众欢迎的演讲。战士们情绪非常高涨。这是水口群众第一次聚集起来为他们的新红色战士送行。在上个月，已有超过1,600人从这里前往前线，其中1,000人是已从伤病中康复的前战士，其余则是自愿报名参军、在红军中作战的志愿者。的确，在粉碎敌人第四次“围剿”的斗争中，在共产党和苏维埃政府的系统领导下，扩大红军的运动取得了迅速进展。

党和政府进行了充分的政治动员，加上各区和各村在革命竞赛中群众的积极性，使得瑞金9月25日至30日的“上前线周”扩大红军的运动取得了成功。新招募的红色战士超过1,600人。这一数字超过了原计划30%，并打破了7月和8月夏季的总纪录。人员构成如下：党员355名；共青团员476名；工人、农工和苦力538名；青年391名。

在355名共产党员和共青团员中，97%是主动响应号召。只有3%是根据党和团的地方组织决定被征召的。

“参加红军！”几乎是每个居民的要求！妇女们尤其表现出极大的热情，动员其他居民成为红色战士。她们为战士们制作鞋子和布衣，在许多情况下，还陪同他们前往政府办公室办理入伍手续。许多妇女流泪，仅仅是因为她们没有机会作为红军战士在前线作战。各区与各村之间的联络气氛极为紧张。强迫和欺骗的错误观念已得到普遍纠正。

在这一周期间，各个村庄分别举行了社交聚会，款待红军家属。援助红色战士家属的工作比较普遍且明确。每位党员和共青团员实际上都在星期六为红军战士家属工作。这些家属享有在合作社以低价赊购所需物品以及以低息贷款的特权。在许多地方，群众甚至先为红军战士家属做农活，然后再做自己的农活。
