6.
The over one thousand Hsinkuo new fighters have been organized
into 13 companies and, amidst the thunders of applause of the masses
who came to see them off, started to the front on Oct. 4.

This movement has spread its influence to the Model Young Vo-
lunteers now concentrated at Hsinkuo awaiting further instruction of
mobilization. Over 70% of them have handed in their names to demand
to enlist in the Red army.

The movement is ever enlarging under the slogan, "Enlist in the
Kiangsi Red Army before November!". It is planned to cover the ten
districts of the Kiangsi Soviet.

Deeply stimulated by the Red victories, the soldiery of the Kuomintang
army has been ever revolutionized. Recently a group of 200 soldiers
of the 19th Route Army revolted at Shihcheng, in the district of Jun-
yen, in Fukien. The 19th Route army soldiery were the heroic Chinese
fighters of the late anti-Japanese war at Shanghai. The soldiers have
had already a series of struggles against the imperialist-Kuomintang
order to send them to suppress the Chinese Reds. The mentioned revolt
was partially suppressed by the 19th Route army officers while another
part successfully made their escape with their arms into the Soviet
district. It is reported the Tinchow masses are preparing to call a
welcome meeting to entertain them.

The Central Government of Soviet China has decided to widespread
daily through its radio sending station the news about the activities
of the Soviets and Red armies in the Central Soviet district. All
revolutionary masses in the White districts and all other Soviet ter-
ritories who possess receiving sets are called to pay attention to the
programs.

*********************

Militarist Wars Gradually Assume Country-wide Scale.
The 47th provincial militarist war in Szechuan.
Kweichow, Yunnan, Kansu, about to be involved.

The militarist war in Shangtung between Han Fu-chu, Provincial
Chairman, and Liu Chen-lien, commander of the KMT troops in the Kia-
chow-Cheefoo district, is pending settlement while militarists in Sz-
chuan also follow suit. The present Szechuan war is the 47th one in
the history of the province since the 1911 Revolution and involves the
whole 300,000 troops of the province.

The war outbreak on Oct. 2. The two fighting parties are: Liu
Wen-hui, Chairman of the Provincial Council, and Liu Hsiang, Commander
for the Military Rehabilitation of Szechuen, and others. Under the KMT
militarists, Szechuen has long been sliced into big and small garrison
territories. The various Szechuen armies, their strength and garrison
territories are shown by the following table.

一千多名兴国新战士已被编成13个连，在前来送行的群众的雷鸣般掌声中，于10月4日前往前线。

这一运动的影响已波及目前集中在兴国等待进一步动员指示的模范青年志愿队。其中超过70%的人已报名要求参加红军。

在“十一月前参加江西红军！”的口号下，这一运动不断扩大。计划覆盖江西苏区的十个区。

受到红军胜利的深刻鼓舞，国民党军队的士兵日益革命化。最近，福建军岩区石城的一群第十九路军200名士兵发动兵变。第十九路军士兵是此前上海抗日战争中的英勇中国战士。这些士兵已经进行了一系列斗争，反对帝国主义-国民党命令他们去镇压中国红军的指令。上述兵变部分被第十九路军军官镇压，另一部分则成功地携带武器逃入苏区。据报道，汀州群众正准备召开欢迎大会招待他们。

中华苏维埃中央政府已决定通过其广播电台每天广泛播发关于中央苏区苏维埃和红军活动的新闻。呼吁白区和其他苏维埃地区所有拥有接收机的革命群众注意收听节目。

*********************

军阀战争逐渐呈现全国规模。
四川第47次省级军阀战争。
贵州、云南、甘肃即将卷入。

山东省主席韩复榘与胶济地区国民党部队指挥官刘珍年之间的山东军阀战争尚待解决，而四川军阀也紧随其后。目前的四川战争是自1911年革命以来该省历史上的第47次战争，涉及全省30万军队。

战争于10月2日爆发。交战双方为：省务委员会主席刘文辉、四川军事善后督办刘湘等人。在国民党军阀统治下，四川长期被分割为大小不一的防区。各四川军队的兵力及防区如下表所示。

On Oct. 7, a regiment of the 24th army garrisoning Lushan came
to blows with a brigade of the 23rd Division who defended Winer. The
latter joined by the 20th A. and the New 5th D. launched an attack on
the 24, resulting in casualties of more than one thousand to both sides.
On the 10th a circular telegram denouncing Liu Wen-hui, commander of
the 24th A, was issued with all other Szechuan militarists signed. On
the 19th, Liu Wen-hui's troops evacuated Kweichow. On the following
day, his troops again yielded Anyo, Donan, Luchi and other two distri-
cts to the 20th and 23rd Armies. On the 21st, street fighting took
place in the city of Chengtu. Beginning from the 25th, the army, na-
val and air forces of the 21st Army under Liu Hsiang assumed the of-
fensive against Liu Wen-hui's troops. A warship was wrecked by cannon
balls off Kiangtsin. Bombers from Chinkiang made air raids along the
Kiangtsin-Wanchun zone. On the 26th, Liu Wen-hui entered the evacua-
tion of Shilar and Donan and made Lushan his first defense line.

Evidently, there is little hope for the Szechwan war to come to
an end in the immediate future. On the contrary, it is ever enlarging
and protracting. According to the bourgeois press, two of the Yunnan
divisions under the command of Lung Yun are now concentrated at Chaoton
ready to reinforce Liu Wen-hui. In the North part of the province, the
Kansu troops under the command of Lu Da-chang are reported to have ca-
ptured Peiho taking advantage of the general mobilization of the Sze-
chwan troops to take part in the war now raging in the central part of
the province. Peiho belongs to Kansu geographically, but unilaterally
the district has long been held by the Szechwan troops.

It is reported war is also fermenting in Kweichow between Wan,
Chiao-lih and Han Kwun-tsian. The former holds the position as the
Chairman of the Kweichow Provincial Council and the latter is the
commander of the KMT 10th Route Army and concurrently one of the mem-
bers of the KMT Military Council at Canton. It may be recalled here
that Wang Chiao-lih had owed the supports of the Nanking Government
for his victory over the chairmanship of the province. Recently Wang
has very close connection with Liu Hsiang at Chunkiang. It is not
difficult to understand this, as reported by the Reuter on Oct. 10,
Liu Hsiang is backed by the Nanking Government of Chiang Kai-shek and
Liu Wen-hui is in alliance with the Wan Chin-wei's Group.

10月7日，驻守芦山的第24军一个团与防守温江的第23师一个旅发生冲突。后者在第20军和新5师的加入下，向第24军发起攻击，导致双方伤亡超过一千人。10日，一份谴责第24军指挥官刘文辉的通电发出，其他四川军阀均署名。19日，刘文辉部队撤离贵州。次日，他的部队又将安岳、潼南、隆昌及其他两个县让给第20军和第23军。21日，成都市内发生巷战。从25日开始，刘湘指挥的第21军陆海空部队对刘文辉部队发起进攻。一艘军舰在江津附近被炮弹击毁。来自镇江的轰炸机沿江津-万县区域进行空袭。26日，刘文辉进入施拉（音译）和潼南的撤离状态，并将芦山作为第一道防线。

显然，四川战争在近期结束的希望渺茫。相反，它正在不断扩大和拖延。据资产阶级报刊报道，龙云指挥下的两个云南师现在集中在昭通，准备增援刘文辉。在该省北部，据报道，鲁大昌指挥的甘肃部队利用四川部队全面动员参与目前在该省中部肆虐的战争之机，占领了沛河。沛河在地理上属于甘肃，但该区长久以来一直被四川部队单方面占据。

据报道，贵州的王乔立（音译）和韩群谦（音译）之间也在酝酿战争。前者担任贵州省务委员会主席，后者是国民党第十路军指挥官，同时也是广州国民党军事委员会成员之一。在此可以回顾的是，王乔立曾依靠南京政府的支持赢得了省主席职位。最近，王与重庆的刘湘关系非常密切。这不难理解，正如路透社10月10日报道，刘湘得到蒋介石南京政府的支持，而刘文辉则与汪精卫集团结盟。

The war either in Suntung or in Szchuen or in Kweichow is nothing local or provincial.

The KMT Canton Government had during September issued Mex$15,000,000 bonds for the purpose to enlarge its air force. Besides, it later issued another sum of Mex$30,000,000 as National Defense Bonds. According to its Three-Year Air Force Plan, Canton will increase its aeroplanes from 40 this year to 400 in 1935.

The notorious Re-organizationist leader, Mr. Chin-woi, of the KMT after his maneuvers proved repeatedly failures before the masses, is now on sick(?) leave to Europe. While he passed Hongkong, he was visited by an emissary from Chen Che-tang, warlord at Canton, who, according to the Taivanpao, Oct. 26, presented him $20,000 through the deputy.

The same Chen Cho-tsai has also recently sent two emissaries to the Shantung warlord, Han Fu-chu, who is now at war with Gen. Chiang-kai-shek in East Shantung.

It is also this Han Fu-chu who about half of a month ago presented $ 20,000 to militarist Feng Yu-hsiang when the latter started from his province northward to see his old comrades and ex-allies.

According to the Taivanpao, Oct. 24, Feng Yu Hsiang is now in Peking and, being invited, will accompany Dr. C. C. Wu, former Chinese Minister-at Washington and now spokesman of the Canton Group, to start for Soviet Russia in the near future, to visit Sun Sui-man, the Communist military leader.

It is also precisely at this moment that all anti-Nanking militarists and bureaucrats such as the famous pro-Japanese Anti-Chiang group, Tan Chi-jen, Sun Chuan-fang, Wu Pei-fu, etc. are gathering at Peking to be guests of the Buddhist meeting under the auspices of the Tibetan monk, Pan Chen Lama. It is for this most revered service (!) that the Nanking authorities even announced state of emergency!

The complex inter-militarist relations plainly reveal us, a sharp conflict now existing among the ruling classes, with Chiang Kai-shek and his comrade Chang Hsueh-liang standing on the one side and all anti-Chiang and anti-Nanking groups, on the other. The utmost aim of the conflict is for the supreme leadership in betraying the Reds and Soviets, in suppressing the nation-wide anti-imperialist movement and in inviting international imperialists to dismember China. The conflict deepens, or in other words, the various militarist groups break up, right after Chiang Kai-shek's Fourth Drive against the Reds has been definitely turned a fiasco and the Lytton Report has appeared before the public expressing its uncerainty with the Nanking Government as to its ability to put down the "Communist bandits". This strongly argues for what the militarists are fighting!

无论是山东、四川还是贵州的战争，都绝非地方性或省域性的冲突。

国民党广东政府曾在九月发行墨西哥银元1,500万元债券，旨在扩充其空军。此外，其后又发行了另一笔金额为墨西哥银元3,000万元的国防公债。根据其三年空军计划，广东的飞机数量将从今年的40架增加至1935年的400架。

国民党改组派著名领袖陈公博（Chin-woi）先生，在其 maneuvers 屡遭民众挫败后，现正病假（?）赴欧洲。当他途经香港时，广东军阀陈济棠（Chen Che-tang）派遣了一名特使拜访他，据10月26日《大晚报》（Taivanpao）报道，该特使通过副手向其赠送了2万美元。

同一位陈济棠（Chen Cho-tsai）最近还派遣了两名特使去见山东军阀韩复榘（Han Fu-chu），后者目前正在鲁东与蒋介石将军作战。

大约半个月前，正是这位韩复榘在冯玉祥（Feng Yu-hsiang）从其省份北上会见老战友和前盟友时，向冯玉祥赠送了2万美元。

据10月24日《大晚报》报道，冯玉祥现在北平，并受邀将在近期陪同前中国驻华盛顿公使、现任广东集团发言人吴铁城（C. C. Wu）博士前往苏维埃俄国，拜访共产党军事领导人孙遂曼（Sun Sui-man，音译）。

也正是在此刻，所有反南京的军阀和官僚，如著名的亲日反蒋集团的谭季仁（Tan Chi-jen，音译）、孙传芳、吴佩孚等，正聚集在北平，作为西藏僧侣班禅喇嘛（Pan Chen Lama）主持的佛教法会的宾客。正是为了这一最受尊崇的服务（!），南京当局甚至宣布了紧急状态！

复杂的军阀间关系清楚地向我们表明，统治阶级内部现在存在尖锐的冲突，一方是蒋介石及其同僚张学良，另一方是所有反蒋和反南京的集团。这场冲突的最高目标是为了在背叛红军和苏维埃、镇压全国性的反帝国主义运动以及邀请国际帝国主义者瓜分中国方面取得最高领导权。随着蒋介石对红军的第四次“围剿”彻底沦为闹剧，以及李顿调查报告公开表达了对南京政府镇压“共匪”能力的怀疑，这种冲突加剧了，或者说，各军阀集团随之分裂。这有力地说明了军阀们究竟为何而战！

天津电车与电力工人罢工。

pages.en:
In opposing the capitalists who did not fulfill the contract for
higher wages and better treatments, more than 1,800 workers of the
Tientsin Tramway and Electric Company after conquered the cheatment
of the leaders of the KMT Yellow Trade Union with their strength of
solidarity declared strike on Oct. 21st.

The Tientsin Tramway and Electric Company was established by
Belgium capitalists in 1904. In recent years, the annual profit of
the Company reaches more than M$3,000,000 which are undoubtedly exploited
from the Chinese workers.

In February last, the workers of this Company had held a strike
on account of the capitalists refusing to increase their wages. But
soon the strike was broken by the KMT Tientsin City Government under
the pretext that "in the midst of the national crisis, workers are
required to maintain peace and order in the city."

Since the failure of the last strike, the workers' emotion of
struggle has become more radical. At the beginning of October, a part
of the workers actively prepared to organize a strike in order to an-
swer the attack of the capitalists. Seeing the firm attitude of the
workers, the leaders of the Yellow Trade Union, in an effort to pre-
vent the outbreak of the strike, called on Oct. 14 an emergency meet-
ing of delegates to discuss measures "against the Company".

The meeting decided: (A) Seven demands to be put forward to the
management,--1. Every worker should be given uniforms of two seasons,
2. Workers who die within the period of service should be pensioned
with M$200 for funeral expenditure (those who die in accident while
at work is excluded from this condition.), 3. Every worker should be
given dwelling place, otherwise, be paid M$5 for house allowance, 4.
Electric power consumed by every worker not surpassing 20 ampere
hours in a month should be free of charge, and if it surpasses the
amount, M$0.12 per ampere hour be the rate of charge, 5. Workers of
the inspection department who work diligently in the north should be
paid a monthly bonus of M$5, 6. Each department should be properly
furnished with newspaper board and 7. The monthly subsidiary to the
school for workers' children should be increased by M$100. and (B)
If the Company refuses to accept the above demands, a "necessary"
measure will be adopted.

The demands were rejected. The whole body of the workers burned
with anger at the oppression of the capitalists, and warmly discussed
the stage a strike for obtaining better working conditions. At that
time, the leaders of the Yellow Trade Union realized that the pacific
method of petition could not alleviate the workers' emotion of strug-
gle. And they, then, use their usual tactics of "leading the struggle
in order to betray the struggle."

In the afternoon of Oct. 20, the leaders of the Yellow Trade
Union again called a delegate meeting, which decided to perform a strike,
beginning from the next morning. The meeting also decided "the method
of strike", "the rules of strike" and the "Strike Committee". (The
committee is controlled by the Yellow Trade Unionists.)
pages.zh:
为了反对资本家不履行提高工资和改善待遇的合同，天津电车电灯公司1,800多名工人在以团结的力量克服了国民党黄色工会领袖的欺骗后，于10月21日宣布罢工。

天津电车电灯公司由比利时资本家于1904年建立。近年来，该公司的年利润超过300万墨西哥银元，这无疑是从中国工人身上剥削而来的。

去年二月，该公司工人曾因资本家拒绝加薪而举行罢工。但罢工很快被国民党天津市政府以“国难当头，工人须维持市内和平秩序”为借口所破坏。

自上次罢工失败以来，工人的斗争情绪变得更加激进。十月初，部分工人积极准备组织罢工，以回应资本家的进攻。看到工人坚定的态度，黄色工会领袖为防止罢工爆发，于10月14日召开代表紧急会议，讨论“对付公司”的措施。

会议决定：(A) 向管理层提出七项要求——1. 每位工人应发给两季制服；2. 在服务期间死亡的工人应发放200墨西哥银元作为丧葬费（工作中因事故死亡者不在此列）；3. 每位工人应提供住所，否则支付5墨西哥银元作为住房津贴；4. 每位工人每月消耗不超过20安培小时的电力应免费，若超过该数量，按每安培小时0.12墨西哥银元收费；5. 在北方勤奋工作的稽查部工人每月应获得5墨西哥银元的奖金；6. 各部门应适当配备阅报栏；7. 工人子弟学校的月度补助应增加100墨西哥银元。(B) 如果公司拒绝接受上述要求，将采取“必要”措施。

这些要求被拒绝。全体工人对资本家的压迫怒火中烧，热烈讨论通过罢工阶段以争取更好的工作条件。当时，黄色工会领袖意识到和平请愿的方法无法缓解工人的斗争情绪。于是，他们使用了惯用的“领导斗争以便出卖斗争”的策略。

10月20日下午，黄色工会领袖再次召开代表会议，决定从次日早晨开始举行罢工。会议还决定了“罢工方法”、“罢工规则”和“罢工委员会”。（该委员会由黄色工会分子控制。）

pages.en:
10.
The Methods of Strike. Run the cars as usual, but sell no ticket, 2. Drivers have to work and stop according to usual regulations, 3. Inspectors stop to examine tickets, 4. Internal workers of the electric department work as usual but increase the motor power and open the street lights even in day time, 5. The external workers still have to keep on regular work, and 6. Boys and coolies of all departments have to go to the company as usual but not work.

B. The Rules of the Strike. 1. Obey the orders of the Strike Committee, 2. Do not disturb the public peace and order. 3. Workers of the electric motor department must work as usual and increase the electric power, and 4. Do not smash furnitures and tools of the company.

Since the workers declared strike on 21st, the Hopeh Provincial Government immediately ordered the Tientsin City Government take precautions to prevent the spreading of the strike movement and to settle the strike as soon as possible. The local Kuomintang, on the other hand, ordered the Yellow Trade Unionists of various branches of industry to organize "The Committee for Supporting the Tram and Electric Strikers", in order to thwart the real aids initiated by the working mass themselves.

On the second day following the outbreak of the strike, the management staged a protest upon the Tientsin City Government demanding measures to stop the strike and punishment of the ringleaders. On Oct. 24, the French and Italian Consul-Generals at Tientsin also formerly produced their protests upon the Chinese authorities in the name of "public peace" demanding that effective methods must be taken promptly to put the strike to an end.

The trinity cheatment and suppressions of the Kuomintang City Headquarters, the City Social Affairs Bureau and the Yellow Trade Union have fallen quite short to do away with the strike. The workers have struck for 8 days to this writing. So far as we can predict, they will not go back to work in the normal way unless their demands are completely complied with.

罢工方法。1. 车辆照常运行，但不售票；2. 司机必须按照常规规定工作和停车；3. 稽查员停止查票；4. 电力部门内部工人照常工作，但增加电机功率，甚至在白天也打开路灯；5. 外部工人仍须保持正常工作；6. 各部门的童工和苦力照常去公司，但不工作。

B. 罢工规则。1. 服从罢工委员会的命令；2. 不得扰乱公共和平与秩序；3. 电动机电部门的工人必须照常工作并增加电力供应；4. 不得打碎公司的家具和工具。

自21日工人宣布罢工以来，河北省政府立即命令天津市政府采取预防措施，防止罢工运动蔓延，并尽快解决罢工。另一方面，当地国民党命令各行业的黄色工会分子组织“支援电车电力罢工工人委员会”，以阻挠工人群众自发发起的真正援助。

罢工爆发后的第二天，管理层向天津市政府提出抗议，要求采取措施制止罢工并惩办首恶。10月24日，驻天津法国和意大利总领事也以“公共和平”的名义正式向中国当局提出抗议，要求迅速采取有效方法结束罢工。

国民党市党部、市社会局和黄色工会的三位一体欺骗和镇压未能消除罢工。截至本文撰写时，工人已罢工8天。据我们预测，除非完全满足他们的要求，否则他们不会恢复正常工作。

The prisoners in the local jail were released and the treasury of the

With more than 7 rifles and joined by several hundreds of the toil-

from the neighboring districts. They were dispersed and it is re-
ported that most of them had already reached the Soviet district in March
last.

The Red troops from the Central Soviet district after won a series
of victories in North Kiangsi and captured the Hsining districts are
now moving north to the southern part of Chekiang. According to the Lihai
Herald, of Tientsin, dated Nov. 1, the district of Chinchow
on the upper Chientan River, in the northern part of South Chekiang, was
occupied by the Red troops under the command of Fang Chih-min on Oct.
27. When news of this reached, the magistrate fled with his staff
and left it to the mercy of the Reds.

欠薪长达7个月，且深受其驻防地附近活动的红军影响，于10月10日在该省南部边境的庆元（Chinyuan）发动兵变。区公署、区警察局、李机枪连（Li Machine Gun Company，音译）和第二连措手不及。兵变者未发一枪一弹便缴获了当地部队的所有武器。当地监狱的囚犯被释放，区政府金库被没收。每名兵变者分得30美元，每名遣散人员分得4-5美元。他们携带7多支步枪，并与镇上数百名劳工汇合，向红军活动所在的福建浦城（Pucheng）进发。途中，他们遭到来自邻近地区的国民党部队追击。他们被击散，据报道，其中大多数人已于去年三月到达苏区。

在“苏维埃威胁”的主题下，同一位作者伍德黑德在表达了希望中日和平解决的愿望后写道：“日本发言人一直声称，他们的国家是远东反对布尔什维克主义的主要堡垒。然而，存在一种真正的危险，即日本通过将其军事活动扩展至长城以内，将使自身陷入一种自相矛盾的境地：不是遏制而是助长了确切的威胁；即中国的苏维埃化。”

一方面引导国民党投降，以维持中国现代化所需的和平与秩序，另一方面要求限制日本的行动，以便在对华问题上产生一种反苏/帝国主义的态度。（正如在中国，伍德黑德揭示了典型的……）

日本帝国主义在法国和英国帝国主义及国际联盟的公开协助下，已开始入侵华北，这是进一步步骤，旨在完全肢解和征服整个中国。大规模屠杀平民、摧毁城镇村庄、加剧苦难和饥饿，标志着日本强盗帝国主义的进一步推进。满洲和上海的恐怖景象正在中国越来越广阔的领土上以日益增强的强度重演；整团的中国士兵被消灭，因为国民党政府拒绝抗击帝国主义侵略者，而国民党将军们在蒋介石的命令下放弃一个又一个阵地，从而鼓励了日本和其他帝国主义的进一步侵略。同时，国民党用一切手段镇压反帝斗争、抵制运动和武装志愿队的组建。

在12月16日的《申报》（Shun-Pao）上一篇题为《皖西苏区究竟如何》的文章中，我们读到：“红军占领皖西的原因有两方面，首先是政治腐败，地方官员在地主阶级的协助下剥削农民……”

显而易见，由这些条件引发的斗争不过是劳苦大众对地主和军阀的反对或抵抗，因此“军队主要由贫农组成”（文件5，《伊工报》(音译)），而“反共围剿的主力是前地主阶级。”（文件12，《伊工报》(音译)）但从此鲜明的对比中，“反共”运动的性质在这里十分清楚：一方是地主，另一方是贫农和工人。

Production- Soviet District: In an article entitled "Impressions of
Ning-Chia-Village" written by Mr. Lien-cai, a correspondent, it says:
"The fields beside the road are beautifully covered with green crops,
but only several women are seen gathering the crop, very few males
are seen."..."Rivulets streaming beside the pine covered way fill one with
the smell of pines; ...one almost forgets that here is the soviet area has
a distinct..."

Non-Soviet-District: The next letter of this series describes about
the "Misery of Kwang-Shan region". It begins with "Although not situated
in the bandit district, the misery is even greater. When we pass through
Hsien or Lanchai Hsien, half of the fields are left unplanted, the
condition of lack in plowing oxen or worse than in the bandit districts
within the 40 miles from Kwang-Shan city to the Lo-Pi-River, the
fields are entirely covered with high weeds...scarcely a soul until
the Lo-Pi-River is crossed where, though, the product is no good and
mostly taken away by military forces.". It concludes with a sigh: "It
is very early to observe that the non-soviet district is even more difficult
to recover than the soviet districts."

生产- 苏区：在一篇题为《宁家村印象》的文章中，记者连才(音译)先生写道：“路边的田野美丽地覆盖着绿色庄稼，但只看到几名妇女在收割，很少见到男性。”……“松林小道旁流淌的小溪充满了松树的气味；……人们几乎忘记了这里是苏维埃区域，有着独特的……”

Thus, what needs the commonly hurled "recovery of farming village"
is not the soviet but the non-soviet district. The reason is plain,
that is, the exploitations described in the first section are removed
in the soviet district, while they are not only still existing but
also intensified due to military expenditure in the non-soviet dis-
tricts. Shun-Pao of Dec. 12, states in an article called "Tyho In-
spection" that "the most striking phenomenon is the removal of own-
ership boundaries of the lands which is the result of the radical
policy of equal division of land." That is why in the same year, the
"northern non-soviet villages yields a production of 20% while for
the south-east un conquered red district, the rice production is
nicely cropped."(3rd letter of Tien-chi, Lan-hua-pao, Nov. 32)
General life conditions--very little life conditions can be found
from the reports, but a striking contrast is seen from the wage pay-
ments of the two districts for the dyke construction:
Soviet District:"The monthly salary for the members of the dyke
Committee is 6 dollars each, 4 dollars for the chairman of the district
government(it is said that 4 dollars are quite enough to live in the
soviet district), 8 dollars for the soldiers."(Dec. 10, Shung-Pao).
As to the working hour and the amount of work (gravel at of the ma-
terial), Committee insists that "the working hours shall be 6 each
day, and pay is for work,...the pay per what may, for each square
of soil is twelve to fourteen cents, which is 60 to 90% more than
the prevalent rate prevailing in the non-soviet districts"
(Dec. 12 Shun-Pao. Dec. 10, Shun-pao)
Non-soviet District:"The magistrate of Hai-ni Hsien, Chang ...
... local landlords collect a monthly poll tax of 15 cents from
each worker under the name of "tax for the people's guard", they
also put the section head of the 15th section under arrest for
about 20 days!"
This single contrast is enough for a clear conclusion.

因此，通常被抛出的“农村恢复”所需的对象不是苏区，而是非苏区。原因很简单，即第一节中描述的剥削在苏区已被消除，而在非苏区，这些剥削不仅仍然存在，还因军费开支而加剧。12月12日的《申报》在一篇题为《堤防视察》的文章中指出：“最引人注目的现象是土地所有权界限的消除，这是激进的土地平均分配政策的结果。”这就是为什么同年，“北方非苏区村庄的产量仅为20%，而东南未征服的红色地区，水稻收成良好。”（11月32日(原文如此)，《兰花报》(音译)，田吉(音译)的第三封信）
一般生活状况——从报告中很难找到生活状况的资料，但从两个地区在堤防建设中的工资支付可以看出鲜明的对比：
苏区：“堤防委员会成员月薪每人6美元，区政府主席4美元（据说4美元在苏区足以维持生活），士兵8美元。”（12月10日，《顺报》(音译)）。至于工作时间和工作量（材料为碎石），委员会坚持“每天工作6小时，按劳付酬，……每平方英尺土壤的工资为12至14美分，比非苏区普遍流行的费率高出60%至90%”（12月12日《申报》，12月10日《顺报》(音译)）
非苏区：“海尼县(音译)县长张……当地地主以‘民团税’的名义向每名工人每月收取15美分的人头税，他们还将第15段的段长逮捕了约20天！”
仅这一对比就足以得出明确的结论。

ed for 5 times, at the rate of 10 cents per mou for the first time, 20

11, Hs-Kung-Pao) And "In Hwang-Chuan, just beside the mandate of Chang
Fong, the commander of 20th route army for-bidding the killing of
laboring cows, there was the proclamation of the arrangement of a
butchery taxation bureau, the inauguration of its director and the
starting of the taxation. "(Dec. 3, Ho-Hsing-Pao) Also when the report-
er walks through the south gate of Hwang-Chuan, he sees that a farmer
entering the city wall with two bundles of bean stuff was stopped by
a guy and was released only after the guy takes two sticks of the
stuff away, the farmer murmured along but didn't dare to say anything!"
(dec. 3, Hc-kun-Pao)
Although these are minute aspects, yet they are quite enough to
bring forth a vivid picture of the people's life in the two districts.
What is most thrilling is the dyke work. "The communist units in
Hunan-Hupeh-Anhwei district have organized a irrigation committee for
the river bank of Western Honan and Hupeh and the dyke work in this area
is under the control of the Soviet government, its action is quick and
efficient. They plan to get 20,000 workers within three days, but the
number is reached before the second day ends. The dyke work at
in-Chow needs pumping of water first, the communists have it done suc-
cessfully with women pumping gang." (Dec. 12, Sh ho-Mo) The people's gov-
ernment of the Soviet district is creative and positive...

虽然这些都是细微的方面，但足以展现两个地区人民生活的生动图景。最令人激动的是堤防工程。“湘鄂皖地区的共产党部队组织了河南西部和湖北河岸的水利委员会，该地区的堤防工程由苏维埃政府控制，行动迅速高效。他们计划在三天内招募2万名工人，但在第二天结束前就达到了这个数字。信阳(音译)的堤防工程需要先抽水，共产党成功组织了妇女抽水队完成了这项工作。”（12月12日，《什霍莫报》(音译)）苏区人民政府具有创造性和积极性……

"After the starting, the work is suddenly attacked by the local

when many bandits were killed." What a glory for the bandit-suppres-
sion!" (to be continued)

REDS TAKE NANCHANG
Reds enter the old Administrative center
Beating KMT's troops

According to Peking (a Japanese paper) news for Nanking on Oct.
15, "the communist troops took the town and also the railway, which
which occupied Linchuan, in southwestern part of Kiangsi, on
last Thursday (Oct. 11), having broken the line held by the Kuomintang
general troops under general Chao Chu-g, and steadily advancing
in the direction of Nanchang, capital of Kiangsi province.
"In the meanwhile, the government anti-red expedition-
ary force, which was defeated at Sseuchang, on Fukien-Kiangsi
border, having had its route of retreat cut toward Wucheng,
is withdrawing in the direction of Anjen.
Taken by this swift offensive of the communist troops,
the provincial authorities at Nanchang, in order to prevent
the alarm of the inhabitants in the capital, have placed a
ban on the news of the activity of the communist troops in gen-
eral and the defeat of the KMT troops in particular (end)

红军占领南昌
红军进入旧行政中心
击败国民党军队

据北京一家日本报纸10月15日发自南京的消息称，“共产党部队于上周四（10月11日）攻占了位于江西南部的临川镇及铁路线，突破了赵朱格(音译)将军率领的国民党正规军防守的防线，并稳步向江西省会南昌方向推进。
“与此同时，在闽赣边境泗昌(音译)战败的政府反共远征军，其退往武城的路线被切断，正朝着安仁(音译)方向撤退。
鉴于共产党部队的这次快速进攻，南昌省级当局为了防止首都居民恐慌，已禁止发布关于共产党部队活动的一般消息，特别是关于国民党部队战败的消息。（完）

党政府为了欺骗民众，免去了何的职务，但现在何不仅留任，还晋升为
师长。

对抗日运动的镇压变得越来越严厉。黄平同志因积极参与抗日运动，于12月24日在北平被捕。北平反战联盟被解散，成员被捕。蒋介石去年12月访问上海期间，特别会见了 ...

and Huang King-Yung, (黄金荣) outstanding imperialistic running dogs and members of Shanghai Municipal Council, simply to discuss the maintenance of imperialistic order and safety, to serve better as the slaughtering agent.
But the anti-imp. sentiment is ever rising with the vast masses. The soldiers of 19 Chui-muo refused to be dispatched away from Shanhaikwan. Seeing the masses' outrage, the Japanese Imperialism began to occupy Shanhaikwan on Jan. 2, while the KMT government orderly ordered the soldiers "not to fire." The soldiers guarding the city were so angry that they used stone instead, and then when they could not refrain any more, bombs and hand bombs were thrown to resist the attack of Japanese army. (Jan. 5 Ma-Jung-Tao) The KMT order was "not to fire" and "wait for the peaceful solution via the League of Nations settlement." On Jan. 3, Japanese occupied the aerodrome and other places. Some 400 soldiers, burning with outrageous anger, fought with their own lives against the Japanese airplanes and cannons. (Jan. 12, Lin-Shih Pao, Tientsin)
When the war was going on in the farmers of a certain village around Tangshan, ( ) together with the mine workers, gathered some one thousand iron mattocks and rakes, joined the front against the Japanese (Nov. 17, Shih-Jih Jih Pao). Workers, peasants and soldiers allied to fight against imperialist invasion.
But, under the KMT shameless surrender, such a glorious united front was sacrificed by the sell-off of the KMT rulers. Shanhaikwan was finally occupied by Japanese imperialism on Jan. 3!
The news of fall of Shanhaikwan splashes petroleum on the fire of anti-imp. of Chinese masses. The KMT has to employ more intrigue cheating measures to cover its sell-out of North China:
Since Chang Hsueh-Liang has become the object of disapproval due to his well known non-resistance, the KMT government, under the hint of Japanese imperialism, is going to place Yuan Chi-Jui in stead, so as to remove the focus of the masses' anger. Yuan, however, is another favorable puppet of Japan.
News were spread by KMT on the bourgeois papers to the effect that Yuan is chosen by the Japanese to head a certain puppet government in North China, and on the other hand invite those militarists as Feng Yu-Hsiang and Chen Chi-Tang to Nanking, showing cooperation and united force against aggression -- another cheating of course.
Yuan reached Nanking on Jan. 22, and came to Shanghai on Jan. 23. Big fascists were gathered by KMT capitalists to welcome this old puppet, large areas were devoted by KMT capitalists on boss papers to report the opinion and action of this central figure of aggression opposition to propagate the success and development of KMT anti-Japan procedure.
Actually, Yuan came to Nanking only to receive the direct information from Nanking for selling out North China.
Two days after Yuan's arrival, Miles Lampson, British Minister to China visits Shanghai, denying awkwardly that he was not intending to mediate for the Sino-Japanese dispute. But only the next day of his arrival, he was found to engage in secret talks with the Japanese Minister (有吉), also later with Major of Shanghai, Mr. Hayashi (林), British Consul and the British Chamber of Commerce. After 5 days, of a full program of visit-playing, he went to Nanking in hurry, on Jan. 30.
No one could forget Miles Lampson's effort in suppressing China on the round-table conference after the Shanghai clash last year. He is surely taking important part in the Imperialist Partition of China, by hurrying back to China at this instant. New arrangements are believed to have been made by imperialist-KMT to sell-out China.
The toiling masses of China could never be cheated so easily. They have seen enough these dirty tricks played by imperialist-KMT. They fully realize only through struggle and revolution, anti-imp. movement and soviet power can lead them that they can reach the emancipation of Chinese nation. And they are advancing on this glorious road. (31 Jan. 1933)

以及黄金荣，这些臭名昭著的帝国主义走狗和上海公共租界工部局董事，仅仅是为了讨论维持帝国主义秩序和安全，以便更好地充当屠杀工具。
但是，广大民众的反帝情绪日益高涨。第19旅的士兵拒绝被调离山海关。看到民众的愤怒，日本帝国主义开始于1月2日占领山海关，而国民党政府却命令士兵“不得开火”。守城士兵愤怒至极，先用石头抵抗，随后当再也无法抑制时，便投掷炸弹和手榴弹以抵抗日军的进攻。（1月5日，《马戎道》[音译]）国民党的命令是“不得开火”和“等待通过国联调解和平解决”。1月3日，日军占领了机场和其他地方。约400名士兵怀着满腔怒火，用生命与日本飞机和大炮搏斗。（1月12日，天津《临时报》[音译]）
当唐山附近某村庄的农民发生战斗时，（ ）与矿工一起，收集了约一千把铁镐和耙子，加入了对抗日本的前线（11月17日，《时事日报》）。工人、农民和士兵联合起来对抗帝国主义侵略。
但是，在国民党无耻的投降下，这样光荣的统一战线被国民党统治者的出卖所牺牲。山海关最终于1月3日被日本帝国主义占领！
山海关失守的消息给中国民众的反帝烈火浇上了汽油。国民党不得不采用更多的阴谋欺骗手段来掩盖其出卖华北的行径：
由于张学良因其众所周知的不抵抗政策而成为众矢之的，国民党政府在日本帝国主义的暗示下，打算让袁世瑞（音译）取而代之，以转移民众愤怒的焦点。然而，袁是日本的另一个宠儿傀儡。
国民党在资产阶级报纸上散布消息，称袁被日本选中在华北领导某个傀儡政府，另一方面又邀请冯玉祥和陈济棠等军阀到南京，显示合作和团结抗敌的力量——这当然又是另一种欺骗。
袁于1月22日抵达南京，并于1月23日来到上海。国民党资本家聚集了一批大法西斯分子来欢迎这位老傀儡，国民党资本家在老板控制的报纸上大篇幅报道这位反对侵略中心人物的言论和行动，以宣传国民党抗日程序的成功和发展。
实际上，袁来南京只是为了从南京接收出卖华北的直接指示。
袁到达两天后，英国驻华公使迈尔斯·兰普森访问上海，尴尬地否认他有意调解中日争端。但在他到达的第二天，就被发现与日本公使有吉进行秘密会谈，后来还与上海市长林先生、英国领事和英国商会进行了会谈。经过5天完整的访问表演后，他于1月30日匆忙前往南京。
没有人能忘记迈尔斯·兰普森在去年上海冲突后的圆桌会议上镇压中国的努力。他此时匆忙返回中国，肯定在帝国主义瓜分中国中扮演重要角色。据信，帝国主义与国民党已做出新的安排来出卖中国。
中国劳苦大众绝不会如此轻易受骗。他们已看够了帝国主义-国民党玩的这些肮脏伎俩。他们充分认识到，只有通过斗争和革命，反帝运动和苏维埃政权才能引导他们实现中华民族的解放。他们正在这条光荣的道路上前进。（1933年1月31日）

147,327 member in Anti-Imp. League of Kiangsi
Compendium adopted by Plenary Congress of the central
Soviet District Anti-Imp. League
(Letter of Aug. 25)

Stimulated by the Manchurian and Shanghai incident, the anti-imp. struggles in the Soviet district develops violently. An armed demonstration covering the whole district, has been hold in the central Soviet district, a sum of ten thousand dollars has been raised for the anti-strike of Shanghai workers through the aid of a few copper from each individual of the workers and peasants masses in the Soviet district. The original organization of anti-imperialist league in the Soviet district has immediately found itself inadequate to meet the vast development of anti-imp. movement. On March 24, demanding by the even-growing organization of anti-imp. nature in various places, the Kiangsi Provincial Anti Imp. League declares its formal establishment. On March 25, Fukien province also declares its own.

The total membership in Kiangsi League amounts to 143,327 in which 36,155 are of Hsing-kuo hsien, 9923 for Mei-chuan-hsien, 20,713 for Ning-tu, 19,231 for Tai-ning, 14,247 for Ju-jui, 12,015 for Loh-sien and 10,711 for Yung-feng.

In Fukien, 20,000 members are organized in Chang-tin, T'ing-chou, Lung-yen, Kuei-lo and Ning-Chow. In the 1st, 3rd, and 5th units of Red Army, the soldiers have their anti-imp. league organized by the unit of regiment, number of person joined being not exactly known. There are 1,000 members in the anti-imp. league of the workers and peasants Red militia corps.

Especially the young masses show their enthusiasm in anti-imp. movement. Branches for anti-imp. work have been set up in Kiangsi, Fukien, and the Hunan-Kiangsi border. 江西反帝同盟拥有147,327名成员
中央苏区反帝同盟全体会议通过的纲要
（8月25日来信）

受满洲事变和上海事变的刺激，苏区的反帝斗争猛烈发展。中央苏区举行了覆盖全区的武装示威，通过苏区工农群众每人捐助几枚铜板，为上海工人的罢工筹集了一万美元。苏区原有的反帝同盟组织立即发现已不足以应对反帝运动的巨大发展。3月24日，应各地日益增长的反帝性质组织的要求，江西省反帝同盟宣布正式成立。3月25日，福建省也宣布成立自己的同盟。

江西同盟的成员总数达到143,327人，其中兴国县36,155人，梅川县9,923人，宁都20,713人，泰宁19,231人，瑞金14,247人，乐安县12,015人，永丰10,711人。

在福建，长汀、汀州、龙岩、归化和宁州组织了20,000名成员。在红军第一、第三和第五军团中，士兵们以团为单位组织了反帝同盟，具体加入人数不详。工农赤卫队反帝同盟有1,000名成员。

The compendium contains 19 articles as follows:
(1) Overthrow the Imperialistic Rule in China, expel the imperialistic army, navy and air forces from China.
(2) Confiscate Imperialistic banks, factories, means of communication and other enterprises in China.
(3) Fight for the independence and unification of China, Restore the concessions and retract the extraterritoriality.
(4) Cancel all unequal treaties used by the Imperialists to butcher China.
(5) Nullify all foreign loans and Indemnities.
(6) Restore the custom house and salt Gabelle from the hands of Imperialists.
(7) Oppose the close connection of Feudal forces by Imperialism. Carry out thoroughly the Land Revolution of China.
(8) Oppose the imperialistic cultural invasion, confiscate all churches, schools and other cultural organizations and their properties.
(9) Oppose military-nationalism and Fascism.
(10) Oppose KMT and all counter-revolutionary parties, oppose the imperialism-surrendering thoughts, oppose the national arbitrary propaganda.
(11) Oppose the imperialistic partition of China, suppression of China, suppression of Chinese Revolution. Oppose the imperialist-KMT Shanghai armistice treaty and all other secret agreements.
(12) Unite with the Headquarter of World Revolution, U.S.S.R. Oppose the attack of U.S.S.R.
(13) Oppose imperialistic wars.
(14) Develop the national revolutionary war, Crush the imp-KMT offensive toward the soviet Districts, Over-throw the imp-Kuomintang rule.
(15) Enlarge the national revolutionary war, Support the Soviet Government declaring war against the Japanese Imperialism, Expel all imperialists from China.
(16) Support and enlarge the real Chinese anti-imp., together with China's workers' and peasants' red army.

(5) 取消所有外债和赔款。
(6) 从帝国主义者手中收回海关和盐税征收权。

(8) 反对帝国主义文化侵略，没收所有教堂、学校及其他文化组织及其财产。
(9) 反对军国主义和法西斯主义。
(10) 反对国民党及所有反革命政党，反对投降帝国主义的思想，反对国民党的专制宣传。

(12) 与世界革命总部苏联联合。反对进攻苏联。
(13) 反对帝国主义战争。
(14) 发展民族革命战争，粉碎帝国主义-国民党对苏区的进攻，推翻帝国主义-国民党的统治。

(16) 与中国工农红军一起，支持和扩大真正的中国反帝运动。

热烈购买苏维埃债券
积极参与革命战争
（摘自军队《前进》第20期，来自中央苏区的信）

兴国（Hsin Kuo）的工农群众以最热烈的购买竞赛响应兴国第二期革命公债的发行，特别是城市工人，他们节省了两个、三个甚至四个月的工资来购买这些债券。少年先锋队除了被指派推销的750美元外，还额外从苏维埃政府购买了800美元。值得注意的是，兴国烟草合作社的50名工人，包括劳工、职员和女工，通过革命竞赛成功购买了500美元的债券。兴国县工会很好地激励了工人和雇农购买省工会指定的数额，该款项已于11月25日上缴。省工会协助各地苏维埃推销债券，得到了群众的热烈响应。
“在汀州（Tingchow），篮筐工人的债券认购额达到了170美元的记录。有一名工人购买了17美元，这是汀州的最高购买额。儿童大多每人购买5美元，有一人支付了7美元。篮筐工人从三美元的新年酬金中拿出两美元购买债券，另一美元则捐赠给了红军。”

- :结束:-

3000 Landlords; 20,000 Tenant Farmers, 15,000 Hired
Peasants
Half Of The Field Owned By 3 Landlords
Catholic Church Super-Powered
Net Loss Of 80 Dollars To The Farmers For Every 100
Now Cultivated

Joint Chien of Imper-    Lin-ho Hsien is at the west Suiyuan, southeast
ialists and Feudal       of Wu-Yuan (1 县), its development into an agri-
Landlords                cultural district is only a matter within 20 years. At first there were
a few big merchants who hired a number of "fighters" to engage with the
native wandering pastoral tribes a bloody weapon fighting and occupied
large area of land for cultivation. Afterwards many poor farmers and
impoverished petty peasants of the interior China (mostly from Shansi,
Shensi and Hopei) took refuge there from the famine or heavy exploita-
tion of the native ruling classes. But since most of the lands were then
already occupied, they came only to be enslaved into tenant or hired f:
farmers.

At that time, the forward force of Imperialistic Invasion, embodied
as the Catholic Church, by utilization of Unequal Treaties, occupied
several important districts and started cultivation too. Through their
blinding skill, they attracted a number of poor peasants around themselves.
They have put quite a sum of capital in the pioneer work, the
first big achievement was the construction of irrigation works by means
of which the absolute majority of the peasantry was put under the mercy
of the Imperialistic exploitation and oppression.

The Imperialist catholic church had enjoyed a powerful rule at Lin-
ho. They built castles, organized armies, and even equipped with ammuni-
tions. Up to present, 4 of the relatively major farm
villages are surrounding the castle of the Catholic Church.

Lin-Ho Hsien became a prosperous agricultural district since 1925,
when the ruling class sponsored a "Commercial Gentlemen union" to carry
out an organized exploitation. On 1929, it was taken as a Hsien by
the KMT government, enabling more active ruling over.

The vast slavery: According to the statistics of the ruling class in
data { 1930, the total population of Lin-ho is 59 thousand. Be-
sides the 8 thousand of merchants, manual laborers and other free-profes-
sed people, all of the population engages in agriculture. There are 3
big landlords owning more than one thousand Chin(100 Mow) of land each
(the total cultivated land in Lin-Ho is ten thousand Chins), 20 owning
more than 100 Chins each, and numerous landowners owning more than 10
Chins. A rough estimation shows that in the whole Hsien, there are 450
landowners, of which 400 are owning more than 3 Chins each. The famil-
ies of the landlords, plus the parasitic class, make the total number
of people living on the exploitation of oppression amounting to
3,000. About 20,000 are tenant farmers; 15,000 hired peasants, 10,000
loafers. Most of the tenant farmers are married, only these hired and
loafing farmers are single and impoverished to the utmost degree.

3000名地主；20,000名佃农，15,000名雇农
半数田地归3名地主所有
天主教会权势熏天
每耕种100元产值，农民净亏损80元

帝国主义与封建地主的联合    林河县位于绥远西部，五原县（Wu-Yuan Hsien）东南，其发展成为农业区仅是最近20年内的事。起初，有几名大商人雇佣了一批“打手”，与当地游牧部落进行血腥的武器战斗，并占领了大片土地进行耕种。后来，中国内地（主要来自山西、陕西和河北）的许多贫农和贫困小农为了躲避饥荒或当地统治阶级的沉重剥削而逃难至此。但由于当时大部分土地已被占领，他们只能沦为佃农或雇农。

当时，作为帝国主义入侵先锋的天主教会，利用不平等条约，占据了几个重要地区并开始垦殖。通过其迷惑手段，他们吸引了一批贫农围绕在其周围。他们在开拓工作中投入了相当多的资本，第一个重大成就是修建水利工程，借此使绝大多数农民受制于帝国主义的剥削和压迫。

帝国主义天主教会在林河享有强大的统治权。他们建造城堡，组织军队，甚至配备弹药。截至目前，四个相对较大的农村村庄环绕着天主教会的城堡。

自1925年统治阶级赞助成立“商绅联合会”以实施有组织的剥削以来，林河县成为一个繁荣的农业区。1929年，国民党政府将其设为县，从而能够进行更积极的统治。

广泛的奴役：根据统治阶级1930年的统计数据，林河总人口为5.9万。除了8000名商人、体力劳动者和其他自由职业者外，所有人口都从事农业。有3大地主每人拥有超过一千顷（100亩）的土地（林河总耕地面积为一万顷），20人每人拥有超过100顷，还有众多地主每人拥有超过10顷。粗略估计，全县共有450名地主，其中400人每人拥有超过3顷。地主家庭加上寄生阶级，靠剥削压迫为生的人数总计达3000人。约有20,000名佃农；15,000名雇农，10,000名游民。大多数佃农已婚，只有这些雇农和游民是单身且极度贫困。

pages.en:
2
Thus 76% of the total population are poor peasants in which 42 are
hired and 34% tenant, while the landlords plus their families take
5.8% only. Here is the reserve for the revolutionary rank and file!
{Exploitation on: There are two general ways by which the landlords
exploit the farmers: One is the collection of rent,
ranging from 10 to 60 dollars per chin of land per year, which is to
be paid before the spring plow, otherwise the rent is to be doubled in
term of quantity of grain in the autumn; one is the "half-tilled" system
in which the farmer offers half of his production to the landlord. Be-
sides the cash rent and grain-rents, there is the additional exploitation
of labor, sometimes the landlords raise a loan to be divided among the
tenants. The irrigation fee (expense for irrigating the field) is most-
ly collected by the landlord too. The oppression on the tenant farmers
is quite serious, in case of failure to pay their rental, the farmers are
often to be expelled from the land, with their lodgings destroyed too.
(As the farmers' houses naturally are built on the landlords' lands)
The farmers dare not to construct better houses on this account of the
landlords. Meanwhile the servants and superintendents of the landlords
squeeze quite a lot out of the farmers.
Then come the crueler exploitation of the KMT government: For every
chin, $36 of formal tax, 300 catties of wheat, 300 catties of millet,
$5 of educational and police tax, one dollar of tax, one dollar of
army tax (no matter you hire labor or not), two dollars of active duty
tax, one dollar of house-number fee, 17 dollars as irrigation fee
and other provisional expenses. Thus, for one chin of land, be-
sides the 60 dollars of land rent, there are 67 dollars of taxes
to be paid, while only 9 dollars of land tax are asked from the lan-
dlord for every Chin by the government! Most of the government re-
venue works along the "green sprout plan system" and is imposed on the
farmers, "Ching shui" (清水) is also collected according to the area
of fields and the amount levied. The sums are much to spend on the tails
and teeth of the ruling classes, the police and the soldiers.
{Exploitations on: Different from the exploitations on the tenant
the hired farmers: farmers, the hired farmers, besides the direct and
indirect exploitations by the ruling classes, have to be exploited by
the employer to whom they must offer any amount of labor. They lived in
huts or soil dens, yet the KMT ruling class does not forget to collect
the one dollar of house-number fee from them. This makes it almost un-
bearable is the frequent payment of their fixed amount of wages by
grains, the value of which fluctuates very much with the market price.
Usually, necessities of their life are all borrowed from the city
by their landlords and paid to them as wages. Thus the employer enables
himself of another exploitation.
This treatment is very bad, given almost no liberty, and the occa-
sional sickness demands a cut to get a substitute for themselves. The
average annual wage is 25 to 30 dollars. During wheat-market (time to
cut the wheat) or autumn harvest time, male or female short-time workers
are employed, usually paid a small portion of the harvest he works for
wage, e.g., 3 muns (or 4 lb.) of wheat for one mow of wheat-cutting.

2
因此，总人口的 76% 是贫农，其中 42% 是雇农，34% 是佃农，而地主及其家属仅占 5.8%。这就是革命队伍的后备力量！
{剥削方式：地主剥削农民主要有两种一般方式：一种是收取地租，每 chin（亩）土地每年从 10 到 60 美元不等，须在春耕前支付，否则秋季将以加倍的谷物数量作为租金；另一种是“半耕”制，即农民将其产量的一半交给地主。除了现金地租和实物地租外，还有额外的劳役剥削，有时地主会发放贷款并在佃户间分配。灌溉费（田间灌溉费用）也大多由地主收取。对佃农的压迫相当严重，如果未能支付租金，农民往往会被赶出土地，其住所也会被摧毁。（因为农民的房屋自然建在地主的土地上）鉴于此，农民不敢建造更好的房屋。同时，地主的仆人和监工也从农民身上榨取不少钱财。
接着是国民党政府更残酷的剥削：每 chin（亩）土地，正式税 36 美元，小麦 300 斤，小米 300 斤，教育和警察税 5 美元，一种税 1 美元，军税 1 美元（无论是否雇佣劳工），现役税 2 美元，门牌费 1 美元，灌溉费及其他临时费用 17 美元。因此，对于每一 chin（亩）土地，除了 60 美元的地租外，还需缴纳 67 美元的税款，而政府向地主征收的每 Chin（亩）土地税仅为 9 美元！大部分政府收入沿袭“青苗计划制度”，强加于农民身上，“清水”税也是根据田地面积和征收量来收集的。这些款项大量用于供养统治阶级、警察和士兵的爪牙。
{剥削方式：与对佃农的剥削不同，对雇农的剥削：雇农除了遭受统治阶级的直接和间接剥削外，还必须受雇主的剥削，他们必须向雇主提供任意数量的劳动。他们住在棚屋或土穴中，然而国民党统治阶级不忘向他们收取 1 美元的门牌费。这几乎令人难以忍受的是，他们的固定工资经常以谷物支付，其价值随市场价格波动很大。通常，他们的生活必需品都由地主从城市借来，并作为工资支付给他们。从而使雇主得以进行另一重剥削。
这种待遇非常糟糕，几乎没有任何自由，偶尔生病需要请假找人替班。平均年工资为 25 至 30 美元。在麦市（割麦时节）或秋收时节，会雇佣男女短工，通常以其工作所得收成的一小部分作为工资，例如，割一 mow（亩）麦子支付 3 muns（或 4 磅）小麦。

The market for production is much unfavorable than last year, here is a comparison of the several major products, the last year price against this year's.

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

Inspite of the low prices, there is practical no market for the provisions, but the heavy taxation and land rent are not reduced anyway, and must be paid in cash. For this year, every Chin can yield about 50 to 60 piculs of rice or wheat, worthing 140 to 150 dollars, but the rent and taxes take way to 120 to 130 dollars. The planting capital for every Chin is at minimum 100 dollars, thus the farmer is suffering a net loss of 30 dollars actually for every Chin. Just imagine if the high-rate loan--rent doubled for late payment--should be again counted on.

The Nanking Government, in order to increase the income, compels the farmers to cultivate opium and smoke the same, collecting opium-farm and opium-lamp taxes. In spite of the poor opium harvest, the opium-farm tax is still 17 40 per mow. The farmers are extremely impoverished under the exploitation of Nanking government and feudal landlords. Their classes conscience is rapidly developing, revealing itself by the recent planning of outbreak against the opium-farm tax. Before the grave outlook for the year's end, naturally they would seek for a more advanced new way out. (1932, Dec, 20 Sui-Yuan Correspondence)

KMT DECLINES THE PROPOSAL OF COMMON DEFENCE
AGAINST JAPAN

The proposal made by the Provisional Central Government Of Soviet China and the Revolutionary Military Council of Workers' and Peasants' Red Army last month to establish a common defence line against Japan with the government troops "seems to have tempted the leading members of the ranking government, but they finally decided to decline the proposal on account of the present situation when the foreign powers are watching developments.

"It was also anticipated that if the Nanking Government sent a large number of troops to the North after a compromise with the Chinese Red Army, they might lose the sympathy of the foreign powers who have a great interest in the provinces along the Yangtze, where naturally, a great resistance may be the result." (Japanese Information Bureau, 2 Feb. Shanghai Evening Post)

南京政府为了增加收入，强迫农民种植鸦片并吸食鸦片，征收鸦片田税和鸦片灯税。尽管鸦片收成不佳，鸦片田税仍为每 mow（亩）17.40（元）。在南京政府和封建地主的剥削下，农民极度贫困。他们的阶级意识迅速发展，表现为最近策划反对鸦片田税的暴动。在年底严峻的前景面前，他们自然会寻求更先进的新的出路。（1932 年 12 月 20 日，绥远通讯）

国民党拒绝共同抗日提议

中华苏维埃临时中央政府和工农红军革命军事委员会上月提出的与政府军队建立共同抗日防线的提议，“似乎曾引诱了政府高层领导成员，但他们最终决定以目前列强正在观望局势为由拒绝该提议。

“此外，预计如果南京政府在与中共红军妥协后派遣大量部队北上，可能会失去对长江沿岸各省拥有重大利益的列强的同情，而在这些地区，自然可能会产生强烈的抵抗。”（日本情报局，2 月 2 日，《上海晚邮报》）

制作及转发人：D. I. Ross

现随函附上三份英文打字的《中国工人通讯》副本，这些副本包含在签署人于 1934 年 5 月 23 日从中国邮局获取的信件中。这些信件在当地投递，收件地址为上海和巴黎的人员，在每次投递尝试失败后，均被退回死信部门。
信件及内容的详情如下：
(1) 收件人：“V. Royer 先生，King Albert 公寓，Rue de Roi Albert。”
附件：第 4 卷，第 13 期，日期为 1934 年 4 月 13 日。
内容：(a) 国民党再次即将背叛华北。
(b) 日本在华北的垄断经济地位。
(c) 日本在华北针对苏联的狂热战争准备。
(d) 1934 年 3 月国民党统治下的工人斗争。

(2) 收件人：“A-I.L. 秘书，巴黎 Neuilly，Parmentier 街 3 号”。
附件：(A) 第 III 卷，第 88 期，日期为 1933 年 12 月 28 日。

CHINESE WORKERS' CORRESPONDENCE VOL. III No. 1. Jan. 4, 1934
(1) The Struggle of the Hopei Workers Sharpens
(2) Tighter Fascist Grip on the Whole Country
(3) The Starving Peasants Besiege the Nanking Municipal Government

The Struggle of the Hopei Workers Sharpens

The Japanese attack on North China in this Spring practically turned 17 Hsiens (5,000 sq. miles in area) of Hopei province into a heap of ruins. It also threatened to seize Peiping and Tientsin. In spite of the shameless Tangu truce signed by KMT to sell out N. China to Japanese imperialism and to hold up the rapid march of Japanese troops, the economic crisis in that part of the country suffered further deepening and sharpening following Nippon's armed aggression. Supported by KMT and Yellow unions, the northern capitalists have been, under the pretext of war losses, seeking a more ruthless attack against the working class, intending in this way to shift the losses to the workers and drive them into a more desperate situation of starvation and death.
Workers's Life Worse Off
The following methods have been employed by the northern capitalists in carrying out their offensive against the workers:
1) Wage cut and Intensification of Labour. First of all contracts and agreements on regular increase of wages, bonus and other allowances were cancelled as in the case of railroads, cotton mills, printing, municipal workers, etc. The same is true with weekly holidays and double pay for extra work as, e.g., railway, printing, etc. Wages were generally reduced and work intensified. In cotton mills working hours were mostly lengthened but wages slashed by 30%. In Paochen cotton mills of Tientsin the 3 shift system was changed into day and night shifts, thus increasing the work of the two shift labourers while wages were cut by 20-30%. Workers were compelled to take up the meals (board) provided by the factory or the foreman who deducted without consulting the boarders the charge directly from the wages. Usurious loans were forced on the workers, too.
2) General Worsening of Treatment. Punishment was more common and severe, freedom to talk and to go to the toilet during working hours more restricted, consolation fund and medical care abolished, free coal tickets (The Tangshan mines) and uniforms (communication and municipal workers) withdrawn, protection and safety devices eliminated, resulting in more frequent accidents in mines and chemical works (In Chiaotso mine at Men Fu Koo casualties from explosions or collapse occurred every day). Still worse was the treatment for female and young workers. Apprentices working up to full terms were denied the position of a full-fledged craftsman or artisan.
3) Compulsory Taxes. Half-starving workers were required to pay Patriotic or Aviation contributions, union fees, etc.
4) Curtailment and stoppage of work, lock-up, etc. The majority of the cotton mill hands were idle or part-idle due to the elimination of the night shifts or the introduction of the 5 day shifts. 10,000 out of the mill hands in Tientsin (referring to the 6 big mills) were permanently semi-employed. More than half of the matches and carpet workers in Peiping and Tientsin, the miners at Men Fu Koo, Tangshan and Liukiang were thrown on the street, the rest being partly employed. 100,000 rickshaw pullers in Peiping and 100,000 rickshaw and wharf coolies in Tientsin were on the verge of starvation. Added to this ghastly picture is the streaming in of the unemployed workers from Manchuria by the hundreds of thousands, concentrating around Tangshan and Tientsin living on theft, robbery or begging.
5) Unemployment of Poor and Agricultural Workers. Japanese bombing on an extensive scale, coupled with floods, drove thousands of farming workers and handicraftsmen from the village to the towns and cities. Wages of the farm hands dropped terribly, as in Paoting where the monthly wages of farm hands declined from $5-6 to $1-2; those for short-term farm hands slumped from 40 cents a day to 8 cents only. The streets of Tientsin were full of starving peasants attempting to sell their children, sons and daughters.
6) Imperialist and KMT Oppression and Massacre. Under the cannon fire of Japanese imperialism numerous workers lost their life or were crippled as in Tangshan, Chin'wantao and Liukiang. In Kalgan scores of revolutionary workers were arrested and murdered by the KMT. The Kuomintang authorities forced workers to run a train or boat without regard to the lives of the workers. Machine guns were employed to suppress strikes, workers' leaders tortured and shot. Volunteers and pickets organized by workers were dissolved and fascist groups placed on guard.

中国工人通讯 第三卷 第一期。1934年1月4日
(1) 河北工人的斗争加剧
(2) 法西斯主义对全国的掌控更加严密
(3) 饥民包围南京市政府

河北工人的斗争加剧

今年春季日本对华北的进攻，实际上将河北省的17个县（面积5,000平方英里）变成了一片废墟。这也威胁到要夺取北平和天津。尽管国民党签署了无耻的《塘沽协定》，将华北出卖给日本帝国主义，并阻挡日军的快速推进，但在日本武装侵略之后，该地区的经济危机进一步加深和激化。在国民党和黄色工会的支持下，北方资本家以战争损失为借口，寻求对工人阶级进行更残酷的攻击，意图以此将损失转嫁给工人，使他们陷入更加绝望的饥饿和死亡境地。

工人生活恶化

北方资本家在发动对工人的攻势中采用了以下手段：
1) 削减工资和强化劳动。首先，取消了关于定期增加工资、奖金和其他津贴的合同和协议，如铁路、棉纺厂、印刷业、市政工人等行业的案例所示。周休日和加班双倍工资也被取消，例如铁路、印刷等行业即是如此。工资普遍降低，劳动强度加大。在棉纺厂，工作时间大多延长，但工资削减了30%。在天津的宝成纱厂，三班制改为日夜两班制，从而增加了两班工人的工作量，而工资却削减了20-30%。工人被迫接受工厂或工头提供的膳食，工头在不征求寄宿者意见的情况下直接从工资中扣除费用。高利贷也被强加给工人。
2) 待遇普遍恶化。惩罚更加常见且严厉，工作期间交谈和上厕所的自由受到更多限制，慰问基金和医疗护理被废除，免费煤票（唐山煤矿）和制服（交通和市政工人）被收回，防护和安全装置被拆除，导致矿山和化工厂的事故更加频繁（在门头沟的焦作煤矿，每天都会发生爆炸或坍塌造成的伤亡）。女工和童工的待遇更糟。学徒期满后被拒绝给予正式工匠或技工的地位。
3) 强制征税。半饥饿状态的工人被要求缴纳爱国捐或航空捐、工会会费等。
4) 缩减和停工、封闭工厂等。由于取消夜班或实行五天轮班制，大多数棉纺厂工人处于失业或半失业状态。天津的纱厂工人（指六大纱厂）中有10,000人长期处于半就业状态。北平和天津超过一半的火柴和地毯工人，以及门头沟、唐山和柳江的矿工被抛向街头，其余的人部分就业。北平的100,000名人力车夫和天津的100,000名人力车夫及码头苦力处于饥饿边缘。在这幅可怕的景象之上，还有成千上万来自满洲的失业工人涌入，集中在唐山和天津周围，靠偷窃、抢劫或乞讨为生。
5) 贫农和农业工人的失业。日本的大规模轰炸加上洪水，迫使成千上万的农业工人和手工业者从乡村流向城镇。农业工人的工资急剧下降，如在保定，农业工人的月工资从5-6美元降至1-2美元；短期农业工人的日工资从40美分暴跌至仅8美分。天津的街道上挤满了试图出售儿女的饥饿农民。
6) 帝国主义和国民党的压迫与屠杀。在日本帝国主义的炮火下，许多工人丧生或致残，如在唐山、秦皇岛和柳江。在张家口，数十名革命工人被国民党逮捕并杀害。国民党当局不顾工人的生命，强迫工人驾驶火车或轮船。机枪被用来镇压罢工，工人领袖遭受酷刑并被枪杀。工人组织的志愿队和纠察队被解散，代之以法西斯团体站岗。

cliques or feudal geographical groups were bought and utilized to split the working class; workers forced to submit to the control of the yellow bureaucratic unions. No freedom of thought and speech was granted to the workers, no talks about Soviet and the red armies tolerated. Under the pressure of the Japanese forces the workers and toilers in Tangshan and East Peiping were forcibly injected with Morphine and sterile drugs.
The Struggle in Its Present Phase
Despite the raging white terror of the imperialist and KMT the work-ers in North China were still able to stage a counter-attack against the capitalist by plunging into an acute struggle. Workers' struggles have been widely developing, covering the heavy, light, municipal, government owned enterprises and handicraft industry. Even outlying regions and backward towns were drawn into the sweeping wave of strikes and struggle (as the salt workers at Kalgan and Tangshan, farm hands at Laoting.) The strikes of cotton mills and railroads doubtlessly held the leading position. There a tendency toward a general strike involving the whole trade was observed in the case of the united strike of two printing of-fices in Peiping and of the laundry workers in Tientsin. Under the stran-glehold of imperialism, KMT and yellow unions a good many of the strikes won whole or partial success as, for example, the printing bureau of the Finance Ministry at Peiping, the Peiping-Mukden line men and the Peiyang cotton mill workers at Tientsin, the Chihsing cement works and the loco-motive shops of the Peiping-Mukden Railway at Tangshan, the Peiping-Sui-yuan line men and the power company strike in Kalgan. The success of the strikes gained an increasing ratio to failures.
Many of the strikes showed a close relationship of the economic as-pects to the political, that is, to the anti-KMT, anti-imperialist strug-gle (Danwah strikers of Peiping against the patriotic tax, demand of the Peiping-Mukden line men for early payment of wages and life security dur-ing wartime). Some of them displayed a notable character of anti-impe-rialism and anti-KMT at the very start. During the process of the strug-gle the strikers manifested a great persistency. Thus, the Tahsing cot-ton mill of Shih-ka-chuang called three strikes under the sharp oppres-sion of the military police, and the struggle lasted well over two months. The Tientsin tramway workers held stiffly to their struggle for a year and so. Sometimes the struggle assumed a form of street fight-ing as was the case with the Yufeng cotton mill workers of Tientsin who, completely arming themselves with various sorts of weapons, besieged the office of the manager, refusing to walk out of the factory, struggling day and night against 2,000 KMT soldiers equipped with machine guns and armed cars. Surrounding a whole brigade of KMT soldiers, the strikers of the Tahsing cotton mill wrested back the arrested workers and killed one of the brigadier staff officers in a fit of rage.
Unemployment struggles were well under way, too. The jobless in the mines and railroads of Tangshan manifested a high sentiment for struggle. Juvenile and female workers not only participated in the struggle but, in some cases, acted as a vanguard and played the leading role. When be-sieging the troops, the boys, girls and women, too, of the Tahsing cot-ton mill bravely stood on the foremost front. In this case, the workers' families also joined the struggle by breaking through the police cordon lines and thus succeeding in sending food to the workers locked in.
In face of the Japanese offensive in full swing, workers in N. China took up the cudgel and led others to fight the Japanese. Scores of the Tangshan workers voluntarily gave up their job and joined the volunteers. At the same time, the miners smashed the gambling and opium dens operat-ed by the Japanese and sent the Japanese owners to graveyards. The unem-ployed performed their part, too, by leading the peasants to repulse the invaders. In Mentukoo workers organised their own volunteer army and rushed for the front. The railway and power men in Kalgan shattered the yellow unions and set up class unions of their own. They played a lead-ing role in the anti-imperialist movement in Kalgan and served as the mainstay of the local salvation association.
The anti-yellow union movement in North China was set on foot. The victorious workers of the Peiyang cotton mill decided to organise their own class unions and handed their names over to the red unions. During bye-election three of the yellow union officers of the Peiping carpet work-ers union were replaced by red workers. The railway and power men at Kal-gan definitely deserted the yellow union and created their own. In the election meeting called by the yellow unions the workers under the in-fluence of the red union openly shouted "Down with yellow unions", "Set up our own union".

各派系或封建地域集团被收买和利用来分裂工人阶级；工人被迫服从黄色官僚工会的控制。工人没有思想和言论自由，不允许谈论苏维埃和红军。在日军的压力下，唐山和北平东部的工人和劳工被强行注射吗啡和无菌药物（注：此处原文sterile drugs可能指毒品或某种控制性药物，依原文直译）。

当前阶段的斗争

尽管面临帝国主义和国民党的白色恐怖猖獗，华北工人仍然能够通过投入激烈的斗争来对资本家发起反击。工人斗争广泛发展，涵盖了重工业、轻工业、市政、政府_owned_企业和手工业。甚至偏远地区和落后城镇也被卷入罢工和斗争的浪潮中（如张家口和唐山的盐工，乐亭的农业工人）。棉纺厂和铁路的罢工无疑占据了主导地位。在北平两家印刷厂的联合罢工以及天津洗衣工人的罢工中，观察到涉及整个行业的大罢工趋势。在帝国主义、国民党和黄色工会的扼制下，许多罢工取得了全部或部分成功，例如北平财政部印刷局、北宁线（北平-沈阳）铁路工人和天津北洋纱厂工人、唐山启新水泥厂和北宁铁路机车厂、北绥线（北平-绥远）铁路工人和张家口的电力公司罢工。罢工成功的比例相对于失败日益增加。

许多罢工显示出经济方面与政治方面，即反国民党、反帝国主义斗争的密切关系（北平大华纱厂罢工者反对爱国税，北宁线铁路工人要求在战时提前支付工资和保障生命安全）。其中一些罢工从一开始就表现出明显的反帝国主义和反国民党特征。在斗争过程中，罢工者表现出了极大的持久性。因此，石家庄的大兴纱厂在军警的严酷压迫下举行了三次罢工，斗争持续了两个多月。天津电车工人坚持斗争了一年左右。有时斗争采取了街头战斗的形式，如天津裕丰纱厂工人，他们完全武装各种武器，包围经理办公室，拒绝离开工厂，日夜与配备机枪和装甲车的2,000名国民党士兵作战。包围整整一个旅的国民党士兵后，大兴纱厂的罢工者夺回了被捕工人，并在愤怒中杀死了一名旅参谋军官。

失业斗争也在顺利进行。唐山矿山和铁路的失业者表现出高昂的斗争情绪。童工和女工不仅参与斗争，而且在某些情况下充当先锋并发挥领导作用。在包围军队时，大兴纱厂的男孩、女孩和妇女也勇敢地站在最前线。在这种情况下，工人家属也冲破警察警戒线加入斗争，从而成功地向被锁在里面的工人输送食物。

面对日本全面进攻，华北工人拿起棍棒，带领他人抗击日本。数十名唐山工人自愿放弃工作，加入志愿队。同时，矿工捣毁了日本人经营的赌博和鸦片窝点，并将日本老板送进坟墓。失业者也发挥了作用，带领农民击退入侵者。在门头沟，工人组织了自己的志愿军，奔赴前线。张家口的铁路和电力工人粉碎了黄色工会，建立了自己的阶级工会。他们在张家口的反帝国主义运动中发挥了领导作用，并成为当地救国会的中坚力量。

华北的反黄色工会运动已经启动。北洋纱厂的胜利工人决定组织自己的阶级工会，并将名单交给红色工会。在北平地毯工人工会的补选中，三名黄色工会官员被红色工人取代。张家口的铁路和电力工人明确脱离黄色工会，创建了自己的工会。在黄色工会召开的选举会议上，受红色工会影响的工人公开高呼“打倒黄色工会”，“建立我们自己的工会”。

But the strikes were for the most part spontaneous or semi-spon-
taneous. The leadership of the red union was still too weak. Many strike
were still carried on by petition or sabotage. Internal conflicts, as
observed in many of the struggles, resulted from the tricks of the yel-
low union, thus affording facility to the capitalist offensive. The
struggles of the unemployed and the employed were as a rule not well co
ordinated. Different factories of the same enterprise have always failed to
enter into the struggle in a united effort.
Yellow Unions in N. China
The bureaucratic yellow unions in North China played a big part in
helping the cheatings and oppression of the KMT capitalists. The majo-
rity of them came into being in 1928 when the KMT north expedition
reached Peiping. Mostly led by the reorganisationists of the KMT, they
gained some successes at the outset. Later on the progressive elements
(CP) were expelled gradually out of the yellow unions. Then the masses
began to learn the reactionary nature of the yellow unions. But misin-
formed workers still believed that the communists cooperated with the re-
organisationists. With a longer history behind, with the gaining of
some minor successes in the economic field, the yellow unions were able
to maintain an unstable hold on the relatively backward workers.
The yellow unions as they are fall under the following headings:
a) Those backed up by masses with functionaries of the union elect-
ed by the workers from among the factory workers as, e.g., the postal
and tramway unions.
b) Those with functionaries appointed by the KMT offices and chosen
by the workers out of their fellow workers as the railway union.
c) Those without the support of the masses, functionaries being en-
tirely appointed by the KMT offices, hence called "empty unit" as the
railway union of Tangshan, Longch union of the five mines.
d) Those formed by foremen and capitalists as the Jade trade union
of Peiping, etc. These unions cared for nothing in normal times and
showed no activity at all but when struggles flared up, they pretended
to act as unions.
To nip the struggles of the workers in the bud, these yellow unions
have done their best in spreading the idea of collaboration between
labour and capital, the necessity of more production during the nation-
al crisis, the need of giving support to native capitalists enabling
them to fight the competing imperialists, more production to overcome
the difficulties of both labour and capital (the difficulties referred
to are losses to the capitalist during the general depression), no strug-
gle during the imperialist attack (Struggle will lead to unemployment,
wage-cut is better than starvation, etc). On finding that all these de-
ceptive talks failed to produce the needed effect, they will pretend to
champion for the workers' interests but at the same time told the work-
ers to observe peace and order. They either bribed the backward workers
or, as is often the case, persecuted the real leaders of the workers.
They often branded the strikes as "illegal and reactionary". By taking
advantage of the feudal relations prevailing among the workers or or-
ganising fascist groups their attempts at sabotaging the struggles al-
ways proved successful.
In imperialist enterprises or those controlled by the imperi-
alist the yellow unions played even a bigger role in stifling the work-
ers' struggles. When the head of the Peiping postal office fired all the
workers' leaders, closed the union and asked the KMT police to arrest
union men and actives, the yellow unions simply advised the workers to
keep order, to avoid misunderstanding with the foreigner, to avoid be-
ing looked on as anti-foreign. They assisted the imperialists and capi-
talists in arresting the struggling workers aiming to choke up the anti-
imperialist struggle.
The yellow unions have considerably declined in influence but are
still able to maintain a hold on a fraction of the workers due to longer
history, especially due to the support of the capitalist who sometimes
made a few minor concessions in favor of the workers, thus helping to
check the declining influence of the yellow leaders among the masses.
The yellow unions utilised feudal organisations to split the workers,

但是，罢工大多属于自发或半自发性质。赤色工会的领导力量仍然过于薄弱。许多罢工仍是通过请愿或破坏活动进行的。正如在许多斗争中所观察到的那样，内部冲突是由黄色工会的伎俩引起的，从而为资本家的进攻提供了便利。失业者与在业者的斗争通常缺乏良好的协调。同一企业的不同工厂始终未能联合起来投入斗争。

华北的黄色工会

华北的官僚主义黄色工会在协助国民党资本家进行欺骗和压迫方面发挥了巨大作用。它们大多数成立于1928年，即国民党北伐军抵达北平之时。它们主要由国民党的改组派领导，起初取得了一些成功。后来，进步分子（共产党人）逐渐被逐出黄色工会。随后，群众开始认识到黄色工会的反动本质。但受蒙蔽的工人仍然相信共产党人与改组派合作。凭借较长的历史以及在经济领域取得的一些微小成功，黄色工会得以在相对落后的工人中维持不稳定的控制力。

目前的黄色工会可分为以下几类：
a) 拥有群众基础，工会职员由工人从工厂工人中选举产生，例如邮政工会和有轨电车工会。
b) 职员由国民党机关任命，并由工人从同事中选出的工会，如铁路工会。
c) 没有群众支持，职员完全由国民党机关任命，因此被称为“空壳单位”，如唐山铁路工会、五矿龙池工会（音译）。
d) 由工头和资本家组成的工会，如北平的玉器业工会等。这些工会在平常时期毫不关心事务，完全不开展活动，但当斗争爆发时，它们便假装以工会身份行事。

为了将工人的斗争扼杀在萌芽状态，这些黄色工会极力宣扬劳资合作的思想，强调在国家危机期间增加生产的必要性，声称需要支持本国资本家以使其能够对抗竞争的帝国主义列强，并通过增加生产来克服劳资双方的困难（此处所指困难是指在大萧条期间资本家的损失），以及在帝国主义攻击期间不进行斗争（声称斗争会导致失业，减薪总比饿死好等）。当发现所有这些欺骗性言论未能产生预期效果时，它们便假装捍卫工人利益，但同时要求工人遵守和平与秩序。它们要么收买落后工人，要么像常见的那样，迫害真正的工人领袖。它们经常给罢工贴上“非法且反动”的标签。通过利用工人中盛行的封建关系或组织法西斯团体，它们破坏斗争的企图总是得逞。

在帝国主义企业或由帝国主义控制的企业中，黄色工会在压制工人斗争方面发挥了更大的作用。当北平邮政局局长解雇所有工人领袖、关闭工会并要求国民党警察逮捕工会成员和积极分子时，黄色工会仅仅建议工人保持秩序，避免与外国人产生误会，避免被视为排外。它们协助帝国主义者和资本家逮捕进行斗争的工人，旨在窒息反帝斗争。

黄色工会的影响力已大幅衰退，但由于其历史较长，特别是由于资本家的支持——资本家有时会对工人做出一些微小的让步，从而有助于遏制黄色领袖在群众中影响力下降的趋势——它们仍能控制一部分工人。黄色工会利用封建组织来分裂工人，

made use of war to discharge experienced and conscious workers, changed
the composition of the working masses by utilizing the children and wo-
men just coming out of the village, spread terrorism by fascist methods,
observed the weaknesses of the workers by taking advantage of their
proximity to the workers.. On the other hand, the revolutionary unions
were too young to get into closer contact with the broad mass of the
workers and shatter their illusions on the yellow unions. The struggles
of the workers in North China have directed severe blows at the yellow
unions because in every strike or struggle we have seen a tendency, more
or less conspicuous, against yellow trade unionism.

TIGHTER FASCIST GRIP ON THE WHOLE COUNTRY

A new wave of white terrorist acts has just set in. Following the in-
auguration of the People's government in Fukien on November 20 the Nan-
king regime intensified its terrorist rule by calling out the fascist
blue jackets to carry on a violent repression campaign against the mass
of people. The Fukien insurrection served as the signal, and on the pre-
text of "Fukien insurgents" many revolutionary people have been arrest-
ed, murdered or tortured. The militarists of the 19th Route Army, now
holding the destiny of the People's government in Foochow, have retali-
ated by pursuing an equally repressive policy under the excuse of plac-
ing a check on the activities of Gen. Chiang Kai-shek's blue jackets. In
Fukien as well as in the KMT controlled regions the white terror is rag-
ing with increasing violence.
In the past month or so Shanghai, Hankow, Peiping, Tientsin and oth-
er cities of strategical importance have been placed under martial law,
accompanied by the arrestation of about 500 persons. In Shanghai the ac-
tivities of the KMT fascist thugs are especially rampant attacking the
publications, bookstores, dramatic societies, film companies... Every-
where martial law hit the workers and students hard, forbidding all sorts
of meetings, searching the pedestrians from 7 o'clock in the evening.
Muzzling of the Press
Aside from maintaining a strict censorship over the press through-
out the country, Nanking and local KMT offices have been quite busy
in issuing orders to suppress the periodicals or papers which have
shown a liberal trend in their editorials. A week ago The Life Weekly
was suppressed by the police of the French concession acting under in-
structions from local KMT office, namely, the Shanghai party headquar-
ters. The Life Weekly is perhaps the largest in circulation, even beat-
ing the Shun Pao of Shanghai which claims to have a circulation of 150,0
000 a day. Sponsored by promoters of vocational education some six years
ago the Life Weekly has increased its readers by leaps and bounds. It
has found special favor with student, teachers, shop employees and pet-
ty bourgeoisie elements. Criticising the KMT's betrayal of national in-
terests, its severe repression, its heavy taxation, etc, in rather dras-
tic terms, it has long since incurred the high displeasure and wrath of
the Kuomintang, and been denied the privilege of using the mails for the
past six months. Its recent criticism of the fascist activities is be-
lieved the cause of suppression.
Somewhat allied with The Life Weekly is The Literature published by
the same company. Showing a leftist inclination, sometimes publishing
one or two articles describing the living conditions of the toiling mass-
es, The Literature has become a favorite with a wide circle of readers.
Under the charge of propagandising for proletarian literature, it has
just been suppressed by the Shanghai KMT office.
Another weekly, Taepan by name, published in Shanghai, met with a
similar fate. Heaping criticisms on the KMT for its misrule of the coun-
try it was for this simple reason suppressed although it pleaded that it
is nothing more than a Liberalist paper. Alleged to have assumed an un-
favorable attitude towards the Kuomintang, the editor of the Ta Mei Wan
Pao run by an American concern was forced to resign as a result of sharp
protests from the fascist quarters. And the editor of the Tientsin Wei-
fare, a popular liberal paper, was assassinated by the fascist thugs.
Taking the country as a whole, such examples may be multiplied infinite-
ly all pointing to the further stiffening of the KMT's fascist terror-
ist policy parallel to the further decay of the Kuomintang rule and the
further deepening of the mass struggle amid the victories of the red
armies.

利用战争解雇经验丰富且有觉悟的工人，通过招募刚从农村出来的儿童和妇女来改变工人群众的构成，采用法西斯手段散布恐怖气氛，并利用其与工人接近的条件观察工人的弱点。另一方面，革命工会因成立太晚，未能与广大工人群众建立更紧密的联系，并打破他们对黄色工会的幻想。华北工人的斗争给予黄色工会沉重打击，因为在每一次罢工或斗争中，我们都看到了或多或少明显的反对黄色工会主义的倾向。

法西斯对全国的 tighter 控制

新一轮的白色恐怖浪潮刚刚兴起。继11月20日福建人民政府成立后，南京政权通过出动法西斯蓝衣社，对广大群众开展暴力镇压运动，从而加强了其恐怖统治。福建事变成为了信号，以“福建叛乱分子”为借口，许多革命人士被捕、杀害或遭受酷刑。目前掌握福州人民政府命运的第十九路军军阀，以遏制蒋介石将军的蓝衣社活动为借口，采取了同样严厉的镇压政策作为报复。在福建以及国民党控制区，白色恐怖正以日益加剧的暴力肆虐。

在过去的一个月左右，上海、汉口、北平、天津和其他具有战略重要性的城市均实行戒严，伴随约有500人被捕。在上海，国民党法西斯暴徒的活动尤为猖獗，袭击出版物、书店、戏剧社团、电影公司……各地戒严严重打击了工人和学生，禁止各种集会，并从晚上7点开始搜查行人。

新闻界的噤声

除了在全国范围内对新闻界保持严格的审查外，南京及地方国民党机关忙于发布命令，取缔那些在社论中表现出自由主义倾向的期刊或报纸。一周前，《生活周刊》根据地方国民党机关（即上海市党部）的指示，被法租界警察查封。《生活周刊》的发行量可能是最大的，甚至超过了声称日发行量为150,000份的上海《申报》。《生活周刊》由职业教育倡导者在约六年前创办，读者数量迅猛增长。它特别受到学生、教师、店员和小资产阶级分子的喜爱。由于它以相当激烈的言辞批评国民党背叛国家利益、严厉镇压、繁重税收等，早已引起国民党的高度不满和愤怒，并在过去六个月中被剥夺了使用邮政服务的特权。据信，其最近对法西斯活动的批评是导致其被查封的原因。

与《生活周刊》 somewhat 关联的是同一家公司出版的《文学》。该刊显示出左倾倾向，有时刊登一两篇描述劳动大众生活状况的文章，因此在广大读者圈中颇受欢迎。以宣传无产阶级文学为罪名，它刚被上海国民党机关查封。

另一份在上海出版的名为《太平》（音译）的周刊也遭遇了类似的命运。它因批评国民党治理国家不善而被查封，尽管它辩称自己只不过是一份自由主义报纸。据说，《大美晚报》（由美资企业经营）的编辑因对国民党持不利态度，在法西斯势力的强烈抗议下被迫辞职。而广受欢迎的自由主义报纸《天津益世报》的编辑则被法西斯暴徒暗杀。纵观全国，此类例子不胜枚举，所有这些都表明，随着国民党统治的进一步衰败以及红军胜利背景下群众斗争的进一步深入，国民党的法西斯恐怖政策正在进一步收紧。

In Shanghai the fascist thugs made a planned attack on the motion picture companies, book stores, printing offices, etc., in the opening days of December. Accusing the Ewah Film Company of shewing sympathy in its pictures with the communist cause, a handful of the blue Jacket thugs stormed the premises of the company and threw a whole lot of anti-communist handbills warning the company as well as others ( The Star, the Tien, etc) to produce no more pro-communist films. The book stores not spared either. The Liangyu Book company with its office in N. Szechuen Road, Shanghai, was the first having fallen a prey to the Fascist attack prompted, as alleged, by a desire to prevent the company from publishing more novels and literature in favor of communist activities. But in this case only one man appeared on the scene and finished the job by throwing a heavy stone wrapped with anti-communist handbills at the show window of the company and certainly smashed the window with a violent force. A few days later the printing office of The China Forum, a popular semi-monthly devoted to the cause of the worker's movement and liberation of China from the imperialist fetters, formed the target of the fascist attack without, however, sustaining much damage to its readers swiftly coming to its aid. By the way, the Shinchuquokwansheh, a book Store run by the social democrats, and The Society and Education, a weekly operated by another fraction of Social democracy, were victimised by the fascists who no doubt wished to fly at the threat of the social democratic in consequence of the latter's subversive activities in Fukien.

FURTHER VICTORIES OF RED ARMY
Nanchang Menaced,
Hung Hsiu-chun's Red Army hit in 20 li
Ho Lung's Red Army entered S.Szechwan.

The Shanghai Mainichi, a Japanese organ, published on Dec.30 a report to the effect that the red army under Hung Hotsung reached Ursonien, only 20 li from Nanchang, while the North China Daily News confirmed the report by saying that the red army advanced to a point about 30 miles from Nanchang. The red army swooped down from West Kiangsi. The rapid approach of the red army caused a widespread consternation among the populace of Nanchang, provincial capital of Kiangsi. The uneasiness was so general that the police of the city had to post an official proclamation in public places threatening to punish the "rumour-mongers" with death penalty, forbidding anyone to talk about the nearing of the red army.
Another portion of Hung's army was reported to have besieged Fuchi and Hanning on the Sucheng-Changsha Railway in an endeavor to capture Hankow (The Mainichi, Dec.26; The Shanghai Sinwanpao, Dec.31).
Marching from West Sunch, Ho Lung's troops took the city of Chientang, Szechwan, on December 26, conquering also a part of Chunisien and Shiohu--those three cities all located in the south of the Yangtse River, opposite to Chunking and Wansien, two important cities along the north bank of the river, where the red armies under Comrade Chi Shangchien scored sweeping victories in the past two months.

Following the Fukien coup the KMT fascists arrested revolutionaries and other liberalists by the score and murdered under the pretext of rounding up the insurgents. In Shanghai, Hankow and Peiping more than 400 were taken into the custody in the last week or so.
In close cooperation with the fascist agents of the Shanghai public safety bureau surrounded on Dec.22 the seven universities of Shanghai about mid night, and arrested nearly 100 students accused of revolutionary actions and inclination. The universities affected are, Kwangwa, Futan, Chinen, Tasha, Tatsen, Faitse, etc, each with an attendance of from several hundreds to 2000. Acting simultaneously, the police of the public safety bureau rushed into the dormitories of the students and dragged sleeping students from their beds then herding them into the trucks and vans standing thereby. The arrested were checked up by the fascist students with photographs and register. At the same time, a couple of radical professors, Li Chienwah and others, were also placed under arrest. And the press was interdicted to pub-

在上海，法西斯暴徒于12月初有计划地袭击了电影公司、书店、印刷所等机构。他们指责亿华影片公司（Ewah Film Company）在其影片中表现出对共产主义事业的同情，一小群身穿蓝制服的暴徒冲入该公司办公处，抛撒大量反共传单，警告该公司及其他公司（如明星影片公司、天一等）不得再制作亲共电影。书店也未能幸免。位于上海北四川路的良友图书公司首当其冲，成为法西斯攻击的受害者，据称此举旨在阻止该公司出版更多支持共产主义活动的小说和文学作品。但在此案中，仅有一人出现在现场，他将一块包着反共传单的巨石砸向公司橱窗，以猛烈之力将橱窗彻底砸碎，从而完成了此次破坏行动。数日后，《中国论坛》（The China Forum）的印刷所成为法西斯攻击的目标，该刊是一份受欢迎的半月刊，致力于工人运动事业及将中国从帝国主义枷锁中解放出来；不过，由于读者迅速前来援助，该印刷所未遭受重大损失。顺便提一下，由社会民主党人经营的新生命书局（Shinchuquokwansheh，音译），以及由另一派社会民主主义者运营的周刊《社会与教育》（The Society and Education），也成为法西斯分子的受害对象，法西斯分子无疑希望借此打击社会民主党的威胁，因为后者在福建进行了颠覆活动。

红军进一步胜利
南昌受威胁，
贺龙红军进抵二十里处
贺龙红军进入川西。

日本机关报《上海每日新闻》于12月30日发表报道，称贺子珍（原文为Hung Hotsung，疑为贺龙或贺子珍之误，此处依原文音译保留或参照上下文指代贺部红军）率领的红军已抵达距南昌仅二十里的乌孙店（Ursonien，音译）；而《字林西报》证实了这一报道，称红军已推进至距南昌约三十英里处。红军从赣西迅猛南下。红军的快速逼近在江西省会南昌民众中引起了广泛的恐慌。不安情绪如此普遍，以致该市警察不得不在公共场所张贴官方公告，威胁以死刑惩处“造谣者”，禁止任何人谈论红军逼近之事。
另有报道称，贺部另一支军队包围了苏长铁路上的抚州和咸宁，试图攻占汉口（《每日新闻》，12月26日；《上海新闻报》，12月31日）。
贺龙部队从川西进军，于12月26日攻占四川黔江（Chientang，音译）城，并征服了綦江（Chunisien，音译）和秀山（Shiohu，音译）的部分地区——这三座城市均位于长江以南，与重庆和万县这两座位于江北岸的重要城市隔江相对，而在过去两个月里，季尚谦同志（Chi Shangchien，音译）率领的红军在这些地区取得了横扫式的胜利。

继福建政变之后，国民党法西斯分子逮捕了数十名革命者和其他自由主义人士，并以围剿叛乱分子为借口将其杀害。在上海、汉口和北平，上周约有400多人被拘留。
12月22日午夜左右，上海市公安局的法西斯特工密切合作，包围了上海的七所大学，逮捕了近100名被指控有革命行为和倾向的学生。受影响的大学包括光华、复旦、暨南、大夏、大同、法政等，每所学校的在校生人数从数百人到两千人不等。与此同时，公安局警察冲进学生宿舍，将熟睡的学生从床上拖起，然后驱赶进停靠在旁的卡车和货车中。被捕者由法西斯学生通过照片和名册进行核对。同时，李建瓦（Li Chienwah，音译）等几位激进教授也被逮捕。新闻界被禁止发

The same furious red and white terror is raging in Hankow. According to the correspondence from Hankow published by the China Weekly Review, Dec.9, 1927, over 130 young men were imprisoned in two weeks. At the same time, Gen. Chiai-kai issued a stringent order to the Wu-chang government to curb the "subversive" activities of the students, while the two universities situated in Wuchang signified the acceptance of the General's order by forbidding the students to take any leave, to participate in any movement, by censoring the letters of the students. Added to this high-handed action is the despatch of secret detectives from the Garrison Commander's office of Wuhan to watch the students more closely. The detectives were empowered to arrest and even shoot any suspicious students or any other persons.
According to the Pa Kung Pao of Dec.3 there were 62 revolutionary youths and workers escorted under heavy guard to the Nanking gendarmerie office. From authoritative sources it has been learned that one sixth of them has been shot, the rest being tortured. On Dec.3 seven arrests were made in the Teachers College and the Am-oi Middle School. In the meantime three functionaries of the trade unions in Tientsin were jailed, and 8 students of the Hsih Normal School arrested for having published a semi-monthly with a tendency against the Kuomintang and imperialism. While brought to Chinkiang, provincial capital of Kiangsu, they were prosecuted under the charge of propagandising against imperialism.
Our list of the arrested revolutionaries or liberals or others may be supplemented by the following statistics all gathered from news clippings: in the first half of December 60 persons were arrested in Paoting, N.China, charged with communism; 13 peasants in Yangchun arraigned up to Dec.19 for having refused to pay the warlord's exactions in the form of taxes; Japanese imperialism rounded up 53 in Changchun, Dairen, etc, charging them with anti-imperialism, etc. Meanwhile executions of the communists and suspects took place everywhere from Peiping to Canton, even not excepting Fukien where the People's government promised to give full freedom to the mass of people.

THE STARVING PEASANTS RESIST NANKING MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT
Appeal For Reclaimed Land
Flakes of snow are falling in Mid China and North China, presaging a rigorous winter ahead. Oppressed and exploited by the Kuomintang and imperialism, millions of peasants are crying for food and clothing in spite of the bumper crop this year. The desperate peasants are facing hunger and starvation. Everywhere the ruined peasants are putting up a resistance more or less stiff against the exploitation of the landlords, against the K.M.T and its master, the imperialist, who are responsible for their miseries.
The struggle of the starving peasants in its elementary form consists in organising the famine-stricken people of a single village into a corps or a band wandering to other districts on a food-begging expedition, seeking to obtain food and clothing everywhere as they go along. Here in Kiangsu, a province supposed to be rich and happy for the peasantry, we observe this year (the year of bumper crops) the widespread development of the famine refugee's struggle. The refugees, though lacking consciousness, manifested however a high spirit and readiness for struggle. Guided by the proletariat, they plunge into a head-on struggle for the division of rice and other cereals, for demand of food from the rich families, etc. Such struggles are brewing almost in every district.
Even in districts around Nanking the peasants are fearless in their struggle against the government which has, in the eyes of the exploited peasants, taken too much from them. Last week the peasants of Shao-kwang-chow, a locality not far from Nanking, marched to the capital and surrounded the municipal government. Intimidated by the bayonets of the gendarmerie and the batons of the police, the angered peasants fiercely demanded land and clashed with the soldiers and policemen, resulting in the wounding of four persons and the arrestation of scores.
Land For Land
All of the tenant class, the peasants in Shao-kwang-chow paid a price of ten dollars for a mou of swampy land for reclaiming purpose. They paid the price to the Nanking city government for the privilege
