oday The specie payment lasted one week, paying out about a hundred dollars, and only 2 or 3 hours were allowed to the big crowd—apparently designed only to fool them. Instead of abating, the run became more serious as more people came along for specie payment. Then the authorities unmasked themselves by issuing an order to stop payment outright and to advise the note holders "to wait quietly" for liquidation. A couple of months have passed without any concrete steps being taken towards resumption of specie payment. The toilers are undoubtedly the hardest hit: now a heap of worthless papers remain in their hands as the only tangible sign of a compensation for their blood and sweat.

How About Shanghai?

On the surface the monetary situation in Shanghai seems much better than anywhere else in the country. But this is only a superficial observation. True, Shanghai is experiencing some trouble in handling the large stocks of idle funds coming from the interior. True, we do not witness any runs or signs of runs on the banks either Chinese or foreign. The inflationist policy of the Shanghai banks, together with Nanking's inflationist policy of public debts, have been causing much concern and worry among the populace. On the other hand, money is also tight. Seeing the approach of the crisis, the banks here are no longer liberal in making loans to their clients. Now even the first class firms in Shanghai are turned down in their proposal for a moderate loan. Slowly coming as it does, the crisis in Shanghai will nevertheless break out in the end. When it does come to the surface, it will be the most severe, perhaps similar to the ones which successively occurred in New York or Chicago.

GREATER TASKS ASSIGNED TO AEROPLANES
during the 5th campaign

In view of the breakdown of the four campaigns before the heroic resistance of the red armies in the past the counterrevolutionary regime at Nanking has come to realise the importance of the aeroplanes as a more effective weapon in the 5th campaign against the Soviet and red armies in Kiangsi and other provinces. The theory lying back of it is that the air force possesses a far greater destructive power in fighting than the troops on land who have always gone over to the side of the red army when brought face to face with the latter while the airships will be more reliable under the direct guidance of imperialism.

Proceeding on this theory Chiang Kai-shek built a network of aerodromes under the instruction of imperialist advisers in Kiangsi where Chiang's 5th campaign is in full swing at present. There 45 aerodromes have been constructed for the use of military planes, those at Nanchang, Nanchen and Nanfeng being said to be the largest, each covering 1,000 square metres, to be shortly enlarged to 10,000 square metres. Besides taking the land from the farmer forcibly, Chiang ordered the construction of the airdromes by conscript labour. All those forced to work for him must bring food and meals with themselves, always subject to the fire of red partisans, the aerodromes under construction were made unsafe for the engineers in charge who went in by planes.

The KMT Air Force

Accurate statistics are not available on the real strength of Nanking's air force but conservative estimates place it at 350-400 planes as against 150 in 1932. Nanking laid down a plan to increase this number up to 700 in 1935, to be distributed among 23 squadrons for the army and navy. In addition there must be four squadrons of dirigibles.

As to the planes actually in the possession of other militarists, we have the following estimation more or less reliable: 100-200 for Gen. Chen Chitong, warlord of Kwangtung, who has spent huge sums on the development of the air force, 40 for Kwangsi, 20 for the 19th route army, all these to be called out to fight the reds. Of course they are to be used occasionally for militarist wars, that is to say, for the expansion of territory as well as for the acquisition of the control of a counterrevolutionary government in order to find favor with imperialism and to bolster the tottering Tuhao-landlord-bourgeoisie rule.

6
oday 现款兑付持续了一周，支付了约一百美元，只给大批人群留出2或3小时的时间——这显然只是为了愚弄他们。挤兑风潮并未平息，随着更多人前来要求现款兑付，情况变得更为严重。随后，当局撕下伪装，发布命令彻底停止兑付，并劝告持票人“安静等待”清算。几个月过去了，在恢复现款兑付方面未采取任何具体步骤。劳工们无疑遭受了最沉重的打击：如今，一堆毫无价值的纸币留在他们手中，成为对其血汗补偿的唯一有形标志。

上海的情况如何？

从表面上看，上海的货币形势似乎比全国其他地方都要好得多。但这只是肤浅的观察。诚然，上海在处理来自内地的巨额闲置资金方面遇到了一些麻烦。诚然，我们并未目睹针对中国银行或外国银行的挤兑或挤兑迹象。上海银行的通货膨胀政策，加上南京政府的公债通货膨胀政策，已在民众中引起诸多担忧和焦虑。另一方面，资金也很紧张。鉴于危机临近，这里的银行在向客户发放贷款时不再宽松。现在，即使是上海的一流商号，其适度贷款的提议也被拒绝。尽管上海的危机来得缓慢，但终究会爆发。当它浮出水面时，将是最为严重的，或许类似于纽约或芝加哥相继发生的那些危机。

第五次“围剿”期间赋予飞机的更重大任务

鉴于前四次“围剿”在红军的英勇抵抗下失败，南京的反革命政权已认识到，在针对江西及其他省份的苏维埃和红军的第五次“围剿”中，飞机作为一种更有效的武器的重要性。其背后的理论是，空军在作战中拥有比陆军大得多的破坏力，而陆军在与红军面对面时总是倒向红军一边，而飞艇在帝国主义的直接指导下将更加可靠。

基于这一理论，蒋介石在帝国主义顾问的指导下，在江西建立了机场网络，目前蒋介石的第五次“围剿”正在那里全面展开。那里已修建了45个供军用飞机使用的机场，据说南昌、南丰（注：原文Nanchen疑为南城Nancheng或南丰Nanfeng之误，此处依音译保留或参照后文Nanfeng）和南丰的机场最大，每个占地1,000平方米，不久将扩建至10,000平方米。除了强行夺取农民的土地外，蒋介石还下令通过征用劳役来修建机场。所有被迫为他工作的人都必须自备食物和餐食，且始终受到红色游击队员的火力的威胁，使得在建的机场对于乘飞机进入的负责工程师来说变得不安全。

国民党空军

关于南京空军的实际实力，没有准确的统计数据，但保守估计其拥有350-400架飞机，而1932年为150架。南京制定了一项计划，要在1935年将这一数量增加到700架，分配给陆海军的23个中队。此外，还必须拥有四个飞艇中队。

至于其他军阀实际拥有的飞机，我们有以下或多或少可靠的估计：广东军阀陈济棠将军拥有100-200架，他在发展空军方面花费了巨资；广西拥有40架；第十九路军拥有20架，所有这些都将调去攻打红军。当然，它们偶尔也会用于军阀战争，也就是说，用于扩张领土以及获取对反革命政府的控制权，以讨好帝国主义并支撑摇摇欲坠的土豪-地主-资产阶级统治。

pages.en:
7

In selecting the candidates for the air force the KMT military authorities exercised more care than ever because they have found in the past that those chosen from among the workers and peasants are "unreliable". In face of the sharpening of the class struggle the workers and peasants are most easily aroused to class consciousness, hence "unreliable". Admission to the central aviation school at Hangchow, for instance, is very strict, the candidates required to secure guaranty from 10 high officials or from capitalists of over 100,000 dollars in property besides taking the regular entrance examination. The students now numbering 600 are therefore sons of the Tumo-landlord-bourgeoisie. Besides the technical instructions from the American instructors, the students must receive the regular fascist political training. They are not allowed to read other periodicals besides the fascist journals. Recently one student was expelled owing to his initiative in organising an Esperanto society. Suspicious elements among the students have been regularly cleared by a process which, as a matter of fact, permitted only 50% of the students to be graduated and to participate in the drive against the workers and peasants. Even this has failed to prevent the graduating students from flying over to the red armies on two occasions in the past two years.

Rivalry Among Imperialists

Imperialism not only takes a hand in the development of the KMT air force and civil aviation but sharpens the imperialist conflicts by striving to obtain a larger share in the control of the KMT air force, to secure more aviation rights as well as to get large orders for the planes. No doubt America stands out first in the importation of planes to China but Italian imperialism does not wish to lag behind. Recently, with the arrival of Chang Hsueh-liang came the Italian aviator, Commandante Mario de Banardi, winner of the Schneider cup, accompanied by several other Italian aviators (6 in all), all ready to secure orders for Italy and to take a part in the training of Nanking's air force. In Kwangtung British and American imperialism are active in their attempts to develop and control Chen Chitong's air force. According to a Reuters message dated Sept.6 Chen Chitong was prepared to spend $30,000,000 on military aviation. On the part of England, she wants to form an air company in competition with the China National Aviation Corporation, American, which controls three major airways, one from Shanghai to Hankow, thence to Chunking and Chentu in Szechwan, another from Shanghai to Peiping and the third from Shanghai to Canton passing Chekiang and Fukien. Now this American concern is contemplating to inaugurate a new line connecting Shanghai with Manila and also another linking Shanghai with Yunnan. The German concern, Luft Hansa, operates a line from Shanghai to Sinkiang. In 1933 China imported more planes valued at $20,000,000 according to a conservative estimate. Thus imperialism is not only making a large profit but equips and trains the KMT air force, to hold it in readiness to attack the red army and the Soviet.

Finally, we may say a few words about demagogical campaign of the KMT "to save the nation by aviation". The campaign was carried on in cities and villages for no other purpose than to rob the people (worker and peasant) of their earnings. Consequently, large funds were raised from this source. But how much was actually obtained no body knows because those in custody of the money made no report on it. The aviation tax was levied here in Shanghai generally on the workers, deducting the tax from their wages. But the worker knew nothing about the use of the money he was forced to contribute. The five planes contributed by Shanghai to Nanking's air force have thrown bombs on the toilers in the Nanking-Fukien war, and will certainly throw more on the workers, peasants and red soldiers in Kiangsi and elsewhere.

END

在选拔空军候选人时，国民党军事当局比以往任何时候都更加谨慎，因为他们过去发现，从工人和农民中选出的人“不可靠”。面对阶级斗争的激化，工人和农民最容易觉醒阶级意识，因此“不可靠”。例如，进入杭州中央航空学校的录取非常严格，候选人除了参加常规入学考试外，还需要获得10名高官或财产超过10万美元的资本家的担保。因此，目前的600名学生都是土豪-地主-资产阶级的子弟。除了美国教官的技术指导外，学生们还必须接受常规的法西斯政治训练。除法西斯刊物外，不允许阅读其他期刊。最近，一名学生因主动组织世界语协会而被开除。学生中的可疑分子经常通过一个流程被清除，事实上，该流程只允许50%的学生毕业并参与镇压工人和农民的行动。即便如此，也未能阻止毕业生在过去两年中两次驾机投奔红军。

帝国主义之间的竞争

帝国主义不仅插手国民党空军和民用航空的发展，还通过争取在控制国民党空军方面获得更大份额、获取更多航空权以及获得大量飞机订单，加剧了帝国主义之间的冲突。毫无疑问，美国在向中国进口飞机方面首屈一指，但意大利帝国主义也不愿落后。最近，随着张学良的到来，意大利飞行员马里奥·德·贝纳尔迪指挥官（Commandante Mario de Banardi，施耐德杯得主）也抵达中国，随行的还有其他几名意大利飞行员（共6人），他们都准备为意大利争取订单，并参与南京空军的训练。在广东，英国和美国帝国主义积极试图发展和控制陈济棠的空军。根据路透社9月6日的消息，陈济棠准备在军事航空上花费3,000万美元。就英国而言，她希望成立一家航空公司，与掌控三条主要航线的美国中国航空公司（China National Aviation Corporation, American）竞争，这三条航线分别是：一条从上海到汉口，再通往四川的重庆和成都；另一条从上海到北平；第三条从上海经过浙江和福建到广州。现在，这家美国公司正考虑开通一条连接上海和马尼拉的新航线，以及另一条连接上海和云南的航线。德国公司汉莎航空（Luft Hansa）运营着从上海到新疆的航线。据保守估计，1933年中国进口的飞机价值超过2,000万美元。因此，帝国主义不仅赚取了巨额利润，还装备和训练国民党空军，使其随时准备进攻红军和苏维埃。

最后，我们可以简略谈谈国民党“航空救国”的蛊惑性宣传运动。这场运动在城市和乡村开展，目的无非是掠夺人民（工人和农民）的收入。因此，从这一来源筹集了大量资金。但实际获得了多少无人知晓，因为掌管这笔钱的人从未就此作出报告。在上海，航空税普遍向工人征收，从他们的工资中扣除。但工人对他们被迫缴纳的钱款的用途一无所知。上海贡献给南京空军的五架飞机，在闽变（南京-福建战争）期间向劳工投掷了炸弹，并且肯定会在江西及其他地方向工人、农民和红军士兵投掷更多炸弹。

完

THE SUCCESS OF THE ELECTION MOVEMENT
on the Eve of the 2nd Soviet Congress

Of vital importance to the future of Soviet China to discover the 5th offensive of the Kuomintang against the Soviet districts is the election movement set on foot by the Central Executive Committee of the Chinese Soviet Republic in spite of the raging civil war in the Soviet districts. Needless to say, the election movement has not only been successfully ended in complete success.

In its declaration regarding the convocation of the 2nd All-China Soviet Congress in question, the Central Executive Committee pointed out that the second congress is to be held for the purpose of consolidating the leadership of the Soviet government, further strengthening and extending the Soviet power and, finally, of drawing a definite lesson from the experiences of the past few years. But it must be remembered that the congress is held in face of the mightiest offensive from the KMT, that is, the 5th campaign. In the first place, elections to the congress must be carried out among the broad masses of workers and peasants both in Soviet and non-Soviet territory, thus giving them opportunities and an approach to participate in the Soviet. In other words, the election movement shall not, so to speak, be subordinated to the central and urgent task of the Soviet government of China to crush the 5th campaign of the Kuomintang right at the present moment.

Ever since its inception the election movement has achieved more or less positive results. First of all, the masses in the Soviet regions have, from their own class standpoint, clearly recognized the Soviet of China as their liberator and set great hopes on it. In their view the short-lived anti-Japanese government of Gen. Feng Yushiang in Chahar and the recent abortive "people's government" in Fukien are nothing but an instrument of the landlord-bourgeoisie employed to fool the people, differing in nothing from the corrupt and truculent counterrevolutionary government at Nanking. It is of course the more so with the workers and peasants in Soviet districts.

From the incomplete statistics at hand it may be said that the election movement has succeeded in penetrating the wide masses throughout the country. Delegates have gone to the second congress from Manchuria in the north to Shanghai and Fukien and Kwangtung in the south, with others going there from the provinces in the interior. From this single fact we can not but draw the conclusion that the Soviet has secured a stronghold among the toiling masses, more and more workers and peasants are mobilized around the Soviet as time goes on. With its increasing prestige and authority among the masses, with more support coming from millions of workers and peasants, the Soviet is confident in its ability to shatter the 5th campaign to pieces.

Election of Delegates

Let us talk about Fukien first. Recalling that the revolutionary influence has been expanding steadily in the province we can easily comprehend the factors involved in the success of the election in Fukien,

第二次苏维埃代表大会前夕
选举运动的成功

对于苏维埃中国的未来而言，尽管苏区战火纷飞，中华苏维埃共和国中央执行委员会发起的选举运动，对于发现国民党对苏区的第五次进攻至关重要。不用说，选举运动已圆满结束，取得了完全的成功。

中央执行委员会在关于召开上述第二次全苏维埃代表大会的宣言中指出，召开第二次大会的目的是巩固苏维埃政府的领导，进一步加强和扩展苏维埃政权，并最终从过去几年的经验中吸取明确的教训。但必须记住，这次大会是在面对国民党最强大的攻势，即第五次“围剿”的情况下召开的。首先，必须在苏区和非苏区的广大工农群众中进行大会代表的选举，从而为他们提供参与苏维埃的机会和途径。换句话说，选举运动不应，可以说，从属于中国政府当前粉碎国民党第五次“围剿”这一中心紧迫任务。

自发起以来，选举运动已取得或多或少的积极成果。首先，苏区的群众从自己的阶级立场出发，清楚地认识到中国苏维埃是他们的解放者，并对其寄予厚望。在他们看来，冯玉祥将军在察哈尔建立的短命抗日政府和最近在福建夭折的“人民政府”，不过是地主资产阶级用来愚弄人民的工具，与南京腐败凶残的反革命政府没有任何区别。苏区的工人和农民当然更是如此。

从目前掌握的不完整统计数据来看，可以说选举运动已成功渗透到全国的广大群众中。代表们从北方的满洲里到南方的上海、福建和广东前往参加第二次大会，其他代表则来自内地各省。仅从这一事实，我们不得不得出结论：苏维埃已在劳动群众中确立了稳固的地位，随着时间的推移，越来越多的工人和农民围绕在苏维埃周围。凭借在群众中日益增长的威望和权威，以及来自数百万工人和农民的更多支持，苏维埃有信心有能力将第五次“围剿”打得粉碎。

代表选举

让我们先谈谈福建。回想起革命影响在该省稳步扩大，我们不难理解福建选举成功的涉及因素，

2

In 1933 the red armies carried out a brilliant campaign against the
troops of the landlord-bourgeoisie, namely, the 19th route army, deal-
ing successively decisive blows against it and bringing west and north
Fukien under the domination of the Soviet. At the same time, the masses
encouraged by the Soviet influence fought hard against the oppression
and exploitation of the reactionary provincial regime backed up by the
19th route army. A multitude of the workers and peasants took part in
the election there. The delegates elected in Fuchow were chosen by a
process of indirect election but they all enjoyed full confidence of
the electorate (numbering more than a thousand). Interviewed, a worker-
delegate says, "We must go to the second congress and take a look at
our own government". Short but brisk, this statement clearly reveals
the deepening of the Soviet among the working population. Another 1,000
workers and poor people in Amoy elected their delegates by similar
process and carried several resolutions to be laid before the con-
gress.
In West Honan 80 peasants assembled and elected their delegates.
At the election meeting South Honan more than 100 peasants were pre-
sent. They passed resolutions to aid the red army by public subscrip-
tion. Some of the peasants proposed to collect 200 cash for the red
army while others turned the proceeds from the sale of fruits over to
the red armies. A feature in the election there is the large number of
communists chosen as delegates.
Besides, a number of delegates was chosen in Honan, Honan
(The Yufeng Cotton Mill), Howhei (Anhwei), etc. But there we find a
few defects in the process of voting. Take, for instance, the election
of the Yufeng cotton mill which as a matter of fact carried out within
the narrow limits of the usual party balloting. In some cases election
was substituted for by appointment as in Hsuchow and Howhei. Added
to these flaws is the lack of preparation for the drawing up of reso-
lutions due primarily to weak leadership on the part of the party.
Here in Shanghai we have elections taking place among the vast
mass of workers, toilers and poor people who went to the polls gladly
and enthusiastically, particularly among the youths. In the six indus-
trial districts of Shanghai 716 young workers voted for 47 delegates
in 323 mass meetings. Here the result of the election, though satisfac-
tory, is not free from criticism in one respect: the election narrowed
down to the masses organised in unions or other associations under the
guidance of the party, not yet carried into the unorganised workers.
The mass meetings unanimously passed the following resolutions:
1) The toilers of the country are glad to be mobilised around the
Soviet in their efforts to smash imperialism and KMT.
2) The youths of the country shall organise and arm their own
self-defence corps.
3) Money shall be collected for the red army and the volunteers.
4) Fight against the fascist demagogy to fool the youths as well
as fascist terrors against the youths.
5) Fight against dismissal and maltreatment of young workers and
working children.
6) Fight against reduction of work, intensification of work, wage-
cut.
7) Relief for youths thrown out of work or from the school.
8) Confiscate all imported ammunitions for the red army and volun-
teers.
In addition, these young workers in Shanghai circulated a telegram,
saying in the concluding part, "We young workers clearly understand
that the Soviet alone can liberate China from the imperialist shackles/
Only by rallying to the Soviet can we smash imperialism and KMT, and
achieve full freedom and happiness by ousting the landlord-bourgeoisie
who sucks our blood. We in the name of all young workers at Shanghai
send the heartiest and most comradely greetings to you, the second na-
tional Soviet congress", the telegram bearing the date of Nov. ..,

Preparation for Election in Soviet Districts

In the Soviet districts more elaborate measures were drawn up in
preparation for the election scheduled to take place at different dates.
The central government sent out its instructions, setting Oct.26-Nov.10,
1933, as the period for the district congresses, Nov.11-30 for the Hsien

1933年，红军对地主资产阶级的军队——即第十九路军——开展了一次出色的战役，接连给予其决定性打击，并将福建西部和北部置于苏维埃的统治之下。与此同时，受苏维埃影响的群众奋力反抗由第十九路军支持的反动省级政权的压迫与剥削。大批工人和农民参加了那里的选举。福州选出的代表是通过间接选举产生的，但他们都享有选民（人数超过一千人）的充分信任。一位工人代表在接受采访时说：“我们必须去参加第二次代表大会，看看我们自己的政府。”这句简短而有力的话清楚地表明了苏维埃在劳动人民中的影响日益加深。厦门的另一千名工人和贫民也通过类似程序选举了他们的代表，并通过了若干项决议提交大会审议。

在豫西，80名农民集会并选举了他们的代表。在豫南的选举会议上，有100多名农民出席。他们通过了通过公众募捐援助红军的决议。一些农民提议为红军募集200文钱，而另一些人则将出售水果所得款项交给红军。那里选举的一个特点是当选为代表的人中共产党员占很大比例。

此外，在河南、河南（裕丰纱厂）、霍淮（安徽）等地也选出了一些代表。但在那里，我们发现投票过程中存在一些缺陷。以裕丰纱厂的选举为例，该选举实际上是在通常的党内投票的狭窄范围内进行的。在某些情况下，选举被任命所取代，如在徐州和霍淮。除了这些缺陷外，还缺乏起草决议的准备工作，这主要是由于党的领导薄弱所致。

在上海，我们在广大工人、劳动者和贫民中进行了选举，他们愉快而热情地前往投票站，青年尤为积极。在上海的六个工业区，716名青年工人在323次群众大会上投票选出了47名代表。这里的选举结果虽然令人满意，但在一个方面并非没有批评意见：选举局限于在党指导下组织在工会或其他协会中的群众，尚未扩展到无组织的工人中。

群众大会一致通过了以下决议：
1) 全国劳动者乐于围绕苏维埃动员起来，努力粉碎帝国主义和国民党。
2) 全国青年应组织并武装自己的自卫队。
3) 为红军和志愿军募集资金。
4) 反对欺骗青年的法西斯煽动宣传以及针对青年的法西斯恐怖行为。
5) 反对解雇和虐待青年工人及童工。
6) 反对减少工作机会、强化劳动强度和削减工资。
7) 救济失业或失学的青年。
8) 没收所有进口弹药供红军和志愿军使用。

此外，上海的青年工人散发了一份电报，结尾部分称：“我们青年工人清楚地认识到，只有苏维埃才能将中国从帝国主义的枷锁中解放出来/只有团结在苏维埃周围，我们才能粉碎帝国主义和国民党，通过驱逐吸我们血的地主资产阶级来实现充分的自由和幸福。我们谨代表上海全体青年工人，向你们——第二次全国苏维埃代表大会——致以最热烈和最同志般的问候”，电报日期为11月..日，

苏维埃地区的选举准备工作

在苏维埃地区，制定了更细致的措施，为定于不同日期举行的选举做准备。中央政府发出指示，规定1933年10月26日至11月10日为区代表大会期间，11月11日至30日为县

For preparation of the election 15 days were set aside, beginning from
Sept.20 to Oct.15. During this period demarcation of local administrative
units shall be finished, election propaganda and agitation pushed ahead,
town and village Soviets urged to make reports of work before the elec-
torate, election committees organised, electors registered writing their
names on red paper while the names of those deprived the right to vote
to be written on white paper, all the names to be posted in public. The
list of candidates approved after thorough discussion by mass organisa-
tions shall be made known to the public in a similar way. The same with
the resolutions. Election units shall be small, taking as their basis the
trade or productive organisation or the village or street as the case may
be. The election committees shall make full preparation for the matters
assigned them.
In the ten days intervening between Oct.16-25 the elections to the town
and village Soviets shall be finished, with the election committees play-
ing the leading role.
The presidiums of the Soviets in the hierarchy shall set themselves
the tasks of making preparation for their own reports of work, for the
drafts of resolutions and the list of candidates. The provincial Soviet
shall make reports to the Hsien Soviet and direct its work through its
delegates designated for the purpose. On the part of the provincial So-
viet, at least 10 able delegates shall be sent out on the said mission,
each taking charge of 2 or 3 hsiers out of a total of 21 hsiers in Kiang-
si. Acting in the same way, the hsien Soviet shall make reports to the
district Soviet and guide its work likewise.
Before the elections to the Soviets, each higher Soviet shall map out
plans of guidance and train leaders for directive work. Only the politi-
cally strong are qualified. Not until they are well trained in a series of
conferences (discussion, debating, etc) can they be sent out to take up
the work allotted them.
Details concerning the elections in the Soviet districts will, we hope,
appear in our next issues.

TWO IMPORTANT APPEALS TO WRITERS AND ARTISTS OF THE WORLD
FOR SUPPORT IN OUR FIGHTS AGAINST KUOMINTANG TERRORS
*TOWARD ALL WRITERS, ARTISTS, PROFESSORS, STUDENTS ETC IN CHINA*
....................................................................................
To authors, writers, and all cultural groups working
for the betterment of the society and humanity, all over the
world.
Comrades:
Since Feb. 7, 1931 when the reactionary Kuomintang atrociously
murdered and buried alive five Left-wing writers together with twenty
two communists, the more progressive cultural movements in China have
had to go entirely underground. The more significant writers, dramatists,
and poets, and other members of the intellectual class who have no sympa-
thy with the reactionary policies of the Kuomintang, are all the time un-
der the threat of unlawful arrest and execution. These last two years, be-
cause of the brazen selling out of the Chinese masses by Chiang Kai-shek
and his government and their complete surrender to the imperialistic po-
wers, the workers and peasants and the revolutionary intellectuals were
aroused to even more determined and forceful struggles. Consequently,
fighting to keep their last political breath, Chiang Kai-shek and his gang-
sters are not hesitant to resort to the most infamous and underhand methods
to deal with their political enemies, by organizing the so-called Blue
Shirt Society, by kidnapping and private assassinations. The well known
cases of such popular left writers as Miss Ting Ling Mr. Pan Fe-nien, Mr.
Ying Shu-jen, and others have made Blue Shirt practice an open secret to all
peoples, even the foreigners in China. Recently, as the Chinese Red Army
has made very rapid, powerful, and substantial gains, and as the people,
in general, have shown more marked anti-Kuomintang and anti-imperialistic
feelings, the Blue Shirts even dare to come out in open and declare in their
publications that the time is ripe to carry out once more the historical
"massacre of intellectuals and the burning of all books", and to make a
"bandit suppression campaign" among colleges and schools.

代表大会期间，12月1日至15日为省代表大会期间，而第二次苏维埃代表大会定于12月12日召开，正值广州公社六周年纪念日。大会的详细情况将在日后向读者披露。

为准备选举，预留了15天时间，从9月20日至10月15日。在此期间，应完成地方行政单位的划分，推进选举宣传和鼓动工作，督促城镇和乡村苏维埃向选民作工作报告，组织选举委员会，登记选民时将姓名写在红纸上，而被剥夺选举权者的姓名则写在白纸上，所有名单均予公开张贴。经群众组织充分讨论后批准的候选人名单也以同样方式公布。决议亦同。选举单位应小型化，视情况以行业或生产组织、村庄或街道为基础。选举委员会应为其指派的事务做好充分准备。

在10月16日至25日的十天间隔期内，应完成城镇和乡村苏维埃的选举，选举委员会发挥主导作用。

各级苏维埃主席团应为自己设定任务，准备各自的工作报告、决议草案和候选人名单。省苏维埃应向县苏维埃作报告，并通过为此指定的代表指导其工作。就省苏维埃而言，至少应派出10名能干的代表执行上述任务，每人负责江西总共21个县中的2或3个县。县苏维埃以同样方式向区苏维埃作报告并指导其工作。

在苏维埃选举之前，各上级苏维埃应制定指导计划并培训从事指导工作的领导人。只有政治坚定者方具备资格。只有在一系列会议（讨论、辩论等）中得到充分培训后，才能派遣他们去承担分配给他们的任务。

关于苏维埃地区选举的详细情况，我们希望将在下一期刊登。

两项重要呼吁：请求世界作家和艺术家支持我们反对国民党恐怖的斗争
*致中国的所有作家、艺术家、教授、学生等*
....................................................................................
致全世界致力于改善社会和人类的作者、作家及所有文化团体。

同志们：

自1931年2月7日反动国民党残忍杀害并活埋五名左翼作家及二十二名共产党员以来，中国较进步的文化运动不得不完全转入地下。那些不与国民党反动政策同流合污的重要作家、剧作家、诗人及其他知识分子阶层成员，始终面临着非法逮捕和处决的威胁。过去两年，由于蒋介石及其政府公然出卖中国民众并向帝国主义列强完全投降，工人、农民和革命知识分子被激起进行更加坚决和有力的斗争。因此，为了保住其最后的政治气息，蒋介石及其匪帮毫不犹豫地采取最臭名昭著和卑鄙的手段来对付其政治敌人，包括组织所谓的蓝衣社，进行绑架和私人暗杀。丁玲女士、潘费年先生、应书仁先生等著名左翼作家的案件，使得蓝衣社的行径成为所有人——甚至是在华外国人——皆知的公开秘密。最近，随着中国红军取得非常迅速、强大和实质性的进展，以及民众普遍表现出更明显的反国民党和反帝国主义情绪，蓝衣社甚至敢于公开在其出版物中宣称，再次实施历史上“屠杀知识分子和焚毁所有书籍”的时机已经成熟，并在大专院校和学校中进行“剿匪运动”。

They have made good their threat! On the 21st of December, through the working together of the Blue Shirts gangsters and the police, eleven universities at Shanghai were raided in one night, and more than three hundred arrests were made. And in the same week, books of a literary nature or dealing with sociological studies, if they should contain the least bit of advanced ideas, and Chinese made moving pictures, depicting actual conditions, were totally suppressed. Writers arrested without warrants; their homes freely searched; moving picture manufacturers, printers, and bookstores were visited at some uncanny moments to destroy goods, fixture and machineries.
China, at present, is in a more dark state than the Middle Age. The members of the Chinese Left Wing Cultural Movement Alliance, besides organizing the oppressed masses to carry on unrelenting struggle with the atrocious ruling class, wish to report to you the actual conditions here and request you to broadcast the same information to all comrades. It is only through the solidarity of the toiling masses of all nations that such darkness may be ended. Use your pens. Use your strength, to help us put down this inhumane Kuomintang terror!
The Chinese Left Wing Cultural Movement alliance
To Writers, Artists and Poets of the World!
Under the kuomintang's bloodthirsty rule, the toiling millions of China have no alternative to choose. The only one path they are traveling on is revolution in the one direction and death in the other.
Revolution which is a matter of life and death to the oppressed masses is raging side by side with the going to pieces of the Kuomintang's rule. The deepened crisis in economic life in this country, the ever-increasing rise of huge masses of workers and peasants to revolution, and the diversion to the left of intellectuals in thought and action have revealed the complete bankruptcy of the Kuomintang in its truculent administration. A giant triumph is no doubt coming ahead to the revolutionary worker and peasant masses.
In its last hour of death, the reactionary Kuomintang is trying once more by its ear-old massacre policy to save itself out of fatal knocks. The world could not forget the death of Hu Yeh-ping and other young Left writers in China who were buried alive by the White Terror of the Kuomintang in February 1931. The previous year the world was once more stirred by two barbarities that happened here: the kidnapping of Ting Ling, wife of the martyred Hu Yeh-ping, and of Pan Tze-nien and Ying Shu-jen, and the open murder of Yang Chien. Now the world is called for the third time to a new drive organized by the Kuomintang, a drive which parallels itself with an ancient aspect of China in time out of mind who set every book on fire and buried scholars alive, a drive which Hitler has carried out in Germany.
On the night of December 21 1933, two hundred citizens, professors and students, were kidnapped by the Shanghai Bureau of Public Safety for no reason whatever, and publications even of free thought were closed by force. The terror is extending to every corner of this country and human lives and culture are being set under the grip of brutality.
We call upon you for support in our fight. In the name of human civilization we call for your comradely support in our knock to the Kuomintang's rule which is on its way to doom.
On to the struggle against the fascist Kuomintang white terror and against the Facist terror throughout the world!
China League of Left Writers
January, 1934, Shanghai, China.

RED ARMIES SCORED NEW VICTORIES
in Crushing the 5th Campaign

Since its commencement the 5th campaign has passed through three months under the personal direction of Chiang Kai-shek who acts on direct instruction from international imperialism. Chiang has thrown 500,000 troops into the drive besides more than 100 bombers. Equipped with the newest weapons from Germany and France, the troops are also aided by fascist units. Among the KMT troops at the front we find the Tax Corps reputed to be the best of Chiang's fighting units. In face of this mighty force the red armies, however, won many significant victories over the KMT armed bandits. Recently, they captured Chinkiang, a city not far from Nanchang, provincial capital of Kiangsi, and almost reached the outskirts of Nanchang as we reported in our previous issues.

他们已使威胁成为现实！12月21日，通过蓝衣社暴徒与警察的勾结，上海一夜之间突袭了十一所大学，逮捕了三百余人。就在同一周，凡是带有丝毫进步思想的文学或社会学研究书籍，以及描绘现实状况的国产电影，均遭全面查禁。作家在无逮捕令的情况下被捕；他们的住所遭到随意搜查；电影制片厂、印刷厂和书店在某些令人毛骨悚然的时刻遭到闯入，货物、固定装置和机器被毁坏。
目前的中国处于比中世纪更为黑暗的状态。中国左翼文化运动同盟的成员，除了组织受压迫群众与残暴的统治阶级进行不懈斗争外，谨向诸位报告此地的实际情况，并请求你们将同样的信息广播给所有同志。只有依靠各国劳苦大众的团结，才能终结这种黑暗。请运用你们的笔。请运用你们的力量，帮助我们推翻这不人道的国民党恐怖统治！
中国左翼文化运动同盟
致全世界的作家、艺术家和诗人！
在国民党血腥的统治下，中国的千万劳苦大众别无选择。他们行走的唯一道路，一端是革命，另一端是死亡。
对于受压迫群众而言生死攸关的革命，正随着国民党统治的分崩离析而猛烈发展。该国经济生活的危机加深，广大工农群众日益高涨的革命浪潮，以及知识分子在思想和行动上的左转，都揭示了国民党在其凶悍管理下的彻底破产。毫无疑问，巨大的胜利正等待着革命的工农群众。
在其垂死之际，反动的国民党正试图再次通过其陈旧的屠杀政策来将自己从致命打击中拯救出来。世界不会忘记胡也频和其他中国年轻左翼作家的死亡，他们于1931年2月被国民党的白色恐怖活埋。前一年，世界再次因发生在此地的两起野蛮行径而震动：烈士胡也频的妻子丁玲，以及潘梓年和应修人被绑架，杨铨被公开谋杀。现在，世界第三次被呼吁关注由国民党发起的新攻势，这一攻势与中国远古时期焚书坑儒的古老面貌如出一辙，也与希特勒在德国实施的行径相平行。
1933年12月21日晚，两百名市民、教授和学生被上海公安局毫无理由地绑架，甚至自由思想的出版物也被强行关闭。恐怖正蔓延至全国的每一个角落，人类生命和文化正被置于残暴的掌控之下。
我们呼吁你们支持我们的斗争。以人类文明的名义，我们呼吁你们给予同志般的支持，打击那正走向灭亡的国民党统治。
向着反对法西斯国民党白色恐怖和反对全世界法西斯恐怖的斗争前进！
中国左翼作家联盟
1934年1月，中国上海。

红军在粉碎第五次“围剿”中取得新的胜利

第五次“围剿”开始以来，已在蒋介石的个人指挥下进行了三个月，蒋是直接按照国际帝国主义的指示行事的。除了十多架轰炸机外，蒋还投入了五十万兵力参与此次攻势。这些部队装备了来自德国和法国的最新武器，并得到法西斯部队的援助。在国民党前线部队中，我们发现税警团，这被认为是蒋介石最好的作战部队之一。然而，面对这股强大的力量，红军在对抗国民党武装匪徒时赢得了许多重大胜利。最近，他们攻占了离江西省会南昌不远的金城（Chinkiang，音译），正如我们在前几期报道的那样，几乎到达了南昌郊区。

German adviser wounded
On Dec.24 the red armies smashed the greater portion of the half
cavalry regiment and took Chinkiang while two days later the red army
operating in Fengli, a neighboring hsien, defeated two regiments belong-
ing to the 18th and 19th divisions. In their march on Nanchang the red
armies occupied Wansukung (near Nanchang). Then the 6th Corps came to
meet the advancing red armies but suffered reverses. A red corporal put
one company of the corps to flight by throwing a hand grenade. In this
confusion a German adviser came forward to reconnoiter but received a
serious wound in the arm. Further, a week before the red army in Lichuan
dealt a crushing blow to the 5th, 6th, 96th regiments of the KMT bands,
wounding dozens of captains.
Turning to Fukien, we have on hand a brilliant record of new vic-
tories for the red army. On Dec.24 the red army fighting in Fukien re-
captured Tienlo and Kweichow from the KMT troops and won a minor engage-
ment in Yinping. The Tatunpao of Shanghai reported on Jan.21 the cap-
ture of Shuisien and Yochi, two hsicns adjoining Kianglo. These triumphs
of the red armies extended the Soviet territory by 300 square li.
Along the Kiangsi-Chekiang border the red armies also achieved some
minor successes. The Soviet territory in Changshan and Yuson has been en-
larged by several hundred square li.

The Brilliant Record
Workers and peasants in China are proud to look back at the long re-
cord of victories of the red army. From the spring of 1932 to October,
1933, the red armies won a series of brilliant successes in fighting the
KMT armed bandits on all sides. In April, 1932, the first corps of the
red army smashed the 47th division of Chiang Hsen and the division of Chen
Choumei (the bandit chief but incorporated by the KMT), captured Changchow
and Lungai near Amoy, seized planes and an arsenal besides thousands of
rifles. In July, 1932, the red armies crushed 13 regiments of the Kwang-
tung army in South Kiangsi and chased them out of the province. Now the
Kwangtung bandits operating in the Kiangsi-Kwangtung borders dare not to
envisage an expedition northwards against the reds.
In February, 1933, the 1st corps of the red army advanced on Hsuchow
(near Suchow) and defeated three divisions of Chiang Kai-shek, namely,
the 90th, 14th and 27th, all crack units. Later in the month two more
divisions of Chiang, the 59th and 52th, were practically annihilated.
Unable to recover from these decisive blows, Chiang had to close his 4th
campaign and prepared for the 5th. During October the red armies shifted
to Fukien and captured Yuchi and Yangkow in a triumphant march on Foochow.
In the same month the red army met the white bandits at Shaoshi, Kiang-
si, annihilated 4 regiments of the 5th and 6th divisions, and smashed the
96th, a victory that compelled Chiang Kai-shek to postpone the 5th cam-
paign by one month.
In our stock-taking of the achievements of the red army we find that
the heroic red armies fought on a battlefield extending from Nanchang to
the north of Kwangtung several thousand li in length and width, met the
enemy in 56 wars major and minor, annihilated 4 divisions, 3 brigades,
26 regiments, 3 battalions, crushed another 4 divisions, 1 brigade, 36
regiments, 20 battalions, captured 41,000 rifles, 250 machine guns, 95
light machine guns, 240 automatic rifles, 12 wireless sets, 3 aeroplanes,
3 field guns, took 40,000 prisoners including 1 divisional commander, 5
brigadier-generals, 9 regimental commanders, 20 captains, shot dead 1
divisional commander, 4 brigadier-generals, 14 regimental commanders, 30
captains.
In addition to these positive successes of the red armies we have also
a bright record for the red partisans who, cooperating with the red army
or fighting single-handed, have won many significant triumphs in the re-
gions bordering on the red and white territory. In the course of fighting
in seven month's time from February to September, 1933, they fought in
113 engagements, seized 1,580 rifles; captured 500 Mauser.

德国顾问受伤
12月24日，红军击溃了半个骑兵团的大部分兵力并攻占金城（Chinkiang，音译），两天后，在邻近县份丰里（Fengli，音译）作战的红军击败了属于第18和第19师的两个团。在向南昌进军的过程中，红军占领了万寿宫（Wansukung，靠近南昌）。随后，第6军前来迎击 advancing 红军，但遭受挫败。一名红军下士投掷一枚手榴弹，致使该军的一个连溃逃。在这场混乱中，一名德国顾问上前侦察，但手臂受重伤。此外，一周前，黎川（Lichuan）的红军对国民党匪帮的第5、第6、第96团给予了毁灭性打击，打伤数十名连长。
转向福建方面，我们手头有一份红军新胜利的辉煌记录。12月24日，在福建作战的红军从国民党军队手中重新夺回了田螺（Tienlo，音译）和贵州（Kweichow，此处原文疑有误，或指特定地名，按音译保留），并在银屏（Yinping，音译）赢得了一场小规模战斗。上海的《大公报》（Tatunpao，音译，注：通常指Ta Kung Pao，此处依原文拼写）在1月21日报道了攻占水先（Shuisien，音译）和约池（Yochi，音译）两个毗邻江洛（Kianglo，音译）的县份。红军的这些胜利将苏区领土扩大了三百平方里。
在赣浙边境，红军也取得了一些小胜。常山（Changshan）和玉山（Yuson，音译，注：通常指Yushan）的苏区领土扩大了几百平方里。

辉煌战绩
中国的工人和农民自豪地回顾红军的长期胜利记录。从1932年春到1933年10月，红军在各方面对抗国民党武装匪徒的战斗中取得了一系列辉煌成功。1932年4月，红军第一军团击溃了蒋先（Chiang Hsen，音译）的第47师和陈卓梅（Chen Choumei，音译，原为匪首后被国民党收编）的师，攻占了厦门附近的漳州（Changchow）和龙溪（Lungai，音译，注：可能指龙岩Longyan或龙海等地，依原文音译），缴获了飞机和兵工厂，以及数千支步枪。1932年7月，红军在赣南击溃了粤军的13个团，并将其逐出该省。现在，在赣粤边境活动的粤系匪徒不敢再设想向北远征进攻红军。
1933年2月，红军第一军团向徐洲（Hsuchow，音译，靠近苏州Suchow）进军，击败了蒋介石的三个师，即第90、第14和第27师，这些都是精锐部队。当月晚些时候，蒋的另外两个师，第59和第52师，几乎被全歼。蒋介石无法从这些决定性打击中恢复过来，不得不结束其第四次“围剿”，并准备第五次“围剿”。10月间，红军转移至福建，在向福州进军的胜利征程中攻占了余池（Yuchi，音译）和杨口（Yangkow，音译）。同月，红军在江西邵武（Shaoshi，音译，注：通常指Shaowu）遭遇白色匪徒，全歼第5和第6师的4个团，并击溃第96团，这一胜利迫使蒋介石将第五次“围剿”推迟一个月。
在总结红军的成就时，我们发现，英勇的红军在从南昌到粤北的纵横数千里的战场上作战，经历了56次大小战争，全歼4个师、3个旅、26个团、3个营，击溃另外4个师、1个旅、36个团、20个营，缴获步枪41,000支、机枪250挺、轻机枪95挺、自动步枪240支、无线电台12部、飞机3架、野战炮3门，俘虏40,000人，其中包括1名师长、5名旅长、9名团长、20名连长，击毙1名师长、4名旅长、14名团长、30名连长。
除了红军的这些积极成果外，红色游击队也有光辉的记录，他们通过与红军合作或单独作战，在红白区域交界地区赢得了许多重大胜利。在1933年2月至9月的七个月战斗过程中，他们参加了113次战斗，缴获步枪1,580支；俘获毛瑟枪500支。

关于法西斯分子绑架上海学生的宣言
由中国共产党发布，
1934年1月11日
（以下是中国共产党中央执行委员会和中国共产主义青年团中央执行委员会于1934年1月11日就此场合发布的上述宣言的简要译文

of the kidnapping of over 100 students enrolled in seven universities at Shanghai, the kidnapping being carried out by the fascists with the aid of men from the public safety bureau and the garrison commander's office of Shanghai—Ed.).

The opposition of the democratic dictatorship of workers and peasants to the dictatorship of the Tuhao-landlord-bourgeoisie, combined with the struggle for the former, is a matter of death or life to the millions in China.

Besides feverish mobilization to attack the Soviet and red armies and the revolutionary vanguard (the communist party) the KMT is actively suppressing every minor struggle or resistance of the worker and peasant, and will not hesitate a single minute in shooting the struggling masses even though no traces of communist leadership are found in the struggles. High handed action is reserved for those students and youths who dare to express any opinion against imperialism and slavery or to come out in the open with liberalist tendencies. Any anti-imperialist movement bent on the liberation of the nation will be ruthlessly put down.

The students at Shanghai were kidnapped simply because they refused to act as slaves of imperialism. They were outspoken in their attitude against the KMT's policy of enslaving the nation and selling it to imperialism. Realising that every syllable uttered by the students may call forth a storm against the KMT's slavery system, the Kuomintang must try everything in its power to wipe out the disgruntled elements, be they students or workers or peasants. It dreams of crushing the mass movement against the 5th campaign by this method of barbarity. It, too, dreams of checking the growing tide against imperialism and the revolutionary struggle of the workers and peasants led by the proletariat in the same barbarous way. But the victories of the red armies, the ceaseless strikes and the mass struggles against taxes and rent throughout the country, the radicalisation and revolutionisation of the youths on a national scale, etc, can not be suppressed by bloody action. On the contrary, bloody action only means decay of the KMT rule.

With revolutionary experiences of over 10 years and entrusted with the leadership of the revolution against the exploiting system of imperialism and landlord-bourgeoisie, workers of China are absolutely in favor of the movement as carried on by the advanced and conscious, young intelligentsia. The Tuhao-landlord-bourgeoisie of China has long ago cast overboard the genuine cultural force and the genuine scientific-artistic progress. What it needs is slaves for the landlord and bourgeoisie and imperialism. It will, to be sure, finish any unwilling slaves at once. Workers of China are developing a prospect for the new social system, nay struggling for this outlook. They place a great value on the advanced cultural forces and will enlist their sympathy and aid in pushing the new cultural development, they will rally the masses in a united front against the relentless dark forces. At present they call on the masses, all of them, to immediately arise against the raging fascist white terrors. Students, young intelligentsia, advanced members of the liberal profession!

You want a free and independent China in defiance of imperialism. You want democratic rights, free culture and cultured life, too. Just look at the arrest of 100 students at Shanghai. They are innocent but thrown into prison. You must understand that words or actions, bodies or individuals are guilty if they aim to support advanced culture or denounce imperialism.

On this ground alone, many papers were suppressed, book stores stormed, film companies attacked. Not long ago a lawyer speaking in behalf of the anti-Japanese volunteers was dragged into prison and beaten by bamboo poles. Worse still, a journalist at Chinkiang was shot for having written articles depicting miseries and hardships of the people. Now the KMT has made good its threat by arresting the students in Shanghai.

Now you must rise up and organise a wide protest movement. Unity is of special importance at present in a movement against the dark force of the landlord-bourgeoisie. Unity assures success in the counter attack against the onslaught of the dark forces. The present mighty revolutionary force emerges from struggles quite unarmed in the very beginning. Otherwise you have but one alternative: submission to the dark forces themselves.

Students!
Rise at once in a protest against the kidnapping, demand release of the

关于在上海七所大学就读的一百多名学生遭绑架一事，该绑架行动由法西斯分子在上海市公安局及上海卫戍司令办公室人员的协助下实施——编者注）。

工农民主专政对土豪-地主-资产阶级专政的反对，以及为前者而进行的斗争，关系到中国数百万人的生死存亡。

国民党除了狂热地动员进攻苏维埃和红军以及革命先锋队（共产党）外，还积极镇压工人和农民的每一次微小斗争或抵抗，即使在斗争中未发现任何共产党领导的痕迹，也毫不犹豫地枪杀挣扎中的群众。对于那些敢于表达对帝国主义和奴役制的任何反对意见，或公开表现出自由主义倾向的学生和青年，则采取高压手段。任何旨在解放国家的反帝运动都将遭到无情镇压。

上海的学生被绑架，仅仅是因为他们拒绝充当帝国主义的奴隶。他们直言不讳地反对国民党出卖国家、将其沦为帝国主义附庸的政策。国民党意识到学生们说出的每一个字都可能引发反对国民党奴役制度的风暴，因此必须竭尽全力消灭这些不满分子，无论他们是学生、工人还是农民。它梦想通过这种野蛮手段粉碎反对第五次“围剿”的群众运动。它同样梦想以同样的野蛮方式遏制日益高涨的反帝浪潮以及由无产阶级领导的工农革命斗争。但是，红军的胜利、全国范围内不断的罢工以及反对捐税和租金的群众斗争、全国青年的激进化与革命化等，是无法通过血腥行动来压制的。相反，血腥行动只意味着国民党统治的衰败。

拥有十多年革命经验并肩负着领导反对帝国主义和地主-资产阶级剥削制度革命重任的中国工人，绝对支持由先进且有觉悟的青年知识分子所开展的运动。中国的土豪-地主-资产阶级早已抛弃了真正的文化力量和真正的科学艺术进步。它所需要的是供地主、资产阶级和帝国主义驱使的奴隶。当然，它会立即处置任何不愿为奴的人。中国工人正在展望新的社会制度，并为这一前景而奋斗。他们高度重视先进的文化力量，并将争取其同情与援助，以推动新文化的发展；他们将团结群众，组成统一战线，对抗无情的黑暗势力。目前，他们号召全体民众立即起来反抗猖獗的法西斯白色恐怖。学生们、青年知识分子们、自由职业界的先进成员们！

你们想要一个不受帝国主义支配的自由独立的中国。你们也想要民主权利、自由的文化和有教养的生活。看看上海一百名学生被捕的事吧。他们是无辜的，却被投入监狱。你们必须明白，如果旨在支持先进文化或谴责帝国主义，那么言语或行动、身体或个人都是有罪的。

仅凭这一点，许多报纸被查禁，书店被冲击，电影公司受攻击。不久前，一位代表抗日义勇军发言的律师被拖入监狱并遭受竹竿毒打。更糟糕的是，镇江一名记者因撰写描绘人民苦难的文章而被枪杀。现在，国民党通过逮捕上海的学生，使其威胁成为现实。

现在你们必须奋起，组织广泛的抗议运动。在反对地主-资产阶级黑暗势力的运动中，团结尤为重要。团结保证了在反击黑暗势力进攻时的成功。目前强大的革命力量起初是在毫无武装的情况下从斗争中涌现出来的。否则，你们只有一条路可走：向黑暗势力本身屈服。

学生们！
立即起身抗议绑架行为，要求释放被

arrested, ask for freedom of speech, assembly, publication. All advanced journalists, lawyers, artists, authors, scientists, etc, unite in a protest against the raging white terror of the ruling class, against the barbarities of the ruling class in violation of liberty, etc. Build up a genuine united front against imperialism and fascism.
You are faced with two roads: the path to colonization and slavery, the path to the Soviet revolution. The decisive victory of the Soviet is the only assurance against the imperialist attempts at division of China or bringing China under international control. No doubt those joining the united front against imperialism and fascism will work for the success of the Soviet revolution.

MOVEMENT AFOOT TO DEMAND RELEASE OF RUEGGS
Paul Rueggs, a leader of the worker movement in the countries adjoining the Pacific and an active supporter of the Chinese revolutionary movement, was taken into custody three years ago by British imperialist agents and then handed over to Chinese henchmen for torture. His wife, Gertrude Rueggs, met with the same fate, too. The pair languished three years in the filthy and inhuman jail. Quite a number of savants and scientists in foreign countries as well as in China made a strong plea for their liberation and, with this end in view, addressed many communications to the National government at Nanking. In face of this pressure the KMT mandarins promised to release the pair now held in Nanking; but never backed up their promise with actions. On the contrary, the KMT officials recently tortured the pair so much that the latter were compelled to go on a hunger strike for nearly a month. During the strike Madam Sun Yat-sen wired Nanking twice asking for the immediate release of the Rueggs but received no answer whatsoever so far. Comrade Harold R. Ithaca, member of the committee organised to save the Rueggs, recently went on a trip to Nanking and experienced considerable difficulty in securing the permission to take a personal look at the weakened pair. He gave a graphic account of what he saw in the China Forum, Jan.13, 1934. The KMT will not release the Rueggs unless forced so to do by the tremendous pressure of the masses. Now a movement is on foot here in Shanghai among the workers as well as advanced intelligentsia to demand the liberation of the Rueggs together with other prisoners of Chinese nationality, all imprisoned in Nanking for no other reason than their identification with the worker movement in China—their leading role in that movement.

MORE KMT'S DESPERATE EFFORTS
to Push the 5th Campaign
During the process of the 5th campaign, now feverishly pushed ahead by the KMT, the heroic red armies have successively directed decisive blows against the white bandits of the Kuomintang. Fresh victories of the red armies in the past two weeks in Kiangsi and Fukien have certainly opened a brighter perspective before the eyes of the wide masses of workers, peasants and other toilers but, on the other hand, have provided a powerful stimulus to the different fractions of the Chinese Tuhao-landlord-bourgeoisie in making new attempts to get together for the badly needed team work, that is, maintenance of the tottering imperialist-landlord-bourgeois rule.
Debacle of People's Government
Since its inauguration on Nov.20, 1933, the people's government in Fukien has deluged the country with numbers of empty phrases against imperialism, against the betraying Nanking regime, for distribution of land among the population, for democratic rights to be granted to the people, etc. But On Jan.13, 1934, leaders of the 19th route army and of the people's government sold and surrendered Foochow, seat of the government, to Chiang Kai-shek at a price of $6,000,000. Another version puts the price only at $1,500,000. Nine days later four generals of the 19th route army issued a circular telegram announcing their secession from the people's government and their support to Nanking. Chiang Kai-shek offered to buy while the 19th route army to sell, both for the realisation of a more united front in massacring workers and peasants in Kiangsi in the 5th crusade. The crumble of the people's government signifies nothing other than that a handful of swindlers will not be able to maintain themselves in position for a long time, that the people's government is but a farce designed by a fraction of the Tuhao-landlord-bourgeoisie to fool the people, that the analysis and conclusions of the Communist Party of China regarding the People's Government have proved entirely correct.
As is known to all, the fall of the people's government will bring Chiang

捕者，要求言论、集会和出版自由。所有进步的记者、律师、艺术家、作家、科学家等，联合起来抗议统治阶级猖獗的白色恐怖，抗议统治阶级侵犯自由等暴行。建立真正的反帝国主义和反法西斯统一战线。
你们面临两条道路：殖民化和奴役之路，苏维埃革命之路。苏维埃的决定性胜利是防止帝国主义企图分裂中国或将中国置于国际控制之下的唯一保障。毫无疑问，加入反帝国主义和反法西斯统一战线的人们将为苏维埃革命的成功而努力。

要求释放吕埃格斯（Rueggs）的运动正在兴起

保罗·吕埃格斯（Paul Rueggs）是环太平洋国家工人运动的领袖，也是中国革命运动的积极支持者，三年前被英国帝国主义代理人拘留，随后移交给中国爪牙进行拷打。他的妻子格特鲁德·吕埃格斯（Gertrude Rueggs）也遭遇了同样的命运。这对夫妇在肮脏且不人道的监狱中受苦三年。国外以及中国的相当数量的学者和科学家强烈呼吁释放他们，并为此目的向南京国民政府发出了许多信函。面对这种压力，国民党官员承诺释放目前关押在南京的这对夫妇；但从未以实际行动履行承诺。相反，国民党官员最近对这对夫妇施以酷刑，迫使他们进行了近一个月的绝食抗议。在绝食期间，孙夫人两次致电南京，要求立即释放吕埃格斯夫妇，但至今未收到任何答复。拯救吕埃格斯委员会成员哈罗德·R·伊萨卡（Harold R. Ithaca，音译）同志最近前往南京，在获准亲自探视这对虚弱的夫妇时遇到了相当大的困难。他在1934年1月13日的《中国论坛》（China Forum）上生动地描述了他的所见所闻。除非受到群众巨大的压力迫使，否则国民党不会释放吕埃格斯夫妇。目前，上海的工人以及先进知识分子中正在开展一场运动，要求释放吕埃格斯夫妇以及其他中国籍囚犯，这些人被关押在南京的唯一原因便是他们认同中国的工人运动——并在该运动中发挥领导作用。

国民党加紧努力
推进第五次“围剿”

在国民党正狂热推进的第五次“围剿”过程中，英勇的红军接连对国民党的白匪给予决定性打击。过去两周红军在江苏（Kiangsu）和福建取得的新胜利，无疑在广大工人、农民和其他劳动者眼前展现了更光明的前景，但另一方面，这也强烈刺激了中国土豪-地主-资产阶级的各派系，促使他们再次尝试联合起来进行迫切需要的协同合作，即维持摇摇欲坠的帝国主义-地主-资产阶级统治。

人民政府的溃败

自1933年11月20日成立以来，福建的人民政府用大量空洞的词藻充斥全国，如反对帝国主义、反对背叛的南京政权、向民众分配土地、授予人民民主权利等。但在1934年1月13日，第十九路军和人民政府的领导层以600万美元的价格将政府所在地福州出卖并投降给蒋介石。另一种说法称价格仅为150万美元。九天后，第十九路军的四位将军发布通电，宣布脱离人民政府并支持南京方面。蒋介石出价购买，第十九路军出售，双方都是为了实现在第五次“围剿”中更统一地屠杀江苏（Kiangsu）的工人和农民的前线。人民政府的垮台仅仅表明，一小撮骗子无法长期维持其地位；人民政府不过是土豪-地主-资产阶级的一部分为愚弄人民而设计的闹剧；中国共产党关于人民政府的分析和结论已被证明是完全正确的。
众所周知，人民政府的倒台将使蒋

Certainly the latter will utilize the defeated 19th Route Army, as the
reserved guard against Chiang Kai-shek while the 19th Route Army, both offi-
cers and men, is still hostile to Chiang. The 19th Route Army beat retreat
it has been able to keep its force of 40,000 intact. Its leaders preferred
outright sale to fighting. Since Chiang's offensive began the 19th Route Ar-
my offered only weak resistance, everywhere yielding the ground without se-
rious fighting. Now the 19th Route Army is just negotiating with Kwantung and
Kwangsi for an alliance against Chang Kai-shek. In view of Kwangtung's deci-
sion to send five divisions into Fukien the conversations may have probably
resulted in some measure of success. The 19th Route Army, therefore, plays
the role of a two faced diplomatist in regard to Nanking and Kwangtung. At
the same time, the red armies advanced last week far into Fukien, defeating
the white bandits as they went along. The hard pressed peasants also fought
stubbornly against the 19th Route Army and the hordes of Chiang. Far
from being a success in favor of unity and unification of the country as
claimed by the fascist papers here, the breakdown of the People's Government
can in no way be interpreted as consolidation of Chiang's power in the South.
The 4th Plenary Session of KMT
As long expected, the 4th plenary session of the KMT opened Jan. 20 at
Nanking. The Kwangtung fraction of the members of CEC, as usual, boycotted the
session but, in token of their wish for unity, appointed a representative in
their behalf. The session will cost the toiling masses $6,300 in cash. Each
CEC member will receive $1,000 as travelling expense, a usual practice adopted
by Chiang-Kai-shek to buy over his opponents.
In delivering the opening speech, Wang Chin-wei (Prime Minister) was quite
careful in saying nothing about the Japanese plan of converting Manchuria in-
to a monarchy because this will be deemed as an unfriendly manifestation to
Japanese imperialism. In conclusion, he only exhorted his comrades with "will-
ing to submit". What this phrase means is well indicated in an editorial of the
fascist organ, the Morning Post, published in Shanghai. On January 21 the
said paper explained "willing to submit" in the following terms:-"At the very
beginning of the Manchurian incident we made a great blunder in fighting Japan
which is immensely stronger than us. The Tangku agreement is the natural re-
sult. We must not permit ourselves controlled by the spirit: glory even though
defeated in a war. We must not run the risk of exposing our vast territory to
Japanese bombing and firing". Thus viewed, the KMT's policy of surrender falls
entirely in line with the betrayal of national interests. Hence "willing to
submit". Besides the KMT papers, other bourgeois journals such as The Ta Kung
Pao, Shun Pao, etc, have shown considerable optimism in their views on the
probable success of the 5th campaign allegedly facilitated by the Fukien de-
bacle, but workers and peasants are confident that the red armies will shatter
the 5th crusade exactly in the same way as they did the previous four drives.
Another 100 Million Bonds
The war against the Soviet and the purchase of the 19th Route Army togeth-
er with minor militarist wars have cost Nanking millions of dollars. Since
the Fukien coup the Nanking regime has spent almost 40 millions, $15,000,000
paid to Kwangtung and Kwangsi in exchange for their friendly neutrality, 10
millions given to the bandit chiefs in Fukien to attack the 19th Route Army
last year, then finally another 10 million to buy over the remnants of the
Route Army. During the height of the campaign against Fukien many influen-
tial but vacillating militarists and politicians demanded and obtained large
sums of money from Chiang Kai-shek who always won the war by purchase.
In the morning of January 12 the Legislative Yuan passed in a secret ses-
sion the regulations governing the issue of the 100 million bonds which, as a
matter of fact, were long ago turned over to the Shanghai banks for 50 mil-
lion cash. The remaining 50 millions accrued to the fat bankers as a profit.
Under the circumstances the bankers are but too glad to underwrite the bonds, particularly
because the greater portion of it will be used to push the 5th campaign.
The picture has also its gloomy side. According to reliable information
in high banking circles Nanking will experience insurmountable difficulties
in trying to float another loan of the same dimensions in Shanghai. In view
of present circumstances Nanking must issue another loan within two or three
months. The sight of this prospect has depressed the bond market here consi-
derably. In reality, Shanghai is no longer in a position to absorb more huge
loans.
In a word, the surrender of the 19th Route Army to Chiang Kai-shek and
the defeat of the 4th plenary session of the KMT and the 100 million
bonds are all symptoms of the further disintegration of the feudal-landlord-bourgeois
dictatorship and serve only to bolster up the shaken rule on a more or

介石与广东和广西的军阀陷入更尖锐的冲突——
当然，后者将利用战败的第19路军，作为
防备蒋介石的后备力量，而第19路军的官兵
至今仍对蒋怀有敌意。第19路军在撤退时
得以保持其4万人的兵力完整无损。其领导人
宁愿 outright sale（原文如此，意指彻底出卖/投降）也不愿作战。自从蒋介石发动进攻以来，第19路军
仅进行了微弱的抵抗，处处不经过激烈战斗便放弃阵地。现在，第19路军正与广东和
广西方面谈判，结成反蒋联盟。鉴于广东决定
派遣五个师进入福建，会谈可能已经
取得了一定程度的成功。因此，第19路军在对南京和广东的关系上
扮演着两面派外交家的角色。同
时，红军上周深入福建腹地，沿途击败
白匪。受压迫的农民也顽强地
对抗第19路军和蒋介石的大军。远
非如本地法西斯报刊所声称的那样有利于国家
团结和统一，人民政府的垮台
绝不能被解释为蒋介石在南方权力的巩固。
国民党四中全会
正如预期的那样，国民党四中全会于1月20日在
南京开幕。国民党中央执行委员会中的广东派成员，像往常一样抵制了
会议，但为了表示他们希望团结，指定了一名代表
代表他们出席。这次会议将使劳动群众花费6,300美元现金。每位
中央执行委员将获得1,000美元作为旅费，这是蒋介石
收买对手的一贯做法。
汪精卫（行政院长）在致开幕词时非常
谨慎，只字不提日本将满洲变为
君主国的计划，因为这将被视为对
日本帝国主义的不友好表现。最后，他仅用“愿意服从”来劝勉
他的同志。这句话的含义在上海出版的法西斯机关报《晨报》的一篇社论中
得到了很好的说明。1月21日，该报
对“愿意服从”作了如下解释：“在‘九一八’事变
伊始，我们犯了一个巨大的错误，即与比我们强大得多的日本作战。《塘沽协定》是自然的结
果。我们决不能让自己受‘虽败犹荣’精神的控制。我们决不能冒让我国广大领土
遭受日本轰炸和炮击的风险”。由此看来，国民党的投降政策完全
符合出卖民族利益的行为。因此有了“愿意服从”。除了国民党报纸外，其他资产阶级刊物如《大公
报》、《申报》等，对于据称因福建事变而促成的第五次“围剿”可能
成功的前景，表现出相当乐观的态度，但工人和农民坚信，红军将以与前四次“围剿”
相同的方式粉碎第五次“围剿”。
又一亿元公债
反苏战争以及收买第19路军，加上
小规模军阀混战，已使南京耗费数百万美元。自
福建事变以来，南京政权已花费近4,000万元，其中1,500万美元
支付给广东和广西，以换取他们的友好中立，1,000万
元给予福建的匪首，用于去年攻击第19路军，最后又拿出1,000万
元收买第19路军的残部。在进攻福建的高潮期间，许多有影响力但
摇摆不定的军阀和政治家向蒋介石索要并获得了大笔
资金，蒋介石总是通过收买来赢得战争。
1月12日上午，立法院在一次秘密会议上通过了管理发行1亿元公债的条例，事实上，这些公债早已以5,000万
元现金的价格移交给了上海银行。剩余的5,000万
元作为利润落入了肥头大耳的银行家手中。在这种情况下，银行家们非常乐意承销这些公债，特别是
因为其中大部分将用于推动第五次“围剿”。
局势也有其阴暗面。根据高层银行界可靠的消息，南京在试图在上海浮动另一笔同等规模的贷款时将面临不可克服的困难。鉴于目前的情况，南京必须在两三个月内发行另一笔贷款。这一前景使得这里的债券市场相当低迷。实际上，上海已不再有能力吸收更多巨额贷款。
总之，第19路军向蒋介石投降、国民党四中全会的失败以及1亿元

CHINESE WORKERS' CORRESPONDENCE VOL III N. 37 20. June 1933

TWO YEARS' FIGHTING RECORD OF THE RED ARMIES OF CHINA

In order to regain their rule of landlords and gentry class in the Soviet districts, KMT of China has incessantly directed its attack towards the Soviet districts of China, especially when the Japanese imperialists have taken Manchuria and are pressing towards North China. The two years and three months' fight that the red armies have waged against the KMT in defending and developing Soviet districts has set in the History of Chinese Revolution the following splendid record:

1. 283,000 white soldiers dissolved.
2. 157,000 white soldiers captured.
3. 129,000 Rifles seized.
4. 7 division commanders, 2 vice division commanders, 9 Brigadier generals, 1 vice Brigadier general, & 17 Regimental colonels were captured.

The yearly records are as follows:
1931 1. 7 divisions, 5 brigades, 15 regiments (about 50,000) were dissolved.
2. 52,000 white soldiers were seized.
3. 44,000 machine guns, rifles, mortars, etc.
4. 3 divisional commanders, 2 brigadier generals, 2 regimental colonels and one vice divisional commander were captured.
1932 1. 6 divisions, 12 brigades, 6 regiments (about 16,000) were dissolved.
2. 71,000 were captured.
3. 54,600 guns, two airplanes, 290 cannons & 5 radio stations were seized.
4. 2 divisional commanders, 1 vice divisional commander, 6 brigadier generals, 1 vice brigadier general, 14 regimental colonels, 2 Battalion majors & 1 Staff officer were captured.
1933 1. 4 divisions, 3 brigades, 13 regiments (about 63,000)
(Jan. were captured.
to 2. 31,000 were captured.
March) 3. 30,000 guns were seized.
... commanders, 1 brigadier general, 1 staff officer & regimental colonel were captured.

为了在苏区恢复地主和绅士阶级的统治，中国国民党不断将其攻击指向中国的苏区，尤其是在日本帝国主义者占领满洲并向华北推进的时候。红军在保卫和发展苏区的过程中与国民党进行的两年零三个月的战斗，在中国革命史上写下了以下辉煌记录：

CHINESE WORKER'S CORRESPONDENCE VOL.III NO.76 SEPT. 6. 1933
(1) Peasants' Struggles in Kuomintang China, from April to Aug., 1933
(2) Latest Activities in the Soviet Districts

PEASANTS' STRUGGLES IN KUOMINTANG
CHINA, APRIL TO AUG. 1933

I. Rural Conditions
Except that portion, about 10,000,000, in the Soviet-controlled areas
the peasant population of China, amounting not less than 250,000,000 and
forming 85% of the whole Chinese population, under the rule of the Kuomin-
tang-Imperialists alliance, suffers more and more every year. Bankruptcy,
calamities, famines, exorbitant taxes, Imperialists' and Kuomintang's exploi-
tations, civil wars and military services have driven them onto the road
of hunger and death.
The fact that the Chinese rural economy is worsening with accelerated
speed can be shown by statistics of decrease in land possession by the part
of peasants and increase in the number of tenants. The statistics recently
published by the Department of Agricultural Economics, Nanking University,
illustrates very vividly the loss of land in the part of middle peasants,
and the tendency of a rapid increase in the number of tenants (mostly poor
peasants):
Percentage of Different Strata of Chinese Peasants in Various
Years
| Kind of peasants | 1911 | 1931 | 1932 | 1933 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Tenants | 28% | 31% | 31% | 32% |
| Peasants cultivating their own lands | 49% | 46% | 46% | 45% |

Nanking University is an organ run by American Imperialists, and the
above statistics can only be partially accurate, but still it shows how ra-
pidly the Chinese peasants lose their lands. The number of tenants (i.e. pea-
sants who have lost their lands) increased only 3% in the twenty years from
1911 to 1931, but recently it increased so fast that in the period of only
one year, 1932-1933, the number of tenants has gained 1% more, being seven
times faster than before.
Again, according to China Year Book, Japanese edition, Chinese tenants
increased from 26% to 32% from 1918-1919. The number of tenant farmers dou-
bled must be much greater now.
Meanwhile, Chinese peasants are always attacked by floods, insect cala-
mities and famines. The extension of such calamitous areas and the number
of suffering peasants grow practically day by day. The official report of
of the Relief Committee of Kuomintang has announced the following figures:
| Year | No. of calamitous districts | No. of suffering people |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1928 | 203 | 9,485,228 |
| 1929 | 841 | 10,000,000 |
| 1930 | 830 | 4,500,148 |
| 1931 (Big flood exploded) | 519 | 12,456 |
| 1931 (The big flood) | 290 | 45,500,899 |
| 1931 (Total) | 809 | 44,513,305 |

In the report, it stated that many districts had not submitted their
complete figures for the big flood of 1931 can only represent those few
districts where the situation was most serious and where Kuomintang has
sent its men for investigation. In reality, the situation is much worse
than what the above statistics has illustrated.
As to the contents of the calamities, according to the same report,
there were 605 cases of floods, droughts, and insect pests out of the 723
cases of 1929, and out of the 1462 cases in the year 1930, 569 cases were
floods, droughts and locust calamities, while 488 cases were civil war and
banditry calamities. All of them are caused directly or indirectly, by the
misconduct of the Kuomintang Government.
1932 was a year Kuomintang has been proud of its good harvests but cal-
amities still devastated seven provinces, such as floods in Kiangsu, Hu-
peh, Anhwei, Shansi, Szechow and other provinces, the collapse of dikes
in Honan, and the drought after a flood in Kiangsi (Section I of this
book, 1933). While in the rest of the provinces, the harvests were not
dropped as much as a panic, the price of grain fell so low that the
whole crop could not compensate...

中国工人通讯 第三卷 第七十六号 1933年9月6日
(1) 国民党统治下中国的农民斗争，1933年4月至8月
(2) 苏区最新动态

国民党统治下中国的农民斗争，1933年4月至8月

一、农村状况

除了约有一千万人口处于苏维埃控制下的地区外，中国农民人口不少于两亿五千万，占中国总人口的85%，在国民党与帝国主义联盟的统治下，他们的处境逐年恶化。破产、灾荒、饥馑、苛捐杂税、帝国主义和国民党的剥削、内战以及兵役，将他们推向了饥饿和死亡的道路。

中国农村经济加速恶化的事实，可以通过农民土地占有量的减少和佃农数量的增加这一统计数据来证明。南京大学农业经济系最近公布的统计数据，非常生动地说明了中农土地的流失，以及佃农（大多为贫农）数量迅速增加的趋势：

中国各阶层农民在不同年份的百分比
| 农民类别 | 1911年 | 1931年 | 1932年 | 1933年 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 佃农 | 28% | 31% | 31% | 32% |
| 自耕农 | 49% | 46% | 46% | 45% |

南京大学是由美国帝国主义运营的机构，上述统计数据只能部分准确，但它仍然显示了中国农民失去土地的速度之快。从1911年到1931年的二十年间，佃农（即失去土地的农民）的数量仅增加了3%，但最近增长速度极快，仅在1932-1933年这一年期间，佃农数量就增加了1%，速度是之前的七倍。

此外，根据日文版《中国年鉴》，中国佃农比例从1918-1919年的26%增加到32%。如今，佃农数量翻倍的幅度肯定更大。

与此同时，中国农民始终遭受水灾、虫灾和饥荒的袭击。受灾地区的范围和受苦农民的数量实际上与日俱增。国民党救济委员会的官方报告公布了以下数据：
| 年份 | 受灾县区数量 | 受灾人数 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1928 | 203 | 9,485,228 |
| 1929 | 841 | 10,000,000 |
| 1930 | 830 | 4,500,148 |
| 1931年（大水爆发） | 519 | 12,456 |
| 1931年（大水） | 290 | 45,500,899 |
| 1931年（总计） | 809 | 44,513,305 |

报告中指出，许多地区未提交完整数据，因此1931年大水的数据仅代表情况最严重且国民党派人调查的那几个地区。实际上，情况比上述统计数据所显示的还要糟糕得多。

关于灾害的内容，根据同一份报告，在1929年的723起案件中，有605起是水灾、旱灾和虫灾；而在1930年的1462起案件中，有569起是水灾、旱灾和蝗灾，另有488起是内战和匪患造成的灾难。所有这些灾难都是直接或间接由国民党政府的不当行为造成的。

1932年是国民党引以为傲的丰收之年，但灾害仍然肆虐江苏、湖北、安徽、山西、四川等七个省份，如上述各省的水灾、河南的堤坝决口，以及江西先涝后旱（见本书第一部分，1933年）。而在其余省份，虽然收成没有大幅下降到引起恐慌的程度，但粮价跌得太低，以至于整个收成无法弥补……

mena gave rise to the contradictory term of "good-harvest-calcimity", the sufferers of which in 1932 were several times as great in number as that of 1931.
This year, according to the reports of the above-said Relief Committee, floods have been reported in 151 districts covering seven provinces(Aug.8 Sin Wen Pao) not including the big flood of Hunan that has done harm to eighteen districts. Presently, due to the overflowing of the Yellow River, and the collapse of dykes in Shensi, Honan, and Shangtung, an area covering several provinces has been devastated by the flood. There is still no official statistics about the damages done, But Sun Pao calculates that there are 2,000,000 refugees in the single province of Shensi, and in those districts in West Shangtung where the Yellow River has bursted the dykes, there are about 2,000,000 people on the edge of being drowned.
Such calamities are of course the result of Kuomintang regime, because the revenues that should be spent in calamity-preventing have been shifted for the use of attacking red armies and slaughtering workers and peasants, and moreover, the bankruptcy of the rural economy-a result of KMT regime too-incapacitates the peasants from doing any preventive work themselves.
In the minds of the peasants, calamities are not as dreadful as the exploitations of the Kuomintang Government. In June this year, the peasant of the Tse District(磁县) of Hpeei Province dared not report the existence of a locust calamity in that district, fearing that the Government would utilize the occasion to lay new taxes or other forms of exploitations. "Locusts are terrible, but the mandarins are more so." is a sentence in a popular folk song of the district. (Takunpao, July 11)
Not mentioned about the 'illegal' exploitations, the regular field tax raised by the Kuomintang Government increased year by year. In Kiangsu, this year, it doubles that of 1925, and the condition worse in other provinces. In Szechuen, a year's tax has to be paid every month in time of civil war, and in some districts, as Shang Lou(上流) the field tax has been pre-collected up to the year 1987! In Ching Kan District(靖边) of Shensi the field tax is twenty times five that before the coming to power of KMT. Parallel to this regular field tax, there are usually some supplementary taxes collected under the names of irrigation development, education promotion, locusts prevention, dyke construction, self administration and other equally holy terms.
All other kinds of taxes have been highly raised. Salt is six times as dear as it was ten years ago because of the tax. Likin has been abolished in name, but in its place, have been installed the Special Tax and Trade Tax which are more annoying than ever, while in Szechuen, the collection of Likin still continues on, and taxes equal to the goods own value will be collected by the half a hundred likin offices, distributed along the 290 miles between Chungking(重庆) and Chengtu(成都).
The Kuomintang militarists spent a portion of their exploitations from the peasants for campaigns against the red armies and the Chinese revolution, while the other portion is to be embezzled and deposited in foreign banks, through which it is transformed again into capitals to exploitate and squeeze the toiling Chinese masses.
The brutality of landlords' exploitations on peasants can be viewed even through Kuomintang's own confessions. A report on peasants financial conditions, issued by an Inquiry Committee under the Committee of Economic Construction of the Kuomintang Sui Yuen Government, after investigating living-conditions of the Short District(短区) of Suiyuan, gives the following:
For a peasant family cultivating 100 Mows of fields,
Their yearly income is $ 60.00 ($0 piculs of grain)
But their outlays consist of the following:
Cost of production----------------$ 77.82
Irrigation tax -------------------- 30.00
Other taxes ----------------------- 39.76
Total outlay ---------------------- $147.58
There was a loss of $ 87.58 for every 100 Mows cultivated, and if the farmer is a tenant, a rent of $ 60--80 has to be added to the outlay items (Sin Wen Pao June 17) (Attention must be given that Short District is the place where Kuomintang, under the cooperation of the International Relief Commission for China, an American Organ, has constructed the Min Sun Canal (民生渠 The Canal of People's Livelihood) and has been so proud of it.)
Arrests and imprisonments are the common methods of the ruling landlords applied on the peasants who are unable to pay their rents and taxes as a result of being over-exploited.

……这种现象导致了“丰灾”这一矛盾术语的出现，1932年受此影响的人数是1931年的数倍。

今年，据上述救济委员会的报告，已有七个省的151个县区报告发生水灾（8月8日《新闻报》），这还不包括危害了十八个县区的湖南大水。目前，由于黄河泛滥，以及陕西、河南和山东的堤坝决口，涵盖数省的区域遭受了水灾破坏。关于造成的损失尚无官方统计数据，但《申报》估算，仅陕西省就有200万难民，而在黄河决堤的鲁西地区，约有200万人面临被淹死的危险。

这些灾害当然是国民党政权的结果，因为本应用于防灾的收入被挪用于进攻红军和屠杀工农，而且，农村经济的破产——这也是国民党政权的结果——使农民无力自行进行任何预防工作。

在农民心目中，灾害并不像国民党政府的剥削那样可怕。今年六月，河北省磁县（Tse District）的农民不敢报告该县存在蝗灾，唯恐政府借此机会征收新税或进行其他形式的剥削。“蝗虫可怕，官老爷更可怕。”这是该县一首流行民谣中的句子。（《大公报》，7月11日）

且不提“非法”剥削，国民党政府征收的常规田赋逐年增加。在江苏，今年的田赋是1925年的两倍，其他省份的情况更糟。在四川，内战期间每月都要缴纳一年的税款，而在上流（Shang Lou，音译）等一些地区，田赋甚至预征到了1987年！在陕西靖边县（Ching Kan District），田赋是国民党掌权前的二十五倍。与这种常规田赋并行的是，通常还会以水利开发、教育推广、防蝗、筑堤、自治以及其他同样神圣的名义征收各种附加税。

所有其他种类的税收都大幅提高。由于税收，盐价是十年前的六倍。厘金名义上已废除，但取而代之的是特别税和营业税，其扰民程度更甚以往；而在四川，厘金的征收仍在继续，在重庆至成都之间290英里的沿途分布着五十个厘金局，征收的税额相当于货物价值的一半。

国民党军阀将一部分从农民身上榨取的剥削所得用于对抗红军和中国革命的运动，而另一部分则被侵吞并存入外国银行，通过这些银行，这些资金又转化为资本，继续剥削和压榨中国劳苦大众。

即使通过国民党自己的供认，也可以看出地主对农民剥削的残酷性。国民党绥远省政府经济建设委员会下属的一个调查委员会，在调查了绥远短区（Short District，音译）的生活状况后，发布了一份关于农民财务状况的报告，内容如下：

对于一个耕种100亩土地的农民家庭，
其年收入为60.00美元（0担粮食）
但其支出包括以下内容：
生产成本----------------$ 77.82
灌溉税 -------------------- 30.00
其他税费 ----------------------- 39.76
总支出 ---------------------- $147.58

每耕种100亩土地亏损87.58美元，如果该农民是佃农，则支出项目中还需加上60-80美元的租金（《新闻报》，6月17日）（需要注意的是，短区是国民党在美国机构中国国际救济委员会的合作下修建了民生渠并为此深感自豪的地方。）

逮捕和监禁是统治阶级地主对因过度剥削而无法支付租金和税费的农民常用的手段。

pages.en:
500 tenants in Soochow and 300 in Chen² Sa(常塾) have been put to prison
by landlords and Kuomintang Governments because of inability to pay.
Besides, there is the Imperialists' exploitations.
The aggression of foreign imperialism has given to the rural economy
of China a fatal blow. The former subsidiary business of the peasants, main-
ly home weaving, can no longer pay since the flowing in of the foreign goods
and the price for agricultural products is wholly manipulated by compradors
who act for the imperialists. The result has been more miserable in recent
years when the big economic crisis that has struck the imperialists
so severely has caused them to dump their overproduced rice, wheat, and cotton
in the Chinese market, resulting a big drop in the price of the Chinese ag-
ricultural products, e. g. the price for rice, the main food of the Chinese
people, dropped more than 50% in the latter half of last year. At present,
the price of rice is about $5.00 per picul, which is only one third the p
rice price for the same period of last year, but price for rice imported f
from Indo-China is as low as $3.00 per picul in the vicinity, therefore a
still lower price will be expected after the Autumn harvest.
And the "relief" Kuomintang is giving to the Chinese peasants is the big
G.$50,000,000 Wheat and Cotton Loan from U. S. A. which practically makes it
impossible any production of wheat and cotton in Chinese fields.
The result of bankruptcy in rural economy under the rule of Kuomintang-
Imperialists is a great decrease in wages of rural workers. The wages of
masons, carpenters, tailors and agricultural laborers in WuHih(五河) has
decreased 20% in June, and the wages of agricultural laborers in Heng Tang
District(行唐) of Hopei has dropped from ten to three cents a day.
Besides all the above exploitations, the Chinese peasants have to suf-
fer the destructions caused by civil wars and wars on China by Imperia-
lists (e.g.Japan) and also the burden of military services required dur-
ing civil wars.
It is on the basis of bankruptcy in rural economy that the peasants
struggles of China have been extensively developed.

II Peasants' Struggles

In the beginning of April, c.w.c. has worked out some statistics of pea-
sants struggles up to March showing that the peasants have arisen to struggle
against landlords and the ruling class in the form of petition(soldiers)
division of landlords' stored crops, anti-tax movement, guerilla wars, riots
etc., In the following table, the struggles of peasants from April to Aug.
were summarized: (minor struggles excluded)

| Date | Location | No of partic. | Form of struggle | Remarks |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 26, Feb. | Cheng Woo(吴县) Hopei. | 1,500 | Armed revolt against taxation | The peasants surrounded the city wall for 4 days, opposing the laying of new taxes by KMT magistrate under the name of fighting against japanese invasion, and succeeded finally. |
| Feb.- Mar. | North of Kwangsi Province | 55,000 | Armed revolt against KMT and its taxation by the Yao race(瑶) | Together with the Yao race in the districts Chuan, Hsin An(全县,兴安), Koon Y:ng(灌阳), Yi Ning(义宁), Lin Chuen(灵川), and Ling Ling(零陵) in Hunan-Kweichow border, the Yao race of North Kwangsi revolted against the oppressions of KMT. Hans(汉人) also participated. The district city of Hsin An was once occupied. Being superstitious and believing in the power of Gods, they were finally defeated by the Kwangsi and Hunan troops. |
| Mar. 30 | Yu Yiao(余姚) district Cheking Province | 2,500 | Anti-tax demonstration | Peasants gathered in district city to demonstrate against the laying of wine tax and to demand for release of the arrested. |
| Mar.- Apr. | Yau Shan & WanShan (鄞山,万山), Huonan. | 10,000 | Riot by Miao Race (苗) | Riot commenced in beginning of March in Yau Shan among the Miao race. Their slogan being: "No rent nor any kind of Tax" |
| April 5-15 | Ya Yiao, Lin An, Hanchow, & Bita Shan; Chekiang. | 20,000 | Riots | Peasants rioted 5-6 times against silk merchants' monopoly over the cocoon market, and the compulsory consumption of Government silkworm eggs. Over 100 merchants and Government silkworm- |
pages.zh:
苏州有500名租户，常熟（Chen² Sa）有300名租户，因无力支付租金而被地主和国民党政府投入监狱。此外，还有帝国主义的剥削。

外国帝国主义的侵略给中国农村经济以致命打击。农民以前的副业，主要是家庭纺织，由于洋货的涌入以及农产品价格完全由代表帝国主义行事的买办操纵，已无利可图。近年来情况更为悲惨，严重打击了帝国主义的大经济危机导致他们将过剩的大米、小麦和棉花倾销到中国市场，致使中国农产品价格大幅下跌，例如，作为中国人民主要食粮的大米价格在去年下半年下跌了50%以上。目前，大米价格约为每担5.00美元，仅为去年同期价格的三分之一，而从印度支那进口的大米在附近地区的价格低至每担3.00美元，因此预计秋收后价格将进一步走低。

国民党给予中国农民的“救济”是来自美国的5,000万美元小麦和棉花贷款，这实际上使得在中国田地里生产小麦和棉花变得不可能。

在国民党-帝国主义者统治下，农村经济破产的结果是农村工人工资的大幅下降。五河（WuHih）的石匠、木匠、裁缝和农业劳工的工资在6月份下降了20%，河北行唐区（Heng Tang District）的农业劳工工资从每天十美分降至三美分。

除了上述所有剥削外，中国农民还必须遭受内战以及帝国主义列强（如日本）对华战争造成的破坏，还要承担内战期间所需的兵役负担。

正是在农村经济破产的基础上，中国的农民斗争得到了广泛发展。

二、农民斗争

四月初，c.w.c.（中共中央？）制定了一些截至三月的农民斗争统计数据，显示农民以请愿（士兵）、分配地主存粮、抗税运动、游击战、暴动等形式起来反抗地主和统治阶级。下表总结了四月至八月的农民斗争情况（小型斗争除外）：

The period from April to September is the time when the Chinese peasants have to be busy in plowing and harvesting, yet it did not show any decrease in their struggles. This means that the Chinese peasants, on the basis of rural bankruptcy, have generally got up to fight against the oppressions and exploitations of the ruling class. These struggles, participated by thousands and thousands of peasants as well as by the minority races were in a great part carried on with good organizations and plans, aiming at the overthrowing of the ruling power—KMT, although in a few cases, they were guided by feudalistic, religious or superstitious leaders with wrong and immature tactics.

四月至九月是中国农民忙于耕种和收获的季节，但他们的斗争并未显示出任何减少。这意味着，基于农村破产，中国农民普遍起来反抗统治阶级的压迫和剥削。这些斗争有成千上万的农民以及少数民族参与，大部分是在良好的组织和计划下进行的，旨在推翻统治权力——国民党，尽管在少数情况下，它们是由封建、宗教或迷信领袖指导的，战术错误且不成熟。

Being the minor and comparatively backward races, the Miaos and Yaos
have always been treated more harshly and exploited more severely by the KMT
rulers. The recent revolts of these two races in Kwangsi and Hainan which
have shocked the two Provincial Governments, were doubtlessly revolutionary
struggles against the oppressions and exploitations of the KMT militarists
and for racial independence and freedom. Although they have been defeated
because of lack of good leadership and being superstitious, their struggles
have had great influence over the minor races, thus the Yi race of Jun Chan,
Szechwan followed them to rise in June.
The struggles of the peasants in Chung Woo, Kung Hsien and Tzei Joo
against the orders of the KMT regime illustrated vividly that the peasants
can no longer stand the sufferings given by the ruling class, and have to
decide for their own right of independence.
Besides these struggles more or less primitive in character, there ex-
isted even advanced ones—the civil-war movements of Hung Lay and other dis-
tricts in Szechwan which are Soviet powers in the Shensi-Szechwan border
area. In Yunnan, touched with the wind of revolution. Again, the silk-
weavers strike from districts round Hangchow in April joined the
struggle. Because of Government still form eggs and the monopoly of cocoons
in Lichuan, the silk merchants has succeeded in absorbing more than thirty
thousand peasants into action, capturing the district city for four days,
burning all KMT organs and offices, and making KMT lose its control lasting
for more than ten days. If not for the inability of the leaders to
smuggle into higher stages, to arm up the peasants with the arms
taken from the KMT forces, to organize a power of their own etc., the
struggle would not have been a failure.
In other places where the struggles have been more acute, growing and
carried on, as that of Koon Yen and other districts in North Kiang-
si, and that of Nan Tung and Shu Yee(舒也), all of which are still in steady
course of development.
Present struggles in the KMT areas have been growing, and become a big cur-
rent in the struggles of the Chinese masses. It will join the struggles of
workers in the cities and the revolutionary war carried on gradually the
Soviet districts, to bring the revolution to take a fur-
ther than ever.

LATEST ACTIVITIES IN THE SOVIET DISTRICTS

I. The Red Army Enlargement Campaign
For the crushing of KMT's fifth offensive and the realization of a
first victory in one or more provinces, the Central Soviet Government of
China called to the masses in the Soviet Districts for a campaign to en-
large the red armies up to a million, and for the economic support of
the battling task, all the Government revenues have been mobilized. This
appeal of the Soviet Government was quickly responded by Communist parties
mass organizations and individual workers and peasants in the Central So-
viet District. The red guards of many districts have joined the Government
red armies, and masses enlisted out unstintingly everywhere.
Over 20,000 men have enlisted in the red armies within one month as

作为较小且相对落后的民族，苗族和瑶族一直受到国民党统治者更严厉的对待和更严重的剥削。近期这两个民族在广西和海南的起义震惊了两个省政府，这无疑是为了种族独立和自由而反对国民党军阀压迫和剥削的革命斗争。虽然由于缺乏良好的领导和迷信而失败，但他们的斗争对少数民族产生了巨大影响，因此四川君昌（Jun Chan，音译，前文作理昌）的彝族在六月随之起义。

中武（Chung Woo，音译）、巩县（Kung Hsien）和资州（Tzei Joo，音译）农民反抗国民党政权命令的斗争生动地表明，农民再也无法忍受统治阶级带来的苦难，必须为自己的独立权利做出决定。

除了这些性质较为原始的斗争外，还存在更先进的斗争——四川洪赖（Hung Lay，音译）和其他地区的内战运动，这些地区是陕川边境地区的苏维埃政权。云南也受到了革命风潮的影响。此外，四月杭州周边地区的丝织工人罢工也加入了斗争。由于政府强制供应蚕种以及李川（Lichuan，音译）的蚕茧垄断，丝绸商人成功地将三万多农民卷入行动，占领县城四天，烧毁所有国民党机关和办公室，使国民党失去控制长达十多天。如果不是因为领导人未能将斗争提升到更高阶段，未能用从国民党军队缴获的武器武装农民，未能建立自己的政权等，这场斗争就不会失败。

在其他斗争更加激烈、增长和持续的地方，如江西北部的高安（Koon Yen，音译，可能指赣南或具体县名）和其他地区，以及南通和舒也（Shu Yee，音译），所有这些地区仍在稳步发展中。

目前国民党统治区的斗争正在增长，并成为中国群众斗争中的一股大潮流。它将加入城市工人的斗争以及在苏区逐渐开展的革命战争，使革命取得前所未有的进一步发展。

苏区最新活动

一、红军扩军运动

为了粉碎国民党的第五次围剿并实现一个或多个省份的首次胜利，中华苏维埃中央政府号召苏区群众开展将红军扩大至一百万人的运动，并为支持作战任务的经济需求，动员了所有政府收入。苏维埃政府的这一呼吁迅速得到了中央苏区共产党、群众组织以及个别工人和农民的响应。许多地区的赤卫队加入了政府红军，各地群众纷纷慷慨入伍。

一个月内，超过20,000人应征加入红军，以下是江西几个地区的征兵数据：
