Besides the above, the trade unions of agricultural laborers, shop em-
ployees, and handicraftsmen under the direction of the Executive Bureau of
the All China Labor Federation in the Central Soviet District have summon-
ed enough men to organize two divisions—the Division of Agricultural La-
borers and the Division of Employees and Handicraftsmen. The formation of
these two Divisions has been formally announced on August 1st, the Inter-
national Anti-war Day, the anniversary of the famous Nanchang Riot as well
as the anniversary for the formation of Chinese Red Armies.
The Provincial C. Y. of Kiangsi also appealed for the creation of a
'C.Y. International Division', and to its appeal, the Kiangsi youths quick-
ly gave their response, 500 youths enlisted in the district Tung Fung, 400
in Kan Hsien, 150 in a single c.y. branch of Kung lui, and several hundred
in seven 'regions' of Pei Sun. Other districts have equal achievements.
In this campaign for the expansion of red armies, high enthusiasm was
shown among the masses. The number enlisted usually surpassed the planned
number, e.g. twice the planned number have enlisted in the Lot Yan region
(洛岩) of the Fukien-Chekiang-Kiangsi Border (395 men within one month),
150 men enlisted within ten days in Lai Chuan District (黎川), 189 enlisted
within 20 days in the En Ping Region (恩平区) of the Vae Tai District, and
in the Tai Fong Region (太丰区) of Pei Sun District there was an enlistment
of 1,500C within a few days. Most of the masses enlisted very voluntarily
and usually demanded to be sent to the front when they enlisted. An example
of masses' enthusiasm can be seen in the May 30 Incident Demonstration of
Sui Jia when 700 workers and peasants joined the red army after an agitat-
ing speech made by a communist member in the meeting. 'It is our task to
join the red armies' was the opinion of the masses in the Jim Po region(金
波区) of the Sui Jin District.
Even those old peasants or peasant women who could not join the red
army themselves encouraged their sons or husbands to enlist in the army.
In the Chang Shi Village (长市村) of Hsin Kuo District and in the Chi Tan
Village and Ping Yan Sheng (池潭村、平洋胜) of Sai Ching, there were scores of
peasants sending their sons to the red armies, and in the Chu Hup Sheng(朱
湖胜) of Kun Lui and the Ping Shang (坪上) of Sai Jin, some peasant women
brought their husbands to the Shang Soviets for enlistment. Such phenomena
have never appeared in the history of China before.
As to the class composition of newly enlisted revolutionary fighters,
only partial statistics is available. In Lai Chuan, it was: youths 50%,
workers 25%, agricultural laborers, poor and coolies 20%. In one Shang of
the Jan Min District, it was: workers and agricultural laborers comprised
90%, C. P. members 6%, C.Y. members 1%.
I In this movement of red army enlargement, the success is not only in
having obtained a big enlargement, but also in the crushing of the backward
and right ideas toward the expansion of the red armies. Under the influence
of this campaign, the masses in the Soviet district will surely be more po-
sitive and energetic than ever in their participation of the revolutionary
war, and thus will assure the crushing of the fifth offensive of the KMT
and guarantee the first total victory of the Soviet power in one or more
provinces.

II. The Current of Returning Government Bonds by Masses
revolutionary way, the All China Commissariat of Finance of a big scale
trict appealed to the masses for a movement of returning $ 200,000 Govern-
ment bonds to the Soviets and saving $300,000 out of the public expenditure
to enrich the war expenses.
The masses in the Central Soviet District responded to its appeal im-
mediately, and within two months, a bond value of 220,679 was returned to
the Government and $22,596.97 was saved from the public expenditure. Many
people contributed money to the Government besides returning the bonds, while
a portion of the faculties of the Soviet voluntarily demanded a re-
duction in their salaries.

III. Struggles for Increased Production and the
Saving of Foodstuffs
A movement for a 20% increase in production and the saving of foodstuff
is now being organized among the masses in the Central Soviet District un-

此外，在中央苏区，受中华全国总工会执行局指导的农业工人、店员和手工业者工会已召集足够的人员，组建了两个师——农业工人师和店员与手工业者师。这两个师的组建已于8月1日正式宣布，这一天是国际反战日，也是著名的南昌暴动纪念日以及中国红军成立纪念日。
江西省共青团也呼吁创建“共青团国际师”，响应这一号召，江西青年迅速行动，东丰区有500名青年入伍，赣县有400人，公累(音译)的一个共青团支部有150人，北顺(音译)的七个“区”有数百人。其他地区也取得了同样的成绩。
在这次扩大红军的运动中，群众表现出高度的热情。入伍人数通常超过计划人数，例如，闽浙赣边区的洛岩地区入伍人数是计划的两倍（一个月内395人），黎川地区十天内有150人入伍，瓦泰(音译)区的恩平区二十天内有189人入伍，北顺区的太丰区几天内就有1,500C(原文不清)人入伍。大多数群众非常自愿地入伍，通常在入伍时就要求被派往前线。绥佳(音译)在五卅惨案示威活动中群众热情的一个例子是，在一次会议上，一名共产党员发表煽动性演讲后，700名工农加入了红军。“加入红军是我们的任务”是绥金(音译)区金波区群众的看法。
即使是那些自己不能参加红军的老农或农妇，也鼓励她们的儿子或丈夫参军。在新国区的长市村以及赛青(音译)的池潭村和平洋胜，有数十名农民送他们的儿子参加红军；在昆累(音译)的朱湖胜和赛金的坪上，一些农妇带着她们的丈夫去上苏维埃政府报名参军。这种现象在中国历史上从未出现过。
关于新入伍的革命战士的阶级成分，只有部分统计数据。在黎川，情况如下：青年占50%，工人占25%，农业工人、贫农和苦力占20%。在延民(音译)区的一个乡，情况如下：工人和农业工人占90%，中共党员占6%，共青团员占1%。
I 在这次红军扩编运动中，成功之处不仅在于获得了大规模的扩编，还在于粉碎了针对红军扩编的落后和右倾思想。在这场运动的影响下，苏区的群众必将以前所未有的积极性和活力参与革命战争，从而确保粉碎国民党的第五次“围剿”，并保证苏维埃政权在一个或几个省份取得首次全面胜利。

II. 群众退还公债的风潮
以革命的方式，中华苏维埃共和国国家银行大规模地
向群众呼吁开展一项运动，将价值20万美元的政府公债退还给苏维埃政府，并从公共支出中节省30万美元，以充实战费。
中央苏区的群众立即响应了这一呼吁，在两个月内，向政府退还了价值220,679美元的公债，并从公共支出中节省了22,596.97美元。除了退还公债外，许多人还向政府捐款，而一部分苏维埃工作人员自愿要求减薪。

III. 增加生产和节约粮食的斗争
中央苏区的群众正在组织一场增产20%和节约粮食的运动，

the leader of the Communist party, in order to make futile the economic
blockade of the enemies. First attention is given to the cultivation of the
uncultivated lands. In this, the toiling masses of Poh Sun District has had
surprising achievements. In that district, 6023 piculs of fields(i.e. fields
producing 6023 piculs of grains) have been cultivated within ten days and
in the Sai Shu Shang(西書上) of Ning Lul where there are only 1,200 inhabi-
tants a field area of over 5,300 Sems have been cultivated. The junmen
of Yutao District voluntarily demanded the Bureau of For-staff Regulation
to reduce their wages, so that the price for rice could be cheaper because
of smaller cost in transportation. The peasant women of Hsin Kuo organised
themselves into Production Brigades, to help and supervise production in
the district. Students of the Red Army Academy assist the peasants to plow
their fields wherever they can find time, and "not a single minute of time
nor a single foot of land is allowed to be wasted" is their slogan. Every-
where, the masses save foodstuffs so that they may send it to the red
armies. Besides, the receipts for the borrowed grains were always returned
to the owners. The Tung Ping region of the Hsin Kuo District has re-
turned 70 catties of grains in three days, the San Li Cheng in the Wu
Yen region of Sai Jin District (西金區) has returned 162 piculs, and
the Kuang region(光區) of the Poh Sun District 10 piculs.

IV. Recent Victories of the Red Armies

The Red Armies of the Central Soviet Districts set out for an Eastern
campaign at the end of July, and disarmed a great part of the army under
the Kuchintang General LU Shin Pong(盧興邦) in the first battle, capturing
the districts Chuncheng(順昌), Tien Lui(建甌), Kwei Hua(歸化) and Tsai Xing
(泰寧) in north Fukien. A second battle in the beginning of August annihi-
lated a great portion of the Au Shin Nien's(區壽年) Division of the KMT
19th Route Army, recapturing the districts Pang How(彭湖), Lien Cheng(連城),
Hsin Chuen(新泉), and Pak Sha(白沙) where it has once been red areas, and
forcing the rest of the KMT 19th Route Army to retreat to the district city
of Lung Yen and Yong Sing(龍岩永定). An area of 5-600 square li was add-
ed to the regime of the Soviet Government of Fukien in this battle. Follow-
ing is a list of capture:
(a)Ammunitions: Rifles 4,600, Machine guns 50, Light machine guns 50,
Other guns 500, Bullets 400,000, Shells 5,000, Wireless
transmitters 3, Military rice 2,500 piculs, Helmets over
2,000.
(b)Captives: Soldiers 3,300, Brigadier Gen. 1, Regiment Col. 3, Bat-
talion Lieut. 3, Company captains numerous.
(c) Districts captured, as mentioned above.
Again, at the end of August, the red armies captured the distinct
Wen Ling(溫嶺), 120 miles from Foochow, and have shot the KMT
authorities in the port. Fighting for their common benefits, battle-
ships of the Japanese, American, British and French Imperialists headed for
Foochow to guard the port for the corrupting KMT Government.
The drive of the red armies still continues on at present.
In the above battles, the opponent had forced the 19th Route Army,
the soldiers of which have once so bravely fought against the Japanese in-
vasion in Shanghai. However, it is difficult to fight any longer at the time
when the higher officers of this Army ordered the soldiers to attack the
red armies, neither wholesale slaughter of revolutionary soldiers was prac-
tised by the higher officers of this Army when the soldiers expressed their
unwillingness to attack their own brothers, the red armies. Thus the revo-
lutionary spirit of the KMT soldiers and the capability of the red armies
have caused KMT's defeat in every battle.
At the same time, the red armies in North Kiangsi are always threaten-
ing the cities of Fu Chow(撫州) and Nanchang along the front of Chung Yan
(中沿), Loh An(樂安), Iee Huang(宜黃), Nan Cheng(南城) and Fuchow.
In the south part of Kiangsi, a recent battle against Wang Chen Yu's(王均)
Division of the KMT army in Kiang Kow Ping(江口坪) of An Yuan Hsien
at the end of July (七月) has crushed and disarmed its two regiments.
While in the Hupei-Honan-Anhwei-Border, the 54th Division of the KMT
force have been surrounded by the red armies, and two regiments of the
Division completely disarmed. A part of the Long Kuen Ying(龍困營) Division
in South Honan surrendered to the red armies.

由共产党领导，旨在使敌人的经济封锁失效。首先关注的是荒地的开垦。在这方面，博顺(音译)区的劳动群众取得了惊人的成就。在该区，十天内开垦了6023担产量的田地（即产粮6023担的田地）；在宁禄(音译)的西书上，那里只有1,200居民，却开垦了超过5,300亩的田地。玉桃(音译)区的军民自愿要求军需管理处降低他们的工资，以便因运输成本降低而使米价更便宜。新国区的农妇组织成生产突击队，帮助和监督该区的生产。红军学院的学生只要有时间就帮助农民耕田，“不浪费一分钟时间，不浪费一尺土地”是他们的口号。各地群众都节约粮食，以便将其送给红军。此外，借粮的收据总是归还给所有者。新国区的东平区三天内归还了70斤粮食，赛金区吴严区的三里城归还了162担，博顺区的光区归还了10担。

IV. 红军的近期胜利

中央苏区的红军于7月底发动东征，在第一次战斗中缴械了国民党将军卢兴邦部队的大部分兵力，占领了闽北的顺昌、建瓯、归化和泰宁等县。8月初的第二次战斗歼灭了国民党第十九路军区寿年师的大部分兵力，收复了彭湖、连城、新泉和白沙等曾是红色区域的县，迫使国民党第十九路军余部退守龙岩和永定县城。此次战斗为福建苏维埃政府政权增加了500-600平方里的区域。缴获清单如下：
(a)弹药：步枪4,600支，机枪50挺，轻机枪50挺，
其他枪支500支，子弹40万发，炮弹5,000发，无线
电发射机3部，军用大米2,500担，钢盔2,000多顶。
(b)俘虏：士兵3,300名，少将1名，上校团长3名，营长3名，连长多名。
(c) 占领的县区，如上所述。
此外，8月底，红军占领了距福州120英里的温岭县，并处决了港口的国民党当局。为了共同利益，日本、美国、英国和法国帝国主义者的战舰驶往福州，为腐败的国民党政府守卫港口。
红军的攻势目前仍在继续。
在上述战斗中，对手是被迫参战的第十九路军，其士兵曾在上海英勇抗击日本入侵。然而，当该军高级军官命令士兵进攻红军时，他们已难以继续作战；当士兵表示不愿攻击自己的兄弟——红军时，该军高级军官也未对革命士兵进行大规模屠杀。因此，国民党士兵的革命精神和红军的能力导致国民党在每次战斗中失败。
与此同时，赣北的红军一直在中沿(音译)、乐安、宜黄、南城和抚州一线威胁着抚州和南昌等城市。
在赣南，7月底在安远县江口坪与国民党军队王均师的一次近期战斗中，击溃并缴械了其两个团。而在鄂豫皖边区，国民党军队的第54师被红军包围，该师的两个团被完全缴械。河南南部的龙困营(音译)师的一部分向红军投降。

As to the development of the red armies in Szechuen, still greater success has been gained recently. Only 10 regiments have been left out of the 46 regiments of Tien Chung Hsiao's force(田頌堯) and 6,000 rifles, 100 cannons and machine guns, 8 brigadier Gen. and regimental col., & 5,000 lower officers and soldiers were captured by the red armies, excluding the 10,000 killed and wounded in battle. Seeing Tien's great loss, the troops of Lui Shang(劉湘) and Yang Ju Cheng(楊虎城) dared not advance a step into the Soviet Districts, which has now covered 14 districts in the Szechuen-Shensi Border—Tung Kiang(通江), Nan Kiang(南江), Pa Chung(巴中), Kuang Yuan(廣元), Wan Yuan(萬源), Sui Ting(綏定), Ning Shan(寧山), Suan Eon(宣漢), Long Chang(閬中), Chang Chi(蒼溪), Cheng Kow(城口), Ning Jung(閬中), Si Chang(西充), and Man Fa(萬發), the first three being the most well organized districts. In this area, ten thousand people have energetically enlisted in the red armies; division of land has been completed; and Soviets of various ranks have been established. The sentiments of the masses in the bordering districts, between the red and white areas, are so high, that they continue to send delegates to connect with the red armies, hoping that their own districts will soon become a part of the Soviet area.

In front of the victories of the red armies, and under the condition of revolutionization among the soldiers and their support to the Soviet Governments and red armies, there is only one way left for the Kuomintang militarists, the way leading to its corruption and death.

V. Other Tidings From the Central Soviet District

Subscription to Help The Volunteers In Manchuria and Jehol—A movement is now being started in the Central Soviet District to help the volunteers in Manchuria and Jehol by subscribing among the masses. The Political Department of the red armies in Chien Ning(建寧), the Military Hospital of Sek Ching, the workers in the post offices, and the mass of other organizations and places are carrying on this movement with great success.

Masses Demand Government to Issue $3,000,000 Bond For Economic Construction Purposes. For the purpose of strengthening and developing the economy in the Soviet area, and for nullifying the influence of enemies' economic blockade, the mass organizations, as well as the armed forces in the Soviet districts unanimously demanded the Government to issue $3,000,000 of bonds to carry on big scale constructions of cooperative societies, factories and other productive enterprises. More than ten such demanding letters have been received by the Central Government every day. The masses in the Yuan Chap region(元查區) of the Sui Jin district have even prepared a sum of $40,000 to purchase the bonds.

至于四川红军的发展，最近取得了更大的成功。田颂尧部队的46个团中只剩下10个团，红军缴获了6,000支步枪、100门大炮和机枪，俘获8名少将和上校团长，以及5,000名下级军官和士兵，这还不包括战斗中死伤的10,000人。鉴于田部的巨大损失，刘湘和杨虎城的部队不敢向苏区前进一步，苏区现在覆盖了川陕边界的14个县——通江、南江、巴中、广元、万源、绥定、宁山、宣汉、阆中、苍溪、城口、阆中(注：原文重复，可能指另一地或误植)、西充和万发(音译)，其中前三个是组织最完善的县。在这个地区，成千上万的人积极加入红军；土地分配已经完成；各级苏维埃已经建立。红白交界地区群众的情绪如此高涨，以至于他们不断派遣代表与红军联系，希望他们自己的地区很快成为苏区的一部分。

在红军胜利的面前，以及在士兵革命化和支持苏维埃政府及红军的条件下，国民党军阀只剩下一条路，一条通向腐败和死亡的路。

V. 来自中央苏区的其他消息

订阅援助满洲和热河义勇军——中央苏区正在发起一场通过群众募捐来援助满洲和热河义勇军的运动。建宁红军政治部、石青(音译)军事医院、邮局工人以及其他许多组织和地方的群众都在大力开展这项运动，并取得了巨大成功。

群众要求政府发行300万美元经济建设公债。为了加强和发展苏区经济，并消除敌人经济封锁的影响，苏区的群众组织以及武装部队一致要求政府发行300万美元公债，以进行合作社、工厂和其他生产企业的大规模建设。中央政府每天收到十多封此类要求信。绥金区元查区的群众甚至准备了4万美元购买公债。

今年秋季苏区各地预计丰收——与洪水、干旱、内战和其他灾害肆虐的国民党统治区相反，今年秋季中央苏区各地预计丰收。土地部现在……（完）

C. S. B. REGISTRY

N. D 1797/6
Section D.S.B./Special 1033
Date August 2, 19 33.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Copy of "Chinese Worker's Correspondence" delivered through
the post addressed to V. Rover, former Tass Agent in Shanghai.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by [Signature] A.1.

I forward herewith an incomplete copy of a communist
publication entitled "Chinese Workers' Correspondence", issue
No. 67, dated July 7, 1933, which was delivered through the
post addressed to Mr. V. Rover, King Albert Apartments, Avenue
du Roi Albert. The letter, which had been opened and later
torn up and discarded by some unknown person, was obtained by
an informer.

The publication in question, which is typewritten in
English, contains a list of strikes and disturbances which took
place in Shanghai and other parts of China during April, 1933,
and an article entitled "Nanking under the Spell of the League
of Nations." In this article it is said that Sommervell,
former labour member of the British Government, will soon come
to China to act as advisor to the Nanking Government in order
to reform the executive system and that Von Seeckt, prominent
military
German staff officer, will assist the Nanking Government in
reorganizing the military system and in guiding the Fascist
movement in China. In conclusion the writer alleges that
the League of Nations is an organization of the imperialistic
robbers formed for the purpose of exploiting weak nations and
that the cooperation between the League and the Kuomintang
aims at the oppression of the Chinese people and the slaughtering
of the red armies of workers and peasants and all revolutionary
masses.

[Signature]
G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
[Handwritten note:]
Reg. Copies of Chinese
Workers Correspondence
given to Communist authorities
Raschke. 2/8 AUG. 1933

报告

事由（全称） 通过邮政投递给前塔斯社驻上海代理人 V. Rover 的《中国工人通讯》副本。

由 D.S. Tcheremshansky 制作 转呈人 [签名] A.1.

现随函附上一份名为《中国工人通讯》的共产主义出版物的不完整副本，第67期，日期为1933年7月7日，该刊物通过邮政投递至阿尔伯特国王公寓（King Albert Apartments），阿尔伯特国王大道（Avenue du Roi Albert），收件人为 V. Rover 先生。这封信件曾被某不明身份者拆阅，随后撕毁并丢弃，后由一名线人获取。

该出版物以英文打字而成，包含一份1933年4月期间发生在上海及中国其他地区的罢工和骚乱清单，以及一篇题为《国联魔咒下的南京》的文章。文章称，英国政府前劳工议员萨默维尔（Sommervell）即将来华，担任南京政府的顾问，以改革行政体系；德国著名军事参谋军官冯·塞克特（Von Seeckt）将协助南京政府重组军事体系，并指导中国的法西斯运动。最后，作者声称国际联盟是一个由帝国主义强盗组成的组织，其目的是剥削弱小国家，而国联与国民党之间的合作旨在压迫中国人民，屠杀工农红军及所有革命群众。

[签名]
G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

特别股主管警官。
[手写批注：]
《中国工人通讯》
登记副本已交予共产党当局
Raschke. 1933年8月2日

a former Labour Depart officer of the British Government named Sommer
vell is also introduced by the League as the adviser for the refor-

    Seeckt, being the Chief Military adviser for Germany during the
war was particularly notable for his work in reorganizing German troops
after the war. He is a close follower of Hitler, and his position in
Germany corresponds to that of Ueda in Japan, His function for Nan-
king is to reorganizing the military system, to guide the Fascist
movement and to be one of the highest military advisor for Chiang Kai-
shek. They are not the first ones in the ranks of League's advisers
and experts for China, these were Dr. Muzzi, silk expert of Italy; Dr.
Dragoni, secretary of International Agriculture Society; Langiven, a
French Professor; Palski, Educational Ministry of Poland; Prof. Towne
of London School of Economics; and many others.
    All of them were requested by the National Economical Committee
presided by Chiang Kai-chek, according to a plan for cooperation be-
tween China and League passed by the League's Executive on May 19, 193:
and were recommended by the League's Chief Secretary.
    Some 10 of such experts and advisors have been introduced into
China since these three years, covering fields ranging from Finance,
Irrigation, Agriculture, Education, Executive, Law, Hygiene and Com-
mercial ports to Military operation, etc.
    At Shanghai, League keeps its own special office for the carrying
out of this "cooperative enterprise".
    "For the discussion with your government of how to carry out con-
structive work in cooperation with the League; for the investigation
of the financial problem of your country with an eye for reconstruc-
tion" declares Drummond, new League's representative to
China, in a talk with the Chinese press men."
    The League of Nations, doubtlessly, is the organization of the im-
perialist powers for the exploitation of the weak nations. It is there-
fore KMT's job serving as their scavenger, to request the "cooperation"
of such advisers and experts for the oppression of Chinese people, sup-
pression of revolutionary peasants' red-armies, and revolutionary mass-
es.
    Before the continuous victory of the revolutionary workers' and
peasants' red-armies and the ever rising upsurge of the Chinese Soviet
Movement, Kuomintang will display ever clearer its function of running
dogs and more such executioners will be needed!

一位名叫索默维尔（Sommer，音译）的前英国政府劳工部官员，也被国际联盟引荐为行政体制改革顾问，并即将来华。
    塞克特（Seeckt，音译）在战争期间担任德国首席军事顾问，战后在重组德国军队方面的工作尤为引人注目。他是希特勒的紧密追随者，其在德国的地位相当于日本的上田（Ueda，音译）。他在南京的职能是重组军事体系，指导法西斯运动，并担任蒋介石的最高军事顾问之一。他们并非国联派往中国的顾问和专家队伍中的首批人员，此前还有意大利丝绸专家穆齐博士（Dr. Muzzi，音译）、国际农业协会秘书德拉戈尼博士（Dr. Dragoni，音译）、法国教授朗吉文（Langiven，音译）、波兰教育部帕尔斯基（Palski，音译）、伦敦经济学院汤恩教授（Prof. Towne，音译）以及许多其他人。
    根据国联行政院于193年5月19日通过的中外国联合作计划，并经国联秘书长推荐，上述人员均受由蒋介石主持的国家经济委员会之邀而来。
    近三年来，已有约十名此类专家和顾问被引入中国，其领域涵盖财政、水利、农业、教育、行政、法律、卫生、商埠直至军事行动等。
    在上海，国联设有自己的专门办事处，以执行这项“合作事业”。
    “为了与贵国政府讨论如何与国联合作开展建设性工作；为了着眼于重建而调查贵国的财政问题”，国联新任驻华代表德拉蒙德（Drummond，音译）在与中方记者的谈话中宣称。
    国际联盟无疑是帝国主义列强剥削弱国组织的机构。因此，国民党作为其清道夫，其职责便是请求此类顾问和专家的“合作”，以压迫中国人民，镇压革命农民红军及革命群众。
    面对工农红军的连续胜利和中国苏维埃运动的日益高涨，国民党将愈发清晰地显露其走狗职能，也将需要更多这样的刽子手！

20,385 (Shanghai Evening Post, 24th March) That means, there will be
about 30,000 rickshaw pullers; all rickshaw pullers have to pay
a rent as high as $1.30, small money a day and besides, they are
fined frequently. The taking away of their licences or seat cushions
by the policemen is a common scene in the streets of Shanghai. Hanchow
has 4,800 rickshaws, Shu-Cheng, of Honan Province, has 1,000, with
at least 2,000 pullers, each of whom earns about 1,500-2,000 cashes
a day, with a rent burden of 800 cashes.. The total number of rickshaw
pullers in China can be conservatively estimated as 200,000. This big
number of people, living under a condition so horrible, and unbearable
will of course struggle for better living and more human conditions.
Then, from the above data, there is the question of the unemploy-
ed. New means of production and communication, that have come to
China thru Imperialist aggression, have driven millions of Chinese
handicraft workers out of work, to be wanderers on the streets. For
example as shown in the table the opening of the Nanking-Pukow steam
ferries which is expected in August this year, will deprive of the
living of some 3,000 shanpan men and luggage transporters. Again, the
transportation of salt by steamboats instead of by junks, as the re-
sult of a suggestion by the foreign advisors of the Bureau of Salt
Revenue, will cause 30,000 people in Yangchow to lose their means of living. (SunPao, 17th March) In
fact, much more can be said about these victims of Imperialist a-
ggression and traitorous Kuomintang rule. Now they are arising to
demand the right of living, the right of having work from Kuomintang
rulers! Unfortunately, they have not had the right guidance, correct
leadership, thus they are cheated and sold by the gentry class. This
is why the struggles have not developed to higher stages than that
of petitioning.
The reason why there are so few struggles in North and South
China as indicated the above tables is because of the handicap in
gathering data from these places. The toiling masses in China are suf-
fering and struggling everywhere.

of which 9 are strikes; and 23 cases in April, of which 15 are strikes

20,385（《上海晚邮报》，3月24日）这意味着，人力车夫约有30,000人；所有人力车夫每天必须缴纳高达1.30元小洋的租金，此外还经常遭受罚款。警察没收他们的执照或座垫在上海街头是司空见惯的景象。杭州有4,800辆人力车，河南省舒城（音译）有1,000辆，至少有2,000名车夫，每人每天收入约1,500至2,000文铜钱，租金负担为800文铜钱。保守估计，中国的人力车夫总数可达200,000人。如此庞大的人群生活在如此可怕且难以忍受的条件下，当然会为争取更好的生活和更人道的条件而斗争。那么，根据上述数据，还存在失业问题。通过帝国主义侵略进入中国的新的生产和交通方式，已使数百万中国手工业工人失业，沦为街头的流浪者。例如，如表所示，预计今年八月开通的南京-浦口蒸汽轮渡，将使约3,000名舢板船夫和行李搬运工失去生计。再者，由于盐务署外籍顾问的建议，食盐运输改用轮船而非木船，这将导致扬州30,000人失去生计来源。（《申报》，3月17日）事实上，关于这些帝国主义侵略和卖国的国民党统治的受害者，还有更多可说的。现在他们正起来向国民党统治者要求生存权和工作权！不幸的是，他们没有得到正确的指导和领导，因此被绅士阶级欺骗和出卖。这就是为什么斗争没有发展到比请愿更高的阶段。

our attention.
First, we can see that struggles of rickshaw pullers practically
occurred every month, altho these struggles have not yet developed
into higher stages(general strike etc.). Rickshaws are the prevail-
ing means of communication in China, in big cities, like Shanghai,
as well as small towns and rural districts. The exploitation exerted
by the rickshaw owners upon the pullers is extremely cruel. From
the investigations of the Lingnan University, there are 5,500 rick-
shaws in Canton, with a number of 15,000 of pullers. Each puller
can earn $1.30 a day, Canton currency, while the rent for the rick-
shaw costs $.60. According to the "Year Book of Hankow, 1930", there
are 2,100 rickshaws in that city, and calculating on the basis that
one rickshaw is pulled by three men, there are about 7,00 pullers.

3) Document dated 9.4.33 entitled "Red Armies Besiege
Nanchang", dealing with the victories alleged to
have been won by Red Armies in Kiangsi.

4) Document dated 11.4.33 telling of the opposition of

Document dated March 21, 1933, entitled "Peiping
and Tientsin will fall into the hands of the
Japanese troops and the Powers are preparing a
war on the Pacific". This document tells
about (1) the advance of the Japanese troops on
Peiping and Tientsin after taking Jehol, (2)
alleged danger of Japan launching an offensive
on the Soviet Union, (3) alleged possibility of
a conflict between America and Japan on the Pacific
as a result of the situation in North China, (4)
alleged intention of other imperialist nations to
partition China, and (5) the suppression of the
Chinese revolutionary Soviet movement.

文件日期为1933年3月21日，题为“北平和天津将落入日军之手，列强正准备太平洋战争”。该文件讲述了 (1) 日军占领热河后进军北平和天津，(2) 据称日本对苏联发动进攻的危险，(3) 据称由于华北局势导致美日在太平洋发生冲突的可能性，(4) 其他帝国主义国家瓜分中国的据称意图，以及 (5) 对中国革命苏维埃运动的镇压。

pages.en:
APPENDIX C.
Translation of a letter posted in Shanghai on March 21,
1933, addressed to : Frau Dr. Elsa Meier, Mullerstr 97,
F., Berlin N.65.

Vee Zuh (维笑) :
Your letter by air mail dated February 26
reached me yesterday. I have not yet seen a copy of
"Inprecor" as the local bookstore has closed down. A
letter has already been sent to Peiping asking them to
act accordingly, but delivery by air mail may not be
put into effect owing to lack of funds.
Have you distributed the drafts throughout
Europe? Commencing from the 1st (since the receipt of
your last letter) I have sent drafts in English to the
various parts of Europe. If you cannot distribute them
please give us another address as we understand that many
former addresses are now unsuitable and require revision.
There will be a change in the contents of the drafts in
future, that is, in connection with current affairs,
social life, struggles and correspondence on internal
affairs. Have you any opinion to offer? Owing to
shortage of staff the quantity of drafts may be reduced
somewhat.
There is a person by the name of Kong Jing Un
(江靖恩), who according to a report of a class mate of his,
assists the "Right Clique" during ordinary and anti-Li San
(立三) times, but has not yet clearly committed acts of
destruction. Nothing further is known about him but it is
advisable that you pay attention to him.
The anti-Imperialist letter has been passed
on and your address made known to them.
With regard to the last problem (the returning
of students), I cannot understand and shall inform you when
I have discussed the matter with my friends.
pages.zh:
附录 C.
1933年3月21日在上海寄出的一封信的译文，收件人为：Elsa Meier 博士夫人，柏林 N.65，穆勒街97号F座。

Vee Zuh (维笑) ：
你2月26日的航空信昨天收到了。我还没有看到《国际新闻通讯》(Inprecor) 的副本，因为当地书店已经关门。已经去信北平要求他们照办，但由于缺乏资金，航空投递可能无法实施。
你是否已在欧洲各地分发草稿？从1日（收到你上一封信以来）开始，我已将英文草稿寄往欧洲各地。如果你无法分发，请给我们另一个地址，因为我们了解到许多旧地址已不适用，需要修改。
今后草稿的内容会有所变化，即涉及时事、社会生活、斗争以及内部事务的通讯。你有什么意见吗？由于人手短缺，草稿的数量可能会略有减少。
有一个人名叫 Kong Jing Un (江靖恩)，据他的一位同学报告，他在平时和反立三 (Li San) 时期协助“右派”，但尚未明确做出破坏行为。对他一无所知，但建议你注意他。
反帝信件已转交，你的地址也已告知他们。
关于最后一个问题（学生回国），我不理解，待我与朋友讨论后再通知你。

pages.en:
( 2 )

Can our drafts produce any effect? We
cannot see the result of our work as we do not receive
the publications from the various places. Should we
change our policy if we cannot obtain results after
expending labour and money? Please let us have a
satisfactory reply regarding this matter.

(Signed in English) Robert. March 26.
pages.zh:
( 2 )

我们的草稿能产生任何效果吗？我们看不到我们工作的结果，因为我们没有收到各地的出版物。如果在耗费劳力和金钱后仍不能取得成果，我们是否应该改变政策？请就此事项给予令人满意的答复。

（英文签名）Robert. 3月26日。

CHINESE WORKERS' CORRESPONDENCE VOL3 NO 11 FEB. 19
1) Triumphant Report of Red Army From Szechuan Expedition
2) Japanese Soldiers in Manchuria Refuse to Fight for Imperialism
3) Workers in Soviet District Answer the Call to Arms Against Fascism -- Central Soviet District Letter.

Increasing triumphant reports of red army reach beyond ... in
... imperialistic paper a "serious danger", especially ... of the b
... victory in north. Szechuan.

130 Miles From Provincial Capital The victory of red army in
Szechuan has so much credited the sympathy of the peasants masses. We
have reported the capture of some ten divisions south of Pa-Chung in the
previous correspon now Pa-Chung has fallen to the red army, another
excellent example of cooperation between military forces and the en-
thusiastic peasant masses. Sin-Won Pao of Feb. 3rd States: "The commu-
nist bandits occupy Pa-Chung by first inciting a big anti-taxation
riot in which the magistrate of the Bureau of Public Safety was killed
by the masses." And when the Szechuan militarist Tien Chung-Yao (田頌堯)
engaged a resistance against the red army at Pa-Chung, whole
bridge under Major Shueh Tsan-Gai ( ) was lost (join the red army)
and Shueh found Killed." (Feb. 3rd Same Paper) Under this condition, to
the west of Pa-Chung "an important city of Paoning (保寧) has been occu-
ied by an army of 60,000 reds, under the leadership of a man named Kwang,"
and "the distance between Chengtu and Paoning is 150 miles by map and
this menaces the capital" (Feb. 3, North China News) "The regular troops
in Chengtu are believed to contain an appreciable number of sympathizers
with the communist creed.... Residents in the city are comforting themselves
with the 'promise of a month or more of peace', "(Feb. 4) Not only the
capital is alarmed, Chungking (重慶), the economical center of Szechuan is
shaken with terror." Communist bandits are active at Chu Hsien (資縣), 100
miles north of Chungking. Christian commissioners at Chu Hsien and Lu-Tsa
(瀘州) (10 miles east of Chu Hsien) escape to Chungking" (Feb. 2 Reuters
Peiping Wire)

South Honan East Hupei South Honan and East Hupei are described by
KMT to have the last trace of Reds expelled, but Reugo wire from Hankow,
Feb. 2nd States. "Signs of growing activity among the communist troops
under Kung Ho-Lung (Not Ho-Lung, but He-Tsung-o...o.) along the Hupei Kiangsi
Borders have become apparent... The communist force are now in close pro-
ximity of Tung Shan (通山) and Tung Chen (通城), it is reported."

In north Honan, reports appeared on Peking Pao of Feb. 2nd to the
effect that 5000 red army are attacking Shang Cheng (商城) and Li-Huang (立煌)
That the Red Army of workers and peasants can not be suppressed but
would develop with the development of workers' and peasants' revolution
is emphatically proved here. (Feb. 4, 1933)
pages.zh:
中国工人通讯 第3卷 第11号 2月19日
1) 红军自四川远征的胜利报告
2) 满洲日军拒绝为帝国主义作战
3) 苏区工人响应反法西斯武装号召——中央苏区来信。

红军……自……的胜利报告……
……正如……富裕且……
……使得……如此糟糕
……，声称

越来越多的红军胜利消息传至……在
……帝国主义报纸上被称为“严重危险”，尤其是……在北方……四川的胜利。

距省城130英里 红军在四川的胜利极大地赢得了农民群众的同情。我们在之前的通讯中曾报道过巴中以南俘获约十个师的消息，现在巴中已落入红军之手，这是军队与热情的农民群众合作的又一个绝佳范例。2月3日的《新闻报》称：“共匪首先在巴中煽动大规模抗税暴动，公安局局长被民众杀死，从而占领了巴中。”而当四川军阀田颂尧在巴中抵抗红军时，薛占凯（音译）少校麾下的整座桥的部队都倒戈（加入红军），薛本人也被发现身亡。”（2月3日同报）在此情况下，巴中西面“保宁这一重要城市已被一支由名为光（音译）的人领导的六万红军占领”，且“地图上成都与保宁之间的距离为150英里，这威胁到了省会”（2月3日，《华北新闻》）“据信成都的正规军中含有相当数量的共产主义信条同情者……市内居民正以‘一个月或更长时间的和平承诺’来自我安慰，”（2月4日）不仅省会感到恐慌，四川的经济中心重庆也陷入恐怖之中。“共匪在重庆以北100英里的资县活动频繁。资县和泸州（资县以东10英里）的基督教委员逃往重庆”（2月2日路透社北平电）

豫南鄂东 国民党宣称豫南和鄂东的红军踪迹已被彻底清除，但2月2日汉口发出的Reugo电讯称：“在湖北江西边境，孔荷宠（非贺龙，而是贺宗欧……o.）领导下的共产党部队活动日益增加的迹象已变得明显……据报道，共产党部队现在紧邻通山和通城。”

在豫北，2月2日的《北京报》刊登消息称，五千红军正在进攻商城和立煌。工农红军无法被镇压，并将随着工农革命的发展而壮大，这一点在此得到了有力证明。（1933年2月4日）

pages.en:
Workers In Soviet District, Under Direct
Leadership Of The Soviet Government And Red
Trade Union, Answer The Capitalists Attack
With Struggles.

Central Soviet District Correspondence:

"Under the direct organization and instruction of the imperialists,
the KMT force is cornering the central soviet district ac-
companied with intensified, economic blockade. The capitalists and ship
owner in the soviet district who are eager to be allowed to arrange
a positive attack against the workers, moreover, plan to close
the factories, intentionally violating the labor laws and break
contracts. At various workers of Ting Chow (汀州), under the
leadership of city and provincial Trade Unions, have raised a strong
challenge with struggles.

"One is for the paper industry. Due to the sabotage of the ca-
pitalists in Tin Chow, their not to issue paper products as well as
silk, many coolies, wood boatsmen, paper workers and other work people
made jobless. The workers, in order to answer the capitalists' attack,
have gathered and have their representatives elected, so as to carry on
struggles under the leadership of the trade unions.

"Textile workers are staging their round struggle against the sab-
otage of shop-owners, who close the factory and run away, making one
fifth of the textile workers in 70 factories of Tin-Chow idle. In
spite of the blockade, there are possibilities of obtaining raw materials
through organized purchase, but the capitalists refuse to do so, fur-
ther more they threaten the workers that if they strike, the factories
will be ruined down and also that the white 19th route army is coming
to PingChow which will not only compel the workers to pay over their
increased wages but also with interest. However, such threats are open-
ly denounced on the workers congress. The workers', after three suc-
cessive struggles, unanimously ask the central committee to
obtain answers to the following conditions from the capitalists:
A) Purchase raw materials within half a month (or one month.)
and should not stop the work whenever.
B) Wages during the unemployed periods of three months should be
paid to the workers.
C) Immediately pay the year end bonus agreed on the contract.
D) Immediately pay the May-Day fees to the workers, etc.
E) Immediately carry out all conditions of the contract.
And the struggle committee has decided to stand to the last word in
case of the capitalists' refusal to admit such conditions.

"Tailor workers have organized a tailors' producing co-operative,
and they raise a struggle to recover their rent-payment from the ca-
pitalists on their machines during the past two months. The city con-
gress of the tailors adopts a strong stand and finally succeeds in the
struggle against the capitalists to yield.

The workers of all Ting-Chow are preparing to assist the struggle
of the wood boatsmen, basket workers paper workers and the other work-
ers for a complete triumph."

JAPANESE SOLDIERS IN MANCHURIA REFUSE TO FIGHT FOR
IMPERIALISM
200 Rebels Flee
Anti-War Slogans before execution
(Jan. 22 Peiping Letter) Revolution rebellions have been repeatedly
carried out since Sept. 18, 1931, by Japanese soldiers in Manchuria and
Shanghai for opposition of the invasion of China and alleged offense
against Soviet Union.
Recently due to the lengthening of military service period so as to
match the increasing need of China invasion and soviet attack, the
Japanese soldiers have raised fresh opposition in struggles.
In the beginning of Jan., 200 soldiers of the 10th divisional group
at Mukden and Mengmuti demanded sending-back for the expiration of the
their service year; being rejected, the soldiers went on a revolution-
ary rebellion by dismissing themselves. The divisional headquarter,
alarmed, sent air forces and army soldiers to encircle the escaping
group. Failing to persuade the resolute rebels with sweet chatting,
the commander shot the 200 home-sick birds right away, who, before
pointing rifles, shouted slogans to the opposition of aggression to-
ward China and attack of Soviet Union.
(End)

苏区工人在苏维埃政府和红色工会的直接领导下，以斗争回应资本家的攻击。

中央苏区通讯：

“在帝国主义的直接组织和指示下，国民党军队正配合加剧的经济封锁，将中央苏区逼入绝境。苏区内急于获准对工人发动正面攻击的资本家和船主， moreover，计划关闭工厂，故意违反劳动法并撕毁合同。汀州各地的工人在市和省工会的领导下，通过斗争发起了强有力的挑战。

“一是造纸业。由于汀州资本家的破坏，他们停止发行纸张产品以及丝绸，导致许多苦力、木船船夫、造纸工人和其他劳工失业。为了回应资本家的攻击，工人们聚集起来并选举了代表，以便在工会的领导下开展斗争。

“纺织工人正在进行一轮斗争，以对抗店主的破坏行为，这些店主关闭工厂并逃跑，导致汀州70家工厂中五分之一的纺织工人闲置。尽管存在封锁，但通过有组织的采购仍有可能获得原材料，但资本家拒绝这样做，此外他们还威胁工人，如果罢工，工厂将被毁掉，而且白军第十九路军即将抵达平州（音译），这不仅会迫使工人退还增加的工资，还要加上利息。然而，这些威胁在工人大会上遭到公开谴责。经过三次连续的斗争后，工人们一致要求中央委员会从资本家那里获得以下条件的答复：
A) 在半个月内（或一个月内）采购原材料，且不得随时停工。
B) 应向工人支付三个月失业期间的工资。
C) 立即支付合同约定的年终奖金。
D) 立即向工人支付五一节费用等。
E) 立即执行合同的所有条件。
斗争委员会决定，如果资本家拒绝承认这些条件，将坚持到底。”

“裁缝工人组织了一个裁缝生产合作社，他们发起斗争，要求资本家偿还过去两个月机器上的租金支付。全市裁缝代表大会采取强硬立场，最终在迫使资本家让步的斗争中取得成功。

汀州所有工人正准备协助木船船夫、篮筐工人、造纸工人和其他工人的斗争，以取得全面胜利。”

满洲日军拒绝为帝国主义作战
200名叛兵逃亡
行刑前高呼反战口号
（1月22日北平来信）自1931年9月18日以来，驻满洲和上海的日本士兵为反对侵略中国和所谓对苏联的冒犯，多次发动革命叛乱。
最近，由于服役期延长以适应日益增长的侵华和攻苏需求，日本士兵在斗争中提出了新的反对意见。
1月初，驻扎在沈阳和孟母梯（音译）的第10师团的200名士兵因服役期满要求遣返；在被拒绝后，士兵们通过自行离队发动了革命叛乱。师部惊慌失措，派遣空军和陆军士兵包围逃亡群体。指挥官未能用甜言蜜语说服坚定的叛兵，便立即枪杀了这200名思乡心切的士兵，他们在枪口指向自己之前，高呼反对侵略中国和攻击苏联的口号。

British Imperialist Partition of Manchuria

日本帝国主义对中国革命的积极干涉。

英国帝国主义瓜分满洲及其攻击日本、朝鲜和中国的阴谋。

帝国主义瓜分中国的前景更为严峻。我们已报道了第一军在攻击宁海河（奉天）以东地区中所扮演的阴险角色，以及由美国军方副部长发起的远征。（见本期第三篇文章。）日本帝国主义在中国的庞大军事计划已接近完善。侵略行动在中国南北两地同时推进。

英国驻华公使迈尔斯·兰普森上月抵达上海，被大多数中国媒体认为涉及帝国主义瓜分中国的阴谋，据说他向南京建议“满洲国际共管”。这一点由2月7日伦敦发出的路透社电讯证实：“英国皇家地理学会会员H.R.H.建议建立一个在国际联盟维护下的临时国际保护体系。”这种国际政府体系无非是为国际帝国主义建立一个强大的军事基地，以便对苏联进行武装干涉，只是主导权掌握在英国人手中。

但日本帝国主义已经积极完成了其攻击中国革命和苏联的阴谋。

日本国会通过了1933年的巨额预算，即“战时估算”。在22.49亿日元的支出中，8.29亿日元直接用于战争，占总数的36.5%。陆军1.6亿（20%），海军3.72亿（11%），而在中央行政支出和其他项目中，涉及2亿日元的军事装备“特别费用”。因此，1933年日本帝国主义的军事总支出将不少于19.14亿日元，即总支出的一半！

除了通过的巨额预算外，南满铁路公司将其资本加倍至8亿日元，用于修建新的铁路、公路和机场，以方便军事行动。陆军省决定加强坦克部队和机械化部队，并将其现有兵力加倍。（2月6日《字林西报》）所有这些显然都是为了准备对苏联进行军事干涉。

巴黎合众社发布了一则令人震惊的消息：“足以支撑一场大战的大量弹药和炸药已运往远东。”——日本。与此同时，日本人在华北和华中的明显阴谋旨在攻击中国革命

trapped by the mine foreman, live a life worse than those of horses and

本周，满洲的天津、津朝（音译）、奉汾（音译）铁路已停止客货运输，以供日本军队运输之用。日军第6、第8、第10和第30大队的5万名士兵已集结在朝阳和密鲁（音译）周围。第8、第10和第14师团的预备部队，连同3万名新征士兵，已于本月初从朝鲜派遣至关外（音译）满洲前线。第16师团和第二舰队目前是主要的预备力量。
与此同时，日本帝国主义第三遣外舰队正在进行周密的军事部署，意图对中国革命发动直接进攻，打击已向其宣战的工农红军。一个月前，舰队司令官高良（音译）视察了汉口与宜昌之间的舰队。本月2日，同一人（高良）在汉口召开了神圣军事会议。目前在汉口的5艘日本战舰正将炮口对准汉口岸边；在日本租界边界，安置了直径达20厘米（原文不清）的大炮，安装了通电铁丝网和防空炮系统，1000名日本青年侨民已武装起来并接受训练。正规军在上午练习巷战和射击，下午进行记录。汉口的一名日本居民声称，长江上的日本舰队大炮配备了足以连续射击800小时的炮弹。
天津和“岛根”（音译）也作出了类似的安排。
在台湾南部，一个占地5000公制单位（原文不清）的航空站正在建设中，显然需要使用该基地，显然已准备好采取更多行动。日本帝国主义已足以预见到，不仅是进一步的压迫，劳苦大众正在觉醒，准备起义推翻帝国统治，并在苏维埃中国的旗帜下战斗，因此她正为与中国苏维埃的战争做各方面的准备。
热河的屠杀已经开始。2月9日，密鲁（音译）的350人在一天内被300枚日军炮弹炸死。10日上午，“日机开始轰炸该城，造成300人（原文不清）伤亡。直到中午仍未停止”（2月10日《时报》）。瓜分中国、干预其爱国者/干预中国革命以及进攻苏联的战争，正沿着帝国主义阴谋的路径发展。
与此同时，蒋介石正忙于指挥30万白军进攻中央苏区，以证明他作为帝国主义屠杀先锋的忠诚。“长期抵抗”或是欺骗抗日群众。但中国的劳苦大众早已认清了帝国主义的阴谋和……的卑躬屈膝。

山西矿工的奴隶生活
在太原市外的东山和西山，大约有50到60个全部采用手工操作的煤矿。矿工被称为“窑黑子”（音译），大多是破产农民或因受地主和高利贷者剥削而逃亡的难民，他们被矿头诱骗，过着比牛马还不如的生活。

Most the blackies are decoyed or kidnapped from the idle peasants,
usually they are contracted to start work from the mid-autumn festival
until the May festival of next year, during which period they lose their
liberty completely and work as cattles.
The mine foremen are to be responsible for the worker recruiting. They
They usually entrap the refugee farmers who run away from their home
either for run having comitted crime or being unable to pay the debts--
people seeking some place where the law is not reaching. Or they dispatch
men to the small highway taverns or inns where they cheat the passing idle
peasants by offering them "job" or borrowing Lending them money. Once the peasants
are entrapped, they could hardly get rid of the dark life as for every
work r, the foremen could get about one or two hundred dollars fr
from the capitalists.
The work in the mine are divided into chopping, carrying and dragging.
Most of the mines are of the open-mine type, but the two mines called Er-
ko(二坑) and San-Ko(三坑) in Tungshen(東神) are having their holes one
Chinese Li(about 2160 ft.) deep, while the 6 mines at Shishon are all d
deeper than four Chinese Li.
For thirteen fourteen hours the "blackies" work a day, by night and day
by turn. The foreman supervises the work with a leather whip. The chopping
work is particularly dangerous, the narrow paths in the mine are rarely
well supported, plus the suffocating coal gas, accidents, are very frequent
happenings in the mine by which many lives are buried either as a result
of explosion or soil collapses. Those who do the carrying work have to
carry hundred catties (about 100 lbs) or more of coal, so half stooped
in four miles of dangerous, darkness, dark pools with oil lamp in mouth
and a short club in hand. They must finish every day the required amount
of work to do every day, never less.
There is one more time called the carrying of "Obligation coal."
Those who should be unable to fulfill the required number of times due to
sickness or physical exhaustion are to be whipped mercilessly, have their
wages or provisions cut. Similar treatment for those who could not carry
the required weight of coal. Frequently, some workers, due to exhaustion,
fail to fulfill the requirements, escape to the innermost mine without food
or go to the inn to eat out until starved to death.
Every blackie in the Tungshen is paid 60 cents a day, but this amount
could never enable them to live without going into debt under the additional
exploitation of the foremen, who supply their daily provisions at a
cost 50% higher than it really worths. In the shishan mines, no cash
wage is paid, every worker is given, instead, twenty or thirty dollars
before he enters the mine, and then during his work, he is paid daily
two catties of flour, half a catty of millet, two lians of oil and a small
quantity of other necessities from the mine office. When they leave the
mine every May festival, each of them is given a suit of summer dress and
a pair of old shoes. That's all they got after a year of hardship and risk
of life. They live in small dirty stone houses by the mountains. Barred
windows and locked doors are equipped in the night to guard them from getting
into contact with the outside world.
Such dark conditions are not only prevailing at Taiyuan, the Capital of
Shansi, but in all mines of Shansi and Suiyuan, for several hundred thousand
sand of enslaved laborers.

牛马。
大多数“黑子”是从游手好闲的农民中诱骗或绑架来的，通常他们被签约从当年中秋节工作到次年五月节，在此期间他们完全失去自由，像牲畜一样劳作。
矿头负责招募工人。他们通常诱骗那些因犯罪或无力偿还债务而逃离家乡的难民——即寻找法律触及不到之地的人。或者他们派人去公路边的小酒馆或旅店，通过提供“工作”或借钱给路过的闲散农民来欺骗他们。一旦农民落入圈套，他们就很难摆脱黑暗的生活，因为每招募一名工人，矿头就能从资本家那里得到大约一两百元。
矿井里的工作分为采掘、搬运和拖运。大多数矿井是露天矿类型，但东神（音译）的两个分别叫二坑和三坑的矿井，其坑洞深达一华里（约2160英尺），而西山的6个矿井深度都超过四华里。
“黑子”们每天轮班工作十三四个小时。矿头用皮鞭监督工作。采掘工作特别危险，矿井内狭窄的通道很少有良好的支撑，加之令人窒息的煤气，矿井事故频繁发生，许多生命因爆炸或土方坍塌而被掩埋。那些从事搬运工作的人必须背负一百斤（约100磅）或更多的煤，在四英里长的危险、黑暗、有积水的坑道中半弯着腰，嘴里衔着油灯，手里拿着短棍。他们必须完成每天要求的定额，绝不能少。
还有一种时间叫做搬运“义务煤”。
那些因生病或体力耗尽而无法完成规定次数的人，将遭到无情的鞭打，并被扣除工资或口粮。对于那些不能搬运规定重量煤炭的人，待遇也是一样。经常有一些工人因精疲力竭无法达到要求，逃到矿井最深处没有食物的地方，或者去旅店吃光存粮直到饿死。
东神的每个“黑子”每天获付60分，但在矿头的额外剥削下，这个数额永远无法让他们不负债生活，矿头提供的日常口粮价格比实际价值高出50%。在西山矿区，不发给现金工资，每个工人在进矿前发给二十或三十元，然后在工作期间，每天从矿务局领取两斤面粉、半斤小米、二两油和少量其他必需品。当他们每年五月节离开矿井时，每人发给一套夏装和一双旧鞋。这就是他们在经历了一年的艰辛和生命危险后得到的全部。他们住在山边肮脏的小石屋里。窗户装有铁栅栏，门在晚上锁上，以防止他们与外界接触。
这种黑暗的情况不仅盛行于太原（山西省会），而且盛行于山西和绥远的所有矿区，涉及数十万被奴役的劳工。

江西和湖北红军势力的推进
随着日本帝国主义在华北侵略的发展，在英国帝国主义的指使下，广东军阀正显露出指责南京无能、或至少是指责其在抗日和剿共运动中充当傀儡的倾向，并正向江西和湖北北进。广东宣布西南七省“联合”（音译）。
西南政务委员会名义上是一个地方组织，实际上是一个独立的政府，它于1月17日发出通电，谴责张学良丢失山海关以及南京政府维持的消极政策。通电最后警告说：“如果南京在抵抗日本侵略方面继续保持消极，西南将无情地联合各省同志和群众，推翻南京独裁政府。”文中表达了明显的反蒋反汪情绪。
与此同时，西南政务委员会决定实现七省联盟：福建、湖南、广东、广西、云南、贵州和四川。（1月16日《申报》）将组织一个南方国防委员会，由广东的陈济棠任主席，广西的李宗仁和福建的蔡廷锴任副主席。寻求军事统一。英国帝国主义将支持飞机并资助这一行动，其中以广九铁路与粤汉铁路接轨为条件的千万贷款是焦点之一。目前正在制造200架飞机以增强实力。（1月31日《申报》）军阀陈济棠、李宗仁、白崇禧和蔡廷锴达成的一项“共同决定”是，将派遣60个团，其中大部分经广东进入江西，另一部分直接进入湖南。（2月7日《中华晚报》）此外，还将发行1000万元债券。大规模的“北伐”正在筹备中。
帝国主义扶持一两个军阀作为傀儡，这在中国已是老惯例。作为支持南京政府两年的结果，美国对华进口贸易已从第三位跃升至第一位。1931年，中国进口贸易中美国占22%，日本占20%，英国占8%（原文不清），而1932年美国占25%，日本占14%，英国占11%。英国帝国主义为了保护其在华侵略，一直是华南军阀的活跃后台，利用广东（原文不清）政府对抗美国的傀儡南京政府。
这也构成了帝国主义瓜分中国的重要一步。随着日本在华北的扩张，英国帝国主义利用其在西藏的傀儡达赖喇嘛，于去年夺取了西康的大部分地区（原文不清），现在又在准备……

Anniversary Of Jan. 28 In Peiping
Mass Meeting At Tien Chiao Market
Arrest Of 18 Girls And Boys Students
Jan. 30 Peiping letter Jan. 28th, the sorrowful anniversary of the
bloody resistance of Japanese Imperialism at Shanghai, is also significant
as the first voluntary cooperation in anti-Imperialist movement of sold-
iers, students and petty civilians, led by the Chinese proletariats. The
KMT government, on such occasions, as a rule, declares martial law in the
major cities.
The peoples anti-Japanese association of Peiping, decides
to hold a mass meeting on Jan. 28 at Tienchiao market to discussing the
peoples' armed guard of Peiping and Tientsin, the opposition of military
fascivism, policy, the path of self-rule, and other important problems.
The ruling class mobilises the whole apparatus of police, gendarmes
and plain clothes men; major passages are guarded to prevent the masses
from forming the mass meeting. In the TienChiao square, every 5 steps are
attended with the armed police, while plainclothes men are numberlessly
scattered. When the "big Ching" strikes one in the afternoon, the street
car station of Tienchiao is gradually crowded with students and workers.
One with a bamboo stick, one with a big banner and an other student are
immediately arrested by the Police. But the meeting starts right on that
moment, the chairman makes a short speech explaining the aim of the meeting
in brief and clear words, revealing the sell-out policy of imperialist--
--. While the 400 participants are listening to it, the surrounding
police suddenly stages a bayonet rush toward the masses. Colorful handbills
are scattered, slogans are shouted, a serious fight ensues with the police-
men. The meeting is dispersed and the chairman together with several others
are arrested.
Not far from Tienchiao, the Hsin Shih-chieh, a district of soldiers
and famine refugees, some 30 students holds there a short meeting. First
a brief speech is made, about one hundred poor people gather up. Then the
group marches along the street shouting slogans as "Down with Japanese
imperialism" "Down with nation-seller Ku!" and "Arm up people to guard Pei-
ping and Tientsin," the toiling masses along the street are very anxious
to read the bills distributed, some even shout spontaneously "Down with
all Japan!" Then a troop of police and soldiers rushes to the crowd and
arrest seven students. The total arrest is 18 students, among which 5 are
girls and most of them are middle school cadets around fifteen or sixteen
years of age.
(End)

北平的一·二八纪念日
天桥市场举行群众大会
18名男女学生被捕

1月30日北平来信 1月28日是日本帝国主义在上海进行血腥抵抗的悲痛周年纪念日，这也是在中国无产阶级领导下，士兵、学生和小市民在反帝运动中首次自愿合作的重要日子。国民党政府在此类场合，通常会在主要城市宣布戒严。

北平民众反日协会决定于1月28日在天桥市场举行群众大会，讨论北平和天津的民众武装自卫、反对军事法西斯主义政策、自治道路以及其他重要问题。

统治阶级动员了全部警察、宪兵和便衣特务机构；主要通道均有守卫，以防止群众聚集举行群众大会。在天桥广场，每五步就有一名武装警察站岗，而便衣特务则无数地散布其中。当下午一点“大钟”敲响时，天桥电车站逐渐挤满了学生和工人。一名手持竹竿者、一名手持大幅标语者以及另一名学生立即被警察逮捕。但会议就在那一刻开始了，主席用简短清晰的语言发表演讲，阐明会议宗旨，揭露帝国主义的卖国政策……。当400名参与者正在聆听时，周围的警察突然向群众发起刺刀冲锋。彩色传单四处散发，口号声此起彼伏，与警察发生了激烈的搏斗。集会被驱散，主席及其他几人被捕。

离天桥不远的新世界地区，这是一个驻军和饥民聚集的区域，约30名学生在那里举行了一个简短的会议。首先发表了一篇简短的演讲，随后大约一百名穷人聚集起来。然后队伍沿街行进，高呼“打倒日本帝国主义”、“打倒卖国贼蒋！”和“武装民众保卫平津”等口号，街上的劳苦大众急切地阅读分发的传单，有些人甚至自发高呼“打倒所有日本人！”随后，一队警察和士兵冲向人群，逮捕了七名学生。总共逮捕了18名学生，其中5名是女生，大多数是十五六岁的中学生学员。
（完）

1) Address to Fraternal Party of France for the 62nd Anniversary of

2) Visiting Lei-shek at Nanchang

ADDRESS TO THE FRATERNAL PARTY OF FRANCE FOR THE
62nd ANNIVERSARY OF PARIS COMMUNE

The c.e.c. of c.p. of China and the Provisional Government of
Soviet Republic of China, have, on Feb. 1y, sent an address to c.p. of
France for the 62nd anniversary of Paris Commune which reads:

Dear Comrade of Communist Party of France:
On this occasion of the 62nd anniversary of the heroic Paris Com-
mune, we, representing all the comrades of the c.p. of China, the
Chinese proletariat and toiling masses, beg to extend to you our hear-
ty revolutionary salutation.
Sixty two years before, on March 18, 1871, the precedents of
French Proletariat which you represent—the heroic Paris Communard wor-
kers, raised up the banner of armed riot, overthrew the bourgeois
"national defence" government and established the first Proletariats'
own government in history,—the Paris Commune. The great Paris Commune
strode a new century for the Proletariat Revolution, wrote the most
glorious page on the history of International Workers' movement and
with its own blood experience, told the proletariats of the whole
world just what is proletariat dictatorship. Despite its many mistakes
despite its eventual collapse amid the "blood-stained week" —— by the
reactionary French bourgeois and the beast-like Prussian military
force, the great Paris Commune had left its most precious experience
and lessons to the world proletariats to live forever in the hearts
of revolutionary workers and the toiling masses. Its historical merit
towards the struggling for liberation of Proletariat as a class is
always existing.
The Sixty Second Anniversary of Paris Commune is marked with the
terrific intensification and sharpening of the world crisis of Capi-
talism, with the commencing of the Second Five Year Plan with which
Soviet Union, the successor of Paris Commune is so gloriously construct-
ing the Proletariat Socialism, with the ever-rising upsurge of prole-
tariat struggles in the capitalistic countries and national liberation
struggles in the colonial lands, with the triumph of the Soviet power
of China over one hundred million of people and with the growing deve-
lopment of the imperialist war to attack Chinese Revolution and inter-
vene U.S.S.R., excited by Japanese Imperialism. With all these, the
anniversary of Paris Commune is particularly significant. In this an-
niversary, the international Proletariat is to learn the revolutionary
lesson and experience of the Paris Commune, to learn the great trium-
phant experience of the proletariat of U.S.S.R., to unite its own st-
rength, to oppose thecapitalistic offense, political reaction and Fa-
scism, to oppose the Imperialist war and the military intervention of
U.S.S.R. and to fight for the Proletariat Dictatorship.

致法国兄弟党巴黎公社62周年纪念日的贺词

中国共产党中央委员会和中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府于2月1y日（原文不清，疑为1日或某日）向法国共产党发送了一份巴黎公社62周年纪念日的贺词，内容如下：

法国共产党的亲爱的同志们：

值此英勇的巴黎公社62周年纪念日之际，我们代表中国共产党全体同志、中国无产阶级和劳苦大众，向你们致以衷心的革命敬礼。

六十二年前的1871年3月18日，你们所代表的法国无产阶级的先驱——英勇的巴黎公社社员工人们，举起了武装起义的旗帜，推翻了资产阶级的“国防”政府，建立了历史上第一个无产阶级自己的政府——巴黎公社。伟大的巴黎公社为无产阶级革命开辟了新纪元，在国际工人运动史上写下了最光辉的一页，并用其自身的血的教训，告诉全世界无产阶级什么是无产阶级专政。尽管它有许多错误，尽管它最终在“流血周”中——被反动的法国资产阶级和野兽般的普鲁士军队——镇压而失败，但伟大的巴黎公社为世界无产阶级留下了最宝贵的经验和教训，永远活在革命工人和劳苦大众的心中。它在争取无产阶级作为一个阶级解放的历史功绩永存。

巴黎公社62周年纪念日正值资本主义世界危机急剧加剧和尖锐化之际，正值巴黎公社的继承者苏联光荣地建设社会主义并开始执行第二个五年计划之际，正值资本主义国家无产阶级斗争和殖民地民族解放斗争不断高涨之际，正值中国苏维埃政权在一亿多人民中取得胜利之际，也正值在日本帝国主义煽动下，旨在攻击中国革命和干涉苏联的帝国主义战争日益发展之际。鉴于所有这些情况，巴黎公社纪念日具有特别重要的意义。在这个纪念日，国际无产阶级要学习巴黎公社的革命教训和经验，学习苏联无产阶级的伟大胜利经验，团结自身力量，反对资本主义进攻、政治反动和法西斯主义，反对帝国主义战争和对苏联的军事干涉，并为无产阶级专政而战。

On the 62nd anniversary of Paris Commune, we are, particularly, to concentrate our effort and direct our strength to mobilize under the leadership of proletariat, the vast masses in the Soviet Districts and the white districts of China for the firm opposition of International Imperialism and its puppet, N.K.M.T., for the struggle for the liberation of Chinese nation and people, and for the complete victory of Soviet China.

Dear Comrades of France! Our common enemy is the International Imperialism, particularly the French Imperialism and its running dog, Chinese Kuomintang! The French bourgeoisie, the executioner of Paris Commune, embodied now in French Imperialism is the organizer and vanguard of the imperialist campaign against Soviet Union, the fatherland of world proletariat. The French Imperialism, under the direct assistance of its loyal servant Social Fascist, has not only unified all of the European anti-Soviet forces, led and organized Poland, Rumania, Czechoslovakia, Balkan states and Baltic States to carry on the lunatic direct preparation for the military intervention of U.S.S.R., but also rendered direct help to the Imperialist venture of Far East, the Japanese Imperialism, which, together with the consistent policy of subservience of the Chinese N.K.M.T. government, has already completed in Manchuria the base for attack of Soviet Union, organized the bandit troop of White Russia and carried out various shameless offense. The White Russians in Paris, under the direct instruction of French military attaché, openly carried out various anti-Soviet activities and challenges. The war of anti-Soviet has never been so pressing and dangerous!

The executioner of Paris Commune, the French Imperialism, is also the enemy of Chinese workers and peasants masses, the fiercest suppressor of Soviet Revolution of China and the supporter of the bloody rule of KMT. The French Imperialism, with her money, exploited from French proletariat and other slave-toiling instrument as arms, cannons and battleships, has afforded effective help to the reactionary KMT to suppress the First Soviet Revolution in the year 1927—Canton Commune! With its army, navy, air force and artillery supported to suppress the national salvation struggle in Indo-China, the French Imperialism has bombed down the Soviet government in Kiangsi, directly killed numberless Soviet citizens and restored the reactionary rule of Imperialist-KMT at Lungchow! Since the occupation of Manchuria on Sept. 18, 1931, the Japanese Imperialism has met the open assistance and support of French Imperialism on its job of wholesale slaughter of Chinese people, cruel suppression of Chinese Revolution, bombing and occupation of Shanghai, Shanhaikwan, Jehol and North China, and every other imperialist deeds. The military industry of France is working on double rate for the help of Japanese Imperialism. The diplomats of France are making open speech at Geneva supporting Japanese Imperialism, active from the plot of partition of China, attack of the Chinese Soviet and armed intervention of U.S.S.R. Utilizing the imperialist privileges and concessions at Shanghai, Tientsin, Hankow

在巴黎公社62周年纪念日之际，我们要特别集中努力， directing our strength（原文此处似有缺漏或语序混乱，意为“引导我们的力量”），在无产阶级领导下，动员中国苏区和白区的广大民众，坚决反对国际帝国主义及其傀儡南京国民政府（N.K.M.T.），为中华民族和人民的解放而斗争，为实现苏维埃中国的完全胜利而斗争。

法国的亲爱的同志们！我们共同的敌人是国际帝国主义，特别是法国帝国主义及其走狗中国国民党！作为巴黎公社刽子手的法国资产阶级，如今体现为法国帝国主义，它是反对世界无产阶级祖国苏联的帝国主义运动的组织者和先锋。法国帝国主义在其忠实仆从社会法西斯分子的直接协助下，不仅统一了所有欧洲反苏势力，领导并组织波兰、罗马尼亚、捷克斯洛伐克、巴尔干国家和波罗的海国家疯狂地直接准备对苏联进行军事干涉，而且还直接援助远东的帝国主义冒险事业——日本帝国主义。日本帝国主义与中国南京国民政府（N.K.M.T.）一贯的屈从政策相结合，已经在满洲完成了进攻苏联的基地，组织了白俄匪帮，并进行了各种无耻的进攻。在巴黎的白俄分子在法国武官的直接指示下，公开进行各种反苏活动和挑衅。反苏战争从未如此紧迫和危险！

巴黎公社的刽子手法国帝国主义，也是中国工农群众的敌人，是中国苏维埃革命最残酷的镇压者和国民党血腥统治的支持者。法国帝国主义利用从法国无产阶级和其他奴隶般劳动工具身上剥削来的金钱，以及武器、大炮和战舰，为反动国民党在1927年镇压第一次苏维埃革命——广州公社——提供了有效帮助。法国帝国主义以其陆海空军和炮兵支持镇压印度支那的救国斗争，轰炸了江西的苏维埃政府，直接杀害了无数苏维埃公民，并在龙州恢复了帝国主义-国民党的反动统治。自1931年9月18日占领满洲以来，日本帝国主义在对中国人民的大规模屠杀、残酷镇压中国革命、轰炸和占领上海、山海关、热河和华北以及其他一切帝国主义行径中，得到了法国帝国主义的公开援助和支持。法国的军事工业正以双倍的速度运转以援助日本帝国主义。法国外交官在日内瓦发表公开演讲支持日本帝国主义，积极参与瓜分中国、攻击中国苏维埃和武装干涉苏联的阴谋。利用在上海、天津、汉口

and Canton, the French Imperialists are mobilizing all their army,
navy, police, spies and gendarmes to suppress and destroy the strikes,
demonstrations, assemblies and other revolutionary struggles of the
Chinese workers and toiling masses. They arrest, torture, and kill
revolutionary masses and leaders, especially members of Communist Par-
ty. French Imperialists, organize and fund the Chinese reactionaries to carry out

es. The Shanghai settlement, Tientsin concession and all other

Comrades, we completely believe that without the destruction of
French and International Imperialism, Imperialist war as well as the
armed intervention of U.S.S.R. will not be stopped. Without the de-
struction of French and International Imperialism, the liberation of
French and Chinese people will not be secured, although the revolu-
tion in China will not be perfectly gained. But, without your help,
without our help of revolutionary struggle against the French Imperi-
alists, we the workers and peasants of China will not be able to suc-
ceed in combating the Imperialism and will not be able to win vic-
tory!

Comrades! Every strike you organize, every revolutionary action,
every anti-Imperialist war demonstration, and resistance to the mili-
tarism, every opposition to the Imperialist war, is a direct, direct help to the Chinese Federal Revolutionary war, to
the development of Chinese Soviet and Red Army. The Chinese workers
and peasants are ready to send you full enthusiasm and sympathy in
response to your every triumph, or sign in your revolutionary struggle,
every call and action you lead to oppose the Imperialists and to sup-
port the U.S.S.R., every campaign for fight against war and against
parliament and every enlargement and strengthening of our revolu-
tionary files. Comrades! Unite the more! Fight closer and closer with
us in their economical and political struggles! Struggle against op-
position of Imperialist war, support of Soviet Union and support of
Soviet China! Only through you that the Proletariat of France can in-
herit and develop the great undertakings of the Paris Commune and
the establishment of Soviet France! Comrades, rise higher under the flag
of Leninism! Fight harder to realize the revolutionary duty before
you! Victory will belong to us, the proletarians and the toiling mass-
es! We shout:
Celebrate the Great Paris Commune!
Support the Fatherland of World Proletariat--U.S.S.R.!
Oppose the Imp. war and the armed intervention of Soviet Union!
Down with French Imp., International Imp. and their running
dog--Kuomintang of China!
Long live the International Union of Proletariat!
Long live the World Revolution!
Long live the C.P. of France, long live the C.P. of China!

C.E.C. of Communist Party of China.
The Government of the R. of Soviet China.    Feb.19,1933

以及广州，法国帝国主义者正动员其全部陆军、海军、警察、间谍和宪兵，以镇压和摧毁中国工人及劳苦大众的罢工、示威、集会和其他革命斗争。他们逮捕、折磨并杀害革命群众和领袖，特别是共产党成员。法国帝国主义者组织和资助中国反动派，实施针对中国苏维埃和英勇的红军及群众的法西斯阴谋。上海租界、天津租界以及中国所有其他租界既是反苏活动的场所，同时也是帝国主义的基地，而中国苏维埃的革命根据地则日益发展壮大。

同志们，我们完全相信，如果不摧毁法国和国际帝国主义，帝国主义战争以及对苏联的武装干涉就不会停止。如果不摧毁法国和国际帝国主义，法国和中国人民的解放就无法得到保障，尽管中国的革命尚未完全取得胜利。但是，如果没有你们的帮助，没有我们在反对法国帝国主义的革命斗争中的互助，我们中国的工农将无法成功对抗帝国主义，也无法赢得胜利！

同志们！你们组织的每一次罢工、每一次革命行动、每一次反帝战争示威以及对军国主义的抵抗，每一次反对帝国主义战争的举动，都是对中国联邦革命战争、对中国苏维埃和红军发展的直接、直接的帮助。中国工农准备以饱满的热情和同情来回应你们的每一次胜利或革命斗争中的迹象，响应你们领导的每一次反对帝国主义和支持苏联的号召与行动，响应每一次反战和反对议会的运动，以及我们革命队伍的每一次扩大和加强。同志们！更加团结起来！在经济和政治斗争中与我们更紧密地并肩战斗！斗争反对帝国主义战争，支持苏联，支持中国苏维埃！只有通过你们，法国无产阶级才能继承和发展巴黎公社的伟大事业，并建立法兰西苏维埃！同志们，在列宁主义的旗帜下更高地崛起！更加努力地去实现摆在你们面前的革命责任！胜利将属于我们，属于无产阶级和劳苦大众！我们高呼：
庆祝伟大的巴黎公社！
支持世界无产阶级的祖国——苏联！
反对帝国主义战争和对苏联的武装干涉！
打倒法国帝国主义、国际帝国主义及其走狗——中国国民党！
无产阶级国际联盟万岁！
世界革命万岁！
法国共产党万岁，中国共产党万岁！
共产主义国际万岁！
中国共产党中央执行委员会。
中华苏维埃共和国政府。 1933年2月19日

and Imperialists
Stop surrender to Red Army by "Willing"
But new triumph to Red Army

With danger of Imperialist partition of China more pressing on
fall of Shanghai, the soviet government of China, in order to effect
a general anti-Japanese Imperialist movement among the toiling masses,
issued a manifesto on Jan. 10 to the effect that under the following
three conditions, the soviet power is willing to cooperate with any
force to resist the Japanese Imperialistic Invasion:
(a) Immediate cessation of the advance against the soviet districts
(b) Immediate granting of democratic rights to the people (right of
assembly, organization, freespeech, press, etc.)
(c) Immediate arming of the people, the creation of armed volunteer
detachments to struggle for the defence, independence and unity
of China.

But the Kuomintang's answer to this manifesto is a more severe
attack against the workers' and peasants' red army. Because "if the
Nanking Government sent a large number of troops to the North after a
compromise with the Chinese Red troops, they might lose the sympathy
of the foreign powers who have a great interest in the provinces along
the Yangtze; therefore "the leading members of Nanking government de-
cided to decline the proposal (by p.c. . of Soviet Government) on ac-
count of the present situation) (the development of Red Army---c.w.c.),
when the "foreign influence" Japanese information bureau") and concentrate
its effort in fighting against the Red Army, for the common benefit of
Imperialists and self.

Half month has been elapsed since Chiang Kai-shek's arrival at
Nanchang. He shouted in a mass meeting on Jan. 30, "we are inconsistent
with the red bandits, either they or we should perish." An "anti-
Communist Year" movement is being staged in Kiangsi. Chiang's answer
to the call of China Soviet Government and the Revolutionary Military
Council of the workers' and peasants' red armies for the united front
against Imperialism is only a doubled effort in attacking soviet China,
especially the central soviet district, with all the landlords, battle
ships of Imperialists, and 300 thousand soldiers mobilized,---to full-
fill his function as the way-clearer for the suppression of Chinese
Revolution and partition of China by the Imperialists.

Another reactionary mobilization is that the Rail Ministry of Finance
has decided to issue from March 20,000,000 dollars of lottery tickets
for airplane and highway, and starting from February, a movement is
being carried out to raise 1,500 airplanes for military use. Recently,
selling the Canton-Hankow and the Changsha-Nungkiang railways, the
National government gains 40,050,000 and 50,000,000 for communist
suppression. Besides, seven economic blockade is being enforced string-
ently, particularly on salt, against the soviet district. Even people
in non-soviet districts are limited in everyday material supply, "the
Fukien people beside the Chingkang(井冈) soviet district are allowed to
buy one catty (about 1.3 lb.) of salt each time, other things are also
restricted."(Sun Pao Feb. 11) This is due to the frequent supply of

帝国主义对苏维埃政府的联合攻击
“自愿”向红军投降被制止
但红军取得新的胜利

随着帝国主义瓜分中国的危险在上海陷落后愈发紧迫，中国苏维埃政府为了在劳苦大众中发动广泛的反日本帝国主义运动，于1月10日发布宣言，表示在以下三个条件下，苏维埃政权愿意与任何力量合作以抵抗日本帝国主义的侵略：
(a) 立即停止对苏区的进攻
(b) 立即给予人民民主权利（集会、结社、言论、出版自由等）
(c) 立即武装民众，创建武装志愿分队，为保卫中国的独立和统一而斗争。

然而，国民党对这一宣言的回应是对工农红军更严厉的攻击。因为“如果南京政府在与中共红军妥协后派遣大量部队北上，他们可能会失去那些在长江沿岸省份拥有重大利益的外国列强的同情；因此‘南京政府的主要成员决定鉴于当前局势（红军的发展——编者注）拒绝（苏维埃政府的提议）’”，并在“外国影响”（日本情报局）下，集中力量打击红军，以符合帝国主义和其自身的共同利益。

蒋介石抵达南昌已半月有余。他在1月30日的一次群众集会上高呼：“我们与赤匪势不两立，非彼亡即我亡。”江西正在上演一场“反共年”运动。蒋介石对中国苏维埃政府和工农红军革命军事委员会关于建立反帝统一战线的呼吁的回答，只是加倍努力攻击中国苏维埃，特别是中央苏区，动员了所有地主、帝国主义的战舰和三十万士兵，以履行其作为镇压中国革命和协助帝国主义瓜分中国的清道夫职能。

另一项反动动员是铁道部和财政部决定从3月20日起发行2000万美元的航空和公路彩票，并从2月开始开展筹集1500架军用飞机的运动。最近，国民政府通过出售粤汉铁路和长沙-宁江铁路，获得了40,050,000元和50,000,000元用于剿共。此外，七道经济封锁线正在严格执行，特别是针对苏区的食盐封锁。甚至非苏区人们的日常物资供应也受到限制，“毗邻井冈苏区的福建百姓每次只允许购买一斤（约1.3磅）盐，其他物品也受到限制。”（《申报》2月11日）这是由于边境农民频繁向

According to report from Nanchang, Chiang Kai-shek in Nanchang
has gathered a group of landlords expelled from the Soviet districts, to
form a committee called "Reclamation Committee" which is supposed to
govern over every city or village conquered.
What annoys the officers is the unwillingness of the White soldiers
to fight. A cruel "vertical and horizontal system" has been worked out
to drive the soldiers to fight on machine gun points. The horizontal
system sees that soldiers and units of the same fighting rank should
be so related as to advance and retreat simultaneously, otherwise all
of the horizontal rank has to be shot. The vertical system requires the
uniformity in action in every fighting unit, death is the only penalty.
Such oppression only arouses rebellion on the bigger scale, soldiers
are often found to revolt by whole regiments or battalions. On the beginning of last month, a complete regiment under Chen Chung-Hao (陳仲豪)
ofzechuan moved to the 4th Red Army when they fought in Pa-Chung(巴中)
(the regimental chief was shot) "At Hosheng Chiao(火燒橋), 150 Li east
of Anyin Lake) two complete regiments of Fifth and Sixth Division revolted, meaning to Haiyang(海陽)(from the back side i.e. eastern
sides) Annyu lake is a base of the Hunan Soviet District.
Also the White 28th Division on
the border of Chekiang and Fukien, refused to be dispatched to Kiangsi
to fight the Red Army and two regiments of it revolted at Taishun(泰順)
Every possible means has been mobilized by itself, under the open and
direct assistance of Imperialism, to attack the Chinese Revolution, to
fight against the workers, peasants and soldiers masses of the whole
nation. But half month in Kiangsi, Chiang Kai-shek has won nothing but
only to see Kwangtsch (光澤) and Tsungpu(崇浦) of North Fukien fallen
into the hands of heroic Red Armies. (reb. 12 China Evening Post) whom
does the final triumph belongs to; them?

据南昌报道，蒋介石在南昌召集了一群被逐出苏区的地主，组成一个名为“垦殖委员会”的组织，旨在管辖每一个被征服的城市或村庄。
令军官们恼火的是白军士兵不愿作战。一种残酷的“纵横连坐法”被制定出来，迫使士兵在机枪口下作战。横向连坐法规定，同一战斗层级的士兵和单位必须同时进退，否则该横向层级的所有人均将被枪决。纵向连坐法要求每个战斗单位行动一致，违者唯一刑罚是死刑。这种压迫只会引发更大规模的叛乱，经常发现整团或整营的士兵起义。上个月初，陈仲豪率领的一个完整团在巴中作战时投奔了红四方面军（团长被枪决）。“在安阴湖以东150里的火烧桥，第五和第六师的两个完整团起义，意图前往海阳（从背面即东侧）。安阴湖是湖南苏维埃区的基地。
此外，位于浙江和福建边境的白军第28师拒绝被派往江西攻打红军，其两个团在泰顺起义。
在帝国主义的公开和直接援助下，各方动员了一切可能的手段来攻击中国革命，对抗全国的工农兵群众。但在江西半个月，蒋介石一无所获，反而目睹闽北的光泽和崇浦落入英勇的红军手中。（2月12日《字林西报》晚刊）最终胜利属于谁？是他们吗？

CHINESE WORKER'S CORRESPONDENCE VOL III NO 59 MAR. 1, 1933
Bernard Shaw's Visit to China
Big Gum Factory Disaster in Shanghai

BERNARD SHAW'S VISIT TO CHINA
"Warm welcome by the people and revolutionary press
Cold reproof from the imperialists and their tools"
"Chinese people should choose for their rulers not
a actor or a feudal baron" says Shaw
Dr. Sun Yat-sen suggests "leaving Shaw to himself".

Bernard Shaw in his world tour passed Shanghai on Feb. 17. The workers masses and revolutionary writers prepared a warm welcome for him. But, as he passed Hongkong, he made the following address to the Chinese students of Hongkong:
"If you are not a red revolutionaryst at your year of 20, you will be most hopeless fossil at your age of 50. If you are a red revolutionist at your age of 20, you will have a chance of living up to date on your age of forty."
To this, all the newspapers in Shanghai published in bold headlines "Bernard Shaw Demands Communism". Actually, the Shanghai Municipal Council (Imperialist city government) of the International Settlement among other things, were alarmed. In addition to this, Shaw has actually expressed his feeling of sympathy with the cause of communism and stated so in no uncertain terms in his speech at Hongkong. It was natural that Kuomintang who had once upon a time persecuted and had to lose writers and intellectuals associated with him, be afraid of the revolutionary writer. This was also proved,--only thus can it be understood why the police and gangsters. It is worthwhile to mention here, by the way, that the exercise of white terror in China has been so intensified that the ruling class arranges kidnappings and murders of revolutionary leaders even publicly on occasions such as the welcome of Bernard Shaw. A recent example could be cited is the arrest of two revolutionary students who were just walking out from a show at the movies movie "Road to Life". Thus Shaw has almost lost his life by stepping on this land of savages.
Shaw's movement is everywhere made in life without need in agitation or even direct discussion. The shameless of organ papers, however class, instead of the poor spread by the imperialists..., the plan of revolution any call necessitates riot & routh on the occasion of the arrival of 'oratory' opinion of the International anti-imperialism League, G. Bernard Shaw. On the bund of the Huangpoo River, handbills of various colors were distributed among the revolutionary masses waiting for Shaw, slogans were printed both in English and Extra Chinese: "Welcome Shaw, the revolutionary artist; Welcome Shaw the sympathiser of Chinese Independence and liberation; Welcome Shaw the Anti-Imperialist forward; Down with imperialism to welcome Shaw; Oppose Japanese invasion of North China to welcome Shaw; Oppose..."

《中国工人通讯》第三卷第59期 1933年3月1日
萧伯纳访华
上海大英烟公司灾难

萧伯纳访华
“受到民众和革命报刊的热烈欢迎
遭到帝国主义者及其工具的冷遇斥责”
萧伯纳称“中国人不应选择演员或封建男爵作为统治者”
孙逸仙博士建议“让萧伯纳自便”。

萧伯纳在其环球旅行中于2月17日途经上海。工人群众和革命作家为他准备了热烈的欢迎。但是，当他途经香港时，他对香港的中国学生发表了如下演讲：
“如果你在20岁时不是红色革命者，那么你在50岁时将成为最无可救药的化石。如果你在20岁时是红色革命者，那么你在40岁时就有机会跟上时代。”
对此，上海所有报纸都以醒目头条刊登“萧伯纳要求共产主义”。实际上，公共租界的工部局（帝国主义市政府）等机构感到惊慌。此外，萧伯纳确实表达了对共产主义事业的同情，并在香港的演讲中毫不含糊地陈述了这一点。曾经迫害并不得不失去与他有关的作家和知识分子的国民党害怕这位革命作家，这也是自然的。这也得到了证实——只有这样，才能理解为何警察和流氓……在此顺便一提，值得提到的是，中国的白色恐怖如此加剧，以至于统治阶级甚至在诸如欢迎萧伯纳这样的场合公开安排绑架和谋杀革命领袖。最近的一个例子是两名刚从电影《生路》放映场走出来的革命学生被捕。因此，萧伯纳踏上这片野蛮之地几乎丧命。
萧伯纳的行踪处处充满生机，无需煽动甚至直接讨论。然而，各阶级御用报刊的无耻之徒……由帝国主义者散布的并非穷人的……任何革命计划或号召都需要在‘演说家’、国际反帝同盟、G. 萧伯纳到达之际引发骚乱和混乱。在黄浦江外滩，各种颜色的传单被分发到等待萧伯纳的革命群众手中，标语用英文和中文印刷：“欢迎革命艺术家萧伯纳；欢迎同情中国独立和解放的萧伯纳；欢迎反帝先锋萧伯纳；打倒帝国主义以欢迎萧伯纳；反对日本入侵华北以欢迎萧伯纳；反对……”

of alleged sorority. What is more daring is a slander spread by the "Hsi

put one in a position of supporting the Nanking Government by utilizing
his style, "A good ruler is never popular with the people." And the

Unfortunately, these only serve to prove that Nanking will never be
"popular" with the people and that the imperialists and KMT are always
cooperating to overthrow the Soviet Districts and the Soviet Government, the
revolutionary and independence movement of China.

New Left Standard for Peking on the same day: Information comes
from Peking proves that the Chinese ruling class and its running dogs"
are only far more skill, e.g. Reuters wire on Feb. 21: "Dr.
Hu Shih says on the eve of Shaw's arrival at Peiping that he thinks
the best welcome to such a distinguished guest being to leave him to
himself and let him do all or any one he likes to. The British Consul-
General there has resolved not to receive him." It is significant that it
is so blatantly ori, indeed from a display of what... and Shanghai, that they
could not be easily made to be a decoration agent for the white terror of
China. And more, again, a story is involved.

That the world-famous Dr. Hu Shih has for years been a tool
of imperialism and Chinese landlords is well known fact. But
recently, he has advanced a step or two in his role as a
"Young Marshal". Recently, the China Weekly Review published an article
by him which is full of lies and slanders against the Soviet Union and the
Chinese Soviet Republic. He even went so far as to say that the Soviet
Union is a "dictatorship" and that the Chinese Soviet Republic is a "bandit
regime". He also tried to justify the Nanking Government's policy of
"encirclement and suppression" against the Red Army. He even went so far
as to say that the Red Army is a "bandit army" and that the Soviet
Republic is a "bandit regime". He also tried to justify the Nanking
Government's policy of "encirclement and suppression" against the Red Army.

However, the truth is that the Soviet Union is a socialist country and
the Chinese Soviet Republic is a revolutionary regime. The Red Army is a
revolutionary army and the Soviet Republic is a revolutionary regime. The
Nanking Government is a reactionary regime and its policy of "encirclement
and suppression" is a reactionary policy. Dr. Hu Shih's article is a
reactionary article and his words are reactionary words. He is a reactionary
intellectual and his actions are reactionary actions. He is a traitor to the
Chinese people and his words are traitorous words. He is a tool of
imperialism and his actions are tools of imperialism. He is a lackey of the
Nanking Government and his words are lackey words. He is a enemy of the
Chinese people and his words are enemy words. He is a enemy of the
revolution and his words are enemy words. He is a enemy of the Soviet
Union and his words are enemy words. He is a enemy of the Chinese Soviet
Republic and his words are enemy words. He is a enemy of the Red Army
and his words are enemy words. He is a enemy of the Chinese people and
his words are enemy words. He is a enemy of the revolution and his words
are enemy words. He is a enemy of the Soviet Union and his words are
enemy words. He is a enemy of the Chinese Soviet Republic and his words
are enemy words. He is a enemy of the Red Army and his words are enemy
words.

In the other letter, another man was described as a counter-revolutionary. And actually, information has leaked out that the five political prisoners
who were arrested shortly after such is the world-famous
Dr. Hu-Shih, secretly informed the "Civilization" police
simply out of fear lest they should say anything unfavorable to "his
government" and he was told to tell them all about his dirty tricks.

The European and American workers might have heard much of this Dr.
Hu Shih of China. Here is a chance of knowing him more closely!

《中国日报》（China Daily News）试探“北平”方面，意图以所谓的女性联谊会取而代之。更为大胆的是，“西联通讯社”（Hsi Union Press）散布诽谤言论，称中国记者整体上不赞成反帝路线。据说，该报还试图利用其笔法，将某人置于支持南京政府的立场，声称“良吏从不为民所喜”。此外，《中国日报》刊登了一则故事，讲述刘（Luu）如何斥责红军和共产党为匪徒。

BIG GUNS TALK BY LIBERALISM IN SHANGHAI
Capitalists have profits before workers
death and wounded roll over 400
workers demand self-inspection of factories

Two successive big, destructive disasters took place in workers of textile
mill on Feb. 21 and 27, with more than 30 dead, 50 seriously wounded. The
dead and wounded are not yet paid any pension whatever.

As the winter season is drawing near to its end, the air is very
cold and dry. The fire hazard is increased and the danger of explosion
is also great. In order to prevent such disasters, the factory owners should
take necessary precautions. But they do not care for the safety of the
workers or factory, a number of explosions or fire disasters have occurred,
and a lot of workers have been killed or injured in these disasters.

The first accident happened in the Chen-Hsi Cotton Factory on Feb. 21.
At about 10 o'clock in the morning, a big explosion occurred in the
cotton warehouse. The whole building was destroyed and 17 workers were
killed and 30 wounded. This is called "accident inspection."

Workers should be protected from the same kind of accidents in the
factory. The owners of the buildings should be responsible for the safety
of the workers and the buildings. But they do not care for the safety of
the workers and the buildings. They only care for their own profits.
This kind of accident exists everywhere.

At about 10 o'clock in the morning, a big explosion occurred in the
warehouse of the Chen-Hsi Cotton Factory. The whole building was destroyed
and 17 workers were killed and 30 wounded. Only a few minutes later, the
building immediately collapsed and buried the workers under the ruins.
Practically everyone in the building was killed or injured. The disaster
was so great that the whole factory was destroyed. The workers who were
killed or injured were not paid any pension whatever. The factory owners
did not care for the safety of the workers. They only cared for their own
profits. This kind of accident exists everywhere.

After the disaster, the workers and their families began to demand
compensation for the dead and wounded. But the factory owners refused to
pay any compensation. They said that the accident was caused by the workers'
carelessness. But the workers said that the accident was caused by the
factory owners' negligence. The workers demanded that the factory owners
should be punished for their negligence. But the factory owners refused to
be punished. They said that they were not responsible for the accident.
The workers were very angry. They decided to go on strike. They demanded
that the factory owners should pay compensation for the dead and wounded,
and that they should be punished for their negligence. The factory owners
refused to meet the workers' demands. The workers were very angry. They
decided to go on strike. They demanded that the factory owners should pay
compensation for the dead and wounded, and that they should be punished for
their negligence. The factory owners refused to meet the workers' demands.

Within one week, another disaster of the similar
kind happened in a similar way, no industrial and factory which has passed
the Factory Inspection, the disaster happened 11 a.m., Feb 27
when the machinery exploded and building collapsed. 17 dead and 32 wounded
all the people, killed by the Yangtze capitalist, shortly after the accident,
anxiously denied the unreasonable accusation of the shortage of
oil in the motor room as the main cause of the burning of gasoline in
the vanishing time, hence the disaster.

This explosion naturally explodes off all the Imperialist-Capitalist
existing mask--they "protect" social equipment for labors in
China!

For the Chen-Hsi incident, the Provisional Soviet Government of China
issued a manifesto pointing out the cruelty of the Imperialist-self exploi-
tation of the toiling masses, the improvement for the workers in the Soviet
District and call for the struggle for the security of the lives of the
workers, labor insurance, etc., especially those workers as in mines or
railways, where there are more risks.

The families of the dead workers have organized up and are demanding
$1,000 for every dead, and, a "workers' self factory inspection" movement
is being launched, calling all the factory workers in Shanghai as well as
workers in whole nation to struggle for the security of workers' life and
labor insurance.
(End)
pages.zh:
上海自由主义者的空谈
资本家将利润置于工人之前
死伤人数超过400人
工人要求对工厂进行自查

2月21日和27日，纺织厂工人接连遭遇两次大规模破坏性灾难，造成30多人死亡，50人重伤。死伤者至今未获得任何抚恤金。

随着冬季接近尾声，空气非常寒冷干燥。火灾隐患增加，爆炸危险也很大。为了防止此类灾难，工厂主应采取必要的预防措施。但他们并不关心工人或工厂的安全，已发生多起爆炸或火灾事故，许多工人在这些灾难中丧生或受伤。

第一起事故发生在2月21日的陈希（Chen-Hsi，音译）棉纺厂。上午10点左右，棉花仓库发生大爆炸。整栋建筑被毁，17名工人死亡，30人受伤。这被称为“事故检查”。

工人应受到保护，以免在工厂内遭受同类事故。建筑物所有者应对工人和建筑物的安全负责。但他们并不关心工人和建筑物的安全。他们只关心自己的利润。这类事故随处可见。

上午10点左右，陈希（Chen-Hsi，音译）棉纺厂的仓库发生大爆炸。整栋建筑被毁，17名工人死亡，30人受伤。仅几分钟后，建筑物立即倒塌，将工人埋在废墟之下。楼内几乎所有人均死伤。灾难如此严重，整个工厂都被摧毁。死伤工人未获得任何抚恤金。工厂主不关心工人的安全。他们只关心自己的利润。这类事故随处可见。

灾难发生后，工人及其家属开始要求对死伤者进行赔偿。但工厂主拒绝支付任何赔偿。他们称事故是由工人的疏忽造成的。但工人称事故是由工厂主的过失造成的。工人要求惩罚工厂主的过失。但工厂主拒绝接受惩罚。他们声称对事故不负责任。工人们非常愤怒。他们决定罢工。他们要求工厂主赔偿死伤者，并因过失受到惩罚。工厂主拒绝满足工人的要求。工人们非常愤怒。他们决定罢工。他们要求工厂主赔偿死伤者，并因过失受到惩罚。工厂主拒绝满足工人的要求。

一周之内，另一起类似性质的灾难以类似方式发生，没有一家工业或工厂通过了工厂检查，灾难发生于2月27日上午11点，当时机器爆炸，建筑物倒塌。17人死亡，32人受伤，所有人皆被长江（Yangtze，此处指代在华）资本家所害，事故发生后不久，他们焦急地否认关于电机房缺油是导致汽油在瞬间燃烧从而引发灾难的主要原因的不合理指控。

这次爆炸自然揭下了所有帝国主义-资本家现有的面具——他们在中国“保护”劳工的社会设施！

针对陈希（Chen-Hsi，音译）事件，中国临时苏维埃政府发表宣言，指出帝国主义自我剥削对劳苦大众的残酷性，介绍苏区工人的改善情况，并号召为争取工人生命安全、劳动保险等进行斗争，特别是那些在矿山或铁路等风险较高领域的工人。

遇难工人家属已组织起来，要求每名死者赔偿1,000美元，一场“工人自行检查工厂”的运动正在发起，号召上海乃至全国的工厂工人为争取工人生命安全和劳动保险而斗争。
（完）
